  }),

  // CLAIM MANIFEST (Change 1, step 1 of the gate): the claim-checker
  // records every extracted claim BEFORE grading anything. The server
  // assigns the stable IDs (CC-001, CC-002, … in the order claims are
  // submitted — Walter's extraction order) and writes claim-manifest.md
  // into the job folder. Re-saving the identical manifest (a retry) is a
  // no-op that returns the same IDs; submitting a different manifest for
  // a job that already has one is a reconciliation failure — the gate
  // fails closed and the job is marked GRADING INCOMPLETE.
  save_claim_manifest: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      taskId: z.string().min(1),
      claims: z.array(z.object({
        text: z.string().trim().min(1).max(4000),
        sources: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(1000)).max(20).default([]),
        role: claimRole,

    }),
    response: claimManifestResult,
    privileged: [privileged.writeClaimGateFile],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof claimManifestResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task) return { ok: false, error: "That job could not be found.", reconciliation: null };
      if (!isResearchGateTask(task)) return { ok: false, error: "A claim manifest belongs to a Research Department case — this job is not one.", reconciliation: null };
      const existing = (await loadClaimGate(ctx, task.id)).manifest;
      if (existing.length > 0) {
        const identical = existing.length === args.claims.length && existing.every((entry, index) => {
          const submitted = args.claims[index];
          return submitted !== undefined && entry.claimText === submitted.text && entry.role === submitted.role
            && JSON.stringify(parseSourceRefs(entry.sourceRefs)) === JSON.stringify(submitted.sources);
        });
        if (identical) {
          const { manifest, grades } = await loadClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
          const lab = await loadLabExtras(ctx, task.id);
          return { ok: true, manifest: claimGradingState(task.id, manifest, grades, computeReconciliation(manifest, grades), lab).manifest, reconciliation: computeReconciliation(manifest, grades) };
        }
        const recon = await applyClaimGate(ctx, task.id, ["A different claim manifest was submitted for a job that already has one — manifest IDs are stable per job, so the new manifest was rejected as a reconciliation failure and the recorded manifest stands."]);
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `The claim-checker tried to replace the claim manifest on “${task.title}” with a different one.         ctx.invalidateQueries();
        return { ok: false, error: "This job already has a claim manifest, and the one submitted differs from it. Manifest IDs are stable per job: grade the recorded manifest (call get_claim_grading_state to see it), or the job stays GRADING INCOMPLETE.", reconciliation: recon };
      }
      const now = new Date();
      for (const [index, claim] of args.claims.entries()) {
        await db.insert(schema.claimManifestEntries).values({
          taskId: task.id, claimId: claimIdForPosition(index), claimText: claim.text, sourceRefs: JSON.stringify(claim.sources), role: claim.role, position: index, createdAt: now,
        });
      }
      await writeClaimGateFiles(ctx, task);
      const recon = await applyClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `The claim-checker recorded the claim manifest for “${task.title}”: ${args.claims.length} claims (${claimIdForPosition(0)}–${claimIdForPosition(args.claims.length - 1)}), each with its sources and role. Grading proceeds in chunks of at most ${CLAIM_CHUNK_SIZE}.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      const { manifest, grades } = await loadClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
      const lab = await loadLabExtras(ctx, task.id);
      return { ok: true, manifest: claimGradingState(task.id, manifest, grades, recon, lab).manifest, reconciliation: recon };
    },
  }),

  // CHUNKED GRADING (Change 1, step 2 of the gate): one call saves one
  // chunk of at most 15 grades — chunk N covers exactly the manifest
  // positions N*15+1 … N*15+15, in order, so chunks are deterministic and
  // a resume always knows which chunk comes next. Each grade is one
  // terminal disposition with its one-line reason (UNGRADED always
  // requires its specific reason). Grades persist as the chunk completes;
  // re-saving the same disposition for an ID is a no-op, and a conflicting
  // disposition, an unknown ID, or a claim in the wrong chunk rejects the
  // whole chunk and records a reconciliation failure (fail closed).
  save_claim_grade_chunk: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      taskId: z.string().min(1),
      chunkIndex: z.number().int().min(0).max(200),
      grades: z.array(z.object({
        claimId: z.string().regex(/^CC-\d{3,}$/, "Use the manifest claim ID, e.g. CC-007."),
        disposition: claimDisposition,
        reason: z.string().trim().min(1).max(1000),
      })).min(1).max(CLAIM_CHUNK_SIZE),
    }),
    response: claimGradeChunkResult,
    privileged: [privileged.writeClaimGateFile],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof claimGradeChunkResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task) return { ok: false, error: "That job could not be found.", reconciliation: null };
      if (!isResearchGateTask(task)) return { ok: false, error: "Claim grades belong to a Research Department case — this job is not one.", reconciliation: null };
      const { manifest, grades: existingGrades } = await loadClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
      if (manifest.length === 0) return { ok: false, error: "Record the claim manifest first (save_claim_manifest) — grades have nothing to attach to without it.", reconciliation: null };
      const fail = async (error: string, recordError: string): Promise<z.infer<typeof claimGradeChunkResult>> => {
        const recon = await applyClaimGate(ctx, task.id, [recordError]);
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `A claim-grade chunk for “${task.title}” was rejected: ${recordError} The job is marked GRADING INCOMPLETE.` });
        ctx.invalidateQueries();
        return { ok: false, error, reconciliation: recon };
      };
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (const grade of args.grades) {
        if (seen.has(grade.claimId)) return fail(`The chunk lists ${grade.claimId} twice — a claim gets exactly one disposition. The chunk was not saved.`, `A grade chunk listed ${grade.claimId} twice (duplicate ID in one chunk).`);
        seen.add(grade.claimId);
      }
      const byId = new Map(manifest.map((entry) => [entry.claimId, entry]));
      const existingById = new Map(existingGrades.map((grade) => [grade.claimId, grade]));
      for (const grade of args.grades) {
        const entry = byId.get(grade.claimId);
        if (!entry) return fail(`${grade.claimId} is not in this job's claim manifest. The chunk was not saved — grade only manifest IDs.`, `A grade chunk named ${grade.claimId}, which is not in the manifest (unknown ID).`);
        const expectedChunk = Math.floor(entry.position / CLAIM_CHUNK_SIZE);
        if (expectedChunk !== args.chunkIndex) return fail(`${grade.claimId} belongs to chunk ${expectedChunk + 1}, not chunk ${args.chunkIndex + 1} — chunks are deterministic (chunk 1 is the first ${CLAIM_CHUNK_SIZE} manifest claims, in order). The chunk was not saved.`, `A grade for ${grade.claimId} arrived in chunk ${args.chunkIndex + 1} but the claim belongs to chunk ${expectedChunk + 1} (chunk mismatch).`);
        const prior = existingById.get(grade.claimId);
        if (prior && prior.disposition !== grade.disposition) {
          return fail(`${grade.claimId} is already graded ${prior.disposition}; this chunk tried to overwrite it with ${grade.disposition}. A conflicting overwrite is a reconciliation failure, never a silent replacement — the chunk was not saved and the recorded grade stands.`, `Conflicting grade for ${grade.claimId}: recorded as ${prior.disposition}, a later chunk tried to overwrite it with ${grade.disposition}.`);
        }
      }
      const now = new Date();
      const fresh = args.grades.filter((grade) => !existingById.has(grade.claimId));
      for (const grade of fresh) {
        await db.insert(schema.claimGrades).values({
          taskId: task.id, claimId: grade.claimId, disposition: grade.disposition, reason: grade.reason, chunkIndex: args.chunkIndex, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
        });
      }
      await writeClaimGateFiles(ctx, task);
      const recon = await applyClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, saved: fresh.length, alreadyRecorded: args.grades.length - fresh.length, reconciliation: recon };
    },
  }),

  // The gate's read surface for workers: the manifest, every grade
  // recorded so far, and a fresh mechanical reconciliation — the
  // claim-checker reads this to resume exactly where grading stopped,
  // and Tom reads it before synthesis to know whether the brief must
  // carry the grading-incomplete banner. Read-only.
  get_claim_grading_state: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ taskId: z.string().min(1) }),
    response: claimGradingStateShape,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof claimGradingStateShape>> {
      const { manifest, grades } = await loadClaimGate(ctx, args.taskId);
      const lab = await loadLabExtras(ctx, args.taskId);
      return claimGradingState(args.taskId, manifest, grades, computeReconciliation(manifest, grades), lab);
    },
  }),

  // THE RECONCILIATION GATE (Change 1): mechanically reconcile the
  // manifest against the grade records and persist the verdict on the
  // job. Complete only when every manifest ID has exactly one
  // non-UNGRADED disposition and there are no duplicate, unknown,
  // missing, malformed, or conflicting records. Anything else marks the
  // job GRADING INCOMPLETE (fail closed) and the result carries the
  // banner synthesis must stamp on the brief.
  reconcile_claim_grades: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ taskId: z.string().min(1) }),
    response: claimGradingStateShape,
    privileged: [privileged.writeClaimGateFile],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof claimGradingStateShape>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task) return emptyClaimGradingState(args.taskId);
      const recon = await applyClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
      const { manifest, grades } = await loadClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
      await writeClaimGateFiles(ctx, task);
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: recon.status === "complete"
        ? `The claim gate reconciled “${task.title}”: all ${recon.manifestCount} manifest claims have exactly one grade — the claim-check is complete.`
        : `The claim gate marked “${task.title}” GRADING INCOMPLETE: ${recon.incompleteIds.length} of ${recon.manifestCount} claims unaccounted for (${recon.incompleteIds.join(", ") || "none recorded"})${recon.errors.length > 0 ? ` — ${recon.errors[0]}` : ""}.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      const lab = await loadLabExtras(ctx, task.id);
      return claimGradingState(task.id, manifest, grades, recon, lab);
    },
  }),

  // SOURCE PROVENANCE (Change 2): the gatherer records one structured
  // provenance record per gathered source, at gather time. Records are
  // keyed by the exact source reference the manifest cites, so every
  // claim's source references resolve to a record here. Re-saving a
  // source's record updates it (gathering is iterative; a record is a
  // description of the source, not a grade). This action never touches
  // the manifest, the grades, or the gate — provenance is recorded and
  // reported only. It also writes source-provenance.md into the job
  // folder and refreshes the job's stored measurement block.
  save_source_provenance: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      taskId: z.string().min(1),
      records: z.array(z.object({
        sourceRef: z.string().trim().min(1).max(1000),
        publisher: z.string().trim().min(1).max(300),
        docType: sourceDocType,
        vintage: z.string().trim().max(200).default(""),
        tier: sourceTier,
        independence: sourceIndependence,
        independenceNote: z.string().trim().max(1000).default(""),
        primaryRef: z.string().trim().max(1000).nullable().optional(),
        primaryAttempt: z.string().trim().max(1000).default(""),
      })).min(1).max(300),
    }),
    response: sourceProvenanceResult,
    privileged: [privileged.writeClaimGateFile],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof sourceProvenanceResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task) return { ok: false, error: "That job could not be found." };
      if (!isResearchGateTask(task)) return { ok: false, error: "Source provenance belongs to a Research Department case — this job is not one." };
      const now = new Date();
      const existing = await loadProvenance(ctx, task.id);
      const existingRefs = new Set(existing.map((record) => record.sourceRef));
      for (const record of args.records) {
        const values = {
          taskId: task.id, sourceRef: record.sourceRef, publisher: record.publisher, docType: record.docType,
          vintage: record.vintage, tier: record.tier, independence: record.independence, independenceNote: record.independenceNote,
          primaryRef: record.primaryRef ?? null, primaryAttempt: record.primaryAttempt, updatedAt: now,
        };
        if (existingRefs.has(record.sourceRef)) {
          await db.update(schema.sourceProvenance).set(values).where(and(eq(schema.sourceProvenance.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.sourceProvenance.sourceRef, record.sourceRef)));
        } else {
          await db.insert(schema.sourceProvenance).values({ ...values, createdAt: now });
          existingRefs.add(record.sourceRef);
        }
      }
      const provenance = await loadProvenance(ctx, task.id);
      try {
        await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.writeClaimGateFile, { taskId: task.id, fileName: "source-provenance.md", text: sourceProvenanceMarkdown(task, provenance) });
      } catch { /* The structured records are the authority; the file is their artifact copy. */ }
      const measurements = await refreshLabMeasurements(ctx, task.id);
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Provenance recorded for “${task.title}”: ${provenance.length} source${provenance.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} now carry a record (publisher, document type, vintage, primary/secondary, independence).${task.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? " This case gathers in tiered mode — secondary finds record their primary-retrieval outcome." : ""}` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, provenance: provenance.map(provenanceDto), measurements: measurements ?? computeLabMeasurements([], [], provenance, task.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? "tiered" : "standard", null) };
    },
  }),

  // A/B COMPARISON (Change 2): the measurement blocks of two research
  // jobs, computed live from their stored records — the side-by-side the
  // standard-vs-tiered experiment reads. Read-only; either job may be in
  // either mode, and a job with no records yet reports honest zeros.
  compare_research_jobs: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ taskIdA: z.string().min(1), taskIdB: z.string().min(1) }),
    response: z.object({
      jobs: z.array(z.object({ taskId: z.string(), title: z.string(), gatheringMode: gatheringMode, measurements: labMeasurementsShape })),
    }),
    async handler(ctx, args) {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const jobs: Array<{ taskId: string; title: string; gatheringMode: "standard" | "tiered"; measurements: LabMeasurements }> = [];
      for (const taskId of [args.taskIdA, args.taskIdB]) {
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, taskId)).limit(1);
        const task = taskRows[0];
        if (!task) continue;
        const mode = task.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? "tiered" : "standard";
        const [{ manifest, grades }, provenance] = await Promise.all([loadClaimGate(ctx, taskId), loadProvenance(ctx, taskId)]);
        jobs.push({ taskId: task.id, title: task.title, gatheringMode: mode, measurements: computeLabMeasurements(manifest, grades, provenance, mode, new Date().toISOString()) });
      }
      return { jobs };
    },
  }),

  run_visionary_hunt_now: defineAction({
    request: z.object({}).strict(), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const activeRuns = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(and(eq(schema.tasks.standingOrderId, SVEN_VISIONARY_ORDER_ID), eq(schema.tasks.status, "working"))).limit(1);
      if (activeRuns.length > 0) return { ok: false, error: "Sven is already out hunting for ideas." };
      const orderRows = await db.select().from(schema.standingOrders).where(eq(schema.standingOrders.id, SVEN_VISIONARY_ORDER_ID)).limit(1);
      const order = orderRows[0];
      if (!order) return { ok: false, error: "Sven's idea brief is not available right now." };
      const title = "Sven: on-demand idea hunt";
      const huntInstruction = expandStandingOrderInstruction(order.instruction);
      const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, {
        title,
        notes: huntInstruction,
        standingOrderId: order.id,
        steps: [{ assignee: "ledger", title, instructions: huntInstruction }],
      });
      if (!created) return { ok: false, error: "Sven's idea hunt could not be created." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: "Ben sent Sven out for an immediate idea hunt." });
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  save_visionary_ideas: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ briefId: z.string().min(1), taskId: z.string().min(1), ideas: z.array(submittedVisionaryIdeaShape).min(2).max(3) }),
    response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, args.briefId)).limit(1);
      const brief = briefRows[0];
      if (!brief || brief.taskId !== args.taskId || brief.assignee !== "ledger" || brief.status !== "in_progress") return { ok: false, error: "Only Sven's active visionary brief can save ideas." };
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task || task.standingOrderId !== SVEN_VISIONARY_ORDER_ID) return { ok: false, error: "This brief is not Sven's visionary run." };
      const scopes = new Set(args.ideas.map((idea) => idea.scope));
      if (!scopes.has("within") || !scopes.has("outside")) return { ok: false, error: "Include at least one within-scope idea and one outside-scope idea in every visionary run." };
      if (args.ideas.some((idea) => isRpgMakerRelatedIdea(idea))) return { ok: false, error: "RPG Maker-related ideas are excluded from Sven's hunts — Ben's RPG Maker chapter is settled and closed. Replace every RPG Maker-related idea with a non-RPG-Maker avenue (within-scope: Pulse HQ, Perfectly Paranoid, or the AI Office itself; outside-scope: a genuinely new venture) and save again." };
      if (args.ideas.some((idea) => readerJargonIn(idea.title) || readerJargonIn(idea.plainSummary))) return { ok: false, error: "Idea titles and plain summaries are read by people, not the crew: rewrite any title or plain summary that uses crew jargon (\"agentic\", \"pipeline\", \"brief\", \"deliverable\") in plain everyday words a business owner would understand, then save again." };
      const now = new Date();
      await db.batch([
        db.delete(schema.visionaryIdeas).where(eq(schema.visionaryIdeas.briefId, brief.id)),
        db.insert(schema.visionaryIdeas).values(args.ideas.map((idea, index) => ({
          id: `idea-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, briefId: brief.id, taskId: task.id, title: idea.title, category: idea.category, scope: idea.scope,
          plainSummary: idea.plainSummary, rationale: idea.rationale, nextStep: idea.nextStep, sourceUrlsJson: JSON.stringify(idea.sourceUrls), createdAt: new Date(now.getTime() + index), launchedTaskId: null,
        }))),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Sven surfaced ${args.ideas.length} new actionable ideas.` }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  mark_visionary_ideas_seen: defineAction({
    request: z.object({}).strict(), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      await ctx.db<typeof schema>().update(schema.visionaryIdeas).set({ seenAt: new Date() }).where(isNull(schema.visionaryIdeas.seenAt));
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  // Sven files story candidates during his hunt run — the same brief that
  // saves his ideas. Append-only (unlike ideas, which a re-save replaces):
  // every filed row is a permanent dedupe record, dismissed and used rows
  // included. The server enforces the whole aggregator contract here —
  // shelf caps for the day, the declassified cap inside the Perfectly
  // Paranoid cap, dedupe by link OR headline against everything ever
  // filed, declassified stories only on the Perfectly Paranoid shelf with
  // an agency and a plainly named document, and plain-language cards.
  save_sven_stories: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ briefId: z.string().min(1), taskId: z.string().min(1), stories: z.array(submittedStoryShape).min(1).max(10) }),
    response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, args.briefId)).limit(1);
      const brief = briefRows[0];
      if (!brief || brief.taskId !== args.taskId || brief.assignee !== "ledger" || brief.status !== "in_progress") return { ok: false, error: "Only Sven's active visionary brief can file stories." };
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task || task.standingOrderId !== SVEN_VISIONARY_ORDER_ID) return { ok: false, error: "This brief is not Sven's visionary run." };
      for (const story of args.stories) {
        if (readerJargonIn(story.headline) || readerJargonIn(story.fitReason)) return { ok: false, error: `Story cards are read by people, not the crew: rewrite “${story.headline}” and its fit line in plain everyday words (no "agentic", "pipeline", "brief", or "deliverable"), then file again.` };
        if (story.isDeclassified) {
          if (story.shelf !== "perfectly_paranoid") return { ok: false, error: `“${story.headline}” is marked as a declassified file — declassified CIA/FBI stories belong on the Perfectly Paranoid shelf only.` };
          if (!story.agency) return { ok: false, error: `“${story.headline}” is a declassified file but names no agency — say plainly whether it is a CIA or an FBI file.` };
          if (!story.documentTitle?.trim()) return { ok: false, error: `“${story.headline}” is a declassified file but names no document — give the document's plain title so the card can name it.` };
        } else if (story.agency || story.documentTitle) {
          return { ok: false, error: `“${story.headline}” names an agency or a document but is not marked as a declassified file — mark it as one, or drop the agency and document.` };
        }
      }
      // Dedupe — inside this batch first, then against every story ever
      // filed (new, dismissed, used, and expired all count: a dismissed
      // story never resurfaces, in any form).
      const existing = await db.select().from(schema.svenStories);
      const seenUrls = new Set<string>();
      const seenHeadlines = new Set<string>();
      for (const story of args.stories) {
        const urlKey = normalizeStoryUrl(story.sourceUrl);
        const headlineKey = normalizeStoryHeadline(story.headline);
        if (seenUrls.has(urlKey) || seenHeadlines.has(headlineKey)) return { ok: false, error: `“${story.headline}” appears twice in this filing — file each story once.` };
        seenUrls.add(urlKey);
        seenHeadlines.add(headlineKey);
        const duplicate = existing.find((row) => normalizeStoryUrl(row.sourceUrl) === urlKey || normalizeStoryHeadline(row.headline) === headlineKey);
        if (duplicate) return { ok: false, error: `“${story.headline}” was already filed as “${duplicate.headline}” (${duplicate.status === "dismissed" ? "Ben dismissed it, and dismissed stories never come back" : duplicate.status === "used" ? "it already became a job" : "it is already on a shelf or was filed before"}) — do not file the same story twice. Drop it and file the rest.` };
      }
      // Daily caps — quality filter, not a quota. Count everything filed
      // today (any status: a dismissed story still used one of today's
      // slots, because Sven still spent the day's curation on it).
      const now = new Date();
      const filedToday = existing.filter((row) => sameStoryDay(row.foundAt, now));
      for (const shelf of ["perfectly_paranoid", "pulse_hq"] as const) {
        const incoming = args.stories.filter((story) => story.shelf === shelf).length;
        const already = filedToday.filter((row) => row.shelf === shelf).length;
        if (incoming > 0 && already + incoming > STORY_SHELF_DAILY_CAP) {
          return { ok: false, error: `The ${shelf === "perfectly_paranoid" ? "Perfectly Paranoid" : "Pulse HQ"} shelf already has ${already} ${already === 1 ? "story" : "stories"} filed today and the daily cap is about ${STORY_SHELF_DAILY_CAP} — filing ${incoming} more would pass it. Curate: keep only the strongest and file those.` };
        }
      }
      const incomingDeclassified = args.stories.filter((story) => story.isDeclassified).length;
      const alreadyDeclassified = filedToday.filter((row) => row.isDeclassified).length;
      if (incomingDeclassified > 0 && alreadyDeclassified + incomingDeclassified > STORY_DECLASSIFIED_DAILY_CAP) {
        return { ok: false, error: `The declassified beat already has ${alreadyDeclassified} ${alreadyDeclassified === 1 ? "file" : "files"} filed today and its cap is ${STORY_DECLASSIFIED_DAILY_CAP} a day — keep only the strongest declassified picks.` };
      }
      const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + STORY_EXPIRY_DAYS * 86_400_000);
      const ppCount = args.stories.filter((story) => story.shelf === "perfectly_paranoid").length;
      const phqCount = args.stories.length - ppCount;
      await db.batch([
        db.insert(schema.svenStories).values(args.stories.map((story, index) => ({
          id: `story-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, briefId: brief.id, huntTaskId: task.id, shelf: story.shelf,
          headline: story.headline, sourceLabel: story.sourceLabel, sourceUrl: story.sourceUrl, fitReason: story.fitReason,
          topicTagsJson: JSON.stringify(story.topicTags), isDeclassified: story.isDeclassified,
          agency: story.isDeclassified ? story.agency ?? null : null,
          documentTitle: story.isDeclassified ? story.documentTitle?.trim() ?? null : null,
          dedupeKey: storyDedupeKey(story.headline, story.sourceUrl), status: "new" as const,
          foundAt: new Date(now.getTime() + index), expiresAt, createdTaskId: null,
        }))),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Sven filed ${args.stories.length} ${args.stories.length === 1 ? "story" : "stories"}: ${ppCount} for Perfectly Paranoid${incomingDeclassified ? ` (${incomingDeclassified} from declassified files)` : ""}${phqCount ? ` and ${phqCount} for Pulse HQ` : ""}. They are candidates on his shelves — nothing is checked yet.` }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  // Dismiss is permanent: the row stays, marked dismissed, and the dedupe
  // check in save_sven_stories counts it forever — the same story can
  // never be re-filed, in any form.
  dismiss_story: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ storyId: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.svenStories).where(eq(schema.svenStories.id, args.storyId)).limit(1);
      const story = rows[0];
      if (!story) return { ok: false, error: "That story could not be found." };
      if (story.status === "used") return { ok: false, error: "That story already became a job — it cannot be dismissed." };
      if (story.status === "dismissed") return { ok: false, error: "That story is already dismissed." };
      if (isStoryExpired(story, new Date())) {
        await db.update(schema.svenStories).set({ status: "expired" }).where(eq(schema.svenStories.id, story.id));
        ctx.invalidateQueries();
        return { ok: false, error: "That story sat untouched past its few days and expired off the shelf." };
      }
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.svenStories).set({ status: "dismissed" }).where(eq(schema.svenStories.id, story.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben dismissed Sven's story “${story.headline}”. It will not be filed again.` }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  // One tap turns a shelf story into a real job through the usual
  // pipelines, with the story carried into the job's notes. A Perfectly
  // Paranoid story creates a Perfectly Paranoid job tagged to Client #1
  // (Maria intake first, per the client pipeline); a Pulse HQ story
  // creates a standard job the same way Remmy triages any standard job.
  // The story is marked used in the same flow — one story = at most one
  // job, ever.
  make_job_from_story: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ storyId: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: storyJobResult, privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof storyJobResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.svenStories).where(eq(schema.svenStories.id, args.storyId)).limit(1);
      const story = rows[0];
      if (!story) return { ok: false, error: "That story could not be found." };
      if (story.status === "used") return { ok: false, error: "That story already became a job — one story makes at most one job." };
      if (story.status === "dismissed") return { ok: false, error: "That story was dismissed — dismissed stories never come back." };
      if (isStoryExpired(story, new Date())) {
        await db.update(schema.svenStories).set({ status: "expired" }).where(eq(schema.svenStories.id, story.id));
        ctx.invalidateQueries();
        return { ok: false, error: "That story sat untouched past its few days and expired off the shelf." };
      }
      let tags: string[] = [];
      try { const parsed = z.array(z.string()).safeParse(JSON.parse(story.topicTagsJson)); if (parsed.success) tags = parsed.data; } catch { tags = []; }
      const declassifiedLine = story.isDeclassified
        ? `\nSource document: ${story.documentTitle ?? story.headline} — a declassified ${story.agency ?? ""} file. A declassified document is a source, not a finished story: work from what the document actually says, and let Tom's checking decide what holds up.`
        : "";
      const notes = `A story Sven found and filed${story.shelf === "perfectly_paranoid" ? " on the Perfectly Paranoid shelf" : " on the Pulse HQ shelf"} — a candidate he found, not something he checked. Tom still verifies anything this job publishes, exactly as always.\n\nHeadline as found: ${story.headline}\nSource: ${story.sourceLabel} — ${story.sourceUrl}\nWhy Sven filed it: ${story.fitReason}${tags.length ? `\nTopics: ${tags.join(", ")}` : ""}${declassifiedLine}`;
      const title = story.headline.slice(0, 120);
      if (story.shelf === "perfectly_paranoid") {
        const clientRows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID)).limit(1);
        const client = clientRows[0] ?? null;
        const subject = `${title}\n\n${notes}`;
        const steps = client ? [mariaIntakeStep(client, title, notes), ...socialPostPlan(subject).steps] : socialPostPlan(subject).steps;
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps, pipeline: "perfectly_paranoid", clientId: PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID, jobType: "perfectly_paranoid" });
        const first = created?.briefs[0];
        if (!created || !first) return { ok: false, error: "The job could not be created." };
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.svenStories).set({ status: "used", createdTaskId: created.task.id }).where(eq(schema.svenStories.id, story.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: client
            ? `Ben turned Sven's story “${story.headline}” into a Perfectly Paranoid job for ${client.businessName}. Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Tom, Johnny, and Nik run in order.` : `Ben turned Sven's story “${story.headline}” into a Perfectly Paranoid job tagged to Client #1. Tom, Johnny, and Nik run in order.` }),
        ]);
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        ctx.invalidateQueries();
        return { ok: true, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: "Perfectly Paranoid story from Sven's shelf, tagged to Client #1 (Perfectly Paranoid): Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then the fixed pipeline runs — Tom researches and verifies, Johnny writes the copy, Nik creates the image. On approval it exits only through the client's delivery package." };
      }
      let plan: z.infer<typeof workPlanShape>;
      try { plan = await planWork(ctx, title, notes, { standardContract: true }); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "Remmy could not divide this job right now. The story is still on its shelf; try again." }; }
      const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: plan.steps, pipeline: null, jobType: "standard" });
      const first = created?.briefs[0];
      if (!created || !first) return { ok: false, error: "The job could not be created." };
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.svenStories).set({ status: "used", createdTaskId: created.task.id }).where(eq(schema.svenStories.id, story.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben turned Sven's Pulse HQ story “${story.headline}” into a job. Remmy divided it into ${created.briefs.length} ${created.briefs.length === 1 ? "crew step" : "crew steps"}.` }),
      ]);
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
      const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: plan.reason };
    },
  }),

  save_x_posts: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ briefId: z.string().min(1), taskId: z.string().min(1), posts: z.array(submittedXPostShape).min(1).max(10) }),
    response: mutationResult,
    privileged: [privileged.readDeliverable],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, args.briefId)).limit(1);
      const brief = briefRows[0];
      if (!brief || brief.taskId !== args.taskId || brief.assignee !== "olivia" || brief.status !== "in_progress") return { ok: false, error: "Only Olivia's active X-post brief can save posts to the queue." };
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task || task.pipeline !== "x_posts") return { ok: false, error: "This brief is not an X-post drafting job." };
      const normalized = args.posts.map((post) => typeof post === "string"
        ? { text: post, imagePath: null as string | null }
        : { text: post.text, imagePath: post.imagePath?.trim() ? post.imagePath.trim() : null });
      // Server-enforced drafting contract — a draft that breaks any of these
      // is incomplete and must not enter the queue at all.
      for (let index = 0; index < normalized.length; index += 1) {
        const post = normalized[index];
        if (!post) continue;
        const label = `Post ${index + 1}`;
        if (X_POST_FORBIDDEN_NAMES.test(post.text)) return { ok: false, error: `${label} mentions the owner (Ben, Benjamin, or Skunk). Posts are written as the Pulse HQ brand — remove that name and save again.` };
        const hashtagError = hashtagBlockError(post.text, "x");
        if (hashtagError) return { ok: false, error: `${label} is incomplete — ${hashtagError}. Every finished X post ends with a hashtag block of 1–3 top topic-specific tags (no filler tags), counted inside the 280-character limit. Fix the ending and save again.` };
        const hasLink = xPostHasLink(post.text);
        if (!hasLink && !post.imagePath) return { ok: false, error: `${label} has neither a link nor an attached image. Add a link to its text (for example ${X_SHOWCASE_LINK}) or generate an image for it during this job and pass that image's path as imagePath, then save again.` };
        if (post.imagePath) {
          const relative = normalizeXImagePath(post.imagePath);
          if (!relative) return { ok: false, error: `${label}'s imagePath is not a usable image file path. Save the generated image (png, jpg, or webp) under this job's folder and pass that path.` };
          post.imagePath = relative;
        }
      }
      // Attach image-branch posts: copy each generated image into owned blob
      // storage now, so the queue card can render it and offer a download
      // long after the job folder moves.
      const now = new Date();
      const source = task.standingOrderId ? "standing" as const : "manual" as const;
      const rowsToInsert: Array<typeof schema.xPosts.$inferInsert> = [];
      for (let index = 0; index < normalized.length; index += 1) {
        const post = normalized[index];
        if (!post) continue;
        const id = `xpost-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
        let imageBlobKey: string | null = null;
        if (post.imagePath) {
          try {
            const content = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.readDeliverable, { relativePath: post.imagePath });
            if (content.kind !== "image" || !content.dataBase64) return { ok: false, error: `Post ${index + 1}'s attached file is not a readable image. Generate the image, save it under this job's folder, and pass its exact path.` };
            imageBlobKey = `x-post-images/${id}`;
            await ctx.blobs.put(imageBlobKey, decodeBase64(content.dataBase64), { contentType: content.contentType });
          } catch {
            return { ok: false, error: `Post ${index + 1}'s image could not be found at ${post.imagePath}. Generate the image during this job, save it under this job's folder (~/workspace/ai-office/jobs/${task.id}/), and pass that exact path as imagePath.` };
          }
        }
        rowsToInsert.push({
          id, text: post.text, status: "queued" as const, source, taskId: task.id, briefId: brief.id,
          imagePath: post.imagePath, imageBlobKey,
          createdAt: new Date(now.getTime() + index), postedAt: null,
        });
      }
      await db.batch([
        db.delete(schema.xPosts).where(eq(schema.xPosts.briefId, brief.id)),
        db.insert(schema.xPosts).values(rowsToInsert),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Olivia saved ${rowsToInsert.length} drafted X post${rowsToInsert.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} to the Post Queue.` }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  mark_x_post_posted: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.xPosts).where(eq(schema.xPosts.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const post = rows[0];
      if (!post) return { ok: false, error: "That post could not be found." };
      if (post.status === "posted") return { ok: false, error: "That post is already marked posted." };
      const now = new Date();
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.xPosts).set({ status: "posted", postedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.xPosts.id, post.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: "Ben marked a queued X post as posted — it moved to the Post Queue history." }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  launch_visionary_idea: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ ideaId: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.visionaryIdeas).where(eq(schema.visionaryIdeas.id, args.ideaId)).limit(1);
      const idea = rows[0];
      if (!idea) return { ok: false, error: "That idea could not be found." };
      if (idea.launchedTaskId) return { ok: false, error: "That idea is already being worked." };
      const ideaDto = visionaryIdeaDto(idea);
      const sources = ideaDto.sourceUrls;
      const scopeLabel = ideaDto.scope === "outside" ? "Outside current scope" : ideaDto.scope === "within" ? "Existing venture" : "Earlier idea";
      const notes = `Sven's idea (${scopeLabel}), in plain words:\n${ideaDto.plainSummary}\n\nWhy Sven thinks it is worth doing:\n${idea.rationale}\n\nSuggested first move:\n${idea.nextStep}${sources.length ? `\n\nSources:\n${sources.join("\n")}` : ""}\n\n${SVEN_PACKAGE_CONTRACT}`;
      let plan: z.infer<typeof workPlanShape>;
      try { plan = await planWork(ctx, idea.title, notes, { svenOriginated: true }); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "Remmy could not turn this idea into a crew plan right now. Try again." }; }
      const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title: idea.title, notes, steps: plan.steps });
      if (!created) return { ok: false, error: "The job could not be created." };
      const now = new Date();
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.visionaryIdeas).set({ launchedTaskId: created.task.id }).where(eq(schema.visionaryIdeas.id, idea.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben sent Sven's idea “${idea.title}” to Remmy. The crew started moving.` }),
      ]);
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  create_work: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120), notes: z.string().trim().max(5000).default(""), jobType: z.enum(["standard", "research", "x_posts", "perfectly_paranoid", "market_briefing", "creative_package", "client_report"]).default("standard"), postCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(10).optional(), clientId: z.string().min(1).nullable().optional(), gatheringMode: gatheringMode.optional() }),
    response: z.discriminatedUnion("ok", [z.object({ ok: z.literal(true), task: taskShape, brief: briefShape, triageReason: z.string() }), z.object({ ok: z.literal(false), error: z.string() })]),
    privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args) {
      // Front Office intake: an optional client picked in Create work. A
      // tagged job gets Maria's intake step FIRST — she shapes the brief
      // with the client's registry voice and constraints — and its normal
      // steps run right behind it, unchanged. No client picked: the job is
      // exactly what it has always been.
      let client: typeof schema.clients.$inferSelect | null = null;
      if (args.clientId) {
        const db0 = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
        const rows = await db0.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.clientId)).limit(1);
        client = rows[0] ?? null;
        if (!client) return { ok: false as const, error: "That client is no longer in the registry. Pick another client, or no client." };
      }
      const withIntake = (steps: Array<PlanStep & { stage?: z.infer<typeof pipelineStage> }>) => client ? [mariaIntakeStep(client, args.title, args.notes), ...steps] : steps;
      if (args.jobType === "x_posts") {
        const count = args.postCount ?? 3;
        const plan = await xPostsPlan(ctx, args.title, args.notes, count);
        if (!plan) return { ok: false as const, error: "Olivia's standing order could not be found, so her drafting rules are unavailable. Nothing was created." };
        const steps = withIntake(plan);
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title: args.title, notes: args.notes, steps, pipeline: "x_posts", clientId: client?.id ?? null, jobType: "x_posts" });
        const first = created?.briefs[0]; if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The X post job could not be created." };
        const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben asked Olivia to draft ${count} X post${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}: “${args.title}”. Finished posts land in the Post Queue — no approval step; Ben pastes them himself.` });
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: "X post jobs always go to Olivia, the X Drafter in the Research Department. Drafts land in the Post Queue; nothing publishes without Ben pasting it himself." };
      }
      if (args.jobType === "perfectly_paranoid") {
        // The Perfectly Paranoid story pipeline, picked explicitly in
        // Create work: the fixed Tom → Johnny → Nik steps, with the
        // client picker applying exactly as it does for every other job
        // type — a picked client puts Maria's intake step FIRST and the
        // finished job exits only through that client's delivery package.
        const subject = args.notes ? `${args.title}\n\n${args.notes}` : args.title;
        const steps = withIntake(socialPostPlan(subject).steps);
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title: args.title, notes: args.notes, steps, pipeline: "perfectly_paranoid", clientId: client?.id ?? null, jobType: "perfectly_paranoid" });
        const first = created?.briefs[0]; if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The story job could not be created." };
        const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: client
          ? `Ben gave Remmy a Perfectly Paranoid story job “${args.title}” for ${client.businessName}. Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Tom, Johnny, and Nik run in order; the finished package goes to Deliverables for delivery.`
          : `Ben gave Remmy a Perfectly Paranoid story job “${args.title}”. Tom, Johnny, and Nik run in order; Ben will see the finished package once at the end.` });
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: client
          ? `Perfectly Paranoid story for ${client.businessName}: Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then the fixed pipeline runs — Tom researches and verifies, Johnny writes the copy, Nik creates the image. On approval it exits only through the client's delivery package in Deliverables.`
          : "Perfectly Paranoid jobs run the fixed story pipeline: Tom researches and verifies, Johnny writes the copy, Nik creates the image." };
      }
      if (args.jobType === "research") {
        // Gathering mode (Change 2): chosen at creation, default
        // standard. Tiered changes gathering behaviour only — the same
        // question can be run twice, once per mode, as two separate
        // jobs for the A/B comparison.
        const mode = args.gatheringMode ?? "standard";
        const steps = withIntake(researchPlan(args.title, args.notes, mode));
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title: args.title, notes: args.notes, steps, pipeline: "research_case", clientId: client?.id ?? null, jobType: "research", gatheringMode: mode });
        const first = created?.briefs[0]; if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The research case could not be created." };
        const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: client
          ? `Ben opened a research case “${args.title}” for ${client.businessName}. It went to the Research Department: Walter reads, Peter verifies, the Claim-checker grades every claim, Tom writes the brief. On approval it exits through ${client.businessName}'s delivery package in Deliverables.`
          : `Ben opened a research case “${args.title}”. It went to the Research Department: Walter reads, Peter verifies, the Claim-checker grades every claim, Tom writes the brief.${mode === "tiered" ? " Gathering runs in TIERED mode for this case: figures found in secondary sources are chased to their primary source first." : ""}` });
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: client
          ? `Research case for ${client.businessName}: Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Walter (Reader) → Peter (Verifier) → Claim-checker (grades) → Tom (brief) in the Research Department. On approval it exits only through ${client.businessName}'s delivery package in Deliverables.`
          : "Research cases always run Walter (Reader) → Peter (Verifier) → Claim-checker (grades) → Tom (brief) in the Research Department." };
      }
      if (args.jobType === "market_briefing") {
        // Business intelligence product: Sven gathers opportunities and
        // market observations, Tom writes the one readable briefing with
        // structured recommendations. A picked client adds Maria's intake
        // first, and approval exits through that client's delivery package.
        const steps = withIntake(marketBriefingPlan(args.title, args.notes));
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title: args.title, notes: args.notes, steps, pipeline: "market_briefing", clientId: client?.id ?? null, jobType: "market_briefing" });
        const first = created?.briefs[0]; if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The market briefing could not be created." };
        const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: client
          ? `Ben asked for a market briefing “${args.title}” for ${client.businessName}. Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Sven gathers opportunities and market observations and Tom writes the briefing. On approval it exits through the client's delivery package.`
          : `Ben asked for a market briefing “${args.title}”. Sven gathers opportunities and market observations, then Tom writes the briefing. Ben will see the finished briefing once, at the end.` });
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: client
          ? `Market briefing for ${client.businessName}: Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Sven gathers opportunities and market observations and Tom turns them into one briefing with recommendations. On approval it exits through the client's delivery package in Deliverables.`
          : "Market briefings always run Sven (gathers opportunities and market observations) → Tom (writes the briefing with structured recommendations), in plain human terms." };
      }
      if (args.jobType === "creative_package") {
        // Creative production product: Johnny develops the campaign concept
        // and copy, Nik builds the branded visuals to match — one package,
        // one approval. A picked client adds Maria's intake first, and
        // approval exits through that client's delivery package.
        const steps = withIntake(creativePackagePlan(args.title, args.notes));
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title: args.title, notes: args.notes, steps, pipeline: "creative_package", clientId: client?.id ?? null, jobType: "creative_package" });
        const first = created?.briefs[0]; if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The creative package could not be created." };
        const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: client
          ? `Ben asked for a creative package “${args.title}” for ${client.businessName}. Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Johnny develops the concept and copy and Nik builds the visuals. On approval it exits through the client's delivery package.`
          : `Ben asked for a creative package “${args.title}”. Johnny develops the concept and copy, then Nik builds the visuals. Ben will see the concept and visual set together once, at the end.` });
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: client
          ? `Creative package for ${client.businessName}: Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Johnny develops the campaign concept and copy and Nik builds the branded visuals to match. The concept and visual set are approved together, and on approval the package exits through the client's delivery package in Deliverables.`
          : "Creative packages always run Johnny (campaign concept and copy) → Nik (branded visuals to match). The concept and the visual set are approved together on one card." };
      }
      if (args.jobType === "client_report") {
        // Operational reporting product: a client report REQUIRES a client —
        // Maria compiles that client's delivered work, turnaround, and
        // results. Without one there is nothing to report on, so the job is
        // refused plainly here (the Create Work form flags it too) rather
        // than silently misrouting. No intake step: Maria's report step IS
        // the first step, exactly like her recurring client reports — she
        // assembles the activity record from office data only, Johnny
        // drafts the plain-language summary, Ben approves it in Ready for
        // You, and approval exits through the client's delivery package.
        if (!client) return { ok: false as const, error: "A client report needs a client — pick the client this report is for below, then create the job again. Nothing was created." };
        const record = await clientActivityRecord(ctx, client);
        const periodRecord = args.notes.trim()
          ? `Reporting period, as stated in the job notes: ${args.notes.trim()}\n\n${record}`
          : record;
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, {
          title: args.title, notes: args.notes, clientId: client.id, pipeline: "client_report", jobType: "client_report",
          steps: [mariaReportStep(client, periodRecord), johnnyReportStep(client)],
        });
        const first = created?.briefs[0]; if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The client report could not be created." };
        const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben asked for a client report “${args.title}” for ${client.businessName}. Maria is compiling the client's delivered work from office records; Johnny drafts the summary. On approval it exits through the client's delivery package.` });
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: `Client report for ${client.businessName}: Maria compiles the client's delivered work, turnaround, and results from office records for the period in the job notes, then Johnny drafts the summary in the standard client report format. It appears in Ready for You for approval first, then exits through ${client.businessName}'s delivery package.` };
      }
      // STANDARD — bound to the standard outcome contract: Remmy plans
      // under the contract (no social-post routing, no PP template, no
      // hashtag finisher, no image step unless the brief asks for one),
      // and createPlannedWork drops any step the contract forbids. A
      // standard job NEVER takes the perfectly_paranoid pipeline — that
      // silent conversion is the failure outcome contracts exist to fix.
      let plan: z.infer<typeof workPlanShape>;
      try { plan = await planWork(ctx, args.title, args.notes, { standardContract: true }); } catch { return { ok: false as const, error: "Remmy could not divide this job right now. Nothing was created; try again." }; }
      const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title: args.title, notes: args.notes, steps: withIntake(plan.steps), pipeline: null, clientId: client?.id ?? null, jobType: "standard" });
      const first = created?.briefs[0]; if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The job could not be created." };
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: client
        ? `Ben gave Remmy “${args.title}” for ${client.businessName}. Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then the crew runs it as usual.`
        : `Ben gave Remmy “${args.title}”. Remmy divided it into ${created.briefs.length} ${created.briefs.length === 1 ? "crew step" : "crew steps"}.` });
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
      const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
      return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason: plan.reason };
    },
  }),

  // Remmy briefing chat — a direct line to the real Remmy (see the schema
  // note). The app stores the thread and moves its status; it never writes
  // a Remmy reply or a shaped summary itself. post_remmy_reply and
  // post_remmy_shaped_job are the main agent's hands into the thread.
  start_remmy_briefing: defineAction({
    request: z.object({}).strict(),
    response: remmyBriefingResult,
    async handler(ctx): Promise<z.infer<typeof remmyBriefingResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const now = new Date();
      const rows = await db.insert(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).values({
        id: `rbrief-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, status: "open", createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
      }).returning();
      const session = rows[0];
      if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "The briefing chat could not be opened." };
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, briefing: await remmyBriefingDto(ctx, session) };
    },
  }),

  get_remmy_briefing: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ sessionId: z.string().min(1) }).strict(),
    response: remmyBriefingResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof remmyBriefingResult>> {
      const session = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, args.sessionId);
      if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "That briefing chat could not be found." };
      return { ok: true, briefing: await remmyBriefingDto(ctx, session) };
    },
  }),

  // Every briefing thread, newest first, with full messages and attachment
  // records (including each attachment's staged file path under
  // ~/workspace/ai-office/) — how the main agent reads what Ben sent.
  list_remmy_briefings: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ status: z.enum(["open", "awaiting_remmy", "shaped", "dispatched"]).optional() }).strict(),
    response: z.object({ briefings: z.array(remmyBriefingShape) }),
    async handler(ctx, args) {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = args.status
        ? await db.select().from(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.status, args.status)).orderBy(desc(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.createdAt)).limit(20)
        : await db.select().from(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).orderBy(desc(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.createdAt)).limit(20);
      const briefings = await Promise.all(rows.map((session) => remmyBriefingDto(ctx, session)));
      return { briefings };
    },
  }),

  send_remmy_message: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      sessionId: z.string().min(1),
      text: z.string().trim().max(5000).default(""),
      attachments: z.array(z.object({
        fileName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(160),
        contentType: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80),
        dataBase64: z.string().min(1).max(REMMY_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BASE64),
      })).max(4).default([]),
    }).strict(),
    response: remmyBriefingResult,
    privileged: [privileged.storeBriefingAttachment],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof remmyBriefingResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const session = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, args.sessionId);
      if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "That briefing chat could not be found." };
      if (session.status === "dispatched") return { ok: false, error: "This briefing already went to the crew — open Remmy again for a new one." };
      if (!args.text && args.attachments.length === 0) return { ok: false, error: "Write a message or attach a file first." };
      for (const attachment of args.attachments) {
        if (!REMMY_ATTACHMENT_TYPES[attachment.contentType]) {
          return { ok: false, error: `“${attachment.fileName}” can't ride along — attachments are PNG, JPEG, or WebP images, or plain-text / Markdown notes.` };
        }
      }
      const now = new Date();
      const message = await appendRemmyMessage(ctx, session.id, "user", args.text, now);
      for (let index = 0; index < args.attachments.length; index += 1) {
        const attachment = args.attachments[index];
        if (!attachment) continue;
        const type = REMMY_ATTACHMENT_TYPES[attachment.contentType];
        if (!type) continue;
        const stem = attachment.fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "").slice(0, 60) || "attachment";
        const storedName = `${stem}${type.extension}`;
        try {
          const stored = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.storeBriefingAttachment, { sessionId: session.id, fileName: storedName, dataBase64: attachment.dataBase64 });
          const attachmentId = `ratt-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
          let previewBlobKey: string | null = null;
          if (type.kind === "image") {
            previewBlobKey = `remmy-briefing-previews/${attachmentId}`;
            await ctx.blobs.put(previewBlobKey, decodeBase64(attachment.dataBase64), { contentType: attachment.contentType });
          }
          await db.insert(schema.remmyBriefingAttachments).values({
            id: attachmentId, sessionId: session.id, messageId: message.id,
            fileName: attachment.fileName, contentType: attachment.contentType, size: stored.size,
            stagingRelativePath: stored.relativePath, previewBlobKey, jobRelativePath: null,
            createdAt: new Date(now.getTime() + index + 1),
          });
        } catch {
          return { ok: false, error: `“${attachment.fileName}” could not be saved with the briefing. The message text is saved; try the file again.` };
        }
      }
      // New words from Ben after a summary was posted make that summary
      // stale: clear it and reopen the thread so nothing dispatches from
      // an out-of-date shape. While a thread is with Remmy, extra messages
      // simply join it — he reads the whole thread.
      const updates: Partial<typeof schema.remmyBriefingSessions.$inferInsert> = { updatedAt: new Date() };
      if (session.status === "shaped") {
        updates.status = "open";
        updates.shapedTitle = null;
        updates.shapedJobType = null;
        updates.shapedSummary = null;
        updates.shapedBrief = null;
        updates.shapedPostCount = null;
      }
      await db.update(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).set(updates).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.id, session.id));
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      const refreshed = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, session.id);
      return { ok: true, briefing: await remmyBriefingDto(ctx, refreshed ?? session) };
    },
  }),

  // "Start": the app's only move is to mark the thread as
  // with Remmy. No summary is generated here and no Remmy reply is faked —
  // the real Remmy reads the thread and posts his reply and the shaped job
  // back through post_remmy_reply / post_remmy_shaped_job.
  request_remmy_shaping: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ sessionId: z.string().min(1) }).strict(),
    response: remmyBriefingResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof remmyBriefingResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const session = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, args.sessionId);
      if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "That briefing chat could not be found." };
      if (session.status === "dispatched") return { ok: false, error: "This briefing already went to the crew." };
      const userMessages = await db.select({ id: schema.remmyBriefingMessages.id }).from(schema.remmyBriefingMessages)
        .where(and(eq(schema.remmyBriefingMessages.sessionId, session.id), eq(schema.remmyBriefingMessages.role, "user"))).limit(1);
      if (!userMessages[0]) return { ok: false, error: "Tell Remmy what you need first — even one line — then hit Start." };
      const now = new Date();
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).set({
          status: "awaiting_remmy", shapedTitle: null, shapedJobType: null, shapedSummary: null, shapedBrief: null, shapedPostCount: null, updatedAt: now,
        }).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.id, session.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: "Ben handed a briefing thread to Remmy from the floor chat — it is with Remmy now, and his shaped job will land back in that chat." }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      const refreshed = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, session.id);
      return { ok: true, briefing: await remmyBriefingDto(ctx, refreshed ?? session) };
    },
  }),

  // The main agent's reply into a thread: a clarifying question, a note, an
  // answer. A plain reply on a thread that was with Remmy reopens the
  // conversation (the shaped summary, when he has one, travels separately
  // through post_remmy_shaped_job).
  post_remmy_reply: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ sessionId: z.string().min(1), text: z.string().trim().min(1).max(5000) }).strict(),
    response: remmyBriefingResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof remmyBriefingResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const session = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, args.sessionId);
      if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "That briefing chat could not be found." };
      if (session.status === "dispatched") return { ok: false, error: "This briefing already went to the crew." };
      const now = new Date();
      await appendRemmyMessage(ctx, session.id, "remmy", args.text, now);
      await db.update(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).set({
        status: session.status === "awaiting_remmy" ? "open" : session.status, updatedAt: now,
      }).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.id, session.id));
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      const refreshed = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, session.id);
      return { ok: true, briefing: await remmyBriefingDto(ctx, refreshed ?? session) };
    },
  }),

  // The main agent posts the job he shaped from the whole thread. The app
  // stores it verbatim and shows it in the chat as the summary card Ben
  // starts from — the words are Remmy's, authored outside the app.
  post_remmy_shaped_job: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      sessionId: z.string().min(1),
      title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120),
      jobType: remmyBriefingJobType,
      summary: z.string().trim().min(1).max(600),
      brief: z.string().trim().min(1).max(5000),
      postCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(10).optional(),
      message: z.string().trim().min(1).max(5000).optional(),
    }).strict(),
    response: remmyBriefingResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof remmyBriefingResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const session = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, args.sessionId);
      if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "That briefing chat could not be found." };
      if (session.status === "dispatched") return { ok: false, error: "This briefing already went to the crew." };
      const now = new Date();
      const typeLabel = args.jobType === "research" ? "Research case" : args.jobType === "x_posts" ? "X Posts" : args.jobType === "perfectly_paranoid" ? "Perfectly Paranoid story" : "Standard job";
      const messageText = args.message ?? `Here's the job I'll take to the crew:\n\n**${args.title}** — ${typeLabel}\n${args.summary}\n\nIf that shape looks right, hit Send it to the crew and it goes out like any other job.`;
      await appendRemmyMessage(ctx, session.id, "remmy", messageText, now);
      await db.update(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).set({
        status: "shaped", shapedTitle: args.title, shapedJobType: args.jobType, shapedSummary: args.summary,
        shapedBrief: args.brief, shapedPostCount: args.jobType === "x_posts" ? args.postCount ?? 3 : null, updatedAt: now,
      }).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.id, session.id));
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Remmy shaped Ben's briefing into a job: “${args.title}”. It is waiting in the briefing chat for Ben to send it to the crew.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      const refreshed = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, session.id);
      return { ok: true, briefing: await remmyBriefingDto(ctx, refreshed ?? session) };
    },
  }),

  // "Send it to the crew" on Remmy's posted summary: create the job from the stored shape
  // through the exact create-work paths (research / X posts / Perfectly
  // Paranoid fixed pipelines, or Remmy's standard triage), then copy the
  // chat's attachments into the job folder so they ride with the job.
  start_remmy_briefing_job: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ sessionId: z.string().min(1) }).strict(),
    response: remmyBriefingResult,
    privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool, privileged.copyBriefingAttachmentsToJob],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof remmyBriefingResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const session = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, args.sessionId);
      if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "That briefing chat could not be found." };
      if (session.status === "dispatched") return { ok: false, error: "This briefing already went to the crew." };
      if (session.status !== "shaped" || !session.shapedTitle || !session.shapedJobType || !session.shapedBrief) {
        return { ok: false, error: "Remmy hasn't posted a shaped job for this thread yet — Send it to the crew unlocks when his summary lands in the chat." };
      }
      const title = session.shapedTitle;
      const [messageRows, attachmentRows] = await Promise.all([
        db.select().from(schema.remmyBriefingMessages).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingMessages.sessionId, session.id)).orderBy(schema.remmyBriefingMessages.createdAt),
        db.select().from(schema.remmyBriefingAttachments).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingAttachments.sessionId, session.id)).orderBy(schema.remmyBriefingAttachments.createdAt),
      ]);
      const transcript = messageRows
        .filter((row) => row.text.trim())
        .map((row) => `${row.role === "user" ? "Ben" : "Remmy"}: ${row.text}`)
        .join("\n\n");
      const notes = [
        session.shapedBrief,
        attachmentRows.length ? `\nAttached in the briefing chat (the files are in this job's folder):\n${attachmentRows.map((row) => `- ${row.fileName}`).join("\n")}` : "",
        transcript ? `\n— The briefing conversation —\n${transcript}` : "",
      ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
      let created: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createPlannedWork>> = null;
      if (session.shapedJobType === "research") {
        created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: researchPlan(title, notes), pipeline: "research_case", jobType: "research" });
      } else if (session.shapedJobType === "x_posts") {
        const plan = await xPostsPlan(ctx, title, notes, session.shapedPostCount ?? 3);
        if (!plan) return { ok: false, error: "Olivia's standing order could not be found, so her drafting rules are unavailable. Nothing was created." };
        created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: plan, pipeline: "x_posts", jobType: "x_posts" });
      } else if (session.shapedJobType === "perfectly_paranoid") {
        const subject = notes ? `${title}\n\n${notes}` : title;
        created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: socialPostPlan(subject).steps, pipeline: "perfectly_paranoid", jobType: "perfectly_paranoid" });
      } else {
        let plan: z.infer<typeof workPlanShape>;
        try { plan = await planWork(ctx, title, notes, { standardContract: true }); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "The job could not be divided into crew steps right now. Nothing was started; try Send it to the crew again." }; }
        created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: plan.steps, pipeline: null, jobType: "standard" });
      }
      if (!created) return { ok: false, error: "The job could not be created." };
      let copiedNote = "";
      if (attachmentRows.length) {
        try {
          const copied = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.copyBriefingAttachmentsToJob, {
            taskId: created.task.id, relativePaths: attachmentRows.map((row) => row.stagingRelativePath),
          });
          for (let index = 0; index < attachmentRows.length; index += 1) {
            const row = attachmentRows[index];
            const path = copied.copiedPaths[index];
            if (row && path) await db.update(schema.remmyBriefingAttachments).set({ jobRelativePath: path }).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingAttachments.id, row.id));
          }
          copiedNote = copied.missing ? ` ${copied.missing} attachment${copied.missing === 1 ? "" : "s"} could not be copied onto the job.` : "";
        } catch {
          copiedNote = " The chat attachments could not be copied onto the job.";
        }
      }
      const now = new Date();
      await appendRemmyMessage(ctx, session.id, "remmy", `Sent to the crew — “${title}” is a normal job now, moving through the usual pipeline.${copiedNote}`, now);
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).set({ status: "dispatched", taskId: created.task.id, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.id, session.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben started the job Remmy shaped from their briefing chat: “${title}”.${attachmentRows.length ? ` ${attachmentRows.length} chat attachment${attachmentRows.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} went with it.` : ""}` }),
      ]);
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      const refreshed = await loadRemmyBriefing(ctx, session.id);
      return { ok: true, briefing: await remmyBriefingDto(ctx, refreshed ?? session) };
    },
  }),

  // Preset jobs — saved job shapes Ben starts himself with one click. A
  // preset is only a starting shape: starting one runs the exact same
  // create-work paths above (same triage, same pipelines, same approvals)
  // and produces a completely normal job. Nothing about a preset fires on
  // its own — that is what standing orders are for.
  create_preset: defineAction({
    request: presetInput,
    response: presetResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof presetResult>> {
      const invalid = presetValidationError(args);
      if (invalid) return { ok: false, error: invalid };
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const now = new Date();
      const rows = await db.insert(schema.presetJobs).values({
        id: `preset-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, name: args.name, jobType: args.jobType, title: args.title, notes: args.notes,
        postCount: args.jobType === "x_posts" ? args.postCount ?? 3 : null,
