        fillInLabel: args.fillInLabel?.trim() ? args.fillInLabel.trim() : null,
        createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
      }).returning();
      const preset = rows[0];
      if (!preset) return { ok: false, error: "The preset could not be saved." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben saved a preset job “${preset.name}”. It starts only when he clicks Start.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, preset: presetDto(preset) };
    },
  }),

  update_preset: defineAction({
    request: presetInput.extend({ id: z.string().min(1) }),
    response: presetResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof presetResult>> {
      const invalid = presetValidationError(args);
      if (invalid) return { ok: false, error: invalid };
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.presetJobs).where(eq(schema.presetJobs.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      if (!rows[0]) return { ok: false, error: "That preset could not be found." };
      const now = new Date();
      const updated = await db.update(schema.presetJobs).set({
        name: args.name, jobType: args.jobType, title: args.title, notes: args.notes,
        postCount: args.jobType === "x_posts" ? args.postCount ?? 3 : null,
        fillInLabel: args.fillInLabel?.trim() ? args.fillInLabel.trim() : null,
        updatedAt: now,
      }).where(eq(schema.presetJobs.id, args.id)).returning();
      const preset = updated[0];
      if (!preset) return { ok: false, error: "The preset could not be saved." };
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, preset: presetDto(preset) };
    },
  }),

  delete_preset: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.presetJobs).where(eq(schema.presetJobs.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const preset = rows[0];
      if (!preset) return { ok: false, error: "That preset could not be found." };
      await db.batch([
        db.delete(schema.presetJobs).where(eq(schema.presetJobs.id, preset.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben deleted the preset job “${preset.name}”.` }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  start_preset: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), fillInValue: z.string().trim().max(2000).optional() }),
    response: startPresetResult,
    privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof startPresetResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.presetJobs).where(eq(schema.presetJobs.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const preset = rows[0];
      if (!preset) return { ok: false, error: "That preset could not be found." };
      // Resolve the one fill-in spot, if the preset marks one: the supplied
      // value replaces every {{fill-in}} token in the title and the brief.
      let title = preset.title;
      let notes = preset.notes;
      if (preset.fillInLabel) {
        const value = args.fillInValue?.trim() ?? "";
        if (!value) return { ok: false, error: `This preset needs its ${preset.fillInLabel} before it can start.` };
        title = title.split(PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN).join(value);
        notes = notes.split(PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN).join(value);
      }
      const finish = async (created: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createPlannedWork>>, logText: string, triageReason: string, failureError: string) => {
        const first = created?.briefs[0];
        if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: failureError };
        await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: logText });
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
        const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
        const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
        return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first), triageReason };
      };
      if (preset.jobType === "x_posts") {
        const count = preset.postCount ?? 3;
        const plan = await xPostsPlan(ctx, title, notes, count);
        if (!plan) return { ok: false, error: "Olivia's standing order could not be found, so her drafting rules are unavailable. Nothing was created." };
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: plan, pipeline: "x_posts", jobType: "x_posts" });
        return finish(created, `Ben started the preset “${preset.name}” — Olivia is drafting ${count} X post${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Finished posts land in the Post Queue — no approval step; Ben pastes them himself.`, "X post jobs always go to Olivia, the X Drafter in the Research Department. Drafts land in the Post Queue; nothing publishes without Ben pasting it himself.", "The X post job could not be created.");
      }
      if (preset.jobType === "research") {
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: researchPlan(title, notes), pipeline: "research_case", jobType: "research" });
        return finish(created, `Ben started the preset “${preset.name}” — a research case in the Research Department: Walter reads, Peter verifies, the Claim-checker grades every claim, Tom writes the brief.`, "Research cases always run Walter (Reader) → Peter (Verifier) → Claim-checker (grades) → Tom (brief) in the Research Department.", "The research case could not be created.");
      }
      if (preset.jobType === "perfectly_paranoid") {
        const subject = notes ? `${title}\n\n${notes}` : title;
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: socialPostPlan(subject).steps, pipeline: "perfectly_paranoid", jobType: "perfectly_paranoid" });
        return finish(created, `Ben started the preset “${preset.name}” — a Perfectly Paranoid story job. Tom, Johnny, and Nik run in order; Ben will see the finished package once at the end.`, "Perfectly Paranoid presets run the fixed story pipeline: Tom researches and verifies, Johnny writes the copy, Nik creates the image.", "The story job could not be created.");
      }
      let plan: z.infer<typeof workPlanShape>;
      try { plan = await planWork(ctx, title, notes, { standardContract: true }); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "Remmy could not divide this job right now. Nothing was created; try again." }; }
      const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes, steps: plan.steps, pipeline: null, jobType: "standard" });
      return finish(created, `Ben started the preset “${preset.name}”. Remmy divided it into ${created?.briefs.length ?? 0} crew step${(created?.briefs.length ?? 0) === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`, plan.reason, "The job could not be created.");
    },
  }),

  start_perfectly_paranoid_pipeline: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ angle: z.string().trim().max(500).default(""), clientId: z.string().min(1).nullable().optional() }),
    response: z.discriminatedUnion("ok", [z.object({ ok: z.literal(true), task: taskShape, brief: briefShape }), z.object({ ok: z.literal(false), error: z.string() })]),
    privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args) {
      // Optional client tag (Ben, 2026-10-14): a tagged story job behaves
      // like every other client job — Maria's intake step runs FIRST,
      // shaping the brief against the client's registry voice notes, then
      // the normal Tom → Johnny → Nik steps run unchanged (Tom's
      // escalation rule included), and on approval it exits ONLY through
      // that client's delivery package, never Deliverables → To post.
      // No clientId: the job is exactly what it has always been.
      let client: typeof schema.clients.$inferSelect | null = null;
      if (args.clientId) {
        const rows = await ctx.db<typeof schema>().select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.clientId)).limit(1);
        client = rows[0] ?? null;
        if (!client) return { ok: false as const, error: "That client is no longer in the registry. Pick another client, or no client." };
      }
      const angle = args.angle || "Find one genuinely interesting AI project, breakthrough, weird demo, or open-source build worth sharing now.";
      const title = args.angle ? `Perfectly Paranoid: ${args.angle}`.slice(0, 120) : "Perfectly Paranoid: find a remarkable AI story";
      const steps = client ? [mariaIntakeStep(client, title, angle), ...socialPostPlan(angle).steps] : socialPostPlan(angle).steps;
      const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, { title, notes: angle, steps, pipeline: "perfectly_paranoid", clientId: client?.id ?? null, jobType: "perfectly_paranoid" }); const first = created?.briefs[0];
      if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "The story job could not be created." };
      await ctx.db<typeof schema>().insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: client
        ? `Ben gave Remmy a Perfectly Paranoid story job for ${client.businessName}. Maria shapes the brief at intake first, then Tom, Johnny, and Nik run in order; the finished package goes to Deliverables for delivery.`
        : `Ben gave Remmy a Perfectly Paranoid story job. Remmy assigned Tom, Johnny, and Nik in order; Ben will see the finished package once at the end.` });
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(created.task), brief: briefDto(first) };
    },
  }),

  set_brief_status: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), status: briefStatus, result: z.string().max(100000).optional() }), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.organizeDeliverables, privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.readDeliverable, privileged.listSkillPool, privileged.writeLabVerification, privileged.appendOfficePotNote],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      if (args.status === "in_progress") { const claimed = await claimBrief(ctx, args.id); if (!claimed) return { ok: false, error: "This step is not eligible to start." }; await spawnWorker(ctx, claimed); return { ok: true }; }
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const rows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, args.id)).limit(1); const brief = rows[0];
      if (!brief) return { ok: false, error: "Brief not found." };
      if (brief.status !== "in_progress") return { ok: false, error: "Only the visible active worker can finish this step." };
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, brief.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      const standingOrderRun = Boolean(task?.standingOrderId);
      const now = new Date(); const result = args.result ?? brief.result;
      if (args.status === "failed") {
        // X-post jobs never request approval either — the Post Queue is the
        // review surface, so a failed draft run is recorded in history.
        // A failed package assembly is also record-only at the job level:
        // the package itself flips to Ready with the failure stated plainly
        // on it, so Ben still gets his one decision in Deliverables.
        const failedSubcaseParent = task ? await isEscalationSubcase(ctx, task) : null;
        const recordOnly = standingOrderRun || task?.pipeline === "x_posts" || task?.pipeline === "client_delivery" || Boolean(failedSubcaseParent);
        if (task?.pipeline === "client_delivery") {
          await db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({
            status: "ready",
            coverNote: `Maria could not assemble this package automatically — the assembly step stopped with this note: ${result ?? "no reason was recorded."} The job's finished work is attached below; you can still approve the package, or send it back to Maria for another try.`,
            updatedAt: now,
          }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.packageTaskId, brief.taskId));
        }
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.briefs).set({ status: "failed", result: result ?? "The worker reported a failure.", progressText: recordOnly ? "Stopped — recorded in history" : "Stopped — needs you", lastHeartbeatAt: now, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id)),
          db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: recordOnly ? "done" : "approval", assignee: brief.assignee }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, brief.taskId)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: recordOnly ? `${memberByAssignee(brief.assignee)} could not finish the run. The issue was recorded in history without requesting approval.` : `${memberByAssignee(brief.assignee)} stopped on “${brief.title}”. The exact failure is waiting for you.` }),
        ]);
        if (failedSubcaseParent) {
          // A lab step failed: the sub-case still never surfaces for Ben.
          // Release the parent with the failure stated plainly — every
          // escalated claim counts as not verified, so downstream steps
          // keep them on the do-not-publish footing.
          const claimCount = failedSubcaseParent.escalationClaimCount ?? 0;
          const labText = `# Lab verification — ${failedSubcaseParent.title}\n\nThe Research Department's check of the escalated claims stopped before it could finish: ${result ?? "no reason was recorded."}\n\nEvery escalated claim is therefore treated as NOT VERIFIED for this job and stays on the do-not-publish footing.`;
          // The lab case closed (by failure): every escalated claim is
          // NOT VERIFIED, so the claim list itself is the do-not-publish
          // list — post it to the office pot like any research close.
          if (task) {
            let failedClaims: string[] = [];
            try { const parsed = JSON.parse(failedSubcaseParent.escalationClaims ?? "[]"); if (Array.isArray(parsed)) failedClaims = parsed.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string"); } catch { failedClaims = []; }
            if (failedClaims.length > 0) {
              await postDoNotPublishToPot(ctx, task, [`## Do-not-publish\n${failedClaims.map((claim) => `- ${claim} — NOT VERIFIED (the lab check stopped before it could finish)`).join("\n")}`]);
            }
          }
          await resumeParentAfterLab(ctx, failedSubcaseParent, labText, { documented: 0, notVerified: claimCount });
        }
        ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true };
      }
      if (args.status !== "done") return { ok: false, error: "A worker step can only finish as done or failed." };
      let resultText = result ?? "";
      const resultHints = deliverableHints([resultText]);
      if (resultHints.length > 0) {
        try {
          await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.organizeDeliverables, { taskId: brief.taskId, relativeHints: resultHints });
        } catch {
          // The textual result remains reviewable even if an optional file could not be packaged.
        }
      }
      if (task?.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" && brief.assignee === "quill") {
        const postCopy = await captureSocialPostCopy(ctx, brief.taskId, resultText);
        if (postCopy) {
          const hashtagError = hashtagBlockError(postCopy, "facebook");
          if (hashtagError) return { ok: false, error: `This social post is unfinished — ${hashtagError}. Every finished post (Perfectly Paranoid and standard social alike) ends with a hashtag block of 3–5 top topic-specific tags, no filler tags, with nothing after the block. Add that ending block to the publication-ready copy and finish again.` };
          await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ postCopy }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, brief.taskId));
        }
      }
      // Standard social copy that arrives through a planner-written Johnny
      // step (pipeline not set to perfectly_paranoid, but the job itself is
      // a social-post request and the result carries publication-ready
      // copy) is held to the same hashtag-block gate. LEGACY ONLY: a
      // contract-bound job (jobType set) follows its own contract instead —
      // the standard contract FORBIDS hashtag finishers, so this gate must
      // never demand one on a bound job. Unbound jobs keep the old gate.
      if (task && !task.jobType && task.pipeline !== "perfectly_paranoid" && brief.assignee === "quill" && isSocialPostRequest(task.title, task.notes)) {
        const standardCopy = extractPublicationReadyPost(resultText);
        if (standardCopy) {
          const hashtagError = hashtagBlockError(standardCopy, "facebook");
          if (hashtagError) return { ok: false, error: `This social post is unfinished — ${hashtagError}. Every finished post ends with a hashtag block of 3–5 top topic-specific tags, no filler tags, with nothing after the block. Add that ending block to the publication-ready copy and finish again.` };
        }
      }
      // Delivery-package steps: if Maria staged a revised post copy in the
      // package job's folder (a rework that changed the post itself), it is
      // carried back onto the source job here — the package Ben reads is
      // rendered from the source job's stored copy. A staged revision that
      // fails the hashtag gate holds the step open, exactly like Johnny's
      // copy gate: she fixes the saved copy and finishes again.
      if (task?.pipeline === "client_delivery") {
        const sync = await syncPackagePostCopy(ctx, brief.taskId, resultText);
        if (sync.outcome === "invalid") return { ok: false, error: `The revised post copy saved in this package job's folder is unfinished — ${sync.error}. Every finished post ends with a hashtag block of 3–5 top topic-specific tags, no filler tags, with nothing after the block. Fix the saved copy in the package job's folder and finish again — the office carries the saved revision into the package Ben reads.` };
      }
      if (task?.standingOrderId === SVEN_VISIONARY_ORDER_ID && brief.assignee === "ledger") {
        const savedIdeas = await db.select({ id: schema.visionaryIdeas.id }).from(schema.visionaryIdeas).where(eq(schema.visionaryIdeas.briefId, brief.id));
        if (savedIdeas.length < 2 || savedIdeas.length > 3) return { ok: false, error: "Save exactly 2 or 3 structured visionary ideas before finishing this run." };
      }
      if (task?.pipeline === "x_posts" && brief.assignee === "olivia") {
        const savedPosts = await db.select({ id: schema.xPosts.id }).from(schema.xPosts).where(eq(schema.xPosts.briefId, brief.id));
        if (savedPosts.length < 1) return { ok: false, error: "Save the drafted posts with save_x_posts before finishing this brief." };
      }
      // PIECE SUMMARY CAPTURE (Ben, 2026-10-19): the plain summary this
      // step authored for its piece — its result's "## In plain words"
      // lead, or the mandated opening summary of an exact-shape piece —
      // is stored on the brief record here, at completion, in the same
      // pass that captures the job's summary from the finishing step
      // below. The contents rows of the job's card serve this stored
      // value; nothing is scraped from the document at display time.
      const pieceSummary = extractPiecePlainSummary(resultText);
      await db.update(schema.briefs).set({ status: "done", result, progressText: "Completed", lastHeartbeatAt: now, updatedAt: now, ...(pieceSummary ? { summary: pieceSummary } : {}) }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id));
      // CLAIM COMPLETENESS GATE (Change 1) — the mechanical boundary
      // between claim-check and synthesis. Scoped to jobs whose briefs
      // carry the gate instructions (jobs planned after this build) or
      // that already hold gate records: jobs created before the gate are
      // never reconciled, marked, or bannered by it.
      if (task && isResearchGateTask(task) && (brief.pipelineStage === "claim_check" || brief.pipelineStage === "synthesis")) {
        const gateRows = await loadClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
        const gateApplies = gateRows.manifest.length > 0 || gateRows.grades.length > 0 || task.gradingStatus !== null || brief.notes.includes("CLAIM COMPLETENESS GATE") || brief.notes.includes("GRADING COMPLETENESS GATE");
        if (gateApplies) {
          const recon = await applyClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
          if (brief.pipelineStage === "claim_check") {
            await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: recon.status === "complete"
              ? `The claim gate reconciled “${task.title}” as the claim-check finished: all ${recon.manifestCount} manifest claims have exactly one grade.`
              : `The claim gate marked “${task.title}” GRADING INCOMPLETE as the claim-check finished: ${recon.incompleteIds.length} of ${recon.manifestCount} claims unaccounted for (${recon.incompleteIds.join(", ") || "none recorded"})${recon.errors.length > 0 ? ` — ${recon.errors[0]}` : ""}. Synthesis may still draft, but the brief must carry the grading-incomplete banner.` });
          } else if (recon.status === "incomplete" && recon.banner && !resultText.includes("GRADING INCOMPLETE")) {
            // Synthesis drafted over an incomplete grading: stamp the
            // banner onto the brief itself (its stored result — the file
            // copy the worker saved is joined by claim-grades.md and the
            // Breakdown, which both carry the same mark), so the finished
            // brief can never read as fully checked.
            resultText = `${recon.banner}\n\n${resultText}`;
            await db.update(schema.briefs).set({ result: resultText }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id));
            await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `The brief for “${task.title}” was stamped with the grading-incomplete banner: ${recon.incompleteIds.length} of ${recon.manifestCount} claims could not be accounted for (${recon.incompleteIds.join(", ") || "none recorded"}). The job is GRADING INCOMPLETE — not fully checked.` });
          }
        }
      }
      // ESCALATION — Tom's step on a main-floor job listed claims under the
      // ESCALATED TO RESEARCH DEPT heading. First time on this job: spawn
      // ONE lab sub-case for exactly those claims and hold the parent here
      // (its status stays "working" and eligibleBriefs skips it while the
      // escalation is pending, so no later step and no approval can jump
      // ahead of the lab). Second attempt on the same job: log it and let
      // the job continue with what the lab already returned — no new case.
      if (task && brief.assignee === "scout" && isEscalationEligibleTask(task)) {
        const escalatedClaims = parseEscalatedClaims(resultText);
        if (escalatedClaims && escalatedClaims.length > 0) {
          const alreadyEscalated = task.escalationStatus !== null || task.escalationSubtaskId !== null;
          if (alreadyEscalated) {
            await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Tom tried to send more claims to the Research Department on “${task.title}”, but a job gets one escalation — it continues with what the lab already returned.` });
          } else {
            const created = await spawnLabSubcase(ctx, task, escalatedClaims, resultText);
            if (created) {
              await db.update(schema.tasks).set({
                escalationStatus: "pending", escalationClaims: JSON.stringify(escalatedClaims), escalationSubtaskId: created.task.id,
                escalationClaimCount: escalatedClaims.length, escalationDocumented: null, escalationNotVerified: null,
              }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id));
              await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Tom sent ${escalatedClaims.length} claim${escalatedClaims.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} to the Research Department on “${task.title}”. The job waits for the lab — Walter gathers, Peter verifies, the Claim-checker grades, Tom writes it up upstairs.` });
              await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
              ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true };
            }
            await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Tom flagged claims for the Research Department on “${task.title}”, but the lab case could not be started — the job continues downstairs.` });
          }
        }
      }
      const all = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(and(eq(schema.briefs.taskId, brief.taskId), eq(schema.briefs.revision, task?.revision ?? brief.revision))).orderBy(schema.briefs.stepIndex, schema.briefs.createdAt);
      const next = all.find((item) => item.status === "new");
      if (!next) {
        // LAB SUB-CASE FINISH — internal: the sub-case closes to Done (it
        // never appears in Ready for You and needs no approval), its
        // synthesis is saved into the parent job's folder as
        // lab-verification.md and attached to Tom's parent step output,
        // and the parent resumes from where it waited.
        const subcaseParent = task ? await isEscalationSubcase(ctx, task) : null;
        if (task && subcaseParent) {
          const peterBrief = all.find((item) => item.assignee === "peter" && item.pipelineStage === "verification" && item.result?.trim()) ?? all.find((item) => item.assignee === "peter" && item.result?.trim());
          const claimCheckBrief = all.find((item) => item.pipelineStage === "claim_check" && item.result?.trim());
          const labelSource = peterBrief?.result ?? all.filter((item) => item.result?.trim()).map((item) => item.result).join("\n\n");
          const counts = countLabLabels(labelSource);
          let escalatedList: string[] = [];
          try { const parsed = JSON.parse(subcaseParent.escalationClaims ?? "[]"); if (Array.isArray(parsed)) escalatedList = parsed.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string"); } catch { escalatedList = []; }
          const labText = [
            `# Lab verification — ${subcaseParent.title}`,
            "",
            `Escalated claims Tom sent to the Research Department (${escalatedList.length}):`,
            ...(escalatedList.length ? escalatedList.map((claim) => `- ${claim}`) : ["- (claim list not recorded)"]),
            "",
            `Lab return: ${counts.documented} documented, ${counts.notVerified} not verified. Claims labeled NOT VERIFIED are on the do-not-publish footing for the parent job.`,
            "",
            "## Peter — verifier labels",
            peterBrief?.result?.trim() || "Peter's labeled list was not recorded.",
            "",
            "## Claim-checker — claim grades",
            claimCheckBrief?.result?.trim() || "The claim-check grading was not recorded.",
            "",
            "## Tom — lab synthesis",
            resultText.trim() || "Tom's lab synthesis was not recorded.",
          ].join("\n");
          await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "done", assignee: brief.assignee }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id));
          await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `The Research Department finished its check for “${subcaseParent.title}” and handed the labels back downstairs.` });
          // A lab sub-case is a research job closing: its do-not-publish
          // items go to the office pot like any other case's.
          await postDoNotPublishToPot(ctx, task, [peterBrief?.result ?? "", resultText]);
          await resumeParentAfterLab(ctx, subcaseParent, labText, counts);
          ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true };
        }
        // PRE-SURFACE FINISHER CHECK — the final step of a contract-bound
        // job just finished. Before this task may surface anywhere (Ready
        // for You, the Post Queue's lanes, a delivery package), its
        // deliverable is validated against the outcome contract bound at
        // creation. A violation bounces it back as a contract-rework step
        // with the reasons recorded on the task and in the office log —
        // Ben never sees the violating version. Delivery-package assembly
        // jobs carry no contract (client_delivery is not one of the seven
        // types) and standing-order runs are unbound, so both skip this.
        if (task && task.pipeline !== "client_delivery" && !standingOrderRun) {
          // The image-step test sees every brief the job has ever run: a
          // part rework (Ben sent back only the copy, say) completes on a
          // fresh revision whose lone brief is not the image step, and the
          // package's image step is the original one.
          const allTaskBriefs = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.taskId, task.id));
          const violations = await validateDeliverableAgainstContract(ctx, task, resultText, allTaskBriefs);
          const contract = contractForTask(task);
          // SUMMARY CAPTURE: the authored summary the finishing step wrote
          // in its result is stored on the task record here, at completion
          // — the card renders the stored value, never a display-time
          // scrape. (A violating finish keeps its old stored summary; the
          // bounce path returns before this point when a rework is queued,
          // and the exhausted-budget path below still records the new one
          // alongside the violation it surfaces with.)
          const authoredSummary = extractAuthoredSummary(resultText);
          if (contract && violations.length > 0) {
            const bounces = (task.contractBounces ?? 0) + 1;
            const violationText = violations.join("; ");
            if (bounces <= CONTRACT_MAX_BOUNCES) {
              const nextIndex = Math.max(...all.map((item) => item.stepIndex), -1) + 1;
              const completedContext = all.filter((item) => item.status === "done" && item.result?.trim()).map((item) => `${memberByAssignee(item.assignee)} — ${item.title}:\n${item.result}`).join("\n\n").slice(-12000);
              const reworkRows = await db.insert(schema.briefs).values({
                id: `brief-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, taskId: task.id, title: `Contract rework: ${task.title}`.slice(0, 120), assignee: brief.assignee,
                notes: `CONTRACT REWORK — the finished deliverable for this ${contract.label} job FAILED its pre-surface outcome-contract check and was bounced back before it could surface. This is not a style note: the deliverable breaks the contract this job was created under, and it will be checked again when you finish.\n\nWhat failed:\n${violations.map((violation) => `- ${violation}`).join("\n")}\n\nFix exactly these problems IN THE DELIVERABLE ITSELF: edit and re-save the deliverable files in this job's folder (${taskDeliverableFolder(task.id)}) so the corrected deliverable is what the files contain — removing a hashtag block means it is gone from the saved document, removing an image means the image file is deleted from the folder, adding a missing required element means it is in the saved deliverable — and make your result the corrected deliverable (or, for a document, the corrected document's text). Change nothing else: the rest of the finished work stands.\n\n${contractBriefBlock(contract)}${completedContext ? `\n\nCompleted work so far (the violating deliverable is in here — fix it, do not resubmit it as-is):\n${completedContext}` : ""}`,
                status: "new", result: null, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, pipeline: task.pipeline, pipelineStage: null,
                runTaskId: null, progressText: "Bounced by the outcome-contract check", lastHeartbeatAt: null, attempt: 0, stepIndex: nextIndex, revision: task.revision,
              }).returning();
              if (reworkRows[0]) {
                await db.batch([
                  db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "working", assignee: brief.assignee, contractStatus: "bounced", contractViolation: violationText, contractBounces: bounces }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
                  db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `The finished ${contract.label} deliverable for “${task.title}” failed its outcome-contract check — ${violationText}. It was bounced back for rework before it could surface (bounce ${bounces} of ${CONTRACT_MAX_BOUNCES}).` }),
                ]);
                await startNextForTask(ctx, task.id);
                ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true };
              }
            }
            // Bounce budget spent: surface WITH the violation recorded, so
            // the job can never loop workers forever. A client-tagged job
            // still cannot be approved into its delivery package while the
            // violation stands (set_task_status enforces that), and Ben
            // sees the violation on the job card either way.
            await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ contractStatus: "bounced", contractViolation: violationText, contractBounces: bounces }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id));
            await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `The ${contract.label} deliverable for “${task.title}” still fails its outcome-contract check after ${CONTRACT_MAX_BOUNCES} rework bounces — ${violationText}. It surfaces with the violation recorded on the job; ${task.clientId ? "as a client job it cannot be approved into a delivery package until the violation is fixed by a rework." : "Ben can send it back for rework or delete it."}` });
          } else if (contract) {
            await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ contractStatus: "passed", contractViolation: null, ...(authoredSummary ? { summary: authoredSummary } : {}) }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id));
          }
          if (!contract && authoredSummary) {
            // Unbound jobs (created before outcome contracts) carry no
            // check to pass, but a summary their finishing step authored
            // is still captured the same way.
            await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ summary: authoredSummary }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id));
          }
        }
        // THE FINAL GATE (pipeline routes): this chain is the one
        // place a finished job is routed to its only surface. Re-read
        // the job first — the contract check above may have stamped a
        // fresh contract status on it, and the routing reads that.
        const freshTaskRows = task ? await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)).limit(1) : [];
        const freshTask = freshTaskRows[0] ?? task;
        // RESEARCH CLOSE → OFFICE POT: whichever route this research
        // job takes out of the gate (Ready for You, a client's delivery
        // package, or straight to Done as a standing-order run), its
        // do-not-publish list is posted to the office pot first, so the
        // other floors are bound by it from the moment the case closes.
        if (task && (task.pipeline === "research_case" || task.jobType === "research")) {
          const allResults = all.filter((item) => item.status === "done" && item.result?.trim()).map((item) => item.result as string);
          await postDoNotPublishToPot(ctx, task, allResults.length > 0 ? allResults : [resultText]);
        }
        if (task?.pipeline === "x_posts") {
          // The Post Queue is the review surface for X posts: no approval
          // step. Manual and Monday-batch jobs alike finish straight to
          // Done, and the drafted posts wait in the queue for Ben to paste.
          const queuedCount = (await db.select({ id: schema.xPosts.id }).from(schema.xPosts).where(eq(schema.xPosts.briefId, brief.id))).length;
          await db.batch([
            db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "done", assignee: brief.assignee }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, brief.taskId)),
            db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Olivia drafted ${queuedCount} X post${queuedCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} into the Post Queue for @PulseHQOffice. Ben pastes them himself — nothing was published.` }),
          ]);
        } else if (task?.pipeline === "client_delivery") {
          // Maria finished assembling a delivery package: the package job
          // closes, and the package itself waits in Deliverables for
          // Ben's one decision. Her result IS the cover note he reads.
          const coverNote = resultText.trim() || null;
          await db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ status: "ready", coverNote, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.packageTaskId, brief.taskId));
          const pkgRows = await db.select().from(schema.deliveryPackages).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.packageTaskId, brief.taskId)).limit(1);
          const clientRows = pkgRows[0] ? await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, pkgRows[0].clientId)).limit(1) : [];
          await db.batch([
            db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "done", assignee: brief.assignee }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, brief.taskId)),
            db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Maria assembled the delivery package for ${clientRows[0]?.businessName ?? "the client"}: “${task.title.replace(/^Delivery package — /, "")}”. It is waiting in Deliverables for your one decision.` }),
          ]);
        } else if (freshTask && isExternalClientJob(freshTask) && !isStuckOnContract(freshTask)) {
          // CLIENT ROUTE: a finished job for an external client goes
          // to its client's delivery package — the package is the
          // decision item in Deliverables, and the job itself never
          // surfaces loose in Ready for You. A job stuck on its
          // contract check (isStuckOnContract) skips this route: it
          // cannot be packaged, so it takes the manual route below and
          // surfaces as a stuck item for Ben's rework/delete decision.
          await routeFinishedClientJob(ctx, freshTask, brief.assignee);
        } else if (standingOrderRun) {
          // Sven's hunt completion report names the story counts in plain
          // words (Ben's aggregator rule): how many stories landed on each
          // shelf in this run, and how many of the Perfectly Paranoid ones
          // came from declassified files.
          let completionText = `${memberByAssignee(brief.assignee)} finished the standing-order run. It moved directly to Done.`;
          if (task?.standingOrderId === SVEN_VISIONARY_ORDER_ID) {
            const runStories = await db.select({ shelf: schema.svenStories.shelf, isDeclassified: schema.svenStories.isDeclassified }).from(schema.svenStories).where(eq(schema.svenStories.briefId, brief.id));
            const ppStories = runStories.filter((row) => row.shelf === "perfectly_paranoid").length;
            const phqStories = runStories.length - ppStories;
            const declassifiedStories = runStories.filter((row) => row.isDeclassified).length;
            completionText = runStories.length > 0
              ? `Sven finished his hunt. Alongside his ideas he filed ${runStories.length} ${runStories.length === 1 ? "story" : "stories"}: ${ppStories} for Perfectly Paranoid${declassifiedStories ? ` (${declassifiedStories} from declassified files)` : ""}${phqStories ? ` and ${phqStories} for Pulse HQ` : ""}. The run moved directly to Done.`
              : "Sven finished his hunt and filed no stories this time — nothing he found was worth a shelf spot. The run moved directly to Done.";
          }
          await db.batch([
            db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "done", assignee: brief.assignee }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, brief.taskId)),
            db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: completionText }),
          ]);
        } else {
          await db.batch([
            db.update(schema.tasks).set(task?.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid"
              ? { status: "approval", assignee: brief.assignee, publicationStatus: "awaiting_approval" }
              : { status: "approval", assignee: brief.assignee }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, brief.taskId)),
            db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `${memberByAssignee(brief.assignee)} finished the final crew step. The job is waiting for your one decision.` }),
          ]);
        }
        ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true };
      }
      const completedContext = all
        .filter((item) => item.status === "done" && item.result?.trim())
        .map((item) => `${memberByAssignee(item.assignee)} — ${item.title}:\n${item.result}`)
        .join("\n\n");
      const priorContext = completedContext ? `\n\nCompleted work so far:\n${completedContext}` : "";
      await db.update(schema.briefs).set({ notes: ensureContractBlock(task, `${next.notes}${priorContext}`).slice(-20000), updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, next.id));
      await db.insert(schema.handoffEvents).values({ id: `handoff-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, fromMemberId: memberId.parse(brief.assignee), toMemberId: memberId.parse(next.assignee), sourceTaskId: brief.taskId, targetBriefId: next.id, title: next.title, createdAt: now });
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `${memberByAssignee(brief.assignee)} finished “${brief.title}” and handed the job to ${memberByAssignee(next.assignee)}. No approval was requested.` });
      await startNextForTask(ctx, brief.taskId);
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  report_progress: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ briefId: z.string().min(1), memberId, progress: z.string().trim().min(1).max(1000) }), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const rows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, args.briefId)).limit(1); const brief = rows[0];
      if (!brief || brief.status !== "in_progress" || brief.assignee !== args.memberId) return { ok: false, error: "This is not the worker's active visible step." };
      const now = new Date(); await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.briefs).set({ progressText: args.progress, lastHeartbeatAt: now, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `${memberNames[args.memberId]}: ${args.progress}` }),
      ]); ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  set_task_status: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), status: taskStatus }), response: taskStatusResult, privileged: [privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.readDeliverable],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof taskStatusResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const rows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.id)).limit(1); const task = rows[0];
      if (!task) return { ok: false, error: "Job not found." };
      if (args.status !== "done" || task.status !== "approval") return { ok: false, error: "Jobs move automatically. Ben can only approve a finished job." };
      if (isApprovedPostPackage(task)) return { ok: false, error: "This package is already approved — it is waiting in Deliverables, under To post. Copy it from there and mark it posted once you have published it." };
      const openBlockers = await db.select().from(schema.blockers).where(and(eq(schema.blockers.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.blockers.status, "open"))).limit(1);
      if (openBlockers[0]) return { ok: false, error: "Answer the crew's blocker before approving this job." };
      // Outcome contracts — strictest enforcement for client-tagged jobs:
      // a deliverable still carrying a contract violation can never be
      // approved into a client's delivery package. It goes back for rework
      // (which re-runs the pre-surface check) or it does not ship.
      if (task.clientId && task.contractStatus === "bounced" && task.contractViolation) {
        return { ok: false, error: `This client deliverable failed its outcome-contract check — ${task.contractViolation}. It cannot be approved into a delivery package until a rework fixes the violation; send it back for rework.` };
      }
      // One decision per job: approving a job also finalizes its deliverable
      // review in the same action — but only when no image deliverable is
      // still awaiting a batch decision. Text-only jobs (the research-case
      // brief IS the deliverable) therefore close fully on the single
      // approval and never resurface for a second review step. A job with a
      // multi-image package is decided on its review grid instead: Ben
      // selects the images to keep and presses the one Accept (the batch
      // finalize action), which records every decision at once — while any
      // image here is still undecided this plain approval is refused and
      // points him at that grid (which for merch jobs also triggers the
      // next pipeline step). A single image with no per-file decision (e.g.
      // the Perfectly Paranoid package, reviewed as a whole) is approved as
      // today and left unfinalized so the image stays visible in
      // Deliverables.
      let finalizeWithApproval = false;
      let imagePaths: string[] = [];
      try {
        imagePaths = await taskImagePaths(ctx, task);
        // Excluded pieces take no decision, so they can never count as
        // an undecided image holding this approval open.
        const excludedPaths = await excludedPathsForTask(ctx, task);
        if (excludedPaths.size > 0) imagePaths = imagePaths.filter((path) => !excludedPaths.has(path));
        if (!task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt) {
          if (imagePaths.length > 1) {
            const reviewRows = await db.select().from(schema.deliverableReviews).where(eq(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, task.id));
            const decided = new Set(reviewRows.map((row) => row.relativePath));
            const pending = imagePaths.filter((path) => !decided.has(path));
            if (pending.length > 0) return { ok: false, error: "Pick the images to keep on the review grid, then press Accept." };
            // Every image already has a decision, but merch packages must
            // still go through the item-review finish so approving images
            // triggers the listing step — never close them from here.
            if (isMerchTask(task)) return { ok: false, error: "Pick the images to keep on the review grid, then press Accept." };
            finalizeWithApproval = true;
          } else if (imagePaths.length === 0) {
            finalizeWithApproval = true;
          } else {
            // Exactly one image: finalize only when it already carries a
            // review decision, so an undecided image is never hidden by the
            // finalized-review filter in get_task_deliverables.
            const reviewRows = await db.select().from(schema.deliverableReviews).where(eq(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, task.id));
            const decided = new Set(reviewRows.map((row) => row.relativePath));
            finalizeWithApproval = imagePaths.every((path) => decided.has(path));
          }
        }
      } catch {
        return { ok: false, error: "The deliverable images could not be checked. Try again." };
      }
      const now = new Date();
      if (isPublishablePostTask(task) && task.clientId && task.clientId !== PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID) {
        // ONE EXIT RULE (Ben, 2026-10-14): a post job tagged to an
        // EXTERNAL client exits through the Clients delivery package
        // ONLY. Approval closes the job to Done like every other
        // external client job and sends it to Maria for its package —
        // it never enters Deliverables → To post, so there is exactly
        // one place to find it and one decision left (Ben's package
        // approval in Deliverables). Perfectly Paranoid is the standing
        // exception (2026-10-16): PP-tagged posts fall through to the
        // untagged To post branch below — house content, no package.
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.tasks).set(finalizeWithApproval
            ? { status: "done", approvedAt: now, deliverableReviewFinalizedAt: now, postImagePath: imagePaths[0] ?? task.postImagePath }
            : { status: "done", approvedAt: now, postImagePath: imagePaths[0] ?? task.postImagePath }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben approved “${task.title}”. The job is done — Maria is assembling its delivery package for the client, and it will wait in Deliverables (client-tagged post jobs never go to Deliverables → To post).` }),
        ]);
        await createDeliveryPackageForTask(ctx, task);
        ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true, chainedBrief: null };
      }
      if (task.pipeline === "research_case" && task.clientId && task.clientId !== PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID) {
        // RESEARCH + CLIENT EXIT (Ben-approved wiring fix, 2026-10-15): a
        // client-tagged research case exits through that client's delivery
        // package in Deliverables — the same exit rule client-tagged
        // Perfectly Paranoid jobs follow — instead of only landing in
        // Deliverables. Approval closes the job to Done and Maria assembles
        // its delivery package; untagged research cases are unchanged and
        // take the normal path below.
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.tasks).set(finalizeWithApproval
            ? { status: "done", approvedAt: now, deliverableReviewFinalizedAt: now, postImagePath: imagePaths[0] ?? task.postImagePath }
            : { status: "done", approvedAt: now, postImagePath: imagePaths[0] ?? task.postImagePath }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben approved the research case “${task.title}”. The case is done — Maria is assembling its delivery package for the client, and it will wait in Deliverables.` }),
        ]);
        await createDeliveryPackageForTask(ctx, task);
        ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true, chainedBrief: null };
      }
      if (isPublishablePostTask(task)) {
        // Ben's Deliverables ruling: approving a publishable package does
        // NOT close the job. It leaves Ready for You and waits in
        // Deliverables, under To post — full body, image, provenance, and
        // the Copy post + image control live there — until Ben marks it
        // posted. The deliverable review is deliberately left unfinalized
        // so the image stays visible on the To post card.
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "approval", publicationStatus: "awaiting_manual_publish", approvedAt: now, postImagePath: imagePaths[0] ?? task.postImagePath }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben approved “${task.title}”. The package moved to Deliverables, under To post — he copies the post and image from there and marks it posted once it is published.` }),
        ]);
        ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true, chainedBrief: null };
      }
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.tasks).set(finalizeWithApproval
          ? { status: "done", approvedAt: now, deliverableReviewFinalizedAt: now }
          : { status: "done", approvedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: finalizeWithApproval ? `Ben approved “${task.title}”. The job is done and its deliverable review was finalized in the same approval.` : `Ben approved “${task.title}”. The job is done.` }),
      ]);
      // Front Office: an approved client job goes to Maria for a delivery
      // package. Untagged jobs skip this entirely (no clientId, no package).
      await createDeliveryPackageForTask(ctx, task);
      ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true, chainedBrief: null };
    },
  }),

  mark_task_posted: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const rows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.id)).limit(1); const task = rows[0];
      if (!task) return { ok: false, error: "That package could not be found." };
      if (!isApprovedPostPackage(task) || task.status !== "approval") return { ok: false, error: "Only an approved post package waiting in Deliverables, under To post, can be marked posted." };
      const openBlockers = await db.select().from(schema.blockers).where(and(eq(schema.blockers.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.blockers.status, "open"))).limit(1);
      if (openBlockers[0]) return { ok: false, error: "Answer the crew's blocker before marking this package posted." };
      const now = new Date();
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "done", publicationStatus: "posted", postedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben marked “${task.title}” as posted — the job closed to Done, and the post moved from To post into the Deliverables post tiles with a Posted badge. It clears itself from the tiles 24 hours after posting; the job itself stays in Done history with its files and provenance.` }),
      ]);
      // If this post belongs to a client, its delivery package hears about
      // the posting too — the package's posting status is part of what the
      // client receives.
      await db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ postingStatus: "Posted", updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.taskId, task.id));
      ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  send_back_task: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), feedback: z.string().trim().min(1).max(5000), target: z.enum(["copy", "image", "research"]).default("copy"), assigneeId: crewMemberId.optional() }), response: sendBackResult, privileged: [privileged.supersedeDeliverables, privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof sendBackResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.id)).limit(1); const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task || task.status !== "approval") return { ok: false, error: "Only a job waiting on you can be denied for rework." };
      if (isApprovedPostPackage(task)) return { ok: false, error: "This package is already approved and waiting in Deliverables, under To post — rework happens from Ready for You, before approval. Mark it posted there once you have published it." };
      const openBlockers = await db.select().from(schema.blockers).where(and(eq(schema.blockers.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.blockers.status, "open"))).limit(1);
      if (openBlockers[0]) return { ok: false, error: "This job is waiting on an answer, not final approval." };
      const briefs = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(and(eq(schema.briefs.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.briefs.revision, task.revision))).orderBy(desc(schema.briefs.stepIndex), desc(schema.briefs.createdAt));
      const latest = briefs[0];
      const suggestedAssignee: z.infer<typeof crewMemberId> = args.target === "copy" ? "quill" : args.target === "image" ? "forge" : "scout";
      const parsed = crewMemberId.safeParse(args.assigneeId ?? suggestedAssignee ?? latest?.assignee ?? task.assignee); const assignee = parsed.success ? parsed.data : suggestedAssignee; const nextRevision = task.revision + 1; const now = new Date();
      const previousResult = briefs.filter((item) => item.result?.trim()).map((item) => `${memberByAssignee(item.assignee)} — ${item.title}:\n${item.result}`).join("\n\n").slice(-12000);
      const targetLabel = args.target === "copy" ? "copy" : args.target === "image" ? "image" : "research";
      // Aspect control: the approver's words below are special instructions
      // for this one part. Where they explicitly conflict with a standing
      // default that applies to that part, they win for this run only. The
      // concrete case is an image rework that says to generate directly:
      // stamp the override marker into the brief so mediaProcessingPolicy
      // appends a policy that agrees with it instead of the source-first
      // default. Locked rules are not standing defaults and never lift:
      // verified-facts limits, and for Perfectly Paranoid jobs the locked
      // voice, apply exactly as before.
      const generateDirectOverride = args.target === "image" && hasExplicitGenerateDirective(args.feedback);
      const aspectNotes = `\n\nSpecial-instructions rule for this rework: Ben's instructions above are special instructions for the ${targetLabel} only. Where they explicitly conflict with a standing default that applies to the ${targetLabel}, the instructions win for this run only; the standing default is unchanged for every other run.${generateDirectOverride ? `\n\n${REWORK_GENERATE_DIRECT_MARKER}: Ben's special instructions for the image explicitly say to generate the image directly (for example, "just generate an image based on the post"). Follow that instruction: generate the image directly from the finished post instead of searching for a real photograph first. This override applies to this run only and never becomes a standing setting. Provenance is still mandatory: record the generated image in image-provenance.md with "Kind: generated" and put the standard AI-generated IMAGE PROVENANCE line in your result, so the approval card labels it AI-generated.` : ""}`;
      const baseNotes = `Ben requested a ${targetLabel} rework of this job. "Rework" means replace ONLY the ${targetLabel}: every other part of the previous package stays exactly as it was. The finished job must still hold together as one package, so if the new ${targetLabel} has to agree with the kept parts (copy describing the image, a caption naming a file), make only the smallest changes needed for that agreement and say what you changed in your result.\n\nBen's feedback defines what is wrong and what done looks like:\n${args.feedback}${aspectNotes}${previousResult ? `\n\nPrevious package, for context only — do not resubmit it as your result. Your result is the replacement ${targetLabel}, and it must name the exact path of any new file you saved:\n${previousResult}` : ""}`;
      // A contract-bound job's rework brief carries its outcome contract
      // too, and the rework starts with a clean contract slate: when the
      // reworked deliverable finishes, the pre-surface check runs again
      // and sets the contract status fresh.
      const sendBackContract = contractForTask(task);
      const reworkNotes = sendBackContract ? `${baseNotes}\n\n${contractBriefBlock(sendBackContract)}` : baseNotes;
      const rows = await db.insert(schema.briefs).values({ id: `brief-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, taskId: task.id, title: `Rework: ${task.title}`.slice(0, 120), assignee, notes: reworkNotes, status: "new", result: null, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, pipeline: task.pipeline, pipelineStage: null, runTaskId: null, progressText: "Queued by Ben", lastHeartbeatAt: null, attempt: 0, stepIndex: 0, revision: nextRevision }).returning();
      const brief = rows[0]; if (!brief) return { ok: false, error: "The rework step could not be created." };
      let preserveRelativePaths: string[] = [];
      try {
        const scanned = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.scanDeliverables, { relativeHints: [taskDeliverableFolder(task.id)] });
        preserveRelativePaths = scanned.files.filter((file) => {
          if (args.target === "image") return file.kind !== "image";
          if (args.target === "copy") return file.kind === "image" || /research|source|evidence|notes/i.test(file.fileName);
          return file.kind === "image";
        }).map((file) => file.relativePath);
        const archived = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.supersedeDeliverables, { taskId: task.id, preserveRelativePaths });
        if (archived.archiveFolder) {
          await db.update(schema.briefs).set({ notes: `${reworkNotes}\n\nArchived superseded files for reference: ~/workspace/ai-office/${archived.archiveFolder}` }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id));
        }
      } catch {
        await db.delete(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id));
        return { ok: false, error: "The previous deliverables could not be replaced safely, so rework was not started. Try again." };
      }
      if (!task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt) await db.delete(schema.deliverableReviews).where(eq(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, task.id));
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "working", assignee, revision: nextRevision, approvedAt: null, contractStatus: null, contractViolation: null, contractBounces: 0, publicationStatus: task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" ? null : task.publicationStatus, postCopy: args.target === "image" ? task.postCopy : null, notes: `${task.notes}\n\nLatest ${targetLabel} rework feedback:\n${args.feedback}`.slice(-5000) }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben sent the ${targetLabel} on “${task.title}” to ${memberNames[assignee]} for rework. The same job card moved back to Working.` }),
      ]);
      await startNextForTask(ctx, task.id); return { ok: true, brief: briefDto({ ...brief, revision: nextRevision }), workerName: memberNames[assignee] };
    },
  }),

  report_blocker: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      briefId: z.string().min(1), taskId: z.string().min(1), memberId, question: z.string().trim().min(3).max(2000),
      blockerKind: blockerKind.optional(), gateKey: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120).optional(), verificationInstructions: z.string().trim().min(3).max(1000).optional(),
    }),
    response: z.object({ blocker: blockerShape }),
    async handler(ctx, args) {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, args.briefId)).limit(1); const brief = briefRows[0];
      if (!brief || brief.taskId !== args.taskId || brief.status !== "in_progress" || brief.assignee !== args.memberId) throw new Error("Only the visible active worker can report a blocker.");
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const standingOrderRun = Boolean(taskRows[0]?.standingOrderId);
      const classification = await classifyBlocker(ctx, args.question, args.blockerKind, args.gateKey, args.verificationInstructions);
      const now = new Date();
      const existingRows = await db.select().from(schema.blockers).where(and(eq(schema.blockers.taskId, args.taskId), eq(schema.blockers.gateKey, classification.gateKey))).orderBy(desc(schema.blockers.updatedAt), desc(schema.blockers.createdAt)).limit(1);
      const existing = existingRows[0];
      let blocker: typeof schema.blockers.$inferSelect | undefined;
      if (existing) {
        const updated = await db.update(schema.blockers).set({
          briefId: args.briefId, memberId: args.memberId, kind: classification.kind, retryCount: existing.retryCount + 1,
          status: standingOrderRun ? "resolved" : "open",
          answer: standingOrderRun ? "Standing-order issue recorded in history." : existing.answer,
          notifiedAt: standingOrderRun ? existing.notifiedAt ?? now : existing.notifiedAt,
          updatedAt: now, resolvedAt: standingOrderRun ? now : null,
          verificationInstructions: existing.verificationInstructions ?? classification.verificationInstructions,
          verificationStatus: standingOrderRun ? null : classification.kind === "browser_action" ? "failed" : null, lastVerificationAt: classification.kind === "browser_action" ? now : existing.lastVerificationAt,
        }).where(eq(schema.blockers.id, existing.id)).returning();
        blocker = updated[0];
      } else {
        const inserted = await db.insert(schema.blockers).values({
          id: `blocker-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, briefId: args.briefId, taskId: args.taskId, memberId: args.memberId, question: args.question,
          kind: classification.kind, gateKey: classification.gateKey, retryCount: 1, status: standingOrderRun ? "resolved" : "open",
          answer: standingOrderRun ? "Standing-order issue recorded in history." : null, notifiedAt: standingOrderRun ? now : null,
          createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, resolvedAt: standingOrderRun ? now : null, verificationInstructions: classification.verificationInstructions,
          verificationStatus: standingOrderRun ? null : classification.kind === "browser_action" ? "pending" : null, lastVerificationAt: null,
        }).returning();
        blocker = inserted[0];
      }
      if (!blocker) throw new Error("The blocker could not be saved.");
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.briefs).set({
          status: "failed",
          result: standingOrderRun ? `Standing-order issue: ${args.question}` : `Needs you: ${args.question}`,
          progressText: standingOrderRun ? "Stopped — recorded in history" : classification.kind === "browser_action" ? "Waiting for browser action" : "Waiting for You",
          lastHeartbeatAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id)),
        db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: standingOrderRun ? "done" : "approval", assignee: args.memberId }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({
          t: now,
          text: standingOrderRun
            ? `${memberNames[args.memberId]} could not finish the standing-order run. The issue was recorded in history without requesting approval.`
            : existing
              ? `${memberNames[args.memberId]} hit the same ${classification.gateKey} gate again (attempt ${blocker.retryCount}). The existing request was refreshed.`
              : `${memberNames[args.memberId]} needs you: ${args.question}`,
        }),
      ]); ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { blocker: blockerDto(blocker) };
    },
  }),

  resolve_blocker: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), answer: z.string().trim().min(1).max(5000) }), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const rows = await db.select().from(schema.blockers).where(eq(schema.blockers.id, args.id)).limit(1); const blocker = rows[0];
      if (!blocker || blocker.status !== "open") return { ok: false, error: "This request is no longer waiting." };
      if (blocker.kind === "browser_action") return { ok: false, error: "This gate needs a browser action. Complete it there, then use Check gate." };
      const assessment = assessDecisionAnswer(args.answer);
      if (assessment.isQuestion || !assessment.addressed) return { ok: false, error: assessment.reason };
      const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, blocker.briefId)).limit(1); const brief = briefRows[0]; if (!brief) return { ok: false, error: "The blocked step could not be found." };
      const now = new Date(); const notes = `${brief.notes}\n\nBen's answer:\n${args.answer}`.slice(-5000);
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.blockers).set({ status: "resolved", answer: args.answer, resolvedAt: now, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.blockers.id, blocker.id)),
        db.update(schema.briefs).set({ status: "new", notes, result: null, runTaskId: null, progressText: "Queued with Ben's decision", lastHeartbeatAt: null, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, brief.id)),
        db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "working", assignee: brief.assignee }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, blocker.taskId)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben answered ${memberByAssignee(blocker.memberId)}. The same step is resuming.` }),
      ]);
      // The decision is committed at this point. A worker-spawn failure
      // must never turn it into a submission error Ben has to retry: the
      // brief stays queued as "new" and the dispatcher picks it up on its
      // next cycle.
      try { await startNextForTask(ctx, blocker.taskId); } catch { /* Decision saved; brief remains queued for the dispatcher. */ }
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  check_inbox_now: defineAction({
    request: z.object({}),
    response: z.discriminatedUnion("status", [z.object({ status: z.literal("clear") }), z.object({ status: z.literal("started"), eligible: z.number().int().positive(), runs: z.array(z.object({ taskId: z.string(), briefId: z.string() })).min(1) }), z.object({ status: z.literal("error"), message: z.string() })]),
    privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx) {
      const eligible = await eligibleBriefs(ctx); if (!eligible.length) return { status: "clear" as const };
      const runs: Array<{ taskId: string; briefId: string }> = [];
      for (const item of eligible) { const claimed = await claimBrief(ctx, item.id); if (!claimed) continue; const spawned = await spawnWorker(ctx, claimed); if (spawned.ok && spawned.taskId) runs.push({ taskId: spawned.taskId, briefId: claimed.id }); }
      return runs.length ? { status: "started" as const, eligible: runs.length, runs } : { status: "error" as const, message: "The visible workers could not be started. The steps remain queued." };
    },
  }),

  poll_dispatch: defineAction({
    request: z.object({}),
    response: z.discriminatedUnion("status", [z.object({ status: z.literal("clear"), standingOrdersEvaluated: z.number().int().nonnegative() }), z.object({ status: z.literal("spawned"), eligibleBriefs: z.number().int().nonnegative(), newBlockers: z.number().int().nonnegative(), dispatchTaskId: z.string() }), z.object({ status: z.literal("error"), message: z.string() })]),
    privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx) {
      // Story expiry lives here now (Phase 2): the dispatcher runs
      // periodically, alongside the stall watchdog, so Sven's stories
      // still expire off the shelves the same way — just not as a write
      // inside get_state on every screen load.
      await expireSvenStories(ctx);
      await rehomeStandingOrderApprovals(ctx);
      await routeStrandedClientJobs(ctx);
      await requeueStalledBriefs(ctx);
      const orders = await evaluateStandingOrdersNow(ctx); const eligible = await eligibleBriefs(ctx); let started = 0; let firstTaskId = "";
      for (const item of eligible) { const claimed = await claimBrief(ctx, item.id); if (!claimed) continue; const spawned = await spawnWorker(ctx, claimed); if (spawned.ok && spawned.taskId) { started += 1; if (!firstTaskId) firstTaskId = spawned.taskId; } }
      const openBlockers = await ctx.db<typeof schema>().select().from(schema.blockers).where(eq(schema.blockers.status, "open"));

      return { status: "spawned" as const, eligibleBriefs: started, newBlockers: openBlockers.filter((item) => !item.notifiedAt).length, dispatchTaskId: firstTaskId };
    },
  }),
