  delete_task: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.deleteJobFolder],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task) return { ok: false, error: "Job not found." };
      // A wrong result is DELETED, not archived (Ben, 2026-10-18): Delete
      // removes the job, its steps, every record that points at them, and
      // its deliverable files — nothing is left in Deliverables or Done.
      // The old handler failed with SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY on jobs
      // with briefs/deliverables attached: it deleted only SOME of the
      // referencing rows, in one db.batch, and never touched the files at
      // all (the only file delete in the office unlinked images only).
      // This handler (1) collects every task row the deletion owns — the
      // job, its escalation lab sub-case, its child tasks, and the
      // delivery-package job tasks assembled from it — (2) removes every
      // owned job folder first, aborting with nothing deleted if the
      // files cannot go, and (3) deletes the rows ONE statement at a
      // time, referencing rows before the rows they reference, covering
      // every table that points at a task or a brief. It is the ordinary
      // delete path — Ben's Delete buttons and any crew deletion alike
      // run this same action.
      const allTaskRows = await db.select({ id: schema.tasks.id, parentTaskId: schema.tasks.parentTaskId, escalationSubtaskId: schema.tasks.escalationSubtaskId }).from(schema.tasks);
      const allPackageRows = await db.select({ taskId: schema.deliveryPackages.taskId, packageTaskId: schema.deliveryPackages.packageTaskId }).from(schema.deliveryPackages);
      const owned = new Set<string>([task.id]);
      let grew = true;
      while (grew) {
        grew = false;
        for (const row of allTaskRows) {
          if (owned.has(row.id)) {
            if (row.escalationSubtaskId && !owned.has(row.escalationSubtaskId)) { owned.add(row.escalationSubtaskId); grew = true; }
          } else if (row.parentTaskId && owned.has(row.parentTaskId)) { owned.add(row.id); grew = true; }
        }
        for (const pkg of allPackageRows) {
          if (owned.has(pkg.taskId) && pkg.packageTaskId && !owned.has(pkg.packageTaskId)) { owned.add(pkg.packageTaskId); grew = true; }
        }
      }
      const ownedIds = Array.from(owned);
      const briefRows = await db.select({ id: schema.briefs.id }).from(schema.briefs).where(inArray(schema.briefs.taskId, ownedIds));
      const briefIds = briefRows.map((item) => item.id);
      // Files first: every owned job's folder (all deliverable kinds, the
      // .superseded archive, and subfolders) is removed before any row
      // goes, so a file failure aborts the whole delete untouched.
      try {
        for (const ownedId of ownedIds) {
          await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.deleteJobFolder, { taskId: ownedId });
        }
      } catch {
        return { ok: false, error: "This job's files could not be deleted, so nothing was removed. Try again." };
      }
      // Rows, in dependency order, one statement at a time: everything
      // that references a task or a brief is removed (or its pointer
      // cleared, where the referencing row is a standing record of its
      // own — a queued X post, a briefing chat, a parent job's escalation
      // pointer) before the briefs and tasks themselves are deleted.
      await db.delete(schema.blockers).where(inArray(schema.blockers.taskId, ownedIds));
      if (briefIds.length) await db.delete(schema.blockers).where(inArray(schema.blockers.briefId, briefIds));
      await db.delete(schema.handoffEvents).where(inArray(schema.handoffEvents.sourceTaskId, ownedIds));
      if (briefIds.length) await db.delete(schema.handoffEvents).where(inArray(schema.handoffEvents.targetBriefId, briefIds));
      await db.delete(schema.visionaryIdeas).where(inArray(schema.visionaryIdeas.taskId, ownedIds));
      if (briefIds.length) await db.delete(schema.visionaryIdeas).where(inArray(schema.visionaryIdeas.briefId, briefIds));
      await db.update(schema.visionaryIdeas).set({ launchedTaskId: null }).where(inArray(schema.visionaryIdeas.launchedTaskId, ownedIds));
      await db.update(schema.xPosts).set({ taskId: null }).where(inArray(schema.xPosts.taskId, ownedIds));
      await db.update(schema.remmyBriefingSessions).set({ taskId: null }).where(inArray(schema.remmyBriefingSessions.taskId, ownedIds));
      await db.delete(schema.deliverableReviews).where(inArray(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, ownedIds));
      await db.delete(schema.deliveryPackages).where(inArray(schema.deliveryPackages.taskId, ownedIds));
      await db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ packageTaskId: null }).where(inArray(schema.deliveryPackages.packageTaskId, ownedIds));
      for (const row of allTaskRows) {
        if (!owned.has(row.id) && row.escalationSubtaskId && owned.has(row.escalationSubtaskId)) {
          await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ escalationSubtaskId: null, escalationStatus: null }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, row.id));
        }
      }
      await db.delete(schema.briefs).where(inArray(schema.briefs.taskId, ownedIds));
      await db.delete(schema.tasks).where(inArray(schema.tasks.id, ownedIds));
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Removed job “${task.title}” — deleted with its steps, records, and files.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  review_deliverable: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ taskId: z.string().min(1), relativePath: z.string().min(1).max(500), decision: deliverableDecision }), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.readDeliverable],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task || task.status !== "approval") return { ok: false, error: "Only a finished job waiting on you can be reviewed." };
      if (task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt) return { ok: false, error: "Those image choices are already saved. Approve the finished listing package or send it back for rework." };
      const openBlockers = await db.select().from(schema.blockers).where(and(eq(schema.blockers.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.blockers.status, "open"))).limit(1);
      if (openBlockers[0]) return { ok: false, error: "Answer the crew's blocker before reviewing deliverables." };
      let imagePaths: string[];
      try { imagePaths = await taskImagePaths(ctx, task); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "The deliverable images could not be checked. Try again." }; }
      if (!imagePaths.includes(args.relativePath)) return { ok: false, error: "That image is not part of this job's review package." };
      // A piece the job's own documents excluded from the pack is not
      // part of the review at all — it takes no keep/delete decision.
      const excludedPaths = await excludedPathsForTask(ctx, task);
      if (excludedPaths.has(args.relativePath)) return { ok: false, error: "That piece was excluded from this pack — it isn't part of the review and takes no keep/delete choice." };
      const existing = await db.select().from(schema.deliverableReviews).where(and(eq(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.deliverableReviews.relativePath, args.relativePath))).limit(1);
      const now = new Date();
      if (existing[0]) {
        await db.update(schema.deliverableReviews).set({ decision: args.decision, updatedAt: now }).where(and(eq(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.deliverableReviews.relativePath, args.relativePath)));
      } else {
        await db.insert(schema.deliverableReviews).values({ taskId: task.id, relativePath: args.relativePath, decision: args.decision, updatedAt: now });
      }
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  finalize_deliverable_review: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ taskId: z.string().min(1), keepPaths: z.array(z.string().min(1).max(500)).max(40) }), response: finalizeDeliverableReviewResult, privileged: [privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.readDeliverable, privileged.deleteDeliverableFiles, privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof finalizeDeliverableReviewResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task || task.status !== "approval") return { ok: false, error: "Only a finished job waiting on you can be reviewed." };
      if (task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt) return { ok: false, error: "Those image choices are already saved. Approve the finished listing package or send it back for rework." };
      const openBlockers = await db.select().from(schema.blockers).where(and(eq(schema.blockers.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.blockers.status, "open"))).limit(1);
      if (openBlockers[0]) return { ok: false, error: "Answer the crew's blocker before finishing this review." };
      if (task.clientId && task.contractStatus === "bounced" && task.contractViolation) {
        return { ok: false, error: `This client deliverable failed its outcome-contract check — ${task.contractViolation}. It cannot be finished into a delivery package until a rework fixes the violation.` };
      }
      let imagePaths: string[];
      try { imagePaths = await taskImagePaths(ctx, task); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "The deliverable images could not be checked. Try again." }; }
      // Excluded pieces are outside the batch entirely: they are not
      // counted, not decided on, and never deleted by an Accept.
      const excludedPaths = await excludedPathsForTask(ctx, task);
      if (excludedPaths.size > 0) imagePaths = imagePaths.filter((path) => !excludedPaths.has(path));
      if (imagePaths.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: "This job does not have a multi-image review package." };
      // Batch Accept (Ben's design): the one action records a decision
      // for EVERY image — selected ones kept, non-selected ones deleted
      // (file removed, review record kept as "rejected"). At least one
      // image must be selected; with none selected the whole item goes
      // back via Deny · rework or Delete instead.
      if (!args.keepPaths.length) return { ok: false, error: "Select at least one image to keep, or use Deny · rework or Delete for the whole job instead." };
      const batch = await applyBatchImageDecisions(ctx, task.id, imagePaths, args.keepPaths);
      if (!batch.ok) return { ok: false, error: batch.error };
      const decisions = new Map<string, string>(imagePaths.map((path) => [path, batch.kept.includes(path) ? "approved" : "rejected"]));
      const approved = batch.kept.length;
      const rejected = batch.discarded.length;
      const now = new Date();
      if (isMerchTask(task)) {
        const allBriefs = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(and(eq(schema.briefs.taskId, task.id), eq(schema.briefs.revision, task.revision))).orderBy(desc(schema.briefs.stepIndex), desc(schema.briefs.createdAt));
        const nextIndex = (allBriefs[0]?.stepIndex ?? -1) + 1;
        const approvedPaths = imagePaths.filter((path) => decisions.get(path) === "approved");
        const briefRows = await db.insert(schema.briefs).values({
          id: `brief-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, taskId: task.id, title: "Prepare Redbubble listings for approved designs", assignee: "quill",
          notes: `Prepare the finished Redbubble listing copy for ONLY these Ben-approved transparent PNGs:\n${approvedPaths.map((path) => `- ~/workspace/ai-office/${path}`).join("\n")}\n\nDEFINITION OF DONE — all four are true:\n- There is exactly one listing per approved design above, matched to that design's exact image — no listing for any other file.\n- Each listing has all three parts: a searchable title built from the words a buyer would type for this design's actual subject, a natural description of 2–4 sentences, and a focused tag set of relevant terms only.\n- No rejected, unreviewed, preview, original, or superseded file appears anywhere in the package.\n- Nothing is uploaded or published — this step produces copy only.\n\nOUTPUT FORMAT: save one publication-ready Markdown listing package in this job's folder (~/workspace/ai-office/jobs/${task.id}/), with one clearly headed section per design, and name the package's exact path in your result.`,
          status: "new", result: null, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, pipeline: "merch_upload", pipelineStage: null, runTaskId: null, progressText: "Queued from image approval", lastHeartbeatAt: null, attempt: 0, stepIndex: nextIndex, revision: task.revision,
        }).returning();
        const next = briefRows[0];
        if (!next) return { ok: false, error: "Your image choices are still saved, but the listing step could not be created. Try finishing the review again." };
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "working", assignee: "quill", pipeline: "merch_upload", deliverableReviewFinalizedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben finished the image review for “${task.title}”: ${approved} kept, ${rejected} deleted. Johnny started the Redbubble listing package.` }),
        ]);
        await startNextForTask(ctx, task.id);
        ctx.invalidateQueries();
        return { ok: true, approved, rejected, continued: true };
      }
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "done", approvedAt: now, deliverableReviewFinalizedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben finished the item review for “${task.title}”: ${approved} kept, ${rejected} deleted.` }),
      ]);
      await createDeliveryPackageForTask(ctx, task);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, approved, rejected, continued: false };
    },
  }),

  get_task_deliverables: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ taskId: z.string().min(1) }), response: taskDeliverablesResponse, privileged: [privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.readDeliverable],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof taskDeliverablesResponse>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const [rows, reviewRows, taskRows] = await Promise.all([
        db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.taskId, args.taskId)).orderBy(desc(schema.briefs.updatedAt)),
        db.select().from(schema.deliverableReviews).where(eq(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, args.taskId)),
        db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1),
      ]);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task) return { items: [], briefs: [], postCopy: null, warning: "This job no longer exists.", isSvenOriginated: false, packageSummary: null, answer: null, hiddenFileCount: 0, grading: emptyClaimGradingState(args.taskId) };
      // Claim completeness gate (read-only here): the Breakdown serves the
      // manifest, the per-ID dispositions, and a fresh mechanical
      // reconciliation of the stored records. Nothing is written on read.
      const gateRows = await loadClaimGate(ctx, task.id);
      const lab = await loadLabExtras(ctx, task.id);
      const grading = claimGradingState(task.id, gateRows.manifest, gateRows.grades, computeReconciliation(gateRows.manifest, gateRows.grades), lab);
      // Plain-language presentation: a job launched from one of Sven's
      // ideas gets human titles and top summaries across its whole review
      // package, plus the idea's own plain summary as the package lead.
      const svenIdeaRows = await db.select().from(schema.visionaryIdeas).where(eq(schema.visionaryIdeas.launchedTaskId, task.id)).limit(1);
      const svenIdea = svenIdeaRows[0];
      const isSvenOriginated = Boolean(svenIdea);
      const reviews = new Map(reviewRows.map((row) => [row.relativePath, row.decision]));
      const revisionRows = rows.filter((item) => item.revision === task.revision);
      // Piece summary precedence (Ben, 2026-10-19): the plain summary
      // stored on the brief record (authored by its step, captured at
      // completion) → the piece's own authored summary lead, backfilled
      // onto the record on first read for steps that authored one before
      // capture existed → the legacy extraction, ONLY for pre-change
      // pieces that authored neither. A contents row's description is
      // this value: what the piece found or did, in plain words. Who did
      // it, which stage it was, and how it was checked never lead it —
      // that detail lives in the card's breakdown section.
      const briefSummaries = new Map<string, { stored: string | null; served: string | null }>();
      for (const item of revisionRows) {
        if (!((item.status === "done" || item.status === "failed") && item.result)) continue;
        let stored = item.summary ?? null;
        if (!stored && item.status === "done") {
          const authoredPiece = extractPiecePlainSummary(item.result);
          if (authoredPiece) {
            stored = authoredPiece;
            try { await db.update(schema.briefs).set({ summary: authoredPiece }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, item.id)); } catch { /* The value is still served for this read. */ }
          }
        }
        const served = stored ?? extractPiecePlainSummary(item.result) ?? legacyPieceSummary(item.result, item.assignee);
        briefSummaries.set(item.id, { stored, served });
      }
      const briefs = revisionRows.filter((item) => (item.status === "done" || item.status === "failed") && item.result).map((item) => ({ id: item.id, title: item.title, assignee: item.assignee, status: item.status, result: item.result ?? "", updatedAt: item.updatedAt.toISOString(), humanTitle: humanTitleForBrief(item.assignee, item.status), plainSummary: briefSummaries.get(item.id)?.served ?? null, summary: briefSummaries.get(item.id)?.stored ?? null }));
      // File ↔ brief linkage: a file item's description is served from
      // the summary of the brief that PRODUCED the file, in the same
      // precedence as the briefs above. Ownership is decided carefully,
      // because a later step's result may merely MENTION an earlier
      // step's file (a synthesis naming its inputs) — a mention must
      // never outrank the producer. Strongest first: (1) the brief
      // whose result says it saved the file ("saved as <name>"); (2) a
      // bare path hint in a result, the existing deliverable-hints
      // linkage. Text files get a stronger check at read time below:
      // the brief whose result matches the file's own opening owns it.
      const briefSummaryByFileName = new Map<string, string | null>();
      const briefSummaryBySavedAs = new Map<string, string | null>();
      for (const item of revisionRows) {
        if (!item.result) continue;
        const served = briefSummaries.get(item.id)?.served ?? legacyPieceSummary(item.result, item.assignee);
        for (const match of item.result.matchAll(/saved as\s+([-\w.]+\.(?:md|txt|png|jpe?g|webp))\b/gi)) {
          const base = (match[1] ?? "").toLowerCase();
          if (base && !briefSummaryBySavedAs.has(base)) briefSummaryBySavedAs.set(base, served);
        }
        for (const hint of deliverableHints([item.result])) {
          const base = hint.split("/").at(-1)?.toLowerCase();
          if (base && !briefSummaryByFileName.has(base)) briefSummaryByFileName.set(base, served);
        }
      }
      const normalizeForMatch = (value: string) => value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
      const briefSummaryByContentMatch = (fileText: string): string | null => {
        const fileNorm = normalizeForMatch(fileText);
        if (fileNorm.length < 40) return null;
        for (const brief of briefs) {
          const resultNorm = normalizeForMatch(brief.result);
          if (resultNorm.length < 40) continue;
          if (resultNorm.startsWith(fileNorm.slice(0, 160)) || fileNorm.startsWith(resultNorm.slice(0, 160))) {
            return briefSummaries.get(brief.id)?.served ?? null;
          }
        }
        return null;
      };
      // Package summary precedence (Ben, 2026-10-19): a Sven idea's own
      // plain summary → the summary stored on the task record (authored
      // by the job's finishing step and captured at completion) → the
      // legacy extraction, ONLY for jobs finished before stored summaries
      // existed. A pre-change job whose finishing brief DID author its
      // summary gets it backfilled onto the task record the first time
      // its package is read, so from then on it is served from storage
      // like every newer job.
      let storedSummary = task.summary ?? null;
      if (!svenIdea && !storedSummary) {
        const authored = briefs.map((brief) => extractAuthoredSummary(brief.result)).find((summary): summary is string => Boolean(summary)) ?? null;
        if (authored) {
          storedSummary = authored;
          try { await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ summary: authored }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, task.id)); } catch { /* The value is still served for this read. */ }
        }
      }
      const basePackageSummary = svenIdea ? plainSummaryForIdea(svenIdea) : storedSummary;
      const resultHints = deliverableHints(briefs.map((item) => item.result));
      const hints = [`jobs/${args.taskId}`, ...resultHints];
      try {
        const scanned = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.scanDeliverables, { relativeHints: hints }); const items: Array<z.infer<typeof deliverableItemShape>> = []; let unreadable = 0;
        const folder = taskDeliverableFolder(task.id);
        const taskFiles = scanned.files.filter((file) => file.relativePath.startsWith(`${folder}/`));
        const liveFiles = taskFiles.filter((file) => !file.relativePath.includes("/.superseded/"));
        const archivedFiles = taskFiles
          .filter((file) => file.relativePath.includes("/.superseded/"))
          .sort((left, right) => new Date(right.modifiedAt).getTime() - new Date(left.modifiedAt).getTime());
        const currentFiles = [...liveFiles];
        const addLatestArchived = (matches: (file: (typeof archivedFiles)[number]) => boolean) => {
          const fallback = archivedFiles.find(matches);
          if (fallback) currentFiles.push(fallback);
        };
        if (!liveFiles.some((file) => file.kind === "image")) addLatestArchived((file) => file.kind === "image");
        const postFile = /(?:facebook|social)[-_ ]*post|post[-_ ]*copy|caption/i;
        if (!liveFiles.some((file) => file.kind !== "image" && postFile.test(file.fileName))) {
          addLatestArchived((file) => file.kind !== "image" && postFile.test(file.fileName));
        }
        const researchFile = /research|source|notes/i;
        if (!liveFiles.some((file) => file.kind !== "image" && researchFile.test(file.fileName))) {
          addLatestArchived((file) => file.kind !== "image" && researchFile.test(file.fileName));
        }
        // Image provenance is metadata, not a display document: the
        // image-provenance.md file is parsed and attached to its image, and
        // never listed as a document in the review package.
        const isProvenanceFile = (file: (typeof currentFiles)[number]) => file.kind !== "image" && /^image-provenance\.(?:md|txt)$/i.test(file.fileName);
        if (!liveFiles.some(isProvenanceFile)) addLatestArchived(isProvenanceFile);
        const provenanceByFile = new Map<string, ImageProvenance>();
        for (const brief of briefs) {
          for (const [name, entry] of parseImageProvenance(brief.result)) if (!provenanceByFile.has(name)) provenanceByFile.set(name, entry);
        }
        for (const file of currentFiles.filter(isProvenanceFile)) {
          try {
            const content = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.readDeliverable, { relativePath: file.relativePath });
            if (content.text) for (const [name, entry] of parseImageProvenance(content.text)) provenanceByFile.set(name, entry);
          } catch { /* The result-line provenance remains as the fallback record. */ }
        }
        const readyImages = readyImageFiles(task, currentFiles);
        // Library membership follows the approval, not the finalized-review
        // flag. For a final package (a Done job, or an approved post package
        // waiting under To post in Deliverables) per-image review decisions
        // are the authority when any exist: only approved images show, even
        // when deliverableReviewFinalizedAt is missing on older/inconsistent
        // records. When no image carries a decision at all — a single-image
        // post package approved as a whole, a text-and-image brief, older
        // approved packages from before per-file review — every ready image
        // is a final output and shows, even if a stray finalized timestamp
        // is present with no decisions behind it. Jobs still awaiting a
        // decision keep the review behavior: all images stay visible for
        // review until the review is finalized, then only approved ones.
        const isFinalPackage = task.status === "done" || isApprovedPostPackage(task);
        const anyImageDecided = readyImages.some((file) => reviews.has(file.relativePath));
        const visibleImagePaths = new Set(readyImages.filter((file) => {
          if (isFinalPackage) return anyImageDecided ? reviews.get(file.relativePath) === "approved" : true;
          return !task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt || reviews.get(file.relativePath) === "approved";
        }).map((file) => file.relativePath));
        const soleProvenance = provenanceByFile.size === 1 ? Array.from(provenanceByFile.values())[0] ?? null : null;
        for (const file of currentFiles) {
          if (isProvenanceFile(file)) continue;
          if (file.kind === "image" && !visibleImagePaths.has(file.relativePath)) continue;
          try {
            const content = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.readDeliverable, { relativePath: file.relativePath });
            // The piece's description, in precedence order: the stored
            // summary of the brief that produced this file (ownership by
            // content match or by its own "saved as" line, then by path
            // hint) → the document's own authored summary lead → the
            // legacy extraction, only for pre-change material that has
            // neither.
            const linkedSummary = briefSummaryBySavedAs.get(file.fileName.toLowerCase()) ?? briefSummaryByFileName.get(file.fileName.toLowerCase()) ?? null;
            if (content.kind === "image" && content.dataBase64) {
              const key = deliverableBlobKey(content.relativePath);
              await ctx.blobs.put(key, decodeBase64(content.dataBase64), { contentType: content.contentType });
              const provenance = provenanceByFile.get(file.fileName.toLowerCase()) ?? (visibleImagePaths.size === 1 ? soleProvenance : null);
              items.push({ relativePath: file.relativePath, fileName: file.fileName, kind: file.kind, contentType: file.contentType, size: file.size, modifiedAt: file.modifiedAt, imageUrl: await ctx.blobs.getUrl(key, { expiresInSeconds: 3600 }), fileUrl: null, text: null, reviewStatus: reviews.get(file.relativePath) ?? null, provenance, humanTitle: humanTitleForDeliverable(file.fileName, file.kind, task.title), plainSummary: linkedSummary, excluded: false });
            } else if ((content.kind === "document" || content.kind === "video") && content.dataBase64) {
              // Documents and media are files to open or download, never
              // inline content: the bytes are copied into owned blob
              // storage and the card links to that copy. Raw HTML in
              // particular is never returned as renderable text.
              const key = deliverableBlobKey(content.relativePath);
              await ctx.blobs.put(key, decodeBase64(content.dataBase64), { contentType: content.contentType });
              items.push({ relativePath: file.relativePath, fileName: file.fileName, kind: file.kind, contentType: file.contentType, size: file.size, modifiedAt: file.modifiedAt, imageUrl: null, fileUrl: await ctx.blobs.getUrl(key, { expiresInSeconds: 3600 }), text: null, reviewStatus: null, provenance: null, humanTitle: humanTitleForDeliverable(file.fileName, file.kind, task.title), plainSummary: linkedSummary, excluded: false });
            } else if (content.text !== null) {
              items.push({ relativePath: file.relativePath, fileName: file.fileName, kind: file.kind, contentType: file.contentType, size: file.size, modifiedAt: file.modifiedAt, imageUrl: null, fileUrl: null, text: content.text, reviewStatus: null, provenance: null, humanTitle: humanTitleForDeliverable(file.fileName, file.kind, task.title), plainSummary: briefSummaryByContentMatch(content.text) ?? linkedSummary ?? extractPiecePlainSummary(content.text) ?? legacyPieceSummary(content.text, file.fileName), excluded: false });
            }
          } catch { unreadable += 1; }
        }
        // Exclusion flags: read the declarations from the job's own
        // texts (brief results + readable documents) and mark every
        // item they name. The client renders excluded pieces only as a
        // held-out note — never in the contents, never as a choice.
        const exclusionStems = exclusionStemsFromTexts([
          ...briefs.map((brief) => brief.result),
          ...items.filter((item) => item.text).map((item) => item.text as string),
        ]);
        if (exclusionStems.size > 0) {
          for (const item of items) if (isExcludedFileName(item.fileName, exclusionStems)) item.excluded = true;
        }
        // Legacy fallback, last resort only: jobs finished before stored
        // summaries existed AND whose finishing brief authored none get
        // the old extraction over their own briefs and documents. New
        // jobs never reach this — their summary is stored at completion.
        let packageSummary = basePackageSummary;
        if (!packageSummary) {
          packageSummary = briefs.map((brief) => brief.plainSummary).find((summary): summary is string => Boolean(summary))
            ?? items.filter((item) => item.text && !item.excluded).map((item) => item.plainSummary).find((summary): summary is string => Boolean(summary))
            ?? null;
        }
        const documentPostCopy = items
          .filter((item) => item.text)
          .sort((left, right) => {
            const score = (name: string) => /(?:facebook|social)[-_ ]*post|post[-_ ]*copy|caption/i.test(name) ? 1 : 0;
            return score(right.fileName) - score(left.fileName) || new Date(right.modifiedAt).getTime() - new Date(left.modifiedAt).getTime();
          })
          .map((item) => extractPublicationReadyPost(item.text ?? ""))
          .find((copy): copy is string => Boolean(copy));
        const resultPostCopy = rows
          .filter((item) => item.status === "done" && item.assignee === "quill" && item.result)
          .map((item) => extractPublicationReadyPost(item.result ?? ""))
          .find((copy): copy is string => Boolean(copy));
        const postCopy = task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" ? task.postCopy ?? documentPostCopy ?? resultPostCopy ?? null : null;
        const unavailable = scanned.missingHints.filter((hint) => hint !== `jobs/${args.taskId}`).length + unreadable;
        // Answer (Ben's ruling): the face shows TITLE + THE ANSWER. The
        // answer is sourced from the PRIMARY deliverable (brief/report/
        // findings first, by filename) using the verdict extraction —
        // its "## Verdict" section, else the "Short answer / verdict"
        // paragraph inside its "## SUMMARY" section, label stripped.
        // A verifier claim tally must NEVER be selected when a verdict
        // paragraph exists in the primary deliverable.
        let answer: string | null = null;
        const docItems = items.filter((item) => item.text && !item.excluded).slice().sort((a, b) => primaryDeliverableScore(a.fileName) - primaryDeliverableScore(b.fileName));
        for (const item of docItems) {
          if (!item.text) continue;
          const candidate = extractAnswerCandidate(item.text);
          if (isUsableAnswerCandidate(candidate)) { answer = candidate; break; }
        }
        if (!answer) {
          for (const brief of briefs) {
            const candidate = extractAnswerCandidate(brief.result);
            if (isUsableAnswerCandidate(candidate)) { answer = candidate; break; }
          }
        }
        if (!answer) {
          // Plain-summary fallback: only a genuine primary deliverable
          // (brief / report / findings, by filename) may supply the
          // answer this way — any other document's opening extraction
          // (a letter's metadata block, a checklist's first lines) is
          // raw body text, not a verdict, and the package summary wins
          // over it.
          const primary = docItems[0];
          if (primary && primaryDeliverableScore(primary.fileName) < 3 && isUsableAnswerCandidate(primary.plainSummary)) answer = primary.plainSummary;
        }
        if (!answer) answer = packageSummary ?? null;
        return { items, briefs, postCopy, warning: unavailable ? `${unavailable} referenced ${unavailable === 1 ? "file is" : "files are"} unavailable for preview.` : null, isSvenOriginated, packageSummary, answer, hiddenFileCount: scanned.hiddenCount, grading };
      } catch {
        let answer: string | null = null;
        for (const brief of briefs) {
          const candidate = extractAnswerCandidate(brief.result);
          if (isUsableAnswerCandidate(candidate)) { answer = candidate; break; }
        }
        if (!answer) answer = basePackageSummary ?? null;
        return { items: [], briefs, postCopy: task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" ? task.postCopy : null, warning: "The referenced files could not be loaded right now.", isSvenOriginated, packageSummary: basePackageSummary, answer, hiddenFileCount: 0, grading };
      }
    },
  }),

  // Website preview (Ben's about:blank fix): a finished web page used to be
  // offered ONLY as an "Open" link to its blob copy in a new tab. Inside
  // the Muse shell that tab never receives the page — it sits at
  // about:blank — because blob responses are served sandboxed for download,
  // not for top-level navigation. So the page itself travels through this
  // action instead: the privileged read already returns the SELF-CONTAINED
  // page (relative images/styles/scripts inlined at serve time), and the
  // client renders it in place in a sandboxed srcDoc frame — no new tab,
  // no popup, no navigation to a blob URL. Only an HTML file that belongs
  // to this job's own deliverable folder can be previewed this way.
  get_website_preview: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ taskId: z.string().min(1), relativePath: z.string().min(1).max(500) }), response: websitePreviewResponse, privileged: [privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.readDeliverable],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof websitePreviewResponse>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, args.taskId)).limit(1);
      const task = taskRows[0];
      if (!task) return { ok: false, error: "That job no longer exists." };
      if (!/\.html?$/i.test(args.relativePath)) return { ok: false, error: "Only a web page can be previewed this way." };
      const folder = taskDeliverableFolder(task.id);
      if (!args.relativePath.startsWith(`${folder}/`) || args.relativePath.includes("/.superseded/")) {
        return { ok: false, error: "That page is not part of this job's finished work." };
      }
      try {
        const scanned = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.scanDeliverables, { relativeHints: [folder] });
        const file = scanned.files.find((item) => item.relativePath === args.relativePath && item.kind === "document");
        if (!file) return { ok: false, error: "That page could not be found in this job's finished work." };
        const content = await ctx.executePrivileged(privileged.readDeliverable, { relativePath: file.relativePath });
        if (!content.dataBase64) return { ok: false, error: "That page could not be loaded right now." };
        const html = new TextDecoder().decode(decodeBase64(content.dataBase64));
        if (html.length > 8_000_000) return { ok: false, error: "That page is too large to preview here — download it from its card instead." };
        return { ok: true, html };
      } catch { return { ok: false, error: "That page could not be loaded right now." }; }
    },
  }),

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Front Office — client registry, delivery packages, reporting, showcase.
  // The registry starts EMPTY: clients exist only when Ben creates them
  // here. Nothing in this section seeds, invents, or backfills a client.
  create_client: defineAction({
    request: clientInput, response: clientResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof clientResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const now = new Date();
      const nextReportAt = args.reportCadence === "off" ? null : nextClientReportAt(args.reportCadence, now);
      const rows = await db.insert(schema.clients).values({
        id: `client-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, businessName: args.businessName, approverName: args.approverName, platforms: args.platforms,
        voiceNotes: args.voiceNotes, photoLibraryStatus: args.photoLibraryStatus, photoLibraryLocation: args.photoLibraryStatus === "provided" ? args.photoLibraryLocation : "",
        showcasePermission: args.showcasePermission, isTest: args.isTest, status: args.status,
        reportCadence: args.reportCadence, nextReportAt, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
      }).returning();
      const client = rows[0];
      if (!client) return { ok: false, error: "The client could not be saved." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben added ${client.businessName} to the client registry (Front Office). Maria works from this record now.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, client: clientDto(client) };
    },
  }),

  update_client: defineAction({
    request: clientInput.extend({ id: z.string().min(1) }), response: clientResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof clientResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const existing = rows[0];
      if (!existing) return { ok: false, error: "That client could not be found." };
      const now = new Date();
      // Turning reporting on (or changing its rhythm) schedules the first
      // report; turning it off clears the due date. An unchanged rhythm
      // keeps its existing due date.
      const nextReportAt = args.reportCadence === "off"
        ? null
        : existing.reportCadence !== args.reportCadence || !existing.nextReportAt
          ? nextClientReportAt(args.reportCadence, now)
          : existing.nextReportAt;
      const updated = await db.update(schema.clients).set({
        businessName: args.businessName, approverName: args.approverName, platforms: args.platforms, voiceNotes: args.voiceNotes,
        photoLibraryStatus: args.photoLibraryStatus, photoLibraryLocation: args.photoLibraryStatus === "provided" ? args.photoLibraryLocation : "",
        showcasePermission: args.showcasePermission, isTest: args.isTest, status: args.status, reportCadence: args.reportCadence, nextReportAt, updatedAt: now,
      }).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.id)).returning();
      const client = updated[0];
      if (!client) return { ok: false, error: "The client could not be saved." };
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, client: clientDto(client) };
    },
  }),

  // In-place edit of a client's SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS (their voiceNotes —
  // the standing instructions Maria shapes every future brief from). The
  // Clients profile edits these in place; this narrow action updates only
  // that text on the same registry record the crew reads, so an edit here
  // is the text future briefs actually use.
  update_client_instructions: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), voiceNotes: z.string().trim().max(2000) }).strict(), response: clientResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof clientResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const existing = rows[0];
      if (!existing) return { ok: false, error: "That client could not be found." };
      const now = new Date();
      const updated = await db.update(schema.clients).set({ voiceNotes: args.voiceNotes, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.id)).returning();
      const client = updated[0];
      if (!client) return { ok: false, error: "The instructions could not be saved." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben updated ${client.businessName}'s special instructions in their client profile. Maria and the crew use the new text on future briefs.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, client: clientDto(client) };
    },
  }),

  delete_client: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const client = rows[0];
      if (!client) return { ok: false, error: "That client could not be found." };
      await db.batch([
        db.delete(schema.deliveryPackages).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.clientId, client.id)),
        db.delete(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, client.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben removed ${client.businessName} from the client registry. Their jobs in the office are untouched.` }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  approve_delivery_package: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), keepPaths: z.array(z.string().min(1).max(500)).max(40).optional() }).strict(), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.deleteDeliverableFiles],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.deliveryPackages).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const pkg = rows[0];
      if (!pkg) return { ok: false, error: "That package could not be found." };
      if (pkg.status === "delivered") return { ok: false, error: "That package is already delivered." };
      if (pkg.status !== "ready") return { ok: false, error: "Maria is still assembling that package — it will be ready for your decision when she finishes." };
      // CLIENT REPORT GUARANTEE at the package door: a package whose
      // source job is missing its required client report cannot be
      // delivered — the report has to be fixed by a rework first.
      const sourceRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, pkg.taskId)).limit(1);
      const sourceTask = sourceRows[0];
      if (sourceTask?.contractStatus === "bounced" && sourceTask.contractViolation?.includes("client report missing")) {
        return { ok: false, error: "client report missing — this package's job is missing its client report, so it cannot be delivered. Send the job back for rework so the report is added first." };
      }
      // Batch image decision at the package door (Ben's design): when the
      // package's images still have no decision, this same Accept commits
      // them — the selected images are kept, every non-selected image is
      // deleted from the source job's deliverables — and the package is
      // delivered in the one motion. No separate image step. When every
      // image already carries a decision (or there are none), approval
      // works exactly as before and keepPaths is not needed.
      let batchNote = "";
      if (sourceTask) {
        let imagePaths: string[];
        try { imagePaths = await taskImagePaths(ctx, sourceTask); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "The package's images could not be checked. Try again." }; }
        if (imagePaths.length) {
          const reviewRows = await db.select().from(schema.deliverableReviews).where(eq(schema.deliverableReviews.taskId, sourceTask.id));
          const decided = new Map(reviewRows.map((row) => [row.relativePath, row.decision]));
          const undecided = imagePaths.filter((path) => !decided.has(path));
          if (undecided.length && args.keepPaths === undefined && decided.size === 0) {
            return { ok: false, error: "Pick the images to keep on the package first — one Accept approves it with only those images." };
          }
          if (undecided.length && args.keepPaths !== undefined) {
            const alreadyKept = imagePaths.filter((path) => decided.get(path) === "approved").length;
            const selectedUndecided = undecided.filter((path) => args.keepPaths?.includes(path)).length;
            if (alreadyKept + selectedUndecided === 0) {
              return { ok: false, error: "Select at least one image to keep, or send the package back for rework instead." };
            }
            const batch = await applyBatchImageDecisions(ctx, sourceTask.id, imagePaths, args.keepPaths, undecided);
            if (!batch.ok) return { ok: false, error: batch.error };
            await db.update(schema.tasks).set({ deliverableReviewFinalizedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, sourceTask.id));
            batchNote = ` Image choices committed with the approval: ${alreadyKept + batch.kept.length} kept, ${batch.discarded.length} deleted.`;
          }
        }
      }
      const clientRows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, pkg.clientId)).limit(1);
      const now = new Date();
      await db.batch([
        db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ status: "delivered", deliveredAt: now, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, pkg.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben approved the delivery package for ${clientRows[0]?.businessName ?? "the client"}: “${pkg.title}”. It is marked Delivered and stays in the client's delivery history.${batchNote}` }),
      ]);
      // Shipped & Revenue: a package becoming Delivered drops its ledger
      // row (amount empty, owed) — one row per package, ever.
      await ensureLedgerRowForDeliveredPackage(ctx, pkg, now);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  // PACKAGE DELIVERY — the customer download link (Ben, 2026-10-16). Ben
  // hosts the package ZIP himself (Google Drive); the office only records
  // the link on the package. Saving a link is a delivery act: a ready
  // package flips to Delivered with the delivery date, under the same
  // status/deliveredAt semantics approve_delivery_package uses. Saving a
  // link on an already-delivered package only updates the link and keeps
  // its original delivery date.
  save_package_customer_link: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), url: z.string().trim().min(1).max(2000) }).strict(), response: packageResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof packageResult>> {
      let parsed: URL;
      try { parsed = new URL(args.url); } catch { return { ok: false, error: "That link does not look like a web address — paste the full link, starting with https://" }; }
      if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" && parsed.protocol !== "http:") return { ok: false, error: "The customer link has to be a web address (https://…)." };
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.deliveryPackages).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const pkg = rows[0];
      if (!pkg) return { ok: false, error: "That package could not be found." };
      if (pkg.status === "assembling") return { ok: false, error: "Maria is still assembling that package — the customer link can be saved once the package is ready." };
      const clientRows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, pkg.clientId)).limit(1);
      const now = new Date();
      const wasReady = pkg.status === "ready";
      const updated = await db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({
        customerLink: args.url,
        status: "delivered",
        deliveredAt: pkg.deliveredAt ?? now,
        updatedAt: now,
      }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, pkg.id)).returning();
      const saved = updated[0];
      if (!saved) return { ok: false, error: "The link could not be saved." };
      // Shipped & Revenue: when saving the link is the delivery act (the
      // package was Ready), its ledger row is created here too — exactly
      // one per package; on an already-delivered package this is a no-op.
      if (wasReady) await ensureLedgerRowForDeliveredPackage(ctx, pkg, pkg.deliveredAt ?? now);
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: wasReady
        ? `Ben saved the customer download link on the package for ${clientRows[0]?.businessName ?? "the client"}: “${pkg.title}”. Saving the link marked the package Delivered.`
        : `Ben updated the customer download link on the delivered package for ${clientRows[0]?.businessName ?? "the client"}: “${pkg.title}”.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, package: packageDto(saved) };
    },
  }),

  // SHIPPED & REVENUE — Ben adds a row by hand for money that never touched
  // a package (a Skunk Tools sale, a cash job). He may link it to a client
  // in the registry or just write the name; the amount is his figure alone,
  // and it may be left empty (shipped, amount not recorded yet).
  add_ledger_entry: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      shippedDate: ledgerDate,
      clientId: z.string().min(1).nullable().optional(),
      clientLabel: z.string().trim().max(160).default(""),
      whatShipped: z.string().trim().min(1).max(300),
      amountCents: z.number().int().min(0).max(100_000_000).nullable().optional(),
      status: ledgerStatus.default("owed"),
      method: z.string().trim().max(60).default(""),
      note: z.string().trim().max(500).default(""),
    }).strict(), response: ledgerResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof ledgerResult>> {
      if (!isRealLedgerDate(args.shippedDate)) return { ok: false, error: "That date is not a real calendar day — check it and try again." };
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      let clientLabel = args.clientLabel.trim();
      let clientId: string | null = null;
      if (args.clientId) {
        const rows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, args.clientId)).limit(1);
        const client = rows[0];
        if (!client) return { ok: false, error: "That client is no longer in the registry. Pick another client, or no client." };
        clientId = client.id;
        clientLabel = client.businessName;
      }
      const now = new Date();
      const inserted = await db.insert(schema.ledgerEntries).values({
        id: `ledger-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
        shippedDate: args.shippedDate,
        clientId,
        clientLabel,
        whatShipped: args.whatShipped,
        amountCents: args.amountCents ?? null,
        status: args.status,
        method: args.method,
        note: args.note,
        source: "manual",
        packageId: null,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      }).returning();
      const entry = inserted[0];
      if (!entry) return { ok: false, error: "That row could not be added. Try again." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben added a row to Shipped & Revenue by hand: “${entry.whatShipped}”${clientLabel ? ` for ${clientLabel}` : ""}${entry.amountCents !== null ? ` — $${(entry.amountCents / 100).toFixed(2)} CAD, ${entry.status}` : " — amount not recorded yet"}.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, entry: ledgerDto(entry) };
    },
  }),

  // SHIPPED & REVENUE — Ben edits a row's money facts: the amount, whether
  // it is owed or paid, how they paid, and the note. Any row can be edited
  // this way (package rows included — recording that a package got paid is
  // the normal flow); what shipped and where the row came from never change.
  update_ledger_entry: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      id: z.string().min(1),
      amountCents: z.number().int().min(0).max(100_000_000).nullable().optional(),
      status: ledgerStatus.optional(),
      method: z.string().trim().max(60).optional(),
      note: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
    }).strict(), response: ledgerResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof ledgerResult>> {
      if (args.amountCents === undefined && args.status === undefined && args.method === undefined && args.note === undefined) {
        return { ok: false, error: "Nothing to change — edit the amount, the owed/paid state, how they paid, or the note first." };
      }
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.ledgerEntries).where(eq(schema.ledgerEntries.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const entry = rows[0];
      if (!entry) return { ok: false, error: "That ledger row could not be found." };
      const now = new Date();
      const updated = await db.update(schema.ledgerEntries).set({
        ...(args.amountCents !== undefined ? { amountCents: args.amountCents } : {}),
        ...(args.status !== undefined ? { status: args.status } : {}),
        ...(args.method !== undefined ? { method: args.method } : {}),
        ...(args.note !== undefined ? { note: args.note } : {}),
        updatedAt: now,
      }).where(eq(schema.ledgerEntries.id, entry.id)).returning();
      const saved = updated[0];
      if (!saved) return { ok: false, error: "That row could not be saved. Try again." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben updated the Shipped & Revenue row “${saved.whatShipped}”: ${saved.amountCents !== null ? `$${(saved.amountCents / 100).toFixed(2)} CAD, ${saved.status}` : "amount not recorded yet"}${saved.method ? `, paid by ${saved.method}` : ""}.` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, entry: ledgerDto(saved) };
    },
  }),

  // SHIPPED & REVENUE — only a row Ben added by hand can be deleted. A
  // package row is the record of something that actually shipped, so it
  // stays in the book.
  delete_ledger_entry: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.ledgerEntries).where(eq(schema.ledgerEntries.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const entry = rows[0];
      if (!entry) return { ok: false, error: "That ledger row could not be found." };
      if (entry.source !== "manual") return { ok: false, error: "That row came from a delivered package, so it stays in the ledger — it is the record of what shipped. You can still edit its amount, owed/paid state, method, and note." };
      await db.batch([
        db.delete(schema.ledgerEntries).where(eq(schema.ledgerEntries.id, entry.id)),
        db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben removed the hand-added Shipped & Revenue row “${entry.whatShipped}”.` }),
      ]);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  // OUTREACH — Ben adds a business to the book by hand: who they are,

  add_outreach_contact: defineAction({

      businessName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(160),
      town: z.string().trim().max(80).default(""),

      note: z.string().trim().max(1000).default(""),

    }).strict(), response: outreachResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof outreachResult>> {

  // OUTREACH — Ben updates a row as outcomes change: where it stands, the
  // outcome note, and whether a door is left open (with the note on how).
  // Who the business is and how they were first contacted never change
  // here — those are the record of what happened.
  update_outreach_contact: defineAction({
    request: z.object({
      id: z.string().min(1),
      status: outreachStatus.optional(),
      note: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional(),
      followUp: z.boolean().optional(),
      followUpNote: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
    }).strict(), response: outreachResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof outreachResult>> {
      if (args.status === undefined && args.note === undefined && args.followUp === undefined && args.followUpNote === undefined) {
        return { ok: false, error: "Nothing to change — edit the status, the outcome note, or the follow-up first." };
      }

    },

  // PACKAGE DELIVERY — assemble the customer ZIP (Ben, 2026-10-16). One ZIP
  // built from the package's source job's listed deliverables (see
  // collectPackageFiles), organized for a non-technical customer: a
  // START HERE.txt on top, finished posts as readable text files with
  // their image beside them under the same name, the client report as its
  // own clearly named file, website/asset files in their own folder, and
  // no internal files. The ZIP bytes are stored as an owned blob and the
  // client downloads from its URL. This action never marks anything
  // delivered — delivery happens when Ben saves the customer link.
  download_package_zip: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: packageZipResult, privileged: [privileged.scanDeliverables, privileged.readDeliverable],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof packageZipResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.deliveryPackages).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const pkg = rows[0];
      if (!pkg) return { ok: false, error: "That package could not be found." };
      if (pkg.status !== "ready" && pkg.status !== "delivered") return { ok: false, error: "Maria is still assembling that package — the ZIP can be downloaded once the package is ready." };
      const clientRows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, pkg.clientId)).limit(1);
      const client = clientRows[0];
      const clientName = client?.businessName ?? "Client";
      const sourceRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, pkg.taskId)).limit(1);
      const sourceTask = sourceRows[0];
      if (!sourceTask) return { ok: false, error: "The job behind that package could not be found." };
      let collected: { files: PackageFile[]; postCopy: string | null };
      try {
        collected = await collectPackageFiles(ctx, sourceTask);
      } catch {
        return { ok: false, error: "The package's files could not be read right now. Try again." };
      }
      // Internal-only files never reach the customer, even when they sit
      // in the source job's folder and show in the office's own review
      // list: Maria's intake brief (client-brief), the lab verification
      // sheet, handoffs, and drafts are office machinery, not finished
      // work. (image-provenance files are already excluded upstream.)
      const internalStem = (fileName: string) => fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
      const isInternalFile = (file: PackageFile) => {
        const stem = internalStem(file.fileName);
        return /^client-brief$/i.test(stem) || /^lab-verification$/i.test(stem) || /^delivery-package$/i.test(stem)
          || /handoff/i.test(stem) || /(^|[-_ ])drafts?([-_ ]|$)/i.test(stem);
      };
      const files = collected.files.filter((file) => !isInternalFile(file));
      if (!files.length && !collected.postCopy) return { ok: false, error: "This package has no finished files to put in a ZIP yet." };
      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
      const usedNames = new Set<string>(["start here.txt"]);
      const uniqueName = (name: string): string => {
        if (!usedNames.has(name.toLowerCase())) { usedNames.add(name.toLowerCase()); return name; }
        const dot = name.lastIndexOf(".");
        const stem = dot > 0 ? name.slice(0, dot) : name;
        const extension = dot > 0 ? name.slice(dot) : "";
        let suffix = 2;
        let candidate = `${stem} (${suffix})${extension}`;
        while (usedNames.has(candidate.toLowerCase())) { suffix += 1; candidate = `${stem} (${suffix})${extension}`; }
        usedNames.add(candidate.toLowerCase());
        return candidate;
      };
      const folder = taskDeliverableFolder(sourceTask.id);
      const isReportFile = (file: PackageFile) => /report/i.test(file.fileName) || sourceTask.jobType === "client_report" || sourceTask.pipeline === "client_report";
      const isPostTextFile = (file: PackageFile) => (file.kind === "markdown" || file.kind === "text") && /(?:facebook|social)[-_ ]*post|post[-_ ]*copy|caption/i.test(file.fileName);
      const hasWebsiteFiles = files.some((file) => file.kind === "document" && /\.html?$/i.test(file.fileName));
      type Planned = { zipName: string; bytes: Uint8Array; description: string };
      const planned: Planned[] = [];
      // The post text the customer receives: the package's stored finished
      // copy when the job carries one (that is the copy the package view
      // shows), otherwise the post text file itself.
      const postSourceFile = collected.postCopy ? null : files.find(isPostTextFile) ?? null;
      const postText = collected.postCopy ?? postSourceFile?.text ?? null;
      const postStem = postText ? sanitizeCustomerName(pkg.title, "Post", 56) : null;
      let postTextPlanned = false;
      let postImagePlanned = false;
      for (const file of files) {
        const extension = file.fileName.includes(".") ? file.fileName.slice(file.fileName.lastIndexOf(".")).toLowerCase() : "";
        if (postText && ((collected.postCopy && isPostTextFile(file)) || (postSourceFile && file.relativePath === postSourceFile.relativePath))) {
          // Superseded by the planned post text below (same content source
          // the package view shows); never include the raw post file twice.
          continue;
        }
        if (file.kind === "image") {
          if (!file.bytes) continue;
          if (postText && !postImagePlanned && postStem) {
            planned.push({ zipName: uniqueName(`${postStem}${extension || ".png"}`), bytes: file.bytes, description: "the picture that goes with the post above — attach it when you post" });
            postImagePlanned = true;
            continue;
          }
          if (hasWebsiteFiles) {
            const subPath = file.relativePath.startsWith(`${folder}/`) ? file.relativePath.slice(folder.length + 1) : file.fileName;
            planned.push({ zipName: uniqueName(`Website and assets/${subPath}`), bytes: file.bytes, description: "one of the website / branding files — see the note below" });
            continue;
          }
          planned.push({ zipName: uniqueName(`${sanitizeCustomerName(file.humanTitle, file.fileName)}${extension}`), bytes: file.bytes, description: "a finished picture from this package, at full quality" });
          continue;
        }
        if (file.kind === "document" && /\.html?$/i.test(file.fileName)) {
          if (!file.bytes) continue;
          const subPath = file.relativePath.startsWith(`${folder}/`) ? file.relativePath.slice(folder.length + 1) : file.fileName;
          planned.push({ zipName: uniqueName(`Website and assets/${subPath}`), bytes: file.bytes, description: "a page of the website — see the note below" });
          continue;
        }
        if (file.kind === "document" || file.kind === "video") {
          if (!file.bytes) continue;
          const name = isReportFile(file) ? `Your report from Pulse HQ${extension || ".pdf"}` : `${sanitizeCustomerName(file.humanTitle, file.fileName)}${extension}`;
          planned.push({ zipName: uniqueName(name), bytes: file.bytes, description: isReportFile(file) ? "your report from Pulse HQ — yours to keep" : "a finished file from this package" });
          continue;
        }
        // Text / markdown: readable text files under human names.
        if (file.text === null) continue;
        const bytes = encoder.encode(file.text);
        if (isReportFile(file)) {
          planned.push({ zipName: uniqueName("Your report from Pulse HQ.txt"), bytes, description: "your report from Pulse HQ — what was done for you, in plain words. It is yours to keep" });
          continue;
        }
        planned.push({ zipName: uniqueName(`${sanitizeCustomerName(file.humanTitle, firstWordsStem(file.text, file.fileName))}.txt`), bytes, description: "a finished document from this package, ready to read and use" });
      }
      if (postText && postStem) {
        planned.unshift({ zipName: uniqueName(`${postStem}.txt`), bytes: encoder.encode(postText), description: "the finished post — copy this text when you post" });
        postTextPlanned = true;
      }
      void postTextPlanned;
      const hasReport = planned.some((entry) => /your report/i.test(entry.zipName));
      const startHereLines = [
        "START HERE",
        "",
        `For: ${clientName}`,
        `Package: ${pkg.title}`,
        "From: Pulse HQ",
        "",
        "WHAT'S INSIDE",
        ...planned.map((entry) => `- ${entry.zipName} — ${entry.description}`),
        "",
        "HOW TO USE IT",
      ];
      if (postText) {
        startHereLines.push("- Posts: each post is a text file. Open it, copy the whole text, and paste it into your post. The picture with the SAME name goes with that post — attach it before you publish. That is all there is to it.");
      }
      if (hasReport) {
        startHereLines.push("- Your report: the file named “Your report from Pulse HQ” sums up the work in plain words. It is yours to keep — save it wherever you keep your records.");
      }
      if (hasWebsiteFiles) {
        startHereLines.push("- Website files: everything in the “Website and assets” folder belongs to your website and branding. You do not need to open these one by one — keep the folder together as it is, and Pulse HQ can put the files to work for you, or hand them to whoever looks after your website.");
      }
      if (!postText && !hasReport && !hasWebsiteFiles) {
        startHereLines.push("- Everything here is finished work, ready to read and use as it is. Text files open with a double-click; pictures are at full quality, exactly as made.");
      }
      if (pkg.coverNote) {
        startHereLines.push("", "A NOTE FROM PULSE HQ", pkg.coverNote.trim());
      }
      startHereLines.push("", "Questions about anything in this package? Just ask Pulse HQ — we are happy to walk through it.");
      const entries = [
        { name: "START HERE.txt", bytes: encoder.encode(startHereLines.join("\n")) },
        ...planned.map((entry) => ({ name: entry.zipName, bytes: entry.bytes })),
      ];
      const zipBytes = buildZipArchive(entries);
      const zipFileName = `${sanitizeCustomerName(`${clientName} - ${pkg.title}`, "Pulse HQ package", 80)}.zip`;
      const blobKey = `package-zips/${pkg.id}.zip`;
      await ctx.blobs.put(blobKey, zipBytes, { contentType: "application/zip" });
      const url = await ctx.blobs.getUrl(blobKey, { expiresInSeconds: 3600 });
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben downloaded the customer ZIP for ${clientName}: “${pkg.title}” (${entries.length} files inside).` });
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true, url, fileName: zipFileName, entries: entries.map((entry) => entry.name), entryCount: entries.length };
    },
  }),

  rework_delivery_package: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), feedback: z.string().trim().min(1).max(5000) }), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.deliveryPackages).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const pkg = rows[0];
      if (!pkg) return { ok: false, error: "That package could not be found." };
      if (pkg.status !== "ready") return { ok: false, error: "Only a package waiting on you can be sent back to Maria." };
      const clientRows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, pkg.clientId)).limit(1);
      const client = clientRows[0];
      if (!client) return { ok: false, error: "That package's client is no longer in the registry." };
      const sourceRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, pkg.taskId)).limit(1);
      const sourceTask = sourceRows[0];
      if (!sourceTask) return { ok: false, error: "The job behind that package could not be found." };
      const now = new Date();
      const step = mariaAssemblyStep(client, sourceTask);
      const reworkStep: FrontOfficeStep = {
        ...step,
        title: `Rework the delivery package: ${sourceTask.title}`.slice(0, 120),
        instructions: `${step.instructions}\n\nREWORK — Ben sent this package back with this feedback. The feedback defines what is wrong and what done looks like this time:\n${args.feedback}\n\nYour previous cover note was:\n${pkg.coverNote ?? "(none was recorded)"}\n\nIf the feedback changes a finished piece itself (the words of the post — adding hashtags, fixing a line), the REVISING A FINISHED PIECE rule above is the whole job: save the complete revised piece in this package job's folder under its original file name before you finish, or the package Ben reads will still show the old version no matter what your cover note says.`,
      };
      // Reuse the package job when it still exists (normal rework shape:
      // revision bump + one fresh Maria brief); rebuild it if it is gone.
      const packageTaskRows = pkg.packageTaskId ? await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, pkg.packageTaskId)).limit(1) : [];
      const packageTask = packageTaskRows[0];
      if (packageTask) {
        const nextRevision = packageTask.revision + 1;
        const briefRows = await db.insert(schema.briefs).values({
          id: `brief-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, taskId: packageTask.id, title: reworkStep.title, assignee: "maria", notes: reworkStep.instructions,
          status: "new", result: null, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, pipeline: "client_delivery", pipelineStage: "assembly",
          runTaskId: null, progressText: "Queued by Ben", lastHeartbeatAt: null, attempt: 0, stepIndex: 0, revision: nextRevision,
        }).returning();
        if (!briefRows[0]) return { ok: false, error: "The rework step could not be created." };
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "working", assignee: "maria", revision: nextRevision }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, packageTask.id)),
          db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ status: "assembling", coverNote: null, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, pkg.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben sent the delivery package for ${client.businessName} back to Maria: “${pkg.title}”. She is reworking it.` }),
        ]);
        await startNextForTask(ctx, packageTask.id);
      } else {
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, {
          title: `Delivery package — ${sourceTask.title}`.slice(0, 120),
          notes: `Maria reworks the delivery package for ${client.businessName} from the approved job “${sourceTask.title}”.`,
          clientId: client.id, pipeline: "client_delivery", parentTaskId: sourceTask.id, steps: [reworkStep],
        });
        if (!created) return { ok: false, error: "The rework could not be started." };
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ status: "assembling", coverNote: null, packageTaskId: created.task.id, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, pkg.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben sent the delivery package for ${client.businessName} back to Maria: “${pkg.title}”. She is reworking it.` }),
        ]);
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      }
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  // Phase 5: a package whose assembly died used to sit in "assembling"
  // forever — approval refuses the state and nothing retried it. This is
  // Ben's working exit: it re-runs Maria's assembly for that one package,
  // reusing the package job when it still exists and rebuilding it when
  // it is gone (the rework action's two shapes). It changes nothing about
  // the approval gate: the package still only becomes ready when Maria's
  // assembly step actually completes.
  finish_assembling_package: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }).strict(), response: mutationResult, privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.deliveryPackages).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, args.id)).limit(1);
      const pkg = rows[0];
      if (!pkg) return { ok: false, error: "That package could not be found." };
      if (pkg.status !== "assembling") return { ok: false, error: "That package is not waiting on assembly." };
      const clientRows = await db.select().from(schema.clients).where(eq(schema.clients.id, pkg.clientId)).limit(1);
      const client = clientRows[0];
      if (!client) return { ok: false, error: "That package's client is no longer in the registry." };
      const sourceRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, pkg.taskId)).limit(1);
      const sourceTask = sourceRows[0];
      if (!sourceTask) return { ok: false, error: "The job behind that package could not be found." };
      const now = new Date();
      const step = mariaAssemblyStep(client, sourceTask);
      const retryStep: FrontOfficeStep = {
        ...step,
        title: `Finish assembling the delivery package: ${sourceTask.title}`.slice(0, 120),
        instructions: `${step.instructions}\n\nRETRY — the earlier assembly of this package did not finish, so the package has been waiting in "assembling". Assemble it now from the approved job exactly as specified above and finish, so the package becomes ready for Ben's decision.`,
      };
      const packageTaskRows = pkg.packageTaskId ? await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, pkg.packageTaskId)).limit(1) : [];
      const packageTask = packageTaskRows[0];
      if (packageTask) {
        const assemblyBriefs = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.taskId, packageTask.id));
        const liveAssembly = assemblyBriefs.find((brief) => brief.pipelineStage === "assembly" && brief.revision === packageTask.revision && brief.status === "in_progress" && (brief.lastHeartbeatAt ?? brief.updatedAt).getTime() > now.getTime() - STALLED_BRIEF_THRESHOLD_MS);
        if (liveAssembly) return { ok: false, error: "Maria is actively assembling that package right now — give her a few minutes and it will be ready." };
        // Retire any stranded assembly attempts so exactly one fresh step runs.
        for (const stale of assemblyBriefs.filter((brief) => brief.pipelineStage === "assembly" && (brief.status === "new" || brief.status === "in_progress"))) {
          await db.update(schema.briefs).set({ status: "failed", result: "Superseded by Ben's finish-assembling retry.", progressText: "Superseded by a retry", updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, stale.id));
        }
        const nextRevision = packageTask.revision + 1;
        const briefRows = await db.insert(schema.briefs).values({
          id: `brief-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, taskId: packageTask.id, title: retryStep.title, assignee: "maria", notes: retryStep.instructions,
          status: "new", result: null, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, pipeline: "client_delivery", pipelineStage: "assembly",
          runTaskId: null, progressText: "Queued by Ben — finishing assembly", lastHeartbeatAt: null, attempt: 0, stepIndex: 0, revision: nextRevision,
        }).returning();
        if (!briefRows[0]) return { ok: false, error: "The assembly step could not be created." };
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.tasks).set({ status: "working", assignee: "maria", revision: nextRevision }).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, packageTask.id)),
          db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ status: "assembling", coverNote: null, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, pkg.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben asked Maria to finish assembling the delivery package for ${client.businessName}: “${pkg.title}”.` }),
        ]);
        await startNextForTask(ctx, packageTask.id);
      } else {
        const created = await createPlannedWork(ctx, {
          title: `Delivery package — ${sourceTask.title}`.slice(0, 120),
          notes: `Maria finishes assembling the delivery package for ${client.businessName} from the approved job “${sourceTask.title}” — the earlier assembly did not finish.`,
          clientId: client.id, pipeline: "client_delivery", parentTaskId: sourceTask.id, steps: [retryStep],
        });
        if (!created) return { ok: false, error: "The assembly could not be restarted." };
        await db.batch([
          db.update(schema.deliveryPackages).set({ status: "assembling", coverNote: null, packageTaskId: created.task.id, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(schema.deliveryPackages.id, pkg.id)),
          db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: now, text: `Ben asked Maria to finish assembling the delivery package for ${client.businessName}: “${pkg.title}”.` }),
        ]);
        await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      }
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
