SOURCE MATERIAL (in the job notes above, plus the source job's folder it names): the delivered package — Maria's cover note and the job's finished pieces. Read the finished pieces before writing. The client has granted showcase permission; that permission covers THIS delivered work only.

DEFINITION OF DONE — all four are true:
- The case study tells the true story of this one piece of work: what the client needed (only as far as the material says), what Pulse HQ made, and what was delivered — every claim traces to the cover note or the finished files.
- Nothing is invented: no results, numbers, quotes, testimonials, or outcomes the material does not contain. A case study that overclaims is worse than none.

IF THE MATERIAL IS TOO THIN to support an honest case study, say exactly what is missing in your result instead of padding it.`,
        }],
      });
      if (!created) return { ok: false, error: "The case-study job could not be created." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: `Ben started a case-study draft from the delivered package for ${client.businessName} — Johnny is drafting it as a normal job.` });
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      ctx.invalidateQueries();
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),

  create_standing_order: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ instruction: z.string().trim().min(3).max(1000), assigneeId: memberId, mode: orderMode, cadence: cadence.optional(), weekday: z.number().int().min(0).max(6).optional(), targetCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(25).optional(), scheduleHour: z.number().int().min(0).max(23).optional(), scheduleMinute: z.number().int().min(0).max(59).optional(), timezone: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80).optional() }), response: z.discriminatedUnion("ok", [z.object({ ok: z.literal(true), order: orderShape }), z.object({ ok: z.literal(false), error: z.string() })]),
    async handler(ctx, args) {
      if (args.mode === "scheduled" && !args.cadence) return { ok: false as const, error: "Choose how often this order runs." };
      if (args.mode === "pipeline" && !args.targetCount) return { ok: false as const, error: "Choose how many jobs to keep active." };
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const now = new Date(); const scheduleHour = args.scheduleHour ?? 9; const scheduleMinute = args.scheduleMinute ?? 0; const timezone = args.timezone ?? "America/Vancouver";
      try { new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { timeZone: timezone }).format(now); } catch { return { ok: false as const, error: "That schedule timezone is not valid." }; }
      const selectedCadence = args.mode === "scheduled" ? args.cadence ?? "daily" : null;
      const selectedWeekday = args.mode === "scheduled" && selectedCadence === "weekly" ? args.weekday ?? 1 : null;
      const nextRunAt = selectedCadence ? nextScheduledRun(now, selectedCadence, selectedWeekday, scheduleHour, scheduleMinute, timezone) : null;
      const rows = await db.insert(schema.standingOrders).values({ id: `order-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, instruction: args.instruction, assignee: args.assigneeId, mode: args.mode, cadence: selectedCadence, weekday: selectedWeekday, targetCount: args.mode === "pipeline" ? args.targetCount ?? 1 : null, enabled: true, nextRunAt, lastRunAt: null, createdAt: now, scheduleHour, scheduleMinute, timezone }).returning();
      const order = rows[0]; if (!order) return { ok: false as const, error: "The standing order could not be saved." }; ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true as const, order: orderDto(order) };
    },
  }),
  set_standing_order_enabled: defineAction({ request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), enabled: z.boolean() }), response: mutationResult, async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> { const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>(); const rows = await db.select().from(schema.standingOrders).where(eq(schema.standingOrders.id, args.id)).limit(1); const order = rows[0]; if (!order) return { ok: false, error: "Standing order not found." }; const nextRunAt = args.enabled && order.cadence ? nextScheduledRun(new Date(), order.cadence, order.weekday, order.scheduleHour, order.scheduleMinute, order.timezone) : order.nextRunAt; await db.update(schema.standingOrders).set({ enabled: args.enabled, nextRunAt }).where(eq(schema.standingOrders.id, order.id)); ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true }; } }),
  delete_standing_order: defineAction({ request: z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }), response: mutationResult, async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> { await ctx.db<typeof schema>().delete(schema.standingOrders).where(eq(schema.standingOrders.id, args.id)); ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { ok: true }; } }),
  // Kept deliberately (Phase 5 sweep): this thin wrapper is the manual /

  // runs — evaluateStandingOrdersNow is the one implementation.
  evaluate_standing_orders: defineAction({ request: z.object({}), response: z.object({ created: z.number().int().nonnegative(), evaluated: z.number().int().nonnegative() }), async handler(ctx) { return evaluateStandingOrdersNow(ctx); } }),
  // Editing a standing order's text. For Olivia's order this is the ONE

  // On-demand run of Olivia's Monday batch — the same creation path the

    privileged: [privileged.listSkillPool],

      const active = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(and(eq(schema.tasks.standingOrderId, OLIVIA_X_ORDER_ID), eq(schema.tasks.status, "working"))).limit(1);
      if (active.length > 0) return { ok: false as const, error: "Olivia's X post batch is already in progress." };
      const rows = await db.select().from(schema.standingOrders).where(eq(schema.standingOrders.id, OLIVIA_X_ORDER_ID)).limit(1);
      const order = rows[0];
      if (!order) return { ok: false as const, error: "Olivia's standing order could not be found." };
      const created = await createOliviaMondayBatch(ctx, order);
      const first = created?.briefs[0];
      if (!created || !first) return { ok: false as const, error: "Olivia's batch could not be created." };
      await db.insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: "Ben ran Olivia's X post batch on demand — the same standing-order brief as the Monday run." });
      await startNextForTask(ctx, created.task.id);
      const taskRows = await db.select().from(schema.tasks).where(eq(schema.tasks.id, created.task.id)).limit(1);
      const briefRows = await db.select().from(schema.briefs).where(eq(schema.briefs.id, first.id)).limit(1);
      return { ok: true as const, task: taskDto(taskRows[0] ?? created.task), brief: briefDto(briefRows[0] ?? first) };
    },
  }),
  add_log: defineAction({ request: z.object({ text: z.string().trim().min(1).max(1000) }), response: z.object({ entry: logShape }), async handler(ctx, args) { const rows = await ctx.db<typeof schema>().insert(schema.activityLog).values({ t: new Date(), text: args.text }).returning(); const row = rows[0]; if (!row) throw new Error("The log entry could not be added."); ctx.invalidateQueries(); return { entry: logDto(row) }; } }),

  // Crew presence steady states. Reading returns every saved presence (an
  // empty list on first run — each floor then initializes from its current
  // defaults and starts saving). Saving upserts a batch of presence rows;
  // it deliberately does NOT invalidate queries: presence writes are
  // frequent and ambient, and the floors read presence only on load.
  get_crew_presence: defineAction({
    request: z.object({}), response: presenceResponse,
    async handler(ctx): Promise<z.infer<typeof presenceResponse>> {
      const rows = await ctx.db<typeof schema>().select().from(schema.crewPresence);
      return { records: rows.map(presenceDto) };
    },
  }),
  save_crew_presence: defineAction({
    request: z.object({ records: z.array(presenceRecordInput).min(1).max(40) }), response: mutationResult,
    async handler(ctx, args): Promise<z.infer<typeof mutationResult>> {
      const db = ctx.db<typeof schema>();
      const now = new Date();
      for (const record of args.records) {
        const values: typeof schema.crewPresence.$inferInsert = {
          memberKey: record.memberKey, floor: record.floor, x: record.x, y: record.y,
          facing: record.facing, label: record.label, phase: record.phase, extra: record.extra, updatedAt: now,
        };
        await db.insert(schema.crewPresence).values(values).onConflictDoUpdate({
          target: schema.crewPresence.memberKey,
          set: { floor: record.floor, x: record.x, y: record.y, facing: record.facing, label: record.label, phase: record.phase, extra: record.extra, updatedAt: now },
        });
      }
      return { ok: true };
    },
  }),
} satisfies ActionsModule;

type DeliverableMeta = z.infer<typeof deliverableMeta>;

function safePath(relativePath: string): string {
  const normalized = relativePath.replace(/^\/+/, "");
  const absolute = resolve(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, normalized);
  if (absolute !== DELIVERABLE_ROOT && !absolute.startsWith(`${DELIVERABLE_ROOT}${sep}`)) {
    throw new Error("Deliverable path is outside the AI Office workspace.");
  }
  return absolute;
}

function isProvenanceFileName(fileName: string): boolean {
  return /^image-provenance\.(?:md|txt)$/i.test(fileName);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Self-contained HTML deliverables (serve-time only — files on disk are
// never modified). Crew-written pages reference sibling files with relative
// paths (src="../images/hero.jpg", src="logo-primary.png"), which resolve
// inside the job folder but point nowhere once the office serves the HTML
// on its own through a blob/Open link. When an HTML deliverable is read
// for serving, relative references to files that actually exist beside it
// are inlined: images and other binary assets become data URIs, local
// stylesheets become <style> blocks, and local scripts are inlined in
// place. External and absolute references (http(s):, //, /, data:, blob:,
// mailto:, tel:, #anchors, …) pass through untouched, and a page whose
// references do not resolve is returned byte-identical to the stored file.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const ASSET_MIME_TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
  ".png": "image/png",
  ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
  ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
  ".webp": "image/webp",
  ".gif": "image/gif",
  ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
  ".ico": "image/x-icon",
  ".avif": "image/avif",
  ".bmp": "image/bmp",
  ".mp4": "video/mp4",
  ".webm": "video/webm",
  ".mov": "video/quicktime",
  ".mp3": "audio/mpeg",
  ".wav": "audio/wav",
  ".ogg": "audio/ogg",
  ".pdf": "application/pdf",
  ".css": "text/css",
  ".js": "text/javascript",
  ".mjs": "text/javascript",
  ".json": "application/json",
  ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  ".htm": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  ".woff": "font/woff",
  ".woff2": "font/woff2",
  ".ttf": "font/ttf",
  ".otf": "font/otf",
  ".eot": "application/vnd.ms-fontobject",
  ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
};
const MAX_ASSET_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_INLINE_TOTAL_BYTES = 48 * 1024 * 1024;

type InlineContext = {
  cache: Map<string, Promise<string | null>>;
  depth: number;
  budget: { remaining: number };
};

function isRelativeRef(ref: string): boolean {
  const value = ref.trim();
  if (!value) return false;
  if (value.startsWith("#") || value.startsWith("/") || value.startsWith("\\")) return false;
  // Any scheme (http:, https:, data:, blob:, mailto:, tel:, javascript:, …)
  // is not a local file reference.
  if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/.test(value)) return false;
  return true;
}

function refPathPart(ref: string): string {
  const cut = ref.search(/[?#]/);
  return cut === -1 ? ref : ref.slice(0, cut);
}

function refFragment(ref: string): string {
  const hash = ref.indexOf("#");
  return hash === -1 ? "" : ref.slice(hash);
}

function resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory: string, ref: string): string | null {
  const pathPart = refPathPart(ref.trim());
  if (!pathPart) return null;
  let decoded = pathPart;
  try { decoded = decodeURIComponent(pathPart); } catch { /* keep the raw path */ }
  if (!decoded || decoded.includes("\0")) return null;
  const absolute = resolve(baseDirectory, decoded);
  if (absolute !== DELIVERABLE_ROOT && !absolute.startsWith(`${DELIVERABLE_ROOT}${sep}`)) return null;
  return absolute;
}

async function existingFileSize(absolutePath: string): Promise<number | null> {
  try {
    const details = await stat(absolutePath);
    return details.isFile() ? details.size : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function mimeForAssetPath(absolutePath: string): string {
  return ASSET_MIME_TYPES[extname(absolutePath).toLowerCase()] ?? "application/octet-stream";
}

async function replaceAsync(
  input: string,
  regex: RegExp,
  replacer: (full: string, ...groups: Array<string | undefined>) => Promise<string>,
): Promise<string> {
  regex.lastIndex = 0;
  let result = "";
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((match = regex.exec(input)) !== null) {
    result += input.slice(lastIndex, match.index);
    result += await replacer(match[0], ...match.slice(1));
    lastIndex = match.index + match[0].length;
    if (match[0].length === 0) regex.lastIndex += 1;
  }
  result += input.slice(lastIndex);
  return result;
}

function getAttrValue(tag: string, name: string): string | null {
  const match = new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\s*=\\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\\s>]+))`, "i").exec(tag);
  if (!match) return null;
  return match[1] ?? match[2] ?? match[3] ?? null;
}

function replaceAttrValue(tag: string, name: string, newValue: string): string {
  const regex = new RegExp(`(\\b${name}\\s*=\\s*)("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\\s>]+)`, "i");
  return tag.replace(regex, (_full, prefix: string, whole: string) => {
    const quote = whole.startsWith("'") ? "'" : '"';
    return `${prefix}${quote}${newValue}${quote}`;
  });
}

function removeAttr(tagAttrs: string, name: string): string {
  return tagAttrs.replace(new RegExp(`\\s*\\b${name}\\s*=\\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\\s>]+)`, "i"), "");
}

async function assetDataUri(absolutePath: string, ctx: InlineContext): Promise<string | null> {
  const cached = ctx.cache.get(absolutePath);
  if (cached) return cached;
  const pending = (async (): Promise<string | null> => {
    const size = await existingFileSize(absolutePath);
    if (size === null || size > MAX_ASSET_BYTES || size > ctx.budget.remaining) return null;
    ctx.budget.remaining -= size;
    const bytes = await readFile(absolutePath);
    const extension = extname(absolutePath).toLowerCase();
    let outBytes: Buffer = bytes;
    if ((extension === ".html" || extension === ".htm") && ctx.depth < 3) {
      const nested = await makeHtmlSelfContained(bytes.toString("utf8"), dirname(absolutePath), ctx.depth + 1, ctx);
      if (nested !== null) outBytes = Buffer.from(nested, "utf8");
    } else if (extension === ".css") {
      const processed = await processCssText(bytes.toString("utf8"), dirname(absolutePath), ctx);
      if (processed !== null) outBytes = Buffer.from(processed, "utf8");
    }
    return `data:${mimeForAssetPath(absolutePath)};base64,${outBytes.toString("base64")}`;
  })();
  ctx.cache.set(absolutePath, pending);
  return pending;
}

async function processCssText(cssText: string, baseDirectory: string, ctx: InlineContext): Promise<string | null> {
  let changed = false;
  let result = await replaceAsync(cssText, /url\(\s*(["']?)([^"')]+)\1\s*\)/g, async (full, _quote, rawUrl) => {
    const url = (rawUrl ?? "").trim();
    if (!isRelativeRef(url)) return full;
    const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, url);
    if (!resolved) return full;
    const dataUri = await assetDataUri(resolved, ctx);
    if (!dataUri) return full;
    changed = true;
    return `url("${dataUri}")`;
  });
  result = await replaceAsync(result, /@import\s+(["'])([^"']+)\1\s*;/g, async (full, _quote, rawUrl) => {
    const url = (rawUrl ?? "").trim();
    if (!isRelativeRef(url)) return full;
    const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, url);
    if (!resolved) return full;
    const size = await existingFileSize(resolved);
    if (size === null || size > MAX_ASSET_BYTES) return full;
    const imported = (await readFile(resolved)).toString("utf8");
    const processed = (await processCssText(imported, dirname(resolved), ctx)) ?? imported;
    changed = true;
    return processed;
  });
  return changed ? result : null;
}

async function processSrcset(srcset: string, baseDirectory: string, ctx: InlineContext): Promise<string | null> {
  let changed = false;
  const candidates: string[] = [];
  for (const rawCandidate of srcset.split(",")) {
    const candidate = rawCandidate.trim();
    if (!candidate) continue;
    const parts = candidate.split(/\s+/);
    const url = parts[0] ?? "";
    const descriptor = parts.slice(1).join(" ");
    if (isRelativeRef(url)) {
      const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, url);
      const dataUri = resolved ? await assetDataUri(resolved, ctx) : null;
      if (dataUri) {
        changed = true;
        candidates.push(descriptor ? `${dataUri} ${descriptor}` : dataUri);
        continue;
      }
    }
    candidates.push(candidate);
  }
  return changed ? candidates.join(", ") : null;
}

async function makeHtmlSelfContained(
  htmlText: string,
  baseDirectory: string,
  depth: number,
  sharedCtx?: InlineContext,
): Promise<string | null> {
  const ctx: InlineContext = sharedCtx ?? { cache: new Map(), depth, budget: { remaining: MAX_INLINE_TOTAL_BYTES } };
  if (sharedCtx) ctx.depth = depth;
  let changed = false;
  let result = htmlText;

  // Tags first (before any stylesheet/script content is inlined below,
  // so inlined code is never mistaken for markup): src / poster / data /
  // href / srcset / style / background attributes pointing at local files.
  result = await replaceAsync(result, /<[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*\b[^>]*>/g, async (tag) => {
    if (/^<(link|script|style)\b/i.test(tag)) return tag;
    const tagNameMatch = /^<([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*)/.exec(tag);
    const tagName = tagNameMatch?.[1]?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
    let newTag = tag;
    let tagChanged = false;
    for (const attrName of ["src", "poster", "data"]) {
      const value = getAttrValue(newTag, attrName);
      if (!value || !isRelativeRef(value)) continue;
      const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, value);
      if (!resolved) continue;
      const dataUri = await assetDataUri(resolved, ctx);
      if (!dataUri) continue;
      newTag = replaceAttrValue(newTag, attrName, dataUri);
      tagChanged = true;
    }
    if (tagName === "a" || tagName === "area" || tagName === "image" || tagName === "use") {
      const value = getAttrValue(newTag, "href");
      if (value && isRelativeRef(value)) {
        const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, value);
        const dataUri = resolved ? await assetDataUri(resolved, ctx) : null;
        if (dataUri) {
          const fragment = (tagName === "use" || tagName === "image") ? refFragment(value) : "";
          newTag = replaceAttrValue(newTag, "href", `${dataUri}${fragment}`);
          tagChanged = true;
        }
      }
    }
    if (tagName === "meta") {
      const value = getAttrValue(newTag, "content");
      if (value && isRelativeRef(value) && /\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp|gif|svg|ico)$/i.test(refPathPart(value.trim()))) {
        const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, value);
        const dataUri = resolved ? await assetDataUri(resolved, ctx) : null;
        if (dataUri) {
          newTag = replaceAttrValue(newTag, "content", dataUri);
          tagChanged = true;
        }
      }
    }
    const srcset = getAttrValue(newTag, "srcset");
    if (srcset) {
      const processed = await processSrcset(srcset, baseDirectory, ctx);
      if (processed !== null) {
        newTag = replaceAttrValue(newTag, "srcset", processed);
        tagChanged = true;
      }
    }
    const styleValue = getAttrValue(newTag, "style");
    if (styleValue && /url\(/i.test(styleValue)) {
      const processed = await processCssText(styleValue, baseDirectory, ctx);
      if (processed !== null) {
        newTag = replaceAttrValue(newTag, "style", processed);
        tagChanged = true;
      }
    }
    const background = getAttrValue(newTag, "background");
    if (background && isRelativeRef(background)) {
      const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, background);
      const dataUri = resolved ? await assetDataUri(resolved, ctx) : null;
      if (dataUri) {
        newTag = replaceAttrValue(newTag, "background", dataUri);
        tagChanged = true;
      }
    }
    if (tagChanged) changed = true;
    return newTag;
  });


  // <style> blocks: resolve url(...) references inside them.
  result = await replaceAsync(result, /(<style\b[^>]*>)([\s\S]*?)(<\/style\s*>)/gi, async (full, open, css, close) => {
    const processed = await processCssText(css ?? "", baseDirectory, ctx);
    if (processed === null) return full;
    changed = true;
    return `${open ?? ""}${processed}${close ?? ""}`;
  });

  // <link> tags: stylesheets are inlined as <style>; other local links
  // (icons, preloads, …) become data URIs.
  result = await replaceAsync(result, /<link\b[^>]*>/gi, async (tag) => {
    const href = getAttrValue(tag, "href");
    if (!href || !isRelativeRef(href)) return tag;
    const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, href);
    if (!resolved) return tag;
    const rel = (getAttrValue(tag, "rel") ?? "").toLowerCase();
    if (rel.split(/\s+/).includes("stylesheet")) {
      const size = await existingFileSize(resolved);
      if (size === null || size > MAX_ASSET_BYTES) return tag;
      const css = (await readFile(resolved)).toString("utf8");
      const processed = (await processCssText(css, dirname(resolved), ctx)) ?? css;
      changed = true;
      return `<style>${processed}</style>`;
    }
    const dataUri = await assetDataUri(resolved, ctx);
    if (!dataUri) return tag;
    changed = true;
    return replaceAttrValue(tag, "href", dataUri);
  });

  // <script src="…">: inline the local script in place.
  result = await replaceAsync(result, /<script\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/script\s*>/gi, async (full, attrs) => {
    const attrText = attrs ?? "";
    const src = getAttrValue(attrText, "src");
    if (!src || !isRelativeRef(src)) return full;
    const resolved = resolveAssetPath(baseDirectory, src);
    if (!resolved) return full;
    const size = await existingFileSize(resolved);
    if (size === null || size > MAX_ASSET_BYTES || size > ctx.budget.remaining) return full;
    ctx.budget.remaining -= size;
    const js = (await readFile(resolved)).toString("utf8");
    changed = true;
    return `<script${removeAttr(attrText, "src")}>${js}</script>`;
  });

  return changed ? result : null;
}

async function metaFor(absolutePath: string, details: Stats): Promise<DeliverableMeta | null> {
  const extension = extname(absolutePath).toLowerCase();
  if (!ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) || !details.isFile()) return null;
  const isImage = IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension);
  const kind: DeliverableMeta["kind"] = isImage
    ? "image"
    : extension === ".md"
      ? "markdown"
      : extension === ".mp4"
        ? "video"
        : extension === ".html" || extension === ".pdf"
          ? "document"
          : "text";
  const contentType = extension === ".png"
    ? "image/png"
    : extension === ".jpg" || extension === ".jpeg"
      ? "image/jpeg"
      : extension === ".webp"
        ? "image/webp"
        : extension === ".mp4"
          ? "video/mp4"
          : extension === ".pdf"
            ? "application/pdf"
            : extension === ".html"
              ? "text/html; charset=utf-8"
              : "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
  let hasAlphaChannel: boolean | null = null;
  if (extension === ".png") {
    const header = await readFile(absolutePath);
    const validPng = header.length >= 26 && header.subarray(1, 4).toString("ascii") === "PNG";
    hasAlphaChannel = validPng ? header[25] === 4 || header[25] === 6 || header.indexOf(Buffer.from("tRNS")) >= 0 : false;
  }
  return {
    relativePath: relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, absolutePath).split(sep).join("/"),
    fileName: absolutePath.split(sep).at(-1) ?? "deliverable",
    kind,
    contentType,
    size: details.size,
    modifiedAt: details.mtime.toISOString(),
    hasAlphaChannel,
  };
}

type InspectResult = { files: DeliverableMeta[]; hidden: string[] };

// Walk a hint (a single file or a job folder) collecting admitted
// deliverables plus every file the walk deliberately skips. Skips are
// never silent: scanDeliverables reports their count so the review UI
// can say how many files in the folder aren't shown. The one exception
// is image-provenance.md/.txt — metadata parsed onto its image, hidden
// on purpose and never counted as "not shown".
async function inspectHintDetailed(relativeHint: string): Promise<InspectResult> {
  const absolute = safePath(relativeHint);
  const details = await stat(absolute);
  const files: DeliverableMeta[] = [];
  const hidden: string[] = [];
  const considerFile = async (childPath: string) => {
    const metadata = await metaFor(childPath, await stat(childPath));
    if (metadata) { files.push(metadata); return; }
    const name = childPath.split(sep).at(-1) ?? "";
    if (!isProvenanceFileName(name)) hidden.push(relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, childPath).split(sep).join("/"));
  };
  // Files nested deeper than one subfolder are not admitted, but they
  // still count as not shown rather than vanishing silently.
  const countDeepFiles = async (directory: string): Promise<void> => {
    let deepEntries: Dirent[];
    try {
      deepEntries = await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    for (const deepEntry of deepEntries) {
      const deepPath = join(directory, deepEntry.name);
      if (deepEntry.isFile()) {
        if (!isProvenanceFileName(deepEntry.name)) hidden.push(relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, deepPath).split(sep).join("/"));
      } else if (deepEntry.isDirectory()) {
        await countDeepFiles(deepPath);
      }
    }
  };
  if (details.isFile()) {
    await considerFile(absolute);
    return { files, hidden };
  }
  if (!details.isDirectory()) return { files, hidden };
  const entries = await readdir(absolute, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const childPath = join(absolute, entry.name);
    if (entry.isFile()) {
      await considerFile(childPath);
    } else if (entry.isDirectory() && entry.name !== ".superseded") {
      // One subfolder deep: files directly inside an immediate subfolder
      // (e.g. mockups/) are deliverables too.
      let subEntries: Dirent[];
      try {
        subEntries = await readdir(childPath, { withFileTypes: true });
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      for (const subEntry of subEntries) {
        const subPath = join(childPath, subEntry.name);
        if (subEntry.isFile()) {
          await considerFile(subPath);
        } else if (subEntry.isDirectory()) {
          await countDeepFiles(subPath);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Older jobs may have been reworked before targeted preservation existed.
  // Make their archived package files available to the server as fallbacks;
  // the action decides which latest non-superseded pieces to expose.
  // Archived files are a deliberate internal store: they are neither
  // admitted directly nor counted as "not shown".
  const archiveRoot = entries.find((entry) => entry.isDirectory() && entry.name === ".superseded");
  if (archiveRoot) {
    const archivePath = join(absolute, archiveRoot.name);
    for (const revision of await readdir(archivePath, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (!revision.isDirectory()) continue;
      const revisionPath = join(archivePath, revision.name);
      for (const entry of await readdir(revisionPath, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        if (!entry.isFile()) continue;
        const childPath = join(revisionPath, entry.name);
        const metadata = await metaFor(childPath, await stat(childPath));
        if (metadata) files.push(metadata);
      }
    }
  }
  return { files, hidden };
}

async function inspectHint(relativeHint: string): Promise<DeliverableMeta[]> {
  return (await inspectHintDetailed(relativeHint)).files;
}

export const privilegedHandlers = definePrivilegedHandlers(privileged, {
  async organizeDeliverables(args) {
    const safeTaskId = args.taskId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
    const jobDirectory = safePath(`jobs/${safeTaskId}`);
    await mkdir(jobDirectory, { recursive: true });
    const organized = new Set<string>();
    let missing = 0;
    for (const hint of args.relativeHints) {
      try {
        const files = await inspectHint(hint);
        for (const file of files) {
          if (organized.size >= MAX_FILES) break;
          const source = safePath(file.relativePath);
          const sourceRelative = relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, source).split(sep).join("/");
          if (sourceRelative.startsWith(`jobs/${safeTaskId}/`)) {
            organized.add(sourceRelative);
            continue;
          }
          const extension = extname(file.fileName);
          const stem = basename(file.fileName, extension).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_") || "deliverable";
          let fileName = `${stem}${extension}`;
          let destination = join(jobDirectory, fileName);
          let suffix = 2;
          while (true) {
            try {
              await stat(destination);
              fileName = `${stem}-${suffix}${extension}`;
              destination = join(jobDirectory, fileName);
              suffix += 1;
            } catch {
              break;
            }
          }
          await copyFile(source, destination);
          organized.add(relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, destination).split(sep).join("/"));
        }
      } catch {
        missing += 1;
      }
    }
    return { organizedPaths: Array.from(organized), missing };
  },

  async supersedeDeliverables(args) {
    const safeTaskId = args.taskId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
    const jobDirectory = safePath(`jobs/${safeTaskId}`);
    const preserved = new Set(args.preserveRelativePaths);
    const archiveRelative = `jobs/${safeTaskId}/.superseded/${Date.now()}`;
    const archiveDirectory = safePath(archiveRelative);
    let entries: Dirent[];
    try {
      entries = await readdir(jobDirectory, { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error && typeof error === "object" && "code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") return { archived: 0, archiveFolder: null };
      throw error;
    }
    let archived = 0;
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry.isFile() || !ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.has(extname(entry.name).toLowerCase())) continue;
      const source = join(jobDirectory, entry.name);
      const sourceRelative = relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, source).split(sep).join("/");
      if (preserved.has(sourceRelative)) continue;
      if (archived === 0) await mkdir(archiveDirectory, { recursive: true });
      await rename(source, join(archiveDirectory, entry.name));
      archived += 1;
    }
    return { archived, archiveFolder: archived ? archiveRelative : null };
  },

  async scanDeliverables(args) {
    const found = new Map<string, DeliverableMeta>();
    const hidden = new Set<string>();
    const missingHints: string[] = [];
    for (const hint of args.relativeHints) {
      try {
        const inspected = await inspectHintDetailed(hint);
        for (const file of inspected.files) {
          if (found.has(file.relativePath)) continue;
          // Files past the scan cap are skipped, and a skip is never
          // silent: they count toward the "aren't shown" number.
          if (found.size < MAX_FILES) found.set(file.relativePath, file);
          else hidden.add(file.relativePath);
        }
        for (const hiddenPath of inspected.hidden) hidden.add(hiddenPath);
      } catch {
        missingHints.push(hint);
      }
    }
    for (const shownPath of found.keys()) hidden.delete(shownPath);
    return {
      files: Array.from(found.values()).sort((left, right) => left.fileName.localeCompare(right.fileName)),
      missing: missingHints.length,
      missingHints,
      hiddenCount: hidden.size,
    };
  },

  // Skill pool: ~/workspace/ai-office/skill-pool/<skill-name>/SKILL.md, one
  // folder per skill, plain files Ben owns. This handler builds ONLY the
  // one-line-per-skill index (folder name + the file's "Use when:" trigger
  // line + path). Full skill text is never returned here — workers read the
  // SKILL.md themselves, and only when a trigger matches their job
  // (progressive disclosure). Dropping a new folder into the pool is enough
  // for it to appear in the index; no code change is involved. The pool is
  // read-only for the office: this is the only pool handler and it reads.
  async listSkillPool() {
    const poolDirectory = safePath("skill-pool");
    let entries: Dirent[];
    try {
      entries = await readdir(poolDirectory, { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error && typeof error === "object" && "code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") return { entries: [] };
      throw error;
    }
    const index: Array<{ name: string; trigger: string; relativePath: string }> = [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
      const name = entry.name;
      if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]*$/i.test(name)) continue;
      let text: string;
      try {
        text = await readFile(join(poolDirectory, name, "SKILL.md"), "utf8");
      } catch {
        continue; // A folder without a readable SKILL.md is not a skill yet.
      }
      const triggerMatch = /^[ \t]*Use when:[ \t]*(.+)$/im.exec(text);
      const trigger = triggerMatch?.[1]?.trim()
        ?? text.split("\n").map((line) => line.replace(/^#+\s*/, "").trim()).find((line) => line.length > 0)
        ?? "No trigger line in SKILL.md.";
      index.push({ name, trigger: trigger.slice(0, 300), relativePath: `skill-pool/${name}/SKILL.md` });
    }
    index.sort((left, right) => left.name.localeCompare(right.name));
    return { entries: index };
  },

  async storeBriefingAttachment(args) {
    const safeSessionId = args.sessionId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
    const directory = safePath(`briefing-uploads/${safeSessionId}`);
    await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
    const extension = extname(args.fileName).toLowerCase();
    const stem = basename(args.fileName, extension).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_").replace(/^_+/, "") || "attachment";
    let fileName = `${stem}${extension}`;
    let destination = join(directory, fileName);
    let suffix = 2;
    while (true) {
      try {
        await stat(destination);
        fileName = `${stem}-${suffix}${extension}`;
        destination = join(directory, fileName);
        suffix += 1;
      } catch {
        break;
      }
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.from(args.dataBase64, "base64");
    await writeFile(destination, bytes);
    return { relativePath: relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, destination).split(sep).join("/"), size: bytes.length };
  },

  async copyBriefingAttachmentsToJob(args) {
    const safeTaskId = args.taskId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
    const jobDirectory = safePath(`jobs/${safeTaskId}`);
    await mkdir(jobDirectory, { recursive: true });
    const copiedPaths: string[] = [];
    let missing = 0;
    for (const relativePath of args.relativePaths) {
      try {
        const source = safePath(relativePath);
        const details = await stat(source);
        if (!details.isFile()) { missing += 1; continue; }
        const originalName = basename(source);
        let fileName = originalName;
        let destination = join(jobDirectory, fileName);
        let suffix = 2;
        while (true) {
          try {
            await stat(destination);
            const extension = extname(originalName);
            fileName = `${basename(originalName, extension)}-${suffix}${extension}`;
            destination = join(jobDirectory, fileName);
            suffix += 1;
          } catch {
            break;
          }
        }
        await copyFile(source, destination);
        copiedPaths.push(relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, destination).split(sep).join("/"));
      } catch {
        missing += 1;
      }
    }
    return { copiedPaths, missing };
  },

  async writeLabVerification(args) {
    const safeTaskId = args.taskId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
    const jobDirectory = safePath(`jobs/${safeTaskId}`);
    await mkdir(jobDirectory, { recursive: true });
    const destination = join(jobDirectory, "lab-verification.md");
    await writeFile(destination, args.text, "utf8");
    return { relativePath: relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, destination).split(sep).join("/") };
  },

  async appendOfficePotNote(args) {
    const potPath = safePath("office-pot.md");
    let existing = "";
    try {
      existing = await readFile(potPath, "utf8");
    } catch {
      existing = "";
    }
    if (existing.includes(args.marker)) return { posted: false };
    const entry = `${args.entry.trim()}\n<!-- ${args.marker} -->\n`;
    let next: string;
    if (!existing) {
      next = `# THE OFFICE POT\n\n## Department notes (post what the other floors need; sign and date)\n${entry}`;
    } else if (/^## Department notes/im.test(existing)) {
      // Department notes is the pot's closing section: the entry lands
      // at the end of the file, inside that section.
      next = `${existing.replace(/\s+$/, "")}\n${entry}`;
    } else {
      next = `${existing.replace(/\s+$/, "")}\n\n## Department notes (post what the other floors need; sign and date)\n${entry}`;
    }
    await writeFile(potPath, next, "utf8");
    return { posted: true };
  },

  async writeClaimGateFile(args) {
    const safeTaskId = args.taskId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
    const jobDirectory = safePath(`jobs/${safeTaskId}`);
    await mkdir(jobDirectory, { recursive: true });
    const destination = join(jobDirectory, args.fileName);
    await writeFile(destination, args.text, "utf8");
    return { relativePath: relative(DELIVERABLE_ROOT, destination).split(sep).join("/") };
  },

  async deleteDeliverableFiles(args) {
    let deleted = 0;
    for (const relativePath of args.relativePaths) {
      const absolute = safePath(relativePath);
      if (!IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.has(extname(absolute).toLowerCase())) {
        throw new Error("Only image deliverables can be deleted this way.");
      }
      try {
        await unlink(absolute);
        deleted += 1;
      } catch (error) {
        if (error && typeof error === "object" && "code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") {
          deleted += 1;
          continue;
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }
    return { deleted };
  },

  async deleteJobFolder(args) {
    const safeTaskId = args.taskId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");
    const jobDirectory = safePath(`jobs/${safeTaskId}`);
    let deletedFiles = 0;
    const countFiles = async (directory: string): Promise<void> => {
      let entries: Dirent[];
      try {
        entries = await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
      } catch {
        return;
      }
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (entry.isDirectory()) await countFiles(join(directory, entry.name));
        else deletedFiles += 1;
      }
    };
    await countFiles(jobDirectory);
    await rm(jobDirectory, { recursive: true, force: true });
    return { deletedFiles };
  },

  async readDeliverable(args): Promise<z.infer<typeof deliverableContent>> {
    const absolute = safePath(args.relativePath);
    const details = await stat(absolute);
    const metadata = await metaFor(absolute, details);
    if (!metadata) throw new Error("This file type cannot be shown in AI Office.");
    const limit = metadata.kind === "image"
      ? MAX_IMAGE_BYTES
      : metadata.kind === "document" || metadata.kind === "video"
        ? MAX_FILE_BYTES
        : MAX_TEXT_BYTES;
    if (details.size > limit) throw new Error("This deliverable is too large to preview.");
    const bytes = await readFile(absolute);
    // HTML deliverables are served SELF-CONTAINED: relative references to
    // sibling files in the job folder are inlined at serve time (see
    // makeHtmlSelfContained) so the page renders complete wherever its
    // blob/Open link is opened. The stored file is never modified, and a
    // page with no resolvable relative references is served byte-identical.
    if (metadata.kind === "document" && /\.html?$/i.test(metadata.fileName)) {
      try {
        const selfContained = await makeHtmlSelfContained(bytes.toString("utf8"), dirname(absolute), 0);
        if (selfContained !== null) {
          const outBytes = Buffer.from(selfContained, "utf8");
          return { ...metadata, size: outBytes.length, dataBase64: outBytes.toString("base64"), text: null };
        }
      } catch { /* Serve the stored page as-is rather than fail the preview. */ }
    }
    // Documents and media (HTML pages, PDFs, videos) travel as bytes so
    // the client can offer the actual file for opening/download — raw
    // HTML is never handed over as renderable text.
    return metadata.kind === "image" || metadata.kind === "document" || metadata.kind === "video"
      ? { ...metadata, dataBase64: bytes.toString("base64"), text: null }
      : { ...metadata, dataBase64: null, text: bytes.toString("utf8") };
  },
});

// Every avatar circle in the app goes through here: when the member's own
// sprite sheet has a front-facing frame, the circle shows that face (see
// MemberPortrait in office-map); a member whose sheet has no clean front
// frame keeps the initial-letter circle — that member only.
function MemberAvatar({ member, large = false }: { member: Member; large?: boolean }) {
  const hasPortrait = hasMemberPortrait(member.id);
  return <span className={`avatar${large ? " large" : ""}${hasPortrait ? " has-portrait" : ""}`} style={{ background: member.color }}>{hasPortrait ? <MemberPortrait memberId={member.id} /> : member.name[0]}</span>;
}

export type WatchdogEvent = { id: number; memberId: MemberId };
export function watchdogEventFor(entry: OfficeLogEntry | undefined): WatchdogEvent | undefined {
  if (!entry || !entry.text.includes("stalled with no progress")) return undefined;
  if (Date.now() - new Date(entry.t).getTime() > 2 * 60_000) return undefined;
  const member = MEMBERS.find((candidate) => entry.text.startsWith(`${candidate.name}'s`));
  return member ? { id: entry.id, memberId: member.id } : undefined;
}

function formatStamp(value: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }).format(new Date(value));
}

// Ready for You "waiting since" stamp, in plain local words: "Today
// 2:41 PM", "Yesterday 9:03 AM", or "Oct 14, 6:22 PM" for anything older
// (with the year added when it is not this year, so it stays unambiguous).
function formatWaitingStamp(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  const time = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }).format(date);
  const startOfDay = (day: Date) => new Date(day.getFullYear(), day.getMonth(), day.getDate()).getTime();
  const dayDiff = Math.round((startOfDay(new Date()) - startOfDay(date)) / 86_400_000);
  if (dayDiff === 0) return `Today ${time}`;
  if (dayDiff === 1) return `Yesterday ${time}`;
  const datePart = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", ...(date.getFullYear() !== new Date().getFullYear() ? { year: "numeric" as const } : {}) }).format(date);
  return `${datePart}, ${time}`;
}

// When a job started waiting on Ben. Tasks carry no entered-approval
// timestamp of their own, so this uses the closest honest field that is
// stored: the last update of the job's current crew steps. Every path
// that puts a job in front of Ben — the final step finishing or failing,
// a blocker being reported, the stall watchdog surfacing a stuck job —
// stamps that step's updatedAt in the same server write that flips the
// job to waiting, and nothing updates those steps while the job waits.
// Falls back to the earliest open blocker's creation time, then to the
// job's own creation time, when a job has no step record at all.
function waitingSinceForTask(task: Task, briefs: Brief[], blockers: Blocker[]): string {
  let latest = 0;
  for (const brief of briefs) {
    if (brief.taskId !== task.id) continue;
    const time = new Date(brief.updatedAt).getTime();
    if (time > latest) latest = time;
  }
  if (latest > 0) return new Date(latest).toISOString();
  let earliest = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for (const blocker of blockers) {
    if (blocker.taskId !== task.id) continue;
    const time = new Date(blocker.createdAt).getTime();
    if (time < earliest) earliest = time;
  }
  if (earliest !== Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) return new Date(earliest).toISOString();
  return task.created;
}

function isMerchTask(task: Pick<Task, "title" | "notes" | "pipeline">): boolean {
  // One shared definition lives in server/src/shared (isMerchTaskLike) —
  // the server classifies with the same function, not a copy.
  return isMerchTaskLike(task);
}

// Ben's combined Deliverables flow for publishable post packages: Ready
// for You is only the decision queue. Once he approves a Perfectly
// Paranoid / social package it lives in Deliverables, pinned under
// "To post", until he marks it posted — it then moves down into the
// Deliverables Library with a Posted badge instead of disappearing.
// Approved packages never count as waiting and never hold a huddle.
function isPublishablePostTask(task: Pick<Task, "pipeline">): boolean {
  return task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid";
}

function isApprovedPackage(task: Pick<Task, "pipeline" | "status" | "publicationStatus" | "clientId">): boolean {
  // EXIT RULE: a post job tagged to an EXTERNAL client never appears in
  // Deliverables → To post — it exits only through its client's delivery
  // package. Untagged post packages wait under To post — and so do
  // Perfectly Paranoid posts (Ben's routing change, 2026-10-16): PP is
  // house content, so its posts take the To post state exactly like
  // untagged posts and never form a delivery package.
  return isPublishablePostTask(task)
    && (!task.clientId || task.clientId === PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID)
    && task.status === "approval"
    && (task.publicationStatus === "awaiting_manual_publish" || task.publicationStatus === "approved_posting" || task.publicationStatus === "preparing_upload");
}

// A package Ben has marked posted: the job record is Done and the package
// itself stays in the Deliverables Library, badged Posted. Older approved
// packages that closed as Done before manual posting was tracked carry no
// posted marker at all — they are Library packages, never badged Posted.
function isPostedPackage(task: Pick<Task, "publicationStatus" | "postedAt">): boolean {
  return Boolean(task.postedAt) || task.publicationStatus === "posted";
}

// Library membership follows the approval, not the finalized-review flag:
// a job belongs in the Library when it carries Ben's approval stamp
// (approvedAt, or a posted marker from the To post flow), even when its
// deliverableReviewFinalizedAt timestamp is missing (older/inconsistent
// records). Outputs from unapproved, working, or still-undecided jobs
// never appear — a job that merely finished (a standing-order run, an
// auto-closed step) without his approval is history, not a deliverable.
function isLibraryTask(task: Pick<Task, "pipeline" | "status" | "publicationStatus" | "approvedAt" | "postedAt" | "clientId">): boolean {
  if (isApprovedPackage(task)) return false;
  if (task.status === "working") return false;
  // POSTED-POST SELF-CLEAR (Ben, 2026-10-16): a post marked posted more
  // than 24 hours ago removes itself from the Deliverables post tiles —
  // the queue keeps itself clean. The job itself is untouched: it stays
  // in Done history with its files and provenance, it only leaves the
  // tile surfaces. A posted post still inside its 24 hours stays, with
  // its "posted · clears in ~Xh" note on the tile.
  if (isPublishablePostTask(task) && isPostedPackage(task) && isPostSelfCleared(task.postedAt)) return false;
  // RESEARCH + CLIENT EXIT: a research case tagged to an EXTERNAL client
  // exits only through its client's delivery package in Deliverables —
  // it does not also sit in the Deliverables Library. Untagged research
  // briefs land in the Library exactly as before, and so do Perfectly
  // Paranoid cases (house content, no package).
  if (task.pipeline === "research_case" && task.clientId && task.clientId !== PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID) return false;
  return task.approvedAt !== null || isPostedPackage(task);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// READY FOR YOU — THE MEMBERSHIP RULE (Ben, 2026-10-18). Ready for You
// means exactly one thing: "this needs Ben's decision." A job belongs
// there ONLY if it is (a) a finished manual-job result awaiting his
// approval, or (b) a job with a genuine open blocker addressed to him.
// Everything else has its own home and can never appear here:
//   · standing-order runs — creating the order was the approval; every
//     run finishes straight to Done (the server routes them there and
//     sweeps any stranded run out of approval in poll_dispatch, and a
//     migration re-homed the runs that were already stranded);
//   · already-approved post packages — they live in Deliverables,
//     under To post, until they are marked posted;
//   · finished jobs for an external client — the lifecycle routes
//     them to their client's delivery package in Deliverables (the
//     package is the decision item); they never surface loose here.
//     The exception is a job stuck on its outcome-contract check,
//     which cannot be packaged and surfaces as a stuck item;
//   · lab sub-cases and package-assembly jobs — internal work, hidden
//     by the shell before this rule ever sees them.
// This predicate is the ONE definition every Ready for You surface
// (Flow, the Work panel, the desktop review view, the counts on the
// floor) reads — the rule lives here, not in per-surface filters.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function isReadyForYouTask(task: Task, blockedTaskIds: ReadonlySet<string>): boolean {
  if (task.standingOrderId) return false;
  // Internal package-assembly jobs never surface: their decision item
  // is the delivery package in Deliverables, not the assembly job.
  if (task.pipeline === "client_delivery") return false;
  if (blockedTaskIds.has(task.id)) return true;
  if (task.status !== "approval" || isApprovedPackage(task)) return false;
  // CLIENT ROUTE, mirrored from the lifecycle gate: a finished job for
  // an external client is decided on its delivery package in
  // Deliverables, never loose here. The one exception is a job stuck
  // on its outcome-contract check — it cannot be packaged, so it
  // surfaces here as a stuck item for a rework/delete decision.
  // (Perfectly Paranoid is house content: Ben is its client, so its
  // jobs take the manual route and DO surface here.)
  if (task.clientId && task.clientId !== PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID && !isBounceExhausted(task.contractStatus, task.contractBounces)) return false;
  return true;
}

// Ready for You presents what client-tagged work does surface — house
// content (Perfectly Paranoid, whose client is Ben) and contract-stuck
// jobs — grouped under its client, one headed group per client,
// instead of scattered lookalike cards mixed in with everyone else's.
// (Finished work for external clients does not surface here at all:
// the lifecycle routes it to the client's delivery package.) Untagged
// work and blocker items keep their own plain groups. Groups are
// ordered: answers needed first (a person is stuck waiting), then
// clients by name, then everything else; inside a group, the
// longest-waiting item comes first.
type ReadyGroup = { key: string; clientId: string | null; clientName: string | null; needsAnswer: boolean; tasks: Task[] };
function groupReadyTasks(tasks: Task[], clients: Client[], blockedTaskIds: ReadonlySet<string>, waitingSinceOf: (task: Task) => string): ReadyGroup[] {
  const byWaiting = (a: Task, b: Task) => new Date(waitingSinceOf(a)).getTime() - new Date(waitingSinceOf(b)).getTime();
  const answerTasks = tasks.filter((task) => blockedTaskIds.has(task.id)).sort(byWaiting);
  const rest = tasks.filter((task) => !blockedTaskIds.has(task.id));
  const groups: ReadyGroup[] = [];
  if (answerTasks.length) groups.push({ key: "needs-answer", clientId: null, clientName: null, needsAnswer: true, tasks: answerTasks });
  const clientIds = [...new Set(rest.flatMap((task) => (task.clientId ? [task.clientId] : [])))].sort((a, b) => (clients.find((client) => client.id === a)?.businessName ?? "").localeCompare(clients.find((client) => client.id === b)?.businessName ?? ""));
  for (const clientId of clientIds) {
    const clientTasks = rest.filter((task) => task.clientId === clientId).sort(byWaiting);
    if (clientTasks.length) groups.push({ key: `client-${clientId}`, clientId, clientName: clients.find((client) => client.id === clientId)?.businessName ?? "Client", needsAnswer: false, tasks: clientTasks });
  }
  const untagged = rest.filter((task) => !task.clientId).sort(byWaiting);
  if (untagged.length) groups.push({ key: "other", clientId: null, clientName: null, needsAnswer: false, tasks: untagged });
  return groups;
}

function readyGroupHeading(group: ReadyGroup): string {
  if (group.needsAnswer) return "Needs your answer";
  if (group.clientName) return `For ${group.clientName}`;
  return "Finished work";
}

function readyGroupSub(group: ReadyGroup): string {
  const count = group.tasks.length;
  if (group.needsAnswer) return count === 1 ? "The crew is stuck on one question — your answer restarts the job." : `The crew is stuck on ${count} questions — each answer restarts its job.`;
  if (group.clientId === PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID) return "House content — Ben is this client. Approving a finished post sends it to Deliverables, under To post; reports land in the Deliverables Library.";
  if (group.clientName) return "Finished work for this client is decided on its delivery package in Deliverables — it never waits loose here. What sits here is stuck and needs your call: send it back for rework, or delete it.";
  return count === 1 ? "One finished job waiting on your decision." : `${count} finished jobs waiting on your decision.`;
}

const FLOW_ESCAPED_SESSION_KEY = "pulse-hq:flow-escaped";

function hasEscapedFlowThisSession(): boolean {
  try {
    return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.sessionStorage.getItem(FLOW_ESCAPED_SESSION_KEY) === "1";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function shouldOpenInFlow(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  // The "← Office" escape holds for the rest of this session only:
  // sessionStorage is cleared when the session ends, so a later fresh
  // open on the phone returns to Flow again.
  if (hasEscapedFlowThisSession()) return false;
  // Additional trigger where query strings survive (e.g. a bookmarked
  // ?view=flow link opened in a plain browser).
  try {
    if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("view") === "flow") return true;
  } catch {
    // Fall through to the width check below.
  }
  // Primary trigger inside the Muse client, where query strings do not
  // reach the app: a phone-sized viewport opens directly into Flow.
  return window.innerWidth <= 700;
}

export function App() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  // Flow companion view (Ben, 2026-10-15): a map-free, mobile-first page
  // over the SAME live office data and actions — Ready for You, Working,
  // Deliverables, Clients, Post Queue. On a phone-sized viewport (<= 700px)
  // it opens automatically on load — no link parameters needed, because
  // ?view=flow does not survive opening through the Muse client.
  // ?view=flow stays as an additional trigger where query strings do
  // survive. Desktop (> 700px) is unchanged: it opens on the office map
  // and there is deliberately NO entry point to Flow anywhere in the
  // office UI — no pill, no button, no menu item, no link. Do not add
  // one. Inside Flow itself the "← Office" escape is the way back; it
  // switches to the office for the rest of this session only.
  const [isFlowView, setIsFlowView] = useState<boolean>(shouldOpenInFlow);
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);

  const [sendBackCandidate, setSendBackCandidate] = useState<Task | null>(null);
  const [approvedTask, setApprovedTask] = useState<Task | null>(null);
  const [showNewTask, setShowNewTask] = useState(false);
  // Phase 3, Stage B — the ACTIVE CLIENT. Clicking a client in the Clients
  // tab sets this; the selection lives here in the app shell so it persists
  // while Ben moves between views, tabs, and floors. It scopes ONLY the
  // Clients-area detail/inventory and the Deliverables Library (both fed
  // by a scoped get_state read below). Every other surface — Ready for
  // You, the three floors, the Work panel boards, standing orders, the
  // office log, Deliverables "To post" — keeps reading the global state
  // and stays cross-client at all times (Stage C).
  const [activeClientId, setActiveClientId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [showNewOrder, setShowNewOrder] = useState(false);

  const [answeringBlocker, setAnsweringBlocker] = useState<Blocker | null>(null);
  // A blocker-answer failure must be visible INSIDE the answer sheet.
  // It used to be toast-only — and the toast renders at z-index 60 while
  // the sheet sits far above it, so a rejected answer looked exactly
  // like a hang: the button flipped back, the sheet stayed open, and no
  // reason ever appeared on screen.
  const [blockerSubmitError, setBlockerSubmitError] = useState("");
  const [toast, setToast] = useState("");
  const [inboxCheckMessage, setInboxCheckMessage] = useState("");
  const [clock, setClock] = useState(new Date());
  const [inboxArrival, setInboxArrival] = useState<InboxArrival | null>(null);
  const [floorOverlayHost, setFloorOverlayHost] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  // Establishing shot: Ben's exterior of the Pulse HQ building plays once on
  // initial load, then fades into the office. It never replays on floor
  // switches or panel/tab changes — this state lives for the page session
  // only and is never reset after it finishes.
  // Choreography (Ben, 2026-10-13): HOLD 2s with the full frame sitting
  // completely still at scale 1.0 → ZOOM 3s slow push-in to the ending
  // scale → the existing fade into the office. The intro clock starts only
  // once the exterior image has actually loaded, so a slow asset load can
  // never eat into the hold or leave Ben catching the tail end of the zoom.
  // Framing: the sharp exterior is contain-fitted so the ENTIRE image
  // (building + yard) is visible in any viewport shape, over a blurred,
  // darkened cover echo of the same image — no cover-crop, no black bars.
  const [introPhase, setIntroPhase] = useState<"showing" | "zooming" | "leaving" | "done">("showing");
  const [introReady, setIntroReady] = useState(false);
  const introStartedRef = useRef(false);
  const introTimersRef = useRef<number[]>([]);
  const startIntro = useCallback(() => {
    if (introStartedRef.current) return;
    introStartedRef.current = true;
    introTimersRef.current = [
      // End of the 2s hold: the push-in begins (CSS animation runs 3s).
      window.setTimeout(() => setIntroPhase((phase) => (phase === "showing" ? "zooming" : phase)), 2000),
      // End of the 3s zoom: begin the fade into the office.
      window.setTimeout(() => setIntroPhase((phase) => (phase === "zooming" ? "leaving" : phase)), 5000),
      // Fade is .75s, matching the previous build's timing.
      window.setTimeout(() => setIntroPhase("done"), 5750),
    ];
  }, []);
  const skipIntro = useCallback(() => {
    introTimersRef.current.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
    introTimersRef.current = [];
    setIntroPhase("done");
  }, []);
  const markIntroImageLoaded = useCallback(() => {
    setIntroReady(true);
    startIntro();
  }, [startIntro]);
  const introImgRef = useCallback((img: HTMLImageElement | null) => {
    // A cached image can finish loading before React's onLoad is wired up;
    // if it is already complete when the element mounts, start the clock.
    if (img && img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) markIntroImageLoaded();
  }, [markIntroImageLoaded]);
  const seenTaskIds = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);
  const seenBriefIds = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);

  const state = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["office-state"],
    queryFn: () => api.get_state({}),
    refetchInterval: 5000,
  });

  // Phase 3, Stage B — the scoped read. It runs ONLY while a client is
  // active and feeds ONLY the scoped surfaces (the active client's
  // Clients-area detail/inventory and the Deliverables Library). The
  // global query above remains the one source for everything else, so
  // no cross-client surface can be starved by this read (Stage C).
  const scopedState = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["office-state", "scoped", activeClientId],
    queryFn: () => api.get_state({ clientId: activeClientId ?? undefined }),
    enabled: Boolean(activeClientId),
    refetchInterval: activeClientId ? 5000 : false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const latest = state.data;
    if (!latest) return;

    if (!seenTaskIds.current || !seenBriefIds.current) {
      seenTaskIds.current = new Set(latest.tasks.map((task) => task.id));
      seenBriefIds.current = new Set(latest.briefs.map((brief) => brief.id));
      return;
    }

    const newBriefs = latest.briefs.filter((brief) => !seenBriefIds.current?.has(brief.id));
    const visibleArrivalBriefs = newBriefs.filter((brief) => {
      const task = latest.tasks.find((item) => item.id === brief.taskId);
      return brief.stepIndex === 0 && !task?.standingOrderId;
    });
    const briefTaskIds = new Set(newBriefs.map((brief) => brief.taskId));
    const newTasks = latest.tasks.filter((task) => !seenTaskIds.current?.has(task.id) && !briefTaskIds.has(task.id) && !task.standingOrderId);
    latest.tasks.forEach((task) => seenTaskIds.current?.add(task.id));
    latest.briefs.forEach((brief) => seenBriefIds.current?.add(brief.id));

    const newestBrief = visibleArrivalBriefs[0];
    const newestTask = newTasks[0];
    const arrival = newestBrief
      ? { id: `brief:${newestBrief.id}`, assignee: newestBrief.assignee, title: newestBrief.title }
      : newestTask
        ? { id: `task:${newestTask.id}`, assignee: newestTask.assignee, title: newestTask.title }
        : undefined;
    if (!arrival) return;
    setInboxArrival({
      id: arrival.id,
      // Walter, Peter, Olivia, and Astrid work on the research floor; Tom,
      // head of research in both departments, is the one who checks the
      // main-office inbox for them.
      memberId: arrival.assignee === "walter" || arrival.assignee === "peter" || arrival.assignee === "olivia" || arrival.assignee === "astrid" ? "scout" : memberById(arrival.assignee)?.id ?? "remmy",
      title: arrival.title,
    });
  }, [state.data]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setClock(new Date()), 30000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    // Any keypress skips straight inside, in every phase (including the
    // hold and even before the image has loaded); pointer skips are handled
    // by the overlay itself. The hold/zoom/fade timers are started by
    // markIntroImageLoaded once the exterior image is on screen.
    const skipOnKey = () => skipIntro();
    window.addEventListener("keydown", skipOnKey);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", skipOnKey);
      introTimersRef.current.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
      introTimersRef.current = [];
    };
  }, [skipIntro]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!toast) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setToast(""), 3200);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [toast]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inboxCheckMessage) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setInboxCheckMessage(""), 5000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [inboxCheckMessage]);
  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.classList.toggle("sheet-open", Boolean(workPanelOpen || flowReadyExpanded || selectedMember || remmyChatOpen || selectedTask || deleteCandidate || sendBackCandidate || approvedTask || showNewTask || presetSheet || startingPreset || deletePresetCandidate || showNewOrder || showContentPipeline || showRegionEditor || editingBrief || editingOrder || answeringBlocker || drawerOpen || clientSheet || deleteClientCandidate || packageReworkCandidate));
    return () => document.body.classList.remove("sheet-open");
  }, [workPanelOpen, flowReadyExpanded, selectedMember, remmyChatOpen, selectedTask, deleteCandidate, sendBackCandidate, approvedTask, showNewTask, presetSheet, startingPreset, deletePresetCandidate, showNewOrder, showContentPipeline, showRegionEditor, editingBrief, editingOrder, answeringBlocker, drawerOpen, clientSheet, deleteClientCandidate, packageReworkCandidate]);

  const refresh = async () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["office-state"] });
  const setTaskStatus = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { id: string; status: TaskStatus }) => api.set_task_status(input),
    onSuccess: async (result, input) => {
      if (!result.ok) {
        setToast(result.error);
      } else if (input.status === "done") {
        const task = state.data?.tasks.find((item) => item.id === input.id);
        if (task && isPublishablePostTask(task) && (!task.clientId || task.clientId === PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID)) {
          // Approved post jobs move to Deliverables, under To post —
          // untagged ones and Perfectly Paranoid ones alike (PP posts
          // are house content, never a delivery package). Ben copies
          // the post and image from there, not from the decision queue.
          setToast("Approved — it's in Deliverables now, under To post. Copy the post and image from there.");
        } else {
          if (task) setApprovedTask(task);
          // A post job tagged to an EXTERNAL client closes like every
          // other external client job: Maria assembles its delivery
          // package for Deliverables — it never goes to To post. An
          // external client-tagged research case follows the same exit
          // rule: package in Deliverables. Perfectly Paranoid's other
          // work (its reports included) simply closes as a plain
          // deliverable — no package.
          setToast(task && task.clientId && task.clientId !== PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID
            ? "Approved — the job is done. Maria is assembling its delivery package — you will decide on it in Deliverables."
            : "Approved — the job is done.");
        }
      }
      await refresh();
      setSelectedTask(null);
    },
  });
  const markTaskPosted = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (taskId: string) => api.mark_task_posted({ id: taskId }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {

"Client report started — Maria is compiling the client's work from office records; you approve it before it goes to their delivery package." : owner === "Remmy" ? "Work sent to Remmy." : `Remmy assigned this to ${owner}.`);
