      await refresh();
    },
    onError: () => setToast("That report could not be started. Try again."),
  });
  const draftCaseStudy = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (packageId: string) => api.draft_case_study({ packageId }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      setToast(result.ok ? "Case study started — Johnny is drafting it as a normal job, and you'll approve it the usual way." : result.error);
      await refresh();
    },
    onError: () => setToast("That case study could not be started. Try again."),
  });
  const requestStartPreset = (preset: Preset) => {
    if (preset.fillInLabel) {
      setStartingPreset(preset);
    } else {
      startPreset.mutate({ id: preset.id });
    }
  };
  const startContentPipeline = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { angle: string; clientId?: string | null }) => api.start_perfectly_paranoid_pipeline(input),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      setToast(result.ok ? "Remmy divided the story job. The crew will run every step automatically, then wait for your one decision." : result.error);
      if (result.ok) {
        setShowContentPipeline(false);
        setWorkPanelOpen(true);
      }
      await refresh();
    },
  });
  const sendBackTask = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { id: string; feedback: string; target: ReworkTarget; assigneeId: "scout" | "forge" | "quill" | "ledger" }) => api.send_back_task(input),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      if (!result.ok) { setToast(result.error); return; }
      setSendBackCandidate(null);
      setSelectedTask(null);
      setToast(`Sent back to ${result.workerName} with your feedback.`);
      await queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: ["task-deliverables", result.brief.taskId] });
      await refresh();
    },
  });
  const deleteTask = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => api.delete_task({ id }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      if (!result.ok) { setToast(result.error); return; }
      setDeleteCandidate(null); setSelectedTask(null); setToast("Task removed."); await refresh();
    },
  });
  const createOrder = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { instruction: string; assigneeId: MemberId; mode: "scheduled" | "pipeline"; cadence?: "daily" | "weekly"; weekday?: number; targetCount?: number }) => api.create_standing_order(input),
    onSuccess: async (result) => { setToast(result.ok ? "Standing order armed." : result.error); if (result.ok) setShowNewOrder(false); await refresh(); },
  });
  const toggleOrder = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { id: string; enabled: boolean }) => api.set_standing_order_enabled(input),
    onSuccess: async (result) => { if (!result.ok) setToast(result.error); await refresh(); },
  });
  const deleteOrder = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => api.delete_standing_order({ id }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => { setToast(result.ok ? "Standing order deleted." : result.error); await refresh(); },
  });
  const updateOrder = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { id: string; instruction: string }) => api.update_standing_order(input),
    onSuccess: async (result) => { setToast(result.ok ? "Standing order saved — future runs use the new text." : result.error); if (result.ok) setEditingOrder(null); await refresh(); },
  });
  const runOliviaBatch = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.run_olivia_batch_now({}),
    onSuccess: async (result) => { setToast(result.ok ? "Olivia's batch is running — drafted from her standing order." : result.error); await refresh(); },
  });
  const updateBrief = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { id: string; title: string; notes: string; assigneeId: BriefAssigneeId }) => api.update_queued_brief(input),
    onSuccess: async (result) => { setToast(result.ok ? "Queued brief updated." : result.error); if (result.ok) setEditingBrief(null); await refresh(); },
  });
  const cancelBrief = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => api.cancel_queued_brief({ id }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => { setToast(result.ok ? "Queued brief cancelled." : result.error); await refresh(); },
  });
  const resolveBlocker = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { id: string; answer: string }) => api.resolve_blocker(input),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      if (!result.ok) { setBlockerSubmitError(result.error); return; }
      setBlockerSubmitError(""); setToast("Decision accepted — the brief is resuming."); setAnsweringBlocker(null); await refresh();
    },
    onError: () => setBlockerSubmitError("Your answer didn't go through — nothing was sent. Check your connection and tap Send again."),
  });
  const verifyBlocker = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => api.verify_blocker({ id }),
    onSuccess: async (result) => {
      if (!result.ok) { setBlockerSubmitError(result.error); return; }
      setBlockerSubmitError(""); setToast("Browser action confirmed — the blocked step is queued to resume."); setAnsweringBlocker(null); await refresh();
    },
    onError: () => setBlockerSubmitError("The resume didn't go through — nothing was sent. Tap the button again."),
  });

  const tasks = state.data?.tasks ?? [];
  // Lab sub-cases (Tom's one-per-job escalation to the Research Department)
  // are internal: they never appear as jobs of their own — not in Ready
  // for You, not in Working, not in history. The parent job carries the
  // passive note instead.
  const labSubcaseIds = new Set(tasks.flatMap((task) => (task.escalationSubtaskId ? [task.escalationSubtaskId] : [])));
  const visibleTasks = tasks.filter((task) => !labSubcaseIds.has(task.id));
  const briefs = state.data?.briefs ?? [];
  const clients = state.data?.clients ?? [];
  const packages = state.data?.packages ?? [];
  const ledgerEntries = state.data?.ledger ?? [];
  const outreachContacts = state.data?.outreach ?? [];
  const openReportTaskClientIds = new Set(tasks.flatMap((task) => (task.pipeline === "client_report" && task.status === "working" && task.clientId ? [task.clientId] : [])));
  const standingOrders = state.data?.standingOrders ?? [];
  const blockers = state.data?.blockers ?? [];
  const handoffs = state.data?.handoffs ?? [];
  const ideas = state.data?.ideas ?? [];
  const stories = state.data?.stories ?? [];
  const xPosts = state.data?.xPosts ?? [];
  const presets = state.data?.presets ?? [];
  const unreadIdeaHunts = new Set(ideas.filter((idea) => !idea.seenAt).map((idea) => idea.taskId)).size;
  const svenHunting = tasks.some((task) => task.standingOrderId === SVEN_VISIONARY_ORDER_ID && task.status === "working");
  const openBlockers = blockers.filter((blocker) => blocker.status === "open" && !tasks.find((task) => task.id === blocker.taskId)?.standingOrderId);
  const log = state.data?.log ?? [];
  const openCount = visibleTasks.filter((task) => task.status !== "done").length;
  const blockedTaskIds = new Set(openBlockers.map((blocker) => blocker.taskId));
  const approvedTasks = visibleTasks.filter((task) => !task.standingOrderId && isApprovedPackage(task));
  const libraryTasks = visibleTasks.filter((task) => !task.standingOrderId && isLibraryTask(task));
  // Phase 3 — scoped derivations, from the scoped read ONLY. The scoped
  // payload's tasks/briefs/packages are already filtered server-side to
  // the active client; the same membership rules as the global lists
  // apply on top (lab sub-cases hidden, Library membership by approval).
  const activeClient = activeClientId ? clients.find((client) => client.id === activeClientId) ?? null : null;
  const scopedTasksRaw = activeClientId ? scopedState.data?.tasks ?? [] : [];
  const scopedLabSubcaseIds = new Set(scopedTasksRaw.flatMap((task) => (task.escalationSubtaskId ? [task.escalationSubtaskId] : [])));
  const scopedVisibleTasks = scopedTasksRaw.filter((task) => !scopedLabSubcaseIds.has(task.id));
  const scopedLibraryTasks = scopedVisibleTasks.filter((task) => !task.standingOrderId && isLibraryTask(task));
  // The Deliverables Library is the one Deliverables surface that scopes:
  // with a client active it shows that client's deliverables only (and
  // says so, via the banner); "To post" above it keeps using the global
  // approvedTasks and never filters (Stage C).
  const displayLibraryTasks = activeClientId ? scopedLibraryTasks : libraryTasks;
  const toggleActiveClient = (client: Client) => setActiveClientId((current) => (current === client.id ? null : client.id));
  const clearActiveClient = () => setActiveClientId(null);
  // If the active client's record disappears (deleted in the registry),
  // the selection clears with it — a scoped view must never point at a
  // client who no longer exists.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeClientId && state.data && !state.data.clients.some((client) => client.id === activeClientId)) setActiveClientId(null);
  }, [activeClientId, state.data]);
  const approvalTasks = visibleTasks.filter((task) => isReadyForYouTask(task, blockedTaskIds));
  const finalApprovalTasks = visibleTasks.filter((task) => isReadyForYouTask(task, blockedTaskIds) && !blockedTaskIds.has(task.id));
  const workPanelNotificationCount = approvalTasks.length + unreadIdeaHunts;
  const workingTasks = visibleTasks.filter((task) => task.status === "working" && !blockedTaskIds.has(task.id));
  const activeTasks = workingTasks;
  const blockersForTask = (taskId: string) => openBlockers.filter((blocker) => blocker.taskId === taskId);
  const doneTasks = visibleTasks.filter((task) => task.status === "done");
  // Ready for You, presented: client work grouped under its client,
  // blockers under "Needs your answer", the rest as finished work —
  // longest-waiting first inside each group (see groupReadyTasks).
  const readyGroups = groupReadyTasks(approvalTasks, clients, blockedTaskIds, (task) => waitingSinceForTask(task, briefs, blockersForTask(task.id)));
  const contentPipelineTasks = visibleTasks.filter((task) => task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid");

  const greeting = useMemo(() => {
    const hour = clock.getHours();
    const part = hour < 5 ? "Night" : hour < 12 ? "Morning" : hour < 17 ? "Afternoon" : hour < 22 ? "Evening" : "Night";
    return `${part} shift.`;
  }, [clock]);

  function openNewTask() {
    setSelectedMember(null);
    setSelectedTask(null);
    setShowNewTask(true);
  }

  function openMember(member: Member, floorStatus?: FloorMemberStatus) {
    setSelectedTask(null);
    setDrawerOpen(false);
    setSelectedMember({ member, floorStatus });
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "auto" });
  }

  // Floor clicks only: Remmy's sprite opens the briefing chat — a direct
  // line to the real Remmy — as a floating overlay. The floor, its music,
  // and every other state stay exactly as they were behind it. Every other
  // crew member keeps the usual live-status card, and Remmy's card still
  // opens from the Team view as before.
  function openFloorMember(member: Member, floorStatus?: FloorMemberStatus) {
    if (member.id === "remmy") {
      setSelectedMember(null);
      setSelectedTask(null);
      setRemmyChatOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    openMember(member, floorStatus);
  }

  function openBlocker(blocker: Blocker) {
    setSelectedTask(null);
    setBlockerSubmitError("");
    setAnsweringBlocker(blocker);
  }

  if (state.data) setOfficeRegionData(state.data.floorMap.regionData);

  const introOverlay = introPhase !== "done" ? (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={[
        "establishing-shot",
        introReady ? "is-ready" : "",
        introPhase === "zooming" ? "is-zooming" : "",
        introPhase === "leaving" ? "is-leaving" : "",
      ].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
      aria-label="Enter the office"
      onPointerDown={skipIntro}
      onClick={skipIntro}
    >
      <span className="establishing-shot-stage">
        <img
          className="establishing-shot-backdrop"
          src={officeExteriorUrl}
          alt=""
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
        <img
          className="establishing-shot-frame"
          ref={introImgRef}
          src={officeExteriorUrl}
          alt="The Pulse HQ office building at night"
          onLoad={markIntroImageLoaded}
          onError={skipIntro}
        />
      </span>
      <span className="establishing-shot-hint" aria-hidden="true">Tap to enter</span>
    </button>
  ) : null;

  if (state.isPending) {
    return <div className="app-shell"><SafeAreaTopScrim backgroundColor="var(--bg)" /><main className="loading">{isFlowView ? "Loading your work…" : "Opening the office…"}</main>{isFlowView ? null : introOverlay}</div>;
  }
  if (state.error) {
    return <div className="app-shell"><SafeAreaTopScrim backgroundColor="var(--bg)" /><main className="loading error"><b>{isFlowView ? "Your work could not load." : "The office door stuck."}</b><span>{String(state.error)}</span><button onClick={() => state.refetch()}>Try again</button></main>{isFlowView ? null : introOverlay}</div>;
  }

  const currentTitle = NAV_ITEMS.find((item) => item.id === view)?.label ?? "Office Floor";
  const goTo = (nextView: ViewId) => {
    if (nextView !== "floor") setWorkPanelOpen(true);
    setView("floor");
    setDrawerOpen(false);
  };

  // A Finished work link in a client profile is a pointer, never a copy:
  // it makes that client the active client (so the Deliverables Library
  // behind the item is scoped to them) and opens the item itself — the
  // job whose files live in Deliverables.
  const openFinishedWork = (task: Task) => {
    if (task.clientId) setActiveClientId(task.clientId);
    setSelectedTask(task);
  };

  const workPanelContent = <SimplifiedWorkPanel
    approvalTasks={approvalTasks}
    readyGroups={readyGroups}
    approvedTasks={approvedTasks}
    libraryTasks={displayLibraryTasks}
    activeClient={activeClient}
    onToggleClient={toggleActiveClient}
    onClearActiveClient={clearActiveClient}
    onMarkTaskPosted={(task) => markTaskPosted.mutate(task.id)}
    taskPostedBusy={markTaskPosted.isPending}
    blockers={openBlockers}
    activeTasks={activeTasks}
    briefs={briefs}
    ideas={ideas}
    stories={stories}
    onMakeStoryJob={(storyId) => makeStoryJob.mutate(storyId)}
    onDismissStory={(storyId) => dismissStory.mutate(storyId)}
    makingStoryJobId={makeStoryJob.isPending ? makeStoryJob.variables ?? null : null}
    dismissingStoryId={dismissStory.isPending ? dismissStory.variables ?? null : null}
    xPosts={xPosts}
    presets={presets}
    onStartPreset={requestStartPreset}
    onNewPreset={() => setPresetSheet("new")}
    onEditPreset={(preset) => setPresetSheet(preset)}
    onDeletePreset={(preset) => setDeletePresetCandidate(preset)}
    presetBusy={startPreset.isPending || deletePreset.isPending}
    onMarkXPostPosted={(postId) => markXPostPosted.mutate(postId)}
    onDeleteXPost={(postId) => deleteXPost.mutate(postId)}
    xPostBusy={markXPostPosted.isPending || deleteXPost.isPending}
    clients={clients}
    packages={packages}
    tasks={tasks}
    openReportTaskClientIds={openReportTaskClientIds}
    onUpdateClientInstructions={(client, voiceNotes) => updateClientInstructions.mutate({ id: client.id, voiceNotes })}
    instructionsBusy={updateClientInstructions.isPending}
    onOpenFinishedWork={openFinishedWork}
    onNewClient={() => setClientSheet("new")}
    onEditClient={(client) => setClientSheet(client)}
    onDeleteClient={(client) => setDeleteClientCandidate(client)}
    onApprovePackage={(pkg, keepPaths) => approvePackage.mutate({ id: pkg.id, keepPaths })}
    onDownloadPackage={(pkg) => downloadPackageZip.mutate(pkg)}
    onSavePackageLink={(pkg, url) => savePackageLink.mutate({ id: pkg.id, url })}
    packageDeliveryBusy={downloadPackageZip.isPending || savePackageLink.isPending}
    ledger={ledgerEntries}
    onAddLedgerEntry={(input) => addLedgerEntry.mutate(input)}
    onUpdateLedgerEntry={(input) => updateLedgerEntry.mutate(input)}
    onDeleteLedgerEntry={(id) => deleteLedgerEntry.mutate(id)}
    ledgerBusy={addLedgerEntry.isPending || updateLedgerEntry.isPending || deleteLedgerEntry.isPending}
    onReworkPackage={(pkg) => setPackageReworkCandidate(pkg)}
    onFinishAssemblingPackage={(pkg) => finishAssemblingPackage.mutate(pkg.id)}
    onRunClientReport={(client) => runClientReport.mutate(client.id)}
    onDraftCaseStudy={(pkg) => draftCaseStudy.mutate(pkg.id)}
    clientBusy={approvePackage.isPending || reworkPackage.isPending || finishAssemblingPackage.isPending || runClientReport.isPending || draftCaseStudy.isPending || deleteClient.isPending}
    log={log}
    onClose={() => setWorkPanelOpen(false)}
    onOpenTask={setSelectedTask}
    onAnswerBlocker={openBlocker}
    onApprove={(task) => setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status: "done" })}
    onFinalize={(task, keepPaths) => finalizeItemReview.mutate({ taskId: task.id, keepPaths })}
    onSendBack={setSendBackCandidate}
    onDelete={setDeleteCandidate}
    onCreateWork={openNewTask}
    onHuntIdeas={() => huntIdeas.mutate()}
    onIdeasOpened={() => { if (unreadIdeaHunts > 0 && !markIdeasSeen.isPending) markIdeasSeen.mutate(); }}
    onLaunchIdea={(ideaId) => launchIdea.mutate(ideaId)}
    onDenyIdea={(ideaId) => denyIdea.mutate(ideaId)}
    huntingIdeas={huntIdeas.isPending || svenHunting}
    launchingIdeaId={launchIdea.isPending ? launchIdea.variables ?? null : null}
    denyingIdeaId={denyIdea.isPending ? denyIdea.variables ?? null : null}
    busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || finalizeItemReview.isPending || sendBackTask.isPending || deleteTask.isPending || createWork.isPending || huntIdeas.isPending || launchIdea.isPending || denyIdea.isPending || markXPostPosted.isPending || deleteXPost.isPending}
  />;

  if (isFlowView) {
    // Flow: one column, no map, no floor, no intro — the same live rows
    // and the same actions as the desktop office, stacked in Ben's order.
    const queuedPosts = xPosts.filter((post) => post.status === "queued");
    const postedPosts = xPosts.filter((post) => post.status === "posted");
    const flowBusy = setTaskStatus.isPending || finalizeItemReview.isPending || sendBackTask.isPending || deleteTask.isPending || resolveBlocker.isPending;
    const flowClientBusy = approvePackage.isPending || reworkPackage.isPending || finishAssemblingPackage.isPending || runClientReport.isPending || draftCaseStudy.isPending || deleteClient.isPending;
    // Session-scoped escape: switch in place (no reload, so no query
    // string or width check can bounce back into Flow), remember the
    // choice in sessionStorage so it holds across any in-session reload,
    // and skip the establishing-shot intro so the office opens directly.
    const exitFlowToOffice = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      try {
        window.sessionStorage.setItem(FLOW_ESCAPED_SESSION_KEY, "1");
      } catch {
        // Storage unavailable (private mode / sandboxed frame): the
        // in-memory switch below still holds for this page session.
      }
      skipIntro();
      setIsFlowView(false);
    };
    return (
      <div className="app-shell flow-shell">
        <SafeAreaTopScrim backgroundColor="var(--bg)" />
        <main className="flow-wrap">
          <header className="flow-topbar">
            <a className="flow-back" href="./" onClick={exitFlowToOffice}>← Office</a>
            <span className="flow-summary">{approvalTasks.length} ready · {activeTasks.length} working</span>
          </header>

          <section className="flow-section" aria-labelledby="flow-ready-title">
            <div className="flow-section-head"><h2 id="flow-ready-title">Ready for You</h2><span className="flow-count" aria-label={`${approvalTasks.length} waiting on you`}>{approvalTasks.length}</span>{approvalTasks.length > 0 && <button type="button" className="flow-expand-button" onClick={() => setFlowReadyExpanded(true)} aria-label="Expand Ready for You">Expand</button>}</div>
            <p className="flow-section-sub">Only things that need your decision — finished work, and questions the crew cannot answer without you. The result is the first thing on each card; extras are behind one tap, only if you want them. Standing-order runs never land here: they finish straight to Done.</p>
            {approvalTasks.length ? <DecisionQueue groups={readyGroups} renderCard={(task) => <DecisionCard
              key={task.id}
              task={task}
              clientName={clients.find((client) => client.id === task.clientId)?.businessName}
              blockers={blockersForTask(task.id)}
              waitingSince={waitingSinceForTask(task, briefs, blockersForTask(task.id))}
              onAnswer={openBlocker}
              onApprove={() => setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status: "done" })}
              onFinalize={(keepPaths) => finalizeItemReview.mutate({ taskId: task.id, keepPaths })}
              onDeny={() => setSendBackCandidate(task)}
              onDelete={() => setDeleteCandidate(task)}
              busy={flowBusy}
            />} /> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>You’re caught up.</b><span>Nothing is waiting on your decision.</span></div>}
          </section>

          <section className="flow-section" aria-labelledby="flow-working-title">
            <div className="flow-section-head"><h2 id="flow-working-title">Working</h2><span className="flow-count" aria-label={`${activeTasks.length} being worked`}>{activeTasks.length}</span></div>
            <p className="flow-section-sub">What the crew has in hand right now, and who is on it.</p>
            {activeTasks.length ? <div className="flow-list">{activeTasks.map((task) => <WorkingJobCard key={task.id} task={task} briefs={briefs} onOpen={() => setSelectedTask(task)} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>The crew is standing by.</b><span>Nothing is being worked right now.</span></div>}
          </section>

          <section className="flow-section" aria-labelledby="flow-deliverables-title">
            <div className="flow-section-head"><h2 id="flow-deliverables-title">Deliverables</h2><span className="flow-count" aria-label={`${(() => { const g = classifyDeliverableTasks([...approvedTasks, ...displayLibraryTasks], packages); return g.posts.length + packages.length + g.files.length + g.reports.length; })()} deliverables`}>{(() => { const g = classifyDeliverableTasks([...approvedTasks, ...displayLibraryTasks], packages); return g.posts.length + packages.length + g.files.length + g.reports.length; })()}</span></div>
            <p className="flow-section-sub">Pick a kind from the dropdown — posts as tiles, packages as full cards, files and reports as compact rows — or leave it on All to see the kinds grouped.</p>
            <DeliverablesKindContent approvedTasks={approvedTasks} libraryTasks={displayLibraryTasks} packages={packages} clients={clients} tasks={tasks} activeClient={activeClient} onClearActiveClient={clearActiveClient} onMarkTaskPosted={(task) => markTaskPosted.mutate(task.id)} taskPostedBusy={markTaskPosted.isPending} onApprovePackage={(pkg, keepPaths) => approvePackage.mutate({ id: pkg.id, keepPaths })} onReworkPackage={(pkg) => setPackageReworkCandidate(pkg)} onFinishAssemblingPackage={(pkg) => finishAssemblingPackage.mutate(pkg.id)} onDownloadPackage={(p) => downloadPackageZip.mutate(p)} onSavePackageLink={(p, url) => savePackageLink.mutate({ id: p.id, url })} packageDeliveryBusy={downloadPackageZip.isPending || savePackageLink.isPending} clientBusy={flowClientBusy} onOpenTask={setSelectedTask} idPrefix="flow" />
          </section>

          <section className="flow-section" aria-labelledby="flow-clients-title">
            <div className="flow-section-head"><h2 id="flow-clients-title">Clients</h2><span className="flow-count" aria-label={`${clients.length} ${clients.length === 1 ? "client" : "clients"} in the directory`}>{clients.length}</span></div>
            <p className="flow-section-sub">Client profiles — their information, their special instructions, the button that populates the world with just them, their delivery packages (the same cards as in Deliverables, controls included), and links to their finished work.</p>
            {activeClient && <ActiveClientBanner client={activeClient} surface="This client is populating the world: the Deliverables Posts, Files and Reports above show only their deliverables. Ready for You still shows everyone." onClear={clearActiveClient} />}
            {clients.length ? <ClientProfileList clients={clients} packages={packages} tasks={tasks} activeClientId={activeClientId} onToggleActive={toggleActiveClient} openReportTaskClientIds={openReportTaskClientIds} onEdit={(client) => setClientSheet(client)} onDelete={(client) => setDeleteClientCandidate(client)} onRunReport={(client) => runClientReport.mutate(client.id)} onDraftCaseStudy={(pkg) => draftCaseStudy.mutate(pkg.id)} onOpenFinishedWork={openFinishedWork} onUpdateInstructions={(client, text) => updateClientInstructions.mutate({ id: client.id, voiceNotes: text })} instructionsBusy={updateClientInstructions.isPending} busy={flowClientBusy} onApprovePackage={(pkg, keepPaths) => approvePackage.mutate({ id: pkg.id, keepPaths })} onReworkPackage={(pkg) => setPackageReworkCandidate(pkg)} onFinishAssemblingPackage={(pkg) => finishAssemblingPackage.mutate(pkg.id)} onDownloadPackage={(p) => downloadPackageZip.mutate(p)} onSavePackageLink={(p, url) => savePackageLink.mutate({ id: p.id, url })} packageDeliveryBusy={downloadPackageZip.isPending || savePackageLink.isPending} onOpenTask={setSelectedTask} /> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>No clients yet.</b><span>Add one from the desktop office’s Clients tab and their profile will appear here.</span></div>}
          </section>

          <section className="flow-section" aria-labelledby="flow-revenue-title">
            <div className="flow-section-head"><h2 id="flow-revenue-title">Shipped & Revenue</h2><span className="flow-count" aria-label={`${ledgerEntries.length} ${ledgerEntries.length === 1 ? "job" : "jobs"} shipped`}>{ledgerEntries.length}</span></div>
            <p className="flow-section-sub">What shipped and what it earned. When an external client’s delivery package is delivered, its row lands here on its own — you fill in the amount. Perfectly Paranoid and Pulse HQ’s own posts never land here. Add rows by hand for money that never touched a package, like a Skunk Tools sale.</p>
            <LedgerView entries={ledgerEntries} clients={clients} busy={addLedgerEntry.isPending || updateLedgerEntry.isPending || deleteLedgerEntry.isPending} onAdd={(input) => addLedgerEntry.mutate(input)} onUpdate={(input) => updateLedgerEntry.mutate(input)} onDelete={(id) => deleteLedgerEntry.mutate(id)} />
          </section>

          <section className="flow-section" aria-labelledby="flow-posts-title">
            <div className="flow-section-head"><h2 id="flow-posts-title">Post Queue</h2><span className="flow-count" aria-label={`${queuedPosts.length} unposted in the queue`}>{queuedPosts.length}</span></div>
            <p className="flow-section-sub">Olivia’s drafts for @PulseHQOffice. Copy one into X yourself, then mark it posted.</p>
            {queuedPosts.length ? <div className="flow-list">{queuedPosts.map((post) => <XPostCard key={post.id} post={post} onMarkPosted={() => markXPostPosted.mutate(post.id)} onDelete={() => deleteXPost.mutate(post.id)} busy={markXPostPosted.isPending || deleteXPost.isPending} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>The queue is empty.</b><span>Olivia’s next batch will land here.</span></div>}
            {postedPosts.length ? <p className="flow-posted-note">{postedPosts.length} already posted — kept in the desktop office’s Post Queue history.</p> : null}
          </section>
        </main>
        {selectedTask && <TaskSheet task={selectedTask} blockers={blockersForTask(selectedTask.id)} onAnswer={openBlocker} onClose={() => setSelectedTask(null)} onMove={(status) => { if (status === "working" && selectedTask.status === "approval") { setSendBackCandidate(selectedTask); setSelectedTask(null); } else { setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: selectedTask.id, status }); } }} onFinalize={(keepPaths) => finalizeItemReview.mutate({ taskId: selectedTask.id, keepPaths })} onMarkPosted={() => markTaskPosted.mutate(selectedTask.id)} onDelete={() => { setDeleteCandidate(selectedTask); setSelectedTask(null); }} busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || finalizeItemReview.isPending || markTaskPosted.isPending || deleteTask.isPending} />}
        {sendBackCandidate && <SendBackSheet task={sendBackCandidate} onCancel={() => setSendBackCandidate(null)} onConfirm={(feedback, target, assigneeId) => sendBackTask.mutate({ id: sendBackCandidate.id, feedback, target, assigneeId })} busy={sendBackTask.isPending} />}
        {deleteCandidate && <DeleteTaskSheet task={deleteCandidate} onCancel={() => setDeleteCandidate(null)} onConfirm={() => deleteTask.mutate(deleteCandidate.id)} busy={deleteTask.isPending} />}
        {approvedTask && <ApprovalCompleteSheet task={approvedTask} onClose={() => setApprovedTask(null)} />}
        {clientSheet && <ClientSheet client={clientSheet === "new" ? null : clientSheet} onClose={() => setClientSheet(null)} onSubmit={(input) => clientSheet === "new" || clientSheet === null ? createClient.mutate(input) : updateClient.mutate({ id: clientSheet.id, ...input })} busy={createClient.isPending || updateClient.isPending} />}
        {deleteClientCandidate && <DeleteClientSheet client={deleteClientCandidate} onCancel={() => setDeleteClientCandidate(null)} onConfirm={() => deleteClient.mutate(deleteClientCandidate.id)} busy={deleteClient.isPending} />}
        {packageReworkCandidate && <PackageReworkSheet pkg={packageReworkCandidate} client={clients.find((client) => client.id === packageReworkCandidate.clientId)} onClose={() => setPackageReworkCandidate(null)} onSubmit={(feedback) => reworkPackage.mutate({ id: packageReworkCandidate.id, feedback })} busy={reworkPackage.isPending} />}
        {answeringBlocker && <BlockerSheet blocker={answeringBlocker} onClose={() => setAnsweringBlocker(null)} onSubmit={(answer) => resolveBlocker.mutate({ id: answeringBlocker.id, answer })} onVerify={() => verifyBlocker.mutate(answeringBlocker.id)} busy={resolveBlocker.isPending || verifyBlocker.isPending} submitError={blockerSubmitError} onClearError={() => setBlockerSubmitError("")} />}
        {flowReadyExpanded && <>
          <button type="button" className="expanded-overlay-scrim" aria-label="Close expanded Ready for You view" onClick={() => setFlowReadyExpanded(false)} />
          <div className="expanded-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Ready for You — expanded view">
            <header className="expanded-overlay-head">
              <div><h2>Ready for You</h2><span>{approvalTasks.length} waiting</span></div>
              <div className="expanded-overlay-actions"><button type="button" className="expanded-overlay-shrink" onClick={() => setFlowReadyExpanded(false)} aria-label="Shrink expanded Ready for You view">Shrink</button><button type="button" className="expanded-overlay-close" onClick={() => setFlowReadyExpanded(false)} aria-label="Close expanded Ready for You view">Close</button></div>
            </header>
            <div className="expanded-overlay-scroll">
              {approvalTasks.length ? <DecisionQueue groups={readyGroups} showPositions renderCard={(task, positionLabel) => <DecisionCard
                key={task.id}
                task={task}
                clientName={clients.find((client) => client.id === task.clientId)?.businessName}
                blockers={blockersForTask(task.id)}
                waitingSince={waitingSinceForTask(task, briefs, blockersForTask(task.id))}
                positionLabel={positionLabel}
                onAnswer={openBlocker}
                onApprove={() => setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status: "done" })}
                onFinalize={(keepPaths) => finalizeItemReview.mutate({ taskId: task.id, keepPaths })}
                onDeny={() => setSendBackCandidate(task)}
                onDelete={() => setDeleteCandidate(task)}
                busy={flowBusy}
              />} /> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>You’re caught up.</b><span>Nothing is waiting on your decision.</span></div>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </>}
        <div className={toast ? "toast show" : "toast"} role="status" aria-live="polite">{toast}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-shell">
      <SafeAreaTopScrim backgroundColor="var(--bg)" />
      {introOverlay}
      {view !== "floor" && <header className="app-header">
        <span className="header-floor-mark" aria-hidden="true"><i /></span>
        <div className="header-copy"><span>{currentTitle}</span><small>{ALL_MEMBERS.length} agents · {openCount} open</small></div>
        <span className="live-dot" aria-label="Office online" />
      </header>}

      <main className={view === "floor" ? "wrap floor-view" : "wrap"}>
        {openBlockers.length > 0 && <section className="needs-you-banner" aria-label="Crew needs you">
          <div><span className="needs-you-bell" aria-hidden="true">!</span><p><b>{openBlockers.length === 1 ? `${memberById(openBlockers[0]?.memberId ?? "")?.name ?? "The crew"} needs you` : `${openBlockers.length} crew requests need you`}</b><small>{openBlockers[0]?.question}</small></p></div>
          <button onClick={() => { const first = openBlockers[0]; if (first) openBlocker(first); }}>{openBlockers[0]?.kind === "browser_action" ? "Open" : "Answer"}</button>
        </section>}
        {view === "review" && <section className="view-section decision-page">
          {/* THE DECISION PAGE (full redo, 2026-10-18). One job: the
              things that need Ben's decision, each showing its result
              first. The header states the whole queue in plain words —
              how many, and how long the oldest has waited. Nothing
              else lives on this page: work in progress is in All jobs,
              finished-and-approved work is in Deliverables, and
              standing-order runs go straight to Done without ever
              landing here. */}
          <header className="decision-page-head">
            <div className="decision-page-head-main">
              <h1 className="decision-page-title">Ready for You</h1>
              {approvalTasks.length === 0
                ? <p className="decision-page-sub">Nothing needs your decision. When the crew finishes a job, or gets stuck on a question only you can answer, it lands here — result first, one decision each.</p>
                : <p className="decision-page-sub"><b>{approvalTasks.length} {approvalTasks.length === 1 ? "thing needs" : "things need"} your decision.</b> The result is the first thing on each one — decide, and it leaves this page.{(() => { const oldest = approvalTasks.map((task) => waitingSinceForTask(task, briefs, blockersForTask(task.id))).sort()[0]; return oldest ? <> The longest wait started {formatWaitingStamp(oldest).toLowerCase()}.</> : null; })()}</p>}
            </div>
            <button className="quick-task" onClick={() => openNewTask()}>+ Create work</button>
          </header>
          {approvalTasks.length === 0 ? <div className="decision-empty">
            <div className="decision-empty-mark" aria-hidden="true">✓</div>
            <b>You’re caught up.</b>
            <span>No finished work is waiting, and the crew has no questions for you.</span>
            <button onClick={() => openNewTask()}>Create work</button>
          </div> : <DecisionQueue groups={readyGroups} renderCard={(task) => <DecisionCard
            key={task.id}
            task={task}
            clientName={clients.find((client) => client.id === task.clientId)?.businessName}
            blockers={blockersForTask(task.id)}
            waitingSince={waitingSinceForTask(task, briefs, blockersForTask(task.id))}
            onAnswer={openBlocker}
            onApprove={() => setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status: "done" })}
            onFinalize={(keepPaths) => finalizeItemReview.mutate({ taskId: task.id, keepPaths })}
            onDeny={() => setSendBackCandidate(task)}
            onDelete={() => setDeleteCandidate(task)}
            busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || finalizeItemReview.isPending || sendBackTask.isPending || deleteTask.isPending || resolveBlocker.isPending}
          />} />}
          <footer className="decision-page-foot">
            <span>{activeTasks.length === 0 ? "The crew is not working on anything else right now." : activeTasks.length === 1 ? "1 job is with the crew right now — it will land here when it is finished and needs your decision." : `${activeTasks.length} jobs are with the crew right now — each lands here only when it is finished and needs your decision.`}</span>
            <button onClick={() => goTo("tasks")}>View all jobs</button>
          </footer>
        </section>}

        {view === "content" && <section className="view-section content-pipeline-home">
          <ViewHeading
            title="Perfectly Paranoid"
            description="About 8.4K followers · curious AI projects, breakthroughs, weird demos, and open-source builds. No generic industry churn."
            action={<button className="quick-task" onClick={() => setShowContentPipeline(true)}>+ Start story</button>}
          />
          <div className="pipeline-truth-line"><span aria-hidden="true">✓</span><p><b>One job. One decision.</b><small>Research and verification, copy, then art flow automatically. The finished package waits for you once, at the end.</small></p></div>
          <div className="pipeline-rail" aria-label="Perfectly Paranoid crew plan">
            <div><span>1</span><b>Tom researches + verifies</b><small>Specific story, checked claims, exact sources</small></div>
            <div><span>2</span><b>Johnny writes</b><small>Finished Facebook post copy</small></div>
            <div><span>3</span><b>Nik makes art</b><small>One untouched social image</small></div>
            <div><span>4</span><b>You decide</b><small>Approve or rework</small></div>
          </div>
          <div className="content-pipeline-list">
            <div className="home-section-head"><div><b>Story jobs</b><span>{contentPipelineTasks.length ? `${contentPipelineTasks.length} ${contentPipelineTasks.length === 1 ? "job" : "jobs"}` : "No stories started yet"}</span></div></div>
            {contentPipelineTasks.length === 0 ? <div className="empty brief-empty"><b>Find the first story.</b><span>Give Tom an angle or let him hunt the whole lane.</span><button onClick={() => setShowContentPipeline(true)}>Start a story</button></div> : contentPipelineTasks.slice(0, 18).map((task) => <button className="content-stage-row" key={task.id} onClick={() => setSelectedTask(task)}>
              <span className="content-stage-icon research">J</span>
              <span><b>{task.title}</b><small>{taskProgressLabel(task)} · crew steps stay in one job</small></span>
              <i aria-hidden="true">›</i>
            </button>)}
          </div>
        </section>}

        {view === "floor" && <section className="view-section floor-home">
          <OfficeFloor
            tasks={tasks}
            waitingCount={approvalTasks.length}
            notificationCount={workPanelNotificationCount}
            unreadIdeaHunts={unreadIdeaHunts}
            huddleCount={finalApprovalTasks.length}
            briefs={briefs}
            handoffs={handoffs}
            watchdogEvent={watchdogEventFor(log.find((entry) => entry.text.includes("stalled with no progress")))}
            clock={clock}
            inboxArrival={inboxArrival}
            onInboxArrivalHandled={(id) => setInboxArrival((current) => current?.id === id ? null : current)}
            onMemberOpen={openFloorMember}
            onOpenWorkPanel={() => setWorkPanelOpen(true)}
            workingCount={workingTasks.length}
            doneCount={tasks.filter((task) => task.status === "done").length}
            summaryLabel={approvalCountLabel(approvalTasks.length)}
            greeting={greeting}
            agentCount={ALL_MEMBERS.length}
            openCount={openCount}
