            onShowReview={() => goTo("review")}
            onShowOutreach={() => { setView("outreach"); setDrawerOpen(false); }}
            overlayHostRef={setFloorOverlayHost}
          />
        </section>}

        {view === "team" && <section className="view-section">
          <ViewHeading title="Team" description="Tap an agent to see their focus and active work." action={<button className="quick-task" onClick={() => openNewTask()}>+ Create work</button>} />
          <div className="team-grid">
            {MEMBERS.map((member) => {
              const count = tasks.filter((task) => task.assignee === member.id && task.status !== "done").length;
              const isLive = briefs.some((brief) => brief.assignee === member.id && brief.status === "in_progress");
              return <button className={isLive ? "member-card is-live" : "member-card"} key={member.id} onClick={() => openMember(member)} aria-label={`Open ${member.name}, ${member.role}${isLive ? ", live" : ""}`}>
                {isLive && <span className="live-badge"><i />Live</span>}
                <MemberAvatar member={member} />
                <span className="member-name">{member.name}</span><span className="member-role">{member.role}</span>
                <span className="member-status"><i className={isLive ? "active" : member.status} />{isLive ? "Working now" : member.statusText}<b>{count}</b></span>
                <span className="member-focus">{member.focus}</span>
              </button>;
            })}
          </div>
          <div className="home-section-head"><div><b>Research Department</b><span>Pulse HQ · their own floor, through the floor switcher</span></div></div>
          <div className="team-grid">
            {RESEARCH_MEMBERS.map((member) => {
              const count = tasks.filter((task) => task.assignee === member.id && task.status !== "done").length;
              const isLive = briefs.some((brief) => brief.assignee === member.id && brief.status === "in_progress");
              return <button className={isLive ? "member-card is-live" : "member-card"} key={member.id} onClick={() => openMember(member)} aria-label={`Open ${member.name}, ${member.role}${isLive ? ", live" : ""}`}>
                {isLive && <span className="live-badge"><i />Live</span>}
                <MemberAvatar member={member} />
                <span className="member-name">{member.name}</span><span className="member-role">{member.role}</span>
                <span className="member-status"><i className={isLive ? "active" : member.status} />{isLive ? "Working now" : member.statusText}<b>{count}</b></span>
                <span className="member-focus">{member.focus}</span>
              </button>;
            })}
          </div>
        </section>}

        {view === "tasks" && <section className="view-section">
          <ViewHeading title="All jobs" description="Every job is being worked, waiting on you, or done." action={<button className="quick-task" onClick={() => openNewTask()}>+ Create work</button>} />
          <div className="inbox-check">
            <button
              className="inbox-check-button"
              type="button"
              disabled={checkInbox.isPending}
              aria-busy={checkInbox.isPending}
              onClick={() => checkInbox.mutate()}
            >
              {checkInbox.isPending && <span className="inbox-check-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />}
              {checkInbox.isPending ? "Checking…" : "Check now"}
            </button>
            <span className={inboxCheckMessage ? "inbox-check-status show" : "inbox-check-status"} role="status" aria-live="polite">{inboxCheckMessage}</span>
          </div>
          {approvalTasks.length > 0 && <TaskGroup title="Waiting on You" count={approvalTasks.length} tone="approval">
            {approvalTasks.map((task) => <TaskCard key={task.id} task={task} blockers={blockersForTask(task.id)} onAnswer={openBlocker} onOpen={() => setSelectedTask(task)} onMove={(status) => status === "working" && task.status === "approval" ? setSendBackCandidate(task) : setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status })} onFinalize={(keepPaths) => finalizeItemReview.mutate({ taskId: task.id, keepPaths })} onDelete={() => setDeleteCandidate(task)} busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || finalizeItemReview.isPending || sendBackTask.isPending || deleteTask.isPending || resolveBlocker.isPending} />)}
          </TaskGroup>}
          {approvedTasks.length > 0 && <TaskGroup title="To post — in Deliverables" count={approvedTasks.length} tone="approval">
            {approvedTasks.map((task) => <TaskCard key={task.id} task={task} onOpen={() => setSelectedTask(task)} onMove={(status) => setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status })} onDelete={() => setDeleteCandidate(task)} busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || markTaskPosted.isPending || deleteTask.isPending} />)}
          </TaskGroup>}
          {workingTasks.length > 0 && <TaskGroup title="Being worked" count={workingTasks.length} tone="working">
            {workingTasks.map((task) => <TaskCard key={task.id} task={task} onOpen={() => setSelectedTask(task)} onMove={(status) => status === "working" && task.status === "approval" ? setSendBackCandidate(task) : setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status })} onDelete={() => setDeleteCandidate(task)} busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || sendBackTask.isPending || deleteTask.isPending} />)}
          </TaskGroup>}
          {openCount === 0 && <div className="empty"><b>No actionable jobs.</b><br />Create work or open history below.</div>}
          <div className="history-block">
            <button className="history-toggle" onClick={() => setShowHistory((value) => !value)} aria-expanded={showHistory}><span>{showHistory ? "Hide completed" : "Completed history"}</span><i>{doneTasks.length}</i></button>
            {showHistory && <div className="task-list history-list">{doneTasks.length ? doneTasks.map((task) => <TaskCard key={task.id} task={task} onOpen={() => setSelectedTask(task)} onMove={(status) => status === "working" && task.status === "approval" ? setSendBackCandidate(task) : setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: task.id, status })} onDelete={() => setDeleteCandidate(task)} busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || sendBackTask.isPending || deleteTask.isPending} />) : <div className="empty">No completed jobs yet.</div>}</div>}
          </div>
        </section>}

        {view === "briefs" && <section className="view-section">
          <ViewHeading title="Briefs Queue" description="Queued briefs are waiting for dispatch; picked up briefs are being handled." />
          <div className="brief-key" aria-label="Brief status key">
            {(["new", "in_progress", "done", "failed"] as Brief["status"][]).map((status) => <span key={status} className={`brief-status ${status}`}>{BRIEF_LABEL[status]}</span>)}
          </div>
          <div className="brief-list">
            {briefs.length === 0 ? <div className="empty brief-empty"><b>No briefs queued.</b><span>Create work and Remmy will assign it.</span><button onClick={() => openNewTask()}>Create work</button></div> : briefs.map((brief) => <BriefCard key={brief.id} brief={brief} onEdit={() => setEditingBrief(brief)} onCancel={() => cancelBrief.mutate(brief.id)} busy={updateBrief.isPending || cancelBrief.isPending} />)}
          </div>
        </section>}

        {view === "orders" && <section className="view-section">
          <ViewHeading title="Standing Orders" description="Creating the order is the approval. Each finished run goes directly to Done and stays available in history." action={<button className="quick-task" onClick={() => setShowNewOrder(true)}>+ New order</button>} />
          <div className="orders-list">
            {standingOrders.length === 0 ? <div className="empty brief-empty"><b>No standing orders.</b><span>Set a rhythm once and let the crew keep the queue moving.</span><button onClick={() => setShowNewOrder(true)}>Create standing order</button></div> : standingOrders.map((order) => <StandingOrderCard key={order.id} order={order} onToggle={() => toggleOrder.mutate({ id: order.id, enabled: !order.enabled })} onDelete={() => deleteOrder.mutate(order.id)} onEdit={() => setEditingOrder(order)} onRunNow={order.id === "olivia-x-posts-weekly" ? () => runOliviaBatch.mutate() : undefined} busy={toggleOrder.isPending || deleteOrder.isPending || updateOrder.isPending || runOliviaBatch.isPending} />)}
          </div>
        </section>}

        {view === "activity" && <section className="view-section">
          <ViewHeading title="Activity Log" description="A timestamped trail of changes across the office." />
          {log.length ? <div className="log-list">{log.map((entry) => <div className="log-entry" key={entry.id}><div>{displayMemberNames(entry.text)}</div><time>{formatStamp(entry.t)}</time></div>)}</div> : <div className="empty">No office activity yet.</div>}
        </section>}

        {view === "outreach" && <section className="view-section">
          <ViewHeading
            title="Outreach"
            description="Every business Pulse HQ has contacted, and what came of each contact. Outcomes change — update any row right here."
            action={<button className="quick-task" onClick={() => setView("floor")}>← Office floor</button>}
          />
          <OutreachView
            contacts={outreachContacts}
            busy={addOutreachContact.isPending || updateOutreachContact.isPending}
            onAdd={(input) => addOutreachContact.mutate(input)}
            onUpdate={(input) => updateOutreachContact.mutate(input)}
          />
        </section>}

      </main>

      {/* On the floor view the Work panel launcher lives in the LEFT side
          panel (rendered by OfficeFloor) so the map's bottom border stays
          clean; this floating launcher serves the other views. */}
      {view !== "floor" && <button className="work-panel-launcher" type="button" onClick={() => setWorkPanelOpen(true)} aria-label={`Open work panel${workPanelNotificationCount ? `, ${workPanelNotificationCount} ${workPanelNotificationCount === 1 ? "notification" : "notifications"}${unreadIdeaHunts ? `, ${unreadIdeaHunts} new from Sven` : ""}` : ""}`}>
        <span className="work-panel-launcher-icon" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></span>
        <b>Work panel</b>
        {workPanelNotificationCount > 0 && <em>{workPanelNotificationCount}</em>}
      </button>}
      {workPanelOpen && (view === "floor" && floorOverlayHost ? createPortal(workPanelContent, floorOverlayHost) : workPanelContent)}
      {remmyChatOpen && <RemmyChatOverlay onClose={() => setRemmyChatOpen(false)} onJobStarted={() => { void refresh(); }} />}
      {selectedMember && <CrewOverlay
        member={selectedMember.member}
        floorStatus={selectedMember.floorStatus}
        tasks={tasks}
        briefs={briefs}
        log={log}
        clock={clock}
        onClose={() => setSelectedMember(null)}
        onCreateWork={openNewTask}
      />}
      {selectedTask && <TaskSheet task={selectedTask} blockers={blockersForTask(selectedTask.id)} onAnswer={openBlocker} onClose={() => setSelectedTask(null)} onMove={(status) => { if (status === "working" && selectedTask.status === "approval") { setSendBackCandidate(selectedTask); setSelectedTask(null); } else { setTaskStatus.mutate({ id: selectedTask.id, status }); } }} onFinalize={(keepPaths) => finalizeItemReview.mutate({ taskId: selectedTask.id, keepPaths })} onMarkPosted={() => markTaskPosted.mutate(selectedTask.id)} onDelete={() => { setDeleteCandidate(selectedTask); setSelectedTask(null); }} busy={setTaskStatus.isPending || finalizeItemReview.isPending || markTaskPosted.isPending || deleteTask.isPending} />}
      {sendBackCandidate && <SendBackSheet task={sendBackCandidate} onCancel={() => setSendBackCandidate(null)} onConfirm={(feedback, target, assigneeId) => sendBackTask.mutate({ id: sendBackCandidate.id, feedback, target, assigneeId })} busy={sendBackTask.isPending} />}
      {deleteCandidate && <DeleteTaskSheet task={deleteCandidate} onCancel={() => setDeleteCandidate(null)} onConfirm={() => deleteTask.mutate(deleteCandidate.id)} busy={deleteTask.isPending} />}
      {approvedTask && <ApprovalCompleteSheet task={approvedTask} onClose={() => setApprovedTask(null)} />}
      {showNewTask && <NewTaskSheet clients={clients} onClose={() => setShowNewTask(false)} onSubmit={(title, notes, jobType, postCount, clientId) => createWork.mutate({ title, notes, jobType, postCount, clientId })} onSavePreset={(input) => savePresetFromForm.mutate(input)} presetBusy={savePresetFromForm.isPending} busy={createWork.isPending} />}
      {clientSheet && <ClientSheet client={clientSheet === "new" ? null : clientSheet} onClose={() => setClientSheet(null)} onSubmit={(input) => clientSheet === "new" || clientSheet === null ? createClient.mutate(input) : updateClient.mutate({ id: clientSheet.id, ...input })} busy={createClient.isPending || updateClient.isPending} />}
      {deleteClientCandidate && <DeleteClientSheet client={deleteClientCandidate} onCancel={() => setDeleteClientCandidate(null)} onConfirm={() => deleteClient.mutate(deleteClientCandidate.id)} busy={deleteClient.isPending} />}
      {packageReworkCandidate && <PackageReworkSheet pkg={packageReworkCandidate} client={clients.find((client) => client.id === packageReworkCandidate.clientId)} onClose={() => setPackageReworkCandidate(null)} onSubmit={(feedback) => reworkPackage.mutate({ id: packageReworkCandidate.id, feedback })} busy={reworkPackage.isPending} />}
      {presetSheet && <PresetSheet preset={presetSheet === "new" ? null : presetSheet} onClose={() => setPresetSheet(null)} onSubmit={(input) => presetSheet === "new" || presetSheet === null ? createPreset.mutate(input) : updatePreset.mutate({ id: presetSheet.id, ...input })} busy={createPreset.isPending || updatePreset.isPending} />}
      {startingPreset && <StartPresetSheet preset={startingPreset} onClose={() => setStartingPreset(null)} onSubmit={(fillInValue) => startPreset.mutate({ id: startingPreset.id, fillInValue })} busy={startPreset.isPending} />}
      {deletePresetCandidate && <DeletePresetSheet preset={deletePresetCandidate} onCancel={() => setDeletePresetCandidate(null)} onConfirm={() => deletePreset.mutate(deletePresetCandidate.id)} busy={deletePreset.isPending} />}
      {showNewOrder && <NewStandingOrderSheet onClose={() => setShowNewOrder(false)} onSubmit={(input) => createOrder.mutate(input)} busy={createOrder.isPending} />}
      {editingOrder && <EditStandingOrderSheet order={editingOrder} onClose={() => setEditingOrder(null)} onSubmit={(instruction) => updateOrder.mutate({ id: editingOrder.id, instruction })} busy={updateOrder.isPending} />}
      {showContentPipeline && <ContentPipelineSheet clients={clients} onClose={() => setShowContentPipeline(false)} onSubmit={(angle, clientId) => startContentPipeline.mutate({ angle, clientId })} busy={startContentPipeline.isPending} />}
      {showRegionEditor && <RegionEditorSheet floorMap={state.data?.floorMap ?? { regionData: null, legend: [], updatedAt: null }} onClose={() => setShowRegionEditor(false)} onSave={(regionData, legend) => saveFloorMap.mutate({ regionData, legend })} busy={saveFloorMap.isPending} />}
      {editingBrief && <EditBriefSheet brief={editingBrief} onClose={() => setEditingBrief(null)} onSubmit={(title, notes, assigneeId) => updateBrief.mutate({ id: editingBrief.id, title, notes, assigneeId })} busy={updateBrief.isPending} />}
      {answeringBlocker && <BlockerSheet blocker={answeringBlocker} onClose={() => setAnsweringBlocker(null)} onSubmit={(answer) => resolveBlocker.mutate({ id: answeringBlocker.id, answer })} onVerify={() => verifyBlocker.mutate(answeringBlocker.id)} busy={resolveBlocker.isPending || verifyBlocker.isPending} submitError={blockerSubmitError} onClearError={() => setBlockerSubmitError("")} />}
      <div className={toast ? "toast show" : "toast"} role="status" aria-live="polite">{toast}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function pipelineStageLabel(stage: Task["pipelineStage"]): string {
  if (stage === "verification") return "Verification";
  if (stage === "synthesis") return "Brief synthesis";
  if (stage === "copy") return "Facebook copy";
  if (stage === "preview") return "Copy + image preview";
  if (stage === "posting") return "Facebook publishing";
  if (stage === "browser_prep") return "Redbubble browser prep";
  if (stage === "scouting") return "Gathering opportunities";
  if (stage === "briefing") return "Writing the briefing";
  if (stage === "concept") return "Concept and copy";
  if (stage === "visuals") return "Building the visuals";
  if (stage === "intake") return "Client intake";
  if (stage === "assembly") return "Delivery package";
  if (stage === "report") return "Client report";
  return "Research";
}

function taskProgressLabel(task: Task): string {
  if (isApprovedPackage(task)) return "To post · in Deliverables";
  if (isPostedPackage(task)) return "Posted · in Deliverables";
  return STATUS[task.status].label;
}

function approvalCountLabel(count: number): string {
  return count === 0 ? "Nothing waiting on you" : `${count} waiting on you`;
}

function ViewHeading({ title, description, action }: { title: string; description: string; action?: ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="view-heading"><div><p className="view-kicker">Workspace</p><h1>{title}</h1><p>{description}</p></div>{action}</div>;
}

function jobKind(task: Task): "facebook" | "redbubble" | "other" {
  if (isMerchTask(task)) return "redbubble";
  if (task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" || /facebook|perfectly paranoid|social post/i.test(`${task.title} ${task.notes}`)) return "facebook";
  return "other";
}

// Deliverables kind classification (Ben's design, 2026-10-16): every
// finished item in Deliverables belongs to exactly ONE kind, derived
// from the data that already exists — posts are finished social posts,
// packages are delivery_packages, reports are client reports, and files
// are the remaining deliverable files. A job whose finished work is
// inside a delivery package is represented BY that package and never
// also listed on its own: no double-listing.
type DeliverableKind = "posts" | "packages" | "files" | "reports";
type DeliverableKindFilter = "all" | DeliverableKind;

function packageSourceTaskIds(packages: DeliveryPackage[]): Set<string> {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const pkg of packages) {
    ids.add(pkg.taskId);
    if (pkg.packageTaskId) ids.add(pkg.packageTaskId);
  }
  return ids;
}

function deliverableKindForTask(task: Task, packageSourceIds: Set<string>): DeliverableKind | null {
  if (packageSourceIds.has(task.id)) return null;
  if (task.pipeline === "client_report" || task.jobType === "client_report") return "reports";
  if (isPublishablePostTask(task) || task.pipeline === "x_posts" || task.jobType === "x_posts" || jobKind(task) === "facebook") return "posts";
  return "files";
}

function classifyDeliverableTasks(tasks: Task[], packages: DeliveryPackage[]): Record<"posts" | "files" | "reports", Task[]> {
  const sourceIds = packageSourceTaskIds(packages);
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const groups: Record<"posts" | "files" | "reports", Task[]> = { posts: [], files: [], reports: [] };
  for (const task of tasks) {
    if (seen.has(task.id)) continue;
    seen.add(task.id);
    const kind = deliverableKindForTask(task, sourceIds);
    if (kind === "posts" || kind === "files" || kind === "reports") groups[kind].push(task);
  }
  return groups;
}

function WorkingJobCard({ task, briefs, onOpen }: { task: Task; briefs: Brief[]; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const currentBriefs = briefs.filter((brief) => brief.taskId === task.id && brief.revision === task.revision);
  const liveBrief = currentBriefs.find((brief) => brief.status === "in_progress") ?? currentBriefs.find((brief) => brief.status === "new");
  const activeMember = memberById(liveBrief?.assignee ?? task.assignee);
  const completedAssignees = new Set(currentBriefs.filter((brief) => brief.status === "done").map((brief) => brief.assignee));
  const activeAssignee = liveBrief?.assignee ?? task.assignee;
  const stages = task.pipeline === "x_posts"
    ? [
      { key: "olivia", label: "Draft" },
      { key: "queue", label: "Post Queue" },
      { key: "posted", label: "You post" },
    ]
    : task.pipeline === "research_case"
    ? [
      { key: "walter", label: "Read" },
      { key: "peter", label: "Verify" },
      { key: "scout", label: "Brief" },
    ]
    : task.pipeline === "market_briefing"
    ? [
      { key: "ledger", label: "Gather" },
      { key: "scout", label: "Briefing" },
    ]
    : task.pipeline === "creative_package"
    ? [
      { key: "quill", label: "Concept + copy" },
      { key: "forge", label: "Visuals" },
    ]
    : task.pipeline === "client_report"
    ? [
      { key: "maria", label: "Compile report" },
      { key: "quill", label: "Write summary" },
    ]
    : (() => {
      // Standard and other unbound-pipeline jobs show the steps the job
      // ACTUALLY has — derived from its briefs in order — never a fixed
      // Research → Write → Image ladder. Under the standard outcome
      // contract there is no automatic image step, so the card must not
      // promise one the job does not carry.
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      const derived: Array<{ key: string; label: string }> = [];
      for (const brief of [...currentBriefs].sort((a, b) => a.stepIndex - b.stepIndex)) {
        if (seen.has(brief.assignee)) continue;
        seen.add(brief.assignee);
        derived.push({ key: brief.assignee, label: memberById(brief.assignee)?.name ?? "Crew" });
      }
      return derived.length ? derived : [{ key: task.assignee, label: memberById(task.assignee)?.name ?? "Crew" }];
    })();
  const activeIndex = Math.max(0, stages.findIndex((stage) => stage.key === activeAssignee));
  return <button className="simple-working-card" type="button" onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`Open ${task.title}`}>
    <div className="simple-card-top"><div><span>In progress</span><h3>{task.title}</h3></div><i aria-hidden="true">›</i></div>
    <p className="simple-owner"><span style={{ background: activeMember?.color ?? "var(--cyan)" }} />{activeMember?.name ?? "The crew"} is on it now</p>
    <EscalationNote task={task} />
    {task.contractStatus === "bounced" && task.contractViolation ? <p className="contract-note bounced">Contract check bounced the finished work back: {task.contractViolation}</p> : null}
    <ol className="job-progress" aria-label={`Progress for ${task.title}`}>
      {stages.map((stage, index) => {
        const complete = completedAssignees.has(stage.key) || index < activeIndex;
        const current = stage.key === activeAssignee || (activeIndex === 0 && index === 0);
        return <li key={stage.key} className={complete ? "complete" : current ? "current" : "upcoming"}><i aria-hidden="true">{complete ? "✓" : index + 1}</i><span>{stage.label}</span></li>;
      })}
    </ol>
  </button>;
}

// A finished social post at its proper size: a compact tile — thumbnail,
// title, a status chip, and the quick actions a post already has (open
// it, copy its text when it is a Facebook post, mark it posted while it
// waits under To post). The full post lives behind Open, in the job
// sheet — a post never renders as a full-size card in Deliverables.
function PostTile({ task, onOpen, onMarkPosted, markPostedBusy }: { task: Task; onOpen: () => void; onMarkPosted?: () => void; markPostedBusy?: boolean }) {
  const deliverables = useTaskDeliverablesQuery(task.id, task.revision);
  const image = deliverables.data?.items.find((item) => item.kind === "image" && item.imageUrl);
  const postCopy = task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" ? deliverables.data?.postCopy ?? "" : "";
  const [copyResult, setCopyResult] = useState<PostCopyResult | null>(null);
  const posted = isPostedPackage(task);
  const toPost = isApprovedPackage(task);
  const statusLabel = posted ? `Posted${task.postedAt ? ` · ${formatStamp(task.postedAt)}` : ""}` : toPost ? "To post" : "Finished";
  // Posted posts self-clear 24 hours after they go up (Ben, 2026-10-16):
  // while the timer runs, the tile says so plainly — never a surprise.
  const clearsIn = posted ? postClearsInLabel(task.postedAt) : null;
  const copy = () => {
    if (!postCopy) return;
    // copyPostToClipboard makes its synchronous attempt in its first
    // turn — this tap — before any await; only the result lands async.
    void copyPostToClipboard(postCopy).then(setCopyResult);
  };
  return <article className="deliverable-post-tile">
    <button type="button" className="post-tile-thumb" onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`Open ${task.title}`}>
      {image?.imageUrl ? <img src={image.imageUrl} alt="" /> : <span aria-hidden="true">POST</span>}
    </button>
    <div className="post-tile-copy">
      <small>{readyKindLabelForTask(task)}</small>
      <b>{task.title}</b>
      <span className={posted ? "post-tile-chip posted" : toPost ? "post-tile-chip to-post" : "post-tile-chip"}>{statusLabel}</span>
      {clearsIn && <span className="post-tile-clear-note">posted · {clearsIn}</span>}
      <time>{formatStamp(task.approvedAt ?? task.created)}</time>
    </div>
    <div className="post-tile-actions">
      <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`Open ${task.title}`}>Open</button>
      {postCopy ? <button type="button" onClick={copy} aria-label={`Copy post text for ${task.title}`}>{copyResult === "text" ? "Copied ✓" : "Copy post"}</button> : null}
      {toPost && onMarkPosted ? <button type="button" className="post-tile-mark-posted" onClick={onMarkPosted} disabled={markPostedBusy} aria-label={`Mark ${task.title} as posted`}>Mark posted</button> : null}
    </div>
    {copyResult === "failed" && <>
      <p className="post-tile-copy-note" role="alert">That copy didn’t take. Long-press the text in the box below, tap Select All, then Copy.</p>
      <ManualCopyBox text={postCopy} rows={5} label={`Post text for ${task.title} — long-press, select all, and copy it manually`} />
    </>}
    {copyResult === "text" && image?.imageUrl && <p className="post-tile-copy-note" role="status">Text copied ✓ — the image is not on your clipboard: open the post to download it.</p>}
  </article>;
}

// The ONE Deliverables body, shared by the desktop Deliverables tab and
// Flow Deliverables (Ben's design, 2026-10-16): a kind dropdown on top —
// All · Posts · Packages · Files · Reports — and each kind rendered at
// its proper size underneath. "All" groups the kinds under small
// headings (Posts, then Packages, then Files, then Reports); a single
// kind shows only that kind. Posts are compact tiles, packages are the
// full package cards, files and reports are compact rows — never one
// mixed stack of full-size cards.
function DeliverablesKindContent({ approvedTasks, libraryTasks, packages, clients, tasks, activeClient, onClearActiveClient, onMarkTaskPosted, taskPostedBusy, onApprovePackage, onReworkPackage, onFinishAssemblingPackage, onDownloadPackage, onSavePackageLink, packageDeliveryBusy, clientBusy, onOpenTask, idPrefix, expanded = false }: {
  approvedTasks: Task[];
  libraryTasks: Task[];
  packages: DeliveryPackage[];
  clients: Client[];
  tasks: Task[];
  activeClient: Client | null;
  onClearActiveClient: () => void;
  onMarkTaskPosted: (task: Task) => void;
  taskPostedBusy: boolean;
  onApprovePackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, keepPaths?: string[]) => void;
  onReworkPackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onFinishAssemblingPackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onDownloadPackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onSavePackageLink: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, url: string) => void;
  packageDeliveryBusy: boolean;
  clientBusy: boolean;
  onOpenTask: (task: Task) => void;
  idPrefix: string;
  expanded?: boolean;
}) {
  const [kindFilter, setKindFilter] = useState<DeliverableKindFilter>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const query = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  const matchesTask = (task: Task) => !query || `${task.title}\n${task.notes}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query);
  const groups = classifyDeliverableTasks([...approvedTasks, ...libraryTasks], packages);
  const posts = groups.posts.filter(matchesTask);
  const files = groups.files.filter(matchesTask);
  const reports = groups.reports.filter(matchesTask);
  const clientNameFor = (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => clients.find((client) => client.id === pkg.clientId)?.businessName ?? "";
  const matchesPackage = (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => !query || `${pkg.title}\n${clientNameFor(pkg)}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query);
  const assemblingPackages = packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "assembling" && matchesPackage(pkg));
  const readyPackages = packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "ready" && matchesPackage(pkg));
  const deliveredPackages = packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "delivered" && matchesPackage(pkg));
  const packageCount = packages.length;
  const showPosts = kindFilter === "all" || kindFilter === "posts";
  const showPackages = kindFilter === "all" || kindFilter === "packages";
  const showFiles = kindFilter === "all" || kindFilter === "files";
  const showReports = kindFilter === "all" || kindFilter === "reports";
  const emptyGroup = (label: string) => kindFilter === "all"
    ? <p className="deliverable-group-empty">No {label} right now.</p>
    : <div className="simple-empty"><b>No {label} found.</b><span>{query ? "Try another search." : "Nothing of this kind has been finished yet."}</span></div>;
  return <div className="deliverables-kind-view">
    <div className="deliverable-kind-bar">
      <label className="deliverable-kind-field"><span>Show</span>
        <select value={kindFilter} onChange={(event) => setKindFilter(event.target.value as DeliverableKindFilter)} aria-label="Filter deliverables by kind">
          <option value="all">All</option>
          <option value="posts">Posts</option>
          <option value="packages">Packages</option>
          <option value="files">Files</option>
          <option value="reports">Reports</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="deliverable-search-field"><span className="search-mark" aria-hidden="true" /><input value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search deliverables" aria-label="Search deliverables" /></label>
      <span className="deliverable-kind-count" aria-label={`${groups.posts.length + packageCount + groups.files.length + groups.reports.length} deliverables in total`}>{groups.posts.length} posts · {packageCount} packages · {groups.files.length} files · {groups.reports.length} reports</span>
    </div>
    {activeClient && <ActiveClientBanner client={activeClient} surface="The Posts, Files and Reports below show only this client's deliverables. Packages still show everyone." onClear={onClearActiveClient} />}

    {showPosts && <div className="deliverables-subsection" aria-labelledby={`${idPrefix}-posts-title`}>
      <div className="simple-section-head deliverables-subhead"><div><h4 id={`${idPrefix}-posts-title`}>Posts</h4><p>Finished social posts as tiles. Open one for the full post and its image; copy its text or mark it posted right from the tile. A posted post clears itself from here 24 hours after it goes up — its tile shows the countdown, and the job itself stays in Done history.</p></div><span className="post-queue-count approved-count" aria-label={`${posts.length} ${posts.length === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}`}>{posts.length} {posts.length === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}</span></div>
      {posts.length ? <div className="deliverable-gallery post-tile-grid">{posts.map((task) => <PostTile key={task.id} task={task} onOpen={() => onOpenTask(task)} onMarkPosted={() => onMarkTaskPosted(task)} markPostedBusy={taskPostedBusy} />)}</div> : emptyGroup("posts")}
    </div>}

    {showPackages && <div className="deliverables-subsection" aria-labelledby={`${idPrefix}-packages-title`}>
      <div className="simple-section-head deliverables-subhead"><div><h4 id={`${idPrefix}-packages-title`}>Packages</h4><p>Delivery packages Maria assembled from approved client jobs. Approve one and it is marked Delivered; its link joins that client’s Finished work. The same cards also live under their client in Clients.</p></div><span className="post-queue-count approved-count" aria-label={`${readyPackages.length} ${readyPackages.length === 1 ? "package" : "packages"} waiting for your decision`}>{readyPackages.length} to decide</span></div>
      {assemblingPackages.length ? <div className="client-package-list assembling-list">{assemblingPackages.map((pkg) => <AssemblingPackageCard key={pkg.id} pkg={pkg} client={clients.find((client) => client.id === pkg.clientId)} onFinish={() => onFinishAssemblingPackage(pkg)} busy={clientBusy} />)}</div> : null}
      {readyPackages.length ? <div className="client-package-list">{readyPackages.map((pkg, index) => <DeliveryPackageCard key={pkg.id} pkg={pkg} client={clients.find((client) => client.id === pkg.clientId)} sourceTask={tasks.find((task) => task.id === pkg.taskId)} positionLabel={expanded ? `${index + 1} of ${readyPackages.length}` : undefined} onApprove={(keepPaths) => onApprovePackage(pkg, keepPaths)} onRework={() => onReworkPackage(pkg)} onOpenTask={onOpenTask} onDownload={onDownloadPackage} onSaveLink={onSavePackageLink} deliveryBusy={packageDeliveryBusy} busy={clientBusy} />)}</div> : null}
      {deliveredPackages.length ? <>
        <div className="simple-section-head deliverables-subhead delivered-subhead"><div><h4 id={`${idPrefix}-delivered-packages-title`}>Delivered packages</h4><p>Packages already delivered. Download the customer ZIP again any time, or update the customer download link saved on the package — the same link shows in that client’s Finished work.</p></div><span className="post-queue-count approved-count" aria-label={`${deliveredPackages.length} ${deliveredPackages.length === 1 ? "package" : "packages"} delivered`}>{deliveredPackages.length} delivered</span></div>
        <div className="client-package-list">{deliveredPackages.map((pkg) => <DeliveryPackageCard key={pkg.id} pkg={pkg} client={clients.find((client) => client.id === pkg.clientId)} sourceTask={tasks.find((task) => task.id === pkg.taskId)} onApprove={() => undefined} onRework={() => undefined} onOpenTask={onOpenTask} onDownload={onDownloadPackage} onSaveLink={onSavePackageLink} deliveryBusy={packageDeliveryBusy} busy={clientBusy} />)}</div>
      </> : null}
      {!assemblingPackages.length && !readyPackages.length && !deliveredPackages.length ? emptyGroup("packages") : null}
    </div>}

    {showFiles && <div className="deliverables-subsection" aria-labelledby={`${idPrefix}-files-title`}>
      <div className="simple-section-head deliverables-subhead"><div><h4 id={`${idPrefix}-files-title`}>Files</h4><p>Standalone finished files — documents, web pages, research briefs and other work that is not a post, a package, or a client report.</p></div><span className="post-queue-count library-count" aria-label={`${files.length} ${files.length === 1 ? "file" : "files"}`}>{files.length} {files.length === 1 ? "file" : "files"}</span></div>
      {files.length ? <div className="deliverable-row-list">{files.map((task) => <DeliverableRow key={task.id} task={task} kindLabel={readyKindLabelForTask(task)} onOpen={() => onOpenTask(task)} />)}</div> : emptyGroup("files")}
    </div>}

    {showReports && <div className="deliverables-subsection" aria-labelledby={`${idPrefix}-reports-title`}>
      <div className="simple-section-head deliverables-subhead"><div><h4 id={`${idPrefix}-reports-title`}>Reports</h4><p>Finished client reports — the periodic record Maria assembles for a client from office records.</p></div><span className="post-queue-count library-count" aria-label={`${reports.length} ${reports.length === 1 ? "report" : "reports"}`}>{reports.length} {reports.length === 1 ? "report" : "reports"}</span></div>
      {reports.length ? <div className="deliverable-row-list">{reports.map((task) => <DeliverableRow key={task.id} task={task} kindLabel="Client report" onOpen={() => onOpenTask(task)} />)}</div> : emptyGroup("reports")}
    </div>}
  </div>;
}

// A standalone deliverable file or a client report at its proper size:
// one compact row — a small thumbnail or kind mark, the title, its kind
// and date, and Open. Files and reports never render as full-size cards.
function DeliverableRow({ task, kindLabel, onOpen }: { task: Task; kindLabel: string; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const deliverables = useTaskDeliverablesQuery(task.id, task.revision);
  const image = deliverables.data?.items.find((item) => item.kind === "image" && item.imageUrl);
  const posted = isPostedPackage(task);
  return <article className="deliverable-row">
    <span className="deliverable-row-thumb">{image?.imageUrl ? <img src={image.imageUrl} alt="" /> : <span aria-hidden="true">{kindLabel === "Client report" ? "REPORT" : "FILE"}</span>}</span>
    <span className="deliverable-row-copy"><small>{kindLabel}</small><b>{task.title}</b><time>{formatStamp(task.approvedAt ?? task.created)}</time></span>
    {posted && <span className="deliverable-posted-badge">Posted{task.postedAt ? ` · ${formatStamp(task.postedAt)}` : ""}</span>}
    <button type="button" className="deliverable-row-open" onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`Open ${task.title}`}>Open</button>
  </article>;
}

const IDEA_CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<VisionaryIdea["category"], string> = {
  content: "Content angle",
  product: "Product idea",
  venture: "Revenue move",
  office: "Office feature",
  trend: "Opportunity",
};

const IDEA_SCOPE_LABELS: Record<VisionaryIdea["scope"], string> = {
  within: "Build what exists",
  outside: "New territory",
  previous: "Earlier idea",
};

function sourceLabel(value: string, index: number): string {
  try { return new URL(value).hostname.replace(/^www\./, ""); } catch { return `Source ${index + 1}`; }
}

function VisionaryIdeaCard({ idea, onLaunch, onDeny, sending, denying }: { idea: VisionaryIdea; onLaunch: (ideaId: string) => void; onDeny: (ideaId: string) => void; sending: boolean; denying: boolean }) {
  const completed = Boolean(idea.launchedTaskId);
  return <article className={completed ? "visionary-card launched" : "visionary-card"}>
    <header><div className="visionary-badges"><span className={`visionary-scope ${idea.scope}`}>{IDEA_SCOPE_LABELS[idea.scope]}</span><span>{IDEA_CATEGORY_LABELS[idea.category]}</span></div><time>{formatStamp(idea.createdAt)}</time></header>
    <h4>{idea.title}</h4>
    <div className="visionary-plain"><b>In plain words</b><p>{idea.plainSummary}</p></div>
    <div className="visionary-reason"><b>Why it’s worth doing</b><p>{idea.rationale}</p></div>
    <div className="visionary-next"><b>First move</b><p>{idea.nextStep}</p></div>
    {idea.sourceUrls.length > 0 && <div className="visionary-sources" aria-label="Sources">{idea.sourceUrls.map((url, index) => <a key={url} href={url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{sourceLabel(url, index)}<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>)}</div>}
    {completed ? <div className="visionary-completed" role="status"><span aria-hidden="true">✓</span> Sent to Remmy</div> : <div className="visionary-actions">
      <button className="visionary-launch" type="button" onClick={() => onLaunch(idea.id)} disabled={sending || denying} aria-label={`Send ${idea.title} to Remmy`}>{sending ? "Sending…" : "Send to Remmy"}</button>
      <button className="visionary-deny" type="button" onClick={() => onDeny(idea.id)} disabled={sending || denying} aria-label={`Deny ${idea.title}`}>{denying ? "Removing…" : "Deny"}</button>
    </div>}
  </article>;
}

// A story card on one of Sven's shelves. Stories are candidates he found —

    </div>
  </article>;
}

function LiveAgentTerminal({ briefs, log }: { briefs: Brief[]; log: OfficeLogEntry[] }) {
  const tailRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const activeBriefs = briefs.filter((brief) => brief.status === "in_progress");
  const workerNames = new Set(MEMBERS.map((member) => member.name));
  const lines = log
    .map((entry) => {
      const separator = entry.text.indexOf(":");
      if (separator <= 0) return null;
      const name = entry.text.slice(0, separator);
      if (!workerNames.has(name)) return null;
      return { ...entry, name, message: entry.text.slice(separator + 1).trim() };
    })
    .filter((entry): entry is OfficeLogEntry & { name: string; message: string } => Boolean(entry))
    .slice(0, 60)
    .reverse();

  useEffect(() => {
    const tail = tailRef.current;
    if (tail) tail.scrollTop = tail.scrollHeight;
  }, [lines.length, activeBriefs.map((brief) => `${brief.id}:${brief.progressText ?? ""}`).join("|")]);

  return <div className="agent-terminal" aria-label="Live agent terminal">
    <header><span className="terminal-lights" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></span><b>crew://live</b><span className="terminal-connection"><i aria-hidden="true" />{activeBriefs.length} active</span></header>
    <div className="terminal-active" aria-label="Active crew work">
      {activeBriefs.length ? activeBriefs.map((brief) => {
        const member = memberById(brief.assignee);
        return <article key={brief.id}><div><span style={{ background: member?.color ?? "var(--cyan)" }} aria-hidden="true" /><b>{member?.name ?? "Crew"}</b><small>{brief.title}</small></div><p>{brief.progressText ?? "Working…"}</p><time>{formatStamp(brief.lastHeartbeatAt ?? brief.updatedAt)}</time></article>;
      }) : <p className="terminal-idle"><span>$</span> No crew process is active right now.</p>}
    </div>
    <div className="terminal-tail" ref={tailRef} role="log" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Crew activity stream">
      {lines.length ? lines.map((entry) => <div className="terminal-line" key={entry.id}><time>{new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" }).format(new Date(entry.t))}</time><b>[{entry.name}]</b><span className={entry.message.startsWith("Tool ·") ? "tool-call" : ""}>{entry.message}</span></div>) : <div className="terminal-line terminal-empty"><span>$ Waiting for the next crew update…</span></div>}
      <span className="terminal-cursor" aria-hidden="true">▋</span>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

// Copying a post's text — layered, and never claimed on faith.
//
// Layer 1 (synchronous, inside the tap): the canonical textarea copy.
// A temp editable textarea is laid out in the viewport at a real size
// and only nearly transparent (iOS Safari and Android WebViews refuse
// to copy a selection from a readonly, display:none, or fully
// transparent field), given the text, focused, and selected via
// select()/setSelectionRange; document.execCommand("copy") then copies
// that selection, and its return value is the confirmation.
//
// The previous version additionally mirrored the selection into a
// document Range over the textarea (range.selectNodeContents(area)) as
// a "second grip" for Android Chrome. That mirror was the bug: a
// textarea's value is NOT a child text node, so the range spanned zero
// characters, and removeAllRanges()+addRange REPLACED the real
// selection with that empty one. execCommand could then report success
// while copying nothing — the button said "Copied ✓" and the paste
// came up empty. The mirror is gone. The textarea's own selection is
// the one grip, and it is verified full-length before the copy runs.
//
// This has to run as the very first thing in the click handler's own
// turn, before any state update or await: once the handler yields, the
// tap's user activation is gone and mobile browsers refuse the copy too.
function copyTextSync(text: string): boolean {
  let area: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
  try {
    area = document.createElement("textarea");
    area.value = text;
    area.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    area.style.position = "fixed";
    area.style.top = "12px";
    area.style.left = "12px";
    area.style.width = "240px";
    area.style.height = "120px";
    area.style.padding = "0";
    area.style.border = "none";
    area.style.outline = "none";
    area.style.boxShadow = "none";
    area.style.background = "transparent";
    area.style.color = "transparent";
    area.style.fontSize = "16px";
    area.style.opacity = "0.05";
    area.style.zIndex = "9999";
    document.body.appendChild(area);
    area.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    area.select();
    area.setSelectionRange(0, text.length);
    // Never trust a copy attempted on a partial or empty selection:
    // that is exactly how the old code produced a lying checkmark.
    if (area.selectionStart !== 0 || area.selectionEnd !== text.length) return false;
    if (typeof document.execCommand !== "function") return false;
    return document.execCommand("copy");
  } catch {
    return false;
  } finally {
    try { area?.remove(); } catch { /* already gone */ }
  }
}

type PostCopyResult = "text" | "failed";

// Copy a post's TEXT only. Images are never written to the clipboard
// and never claimed as copied: the card keeps the image visible with
// its own Save/Download control, and the result note for an image post
// says plainly that the image is not on the clipboard.
//
// Layer 1 is the synchronous copy above, attempted in this function's
// first turn — the caller's tap — before any await. Layer 2, only when
// layer 1 cannot run or reports failure, is the async Clipboard API —
// but a resolved writeText promise is NOT taken as proof: on Ben's
// Galaxy S20 FE in the Muse Android app (2026-10-15) an async
// clipboard write RESOLVED while nothing reached the clipboard at
// paste time. So layer 2 counts only when a read-back returns the
// exact text; anything else is "failed" and the card shows the manual
// box instead of a checkmark.
async function copyPostToClipboard(text: string): Promise<PostCopyResult> {
  if (copyTextSync(text)) return "text";
  try {
    if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      try {
        const readBack = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
        if (readBack === text) return "text";
      } catch {
        // Read-back unavailable or denied: the write stays unproven.
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Clipboard API unavailable or denied: fall through to "failed".
  }
  return "failed";
}

// The manual rescue shown whenever a copy cannot be confirmed: the full
// post text in a visible, editable field the OS selection toolbar can
// grip — long-press (or tap) selects it, then Select All → Copy from the
// toolbar puts it on the clipboard by hand. Uncontrolled (defaultValue)
// so the field stays selectable/editable; editing it changes nothing in
// the stored post.
function ManualCopyBox({ text, rows, label }: { text: string; rows: number; label: string }) {
  return <textarea
    key={text}
    className="copy-post-manual"
    defaultValue={text}
    rows={rows}
    autoFocus
    aria-label={label}
    onFocus={(event) => event.currentTarget.select()}
    onClick={(event) => event.currentTarget.select()}
  />;
}

function XPostMedia({ post }: { post: XPost }) {
  if (!post.hasImage) return null;
  const fileName = post.imagePath?.split("/").at(-1) ?? "pulse-hq-x-post-image.png";
  return <figure className="x-post-media">
    {post.imageUrl
      ? <img src={post.imageUrl} alt="Image attached to this drafted X post" loading="lazy" />
      : <figcaption className="x-post-media-missing">Attached image is saved with this post but could not be loaded for preview right now.</figcaption>}
    {post.imageUrl && <a className="x-post-download" href={post.imageUrl} download={fileName} aria-label="Download the image attached to this post">Save image</a>}
  </figure>;
}

function XPostCard({ post, onMarkPosted, onDelete, busy }: { post: XPost; onMarkPosted: () => void; onDelete: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const [copyResult, setCopyResult] = useState<PostCopyResult | null>(null);
  function copy() {
    // copyPostToClipboard makes its synchronous copy attempt in its
    // first turn — inside this tap, before any await — and resolves
    // only with a confirmed result. The result note then stays until
    // the next copy attempt, so a "text only" caveat is still there
    // at paste time.
    void copyPostToClipboard(post.text).then(setCopyResult);
  }
  const branchLabel = post.hasImage && post.hasLink ? "Link + image" : post.hasImage ? "Image attached" : post.hasLink ? "Link included" : "Draft";
  return <article className="x-post-card">
    <header><span className="x-post-source">{post.source === "standing" ? "Monday batch" : "Manual request"}</span><span className="x-post-branch">{branchLabel}</span><time>{formatStamp(post.createdAt)}</time></header>
    <p className="x-post-text">{post.text}</p>
    <XPostMedia post={post} />
    {copyResult === "text" && <p className="x-post-copy-note rich" role="status">{post.hasImage ? "Text copied ✓ — the image is not on your clipboard: use Save image on this card and attach it in X." : "Text copied ✓ — paste it into X."}</p>}
    {copyResult === "failed" && <>
      <p className="x-post-copy-failed" role="alert">That copy didn't take. Long-press the text in the box below, tap Select All, then Copy, and paste into X.{post.hasImage ? " The image stays on this card — use Save image and attach it in X." : ""}</p>
      <ManualCopyBox text={post.text} rows={4} label="Post text — long-press, select all, and copy it manually" />
    </>}
    <footer>
      <span className="x-post-meta">{post.text.length} / 280 · Drafted by Olivia</span>
      <div className="x-post-actions">
        <button className="x-post-delete" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label="Delete this drafted post">Delete</button>
        <button className="x-post-posted" type="button" onClick={onMarkPosted} disabled={busy} aria-label="Mark this post as posted">Mark posted</button>
        <button className="x-post-copy" type="button" onClick={copy} aria-label="Copy this post text">{copyResult === "text" ? "Copied text ✓" : "Copy post text"}</button>
      </div>
    </footer>
  </article>;
}

const CLIENT_STATUS_LABELS: Record<ClientStatus, string> = { prospect: "Prospect", pilot: "Pilot", retainer: "Retainer", paused: "Paused" };
const CLIENT_REPORT_LABELS: Record<ClientReportCadence, string> = { off: "Reports off", weekly: "Weekly report", monthly: "Monthly report" };
function clientPhotoLibraryText(client: Client): string {
  if (client.photoLibraryStatus === "provided") return client.photoLibraryLocation ? `Provided — ${client.photoLibraryLocation}` : "Provided — the client gave Pulse HQ their own photos";
  if (client.photoLibraryStatus === "none") return "None provided — no client photos to use";
  return "Not recorded yet — Maria asks for their photos at onboarding";
}

// Ready for You — plain words for the decision tray. The face of a
// waiting card carries only its label (whose it is / what kind it is),
// the title, how long it has been waiting, the finished result itself
// rendered readable (see buildReadyPlan / ReadyResultFace), and the
// decision buttons. Everything else — full source documents, the crew's
// working papers, work summaries, the outcome-contract note, package
// operations — lives behind the one “Extras” door and is not rendered
// until the card is first opened.
function readyKindLabelForTask(task: Task): string {
  if (task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" || task.jobType === "perfectly_paranoid") return "Perfectly Paranoid post";
  if (task.pipeline === "research_case" || task.jobType === "research") return "Research case";
  if (task.pipeline === "client_report" || task.jobType === "client_report") return "Client report";
  if (task.pipeline === "market_briefing" || task.jobType === "market_briefing") return "Market briefing";
  if (task.pipeline === "creative_package" || task.jobType === "creative_package") return "Creative package";
  if (task.pipeline === "x_posts" || task.jobType === "x_posts") return "Posts for X";
  if (isMerchTask(task)) return "Design package";
  if (task.jobType === "standard") return "Standard job";
  if (task.clientId) return "Client work";
  return "Finished work";
}

// Package delivery (Ben, 2026-10-16): the customer download link lives in
// the package card's extras. Ben hosts the package ZIP himself (Google Drive) and
// pastes its link here; saving it marks a ready package Delivered, and the
// same link shows in the client's Finished work. The saved link is shown
// labelled and copyable, and can be replaced at any time.
function PackageCustomerLink({ pkg, onSaveLink, busy }: {
  pkg: DeliveryPackage;
  onSaveLink: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, url: string) => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [copyState, setCopyState] = useState<"idle" | "copied" | "failed">("idle");
  const startEditing = () => { setDraft(pkg.customerLink ?? ""); setEditing(true); };
  const submit = () => {
    const url = draft.trim();
    if (!url) return;
    onSaveLink(pkg, url);
    setEditing(false);
  };
  const copyLink = async () => {
    if (!pkg.customerLink) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(pkg.customerLink);
      setCopyState("copied");
    } catch {
      setCopyState("failed");
    }
  };
  return <div className="package-customer-link">
    <b className="package-customer-link-label">Customer download link</b>
    {pkg.customerLink && !editing && <>
      <span className="package-customer-link-row">
        <a href={pkg.customerLink} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`Open the customer download link for ${pkg.title}`}>{pkg.customerLink}</a>
        <button type="button" onClick={copyLink} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Copy the customer download link for ${pkg.title}`}>{copyState === "copied" ? "Copied ✓" : "Copy link"}</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={startEditing} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Change the customer download link for ${pkg.title}`}>Change link</button>
      </span>
      {copyState === "failed" && <span className="package-customer-link-note" role="alert">That copy didn't take — long-press or select the link above and copy it by hand.</span>}
      {pkg.status === "delivered" && <span className="package-customer-link-note">This is the link to send the customer. It also shows in their Finished work.</span>}
    </>}
    {(!pkg.customerLink || editing) && <div className="package-customer-link-form">
      <label className="field" htmlFor={`package-link-${pkg.id}`}>Paste the hosted ZIP link (e.g. the Google Drive link) {pkg.status === "ready" ? "— saving it marks this package Delivered" : ""}</label>
      <span className="package-customer-link-input-row">
        <input id={`package-link-${pkg.id}`} className="field-control" type="url" inputMode="url" placeholder="https://drive.google.com/…" value={draft} onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)} maxLength={2000} aria-label={`Customer download link for ${pkg.title}`} />
        <button type="button" className="package-link-save" onClick={submit} disabled={busy || !draft.trim()} aria-label={`Save the customer download link for ${pkg.title}`}>{pkg.status === "ready" ? "Save link — mark Delivered" : "Save link"}</button>
        {editing && <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(false)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>}
      </span>
    </div>}
  </div>;
}

function DeliveryPackageCard(props: {
  pkg: DeliveryPackage;
  client?: Client;
  sourceTask?: Task;
  positionLabel?: string;
  onApprove: (keepPaths?: string[]) => void;
  onRework: () => void;
  onOpenTask: (task: Task) => void;
  onDownload?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onSaveLink?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, url: string) => void;
  deliveryBusy?: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  // The batch selection scope is keyed by the SOURCE job's id: the grid in
  // this card's details and this card's Accept share the one selection.
  if (!props.sourceTask) return <DeliveryPackageCardInner {...props} />;
  return <BatchSelectionScope taskId={props.sourceTask.id}><DeliveryPackageCardInner {...props} /></BatchSelectionScope>;
}

function DeliveryPackageCardInner({ pkg, client, sourceTask, positionLabel, onApprove, onRework, onOpenTask, onDownload, onSaveLink, deliveryBusy, busy }: {
  pkg: DeliveryPackage;
  client?: Client;
  sourceTask?: Task;
  positionLabel?: string;
  onApprove: (keepPaths?: string[]) => void;
  onRework: () => void;
  onOpenTask: (task: Task) => void;
  onDownload?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onSaveLink?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, url: string) => void;
  deliveryBusy?: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const [extrasOpen, setExtrasOpen] = useState(false);
  const [extrasOpened, setExtrasOpened] = useState(false);
  const clientName = client?.businessName ?? "Client";
  // Batch image decision at the package door: when the package's images
  // still have no keep/delete decision, this card's grid decides them and
  // its one Accept approves the package with only the kept images — no
  // separate image step, no per-image wizard. Once every image carries a
  // decision (or there are none), the card approves exactly as before.
  // The grid itself is part of the face now (it IS what the client is
  // getting), so no auto-expanding details are needed any more.
  const deliverables = useTaskDeliverablesQuery(sourceTask?.id ?? "", sourceTask?.revision ?? 0, Boolean(sourceTask));
  const images = deliverables.data?.items.filter((item) => item.kind === "image" && !item.excluded) ?? [];
  const batchApplies = pkg.status === "ready" && Boolean(sourceTask) && images.length > 0 && images.every((item) => item.reviewStatus === null);
  const batch = useBatchSelection(sourceTask?.id ?? "");
  const keepPaths = batchApplies ? images.filter((item) => batch?.selected.has(item.relativePath)).map((item) => item.relativePath) : [];
  const checking = Boolean(sourceTask) && pkg.status === "ready" && deliverables.isLoading;
  const plan = useReadyResultPlan(sourceTask?.id ?? "", sourceTask?.revision ?? 0, sourceTask, Boolean(sourceTask));
  const hasExtras = Boolean(sourceTask) || Boolean(onSaveLink && (pkg.status === "ready" || pkg.status === "delivered"));
  const toggleExtras = () => {
    if (!extrasOpen) setExtrasOpened(true);
    setExtrasOpen((value) => !value);
  };
  return <article className="client-package-card ready-compact">
    <div className="ready-card-face">
      <div className="ready-card-meta">
        <span className="ready-card-label">For {clientName} · Delivery package</span>
        {positionLabel && <span className="ready-card-position" aria-label={`Position ${positionLabel} in this list`}>{positionLabel}</span>}
        {/* Waiting since = the package's updatedAt: the server stamps it
            in the same write that flips the package to ready, and nothing
            updates a ready package until Ben decides on it. */}
        {pkg.status === "delivered"
          ? <span className="ready-card-waiting">Delivered {formatWaitingStamp(pkg.deliveredAt ?? pkg.updatedAt)}</span>
          : <span className="ready-card-waiting">Waiting since {formatWaitingStamp(pkg.updatedAt)}</span>}
      </div>
      <h4 className="ready-card-title">{pkg.title}</h4>
      {sourceTask && plan.resultLead && <p className="ready-result-lead">{plan.resultLead}</p>}
      {sourceTask
        ? <ReadyResultFace task={sourceTask} plan={plan} reviewMode={false} batchSelect={batchApplies} />
        : pkg.coverNote ? <p className="ready-card-summary">{pkg.coverNote}</p> : null}
    </div>
    {batchApplies && <p className="item-review-progress"><b>{keepPaths.length} of {images.length} selected to keep</b><span>{images.length - keepPaths.length} will be deleted</span></p>}
    {batchApplies && keepPaths.length === 0 && <p className="batch-select-note" role="note">Select at least one image to keep — or send the package back for rework instead.</p>}
    <div className="client-card-actions package-actions">
      {pkg.status === "ready" && (batchApplies
        ? <button type="button" className="approve-package-button" onClick={() => onApprove(keepPaths)} disabled={busy || checking || keepPaths.length === 0}>{checking ? "Checking files…" : "Accept — approve package with the kept images"}</button>
        : <button type="button" className="approve-package-button" onClick={() => onApprove()} disabled={busy || checking}>{checking ? "Checking files…" : "Approve package — mark Delivered"}</button>)}
      {pkg.status === "ready" && <button type="button" onClick={onRework} disabled={busy}>Rework</button>}
      {/* Re-download (Ben, 2026-10-16): the ZIP button lives on READY and
          DELIVERED packages alike, in both of this card's homes, and it is
          never a one-shot — the server rebuilds the ZIP from the package's
          current files on every click. It is not disabled by another
          package's download or a link save (deliveryBusy); only this
          card's own decision actions (busy) pause it. */}
      {onDownload && (pkg.status === "ready" || pkg.status === "delivered") && <button type="button" className="download-package-button" onClick={() => onDownload(pkg)} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Download package (.zip) for ${pkg.title}`}>Download package (.zip)</button>}
    </div>
    {hasExtras && <button type="button" className="ready-details-toggle" aria-expanded={extrasOpen} onClick={toggleExtras}>{extrasOpen ? "Hide extras" : "Extras — full documents, paperwork & package tools"}</button>}
    {extrasOpened && hasExtras && <div className="ready-card-details" hidden={!extrasOpen}>
      {sourceTask
        ? <ReadyExtrasShelf entries={[...(pkg.coverNote ? [{ key: "cover-note", kind: "note" as const, title: "Maria’s cover note", markdown: pkg.coverNote, isSven: false }] : []), ...plan.extras]} notes={plan.extrasNotes} />
        : <p className="sheet-sub">The job behind this package could not be found.</p>}
      {sourceTask && <div className="package-extras-actions"><button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenTask(sourceTask)} disabled={busy}>Open the job</button></div>}
      {onSaveLink && (pkg.status === "ready" || pkg.status === "delivered") && <PackageCustomerLink pkg={pkg} onSaveLink={onSaveLink} busy={busy || Boolean(deliveryBusy)} />}
    </div>}
  </article>;
}

// How long a package has been assembling, in plain words.
function assemblingForLabel(createdAt: string): string {
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(createdAt).getTime()) / 60000));
  if (minutes < 1) return "just started";
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 48) return `${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return `${days} day${days === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
}

// Phase 5: a package stuck in "assembling" is visible — with how long it
// has been waiting — and carries a working "Finish assembling" retry.
// Before this card existed, such a package sat invisible forever:
// approval refuses the assembling state and nothing retried it.
function AssemblingPackageCard({ pkg, client, onFinish, busy }: {
  pkg: DeliveryPackage;
  client?: Client;
  onFinish: () => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const clientName = client?.businessName ?? "Client";
  return <article className="client-package-card assembling ready-compact" aria-label={`Package still assembling: ${pkg.title}`}>
    <div className="ready-card-face">
      <span className="ready-card-label">For {clientName} · Still assembling</span>
      <h4 className="ready-card-title">{pkg.title}</h4>
      <p className="ready-card-summary">Maria has been assembling this package for {assemblingForLabel(pkg.createdAt)}. If it seems stuck, ask her to finish it — she re-runs the assembly and the package lands here when it’s ready.</p>
    </div>
    <div className="client-card-actions package-actions">
      <button type="button" className="approve-package-button" onClick={onFinish} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Finish assembling ${pkg.title}`}>Finish assembling</button>
    </div>
  </article>;
}

// Phase 3, Stage B — the scoped-view banner. Any view that is filtered
// to the active client carries this, naming the client and offering the
// one-tap way back to everyone, so a scoped view can never silently look
// like the whole office.
function ActiveClientBanner({ client, surface, onClear }: { client: Client; surface: string; onClear: () => void }) {
  return <div className="active-client-banner" role="status">
    <p><b>Showing only {client.businessName}.</b><span>{surface}</span></p>
    <button type="button" onClick={onClear} aria-label={`Show all clients instead of only ${client.businessName}`}>All clients</button>
  </div>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shipped & Revenue (Ben's design, 2026-10-16): the plain ledger of what
// shipped and what it earned. The same view renders in the desktop Work
// panel (its own tab) and in Flow. Totals are read straight off the rows:
// Revenue is the paid amounts added up, Owed is the owed amounts, Jobs
// shipped is the row count, and This month is the paid amounts whose
// shipped date falls in the current month. All money is CAD.
function formatCadAmount(cents: number): string {
  return `$${(cents / 100).toLocaleString("en-CA", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
}
function ledgerDayLabel(isoDate: string): string {
  const [y = 1970, m = 1, d = 1] = isoDate.split("-").map(Number);
  return new Date(y, m - 1, d).toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
}
function todayLedgerDate(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  return `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}
function parseAmountToCents(text: string): number | null | "invalid" {
  const trimmed = text.trim().replace(/^\$/, "").replace(/,/g, "");
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  const value = Number(trimmed);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return "invalid";
  return Math.round(value * 100);
}

function LedgerView({ entries, clients, busy, onAdd, onUpdate, onDelete }: {
  entries: LedgerEntry[];
  clients: Client[];
  busy: boolean;
  onAdd: (input: LedgerAddInput) => void;
  onUpdate: (input: LedgerUpdateInput) => void;
  onDelete: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [showAddForm, setShowAddForm] = useState(false);
  const revenueCents = entries.filter((entry) => entry.status === "paid").reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const owedCents = entries.filter((entry) => entry.status === "owed").reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const thisMonthPrefix = todayLedgerDate().slice(0, 7);
  const thisMonthCents = entries.filter((entry) => entry.status === "paid" && entry.shippedDate.startsWith(thisMonthPrefix)).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  return <div className="ledger-view">
    <div className="ledger-totals">
      <div className="ledger-total"><span>Revenue</span><b>{formatCadAmount(revenueCents)}</b><small>This month: {formatCadAmount(thisMonthCents)}</small></div>
      <div className="ledger-total"><span>Owed</span><b>{formatCadAmount(owedCents)}</b><small>Shipped, not yet paid</small></div>
      <div className="ledger-total"><span>Jobs shipped</span><b>{entries.length}</b><small>{entries.length === 1 ? "row in the book" : "rows in the book"}</small></div>
    </div>
    {showAddForm
      ? <LedgerAddForm clients={clients} busy={busy} onCancel={() => setShowAddForm(false)} onSubmit={(input) => { onAdd(input); setShowAddForm(false); }} />
      : <button type="button" className="preset-new-button ledger-add-button" onClick={() => setShowAddForm(true)}>+ Add a row by hand</button>}
    {entries.length ? <div className="ledger-list">{entries.map((entry) => <LedgerRow key={entry.id} entry={entry} busy={busy} onUpdate={onUpdate} onDelete={onDelete} />)}</div>
      : <div className="simple-empty"><b>Nothing shipped yet.</b><span>When an external client’s delivery package is delivered, its row lands here on its own. You can also add a row by hand for money that never touched a package.</span></div>}
  </div>;
}

function LedgerAddForm({ clients, busy, onCancel, onSubmit }: {
  clients: Client[];
  busy: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onSubmit: (input: LedgerAddInput) => void;
}) {
  const [shippedDate, setShippedDate] = useState(todayLedgerDate());
  const [clientId, setClientId] = useState("");
  const [clientLabel, setClientLabel] = useState("");
  const [whatShipped, setWhatShipped] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<LedgerStatus>("owed");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!whatShipped.trim()) { setError("Say what shipped — a few plain words is plenty."); return; }
    const cents = parseAmountToCents(amount);
    if (cents === "invalid") { setError("That amount does not look like a dollar figure — use numbers only, like 50 or 49.99."); return; }
    onSubmit({ shippedDate, clientId: clientId || null, clientLabel: clientId ? "" : clientLabel.trim(), whatShipped: whatShipped.trim(), amountCents: cents, status, method: method.trim(), note: note.trim() });
  }
  return <form className="ledger-form" onSubmit={submit} aria-label="Add a row to Shipped and Revenue by hand">
    <p className="ledger-form-title">Add a row by hand — for money that never touched a package, like a Skunk Tools sale.</p>
    <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-date">Date shipped</label>
    <input id="ledger-add-date" className="field-control" type="date" value={shippedDate} onChange={(event) => setShippedDate(event.target.value)} required />
    <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-client">Client <span className="field-optional">pick from the registry, or leave it and just write the name</span></label>
    <select id="ledger-add-client" className="field-control" value={clientId} onChange={(event) => setClientId(event.target.value)} aria-label="Client from the registry">
      <option value="">No registry client</option>
      {clients.map((client) => <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>{client.businessName}</option>)}
    </select>
    {!clientId && <>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-client-name">Client or buyer name <span className="field-optional">as you want it in the book</span></label>
      <input id="ledger-add-client-name" className="field-control" value={clientLabel} onChange={(event) => setClientLabel(event.target.value)} maxLength={160} placeholder="e.g. Skunk Tools buyer" />
    </>}
    <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-what">What shipped</label>
    <input id="ledger-add-what" className="field-control" value={whatShipped} onChange={(event) => setWhatShipped(event.target.value)} maxLength={300} placeholder="e.g. Skunk Tools suite — full set" required />
    <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-amount">Amount (CAD) <span className="field-optional">leave blank if it is not recorded yet</span></label>
    <input id="ledger-add-amount" className="field-control" inputMode="decimal" value={amount} onChange={(event) => setAmount(event.target.value)} maxLength={20} placeholder="e.g. 50" aria-label="Amount in Canadian dollars" />
    <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-status">Owed or paid</label>
    <select id="ledger-add-status" className="field-control" value={status} onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value as LedgerStatus)} aria-label="Owed or paid">
      <option value="owed">Owed — not paid yet</option>
      <option value="paid">Paid</option>
    </select>
    <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-method">How they paid <span className="field-optional">e-transfer, PayPal, cash…</span></label>
    <input id="ledger-add-method" className="field-control" value={method} onChange={(event) => setMethod(event.target.value)} maxLength={60} placeholder="e.g. e-transfer" />
    <label className="field" htmlFor="ledger-add-note">Note <span className="field-optional">one line, anything worth remembering</span></label>
    <input id="ledger-add-note" className="field-control" value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={500} />
    {error && <p className="ledger-form-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    <div className="ledger-form-actions">
      <button type="submit" className="big-button" disabled={busy || !whatShipped.trim()}>{busy ? "Adding…" : "Add row"}</button>
      <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </form>;
}

function LedgerRow({ entry, busy, onUpdate, onDelete }: {
  entry: LedgerEntry;
  busy: boolean;
  onUpdate: (input: LedgerUpdateInput) => void;
  onDelete: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [confirmingDelete, setConfirmingDelete] = useState(false);
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(entry.amountCents === null ? "" : String(entry.amountCents / 100));
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<LedgerStatus>(entry.status);
  const [method, setMethod] = useState(entry.method);
  const [note, setNote] = useState(entry.note);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  // If the row changes underneath an open editor (a refetch lands), the
  // editor re-seeds from the fresh row rather than overwriting it later.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing) {
      setAmount(entry.amountCents === null ? "" : String(entry.amountCents / 100));
      setStatus(entry.status);
      setMethod(entry.method);
      setNote(entry.note);
    }
  }, [entry, editing]);
  function save(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const cents = parseAmountToCents(amount);
    if (cents === "invalid") { setError("That amount does not look like a dollar figure — use numbers only, like 50 or 49.99."); return; }
    onUpdate({ id: entry.id, amountCents: cents, status, method: method.trim(), note: note.trim() });
    setEditing(false);
  }
  const clientDisplay = entry.clientLabel || "No client recorded";
  if (editing) {
    return <form className="ledger-row ledger-row-editing" onSubmit={save} aria-label={`Edit the ledger row for ${entry.whatShipped}`}>
      <p className="ledger-form-title">{entry.whatShipped} <span>· {clientDisplay} · shipped {ledgerDayLabel(entry.shippedDate)}</span></p>
      <label className="field" htmlFor={`ledger-amount-${entry.id}`}>Amount (CAD) <span className="field-optional">leave blank if it is not recorded yet</span></label>
      <input id={`ledger-amount-${entry.id}`} className="field-control" inputMode="decimal" value={amount} onChange={(event) => setAmount(event.target.value)} maxLength={20} placeholder="e.g. 50" aria-label={`Amount in Canadian dollars for ${entry.whatShipped}`} />
      <label className="field" htmlFor={`ledger-status-${entry.id}`}>Owed or paid</label>
      <select id={`ledger-status-${entry.id}`} className="field-control" value={status} onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value as LedgerStatus)} aria-label={`Owed or paid for ${entry.whatShipped}`}>
        <option value="owed">Owed — not paid yet</option>
        <option value="paid">Paid</option>
      </select>
      <label className="field" htmlFor={`ledger-method-${entry.id}`}>How they paid <span className="field-optional">e-transfer, PayPal, cash…</span></label>
      <input id={`ledger-method-${entry.id}`} className="field-control" value={method} onChange={(event) => setMethod(event.target.value)} maxLength={60} placeholder="e.g. e-transfer" />
      <label className="field" htmlFor={`ledger-note-${entry.id}`}>Note</label>
      <input id={`ledger-note-${entry.id}`} className="field-control" value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={500} />
      {error && <p className="ledger-form-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
      <div className="ledger-form-actions">
        <button type="submit" className="big-button" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Saving…" : "Save changes"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={() => { setEditing(false); setError(""); }} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </form>;
  }
  return <article className="ledger-row">
    <div className="ledger-row-main">
      <b>{entry.whatShipped}</b>
      <span>{clientDisplay} · shipped {ledgerDayLabel(entry.shippedDate)}</span>
      {entry.note && <span className="ledger-row-note">{entry.note}</span>}
      <span className="ledger-row-source">{entry.source === "package" ? "From a delivered package" : "Added by hand"}</span>
    </div>
    <div className="ledger-row-money">
      <b>{entry.amountCents === null ? "Amount not recorded" : formatCadAmount(entry.amountCents)}</b>
      <span className={`ledger-status ${entry.status}`}>{entry.status === "paid" ? "Paid" : "Owed"}{entry.method ? ` · ${entry.method}` : ""}</span>
    </div>
    <div className="ledger-row-actions">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => onUpdate({ id: entry.id, status: entry.status === "paid" ? "owed" : "paid" })} disabled={busy} aria-label={entry.status === "paid" ? `Mark “${entry.whatShipped}” as owed` : `Mark “${entry.whatShipped}” as paid`}>{entry.status === "paid" ? "Mark owed" : "Mark paid"}</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(true)} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Edit “${entry.whatShipped}”`}>Edit</button>
      {entry.source === "manual" && (confirmingDelete
        ? <button type="button" className="ledger-delete-confirm" onClick={() => onDelete(entry.id)} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Confirm delete of “${entry.whatShipped}”`}>Tap again to delete</button>
        : <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmingDelete(true)} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete “${entry.whatShipped}”`}>Delete</button>)}
    </div>
  </article>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Outreach (Ben, 2026-10-17): its own full view — every business Pulse HQ
// has contacted, and what came of it. The counts at the top are read
// straight off the rows: a reply is any row that moved past Waiting or
// Blocked (someone actually answered); Interested / in conversation counts
// the live threads; Became a client counts the wins. Rows are edited in
// place — status, outcome note, and the follow-up flag — because outcomes
// change over time.
const OUTREACH_STATUSES: OutreachStatus[] = ["Waiting", "In conversation", "Interested", "Not now", "Said no", "Blocked", "Became a client"];
const OUTREACH_CHANNELS: OutreachChannel[] = ["Contact form", "Email", "Facebook DM", "In person", "Inbound"];
const OUTREACH_GROUPS: OutreachGroup[] = ["Founding seven", "Pack 1", "Pack 2", "Pack 3", "Mockup pitches", "Inbound"];
const OUTREACH_REPLY_STATUSES: OutreachStatus[] = ["In conversation", "Interested", "Not now", "Said no", "Became a client"];

function outreachStatusClass(status: OutreachStatus): string {
  return status.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, "-");
}

function OutreachView({ contacts, busy, onAdd, onUpdate }: {
  contacts: OutreachContact[];
  busy: boolean;
  onAdd: (input: OutreachAddInput) => void;
  onUpdate: (input: OutreachUpdateInput) => void;
}) {
  const [showAddForm, setShowAddForm] = useState(false);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<OutreachStatus | "All">("All");
  const total = contacts.length;
