  const replies = contacts.filter((contact) => OUTREACH_REPLY_STATUSES.includes(contact.status)).length;
  const liveThreads = contacts.filter((contact) => contact.status === "In conversation" || contact.status === "Interested").length;
  const clients = contacts.filter((contact) => contact.status === "Became a client").length;
  const visible = statusFilter === "All" ? contacts : contacts.filter((contact) => contact.status === statusFilter);
  return <div className="outreach-view">
    <div className="ledger-totals outreach-totals">
      <div className="ledger-total"><span>Contacted</span><b>{total}</b><small>{total === 1 ? "business in the book" : "businesses in the book"}</small></div>
      <div className="ledger-total"><span>Replies received</span><b>{replies}</b><small>Answered, one way or another</small></div>
      <div className="ledger-total"><span>Interested / in conversation</span><b>{liveThreads}</b><small>Live threads right now</small></div>
      <div className="ledger-total"><span>Became a client</span><b>{clients}</b><small>{clients === 1 ? "Outreach win" : "Outreach wins"}</small></div>
    </div>
    <div className="outreach-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter outreach rows by status">
      <button type="button" className={statusFilter === "All" ? "outreach-filter is-active" : "outreach-filter"} onClick={() => setStatusFilter("All")} aria-pressed={statusFilter === "All"}>All · {total}</button>
      {OUTREACH_STATUSES.map((status) => {
        const count = contacts.filter((contact) => contact.status === status).length;
        return <button key={status} type="button" className={statusFilter === status ? "outreach-filter is-active" : "outreach-filter"} onClick={() => setStatusFilter(status)} aria-pressed={statusFilter === status}>{status} · {count}</button>;
      })}
    </div>
    {showAddForm
      ? <OutreachAddForm busy={busy} onCancel={() => setShowAddForm(false)} onSubmit={(input) => { onAdd(input); setShowAddForm(false); }} />
      : <button type="button" className="preset-new-button ledger-add-button" onClick={() => setShowAddForm(true)}>+ Add a business</button>}
    {visible.length ? <div className="outreach-list">{visible.map((contact) => <OutreachRow key={contact.id} contact={contact} busy={busy} onUpdate={onUpdate} />)}</div>
      : <div className="simple-empty"><b>{total === 0 ? "No businesses in the book yet." : `No businesses are “${statusFilter}” right now.`}</b><span>{total === 0 ? "Add the first one above and it will live here." : "Pick another status above to see the rest of the book."}</span></div>}
  </div>;
}

function OutreachAddForm({ busy, onCancel, onSubmit }: {
  busy: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onSubmit: (input: OutreachAddInput) => void;
}) {
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState("");
  const [town, setTown] = useState("");
  const [channel, setChannel] = useState<OutreachChannel>("Contact form");
  const [group, setGroup] = useState<OutreachGroup>("Pack 1");
  const [dateContacted, setDateContacted] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<OutreachStatus>("Waiting");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [followUp, setFollowUp] = useState(false);
  const [followUpNote, setFollowUpNote] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!businessName.trim()) { setError("Give the business a name — that is the row."); return; }
    onSubmit({ businessName: businessName.trim(), town: town.trim(), channel, group, dateContacted: dateContacted || null, status, note: note.trim(), followUp, followUpNote: followUpNote.trim() });
  }
  return <form className="ledger-form" onSubmit={submit} aria-label="Add a business to Outreach">
    <p className="ledger-form-title">Add a business — who they are, how they were contacted, and where it stands.</p>
    <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-name">Business name</label>
    <input id="outreach-add-name" className="field-control" value={businessName} onChange={(event) => setBusinessName(event.target.value)} maxLength={160} placeholder="e.g. Lakeside Bakery" required />
    <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-town">Town</label>
    <input id="outreach-add-town" className="field-control" value={town} onChange={(event) => setTown(event.target.value)} maxLength={80} placeholder="e.g. Revelstoke" />
    <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-channel">How contacted</label>
    <select id="outreach-add-channel" className="field-control" value={channel} onChange={(event) => setChannel(event.target.value as OutreachChannel)} aria-label="How they were contacted">
      {OUTREACH_CHANNELS.map((option) => <option key={option} value={option}>{option === "Inbound" ? "Inbound — they contacted us" : option}</option>)}
    </select>
    <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-group">Group</label>
    <select id="outreach-add-group" className="field-control" value={group} onChange={(event) => setGroup(event.target.value as OutreachGroup)} aria-label="Which group this contact belongs to">
      {OUTREACH_GROUPS.map((option) => <option key={option} value={option}>{option}</option>)}
    </select>
    <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-date">Date contacted <span className="field-optional">leave blank if the date is not on record</span></label>
    <input id="outreach-add-date" className="field-control" type="date" value={dateContacted} onChange={(event) => setDateContacted(event.target.value)} />
    <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-status">Status</label>
    <select id="outreach-add-status" className="field-control" value={status} onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value as OutreachStatus)} aria-label="Where this contact stands">
      {OUTREACH_STATUSES.map((option) => <option key={option} value={option}>{option}</option>)}
    </select>
    <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-note">Outcome note <span className="field-optional">plain words — what actually happened</span></label>
    <input id="outreach-add-note" className="field-control" value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={1000} placeholder="e.g. Replied the same day, asked for prices" />
    <label className="outreach-followup-toggle" htmlFor="outreach-add-followup">
      <input id="outreach-add-followup" type="checkbox" checked={followUp} onChange={(event) => setFollowUp(event.target.checked)} />
      <span>Follow up — a door is left open</span>
    </label>
    {followUp && <>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="outreach-add-followup-note">Follow-up note <span className="field-optional">when, or what to say</span></label>
      <input id="outreach-add-followup-note" className="field-control" value={followUpNote} onChange={(event) => setFollowUpNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={500} placeholder="e.g. Check back in November" />
    </>}
    {error && <p className="ledger-form-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    <div className="ledger-form-actions">
      <button type="submit" className="big-button" disabled={busy || !businessName.trim()}>{busy ? "Adding…" : "Add business"}</button>
      <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </form>;
}

function OutreachRow({ contact, busy, onUpdate }: {
  contact: OutreachContact;
  busy: boolean;
  onUpdate: (input: OutreachUpdateInput) => void;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<OutreachStatus>(contact.status);
  const [note, setNote] = useState(contact.note);
  const [followUp, setFollowUp] = useState(contact.followUp);
  const [followUpNote, setFollowUpNote] = useState(contact.followUpNote);
  // If the row changes underneath an open editor (a refetch lands), the
  // editor re-seeds from the fresh row rather than overwriting it later.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing) {
      setStatus(contact.status);
      setNote(contact.note);
      setFollowUp(contact.followUp);
      setFollowUpNote(contact.followUpNote);
    }
  }, [contact, editing]);
  function save(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    onUpdate({ id: contact.id, status, note: note.trim(), followUp, followUpNote: followUpNote.trim() });
    setEditing(false);
  }
  const metaLine = `${contact.channel} · ${contact.group} · ${contact.dateContacted ? ledgerDayLabel(contact.dateContacted) : "Date unconfirmed"}`;
  if (editing) {
    return <form className="outreach-row outreach-row-editing" onSubmit={save} aria-label={`Edit the outreach row for ${contact.businessName}`}>
      <p className="ledger-form-title">{contact.businessName} <span>· {contact.town || "Town not recorded"} · {metaLine}</span></p>
      <label className="field" htmlFor={`outreach-status-${contact.id}`}>Status</label>
      <select id={`outreach-status-${contact.id}`} className="field-control" value={status} onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value as OutreachStatus)} aria-label={`Status for ${contact.businessName}`}>
        {OUTREACH_STATUSES.map((option) => <option key={option} value={option}>{option}</option>)}
      </select>
      <label className="field" htmlFor={`outreach-note-${contact.id}`}>Outcome note <span className="field-optional">plain words — what actually happened</span></label>
      <input id={`outreach-note-${contact.id}`} className="field-control" value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={1000} />
      <label className="outreach-followup-toggle" htmlFor={`outreach-followup-${contact.id}`}>
        <input id={`outreach-followup-${contact.id}`} type="checkbox" checked={followUp} onChange={(event) => setFollowUp(event.target.checked)} />
        <span>Follow up — a door is left open</span>
      </label>
      {followUp && <>
        <label className="field" htmlFor={`outreach-followup-note-${contact.id}`}>Follow-up note <span className="field-optional">when, or what to say</span></label>
        <input id={`outreach-followup-note-${contact.id}`} className="field-control" value={followUpNote} onChange={(event) => setFollowUpNote(event.target.value)} maxLength={500} />
      </>}
      <div className="ledger-form-actions">
        <button type="submit" className="big-button" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Saving…" : "Save changes"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={() => setEditing(false)} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </form>;
  }
  return <article className="outreach-row">
    <div className="outreach-row-main">
      <b>{contact.businessName}{contact.town ? <span className="outreach-row-town"> · {contact.town}</span> : null}</b>
      <span>{metaLine}</span>
      {contact.note && <span className="outreach-row-note">{contact.note}</span>}
      {contact.followUp && <span className="outreach-row-followup">Follow up{contact.followUpNote ? ` — ${contact.followUpNote}` : ""}</span>}
    </div>
    <div className="outreach-row-side">
      <span className={`outreach-status ${outreachStatusClass(contact.status)}`}>{contact.status}</span>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(true)} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Update the status, outcome or follow-up for ${contact.businessName}`}>Update</button>
    </div>
  </article>;
}

// Clients = a directory of client PROFILES (Ben's ruling, 2026-10-16;
// packages given a second home here the same day). A profile carries:
// the client's information, their special instructions (editable in
// place, saved to the same registry record Maria briefs from), the
// POPULATE THE WORLD button (the Phase 3 active-client switch), a
// "What's next" line, a Finished work index of hyperlinks into
// Deliverables, and a Packages section — this client's delivery
// packages rendered with the SAME DeliveryPackageCard component as
// Deliverables, every control functional from here too. One component,
// two homes; package decisions work identically in both places.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Test / simulation clients: the registry flag is the record, and the
// one rehearsal client Ben ran before it existed (Free Spirit Spheres —
// a simulation only, never contacted) is recognised by name so it can
// never sit unbadged as a peer of real clients.
function isTestClient(client: Client): boolean {
  if (client.isTest) return true;
  const name = client.businessName.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  return name.includes("free spirit spheres") || name.includes("test client") || name.includes("simulation");
}

function clientStandingLabel(client: Client): string {
  if (isTestClient(client)) return "Test";
  return CLIENT_STATUS_LABELS[client.status];
}

// "Mon Oct 19" — the plain date a report line or a finished-work
// description carries (weekday included for report dates).
function formatDayLabel(value: string | null | undefined, withWeekday = false): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { ...(withWeekday ? { weekday: "short" as const } : {}), month: "short", day: "numeric" }).format(date);
}

type FinishedWorkItem = {
  key: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  when: number;
  task: Task;
  pkg?: DeliveryPackage;
};

function finishedKindForPackage(pkg: DeliveryPackage, sourceTask: Task | undefined): string {
  if (sourceTask) {
    if (sourceTask.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" || sourceTask.jobType === "perfectly_paranoid") return "post package";
    if (sourceTask.pipeline === "client_report" || sourceTask.jobType === "client_report") return "client report";
    if (sourceTask.pipeline === "research_case" || sourceTask.jobType === "research") return "research brief";
    if (sourceTask.pipeline === "creative_package" || sourceTask.jobType === "creative_package") return "creative package";
    if (sourceTask.pipeline === "market_briefing" || sourceTask.jobType === "market_briefing") return "market briefing";
  }
  if (/report/i.test(pkg.title)) return "client report";
  return "delivery package";
}

// The Finished work index for one client: delivered packages first-class
// (each is a delivered deliverable), plus the client's other finished
// items that live in the Deliverables Library and are not already
// represented by a package. Pointers only — the files stay in
// Deliverables and the link opens the item there.
function finishedWorkForClient(client: Client, packages: DeliveryPackage[], tasks: Task[]): FinishedWorkItem[] {
  const clientPackages = packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.clientId === client.id);
  const packageSourceIds = new Set(clientPackages.map((pkg) => pkg.taskId));
  const packageJobIds = new Set(clientPackages.flatMap((pkg) => (pkg.packageTaskId ? [pkg.packageTaskId] : [])));
  const labSubcaseIds = new Set(tasks.flatMap((task) => (task.escalationSubtaskId ? [task.escalationSubtaskId] : [])));
  const items: FinishedWorkItem[] = [];
  for (const pkg of clientPackages) {
    if (pkg.status !== "delivered") continue;
    const sourceTask = tasks.find((task) => task.id === pkg.taskId);
    if (!sourceTask) continue;
    const kind = finishedKindForPackage(pkg, sourceTask);
    items.push({
      key: `pkg:${pkg.id}`,
      title: pkg.title,
      description: `${kind} · delivered ${formatDayLabel(pkg.deliveredAt ?? pkg.updatedAt)}`,
      when: new Date(pkg.deliveredAt ?? pkg.updatedAt).getTime(),
      task: sourceTask,
      pkg,
    });
  }
  for (const task of tasks) {
    if (task.clientId !== client.id) continue;
    if (task.pipeline === "client_delivery") continue;
    if (labSubcaseIds.has(task.id)) continue;
    if (packageSourceIds.has(task.id) || packageJobIds.has(task.id)) continue;
    if (!isLibraryTask(task)) continue;
    const when = task.postedAt ?? task.approvedAt ?? task.created;
    items.push({
      key: `task:${task.id}`,
      title: task.title,
      description: `${readyKindLabelForTask(task)} · ${task.postedAt ? "posted" : "finished"} ${formatDayLabel(when)}`,
      when: new Date(when).getTime(),
      task,
    });
  }
  return items.sort((a, b) => b.when - a.when);
}

function ClientCard({ client, packages, tasks, reportOpen, onEdit, onDelete, onRunReport, onDraftCaseStudy, onOpenFinishedWork, onUpdateInstructions, instructionsBusy, busy, isActive = false, onToggleActive, onApprovePackage, onReworkPackage, onFinishAssemblingPackage, onDownloadPackage, onSavePackageLink, packageDeliveryBusy = false, onOpenTask }: {
  client: Client;
  // This client's packages and the office's tasks, both global — the
  // profile derives its What's next counts and Finished work index from
  // them, and its Packages section renders this client's packages with
  // the same DeliveryPackageCard component Deliverables uses.
  packages: DeliveryPackage[];
  tasks: Task[];
  reportOpen: boolean;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onRunReport: () => void;
  onDraftCaseStudy: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onOpenFinishedWork: (task: Task) => void;
  onUpdateInstructions: (text: string) => void;
  instructionsBusy: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean;
  onToggleActive?: () => void;
  onApprovePackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, keepPaths?: string[]) => void;
  onReworkPackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onFinishAssemblingPackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onDownloadPackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onSavePackageLink?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, url: string) => void;
  packageDeliveryBusy?: boolean;
  onOpenTask?: (task: Task) => void;
}) {
  const test = isTestClient(client);
  const standing = clientStandingLabel(client);
  const [editingInstructions, setEditingInstructions] = useState(false);
  const [instructionsDraft, setInstructionsDraft] = useState("");
  const finishedWork = finishedWorkForClient(client, packages, tasks);
  const waitingPackages = packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "ready").length;
  const assemblingPackagesCount = packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "assembling").length;
  const waitingJobs = tasks.filter((task) => task.clientId === client.id && task.status === "approval" && !isApprovedPackage(task)).length;
  const waitingCount = waitingPackages + waitingJobs;
  const reportDue = Boolean(client.reportCadence !== "off" && client.nextReportAt && new Date(client.nextReportAt).getTime() <= Date.now() && !reportOpen);
  const whatsNext = reportOpen
    ? "A report for this client is being worked now — it will wait for your approval when it is ready."
    : client.nextReportAt
      ? `Next report: ${formatDayLabel(client.nextReportAt, true)}${reportDue ? " — due now" : ""}${waitingCount ? ` · ${waitingCount} ${waitingCount === 1 ? "item" : "items"} waiting on you in Deliverables` : ""}`
      : waitingCount
        ? `${waitingCount} ${waitingCount === 1 ? "item is" : "items are"} waiting on you in Deliverables${assemblingPackagesCount ? `, and Maria is assembling ${assemblingPackagesCount === 1 ? "a package" : `${assemblingPackagesCount} packages`} for this client` : ""}.`
        : assemblingPackagesCount
          ? `Maria is assembling ${assemblingPackagesCount === 1 ? "a delivery package" : `${assemblingPackagesCount} delivery packages`} for this client — it will wait in Deliverables when it is ready.`
          : "Nothing is waiting on you for this client right now.";
  const startEditingInstructions = () => {
    setInstructionsDraft(client.voiceNotes);
    setEditingInstructions(true);
  };
  const saveInstructions = () => {
    onUpdateInstructions(instructionsDraft.trim());
    setEditingInstructions(false);
  };
  return <article className={`client-card client-profile${isActive ? " is-active-client" : ""}${test ? " is-test-client" : ""}`} aria-current={isActive ? "true" : undefined}>
    <div className="client-card-top">
      <div><b>{client.businessName}</b><span>{standing}{client.approverName ? ` · Approved by ${client.approverName}` : ""}</span></div>
      <span className="client-standing-badges">
        {test && <span className="test-client-badge">TEST</span>}
        {isActive ? <span className="active-client-badge">Active client</span> : <span className={client.status === "paused" ? "order-state" : "order-state active"}>{standing}</span>}
      </span>
    </div>
    {test && <p className="test-client-note">Test client — a simulation for rehearsing the work, not a real client.</p>}
    {onToggleActive && <button type="button" className={isActive ? "populate-world-button is-on" : "populate-world-button"} onClick={onToggleActive} aria-pressed={isActive} aria-label={isActive ? `Show all clients instead of only ${client.businessName}` : `Populate the world with only ${client.businessName} — view only this client`}>{isActive ? `Populating the world — only ${client.businessName} · tap for all clients` : "Populate the world — view only this client"}</button>}
    {isActive && <p className="active-client-note">This client is populating the world: the Deliverables Library shows only their deliverables. Ready for You, the floors, the Work boards, and To post still show everyone.</p>}
    <p className="client-whats-next"><b>What’s next</b><span>{whatsNext}</span></p>
    <div className="client-profile-block">
      <b className="client-profile-block-title">Information</b>
      <dl className="client-facts">
        <div><dt>Standing</dt><dd>{standing}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Approver</dt><dd>{client.approverName || "Not recorded"}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Channels</dt><dd>{client.platforms || "Not recorded"}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Contact facts on record</dt><dd>{client.approverName ? `${client.approverName} approves their work` : "No approver recorded"}{client.platforms ? ` · publishes on ${client.platforms}` : ""}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Photo library</dt><dd>{clientPhotoLibraryText(client)}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Showcase permission</dt><dd>{client.showcasePermission ? "Yes — Pulse HQ may showcase this client's work" : "No — their work stays private"}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Reporting</dt><dd>{CLIENT_REPORT_LABELS[client.reportCadence]}{client.reportCadence !== "off" && client.nextReportAt ? ` · next report ${formatDayLabel(client.nextReportAt, true)}` : ""}{reportOpen ? " · a report is being worked now" : ""}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>In the directory since</dt><dd>{formatDayLabel(client.createdAt)}</dd></div>
      </dl>
    </div>
    <div className="client-profile-block client-instructions">
      <div className="client-profile-block-head"><b className="client-profile-block-title">Special instructions</b>{!editingInstructions && <button type="button" className="client-instructions-edit" onClick={startEditingInstructions} disabled={busy || instructionsBusy} aria-label={`Edit ${client.businessName}'s special instructions`}>Edit</button>}</div>
      {editingInstructions ? <div className="client-instructions-editor">
        <label className="field" htmlFor={`client-instructions-${client.id}`}>Standing instructions for {client.businessName} <span className="field-optional">Maria shapes every future brief from this text</span></label>
        <textarea id={`client-instructions-${client.id}`} className="field-control field-textarea" autoFocus value={instructionsDraft} onChange={(event) => setInstructionsDraft(event.target.value)} maxLength={2000} placeholder="e.g. Plain and friendly, no hype. Meals are Monday and Thursday at noon, $12 per person." />
        <div className="client-instructions-actions">
          <button type="button" className="client-instructions-save" onClick={saveInstructions} disabled={instructionsBusy}>{instructionsBusy ? "Saving…" : "Save instructions"}</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditingInstructions(false)} disabled={instructionsBusy}>Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div> : client.voiceNotes
        ? <p className="client-instructions-text">{client.voiceNotes}</p>
        : <p className="client-instructions-text empty">No special instructions recorded yet. Add the standing notes the crew should follow for this client — how they like to sound, their always / never rules, the facts every job must respect.</p>}
    </div>
    <div className="client-profile-block client-finished-work">
      <b className="client-profile-block-title">Finished work</b>
      {finishedWork.length ? <ul className="finished-work-list">{finishedWork.slice(0, 20).map((item) => <li key={item.key}>
        <span className="finished-work-entry">
          <button type="button" className="finished-work-link" onClick={() => onOpenFinishedWork(item.task)} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Open “${item.title}” in Deliverables — ${item.description}`}>
            <span className="finished-work-title">{item.title}</span>
            <small className="finished-work-description">{item.description}</small>
          </button>
          {item.pkg?.customerLink && <a className="finished-work-customer-link" href={item.pkg.customerLink} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`Customer download link for “${item.title}”`}>Customer download link</a>}
        </span>
        {item.pkg && client.showcasePermission && <button type="button" className="finished-work-case-study" onClick={() => onDraftCaseStudy(item.pkg as DeliveryPackage)} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Draft a case study from “${item.title}”`}>Draft case study</button>}
      </li>)}</ul> : <p className="client-finished-empty">Nothing finished yet. When work for this client is delivered, a link to it will appear here — the files themselves live in Deliverables.</p>}
      {finishedWork.length > 20 && <p className="client-finished-empty">…and {finishedWork.length - 20} more in Deliverables — populate the world with this client and the Library shows only theirs.</p>}
    </div>
    {client.id === PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID ? <div className="client-profile-block client-packages">
      <b className="client-profile-block-title">Packages</b>
      <p className="client-finished-empty">No packages — Perfectly Paranoid is house content, so its posts are never delivery packages. Finished posts live in Deliverables, under Posts, with their images and verification write-ups.</p>
    </div> : <div className="client-profile-block client-packages">
      <b className="client-profile-block-title">Packages</b>
      <p className="client-packages-note">Every package’s ZIP can be downloaded again any time — as often as you need, before and after delivery.</p>
      {packages.length ? <div className="client-package-list client-packages-list">
        {packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "assembling").map((pkg) => <AssemblingPackageCard key={pkg.id} pkg={pkg} client={client} onFinish={() => onFinishAssemblingPackage?.(pkg)} busy={busy} />)}
        {packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "ready").map((pkg) => <DeliveryPackageCard key={pkg.id} pkg={pkg} client={client} sourceTask={tasks.find((task) => task.id === pkg.taskId)} onApprove={(keepPaths) => onApprovePackage?.(pkg, keepPaths)} onRework={() => onReworkPackage?.(pkg)} onOpenTask={(task) => onOpenTask?.(task)} onDownload={onDownloadPackage} onSaveLink={onSavePackageLink} deliveryBusy={packageDeliveryBusy} busy={busy} />)}
        {packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.status === "delivered").map((pkg) => <DeliveryPackageCard key={pkg.id} pkg={pkg} client={client} sourceTask={tasks.find((task) => task.id === pkg.taskId)} onApprove={() => undefined} onRework={() => undefined} onOpenTask={(task) => onOpenTask?.(task)} onDownload={onDownloadPackage} onSaveLink={onSavePackageLink} deliveryBusy={packageDeliveryBusy} busy={busy} />)}
      </div> : <p className="client-finished-empty">No packages for this client yet. When you approve one of their jobs, Maria’s package will appear here — and in Deliverables, under Packages.</p>}
    </div>}
    <div className="client-card-actions">
      <button type="button" onClick={onRunReport} disabled={busy || reportOpen}>{reportOpen ? "Report being worked" : "Run a report now"}</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={onEdit} disabled={busy}>Edit record</button>
      <button type="button" className="danger-link" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy}>Delete</button>
    </div>
  </article>;
}

// The Clients directory: real clients first, in full. Test / simulation
// clients sit under their own divider, collapsed until opened — badged
// TEST, visually separated, never presented as peers of real clients.
function ClientProfileList({ clients, packages, tasks, activeClientId, onToggleActive, openReportTaskClientIds, onEdit, onDelete, onRunReport, onDraftCaseStudy, onOpenFinishedWork, onUpdateInstructions, instructionsBusy, busy, onApprovePackage, onReworkPackage, onFinishAssemblingPackage, onDownloadPackage, onSavePackageLink, packageDeliveryBusy = false, onOpenTask }: {
  clients: Client[];
  packages: DeliveryPackage[];
  tasks: Task[];
  activeClientId: string | null;
  onToggleActive: (client: Client) => void;
  openReportTaskClientIds: Set<string>;
  onEdit: (client: Client) => void;
  onDelete: (client: Client) => void;
  onRunReport: (client: Client) => void;
  onDraftCaseStudy: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onOpenFinishedWork: (task: Task) => void;
  onUpdateInstructions: (client: Client, text: string) => void;
  instructionsBusy: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  onApprovePackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, keepPaths?: string[]) => void;
  onReworkPackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onFinishAssemblingPackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onDownloadPackage?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onSavePackageLink?: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, url: string) => void;
  packageDeliveryBusy?: boolean;
  onOpenTask?: (task: Task) => void;
}) {
  const [testExpanded, setTestExpanded] = useState(false);
  const realClients = clients.filter((client) => !isTestClient(client));
  const testClients = clients.filter((client) => isTestClient(client));
  const renderCard = (client: Client) => <ClientCard key={client.id} client={client} isActive={client.id === activeClientId} onToggleActive={() => onToggleActive(client)} packages={packages.filter((pkg) => pkg.clientId === client.id)} tasks={tasks} reportOpen={openReportTaskClientIds.has(client.id)} onEdit={() => onEdit(client)} onDelete={() => onDelete(client)} onRunReport={() => onRunReport(client)} onDraftCaseStudy={onDraftCaseStudy} onOpenFinishedWork={onOpenFinishedWork} onUpdateInstructions={(text) => onUpdateInstructions(client, text)} instructionsBusy={instructionsBusy} busy={busy} onApprovePackage={onApprovePackage} onReworkPackage={onReworkPackage} onFinishAssemblingPackage={onFinishAssemblingPackage} onDownloadPackage={onDownloadPackage} onSavePackageLink={onSavePackageLink} packageDeliveryBusy={packageDeliveryBusy} onOpenTask={onOpenTask} />;
  return <>
    {realClients.length ? <div className="client-list">{realClients.map(renderCard)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>No real clients in the directory yet.</b><span>Add a client and their profile — information, special instructions, and finished-work links — will live here.</span></div>}
    {testClients.length > 0 && <div className="test-clients-section">
      <button type="button" className="test-clients-toggle" onClick={() => setTestExpanded((value) => !value)} aria-expanded={testExpanded} aria-label={`${testExpanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand"} test clients`}>
        <span className="test-client-badge">TEST</span>
        <span className="test-clients-toggle-label">Test clients — simulations, not real clients</span>
        <span className="test-clients-count">{testClients.length}</span>
        <span aria-hidden="true">{testExpanded ? "−" : "+"}</span>
      </button>
      {testExpanded && <div className="client-list test-client-list">{testClients.map(renderCard)}</div>}
    </div>}
  </>;
}


function ClientSheet({ client, onClose, onSubmit, busy }: {
  client: Client | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (input: { businessName: string; approverName: string; platforms: string; voiceNotes: string; photoLibraryStatus: ClientPhotoLibraryStatus; photoLibraryLocation: string; showcasePermission: boolean; isTest: boolean; status: ClientStatus; reportCadence: ClientReportCadence }) => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState(client?.businessName ?? "");
  const [approverName, setApproverName] = useState(client?.approverName ?? "");
  const [platforms, setPlatforms] = useState(client?.platforms ?? "");
  const [voiceNotes, setVoiceNotes] = useState(client?.voiceNotes ?? "");
  const [photoLibraryStatus, setPhotoLibraryStatus] = useState<ClientPhotoLibraryStatus>(client?.photoLibraryStatus ?? "not_recorded");
  const [photoLibraryLocation, setPhotoLibraryLocation] = useState(client?.photoLibraryLocation ?? "");
  const [showcasePermission, setShowcasePermission] = useState(client?.showcasePermission ?? false);
  const [isTest, setIsTest] = useState(client ? isTestClient(client) : false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ClientStatus>(client?.status ?? "prospect");
  const [reportCadence, setReportCadence] = useState<ClientReportCadence>(client?.reportCadence ?? "off");
  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!businessName.trim()) return;
    onSubmit({ businessName: businessName.trim(), approverName: approverName.trim(), platforms: platforms.trim(), voiceNotes: voiceNotes.trim(), photoLibraryStatus, photoLibraryLocation: photoLibraryStatus === "provided" ? photoLibraryLocation.trim() : "", showcasePermission, isTest, status, reportCadence });
  }
  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onClose} label={client ? "Edit client" : "New client"}>
    <p className="sheet-kicker">Front Office · Client registry</p>
    <h3>{client ? "Edit client" : "New client"}</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">This record is what Maria works from: she shapes this client's jobs at intake with their voice and constraints, and their reports and delivery packages key off it.</p>
    <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="client-business">Business name</label>
      <input id="client-business" className="field-control" autoFocus value={businessName} onChange={(event) => setBusinessName(event.target.value)} maxLength={120} required />
      <label className="field" htmlFor="client-approver">Approver name <span className="field-optional">the person who approves their work</span></label>
      <input id="client-approver" className="field-control" value={approverName} onChange={(event) => setApproverName(event.target.value)} maxLength={120} />
      <label className="field" htmlFor="client-platforms">Platforms <span className="field-optional">where they publish</span></label>
      <input id="client-platforms" className="field-control" value={platforms} onChange={(event) => setPlatforms(event.target.value)} maxLength={300} placeholder="e.g. Facebook, Instagram" />
      <label className="field" htmlFor="client-voice">Special instructions <span className="field-optional">their standing instructions — how they like to sound, always / never rules, facts every job must respect</span></label>
      <textarea id="client-voice" className="field-control field-textarea" value={voiceNotes} onChange={(event) => setVoiceNotes(event.target.value)} maxLength={2000} placeholder="e.g. Plain and friendly, no hype. Never use exclamation marks." />
      <label className="field" htmlFor="client-photos">Photo library <span className="field-optional">the client's own photos — Maria asks for these at onboarding</span></label>
      <select id="client-photos" className="field-control" value={photoLibraryStatus} onChange={(event) => setPhotoLibraryStatus(event.target.value as ClientPhotoLibraryStatus)}>
        <option value="not_recorded">Not recorded yet — still to ask at onboarding</option>
        <option value="provided">Provided — the client gave Pulse HQ their own photos</option>
        <option value="none">None provided — the client has no photos to give</option>
      </select>
      <p className="sheet-sub">Real photos of their business, place, and products. When a client provides photos, image work for their jobs uses those first — generated pictures are the labelled fallback only.</p>
      {photoLibraryStatus === "provided" && <>
        <label className="field" htmlFor="client-photo-location">Where the photos live <span className="field-optional">folder, drive link, or where Maria can find them</span></label>
        <input id="client-photo-location" className="field-control" value={photoLibraryLocation} onChange={(event) => setPhotoLibraryLocation(event.target.value)} maxLength={1000} placeholder="e.g. The shared drive folder they sent at onboarding" />
      </>}
      <label className="field" htmlFor="client-status">Status</label>
      <select id="client-status" className="field-control" value={status} onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value as ClientStatus)}>
        <option value="prospect">Prospect</option>
        <option value="pilot">Pilot</option>
        <option value="retainer">Retainer</option>
        <option value="paused">Paused</option>
      </select>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="client-reporting">Client reports</label>
      <select id="client-reporting" className="field-control" value={reportCadence} onChange={(event) => setReportCadence(event.target.value as ClientReportCadence)}>
        <option value="off">Off — no recurring report</option>
        <option value="weekly">Weekly — Mondays at 9:00 AM</option>
        <option value="monthly">Monthly — the 1st at 9:00 AM</option>
      </select>
      <label className="field client-permission-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={showcasePermission} onChange={(event) => setShowcasePermission(event.target.checked)} aria-label="Showcase permission — Pulse HQ may showcase this client's work" />
        <span><b>Showcase permission</b><small>May Pulse HQ showcase this client's finished work (case studies for the showcase)? Only when they have said yes.</small></span>
      </label>
      <label className="field client-permission-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={isTest} onChange={(event) => setIsTest(event.target.checked)} aria-label="Test client — a simulation, not a real client" />
        <span><b>Test client</b><small>A simulation for rehearsing the work — badged TEST in the Clients directory and kept apart from real clients, never presented as their peer.</small></span>
      </label>
      <button className="big-button" disabled={busy || !businessName.trim()}>{busy ? "Saving…" : client ? "Save client changes" : "Add client"}</button>
      <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
    </form>
  </Sheet>;
}

function DeleteClientSheet({ client, onCancel, onConfirm, busy }: { client: Client; onCancel: () => void; onConfirm: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onCancel} label="Delete client confirmation">
    <p className="sheet-kicker danger-kicker">Delete client</p>
    <h3>Remove this client?</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">Their registry record and delivery-package history go away. Jobs already in the office are untouched.</p>
    <p className="blocker-question delete-task-name">{client.businessName}</p>
    <div className="confirm-actions">
      <button className="big-button danger" onClick={onConfirm} disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Removing…" : "Remove client"}</button>
      <button className="big-button ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </Sheet>;
}

function PackageReworkSheet({ pkg, client, onClose, onSubmit, busy }: { pkg: DeliveryPackage; client?: Client; onClose: () => void; onSubmit: (feedback: string) => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState("");
  function submit(event: FormEvent) { event.preventDefault(); if (feedback.trim()) onSubmit(feedback.trim()); }
  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onClose} label="Send package back to Maria">
    <p className="sheet-kicker">Front Office · Delivery package</p>
    <h3>Send it back to Maria</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">Like a normal rework: Maria rebuilds the package for {client?.businessName ?? "the client"} with your feedback, and it comes back to Deliverables, under Delivery packages, for your one decision.</p>
    <p className="blocker-question delete-task-name">{pkg.title}</p>
    <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="package-rework-feedback">What needs to change</label>
      <textarea id="package-rework-feedback" className="field-control field-textarea" autoFocus value={feedback} onChange={(event) => setFeedback(event.target.value)} maxLength={5000} placeholder="What is wrong with the package, and what does the fixed version look like?" required />
      <button className="big-button" disabled={busy || !feedback.trim()}>{busy ? "Sending…" : "Send back to Maria"}</button>
      <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
    </form>
  </Sheet>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// THE DECISION QUEUE (Ready for You, redesigned from scratch,
// 2026-10-18). The old page was a card list that mixed four kinds of
// things wearing the same costume. This surface is built around the
// page's one job — "this needs Ben's decision" — and nothing else:
//   · a plain count of what needs deciding, and how long the oldest
//     item has waited;
//   · groups with plain names ("Needs your answer", one per client,
//     "Finished work") — never a mixed pile;
//   · one DecisionCard per item, result first, one decision per card.
// Every Ready for You surface (the desktop page, Flow, the Work
// panel) renders through this queue and DecisionCard, so the page is
// the same page everywhere.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function DecisionQueue({ groups, showPositions = false, renderCard }: {
  groups: ReadyGroup[];
  showPositions?: boolean;
  renderCard: (task: Task, positionLabel?: string) => ReactNode;
}) {
  const total = groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.tasks.length, 0);
  const showHeaders = groups.length > 1 || (groups[0] ? groups[0].needsAnswer || Boolean(groups[0].clientName) : false);
  let position = 0;
  return <div className="decision-queue">
    {groups.map((group) => <section className="decision-group" key={group.key} aria-label={readyGroupHeading(group)}>
      {showHeaders && <header className="decision-group-head">
        <div className="decision-group-title-row"><h3>{readyGroupHeading(group)}</h3><span className="decision-group-count" aria-label={`${group.tasks.length} waiting`}>{group.tasks.length}</span></div>
        <p>{readyGroupSub(group)}</p>
      </header>}
      <div className="decision-list">
        {group.tasks.map((task) => { position += 1; return renderCard(task, showPositions ? `${position} of ${total}` : undefined); })}
      </div>
    </section>)}
  </div>;
}

function SimplifiedWorkPanel({ approvalTasks, readyGroups, approvedTasks, libraryTasks, activeClient, onToggleClient, onClearActiveClient, onMarkTaskPosted, taskPostedBusy, blockers, activeTasks, briefs, ideas, stories, onMakeStoryJob, onDismissStory, makingStoryJobId, dismissingStoryId, xPosts, presets, onStartPreset, onNewPreset, onEditPreset, onDeletePreset, presetBusy, onMarkXPostPosted, onDeleteXPost, xPostBusy, clients, packages, openReportTaskClientIds, onUpdateClientInstructions, instructionsBusy, onOpenFinishedWork, onNewClient, onEditClient, onDeleteClient, onApprovePackage, onDownloadPackage, onSavePackageLink, packageDeliveryBusy, ledger, onAddLedgerEntry, onUpdateLedgerEntry, onDeleteLedgerEntry, ledgerBusy, onReworkPackage, onFinishAssemblingPackage, onRunClientReport, onDraftCaseStudy, clientBusy, tasks, log, onClose, onOpenTask, onAnswerBlocker, onApprove, onFinalize, onSendBack, onDelete, onCreateWork, onHuntIdeas, onIdeasOpened, onLaunchIdea, onDenyIdea, huntingIdeas, launchingIdeaId, denyingIdeaId, busy }: {
  approvalTasks: Task[];
  readyGroups: ReadyGroup[];
  approvedTasks: Task[];
  libraryTasks: Task[];
  // Phase 3 — active-client scoping for this panel. libraryTasks arrives
  // already scoped by the shell when a client is active (the Deliverables
  // Posts/Files/Reports lists are the panel's scoped lists);
  // approvalTasks (Ready for You), approvedTasks (To post posts),
  // activeTasks, briefs, log, and packages all arrive GLOBAL and stay
  // global (Stage C).
  activeClient: Client | null;
  onToggleClient: (client: Client) => void;
  onClearActiveClient: () => void;
  onMarkTaskPosted: (task: Task) => void;
  taskPostedBusy: boolean;
  blockers: Blocker[];
  activeTasks: Task[];
  briefs: Brief[];
  ideas: VisionaryIdea[];
  stories: Story[];
  onMakeStoryJob: (storyId: string) => void;
  onDismissStory: (storyId: string) => void;
  makingStoryJobId: string | null;
  dismissingStoryId: string | null;
  xPosts: XPost[];
  presets: Preset[];
  onStartPreset: (preset: Preset) => void;
  onNewPreset: () => void;
  onEditPreset: (preset: Preset) => void;
  onDeletePreset: (preset: Preset) => void;
  presetBusy: boolean;
  onMarkXPostPosted: (postId: string) => void;
  onDeleteXPost: (postId: string) => void;
  xPostBusy: boolean;
  clients: Client[];
  packages: DeliveryPackage[];
  openReportTaskClientIds: Set<string>;
  onUpdateClientInstructions: (client: Client, voiceNotes: string) => void;
  instructionsBusy: boolean;
  onOpenFinishedWork: (task: Task) => void;
  onNewClient: () => void;
  onEditClient: (client: Client) => void;
  onDeleteClient: (client: Client) => void;
  onApprovePackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, keepPaths?: string[]) => void;
  onDownloadPackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onSavePackageLink: (pkg: DeliveryPackage, url: string) => void;
  packageDeliveryBusy: boolean;
  ledger: LedgerEntry[];
  onAddLedgerEntry: (input: LedgerAddInput) => void;
  onUpdateLedgerEntry: (input: LedgerUpdateInput) => void;
  onDeleteLedgerEntry: (id: string) => void;
  ledgerBusy: boolean;
  onFinishAssemblingPackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onReworkPackage: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  onRunClientReport: (client: Client) => void;
  onDraftCaseStudy: (pkg: DeliveryPackage) => void;
  clientBusy: boolean;
  tasks: Task[];
  log: OfficeLogEntry[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenTask: (task: Task) => void;
  onAnswerBlocker: (blocker: Blocker) => void;
  onApprove: (task: Task) => void;
  onFinalize: (task: Task, keepPaths: string[]) => void;
  onSendBack: (task: Task) => void;
  onDelete: (task: Task) => void;
  onCreateWork: () => void;
  onHuntIdeas: () => void;
  onIdeasOpened: () => void;
  onLaunchIdea: (ideaId: string) => void;
  onDenyIdea: (ideaId: string) => void;
  huntingIdeas: boolean;
  launchingIdeaId: string | null;
  denyingIdeaId: string | null;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<WorkTab>(approvalTasks.length ? "ready" : "working");
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const deliverableGroups = classifyDeliverableTasks([...approvedTasks, ...libraryTasks], packages);
  const deliverableTotal = deliverableGroups.posts.length + packages.length + deliverableGroups.files.length + deliverableGroups.reports.length;
  const activeIdeas = ideas.filter((idea) => !idea.launchedTaskId);
  const completedIdeas = ideas.filter((idea) => Boolean(idea.launchedTaskId));
  const ppStories = stories.filter((story) => story.shelf === "perfectly_paranoid");
  const pulseStories = stories.filter((story) => story.shelf === "pulse_hq");
  const unreadIdeaHunts = new Set(ideas.filter((idea) => !idea.seenAt).map((idea) => idea.taskId)).size;
  const openTab = (nextTab: WorkTab) => {
    setTab(nextTab);
    if (nextTab === "ideas" && unreadIdeaHunts > 0) onIdeasOpened();
  };
  const queuedPosts = xPosts.filter((post) => post.status === "queued");
  const postedPosts = xPosts.filter((post) => post.status === "posted");
  const tabs: Array<{ id: WorkTab; label: string; count?: number }> = [
    { id: "working", label: "Working", count: activeTasks.length },
    { id: "terminal", label: "Live terminal", count: briefs.filter((brief) => brief.status === "in_progress").length },
    { id: "ready", label: "Ready for You", count: approvalTasks.length },
    { id: "ideas", label: "Sven's ideas", count: ideas.filter((idea) => !idea.launchedTaskId).length + stories.length },
    { id: "posts", label: "Post Queue", count: queuedPosts.length },
    { id: "presets", label: "Preset jobs", count: presets.length },
    { id: "deliverables", label: "Deliverables", count: deliverableTotal },
    { id: "clients", label: "Clients", count: clients.length },
    { id: "revenue", label: "Shipped & Revenue", count: ledger.length },
    { id: "history", label: "History" },
  ];
  const activeTabInfo = tabs.find((item) => item.id === tab);
  const expandedCountLabel = tab === "ready" ? `${approvalTasks.length} waiting` : activeTabInfo?.count !== undefined ? `${activeTabInfo.count} in this view` : "";
  return <>
    <button className="work-panel-scrim" aria-label="Close work panel" onClick={onClose} />
    <aside className={`work-panel simple-work-panel${expanded ? " is-expanded" : ""}`} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={expanded ? `Work panel — ${activeTabInfo?.label ?? "Work"} expanded view` : "Work panel"}>
      {!expanded && <div className="work-panel-handle" aria-hidden="true" />}
      {expanded ? <header className="work-panel-head simple-panel-head expanded-panel-head"><div className="expanded-panel-title"><h2>{activeTabInfo?.label ?? "Work"}</h2>{expandedCountLabel && <span className="expanded-panel-count" aria-label={expandedCountLabel}>{expandedCountLabel}</span>}</div><div className="simple-panel-actions"><button type="button" className="panel-shrink" onClick={() => setExpanded(false)} aria-label="Shrink expanded view back to normal panel">Shrink</button><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close work panel">×</button></div></header> : <header className="work-panel-head simple-panel-head"><div><span>One job. One decision.</span><h2>Work</h2></div><div className="simple-panel-actions"><button className="panel-expand" type="button" onClick={() => setExpanded(true)} aria-label={`Expand ${activeTabInfo?.label ?? "current"} view`}>Expand</button><button className="panel-new-job" type="button" onClick={onCreateWork}>+ New job</button><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close work panel">×</button></div></header>}
      {!expanded && <nav className="work-tabs" aria-label="Work views">{tabs.map((item) => <button key={item.id} type="button" className={`${tab === item.id ? "active" : ""}${item.id === "ideas" && unreadIdeaHunts > 0 ? " has-unread" : ""}`} aria-current={tab === item.id ? "page" : undefined} onClick={() => openTab(item.id)}><span>{item.label}</span>{item.count !== undefined && <i>{item.count}</i>}{item.id === "ideas" && unreadIdeaHunts > 0 && <em aria-label={`${unreadIdeaHunts} new ${unreadIdeaHunts === 1 ? "idea hunt" : "idea hunts"}`}>{unreadIdeaHunts}</em>}</button>)}</nav>}

      <div className="work-tab-content">
        {tab === "working" && <section aria-labelledby="working-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="working-tab-title">What’s moving</h3><p>Watch the handoff from research to writing to image.</p></div></div>
          {activeTasks.length ? <div className="simple-job-list">{activeTasks.map((task) => <WorkingJobCard key={task.id} task={task} briefs={briefs} onOpen={() => onOpenTask(task)} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>The crew is standing by.</b><span>Start a job when you’re ready.</span><button type="button" onClick={onCreateWork}>Create work</button></div>}
        </section>}

        {tab === "terminal" && <section aria-labelledby="terminal-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head terminal-section-head"><div><h3 id="terminal-tab-title">Live crew terminal</h3><p>Current briefs, progress, and human-readable tool activity. Updates every few seconds.</p></div></div>
          <LiveAgentTerminal briefs={briefs} log={log} />
        </section>}

        {tab === "ready" && <section aria-labelledby="ready-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="ready-tab-title">Ready for You — needs your decision</h3><p>Only two kinds of things ever land here: finished work waiting on your one decision (Approve, Rework, or Delete), and a question the crew cannot answer without you. Standing-order runs never land here — creating the order was the approval, so each run finishes straight to Done. Once you approve a post package it moves to Deliverables, under To post; everything else you approve lands in the Deliverables Library.</p></div></div>
          {approvalTasks.length ? <DecisionQueue groups={readyGroups} showPositions={expanded} renderCard={(task, positionLabel) => {
            const taskBlockers = blockers.filter((blocker) => blocker.taskId === task.id);
            return <DecisionCard key={task.id} task={task} clientName={clients.find((client) => client.id === task.clientId)?.businessName} blockers={taskBlockers} waitingSince={waitingSinceForTask(task, briefs, taskBlockers)} positionLabel={positionLabel} onAnswer={onAnswerBlocker} onApprove={() => onApprove(task)} onFinalize={(keepPaths) => onFinalize(task, keepPaths)} onDeny={() => onSendBack(task)} onDelete={() => onDelete(task)} busy={busy} />;
          }} /> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>Nothing needs your decision.</b><span>Finished work and crew questions will land here — nothing else can.</span></div>}
        </section>}

        {tab === "ideas" && <section aria-labelledby="ideas-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head visionary-head"><div><span className="visionary-mark" aria-hidden="true">S</span><div><h3 id="ideas-tab-title">Sven’s idea desk</h3><p>Stories he found, on the shelves up top. His own ideas below. Sharper moves for what exists; realistic new territory beyond it.</p></div></div><button className="visionary-hunt" type="button" onClick={onHuntIdeas} disabled={huntingIdeas} aria-label={huntingIdeas ? "Sven is hunting for ideas" : "Send Sven to hunt for ideas now"}>{huntingIdeas && <span className="visionary-hunt-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />}{huntingIdeas ? "Sven is hunting…" : "Hunt for ideas"}</button></div>
          <div className="visionary-section-head story-shelf-head"><div><h4>Stories for Perfectly Paranoid</h4><p>Stories Sven found that fit Perfectly Paranoid — strange history, disappearances, weird science, and declassified CIA and FBI files. Candidates only: nothing here is checked yet. Make one a job and it runs as a Perfectly Paranoid job for the client, checked the usual way. Dismissed stories never come back.</p></div><span>{ppStories.length}</span></div>
          {ppStories.length ? <div className="story-feed">{ppStories.map((story) => <StoryCard key={story.id} story={story} onMakeJob={onMakeStoryJob} onDismiss={onDismissStory} making={makingStoryJobId === story.id} dismissing={dismissingStoryId === story.id} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty visionary-empty"><b>No stories on this shelf.</b><span>Sven files what he finds on his daily hunt — including a look through declassified files.</span></div>}
          <div className="visionary-section-head story-shelf-head"><div><h4>Stories for Pulse HQ</h4><p>AI and business stories Sven found that could become Pulse HQ content. Make one a job and the crew works it like any other job.</p></div><span>{pulseStories.length}</span></div>
          {pulseStories.length ? <div className="story-feed">{pulseStories.map((story) => <StoryCard key={story.id} story={story} onMakeJob={onMakeStoryJob} onDismiss={onDismissStory} making={makingStoryJobId === story.id} dismissing={dismissingStoryId === story.id} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty visionary-empty"><b>No stories on this shelf.</b><span>Sven’s next hunt will look again.</span></div>}
          <div className="visionary-section-head"><div><h4>Active ideas</h4><p>Sven’s own proposals — send the good ones to Remmy or deny what doesn’t fit.</p></div><span>{activeIdeas.length}</span></div>
          {activeIdeas.length ? <div className="visionary-feed">{activeIdeas.map((idea) => <VisionaryIdeaCard key={idea.id} idea={idea} onLaunch={onLaunchIdea} onDeny={onDenyIdea} sending={launchingIdeaId === idea.id} denying={denyingIdeaId === idea.id} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty visionary-empty"><b>No active ideas.</b><span>Sven’s next run will bring back more.</span></div>}
          <div className="visionary-section-head completed"><div><h4>Completed</h4><p>Ideas already handed to Remmy.</p></div><span>{completedIdeas.length}</span></div>
          {completedIdeas.length ? <div className="visionary-feed visionary-completed-feed">{completedIdeas.map((idea) => <VisionaryIdeaCard key={idea.id} idea={idea} onLaunch={onLaunchIdea} onDeny={onDenyIdea} sending={false} denying={false} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty visionary-empty compact"><b>Nothing sent yet.</b><span>Actioned ideas will stay visible here.</span></div>}
        </section>}

        {tab === "posts" && <section aria-labelledby="posts-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="posts-tab-title">Post Queue — @PulseHQOffice</h3><p>Drafted by Olivia · Research Dept. Every post carries a link or an attached image. Copy puts the post text on your clipboard; paste into X yourself, save the image from the card and attach it, then mark it posted. If a copy doesn't take, the card says so and gives you the text in a box to copy by hand. Olivia never logs into X — drafting only.</p></div><span className="post-queue-count" aria-label={`${queuedPosts.length} unposted ${queuedPosts.length === 1 ? "post" : "posts"} in the queue`}>{queuedPosts.length} unposted</span></div>
          {queuedPosts.length ? <div className="post-queue-list">{queuedPosts.map((post) => <XPostCard key={post.id} post={post} onMarkPosted={() => onMarkXPostPosted(post.id)} onDelete={() => onDeleteXPost(post.id)} busy={xPostBusy} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>The queue is empty.</b><span>Create an X Posts job for Olivia, or wait for her Monday batch of 3.</span><button type="button" onClick={onCreateWork}>Create work</button></div>}
          <div className="visionary-section-head completed"><div><h4>Posted history</h4><p>Posts you already pasted into X — kept here, out of the queue.</p></div><span>{postedPosts.length}</span></div>
          {postedPosts.length ? <div className="post-queue-list posted">{postedPosts.map((post) => <article className="x-post-card posted" key={post.id}>
            <header><span className="x-post-source">{post.source === "standing" ? "Monday batch" : "Manual request"}</span><time>{post.postedAt ? `Posted ${formatStamp(post.postedAt)}` : formatStamp(post.createdAt)}</time></header>
            <p className="x-post-text">{post.text}</p>
            <XPostMedia post={post} />
            <footer><span>{post.text.length} / 280</span><span>Drafted by Olivia</span></footer>
          </article>)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty visionary-empty compact"><b>Nothing posted yet.</b><span>Marked posts will stay visible here.</span></div>}
        </section>}

        {tab === "presets" && <section aria-labelledby="presets-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="presets-tab-title">Preset jobs</h3><p>Saved job shapes that start only when you click Start — the manual counterpart to standing orders, which fire on their own schedule. Starting a preset creates a completely normal job: same crew, same pipeline, same one decision at the end.</p></div><button className="preset-new-button" type="button" onClick={onNewPreset}>+ New preset</button></div>
          {presets.length ? <div className="preset-list">{presets.map((preset) => <PresetCard key={preset.id} preset={preset} onStart={() => onStartPreset(preset)} onEdit={() => onEditPreset(preset)} onDelete={() => onDeletePreset(preset)} busy={presetBusy} />)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>No presets yet.</b><span>Save any job shape you start often — a name, a job type, and its brief kept ready — and next time it starts with one click. You can also save a preset straight from the Create work form.</span><button type="button" onClick={onNewPreset}>Create your first preset</button></div>}
        </section>}

        {tab === "deliverables" && <section aria-labelledby="deliverables-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="deliverables-tab-title">Deliverables</h3><p>If you approved it, its finished output lives here. Pick a kind from the dropdown — posts as tiles, packages as full cards, files and reports as compact rows — or leave it on All to see the kinds grouped under their headings. Packages also live under their client in Clients, with the same cards and controls.</p></div></div>
          <DeliverablesKindContent approvedTasks={approvedTasks} libraryTasks={libraryTasks} packages={packages} clients={clients} tasks={tasks} activeClient={activeClient} onClearActiveClient={onClearActiveClient} onMarkTaskPosted={onMarkTaskPosted} taskPostedBusy={taskPostedBusy} onApprovePackage={onApprovePackage} onReworkPackage={onReworkPackage} onFinishAssemblingPackage={onFinishAssemblingPackage} onDownloadPackage={onDownloadPackage} onSavePackageLink={onSavePackageLink} packageDeliveryBusy={packageDeliveryBusy} clientBusy={clientBusy} onOpenTask={onOpenTask} idPrefix="panel" expanded={expanded} />
        </section>}

        {tab === "clients" && <section aria-labelledby="clients-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="clients-tab-title">Clients — client profiles</h3><p>Who each client is, their special instructions, the button that populates the world with just them, what's next for them, their delivery packages (the same cards as in Deliverables, with every control working here too), and links to their finished work. Tag a job to a client in Create work and Maria shapes its brief from the profile below.</p></div><button className="preset-new-button" type="button" onClick={onNewClient}>+ New client</button></div>
          {activeClient && <ActiveClientBanner client={activeClient} surface="This client is populating the world: the Deliverables Posts, Files and Reports show only their deliverables. Ready for You, the floors, and the Work boards still show everyone." onClear={onClearActiveClient} />}
          {clients.length ? <ClientProfileList clients={clients} packages={packages} tasks={tasks} activeClientId={activeClient?.id ?? null} onToggleActive={onToggleClient} openReportTaskClientIds={openReportTaskClientIds} onEdit={onEditClient} onDelete={onDeleteClient} onRunReport={onRunClientReport} onDraftCaseStudy={onDraftCaseStudy} onOpenFinishedWork={(task) => { openTab("deliverables"); onOpenFinishedWork(task); }} onUpdateInstructions={onUpdateClientInstructions} instructionsBusy={instructionsBusy} busy={clientBusy} onApprovePackage={onApprovePackage} onReworkPackage={onReworkPackage} onFinishAssemblingPackage={onFinishAssemblingPackage} onDownloadPackage={onDownloadPackage} onSavePackageLink={onSavePackageLink} packageDeliveryBusy={packageDeliveryBusy} onOpenTask={onOpenTask} /> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>The directory is empty.</b><span>Add your first client and Maria can start shaping their work — intake, reports, packages, and their finished-work links all key off their profile.</span><button type="button" onClick={onNewClient}>Add your first client</button></div>}
        </section>}

        {tab === "revenue" && <section aria-labelledby="revenue-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="revenue-tab-title">Shipped & Revenue</h3><p>Everything that shipped and what it earned, newest first. When an external client’s delivery package is delivered, its row appears here on its own with the amount blank — you fill in the money. Perfectly Paranoid and Pulse HQ’s own posts never appear here — they aren’t owed money. Add rows by hand for money that never touched a package, like a Skunk Tools sale. Amounts are in Canadian dollars.</p></div></div>
          <LedgerView entries={ledger} clients={clients} busy={ledgerBusy} onAdd={onAddLedgerEntry} onUpdate={onUpdateLedgerEntry} onDelete={onDeleteLedgerEntry} />
        </section>}

        {tab === "history" && <section aria-labelledby="history-tab-title">
          <div className="simple-section-head"><div><h3 id="history-tab-title">What happened</h3><p>A chronological office log—not a filing cabinet.</p></div></div>
          {log.length ? <div className="log-list panel-history-log">{log.map((entry) => <div className="log-entry" key={entry.id}><div>{displayMemberNames(entry.text)}</div><time>{formatStamp(entry.t)}</time></div>)}</div> : <div className="simple-empty"><b>No activity yet.</b><span>The office log will build as work moves.</span></div>}
        </section>}
      </div>
    </aside>
  </>;
}

export function WorkPanel({ approvalTasks, blockers, activeTasks, doneTasks, standingOrders, showHistory, historySearch, onHistorySearch, onToggleHistory, onClose, onOpenTask, onAnswerBlocker, onApprove, onFinalize, onSendBack, onDelete, onCreateWork, onNewOrder, onStartStory, onToggleOrder, onDeleteOrder, busy }: {
  approvalTasks: Task[];
  blockers: Blocker[];
  activeTasks: Task[];
  doneTasks: Task[];
  standingOrders: StandingOrder[];
  showHistory: boolean;
  historySearch: string;
  onHistorySearch: (value: string) => void;
  onToggleHistory: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenTask: (task: Task) => void;
  onAnswerBlocker: (blocker: Blocker) => void;
  onApprove: (task: Task) => void;
  onFinalize: (task: Task, keepPaths: string[]) => void;
  onSendBack: (task: Task) => void;
  onDelete: (task: Task) => void;
  onCreateWork: (title: string, notes: string) => void;
  onNewOrder: () => void;
  onStartStory: () => void;
  onToggleOrder: (order: StandingOrder) => void;
  onDeleteOrder: (order: StandingOrder) => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const query = historySearch.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  const filteredHistory = query ? doneTasks.filter((task) => `${task.title}\n${task.notes}\n${memberById(task.assignee)?.name ?? ""}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query)) : doneTasks;
  return <>
    <button className="work-panel-scrim" aria-label="Close work panel" onClick={onClose} />
    <aside className="work-panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Work panel">
      <div className="work-panel-handle" aria-hidden="true" />
      <header className="work-panel-head"><div><span>Everything in one place</span><h2>Work panel</h2></div><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close work panel">×</button></header>

      <section className="panel-section approvals-section" aria-labelledby="approvals-title">
        <div className="panel-section-head"><div><span className="panel-section-index">01</span><h3 id="approvals-title">Waiting on You</h3></div><b className="panel-count approval-count">{approvalTasks.length}</b></div>
        {approvalTasks.length ? <div className="panel-job-list">{approvalTasks.map((task) => {
          const taskBlockers = blockers.filter((blocker) => blocker.taskId === task.id);
          return <PanelJobCard key={task.id} task={task} blockers={taskBlockers} onAnswer={onAnswerBlocker} onOpen={() => onOpenTask(task)} onApprove={taskBlockers.length ? undefined : () => onApprove(task)} onFinalize={taskBlockers.length ? undefined : (keepPaths) => onFinalize(task, keepPaths)} onSendBack={taskBlockers.length ? undefined : () => onSendBack(task)} onDelete={() => onDelete(task)} busy={busy} />;
        })}</div> : <div className="panel-clear"><i aria-hidden="true">✓</i><span><b>You're caught up.</b><small>Nothing is waiting for a decision.</small></span></div>}
      </section>

      <section className="panel-section" aria-labelledby="active-title">
        <div className="panel-section-head"><div><span className="panel-section-index">02</span><h3 id="active-title">Being worked</h3></div><b className="panel-count">{activeTasks.length}</b></div>
        {activeTasks.length ? <div className="panel-job-list compact">{activeTasks.map((task) => <PanelJobCard key={task.id} task={task} onOpen={() => onOpenTask(task)} onDelete={() => onDelete(task)} busy={busy} />)}</div> : <div className="panel-empty">The crew is standing by.</div>}
      </section>

      <section className="panel-section" aria-labelledby="orders-title">
        <div className="panel-section-head"><div><span className="panel-section-index">03</span><h3 id="orders-title">Standing orders</h3></div><button className="panel-text-action" type="button" onClick={onNewOrder}>New order</button></div>
        {standingOrders.length ? <div className="orders-list panel-orders">{standingOrders.map((order) => <StandingOrderCard key={order.id} order={order} onToggle={() => onToggleOrder(order)} onDelete={() => onDeleteOrder(order)} busy={busy} />)}</div> : <div className="panel-empty">No recurring work yet.</div>}
      </section>

      <section className="panel-section new-job-section" aria-labelledby="new-job-title">
        <div className="panel-section-head"><div><span className="panel-section-index">04</span><h3 id="new-job-title">Create work</h3></div></div>
        <InlineJobForm onSubmit={onCreateWork} busy={busy} />
        <button className="pipeline-shortcut" type="button" onClick={onStartStory}><span><b>Perfectly Paranoid story</b><small>Research → verify → image → copy → your one decision</small></span><i aria-hidden="true">Start story ›</i></button>
      </section>

      <section className="panel-section history-section" aria-labelledby="history-title">
        <button className="panel-history-toggle" type="button" onClick={onToggleHistory} aria-expanded={showHistory}>
          <span><span className="panel-section-index">05</span><b id="history-title">History</b></span><span><i>{doneTasks.length}</i><em aria-hidden="true">{showHistory ? "−" : "+"}</em></span>
        </button>
        {showHistory && <div className="history-panel-body">
          <label className="history-search"><span className="search-mark" aria-hidden="true" /><input value={historySearch} onChange={(event) => onHistorySearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search completed jobs" aria-label="Search completed jobs" /></label>
          <div className="panel-job-list compact">{filteredHistory.length ? filteredHistory.map((task) => <PanelJobCard key={task.id} task={task} onOpen={() => onOpenTask(task)} onDelete={() => onDelete(task)} busy={busy} />) : <div className="panel-empty">{query ? "No completed jobs match that search." : "No completed jobs yet."}</div>}</div>
        </div>}
      </section>
    </aside>
  </>;
}

function InlineJobForm({ onSubmit, busy }: { onSubmit: (title: string, notes: string) => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = title.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    onSubmit(trimmed, notes.trim());
    setTitle("");
    setNotes("");
  }
  return <form className="inline-job-form" onSubmit={submit}>
    <label htmlFor="panel-job-title">What needs doing</label>
    <input id="panel-job-title" value={title} onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)} maxLength={120} placeholder="Research Halloween shirt trends" required />
    <label htmlFor="panel-job-notes">Instructions <span>optional</span></label>
    <textarea id="panel-job-notes" value={notes} onChange={(event) => setNotes(event.target.value)} maxLength={5000} placeholder="Add the details Remmy needs…" />
    <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">R</span><p><b>Send it to Remmy</b><small>He reads the job and assigns the right worker.</small></p></div>
    <button className="inline-job-send" type="submit" disabled={busy || !title.trim()}>{busy ? "Remmy is assigning…" : "Create work"}</button>
  </form>;
}

function BlockerPrompts({ blockers, onAnswer, compact = false }: { blockers: Blocker[]; onAnswer: (blocker: Blocker) => void; compact?: boolean }) {
  if (!blockers.length) return null;
  return <div className={compact ? "blocker-prompts compact" : "blocker-prompts"} aria-label="Open crew questions">
    {blockers.map((blocker) => <div className="blocker-prompt" key={blocker.id}>
      <div><span>{memberById(blocker.memberId)?.name ?? "The crew"} needs {blocker.kind === "browser_action" ? "a browser action" : "your decision"}{blocker.retryCount > 1 ? ` · seen ${blocker.retryCount} times` : ""}</span><p>{blocker.question}</p></div>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => onAnswer(blocker)}>{blocker.kind === "browser_action" ? "Open gate check" : "Answer question"}</button>
    </div>)}
  </div>;
}

// Batch image approval (Ben's design): one screen shows ALL of an item's
// images in a grid, each with a Keep selector; one Accept button commits
// everything — selected images are kept, every non-selected image is
// deleted. The selection is local, in-flight state shared between the
// grid (TaskDeliverables / the package card) and the Accept button
// (ApprovalActions) inside one card: nothing is pre-selected, and
// nothing is recorded until Accept is pressed. The scope is keyed by
// task id so a card only ever reads its own item's selection.
type BatchSelection = { taskId: string; selected: ReadonlySet<string>; toggle: (relativePath: string) => void };
const BatchSelectionContext = createContext<BatchSelection | null>(null);

function BatchSelectionScope({ taskId, children }: { taskId: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(() => new Set());
  const value = useMemo<BatchSelection>(() => ({
    taskId,
    selected,
    toggle: (relativePath: string) => setSelected((previous) => {
      const next = new Set(previous);
      if (next.has(relativePath)) next.delete(relativePath);
      else next.add(relativePath);
      return next;
    }),
  }), [taskId, selected]);
  return <BatchSelectionContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</BatchSelectionContext.Provider>;
}

function useBatchSelection(taskId: string): BatchSelection | null {
  const selection = useContext(BatchSelectionContext);
  return selection && selection.taskId === taskId ? selection : null;
}

type ApprovalActionsLayout = "panel" | "review" | "compact" | "sheet";

function ApprovalActions({ task, layout, onApprove, onFinalize, onDeny, onDelete, onReviewImages, busy }: { task: Task; layout: ApprovalActionsLayout; onApprove: () => void; onFinalize: (keepPaths: string[]) => void; onDeny: () => void; onDelete: () => void; onReviewImages?: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const deliverables = useTaskDeliverablesQuery(task.id, task.revision, task.status === "approval");
  const images = deliverables.data?.items.filter((item) => item.kind === "image" && !item.excluded) ?? [];
  const multiImage = images.length > 1 && !task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt;
  const checking = deliverables.isLoading;
  // Batch Accept: the selection lives on the review grid (shared through
  // BatchSelectionScope). Accept commits it in one action — selected
  // images kept, every non-selected image deleted. With nothing selected
  // Accept is unavailable and the note below says so plainly.
  const batch = useBatchSelection(task.id);
  const keepPaths = multiImage ? images.filter((item) => batch?.selected.has(item.relativePath)).map((item) => item.relativePath) : [];
  const canAccept = multiImage && keepPaths.length > 0;
  const accept = () => { if (canAccept) onFinalize(keepPaths); };
  const batchProgress = multiImage ? <p className="item-review-progress"><b>{keepPaths.length} of {images.length} selected to keep</b><span>{images.length - keepPaths.length} will be deleted</span></p> : null;
  const batchNote = multiImage && keepPaths.length === 0 ? <p className="batch-select-note" role="note">Select at least one image to keep — or use Deny · rework or Delete for the whole job instead.</p> : null;

  // Phase 5: a bounce-exhausted job is STUCK — approval is not offered
  // (the server gate refuses it anyway); the working exits are exactly
  // Send back for rework and Delete, in every layout.
  if (isBounceExhausted(task.contractStatus, task.contractBounces)) {
    if (layout === "panel") return <div className="panel-job-actions">
      <button className="panel-delete" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`}>Delete</button>
      <button className="panel-sendback" type="button" onClick={onDeny} disabled={busy}>Send back for rework</button>
    </div>;
    if (layout === "sheet") return <div className="sheet-actions">
      <button className="big-button danger-ghost" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy}>Delete job</button>
      <button className="big-button ghost sendback-solid" onClick={onDeny} disabled={busy}>Send back for rework</button>
    </div>;
    return <div className="review-decisions three-way">
      <button className="review-delete-button" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`}>Delete</button>
      <button className="deny-button" onClick={onDeny} disabled={busy}>Send back for rework</button>
    </div>;
  }

  if (layout === "panel") return <>
    {batchProgress}
    {batchNote}
    <div className="panel-job-actions">
      <button className="panel-delete" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`}>Delete</button>
      <button className="panel-sendback" type="button" onClick={onDeny} disabled={busy}>Rework</button>
      <button className="panel-approve" type="button" onClick={multiImage ? accept : onApprove} disabled={busy || checking || (multiImage && !canAccept)}>{checking ? "Checking files…" : multiImage ? "Accept" : "Approve"}</button>
    </div>
  </>;

  if (layout === "sheet") return <div className="sheet-actions">
    {batchProgress}
    {batchNote}
    <button className="big-button danger-ghost" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy}>Delete job</button>
    <button className="big-button ghost sendback-solid" onClick={onDeny} disabled={busy}>Deny · rework</button>
    <button className="big-button approve-solid" onClick={multiImage ? accept : onApprove} disabled={busy || checking || (multiImage && !canAccept)}>{checking ? "Checking files…" : multiImage ? "Accept" : "Approve · done"}</button>
  </div>;

  // Compact board cards carry no image grid of their own: for a
  // multi-image job the primary action opens the job, where the grid and
  // the Accept live — the batch decision is never made blind from here.
  if (layout === "compact" && multiImage && onReviewImages) return <>
    {batchProgress}
    <div className="review-decisions compact three-way">
      <button className="review-delete-button" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`}>Delete</button>
      <button className="deny-button" onClick={onDeny} disabled={busy}>Deny · rework</button>
      <button className="approve-button" onClick={onReviewImages} disabled={busy || checking}>{checking ? "Checking files…" : "Pick images"}</button>
    </div>
  </>;

  return <>
    {batchProgress}
    {batchNote}
    <div className={layout === "compact" ? "review-decisions compact three-way" : "review-decisions three-way"}>
