      <button className="review-delete-button" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`}>Delete</button>
      <button className="deny-button" onClick={onDeny} disabled={busy}>Deny · rework</button>
      <button className="approve-button" onClick={multiImage ? accept : onApprove} disabled={busy || checking || (multiImage && !canAccept)}>{checking ? "Checking files…" : multiImage ? "Accept" : "Approve · done"}</button>
    </div>
  </>;
}

function PanelJobCard({ task, blockers = [], onAnswer, onOpen, onApprove, onFinalize, onSendBack, onDelete, busy }: { task: Task; blockers?: Blocker[]; onAnswer?: (blocker: Blocker) => void; onOpen: () => void; onApprove?: () => void; onFinalize?: (keepPaths: string[]) => void; onSendBack?: () => void; onDelete: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const member = memberById(task.assignee);
  return <BatchSelectionScope taskId={task.id}><article className={`panel-job-card ${blockers.length ? "blocked" : task.status}`}>
    <button className="panel-job-main" type="button" onClick={onOpen}>
      <span className={`panel-job-status ${blockers.length ? "blocked" : task.status}`} aria-hidden="true" />
      <span><b>{task.title}</b><small>{member?.name ?? "The crew"} · {blockers.length ? "Needs your answer" : taskProgressLabel(task)}</small></span>
      <i aria-hidden="true">›</i>
    </button>
    {onAnswer && <BlockerPrompts blockers={blockers} onAnswer={onAnswer} compact />}
    {task.status === "approval" && blockers.length === 0 && <DecisionScreen task={task} variant="review" embedded />}
    {onApprove && onFinalize && onSendBack ? <ApprovalActions task={task} layout="panel" onApprove={onApprove} onFinalize={onFinalize} onDeny={onSendBack} onDelete={onDelete} busy={busy} /> : <div className="panel-job-actions">
      <button className="panel-delete" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`}>Delete</button>
      {task.status === "done" && <button className="panel-sendback" type="button" onClick={onOpen}>View deliverables</button>}
    </div>}
  </article></BatchSelectionScope>;
}

type CrewStage = { label: string; steps: string[]; currentIndex: number };

function crewStage(task: Task | undefined, brief: Brief | undefined): CrewStage {
  if (!task) return { label: brief?.status === "in_progress" ? "Being worked" : "Standing by", steps: ["Being worked", "Waiting on You", "Done"], currentIndex: 0 };
  const steps = ["Being worked", "Waiting on You", "Done"];
  const currentIndex: Record<TaskStatus, number> = { working: 0, approval: 1, done: 2 };
  return { label: brief?.progressText || taskProgressLabel(task), steps, currentIndex: currentIndex[task.status] };
}

function elapsedLabel(startedAt: string, clock: Date): string {
  const elapsedSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor((clock.getTime() - new Date(startedAt).getTime()) / 1000));
  if (elapsedSeconds < 60) return `${elapsedSeconds}s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(elapsedSeconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  const remainder = minutes % 60;
  return remainder ? `${hours}h ${remainder}m` : `${hours}h`;
}

function CrewOverlay({ member, floorStatus, tasks, briefs, log, clock, onClose, onCreateWork }: { member: Member; floorStatus?: FloorMemberStatus; tasks: Task[]; briefs: Brief[]; log: OfficeLogEntry[]; clock: Date; onClose: () => void; onCreateWork: () => void }) {
  const liveBrief = briefs.find((brief) => brief.assignee === member.id && brief.status === "in_progress");
  const floorTask = floorStatus?.taskId ? tasks.find((task) => task.id === floorStatus.taskId) : undefined;
  const currentTask = floorTask ?? (liveBrief
    ? tasks.find((task) => task.id === liveBrief.taskId)
    : tasks.find((task) => task.assignee === member.id && task.status === "approval")
      ?? tasks.find((task) => task.assignee === member.id && task.status === "working"));
  const active = floorStatus?.active ?? liveBrief?.status === "in_progress";
  const title = floorStatus?.label ?? liveBrief?.title ?? currentTask?.title;
  const stage = crewStage(currentTask, liveBrief);
  const stageLabel = floorStatus?.label ?? stage.label;
  const statusBadge = floorStatus?.badge ?? (active ? "Live" : "Standby");
  const progress = stage.steps.length > 1 ? Math.round((stage.currentIndex / (stage.steps.length - 1)) * 100) : 0;
  const startedAt = liveBrief?.updatedAt ?? currentTask?.created;
  const legacyName = Object.entries(LEGACY_MEMBER_NAMES).find(([, current]) => current === member.name)?.[0];
  const nameNeedles = [member.name, legacyName].filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value)).map((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase());
  const activity = log.filter((entry) => nameNeedles.some((name) => entry.text.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(name))).slice(0, 4);
  const cardStyle = { "--member-color": member.color, "--crew-progress": `${progress}%`, "--crew-stage-count": stage.steps.length } as CSSProperties;

  return <>
    <button className="crew-card-scrim" aria-label={`Close ${member.name} card`} onClick={onClose} />
    <aside className="crew-float-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`${member.name} live status`} data-current-status={stageLabel} style={cardStyle}>
      <button className="crew-card-close" type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label={`Close ${member.name} card`}>×</button>
      <header className="crew-card-identity">
        <span className="crew-avatar-beacon"><MemberAvatar member={member} large />{active && <i aria-hidden="true" />}</span>
        <div><small>{member.role}</small><h2>{member.name}</h2><span className={active ? "crew-live-chip" : "crew-live-chip standby"}>{statusBadge}</span></div>
      </header>

      <section className={active ? "crew-visual-console active" : "crew-visual-console"} aria-label={`${member.name} progress`}>
        <div className="crew-progress-dial" aria-hidden="true"><span><b>{stage.currentIndex + 1}</b><small>of {stage.steps.length}</small></span></div>
        <div className="crew-console-copy"><span>Current status</span><b>{stageLabel}</b><small>{startedAt ? `${active ? "Active" : "Open"} for ${elapsedLabel(startedAt, clock)}` : active ? "Active now" : "No active clock"}</small></div>
        <div className="crew-signal" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /><i /><i /></div>
      </section>

      {title ? <section className="crew-current-task" aria-label="Current activity">
        <span>{floorStatus ? "Current activity" : "Current brief"}</span><b>{title}</b>
        {floorStatus?.title && floorStatus.title !== title && <small>{floorStatus.title}</small>}
        {!floorStatus && liveBrief && <small>Picked up {formatStamp(liveBrief.updatedAt)}</small>}
      </section> : <section className="crew-current-task empty-current"><span>Current activity</span><b>Standing by</b><small>{member.focus}</small></section>}

      <ol className="crew-stage-track" aria-label={`Workflow progress: ${stageLabel}`}>
        {stage.steps.map((step, index) => <li key={step} className={index < stage.currentIndex ? "complete" : index === stage.currentIndex ? "current" : "upcoming"}>
          <i aria-hidden="true">{index < stage.currentIndex ? "✓" : index + 1}</i><span>{step}</span>
        </li>)}
      </ol>

      <section className="crew-activity-panel" aria-labelledby={`crew-activity-${member.id}`}>
        <div className="crew-panel-heading"><h3 id={`crew-activity-${member.id}`}>Recent activity</h3><span>Auto-refreshes</span></div>
        {activity.length ? <div className="crew-activity-list">{activity.map((entry, index) => <div key={entry.id} className="crew-activity-item"><i className={index === 0 && active ? "hot" : ""} aria-hidden="true" /><p><span>{displayMemberNames(entry.text)}</span><time>{formatStamp(entry.t)}</time></p></div>)}</div> : <p className="crew-no-activity">No activity milestone has been logged yet.</p>}
      </section>

      {isBriefAssignable(member.id) && <button className="crew-assign-button" type="button" onClick={onCreateWork}>Create work</button>}
    </aside>
  </>;
}

type PendingBriefingAttachment = {
  key: string;
  fileName: string;
  contentType: string;
  dataBase64: string;
  previewUrl: string | null;
  isImage: boolean;
};

const REMMY_ATTACHMENT_ACCEPT = "image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,text/plain,text/markdown,.md";
const REMMY_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

function briefingAttachmentKind(file: File): { contentType: string; isImage: boolean } | null {
  if (file.type === "image/png" || file.type === "image/jpeg" || file.type === "image/webp") return { contentType: file.type, isImage: true };
  if (file.type === "text/plain") return { contentType: "text/plain", isImage: false };
  if (file.type === "text/markdown" || /\.md$/i.test(file.name)) return { contentType: "text/markdown", isImage: false };
  return null;
}

// The briefing chat: a direct line to the real Remmy. The thread lives
// server-side; this overlay only collects Ben's messages and attachments,
// marks the thread as with Remmy, and dispatches the shaped job Remmy
// posts back. It never invents a Remmy reply — while a thread is with him
// it shows an honest waiting state.
function RemmyChatOverlay({ onClose, onJobStarted }: { onClose: () => void; onJobStarted: () => void }) {
  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [localBriefing, setLocalBriefing] = useState<RemmyBriefing | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<PendingBriefingAttachment[]>([]);
  const [chatError, setChatError] = useState("");
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const threadRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const startedRef = useRef(false);

  const polled = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["remmy-briefing", sessionId],
    queryFn: () => api.get_remmy_briefing({ sessionId: sessionId ?? "" }),
    enabled: Boolean(sessionId),
    refetchInterval: 4000,
  });
  // Mutations return the freshest thread; the 4-second poll catches up
  // behind them. Always render whichever copy is newer, so a just-sent
  // message never blinks out while the poll is still holding the old one.
  const polledBriefing = polled.data?.ok ? polled.data.briefing : null;
  const briefing = polledBriefing && localBriefing
    ? (Date.parse(localBriefing.updatedAt) > Date.parse(polledBriefing.updatedAt) ? localBriefing : polledBriefing)
    : polledBriefing ?? localBriefing;

  const startSession = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.start_remmy_briefing({}),
    onSuccess: (result) => {
      if (result.ok) {
        setLocalBriefing(result.briefing);
        setSessionId(result.briefing.id);
      } else {
        setChatError(result.error);
      }
    },
    onError: () => setChatError("The briefing chat could not be opened. Try again."),
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (startedRef.current) return;
    startedRef.current = true;
    startSession.mutate();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const sendMessage = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: { text: string; attachments: Array<{ fileName: string; contentType: string; dataBase64: string }> }) =>
      api.send_remmy_message({ sessionId: sessionId ?? "", text: input.text, attachments: input.attachments }),
    onSuccess: (result) => {
      if (result.ok) {
        setLocalBriefing(result.briefing);
        setDraft("");
        setPending((current) => {
          current.forEach((item) => { if (item.previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(item.previewUrl); });
          return [];
        });
        setChatError("");
      } else {
        setChatError(result.error);
      }
    },
    onError: () => setChatError("That message could not be sent. Your words are still in the box — try again."),
  });
  const requestShaping = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.request_remmy_shaping({ sessionId: sessionId ?? "" }),
    onSuccess: (result) => {
      if (result.ok) {
        setLocalBriefing(result.briefing);
        setChatError("");
      } else {
        setChatError(result.error);
      }
    },
    onError: () => setChatError("That could not be handed to Remmy. Try again."),
  });
  const startJob = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.start_remmy_briefing_job({ sessionId: sessionId ?? "" }),
    onSuccess: (result) => {
      if (result.ok) {
        setLocalBriefing(result.briefing);
        setChatError("");
        onJobStarted();
      } else {
        setChatError(result.error);
      }
    },
    onError: () => setChatError("The job could not be started. Try again."),
  });

  const messageCount = briefing?.messages.length ?? 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    const thread = threadRef.current;
    if (thread) thread.scrollTop = thread.scrollHeight;
  }, [messageCount, briefing?.status, briefing?.shaped?.title]);

  async function addFiles(files: File[]) {
    const accepted: PendingBriefingAttachment[] = [];
    for (const file of files) {
      if (pending.length + accepted.length >= 4) {
        setChatError("Four attachments per message is the limit — send these, then add the rest.");
        break;
      }
      const kind = briefingAttachmentKind(file);
      if (!kind) {
        setChatError(`“${file.name}” can't ride along — attachments are PNG, JPEG, or WebP images, or plain-text / Markdown notes.`);
        continue;
      }
      if (file.size > REMMY_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES) {
        setChatError(`“${file.name}” is over the 8 MB attachment limit.`);
        continue;
      }
      try {
        const encoded = await fileToBase64(file);
        accepted.push({
          key: `${file.name}-${file.size}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
          fileName: file.name,
          contentType: kind.contentType,
          dataBase64: encoded.dataBase64,
          previewUrl: kind.isImage ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : null,
          isImage: kind.isImage,
        });
      } catch {
        setChatError(`“${file.name}” could not be read.`);
      }
    }
    if (accepted.length) {
      setPending((current) => [...current, ...accepted].slice(0, 4));
    }
  }

  function handlePaste(event: ClipboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) {
    const files = Array.from(event.clipboardData?.files ?? []);
    if (files.length) {
      event.preventDefault();
      void addFiles(files);
    }
  }

  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!sessionId || sendMessage.isPending) return;
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text && pending.length === 0) return;
    sendMessage.mutate({
      text,
      attachments: pending.map((item) => ({ fileName: item.fileName, contentType: item.contentType, dataBase64: item.dataBase64 })),
    });
  }

  const status = briefing?.status ?? "open";
  const hasUserMessage = briefing?.messages.some((message) => message.role === "user") ?? false;
  const busy = sendMessage.isPending || requestShaping.isPending || startJob.isPending;

  return <>
    <button className="remmy-chat-scrim" aria-label="Close briefing chat" onClick={onClose} />
    <aside className="remmy-chat" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Brief Remmy">
      <header className="remmy-chat-head">
        <span className="avatar has-portrait" style={{ background: "#5eead4" }} aria-hidden="true"><MemberPortrait memberId="remmy" /></span>
        <div>
          <h2>Remmy</h2>
          <p>A direct line to the real Remmy. He reads this whole thread — links, images, all of it — and replies here. Replies come at agent speed, not instantly.</p>
        </div>
        <button className="remmy-chat-close" type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close briefing chat">×</button>
      </header>

      <div className="remmy-chat-thread" ref={threadRef} aria-live="polite">
        {!briefing && <p className="remmy-chat-loading">Opening the line…</p>}
        {briefing && briefing.messages.length === 0 && <div className="remmy-chat-empty">
          <b>Brief him like you'd brief a person.</b>
          <span>Say what you need across as many messages as it takes. Paste links, drop in images or notes — nothing goes to the crew until you say so.</span>
        </div>}
        {briefing?.messages.map((message) => <RemmyChatMessage key={message.id} message={message} />)}
        {status === "awaiting_remmy" && <div className="remmy-chat-waiting" role="status">
          <span className="remmy-chat-waiting-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
          <p><b>With Remmy</b><span>He'll shape this and reply here — his summary lands in this chat.</span></p>
        </div>}
        {briefing?.shaped && status === "shaped" && <section className="remmy-chat-shaped" aria-label="The job Remmy shaped">
          <span className="remmy-chat-shaped-kicker">Remmy's shaped job</span>
          <h3>{briefing.shaped.title}</h3>
          <p className="remmy-chat-shaped-type">{REMMY_JOB_TYPE_LABELS[briefing.shaped.jobType]}{briefing.shaped.jobType === "x_posts" && briefing.shaped.postCount ? ` · ${briefing.shaped.postCount} post${briefing.shaped.postCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : ""}</p>
          <p className="remmy-chat-shaped-summary">{briefing.shaped.summary}</p>
          <details className="remmy-chat-shaped-brief">
            <summary>Read the brief he'll send</summary>
            <p>{briefing.shaped.brief}</p>
          </details>
          <button className="remmy-chat-start" type="button" onClick={() => startJob.mutate()} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Send it to the crew: ${briefing.shaped.title}`}>{startJob.isPending ? "Sending to the crew…" : "▶ Send it to the crew"}</button>
          <p className="remmy-chat-shaped-note">Sending it to the crew creates a normal job — same pipeline, same one decision waiting for you at the end. Anything you attached rides with it.</p>
        </section>}
        {status === "dispatched" && <div className="remmy-chat-dispatched" role="status">
          <b>Sent to the crew</b>
          <span>{briefing?.taskTitle ? `“${briefing.taskTitle}” is moving through the pipeline now.` : "The job is moving through the pipeline now."} You can close this chat — the floor never missed a beat.</span>
        </div>}
      </div>

      {chatError && <p className="remmy-chat-error" role="alert">{chatError}</p>}

      <form className="remmy-chat-composer" onSubmit={submit}>
        {pending.length > 0 && <div className="remmy-chat-pending" aria-label="Attachments ready to send">
          {pending.map((item) => <span className="remmy-chat-pending-chip" key={item.key}>
            {item.previewUrl ? <img src={item.previewUrl} alt="" /> : <i aria-hidden="true">TXT</i>}
            <span>{item.fileName}</span>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setPending((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.key !== item.key))} aria-label={`Remove attachment ${item.fileName}`}>×</button>
          </span>)}
        </div>}
        <div className="remmy-chat-input-row">
          <button className="remmy-chat-attach" type="button" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} aria-label="Attach an image or text file">+</button>
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            accept={REMMY_ATTACHMENT_ACCEPT}
            multiple
            hidden
            aria-label="Choose files to attach"
            onChange={(event) => {
              const files = Array.from(event.target.files ?? []);
              event.target.value = "";
              if (files.length) void addFiles(files);
            }}
          />
          <textarea
            value={draft}
            onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
            onPaste={handlePaste}
            placeholder="Tell Remmy what you need…"
            aria-label="Message Remmy"
            rows={2}
            maxLength={5000}
          />
          <button className="remmy-chat-send" type="submit" disabled={!sessionId || busy || (!draft.trim() && pending.length === 0)} aria-label="Send message">{sendMessage.isPending ? "Sending…" : "Send"}</button>
        </div>
        {status !== "dispatched" && <button
          className="remmy-chat-take"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => requestShaping.mutate()}
          disabled={!sessionId || busy || !hasUserMessage || status === "awaiting_remmy"}
          aria-label="Start — hand this thread to Remmy"
        >{status === "awaiting_remmy" ? "With Remmy — waiting for his reply" : requestShaping.isPending ? "Handing it to Remmy…" : "Start"}</button>}
        {status !== "dispatched" && status !== "awaiting_remmy" && <p className="remmy-chat-hint">Nothing dispatches while you're still talking. “Start” hands Remmy the whole thread; he posts the shaped job back here, and “Send it to the crew” is what sends it out.</p>}
      </form>
    </aside>
  </>;
}

function RemmyChatMessage({ message }: { message: RemmyBriefingMessage }) {
  const fromRemmy = message.role === "remmy";
  return <article className={fromRemmy ? "remmy-chat-message remmy" : "remmy-chat-message user"}>
    <span className="remmy-chat-message-who">{fromRemmy ? "Remmy" : "You"} · {formatStamp(message.createdAt)}</span>
    {message.text && <p>{message.text}</p>}
    {message.attachments.length > 0 && <div className="remmy-chat-message-files">
      {message.attachments.map((attachment) => attachment.kind === "image" && attachment.imageUrl
        ? <figure key={attachment.id} className="remmy-chat-message-image"><img src={attachment.imageUrl} alt={attachment.fileName} loading="lazy" /><figcaption>{attachment.fileName}</figcaption></figure>
        : <span key={attachment.id} className="remmy-chat-message-file"><i aria-hidden="true">{attachment.kind === "image" ? "IMG" : "TXT"}</i>{attachment.fileName}</span>)}
    </div>}
  </article>;
}

// One item on the decision page, designed fresh around the decision
// itself (2026-10-18 redo — this replaces the old review card, it is
// not a restyle of it). Reading order is the whole design:
//   1. WHAT IT IS — kind, client, and how long it has waited, in one
//      quiet line. The waiting time is part of the item, not metadata.
//   2. WHAT IT IS CALLED — the finished deliverable's own title. The
//      job's working title rides underneath in small type, so nothing
//      is hidden and nothing leads with raw instruction text.
//   3. THE RESULT — first content, in a reading column: the result
//      lead (the deliverable's own opening), then the finished work
//      itself. Evidence, working papers, and checks live behind the
//      one Extras door at the bottom — present, never in the way.
//   4. THE DECISION — one bar, the same three decisions as always
//      (Approve / Rework / Delete, or Accept for a multi-image batch),
//      directly under the result they decide on.
// A blocked item has no result to decide on yet: its body is the
// crew's question, large and plain, with the Answer button on it.
function DecisionCard({ task, clientName, blockers, waitingSince, positionLabel, onAnswer, onApprove, onFinalize, onDeny, onDelete, busy }: { task: Task; clientName?: string; blockers: Blocker[]; waitingSince?: string; positionLabel?: string; onAnswer: (blocker: Blocker) => void; onApprove: () => void; onFinalize: (keepPaths: string[]) => void; onDeny: () => void; onDelete: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const [extrasOpen, setExtrasOpen] = useState(false);
  const [extrasOpened, setExtrasOpened] = useState(false);
  const kindLabel = readyKindLabelForTask(task);
  const stuck = isBounceExhausted(task.contractStatus, task.contractBounces);
  const plan = useReadyResultPlan(task.id, task.revision, task, task.status === "approval" && blockers.length === 0);
  const hasExtras = plan.extras.length > 0 || plan.extrasNotes.length > 0;
  const toggleExtras = () => {
    if (!extrasOpen) setExtrasOpened(true);
    setExtrasOpen((value) => !value);
  };
  const waitingLabel = waitingSince ? formatWaitingStamp(waitingSince) : "";
  return <BatchSelectionScope taskId={task.id}><article className={`decision-card${blockers.length ? " is-blocked" : ""}${stuck ? " is-stuck" : ""}`} aria-label={`${plan.displayTitle ?? task.title} — needs your decision`}>
    <header className="decision-card-head">
      <span className="decision-card-kind">{stuck ? "Stuck · " : ""}{blockers.length ? "Needs your answer · " : ""}{clientName ? `For ${clientName} · ` : ""}{kindLabel}</span>
      <span className="decision-card-head-right">
        {positionLabel && <span className="decision-card-position" aria-label={`Position ${positionLabel} in this list`}>{positionLabel}</span>}
        {waitingLabel && <span className="decision-card-waiting">Waiting since {waitingLabel}</span>}
      </span>
    </header>
    <h2 className="decision-card-title">{plan.displayTitle ?? task.title}</h2>
    {plan.displayTitle && <p className="decision-card-job">Job: {task.title}</p>}
    {stuck && <p className="decision-stuck-note" role="note">Stuck — this job failed its outcome check {task.contractBounces} times, so it can’t be approved. What went wrong: {task.contractViolation ?? "the finished work did not match what was asked for"}. Send it back for rework or delete it.</p>}
    {blockers.length > 0 ? <>
      <div className="decision-question">
        <BlockerPrompts blockers={blockers} onAnswer={onAnswer} />
      </div>
      <footer className="decision-bar">
        <button className="review-delete-button" type="button" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete ${task.title}`}>Delete</button>
      </footer>
    </> : <>
      <section className="decision-result" aria-label="The finished result">
        {plan.resultLead && <p className="decision-result-lead">{plan.resultLead}</p>}
        <ReadyResultFace task={task} plan={plan} reviewMode />
      </section>
      {plan.multiPiece && !plan.face?.researchFace && !plan.face?.facebookPost && <DecisionScreen task={task} variant="review" embedded />}
      {!(plan.multiPiece && !plan.face?.researchFace && !plan.face?.facebookPost) && plan.heldOut.length > 0 && <p className="held-out-note" role="note">Held out by ruling — not part of this pack: {plan.heldOut.join(" · ")}</p>}
      <footer className="decision-bar">
        <ApprovalActions task={task} layout="review" onApprove={onApprove} onFinalize={onFinalize} onDeny={onDeny} onDelete={onDelete} busy={busy} />
      </footer>
      {hasExtras && <button type="button" className="decision-extras-toggle" aria-expanded={extrasOpen} onClick={toggleExtras}>{extrasOpen ? "Hide extras" : "Extras — the evidence, full documents & checks"}</button>}
      {extrasOpened && hasExtras && <div className="decision-extras" hidden={!extrasOpen}>
        <ReadyExtrasShelf entries={plan.extras} notes={plan.extrasNotes} />
      </div>}
    </>}
  </article></BatchSelectionScope>;
}

function TaskGroup({ title, count, tone, children }: { title: string; count: number; tone: "approval" | "working"; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <section className={`task-group ${tone}`}><div className="task-group-title"><h2>{title}</h2><span>{count}</span></div><div className="task-list">{children}</div></section>;
}

// Passive visibility for Tom's escalation rule: the parent job card says
// plainly that claims went upstairs and what the lab returned. The lab
// sub-case itself is internal and never gets a card of its own.
function EscalationNote({ task }: { task: Task }) {
  if (!task.escalationStatus || !task.escalationClaimCount) return null;
  if (task.escalationStatus === "pending") {
    return <p className="escalation-note">Tom sent {task.escalationClaimCount} claim{task.escalationClaimCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} to the Research Department</p>;
  }
  return <p className="escalation-note">Research Department returned: {task.escalationDocumented ?? 0} documented, {task.escalationNotVerified ?? 0} not verified</p>;
}

// The job's outcome contract, in plain words, on the surfaces Ben reads:
// which shape this job type promises, and — when the pre-surface check
// bounced the deliverable — exactly why, recorded before Ben ever saw it.
// Jobs created before outcome contracts carry no contract and show none.
function ContractNote({ task }: { task: Task }) {
  if (!task.jobType || !task.contractLabel) return null;
  if (task.contractStatus === "bounced" && task.contractViolation) {
    if (isBounceExhausted(task.contractStatus, task.contractBounces)) {
      return <p className="contract-note bounced stuck" role="note"><b>STUCK — outcome contract — {task.contractLabel}.</b> This job failed its contract check {task.contractBounces} times and used up its automatic rework rounds: {task.contractViolation}. It cannot be approved. Send it back for rework, or delete it.</p>;
    }
    return <p className="contract-note bounced" role="note"><b>Outcome contract — {task.contractLabel}.</b> This deliverable failed its contract check: {task.contractViolation}. {task.clientId ? "As a client job it cannot be delivered until a rework fixes it." : "Send it back for rework, or delete it."}</p>;
  }
  if (task.contractStatus === "passed") {
    return <p className="contract-note" role="note"><b>Outcome contract — {task.contractLabel}.</b> {task.contractDeliverable} Checked against its contract before it surfaced: passed.</p>;
  }
  return <p className="contract-note" role="note"><b>Outcome contract — {task.contractLabel}.</b> {task.contractDeliverable} {task.contractVoice} The finished work is checked against this contract before it reaches you.</p>;
}

function TaskCard({ task, blockers = [], onAnswer, onOpen, onMove, onFinalize, onDelete, busy }: { task: Task; blockers?: Blocker[]; onAnswer?: (blocker: Blocker) => void; onOpen: () => void; onMove: (status: TaskStatus) => void; onFinalize?: (keepPaths: string[]) => void; onDelete: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const member = memberById(task.assignee);
  const meta = member ?? { name: "Any agent", color: "#8b98ad" };
  return <BatchSelectionScope taskId={task.id}><article className={`task-card ${task.status === "done" ? "is-done" : ""} ${blockers.length ? "is-blocked" : ""}`}>
    <div className="task-card-head">
      <button className="task-title" onClick={onOpen}>{task.title}</button>
      {(task.status !== "approval" || blockers.length > 0) && <button className="task-delete" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Delete task ${task.title}`}>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V4h6v3m-9 0 1 13h10l1-13M10 11v5m4-5v5" /></svg>
        <span>Delete</span>
      </button>}
    </div>
    <div className="task-meta"><span className="person"><i style={{ background: meta.color }} />{meta.name}</span><span className={`status-pill ${blockers.length ? "approval" : task.status}`}>{blockers.length ? "Answer needed" : taskProgressLabel(task)}</span><time>{formatStamp(task.created)}</time></div>
    <EscalationNote task={task} />
    <ContractNote task={task} />
    {task.notes && <BriefNotes notes={task.notes} compact />}
    {onAnswer && <BlockerPrompts blockers={blockers} onAnswer={onAnswer} compact />}
    {task.status === "approval" && !blockers.length && onFinalize && <div className="task-actions"><ApprovalActions task={task} layout="compact" onApprove={() => onMove("done")} onFinalize={onFinalize} onDeny={() => onMove("working")} onDelete={onDelete} onReviewImages={onOpen} busy={busy} /></div>}
  </article></BatchSelectionScope>;
}

function inlineMarkdown(value: string): ReactNode[] {
  return value.split(/(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g).filter(Boolean).map((part, index) => {
    if (part.startsWith("**") && part.endsWith("**")) return <strong key={index}>{part.slice(2, -2)}</strong>;
    const link = /^\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/.exec(part);
    if (link?.[1] && link[2]) return <a key={index} href={link[2]} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{link[1]}</a>;
    return <span key={index}>{part}</span>;
  });
}

function MarkdownResult({ content }: { content: string }) {
  const lines = displayMemberNames(content).replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
  let index = 0;
  while (index < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[index] ?? "";
    if (!line.trim()) { index += 1; continue; }
    // Markdown tables render as real tables. Before this, a table row
    // was dumped as one pre-wrapped paragraph of pipe characters — the
    // "garbled wall of text" in a pack manifest. Cells wrap normally
    // and the table scrolls sideways inside its own box when wide.
    if (line.trim().startsWith("|") && index + 1 < lines.length && /^\|?[\s:|-]+\|?$/.test((lines[index + 1] ?? "").trim()) && (lines[index + 1] ?? "").includes("-")) {
      const splitRow = (row: string) => row.trim().replace(/^\|/, "").replace(/\|$/, "").split("|").map((cell) => cell.trim());
      const header = splitRow(line);
      index += 2;
      const rows: string[][] = [];
      while (index < lines.length && (lines[index] ?? "").trim().startsWith("|")) { rows.push(splitRow(lines[index] ?? "")); index += 1; }
      blocks.push(<div className="md-table-wrap" key={`table-${index}`}><table className="md-table"><thead><tr>{header.map((cell, cellIndex) => <th key={cellIndex}>{inlineMarkdown(cell)}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row, rowIndex) => <tr key={rowIndex}>{header.map((_, cellIndex) => <td key={cellIndex}>{inlineMarkdown(row[cellIndex] ?? "")}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody></table></div>);
      continue;
    }
    if (/^---+$/.test(line.trim()) || /^\*\*\*+$/.test(line.trim())) { blocks.push(<hr key={index} className="md-hr" />); index += 1; continue; }
    const heading = /^(#{1,3})\s+(.+)$/.exec(line);
    if (heading) {
      const level = heading[1]?.length ?? 1;
      const text = heading[2] ?? "";
      blocks.push(level === 1 ? <h3 key={index}>{inlineMarkdown(text)}</h3> : level === 2 ? <h4 key={index}>{inlineMarkdown(text)}</h4> : <h5 key={index}>{inlineMarkdown(text)}</h5>);
      index += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const unordered = /^[-*]\s+(.+)$/.exec(line);
    if (unordered) {
      const items: ReactNode[] = [];
      while (index < lines.length) {
        const match = /^[-*]\s+(.+)$/.exec(lines[index] ?? "");
        if (!match) break;
        items.push(<li key={index}>{inlineMarkdown(match[1] ?? "")}</li>);
        index += 1;
      }
      blocks.push(<ul key={`ul-${index}`}>{items}</ul>);
      continue;
    }
    const ordered = /^\d+[.)]\s+(.+)$/.exec(line);
    if (ordered) {
      const items: ReactNode[] = [];
      while (index < lines.length) {
        const match = /^\d+[.)]\s+(.+)$/.exec(lines[index] ?? "");
        if (!match) break;
        items.push(<li key={index}>{inlineMarkdown(match[1] ?? "")}</li>);
        index += 1;
      }
      blocks.push(<ol key={`ol-${index}`}>{items}</ol>);
      continue;
    }
    blocks.push(<p key={index}>{inlineMarkdown(line)}</p>);
    index += 1;
  }
  return <div className="markdown-result">{blocks}</div>;
}

type BriefNoteSections = { instructions: string; reference: string };

const REFERENCE_SECTION_PATTERN = /^(Approved pipeline evidence|Johnny's exact Facebook copy|Approved result|Evidence|Reference material):\s*$/im;

function splitBriefNotes(notes: string): BriefNoteSections {
  const normalized = displayMemberNames(notes).replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  if (!normalized) return { instructions: "", reference: "" };
  const marker = REFERENCE_SECTION_PATTERN.exec(normalized);
  if (!marker || marker.index === undefined) return { instructions: normalized, reference: "" };
  const markerLabel = marker[1] ?? "Reference material";
  const referenceBody = normalized.slice(marker.index + marker[0].length).trim();
  return {
    instructions: normalized.slice(0, marker.index).trim(),
    reference: referenceBody ? `${markerLabel}:\n${referenceBody}` : markerLabel,
  };
}

function BriefNotes({ notes, compact = false }: { notes: string; compact?: boolean }) {
  const sections = splitBriefNotes(notes);
  if (!sections.instructions && !sections.reference) return <p className="brief-notes-empty">No notes added.</p>;
  return <div className={compact ? "brief-note-sections compact" : "brief-note-sections"}>
    {sections.instructions && <section className="brief-note-block instructions" aria-label="Task instructions">
      <h4>Task instructions</h4>
      <MarkdownResult content={sections.instructions} />
    </section>}
    {sections.reference && <section className="brief-note-block reference" aria-label="Reference material">
      <h4>Reference material</h4>
      <MarkdownResult content={sections.reference} />
    </section>}
  </div>;
}

function BriefCard({ brief, onEdit, onCancel, busy }: { brief: Brief; onEdit: () => void; onCancel: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  return <article className="brief-card">
    <div className="brief-top"><div><b>{brief.title}</b><span>{memberById(brief.assignee)?.name ?? "Any agent"}{brief.pipelineStage ? ` · ${pipelineStageLabel(brief.pipelineStage)}` : ""}</span></div><span className={`brief-status ${brief.status}`}>{BRIEF_LABEL[brief.status]}</span></div>
    <time>{formatStamp(brief.updatedAt)}</time>
    <BriefNotes notes={brief.notes} compact />
    {brief.status === "new" && <div className="brief-queue-actions"><button onClick={onEdit} disabled={busy}>Edit / redirect</button><button className="danger-link" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button></div>}
    {brief.result && <details className="brief-result"><summary>View result</summary><MarkdownResult content={brief.result} /></details>}
  </article>;
}

function Sheet({ onClose, children, label, className = "" }: { onClose: () => void; children: ReactNode; label: string; className?: string }) {
  return <><button className="scrim" aria-label={`Close ${label}`} onClick={onClose} /><div className={`sheet ${className}`.trim()} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={label}><div className="grab" /><button className="sheet-close" onClick={onClose} aria-label={`Close ${label}`}>×</button>{children}</div></>;
}

// Research briefs open with a `## SUMMARY` section (Tom's synthesis template).
// Extract just that section's body so Deliverables can show it as a short
// summary card with the full brief one expand away. Older briefs written
// before the template change have no SUMMARY heading — they return null and
// keep the existing full-document presentation.
function extractSummarySection(content: string): string | null {
  const lines = content.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  let start = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    const heading = /^(#{1,3})\s+(.+)$/.exec(lines[i] ?? "");
    if (!heading) continue;
    const text = (heading[2] ?? "").replace(/\*\*/g, "").trim();
    if (/^(?:\d+[.)]\s*)?summary\b/i.test(text)) { start = i; break; }
  }
  if (start < 0) return null;
  let end = lines.length;
  for (let i = start + 1; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    if (/^#{1,2}\s+/.test(lines[i] ?? "")) { end = i; break; }
  }
  const body = lines.slice(start + 1, end).join("\n").trim();
  return body || null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// Research case faces (Ben, 2026-10-18): a finished research case's
// Ready for You card face carries only the decision — the research
// question in its current wording, the brief's full short answer /
// verdict, and one tally line counted from the brief's own claim
// labels. Everything else the face used to show (the top verified
// facts, the failed-checking section, rework and provenance notes, the
// superseded original question wording, and the full brief itself)
// lives behind the card's Extras door, where the full brief already
// sits. Display only: the brief document itself never changes.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------

type ResearchFace = { question: string; verdict: string; tally: string | null };

const CLAIM_LABELS = ["DOCUMENTED", "MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION", "FRINGE CLAIM", "NOT VERIFIED"] as const;
type ClaimLabel = (typeof CLAIM_LABELS)[number];
const CLAIM_LABEL_PATTERN = "(DOCUMENTED|MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION|FRINGE CLAIM|NOT VERIFIED)";

// Count a brief's claims by the labels the brief itself gives them.
// Claims are keyed by their number (Claim 12, Rework Claim R3), so a
// claim cited in several sections is counted once. The detailed
// evidence entries ("- Claim 12 — … [DOCUMENTED]") are the authority;
// bracketed citations ("[DOCUMENTED — Claim 12]") fill any gaps. A
// claim whose label cannot be found is not counted at all — the tally
// never invents a number.
function countBriefClaimLabels(text: string): ({ total: number } & Record<ClaimLabel, number>) | null {
  const byClaim = new Map<string, ClaimLabel>();
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  let currentClaim: string | null = null;
  for (const line of lines) {
    const header = /^\s*-\s*(?:Rework\s+)?Claim\s+(R?\d+)\b/i.exec(line);
    if (header?.[1]) currentClaim = header[1].toUpperCase();
    else if (/^\s*-\s/.test(line) || /^#{1,6}\s/.test(line)) currentClaim = null;
    if (currentClaim && !byClaim.has(currentClaim)) {
      const bracket = new RegExp(`\\[\\s*${CLAIM_LABEL_PATTERN}\\b`, "i").exec(line);
      const label = bracket?.[1]?.toUpperCase() as ClaimLabel | undefined;
      if (label) byClaim.set(currentClaim, label);
    }
  }
  const citation = new RegExp(`\\[\\s*${CLAIM_LABEL_PATTERN}\\b[^\\]]*?(?:Rework\\s+)?Claim\\s+(R?\\d+)\\b`, "gi");
  for (const match of text.matchAll(citation)) {
    const label = match[1]?.toUpperCase() as ClaimLabel | undefined;
    const id = match[2]?.toUpperCase();
    if (label && id && !byClaim.has(id)) byClaim.set(id, label);
  }
  if (byClaim.size === 0) return null;
  const counts: { total: number } & Record<ClaimLabel, number> = { total: byClaim.size, DOCUMENTED: 0, "MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION": 0, "FRINGE CLAIM": 0, "NOT VERIFIED": 0 };
  for (const label of byClaim.values()) counts[label] += 1;
  return counts;
}

function researchTallyLine(text: string): string | null {
  const counts = countBriefClaimLabels(text);
  if (!counts) return null;
  return `${counts.total} claims checked · ${counts.DOCUMENTED} documented · ${counts["MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION"]} mainstream interpretation · ${counts["FRINGE CLAIM"]} fringe claim · ${counts["NOT VERIFIED"]} not verified`;
}

// Split a research brief's SUMMARY section into the two pieces the
// card face keeps: the research question in its current wording (any
// superseded original-question wording is cut here — it stays in the
// full brief behind Extras) and the short answer / verdict, whole and
// untruncated. Returns null when the summary does not carry both, so
// the card falls back to the ordinary face.
function parseResearchSummary(summary: string): { question: string; verdict: string } | null {
  const lines = summary.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const questionIndex = lines.findIndex((line) => /^\s*(?:[-*]\s*)?(?:\*\*)?research question\b/i.test(line));
  const verdictIndex = lines.findIndex((line) => /^\s*(?:[-*]\s*)?(?:\*\*)?short answer\b/i.test(line));
  if (questionIndex < 0 || verdictIndex < 0 || verdictIndex <= questionIndex) return null;
  const question = lines.slice(questionIndex, verdictIndex).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
    .replace(/^(?:\*\*)?research question\b[^:]*:\s*(?:\*\*)?\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/\s*(?:the\s+)?original case question is kept underneath it:[\s\S]*$/i, "")
    .replace(/\s*(?:the\s+)?original question\b[^.?!]*\bkept underneath\b[\s\S]*$/i, "")
    .trim();
  let verdictEnd = lines.length;
  for (let i = verdictIndex + 1; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    if (/^\s*(?:[-*]\s*)?(?:\*\*)?(top\s+(?:\d+\s+)?verified facts|failed checking|rework note)\b/i.test(lines[i] ?? "")) { verdictEnd = i; break; }
  }
  const verdict = lines.slice(verdictIndex, verdictEnd).join("\n").trim()
    .replace(/^(?:\*\*)?short answer(?:\s*\/\s*verdict)?\s*:\s*(?:\*\*)?\s*/i, "")
    .trim();
  if (!question || !verdict) return null;
  return { question, verdict };
}

function deliverableTitle(fileName: string): string {
  const stem = fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "").replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").trim();
  return stem.replace(/\b\w/g, (character) => character.toUpperCase());
}

function useTaskDeliverablesQuery(taskId: string, revision: number, enabled = true) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["task-deliverables", taskId, revision],
    queryFn: () => api.get_task_deliverables({ taskId }),
    staleTime: 60_000,
    enabled,
  });
}
