function ProvenanceLine({ provenance, tone = "card" }: { provenance: DeliverableProvenance; tone?: "card" | "facebook" | "lightbox" }) {
  return <span className={`image-provenance ${provenance.kind} tone-${tone}`}>
    <b>{provenance.label}</b>
    {provenance.kind === "real" && provenance.sourceUrl && <> · <a href={provenance.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`Image source: ${provenance.sourceUrl}`}>Source</a></>}
  </span>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// Ready for You — the result IS the card face (Ben's revamp, 2026-10-17).
// The analysis below splits a job's deliverables into what Ben is being
// asked to decide on (the FACE: the finished result itself, readable) and
// the EXTRAS (behind one closed-by-default door: the full source
// documents, the crew's working papers — reader extraction, verifier
// check — work summaries, and the completeness notes). Every document
// appears exactly once across face and extras: a brief whose result is
// the same text as a saved document is that document, never a second
// rendering of it.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------

type DeliverableBrief = TaskDeliverablesResponse["briefs"][number];

type QaPair = { question: string; answer: string };

type PayloadExtraction =
  | { kind: "qa"; pairs: QaPair[]; mode: "qa" }
  | { kind: "post"; text: string; mode: "post" }
  | { kind: "markdown"; markdown: string; mode: "summary" | "body" };

type ReadyFacePlan = {
  facebookPost: string | null;
  previewImage: DeliverableItem | null;
  svenIntro: string | null;
  isSvenPackage: boolean;
  images: DeliverableItem[];
  showImageGrid: boolean;
  fileItems: DeliverableItem[];
  payload: PayloadExtraction | null;
  researchFace: ResearchFace | null;
  // A multi-piece set (a pack of letters + mockups + images) never
  // renders its pieces as a wall on the face: the face carries the
  // result line and a thumbnail strip, and the DecisionScreen below it
  // carries the index, the one-piece-at-a-time reader, and the
  // checklist. payloadFromDocument marks a payload that is a whole
  // document's body (the pack file itself) rather than a result text.
  compactSet: boolean;
  payloadFromDocument: boolean;
};

type ReadyExtraEntry = {
  key: string;
  kind: "full" | "brief" | "paper" | "note";
  title: string;
  sub?: string;
  markdown: string;
  plainSummary?: string | null;
  isSven: boolean;
};

type ReadyResultPlan = {
  loading: boolean;
  error: boolean;
  face: ReadyFacePlan | null;
  extras: ReadyExtraEntry[];
  extrasNotes: string[];
  multiImageReview: boolean;
  multiPiece: boolean;
  // Verdict-first face (Ben, 2026-10-18): the card's title comes from
  // the finished deliverable itself (its own heading, or its file's
  // plain name) — never the raw instruction text the job was created
  // with — and the first content line on the face is the RESULT: the
  // deliverable's own opening, lifted whole from its lead section or
  // its first paragraph (and not repeated in the body below it).
  displayTitle: string | null;
  resultLead: string | null;
  // Pieces the job's own documents excluded from the pack (by ruling):
  // named here once, as a held-out note — never contents, never choices.
  heldOut: string[];
};

const EMPTY_READY_PLAN: ReadyResultPlan = { loading: false, error: false, face: null, extras: [], extrasNotes: [], multiImageReview: false, multiPiece: false, displayTitle: null, resultLead: null, heldOut: [] };

// The crew's working papers, by file name: Walter's reader extraction,
// Peter's verifier check, and any lab verification. These are paperwork
// behind the extras door, never the face.
const WORKING_PAPER_FILE_PATTERN = /reader|extraction|verifier|verification|lab[-_ ]?check/i;

function isWorkingPaperBrief(brief: DeliverableBrief): boolean {
  return brief.assignee === "walter" || brief.assignee === "peter";
}

function normalizeContentForDup(text: string): string {
  return text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
}

// Same content, allowing one side to carry small wrapper differences
// the other lacks (a heading line, a file-path note): equal after
// normalization, the shorter text contained whole in the longer, or —
// for a wrapper line inserted mid-document, which breaks containment —
// at least nine of every ten substantive lines of the shorter text
// present in the longer, past a safe length floor.
function sameDeliverableContent(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const na = normalizeContentForDup(a);
  const nb = normalizeContentForDup(b);
  if (!na || !nb) return false;
  if (na === nb) return true;
  const [short, long] = na.length <= nb.length ? [na, nb] : [nb, na];
  if (short.length < 240) return false;
  if (long.includes(short)) return true;
  const linesOf = (text: string) => text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n").map((line) => line.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase()).filter((line) => line.length > 10);
  const [shortRaw, longRaw] = na.length <= nb.length ? [a, b] : [b, a];
  const longLines = new Set(linesOf(longRaw));
  const shortLines = linesOf(shortRaw);
  if (shortLines.length < 8) return false;
  const shared = shortLines.filter((line) => longLines.has(line)).length;
  return shared / shortLines.length >= 0.9;
}

// Strip the evidence apparatus from a deliverable's own text for the
// FACE: claim-label prefixes ("**DOCUMENTED (Claim 2)** —"), "(Claim N)"
// cross-references, "Source: <url>" tails, bare-URL lines, and the
// document's header metadata block (Case / Brief id / Author / …). The
// words themselves are never rewritten — this only removes the labelling
// machinery around them. The untouched original lives in the extras.
function cleanPayloadMarkdown(content: string): string {
  const lines = displayMemberNames(content).replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const kept: string[] = [];
  let seenContent = false;
  for (const rawLine of lines) {
    const trimmed = rawLine.trim();
    if (!seenContent) {
      if (/^-\s*(Case|Brief id|Job id|Author|Reader|Verifier|Date|Stage|Final file|Source file checked|Synthesis rule applied|Note on sources)\s*:/i.test(trimmed)) continue;
      if (/^#\s+/.test(trimmed)) continue;
    }
    if (trimmed) seenContent = true;
    if (/^(?:[-*]\s*)?https?:\/\/\S+$/.test(trimmed)) continue;
    let line = rawLine;
    line = line.replace(/\s+Source:\s*https?:\/\/\S+/gi, "");
    line = line.replace(/\*\*(DOCUMENTED|MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION|FRINGE CLAIM|NOT VERIFIED)\*\*\s*(?:\(Claims?[^)]*\)\s*)?[—–-]?\s*/g, "");
    line = line.replace(/^(\s*(?:[-*]|\d+[.)])\s+)(DOCUMENTED|MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION|FRINGE CLAIM|NOT VERIFIED)\s*(?:\(Claims?[^)]*\)\s*)?[—–:\-]\s*/, "$1");
    line = line.replace(/\(Claims?\s+\d[^)]*\)/g, "");
    line = line.replace(/,?\s*Claims?\s+[\d,\s]+(?=\s*[;)])/g, "");
    line = line.replace(/\s+([.,;:!?])/g, "$1");
    kept.push(line);
  }
  return kept.join("\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
}

// A document's lead section — its SUMMARY or plain-words opening — when
// it has one. Generalizes extractSummarySection (which stays as-is for
// the Deliverables view) to the headings the crew actually uses.
const LEAD_SECTION_HEADING = /^(?:\d+[.)]\s*)?(summary|in plain words|plain(?:[- ]language)? summary|overview|the short version|tl;?dr)\b/i;

function extractLeadSection(content: string): string | null {
  const lines = content.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  let start = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    const heading = /^(#{1,3})\s+(.+)$/.exec(lines[i] ?? "");
    if (!heading) continue;
    const text = (heading[2] ?? "").replace(/\*\*/g, "").trim();
    if (LEAD_SECTION_HEADING.test(text)) { start = i; break; }
  }
  if (start < 0) return null;
  let end = lines.length;
  for (let i = start + 1; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    if (/^#{1,2}\s+/.test(lines[i] ?? "")) { end = i; break; }
  }
  const body = lines.slice(start + 1, end).join("\n").trim();
  return body || null;
}

// Q&A payload extraction: a section headed like a question ("### Q1. …"
// or any heading ending in "?") whose body carries an explicit Answer
// line yields one pair — the question, and the answer text with the
// evidence stack left behind for the extras. Fewer than two pairs is not
// a Q&A document.
function extractQaPairs(content: string): QaPair[] {
  const lines = content.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const pairs: QaPair[] = [];
  let current: { question: string; body: string[] } | null = null;
  const flush = () => {
    if (!current) return;
    const body = current.body;
    const answerIndex = body.findIndex((line) => /^\s*(?:[-*]\s*)?(?:\*\*Answer:?\*\*|Answer:)\s*/i.test(line));
    if (answerIndex >= 0) {
      const first = (body[answerIndex] ?? "").replace(/^\s*(?:[-*]\s*)?(?:\*\*Answer:?\*\*|Answer:)\s*/i, "");
      const answer = cleanPayloadMarkdown([first, ...body.slice(answerIndex + 1)].join("\n"));
      if (current.question && answer) pairs.push({ question: current.question, answer });
    }
    current = null;
  };
  for (const line of lines) {
    const heading = /^(#{2,4})\s+(.+)$/.exec(line);
    if (heading) {
      const text = displayMemberNames((heading[2] ?? "").replace(/\*\*/g, "").trim());
      const numbered = /^Q(\d+)\s*[.:)]\s*(.+)$/i.exec(text);
      if (numbered) { flush(); current = { question: (numbered[2] ?? "").trim(), body: [] }; continue; }
      if (text.endsWith("?")) { flush(); current = { question: text, body: [] }; continue; }
      flush();
      continue;
    }
    if (current) current.body.push(line);
  }
  flush();
  return pairs;
}

// The publication-ready post copy section, when a document carries one —
// the same heading contract the server extracts post copy by, mirrored
// here so standard social jobs (whose copy the server does not lift into
// postCopy) still put their exact finished copy on the face.
const POST_COPY_HEADING_PATTERN = /^#{1,6}\s*(?:publication[- ]ready\s+)?(?:(?:facebook|social(?: media)?)\s+)?post\s+copy(?:\s*\(final\)|\s*[-—:]\s*final)?\s*$/im;

function extractPostCopySection(content: string): string | null {
  const normalized = content.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  if (!normalized) return null;
  const heading = POST_COPY_HEADING_PATTERN.exec(normalized);
  if (!heading || heading.index === undefined) return null;
  const afterHeading = normalized.slice(heading.index + heading[0].length).replace(/^\s+/, "");
  const boundary = /\n(?:---\s*$|#{1,6}\s+)/m.exec(afterHeading);
  const copy = (boundary ? afterHeading.slice(0, boundary.index) : afterHeading).trim();
  return copy || null;
}

// The payload of one finished text, in face order: Q&A pairs first, then
// an exact post-copy section, then the document's lead section, then —
// gracefully — its whole readable body, cleaned.
function extractPayload(text: string): PayloadExtraction {
  const pairs = extractQaPairs(text);
  if (pairs.length >= 2) return { kind: "qa", pairs, mode: "qa" };
  const post = extractPostCopySection(text);
  if (post) return { kind: "post", text: post, mode: "post" };
  const lead = extractLeadSection(text);
  if (lead) return { kind: "markdown", markdown: cleanPayloadMarkdown(lead), mode: "summary" };
  return { kind: "markdown", markdown: cleanPayloadMarkdown(text), mode: "body" };
}

function payloadScore(text: string, fileName: string): number {
  let score = 0;
  if (extractPostCopySection(text)) score += 5;
  if (extractQaPairs(text).length >= 2) score += 4;
  if (/brief|report/i.test(fileName)) score += 3;
  if (/post|copy|caption|listing/i.test(fileName)) score += 2;
  if (extractLeadSection(text)) score += 2;
  return score;
}

// A deliverable's own first heading — the human outcome title the
// card carries when the document names itself. Wrapper headings that
// only label the container ("SUMMARY", "The full finished work") are
// not titles and are skipped.
function firstHeadingOf(content: string): string | null {
  for (const line of content.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n")) {
    const heading = /^#{1,2}\s+(.+)$/.exec(line.trim());
    if (!heading) continue;
    const text = (heading[1] ?? "").replace(/\*\*/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!text) continue;
    if (/^(summary|in plain words|overview|the short version|tl;?dr)\b/i.test(text)) continue;
    return text.length > 140 ? `${text.slice(0, 137).trimEnd()}…` : text;
  }
  return null;
}

// The RESULT as a plain first line: the deliverable's lead section's
// opening when it has one (verdict-first documents open with their
// answer), else the face payload's first paragraph, markdown stripped.
// Capped at a readable lead length — the full text stays on the face
// and in Extras; nothing is summarized or rewritten here.
function firstResultLeadOf(primaryText: string, extraction: PayloadExtraction | null): string | null {
  const source = extractLeadSection(primaryText) ?? (extraction?.kind === "markdown" ? extraction.markdown : extraction?.kind === "post" ? extraction.text : null);
  if (!source) return null;
  const paragraph = source.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split(/\n\s*\n/).map((part) => part.trim()).find((part) => part && !/^#{1,6}\s/.test(part) && !/^[-*]\s/.test(part));
  if (!paragraph) return null;
  const plain = paragraph.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "$1").replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (plain.length < 12) return null;
  return plain.length > 300 ? `${plain.slice(0, 297).trimEnd()}…` : plain;
}

// Remove the payload's first paragraph when it is the same text the
// result lead already shows, so the result appears exactly once, first.
function stripLeadingParagraph(markdown: string, lead: string | null): string {
  if (!lead) return markdown;
  const normalize = (value: string) => value.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "$1").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
  const parts = markdown.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split(/\n\s*\n/);
  const first = parts[0];
  if (!first) return markdown;
  const firstNorm = normalize(first.replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/, ""));
  const leadNorm = normalize(lead).replace(/…$/, "");
  if (firstNorm && leadNorm && (firstNorm.startsWith(leadNorm.slice(0, 60)) || leadNorm.startsWith(firstNorm.slice(0, 60)))) {
    const rest = parts.slice(1).join("\n\n").trim();
    return rest || markdown;
  }
  return markdown;
}

function buildReadyPlan(data: TaskDeliverablesResponse, task: Task): ReadyResultPlan {
  const isSvenPackage = data.isSvenOriginated;
  const images = data.items.filter((item) => item.kind === "image" && item.imageUrl && !item.excluded);
  const documents = data.items.filter((item) => item.kind !== "image" && item.text !== null && !item.excluded);
  const fileItems = data.items.filter((item) => (item.kind === "document" || item.kind === "video") && !item.excluded);
  const heldOut = [...new Set(data.items.filter((item) => item.excluded).map((item) => item.humanTitle))];
  const multiImageReview = images.length > 1 && !task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt;
  // A pack/set (several finished pieces) is decided through the
  // DecisionScreen's index, never by rendering every piece on the face.
  const multiPiece = images.length + documents.length > 1;

  // Dedupe: a brief result that restates a saved document (or an earlier
  // kept brief) is the same content — it is shown once, as the document.
  const keptBriefs: DeliverableBrief[] = [];
  for (const brief of data.briefs) {
    if (documents.some((doc) => sameDeliverableContent(brief.result, doc.text ?? ""))) continue;
    if (keptBriefs.some((kept) => sameDeliverableContent(brief.result, kept.result))) continue;
    keptBriefs.push(brief);
  }
  const paperDocs = documents.filter((item) => WORKING_PAPER_FILE_PATTERN.test(item.fileName));
  const resultDocs = documents.filter((item) => !WORKING_PAPER_FILE_PATTERN.test(item.fileName));
  const paperBriefs = keptBriefs.filter(isWorkingPaperBrief);
  const workBriefs = keptBriefs.filter((brief) => !isWorkingPaperBrief(brief));

  // The primary result — the one text the face leads with. Documents
  // outrank brief results; within each, the payload score decides.
  type Primary = { kind: "document"; item: DeliverableItem } | { kind: "brief"; brief: DeliverableBrief } | null;
  let primary: Primary = null;
  let primaryText = "";
  let primaryExtraction: PayloadExtraction | null = null;
  const docCandidates = [...resultDocs].sort((a, b) =>
    payloadScore(b.text ?? "", b.fileName) - payloadScore(a.text ?? "", a.fileName)
    || (b.text ?? "").length - (a.text ?? "").length
    || new Date(b.modifiedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.modifiedAt).getTime());
  const firstDoc = docCandidates[0];
  if (firstDoc) {
    primary = { kind: "document", item: firstDoc };
    primaryText = firstDoc.text ?? "";
  } else {
    const briefCandidates = [...workBriefs].sort((a, b) =>
      payloadScore(b.result, "") - payloadScore(a.result, "")
      || new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime());
    const firstBrief = briefCandidates[0];
    if (firstBrief) {
      primary = { kind: "brief", brief: firstBrief };
      primaryText = firstBrief.result;
    }
  }
  if (primary) primaryExtraction = extractPayload(primaryText);

  const facebookPost = task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" ? data.postCopy ?? "" : "";
  const previewImage = images[0];
  // Research cases get the trimmed decision face — question, verdict,
  // tally — parsed from the primary brief's own SUMMARY section. When
  // the brief carries no parseable summary, the face stays as it was.
  const isResearchCase = task.pipeline === "research_case" || task.jobType === "research";
  let researchFace: ResearchFace | null = null;
  if (isResearchCase && primary) {
    const summary = extractSummarySection(primaryText);
    const parsed = summary ? parseResearchSummary(summary) : null;
    if (parsed) researchFace = { ...parsed, tally: researchTallyLine(primaryText) };
  }
  // Verdict-first face data: the title from the deliverable itself,
  // and the result as the face's first content line. Research faces
  // already lead with their verdict and post faces with the post
  // itself, so neither gets a separate lead.
  const displayTitle = !researchFace && primary
    ? (firstHeadingOf(primaryText) ?? (primary.kind === "document" ? deliverableTitle(primary.item.fileName) : null))
    : null;
  const resultLead = !researchFace && !facebookPost ? firstResultLeadOf(primaryText, primaryExtraction) : null;
  const facePayload = primaryExtraction?.kind === "markdown" && resultLead
    ? { ...primaryExtraction, markdown: stripLeadingParagraph(primaryExtraction.markdown, resultLead) }
    : primaryExtraction;
  const hasFaceContent = Boolean(facebookPost || primaryExtraction || images.length || fileItems.length || (isSvenPackage && data.packageSummary));
  const face: ReadyFacePlan | null = hasFaceContent ? {
    facebookPost: facebookPost || null,
    previewImage: previewImage ?? null,
    svenIntro: isSvenPackage ? data.packageSummary : null,
    isSvenPackage,
    images,
    showImageGrid: !(facebookPost && previewImage?.imageUrl),
    fileItems,
    payload: facebookPost ? null : facePayload,
    researchFace,
    compactSet: multiPiece,
    payloadFromDocument: primary?.kind === "document",
  } : null;

  // Extras: every remaining document exactly once — the primary's full
  // original (only when the face showed an extraction of it, never when
  // the face already carries its whole body), the other result
  // documents, the crew's finished steps, the contract note, and the
  // crew's paperwork last — one flat shelf, each item named.
  const extras: ReadyExtraEntry[] = [];
  // A trimmed research face also puts the primary's full original
  // behind the door even when the face would otherwise carry its whole
  // body — nothing the face stops showing may become unreachable.
  if (primary && primaryExtraction && (primaryExtraction.mode !== "body" || researchFace || multiPiece)) {
    if (primary.kind === "document") {
      extras.push({ key: `doc-${primary.item.relativePath}`, kind: "full", title: isSvenPackage ? primary.item.humanTitle : deliverableTitle(primary.item.fileName), sub: primary.item.fileName, markdown: primaryText, isSven: isSvenPackage });
    } else {
      extras.push({ key: `brief-${primary.brief.id}`, kind: "full", title: isSvenPackage ? primary.brief.humanTitle : "The full finished work", sub: `${memberById(primary.brief.assignee)?.name ?? "The crew"} · ${formatStamp(primary.brief.updatedAt)}`, markdown: primaryText, plainSummary: primary.brief.plainSummary, isSven: isSvenPackage });
    }
  }
  for (const item of resultDocs) {
    if (primary?.kind === "document" && item.relativePath === primary.item.relativePath) continue;
    extras.push({ key: `doc-${item.relativePath}`, kind: "full", title: isSvenPackage ? item.humanTitle : /listing/i.test(item.fileName) ? "Listing copy" : deliverableTitle(item.fileName), sub: item.fileName, markdown: item.text ?? "", plainSummary: item.plainSummary, isSven: isSvenPackage });
  }
  for (const brief of workBriefs) {
    if (primary?.kind === "brief" && brief.id === primary.brief.id) continue;
    extras.push({ key: `brief-${brief.id}`, kind: "brief", title: brief.humanTitle || `Finished step — ${memberById(brief.assignee)?.name ?? "The crew"}`, sub: `${memberById(brief.assignee)?.name ?? "The crew"} · ${formatStamp(brief.updatedAt)}`, markdown: brief.result, plainSummary: brief.plainSummary, isSven: isSvenPackage });
  }
  // The outcome contract, as one plain named item on the shelf — the
  // note itself, in the job's own recorded words, never a narration
  // block on the card.
  if (task.contractLabel) {
    const contractText = task.contractStatus === "bounced" && task.contractViolation
      ? isBounceExhausted(task.contractStatus, task.contractBounces)
        ? `This job failed its contract check ${task.contractBounces} times and used up its automatic rework rounds: ${task.contractViolation} It cannot be approved. Send it back for rework, or delete it.`
        : `This finished work failed its contract check: ${task.contractViolation}`
      : task.contractStatus === "passed"
        ? `${task.contractDeliverable ?? ""} Checked against its contract before it surfaced: passed.`.trim()
        : `${task.contractDeliverable ?? ""} ${task.contractVoice ?? ""}`.trim();
    if (contractText) extras.push({ key: "contract-note", kind: "note", title: `Outcome contract — ${task.contractLabel}`, markdown: contractText, isSven: false });
  }
  for (const item of paperDocs) {
    extras.push({ key: `paper-${item.relativePath}`, kind: "paper", title: deliverableTitle(item.fileName), sub: item.fileName, markdown: item.text ?? "", isSven: false });
  }
  for (const brief of paperBriefs) {
    extras.push({ key: `paper-brief-${brief.id}`, kind: "paper", title: brief.humanTitle, sub: `${memberById(brief.assignee)?.name ?? "The crew"} · ${formatStamp(brief.updatedAt)}`, markdown: brief.result, isSven: false });
  }
  const extrasNotes: string[] = [];
  if (data.warning) extrasNotes.push(data.warning);
  if (data.hiddenFileCount > 0) extrasNotes.push(`${data.hiddenFileCount} ${data.hiddenFileCount === 1 ? "file" : "files"} in this job's folder ${data.hiddenFileCount === 1 ? "isn't" : "aren't"} shown here.`);
  return { loading: false, error: false, face, extras, extrasNotes, multiImageReview, multiPiece, displayTitle: displayTitle && displayTitle !== task.title ? displayTitle : null, resultLead, heldOut };
}

function useReadyResultPlan(taskId: string, revision: number, task: Task | undefined, enabled: boolean): ReadyResultPlan {
  const deliverables = useTaskDeliverablesQuery(taskId, revision, enabled);
  return useMemo<ReadyResultPlan>(() => {
    if (!enabled || !task) return EMPTY_READY_PLAN;
    if (deliverables.isLoading) return { ...EMPTY_READY_PLAN, loading: true };
    if (deliverables.isError) return { ...EMPTY_READY_PLAN, error: true };
    if (!deliverables.data) return EMPTY_READY_PLAN;
    return buildReadyPlan(deliverables.data, task);
  }, [enabled, task, deliverables.isLoading, deliverables.isError, deliverables.data]);
}

// The FACE of a waiting card: the finished result itself. Post copy and
// its image for post jobs; the extracted payload (Q&A pairs, the exact
// post copy, the lead section, or the cleaned body) for everything else;
// the image grid (with Keep/Delete selection while a multi-image review
// is open) and any finished files alongside.
function ReadyResultFace({ task, plan, reviewMode, batchSelect = false }: { task: Task; plan: ReadyResultPlan; reviewMode: boolean; batchSelect?: boolean }) {
  const [fbCopyResult, setFbCopyResult] = useState<PostCopyResult | null>(null);
  const [openImage, setOpenImage] = useState<DeliverableItem | null>(null);
  const batch = useBatchSelection(task.id);
  if (plan.loading) {
    return <div className="deliverables-loading" aria-live="polite"><span className="live-dot" />Loading the finished work…</div>;
  }
  if (plan.error) {
    return <div className="deliverables-warning">The finished files could not be loaded right now. The job record is still intact.</div>;
  }
  const face = plan.face;
  if (!face) return null;
  const batchActive = reviewMode
    ? task.status === "approval" && face.images.length > 1 && !task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt
    : batchSelect && face.images.length > 0;
  const { facebookPost, previewImage } = face;
  // The trimmed research face belongs to the Ready for You decision
  // card only; other surfaces reusing this renderer (delivery package
  // cards) keep the payload they had.
  const researchFace = reviewMode ? face.researchFace : null;
  function copyFacebookPost() {
    if (!facebookPost) return;
    void copyPostToClipboard(facebookPost).then(setFbCopyResult);
  }
  return <div className="ready-face-result">
    {facebookPost && previewImage?.imageUrl && <article className="facebook-post-mockup" aria-label="Perfectly Paranoid Facebook post preview">
      <header><span className="facebook-page-mark" aria-hidden="true">PP</span><p><b>Perfectly Paranoid</b><small>Post preview · Not published</small></p><i aria-hidden="true">•••</i></header>
      <p className="facebook-preview-copy">{facebookPost}</p>
      <button className="facebook-preview-image" type="button" onClick={() => setOpenImage(previewImage)} aria-label={`View ${deliverableTitle(previewImage.fileName)} full size`}><img src={previewImage.imageUrl} alt="Image prepared for this Perfectly Paranoid post" /></button>
      {previewImage.provenance && <p className="facebook-provenance"><ProvenanceLine provenance={previewImage.provenance} tone="facebook" /></p>}
      <footer><span>Like</span><span>Comment</span><span>Share</span></footer>
    </article>}
    {facebookPost && !previewImage?.imageUrl && <p className="ready-post-copy">{facebookPost}</p>}
    {face.svenIntro && <article className="sven-package-intro" aria-label="What this package is, in plain words"><b>From one of Sven’s ideas — in plain words</b><p>{face.svenIntro}</p></article>}
    {face.showImageGrid && face.images.length > 0 && (reviewMode && face.compactSet ? <div className="ds-face-thumbs">
      <div className="ds-face-thumbs-row">{face.images.slice(0, 12).map((item) => item.imageUrl ? <button key={item.relativePath} type="button" className="ds-face-thumb" onClick={() => setOpenImage(item)} aria-label={`View ${item.humanTitle} full size`}><img src={item.imageUrl} alt="" loading="lazy" /></button> : null)}</div>
      <p>{face.images.length} finished images in this set — they open one at a time in the review list below, where the keep/delete choices live.</p>
    </div> : <div className="deliverable-grid">
      {face.images.map((item) => <DeliverableImage key={item.relativePath} item={item} humanTitle={face.isSvenPackage ? item.humanTitle : undefined} onOpen={() => setOpenImage(item)} selectable={batchActive} selected={batchActive ? Boolean(batch?.selected.has(item.relativePath)) : false} onToggleSelect={batchActive && batch ? () => batch.toggle(item.relativePath) : undefined} radioGroup={`keep-decision-${task.id}-${item.relativePath}`} />)}
    </div>)}
    {face.fileItems.length > 0 && !(reviewMode && face.compactSet) && <div className="deliverable-file-list">
      {face.fileItems.map((item) => <DeliverableFileCard key={item.relativePath} item={item} taskId={task.id} />)}
    </div>}
    {researchFace && <div className="research-face">
      <div className="research-face-verdict"><span className="research-face-label">Short answer / verdict</span><div className="research-face-verdict-body"><MarkdownResult content={researchFace.verdict} /></div></div>
      <p className="research-face-question"><span className="research-face-label">Research question</span>{researchFace.question}</p>
      {researchFace.tally && <p className="research-face-tally">{researchFace.tally}</p>}
    </div>}
    {!researchFace && face.payload?.kind === "qa" && <ol className="qa-list">
      {face.payload.pairs.map((pair, index) => <li className="qa-item" key={index}>
        <p className="qa-question"><span className="qa-number" aria-hidden="true">{index + 1}.</span> {pair.question}</p>
        <div className="qa-answer"><MarkdownResult content={pair.answer} /></div>
      </li>)}
    </ol>}
    {!researchFace && face.payload?.kind === "post" && <p className="ready-post-copy">{face.payload.text}</p>}
    {!researchFace && face.payload?.kind === "markdown" && !(reviewMode && face.compactSet && face.payloadFromDocument) && <div className="ready-result-body"><MarkdownResult content={face.payload.markdown} /></div>}
    {facebookPost && <div className="facebook-copy-block">
      <button className="copy-facebook-post" type="button" onClick={copyFacebookPost} aria-label="Copy Facebook post text">{fbCopyResult === "text" ? "Copied text ✓" : "Copy post text"}</button>
      {fbCopyResult === "text" && <p className="copy-post-status ok" role="status">{previewImage?.imageUrl ? "Text copied ✓ — the image is not on your clipboard: download the image from this card and add it to your Facebook post." : "Text copied ✓ — paste it into Facebook."}</p>}
      {fbCopyResult === "failed" && <>
        <p className="copy-post-status failed" role="alert">That copy didn't take. Long-press the text in the box below, tap Select All, then Copy, and paste into Facebook.{previewImage?.imageUrl ? " The image stays on this card — download it and add it to your post." : ""}</p>
        <ManualCopyBox text={facebookPost} rows={6} label="Facebook post text — long-press, select all, and copy it manually" />
      </>}
    </div>}
    {openImage?.imageUrl && <ImageLightbox item={openImage} onClose={() => setOpenImage(null)} />}
  </div>;
}

// The EXTRAS SHELF: what lives inside the card's ONE extras dropdown,
// rendered only once that door has been opened. One flat list of named
// items — full documents, the crew's finished steps, the contract note,
// and (last, quieter) the crew's working papers. Ben picks the one item
// he wants and reads it in the single reading area under the list: no
// sections within sections, no stack of expanders inside the door.
function ReadyExtrasShelf({ entries, notes }: { entries: ReadyExtraEntry[]; notes: string[] }) {
  const [selectedKey, setSelectedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const selected = entries.find((entry) => entry.key === selectedKey) ?? null;
  return <div className="extras-shelf">
    {entries.length > 0 && <ul className="extras-shelf-list">
      {entries.map((entry) => <li className={entry.kind === "paper" ? "extras-shelf-item paperwork" : "extras-shelf-item"} key={entry.key}>
        <button type="button" aria-pressed={selectedKey === entry.key} onClick={() => setSelectedKey((current) => (current === entry.key ? null : entry.key))}>
          <span className="extras-shelf-name">{entry.kind === "paper" && <span className="extras-shelf-tag">Paperwork</span>}{entry.title}</span>
          {entry.sub && <small>{entry.sub}</small>}
        </button>
      </li>)}
    </ul>}
    {selected && <div className="extras-shelf-reader">
      {selected.isSven && selected.plainSummary && <div className="plain-summary-callout"><b>In plain words</b><p>{selected.plainSummary}</p></div>}
      <MarkdownResult content={selected.markdown} />
    </div>}
    {notes.map((note, index) => <p className="deliverables-warning" role="note" key={index}>{note}</p>)}
  </div>;
}

function formatFileSize(size: number): string {
  if (size < 1024) return `${size} B`;
  if (size < 1024 * 1024) return `${(size / 1024).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "")} KB`;
  return `${(size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "")} MB`;
}

function DeliverableFileCard({ item, taskId }: { item: DeliverableItem; taskId: string }) {
  const title = deliverableTitle(item.fileName);
  const isWebPage = /\.html?$/i.test(item.fileName);
  const typeLabel = item.kind === "video" ? "Video" : /\.pdf$/i.test(item.fileName) ? "PDF" : isWebPage ? "Web page" : "File";
  // Web pages preview IN the office (see WebsitePreview): the old "Open"
  // link navigated a new tab to the file's blob copy, which the shell
  // never loads — Ben got a blank about:blank tab every time.
  const [previewOpen, setPreviewOpen] = useState(false);
  const preview = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["website-preview", taskId, item.relativePath],
    queryFn: () => api.get_website_preview({ taskId, relativePath: item.relativePath }),
    enabled: previewOpen && isWebPage,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
  const previewData = preview.data;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!previewOpen) return;
    function closeOnEscape(event: KeyboardEvent) { if (event.key === "Escape") setPreviewOpen(false); }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
  }, [previewOpen]);
  return <article className="deliverable-file-card" aria-label={`${typeLabel}: ${item.fileName}`}>
    <div className="deliverable-file-copy">
      <span className="deliverable-file-type">{typeLabel}</span>
      <b>{title}</b>
      <small>{item.fileName} · {formatFileSize(item.size)}</small>
      {item.relativePath.split("/").length > 3 && <small>In {item.relativePath.split("/").slice(2, -1).join("/")}/</small>}
    </div>
    {item.kind === "video" && item.fileUrl && <video className="deliverable-file-video" controls preload="metadata" src={item.fileUrl} aria-label={`Play ${title}`} />}
    <span className="deliverable-file-actions">
      {isWebPage
        ? <><button type="button" className="deliverable-preview-button" onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(true)} aria-label={`Preview the website ${item.fileName} here`}>Preview website</button>{item.fileUrl && <a href={item.fileUrl} download={item.fileName} aria-label={`Download ${item.fileName}`}>Download</a>}</>
        : item.fileUrl
          ? <><a href={item.fileUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`Open ${item.fileName}`}>Open</a><a href={item.fileUrl} download={item.fileName} aria-label={`Download ${item.fileName}`}>Download</a></>
          : <span className="deliverable-file-unavailable">This file could not be loaded for download right now.</span>}
    </span>
    {/* The overlay is portaled to <body>: rendered in place it inherits the
        floor-zoom viewport's transform, which captures position:fixed and
        leaves the dialog painted far off-screen inside the scroll panel. */}
    {previewOpen && isWebPage && createPortal(<>
      <button className="website-preview-scrim" type="button" aria-label={`Close ${title} website preview`} onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(false)} />
      <section className="website-preview" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`${title} website preview`}>
        <header className="website-preview-head">
          <div><b>{title}</b><span>{item.fileName} · Finished page preview — it is shown exactly as built; links inside it don't navigate away.</span></div>
          {item.fileUrl && <a className="website-preview-download" href={item.fileUrl} download={item.fileName} aria-label={`Download ${item.fileName}`}>Download</a>}
          <button className="website-preview-close" type="button" onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(false)} aria-label={`Close ${title} website preview`}>×</button>
        </header>
        {preview.isLoading
          ? <p className="website-preview-status" aria-live="polite">Loading the page…</p>
          : preview.isError
            ? <p className="website-preview-status" role="alert">That page could not be loaded right now. The file is still on its card — try the preview again, or download it.</p>
            : previewData && !previewData.ok
              ? <p className="website-preview-status" role="alert">{previewData.error}</p>
              : previewData
                ? <iframe className="website-preview-frame" title={`${title} — finished website preview`} sandbox="" srcDoc={previewData.html} />
                : null}
      </section>
    </>, document.body)}
  </article>;
}

function DeliverableImage({ item, onOpen, selectable = false, selected = false, onToggleSelect, radioGroup, humanTitle }: { item: DeliverableItem; onOpen: () => void; selectable?: boolean; selected?: boolean; onToggleSelect?: () => void; radioGroup?: string; humanTitle?: string }) {
  const title = humanTitle ?? deliverableTitle(item.fileName);
  if (!item.imageUrl) return null;
  return <figure className={`deliverable-image ${selectable ? (selected ? "batch-selected" : "batch-unselected") : item.reviewStatus ?? "pending"}`}>
    <button className="deliverable-image-open" type="button" onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`View ${title} full size`}><img src={item.imageUrl} alt={title} /></button>
    <figcaption><span>{title}</span>{item.provenance && <ProvenanceLine provenance={item.provenance} />}<span className="deliverable-file-actions"><button type="button" onClick={onOpen}>Full size</button><a href={item.imageUrl} download={item.fileName}>Download</a></span></figcaption>
    {selectable && onToggleSelect && <fieldset className="deliverable-item-decisions">
      <legend className="keep-decision-legend">Keep or delete {title}?</legend>
      <label className={selected ? "keep-choice keep selected" : "keep-choice keep"}>
        <input type="radio" name={radioGroup} checked={selected} onChange={() => { if (!selected) onToggleSelect(); }} aria-label={`Keep ${title}`} />
        <span>Keep</span>
      </label>
      <label className={!selected ? "keep-choice delete selected" : "keep-choice delete"}>
        <input type="radio" name={radioGroup} checked={!selected} onChange={() => { if (selected) onToggleSelect(); }} aria-label={`Delete ${title}`} />
        <span>Delete</span>
      </label>
    </fieldset>}
  </figure>;
}

function ImageLightbox({ item, onClose }: { item: DeliverableItem; onClose: () => void }) {
  const title = deliverableTitle(item.fileName);
  useEffect(() => {
    function closeOnEscape(event: KeyboardEvent) { if (event.key === "Escape") onClose(); }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
  }, [onClose]);
  if (!item.imageUrl) return null;
  return <>
    <button className="image-lightbox-scrim" type="button" aria-label={`Close ${title} preview`} onClick={onClose} />
    <section className="image-lightbox" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`${title} full-size preview`}>
      <button className="image-lightbox-close" type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label={`Close ${title} preview`}>×</button>
      <img src={item.imageUrl} alt={title} />
      <footer><b>{title}</b><span>{item.fileName}</span>{item.provenance && <ProvenanceLine provenance={item.provenance} tone="lightbox" />}<a className="lightbox-download" href={item.imageUrl} download={item.fileName}>Download image</a></footer>
    </section>
  </>;
}

function RegionEditorSheet({ floorMap, onClose, onSave, busy }: { floorMap: FloorMapState; onClose: () => void; onSave: (regionData: number[], legend: RegionLegendItem[]) => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const [regionData, setRegionData] = useState<number[]>(() => [...(floorMap.regionData ?? BASE_REGION_DATA)]);
  const [legend, setLegend] = useState<RegionLegendItem[]>(() => floorMap.legend.map((item) => ({ ...item })));
  const [selectedRegion, setSelectedRegion] = useState(floorMap.legend.find((item) => item.id === 12)?.id ?? floorMap.legend[0]?.id ?? 0);
  const [newRegionId, setNewRegionId] = useState("");
  const [newRegionLabel, setNewRegionLabel] = useState("");
  const painting = useRef(false);
  // The editor's map zooms exactly like the live floor — wheel anchored at
  // the cursor, the paint grid and the floor art inside the one zoom
  // viewport so region overlays track the picture tile-for-tile. A plain
  // drag still paints; panning is Alt-drag (or middle-button drag), and
  // double-click resets to the full floor.
  const regionZoom = useMapZoom<HTMLDivElement>({ panPredicate: (event) => event.altKey || event.button === 1 });

  useEffect(() => {
    const stopPainting = () => { painting.current = false; };
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", stopPainting);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopPainting);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", stopPainting);
      window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", stopPainting);
    };
  }, []);

  function paint(index: number) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= regionData.length) return;
    setRegionData((previous) => previous[index] === selectedRegion ? previous : previous.map((value, itemIndex) => itemIndex === index ? selectedRegion : value));
  }

  function pointerMove(event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (event.altKey) return;
    if (!painting.current) return;
    const target = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY)?.closest<HTMLElement>("[data-region-tile]");
    const index = Number(target?.dataset.regionTile);
    if (Number.isInteger(index)) paint(index);
  }

  function addLegendItem() {
    const id = Number(newRegionId);
    const label = newRegionLabel.trim();
    if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id < 0 || id > 255 || !label || legend.some((item) => item.id === id)) return;
    setLegend((previous) => [...previous, { id, label }].sort((left, right) => left.id - right.id));
    setSelectedRegion(id);
    setNewRegionId("");
    setNewRegionLabel("");
  }

  const addId = Number(newRegionId);
  const canAdd = Number.isInteger(addId) && addId >= 0 && addId <= 255 && Boolean(newRegionLabel.trim()) && !legend.some((item) => item.id === addId);
  const canSave = regionData.length === MAP_WIDTH * MAP_HEIGHT && legend.length > 0 && legend.every((item) => item.label.trim());
  const selectedLabel = legend.find((item) => item.id === selectedRegion)?.label ?? `Region ${selectedRegion}`;

  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onClose} label="Region ID editor" className="region-editor-sheet">
    <p className="sheet-kicker">Floor map</p>
    <h3>Region ID editor</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">Choose an ID, then tap or drag across tiles. Saving updates the live region layer; the floor art stays untouched. Scroll to zoom into the cursor, Alt-drag to pan while zoomed, double-click to reset the view.</p>
    <div className="region-tool-row">
      <label htmlFor="paint-region">Paint with</label>
      <select id="paint-region" value={selectedRegion} onChange={(event) => setSelectedRegion(Number(event.target.value))}>
        {legend.map((item) => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.id} — {item.label}</option>)}
      </select>
      <span>Selected: {selectedLabel}</span>
    </div>
    <div
      className="region-editor-map"
      ref={regionZoom.containerRef}
      data-zoom-scale={regionZoom.zoom.scale.toFixed(3)}
      data-zoomed={regionZoom.isZoomed ? "true" : "false"}
      data-panning={regionZoom.isPanning ? "true" : "false"}
      style={regionZoom.zoomVars}
      onPointerDown={regionZoom.handlers.onPointerDown}
      onPointerMove={(event) => { regionZoom.handlers.onPointerMove(event); pointerMove(event); }}
      onPointerUp={regionZoom.handlers.onPointerUp}
      onPointerCancel={regionZoom.handlers.onPointerCancel}
      onClickCapture={regionZoom.handlers.onClickCapture}
      onDoubleClick={regionZoom.handlers.onDoubleClick}
      onPointerLeave={() => { painting.current = false; }}
    >
      <div className="floor-zoom-viewport">
      <RpgMapBackground className="rpg-map-background" />
      <div className="region-paint-grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${MAP_WIDTH}, 1fr)`, gridTemplateRows: `repeat(${MAP_HEIGHT}, 1fr)` }}>
        {regionData.map((region, index) => {
          const x = index % MAP_WIDTH;
          const y = Math.floor(index / MAP_WIDTH);
          return <button
            key={index}
            type="button"
            data-region-tile={index}
            className={region === selectedRegion ? "selected-region" : ""}
            onPointerDown={(event) => { if (event.altKey || event.button === 1) return; event.preventDefault(); painting.current = true; paint(index); }}
            aria-label={`Tile ${x + 1}, ${y + 1}, region ${region}`}
          ><span>{region}</span></button>;
        })}
      </div>
      </div>
      {regionZoom.isZoomed && <button
        type="button"
        className="floor-zoom-reset region-editor-zoom-reset"
        data-zoom-ignore
        onClick={regionZoom.resetZoom}
        aria-label="Reset region editor map zoom to full floor view"
        title="Reset zoom — or double-click the map"
      ><span aria-hidden="true">⤢</span><b>{Math.round(regionZoom.zoom.scale * 100)}% · Reset view</b></button>}
    </div>
    <section className="region-legend-editor" aria-labelledby="region-legend-title">
      <div className="region-editor-section-head"><h4 id="region-legend-title">Legend</h4><span>{legend.length} IDs</span></div>
      <div className="region-legend-list">
        {legend.map((item) => <label key={item.id}><b>{item.id}</b><input aria-label={`Label for region ${item.id}`} value={item.label} maxLength={60} onChange={(event) => setLegend((previous) => previous.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? { ...entry, label: event.target.value } : entry))} /></label>)}
      </div>
      <div className="region-add-row">
        <label><span>New ID</span><input type="number" min={0} max={255} value={newRegionId} onChange={(event) => setNewRegionId(event.target.value)} /></label>
        <label><span>Label</span><input maxLength={60} value={newRegionLabel} onChange={(event) => setNewRegionLabel(event.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Visitor chair" /></label>
        <button type="button" onClick={addLegendItem} disabled={!canAdd}>Add ID</button>
      </div>
    </section>
    <div className="sheet-actions region-save-actions"><button className="big-button" type="button" disabled={busy || !canSave} onClick={() => onSave(regionData, legend.map((item) => ({ ...item, label: item.label.trim() })))}>{busy ? "Saving…" : "Save region map"}</button><button className="big-button ghost" type="button" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button></div>
  </Sheet>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// THE DECISION SCREEN (Ben, 2026-10-18 — the item view, rebuilt from
// scratch after he filmed the old one: a 25-second scroll of full-size
// images, a keep/delete chore under each, a garbled wall of manifest
// text, then twelve full letters stacked underneath, with the decision
// at the very bottom). Opening an item is a DECISION SCREEN now:
//   1. THE RESULT first — the verdict / result lead, nothing else.
//   2. WHAT'S IN IT — a compact index: every piece named, its kind,
//      and its one-line outcome. Nothing renders in full here.
//   3. THE PIECE, ON TAP — one piece at a time in the reader under the
//      index, rendered properly (real tables, wrapped text). Tap
//      another row to swap it.
//   4. KEEP / DELETE — where a flow genuinely needs per-image choices,
//      ONE compact checklist (a thumb and two radios per line), never
//      interleaved through the content. Pieces the job's own documents
//      excluded by ruling appear nowhere here — not as contents, not
//      as choices — only in the held-out note.
// The decision actions themselves sit at the TOP of the sheet (TaskSheet
// renders them above this screen), never at the bottom of a scroll.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------

type DecisionPiece = {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  kindLabel: string;
  outcome: string;
  thumb?: string | null;
  body: ReactNode;
};

// A piece's one-line outcome for the index: its own first readable line
// (markdown machinery stripped), never a summary of the index itself.
function firstOutcomeLine(text: string): string {
  const lead = extractLeadSection(text);
  const source = lead ?? text;
  for (const raw of source.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n")) {
    const line = raw.replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/, "").replace(/^[-*]\s+/, "").replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "$1").replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1").replace(/\|/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (line.length >= 12 && !/^https?:\/\//.test(line)) return line.length > 120 ? `${line.slice(0, 117).trimEnd()}…` : line;
  }
  return "Finished piece — tap to read it.";
}

function DecisionScreen({ task, variant = "review", embedded = false }: { task: Task; variant?: "review" | "approved"; embedded?: boolean }) {
  const plan = useReadyResultPlan(task.id, task.revision, task, true);
  const deliverables = useTaskDeliverablesQuery(task.id, task.revision);
  const batch = useBatchSelection(task.id);
  const [selectedKey, setSelectedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [extrasOpen, setExtrasOpen] = useState(false);
  const [openImage, setOpenImage] = useState<DeliverableItem | null>(null);
  const [fbCopyResult, setFbCopyResult] = useState<PostCopyResult | null>(null);
  const data = deliverables.data;

  if (deliverables.isLoading) {
    return <div className="deliverables-loading" aria-live="polite"><span className="live-dot" />Loading the finished work…</div>;
  }
  if (deliverables.isError) {
    return <div className="deliverables-warning">The finished files could not be loaded right now. The job record is still intact.</div>;
  }
  if (!data || (data.items.length === 0 && data.briefs.length === 0 && data.hiddenFileCount === 0)) return null;

  const images = data.items.filter((item) => item.kind === "image" && item.imageUrl && !item.excluded);
  const documents = data.items.filter((item) => item.kind !== "image" && item.text !== null && !item.excluded);
  const fileItems = data.items.filter((item) => (item.kind === "document" || item.kind === "video") && !item.excluded);
  const facebookPost = task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" ? data.postCopy ?? "" : "";
  const previewImage = images[0];
  const multiImageReview = variant === "review" && task.status === "approval" && images.length > 1 && !task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt;
  const researchFace = plan.face?.researchFace ?? null;

  const pieces: DecisionPiece[] = [];
  if (facebookPost) {
    pieces.push({
      key: "post", name: "The finished post", kindLabel: "Post", outcome: firstOutcomeLine(facebookPost),
      body: <div className="ds-post">
        {previewImage?.imageUrl && <button className="ds-post-image" type="button" onClick={() => setOpenImage(previewImage)} aria-label="View the post image full size"><img src={previewImage.imageUrl} alt="Image prepared for this post" /></button>}
        {previewImage?.provenance && <p className="facebook-provenance"><ProvenanceLine provenance={previewImage.provenance} tone="facebook" /></p>}
        <p className="ready-post-copy">{facebookPost}</p>
        <div className="facebook-copy-block">
          <button className="copy-facebook-post" type="button" onClick={() => { void copyPostToClipboard(facebookPost).then(setFbCopyResult); }} aria-label="Copy Facebook post text">{fbCopyResult === "text" ? "Copied text ✓" : "Copy post text"}</button>
          {fbCopyResult === "text" && <p className="copy-post-status ok" role="status">{previewImage?.imageUrl ? "Text copied ✓ — the image is not on your clipboard: download it from its piece here and add it to your Facebook post." : "Text copied ✓ — paste it into Facebook."}</p>}
          {fbCopyResult === "failed" && <>
            <p className="copy-post-status failed" role="alert">That copy didn't take. Long-press the text in the box below, tap Select All, then Copy, and paste into Facebook.</p>
            <ManualCopyBox text={facebookPost} rows={6} label="Facebook post text — long-press, select all, and copy it manually" />
          </>}
        </div>
      </div>,
    });
  }
  for (const item of documents) {
    pieces.push({
      key: `doc-${item.relativePath}`, name: deliverableTitle(item.fileName), kindLabel: item.kind === "markdown" ? "Document" : "Text file",
      outcome: item.plainSummary ?? firstOutcomeLine(item.text ?? ""),
      body: <div className="ds-reader">{item.plainSummary && data.isSvenOriginated && <div className="plain-summary-callout"><b>In plain words</b><p>{item.plainSummary}</p></div>}<MarkdownResult content={item.text ?? ""} /></div>,
    });
  }
  const seenBriefResults: string[] = [];
  for (const brief of data.briefs) {
    if (documents.some((doc) => sameDeliverableContent(brief.result, doc.text ?? ""))) continue;
    if (seenBriefResults.some((seen) => sameDeliverableContent(brief.result, seen))) continue;
    seenBriefResults.push(brief.result);
    pieces.push({
      key: `brief-${brief.id}`, name: brief.humanTitle || "Finished step", kindLabel: "Finished work",
      outcome: brief.plainSummary ?? firstOutcomeLine(brief.result),
      body: <div className="ds-reader">{brief.plainSummary && data.isSvenOriginated && <div className="plain-summary-callout"><b>In plain words</b><p>{brief.plainSummary}</p></div>}<MarkdownResult content={brief.result} /></div>,
    });
  }
  for (const item of images) {
    const name = deliverableTitle(item.fileName);
    pieces.push({
      key: `img-${item.relativePath}`, name, kindLabel: "Image", thumb: item.imageUrl,
      outcome: item.provenance?.label ?? "Image — tap to see it full size.",
      body: <figure className="ds-image-view">
        <img src={item.imageUrl ?? ""} alt={name} />
        <figcaption>{item.provenance && <ProvenanceLine provenance={item.provenance} />}<span className="deliverable-file-actions"><button type="button" onClick={() => setOpenImage(item)}>Full size</button><a href={item.imageUrl ?? undefined} download={item.fileName}>Download</a></span></figcaption>
      </figure>,
    });
  }
  for (const item of fileItems) {
    pieces.push({
      key: `file-${item.relativePath}`, name: deliverableTitle(item.fileName), kindLabel: /\.html?$/i.test(item.fileName) ? "Web page" : item.kind === "video" ? "Video" : "File",
      outcome: `${item.fileName} · ${formatFileSize(item.size)} — tap to preview or download it.`,
      body: <DeliverableFileCard item={item} taskId={task.id} />,
    });
  }

  const selected = pieces.find((piece) => piece.key === selectedKey) ?? pieces[0] ?? null;
  const hasExtras = plan.extras.length > 0 || plan.extrasNotes.length > 0;

  return <div className="decision-screen">
    {!embedded && (researchFace ? <div className="ds-verdict">
      <span className="ds-verdict-label">The result</span>
      <div className="ds-verdict-body"><MarkdownResult content={researchFace.verdict} /></div>
      <p className="ds-verdict-meta">Question: {researchFace.question}{researchFace.tally ? ` · ${researchFace.tally}` : ""}</p>
    </div> : plan.resultLead ? <div className="ds-verdict">
      <span className="ds-verdict-label">The result</span>
      <p className="ds-verdict-lead">{plan.resultLead}</p>
    </div> : data.packageSummary ? <div className="ds-verdict">
      <span className="ds-verdict-label">In plain words</span>
      <p className="ds-verdict-lead">{data.packageSummary}</p>
    </div> : null)}

    {pieces.length > 0 && <nav className="ds-index" aria-label="What's in this item">
      <h4>What&rsquo;s in it — {pieces.length} {pieces.length === 1 ? "piece" : "pieces"}</h4>
      <ul>
        {pieces.map((piece) => <li key={piece.key}>
          <button type="button" className={selected?.key === piece.key ? "ds-index-row selected" : "ds-index-row"} aria-pressed={selected?.key === piece.key} onClick={() => setSelectedKey(piece.key)}>
            {piece.thumb && <img className="ds-index-thumb" src={piece.thumb} alt="" />}
            <span className="ds-index-main"><b>{piece.name}</b><small>{piece.outcome}</small></span>
            <span className="ds-index-kind">{piece.kindLabel}</span>
          </button>
        </li>)}
      </ul>
    </nav>}

    {selected && <section className="ds-viewer" aria-label={selected.name}>
      <h4 className="ds-viewer-title">{selected.name}</h4>
      {selected.body}
    </section>}

    {multiImageReview && <section className="ds-checklist" aria-label="Choose which images to keep">
      <h4>Keep or delete — {batch?.selected.size ?? 0} of {images.length} to keep</h4>
      <p className="ds-checklist-note">One list, one decision: Accept keeps the images marked Keep and deletes the rest.</p>
      <ul>
        {images.map((item) => {
          const name = deliverableTitle(item.fileName);
          const kept = Boolean(batch?.selected.has(item.relativePath));
          return <li key={item.relativePath} className="ds-check-row">
            {item.imageUrl && <img className="ds-check-thumb" src={item.imageUrl} alt="" />}
            <span className="ds-check-name">{name}</span>
            <span className="ds-check-choices">
              <label className={kept ? "keep-choice keep selected" : "keep-choice keep"}>
                <input type="radio" name={`ds-keep-${task.id}-${item.relativePath}`} checked={kept} onChange={() => { if (!kept) batch?.toggle(item.relativePath); }} aria-label={`Keep ${name}`} />
                <span>Keep</span>
              </label>
              <label className={!kept ? "keep-choice delete selected" : "keep-choice delete"}>
                <input type="radio" name={`ds-keep-${task.id}-${item.relativePath}`} checked={!kept} onChange={() => { if (kept) batch?.toggle(item.relativePath); }} aria-label={`Delete ${name}`} />
                <span>Delete</span>
              </label>
            </span>
          </li>;
        })}
      </ul>
    </section>}

    {plan.heldOut.length > 0 && <p className="held-out-note" role="note">Held out by ruling — not part of this pack: {plan.heldOut.join(" · ")}</p>}
    {data.warning && <p className="deliverables-warning">{data.warning}</p>}
    {data.hiddenFileCount > 0 && <p className="deliverables-warning" role="note">{data.hiddenFileCount} {data.hiddenFileCount === 1 ? "file" : "files"} in this job&rsquo;s folder {data.hiddenFileCount === 1 ? "isn’t" : "aren’t"} shown here</p>}

    {!embedded && hasExtras && <button type="button" className="decision-extras-toggle" aria-expanded={extrasOpen} onClick={() => setExtrasOpen((value) => !value)}>{extrasOpen ? "Hide extras" : "Extras — the evidence, working papers & checks"}</button>}
    {!embedded && extrasOpen && hasExtras && <ReadyExtrasShelf entries={plan.extras} notes={plan.extrasNotes} />}

    {!embedded && <details className="ds-brief-details">
      <summary>The job as briefed</summary>
      <BriefNotes notes={task.notes} />
    </details>}
    {openImage?.imageUrl && <ImageLightbox item={openImage} onClose={() => setOpenImage(null)} />}
  </div>;
}

function TaskSheet({ task, blockers, onAnswer, onClose, onMove, onFinalize, onMarkPosted, onDelete, busy }: { task: Task; blockers: Blocker[]; onAnswer: (blocker: Blocker) => void; onClose: () => void; onMove: (status: TaskStatus) => void; onFinalize: (keepPaths: string[]) => void; onMarkPosted: () => void; onDelete: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const member = memberById(task.assignee);
  const approvedPackage = isApprovedPackage(task);
  // The decision screen (verdict first, contents index, one piece at a
  // time) with the decision actions at the TOP of the sheet — a waiting
  // item is decided from its first screen, never from the bottom of a
  // scroll. Blocked items keep the question-first layout below: their
  // body is the crew's question, not a result.
  const plan = useReadyResultPlan(task.id, task.revision, task, task.status === "approval" && !approvedPackage && blockers.length === 0);
  if (task.status === "approval" && !approvedPackage && blockers.length === 0) {
    return <Sheet onClose={onClose} label="Decide on this finished work"><BatchSelectionScope taskId={task.id}>
      <p className="sheet-kicker">{readyKindLabelForTask(task)} · Waiting on you</p>
      <h3>{plan.displayTitle ?? task.title}</h3>
      <p className="sheet-sub">{plan.displayTitle ? `Job: ${task.title} · ` : ""}{member?.name ?? "The crew"} · {formatStamp(task.created)}</p>
      <ContractNote task={task} />
      <div className="ds-actions"><ApprovalActions task={task} layout="sheet" onApprove={() => onMove("done")} onFinalize={onFinalize} onDeny={() => onMove("working")} onDelete={onDelete} busy={busy} /></div>
      <DecisionScreen task={task} variant="review" />
    </BatchSelectionScope></Sheet>;
  }
  return <Sheet onClose={onClose} label="Job details"><BatchSelectionScope taskId={task.id}>
    <p className={blockers.length ? "sheet-kicker danger-kicker" : "sheet-kicker"}>{blockers.length ? "Answer needed" : taskProgressLabel(task)}</p><h3>{task.title}</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">{member?.name ?? "The crew"} · {formatStamp(task.created)}</p>
    {isPostedPackage(task) && <p className="deliverable-posted-badge sheet-posted-badge">Posted{task.postedAt ? ` · ${formatStamp(task.postedAt)}` : ""}{postClearsInLabel(task.postedAt) ? ` · ${postClearsInLabel(task.postedAt)}` : ""} — this post sits in the Deliverables post tiles and stays copyable{postClearsInLabel(task.postedAt) ? " until it clears; the job itself stays in Done history with its files" : ""}.</p>}
    <ContractNote task={task} />
    <BlockerPrompts blockers={blockers} onAnswer={onAnswer} />
    {approvedPackage && !blockers.length ? <div className="sheet-actions ds-actions-top"><button className="big-button danger-ghost" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy}>Delete job</button><button className="big-button approve-solid" onClick={onMarkPosted} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Mark ${task.title} as posted`}>Mark posted</button></div>
      : blockers.length > 0 ? <div className="sheet-actions ds-actions-top"><button className="big-button danger-ghost" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy}>Delete job</button></div>
      : task.status !== "approval" ? <div className="sheet-actions ds-actions-top"><button className="big-button danger-ghost" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy}>Delete job</button></div> : null}
    {!blockers.length && <DecisionScreen task={task} variant={approvedPackage ? "approved" : "review"} />}
    {blockers.length > 0 && <div className="detail-block brief-detail-block"><BriefNotes notes={task.notes} /></div>}
  </BatchSelectionScope></Sheet>;
}

function ApprovalCompleteSheet({ task, onClose }: { task: Task; onClose: () => void }) {
  return <Sheet onClose={onClose} label="Job approved">
    <p className="sheet-kicker approved-kicker">Done</p>
    <h3>{task.title}</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">{task.clientId
      ? "Approved. The job is closed — nothing else was queued and no second approval will appear. Maria is assembling its delivery package, and it will wait in Deliverables, under Delivery packages."
      : "Approved. The job is closed — nothing else was queued and no second approval will appear. Its finished work lives in Deliverables, in the Library."}</p>
    <button className="big-button" onClick={onClose}>Done</button>
  </Sheet>;
}

const REWORK_PART_NAMES: Record<ReworkTarget, string> = { copy: "copy", image: "image", research: "research" };
const REWORK_PART_TITLES: Record<ReworkTarget, string> = { copy: "Copy", image: "Image", research: "Research" };
const REWORK_PART_QUESTIONS: Record<ReworkTarget, string> = {
  copy: "What should change about the copy?",
  image: "What should change about the image?",
  research: "What should change about the research?",
};

// Aspect control — mismatch guard: plain-language heuristics that notice
// when the special instructions are clearly about a different part than the
// one selected (the live failure mode: "just generate an image based on the
// post" typed while Copy is selected). This only ever warns and offers a
// switch — it never rewrites the approver's words: "Keep … selected"
// acknowledges the warning and sends exactly as chosen.
function detectReworkMismatch(feedback: string, target: ReworkTarget): ReworkTarget | null {
  const text = feedback.toLowerCase();
  if (!text.trim()) return null;
  const asksImage = /\b(generate|create|make|draw|produce|render|replace|redo|fix|change|find|search for|get|use|swap)\b[^.!?\n]{0,50}\b(image|picture|photo|photograph|illustration|artwork|visual)\b/.test(text)
    || /\b(image|picture|photo|photograph|illustration)\b[^.!?\n]{0,30}\b(is poor|is bad|is wrong|looks wrong|needs replacing|generate|replace)\b/.test(text)
    || /\bjust generate\b/.test(text);
  const asksCopy = /\b(rewrite|reword|revise|edit|change|fix|redo|shorten|lengthen|expand|tighten)\b[^.!?\n]{0,50}\b(copy|wording|text|headline|ending|paragraph|caption|title)\b/.test(text)
    || /\b(copy|wording)\b[^.!?\n]{0,20}\b(is|reads|feels)\b[^.!?\n]{0,12}\b(wrong|off|bad|weak|too)\b/.test(text);
  const asksResearch = /\b(re-?check|re-?research|verify|fact-?check)\b/.test(text)
    || /\b(check|verify)\b[^.!?\n]{0,30}\b(claims?|facts?|sources?)\b/.test(text)
    || /\b(research|sources?|claims?|facts?)\b[^.!?\n]{0,20}\b(is wrong|are wrong|is incomplete|are incomplete|needs|missing)\b/.test(text);
  if (target !== "image" && asksImage) return "image";
  if (target !== "research" && asksResearch) return "research";
  if (target !== "copy" && asksCopy) return "copy";
  return null;
}

// Aspect control — one-off override detection (image part): the approver is
// explicitly asking for a generated image, directly, instead of the usual
// source-first search. The server applies the same detection when it builds
// the rework brief, and for that run only the instruction outranks the
// standing source-first default.
function hasGenerateDirectInstruction(feedback: string): boolean {
  const text = feedback.toLowerCase();
  return /\b(generate|create|make|draw|produce|render)\b[^.!?\n]{0,50}\b(image|picture|photo|photograph|illustration|artwork|visual|one|it)\b/.test(text)
    || /\bjust generate\b/.test(text)
    || /\bgenerate (it|one|directly)\b/.test(text)
    || (/\b(skip|don't|do not|no need to|instead of)\b[^.!?\n]{0,40}\b(search|searching|find|finding|look for|sourcing)\b/.test(text) && /\b(image|picture|photo|generate)\b/.test(text));
}

function SendBackSheet({ task: _task, onCancel, onConfirm, busy }: { task: Task; onCancel: () => void; onConfirm: (feedback: string, target: ReworkTarget, assigneeId: "scout" | "forge" | "quill" | "ledger") => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState("");
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<ReworkTarget>("copy");
  const suggestedWorker: Record<ReworkTarget, "scout" | "forge" | "quill"> = { copy: "quill", image: "forge", research: "scout" };
  const [workerOverride, setWorkerOverride] = useState<"" | "scout" | "forge" | "quill" | "ledger">("");
  const [mismatchKeptKey, setMismatchKeptKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitBlocked, setSubmitBlocked] = useState(false);
  const workerId = workerOverride || suggestedWorker[target];
  const worker = memberById(workerId)?.name ?? "the crew";
  const mismatch = detectReworkMismatch(feedback, target);
  const mismatchKey = mismatch ? `${target}->${mismatch}:${feedback.trim().toLowerCase()}` : null;
  const mismatchAcknowledged = mismatchKey !== null && mismatchKeptKey === mismatchKey;
  const generateDirect = target === "image" && hasGenerateDirectInstruction(feedback);
  function chooseTarget(nextTarget: ReworkTarget) {
    setTarget(nextTarget);
    setWorkerOverride("");
    setSubmitBlocked(false);
  }
  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = feedback.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    if (mismatch && !mismatchAcknowledged) { setSubmitBlocked(true); return; }
    onConfirm(trimmed, target, workerId);
  }
  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onCancel} label="Rework job">
    <p className="sheet-kicker danger-kicker">Rework</p>
    <h3>What needs changing?</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">Pick the one part that is off — only that part is replaced, and everything else in the post stays exactly as it is. This stays on the same job card.</p>
    <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <div className="rework-targets" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Part to rework">
        {(["copy", "image", "research"] as ReworkTarget[]).map((item) => <button key={item} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={target === item} className={target === item ? "selected" : ""} onClick={() => chooseTarget(item)}>{item === "copy" ? "Copy" : item === "image" ? "Image" : "Research"}</button>)}
      </div>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="rework-worker">Who should fix it?</label>
      <select id="rework-worker" className="field-control" value={workerId} onChange={(event) => setWorkerOverride(event.target.value as typeof workerOverride)}>
        <option value="quill">Johnny · Copy</option><option value="forge">Nik · Image</option><option value="scout">Tom · Research</option><option value="ledger">Sven · Visionary</option>
      </select>
      <p className="rework-suggestion">Suggested: <b>{memberById(suggestedWorker[target])?.name}</b></p>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="send-back-feedback">{REWORK_PART_QUESTIONS[target]}</label>
      <p className="rework-field-note">Special instructions for the {REWORK_PART_NAMES[target]} only. Your words go to {worker} word-for-word, and the other parts of this post are not touched.</p>
      <textarea id="send-back-feedback" className="field-control field-textarea send-back-feedback" autoFocus value={feedback} onChange={(event) => { setFeedback(event.target.value); setSubmitBlocked(false); }} placeholder={target === "image" ? `Tell ${worker} exactly what to change about the image — for example, “just generate an image based on the post”.` : target === "copy" ? `Tell ${worker} exactly what to change about the copy — the words only.` : `Tell ${worker} exactly what to change about the research — the facts and sources only.`} maxLength={5000} required />
      {mismatch && !mismatchAcknowledged && <div className="rework-mismatch" role="alert">
        <b>These instructions sound like they are about the {REWORK_PART_NAMES[mismatch]}, but you have {REWORK_PART_TITLES[target]} selected.</b>
        <p>If you send this as a {REWORK_PART_NAMES[target]} rework, only the {REWORK_PART_NAMES[target]} changes — the {REWORK_PART_NAMES[mismatch]} stays exactly as it is, and no {REWORK_PART_NAMES[mismatch]} work happens.</p>
        {submitBlocked && <p className="rework-mismatch-blocked">Nothing has been sent yet. Switch the part to match your instructions, or keep {REWORK_PART_TITLES[target]} if that is really what you meant.</p>}
        <div className="rework-mismatch-actions">
          <button type="button" className="rework-switch-button" onClick={() => chooseTarget(mismatch)}>Switch to {REWORK_PART_TITLES[mismatch]}</button>
          <button type="button" className="rework-keep-button" onClick={() => { setMismatchKeptKey(mismatchKey); setSubmitBlocked(false); }}>Keep {REWORK_PART_TITLES[target]} selected</button>
        </div>
      </div>}
      {mismatch && mismatchAcknowledged && <p className="rework-kept-note">Kept as a {REWORK_PART_NAMES[target]} rework, as you chose — only the {REWORK_PART_NAMES[target]} will change.</p>}
      {generateDirect && <div className="rework-override" role="note">
        <b>One-off override for this run.</b>
        <p>Your instructions say to generate the image directly. For this run only, {worker} will generate it instead of searching for a real photo first — and the finished image will still be labelled AI-generated. The usual search-first rule is unchanged for every other job.</p>
      </div>}
      <button className="big-button danger" disabled={busy || !feedback.trim()}>{busy ? "Sending…" : `Send ${target} rework to ${worker}`}</button>
      <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
    </form>
  </Sheet>;
}

function DeleteTaskSheet({ task, onCancel, onConfirm, busy }: { task: Task; onCancel: () => void; onConfirm: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onCancel} label="Delete task confirmation">
    <p className="sheet-kicker danger-kicker">Permanent action</p>
    <h3>Delete this task? This can't be undone.</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub delete-task-name">“{task.title}” and any briefs tied to it will be permanently removed.</p>
    <div className="confirm-actions">
      <button className="big-button danger" onClick={onConfirm} disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Deleting…" : "Delete"}</button>
      <button className="big-button ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </Sheet>;
}

function NewTaskSheet({ clients, onClose, onSubmit, onSavePreset, presetBusy, busy }: { clients: Client[]; onClose: () => void; onSubmit: (title: string, notes: string, jobType: CreateWorkJobType, postCount?: number, clientId?: string | null) => void; onSavePreset: (input: { name: string; jobType: PresetJobType; title: string; notes: string; postCount?: number; fillInLabel?: string | null }) => void; presetBusy: boolean; busy: boolean }) {

        <option value="client_report">Client report — Maria compiles a client's report</option>
      </select>
      {jobType === "perfectly_paranoid" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">P</span><p><b>The fixed story pipeline</b><small>Tom researches and verifies · Johnny writes in the locked voice · Nik makes the image · you decide once, at the end. Outcome contract: verified facts only, the locked voice with its stakes beat, one image, and the hashtag block at the end. Tag an external client below and Maria shapes the brief first; the finished package then waits in Deliverables, under Delivery packages — not under To post. Perfectly Paranoid is the exception: Maria still shapes its brief, but its posts are house content — they land under To post, never a package.</small></p></div>}
      {jobType === "research" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">§</span><p><b>Research Department · Pulse HQ</b><small>Walter reads and extracts claims · Peter verifies and labels them · Tom writes the case brief. Outcome contract: a case-file brief with claim labels — no post copy, no image, no hashtags. You decide once, at the end. Tag a client below and Maria shapes the brief first; on approval the case exits through that client's delivery package in Deliverables.</small></p></div>}
      {jobType === "x_posts" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">𝕏</span><p><b>Olivia · X Drafter — Research Dept</b><small>Pulse HQ capabilities only · attraction copy as the Pulse HQ brand · 280 characters max per post · every post gets a link or a generated image · drafts land in the Post Queue with no approval step — you copy, paste, and post them yourself.</small></p></div>}
      {jobType === "market_briefing" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">S</span><p><b>Market briefing · Business intelligence</b><small>Sven gathers opportunities and market observations for the business or market you name · Tom turns them into one readable briefing with clear recommendations, in plain words. Outcome contract: brand assets are never invented — a missing one is marked as a placeholder for the client to supply · hashtags live only inside copy items that are themselves posts, never as a pack-level finisher.</small></p></div>}
      {jobType === "client_report" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">M</span><p><b>Client report · Operational reporting</b><small>Maria compiles the client's delivered work, turnaround, and results from office records · Johnny writes the summary in the standard report format · you approve it first, then it goes to the client's delivery package. Outcome contract — the strictest one: no hashtags, no social finishers, no stock imagery; a report that breaks it can't be delivered. Report guarantee: this job cannot close or be packaged without its report document — a missing report bounces it as “client report missing”. The same guarantee covers any client job whose brief includes a report. A client is required — pick one below.</small></p></div>}

When you approve the finished job, she assembles its delivery package — you decide on it in Deliverables, under Delivery packages. Perfectly Paranoid is the exception: its work is house content and never becomes a package — its posts land under To post.</small></p></div>}
      {pickedClient && jobType === "client_report" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">M</span><p><b>Maria · Front Office reporting</b><small>This report covers {pickedClient.businessName}. Maria compiles it from their office records — say the period it should cover in the instructions below. You approve it in Ready for You first; then it goes to their delivery package. It cannot close or be packaged without its report document. Perfectly Paranoid is the exception: its approved report lands in Deliverables, under Reports — no package.</small></p></div>}

      <label className="field" htmlFor="new-task-notes">{jobType === "client_report" ? "Period and instructions" : "Instructions"} <span className="field-optional">optional</span></label>
      <textarea id="new-task-notes" className="field-control field-textarea" value={notes} onChange={(event) => setNotes(event.target.value)} maxLength={5000} placeholder={jobType === "research" ? "Name the topic or question the department should run down…" : jobType === "x_posts" ? "The angle, the real facts or numbers Olivia can use, the tone…" : jobType === "perfectly_paranoid" ? "The angle, a source link, or the details Tom should work from…" : jobType === "market_briefing" ? "Name the business and the market to look at — competitors, area, what you want to know…" : jobType === "creative_package" ? "The campaign goal, who it is for, what it promotes, and any brand assets supplied…" : jobType === "client_report" ? "The period this report covers — for example, the last two weeks, or October so far…" : "Add the details Remmy needs…"} />
      {jobType === "standard" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">R</span><p><b>Outcome contract — Standard</b><small>The deliverable follows your brief exactly (a document, a pack, a list, or finished posts) · Remmy plans only the steps the brief needs · no image step unless your brief asks for an image · hashtags: documents, letters, and reports get NO hashtag finisher — but when your brief asks for finished social posts, each post DOES end with its strongest topic hashtags, and a post without them breaks the contract · no Perfectly Paranoid voice unless your brief asks for it. The finished work is checked against this contract before it reaches you.</small></p></div>}
