"Starting the package…" : jobType === "client_report" ? "Starting the report…" : "Remmy is assigning…") : jobType === "research" ? "Open research case" : jobType === "x_posts" ? "Draft posts with Olivia" : jobType === "perfectly_paranoid" ? "Start story job" : jobType === "market_briefing" ? "Start market briefing" : jobType === "creative_package" ?         {showPresetSave && <div className="preset-save-fields">

          <input id="new-task-preset-fillin" className="field-control" value={presetFillInLabel} onChange={(event) => setPresetFillInLabel(event.target.value)} maxLength={60} placeholder="e.g. Source link" />
          {presetFillInLabel.trim() && <p className="sheet-sub">Put <code>{"{{fill-in}}"}</code> in the title or instructions above, exactly where the {presetFillInLabel.trim()} should land when this preset starts.</p>}
          <button type="button" className="big-button ghost" onClick={savePreset} disabled={presetBusy || busy || !title.trim() || !(presetName.trim() || title.trim())}>{presetBusy ? "Saving preset…" : "Save preset (does not start the job)"}</button>
        </div>}
      </div>}
    </form>
  </Sheet>;
}

const PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN_TEXT = "{{fill-in}}";

function PresetSheet({ preset, onClose, onSubmit, busy }: { preset: Preset | null; onClose: () => void; onSubmit: (input: { name: string; jobType: PresetJobType; title: string; notes: string; postCount?: number; fillInLabel?: string | null }) => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(preset?.name ?? "");
  const [jobType, setJobType] = useState<PresetJobType>(preset?.jobType ?? "standard");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(preset?.title ?? "");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(preset?.notes ?? "");
  const [postCount, setPostCount] = useState(preset?.postCount ?? 3);
  const [fillInLabel, setFillInLabel] = useState(preset?.fillInLabel ?? "");
  const hasToken = title.includes(PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN_TEXT) || notes.includes(PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN_TEXT);
  const fillInProblem = fillInLabel.trim() && !hasToken
    ? `Add ${PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN_TEXT} to the job title or the brief — that is the spot the ${fillInLabel.trim()} lands in when this preset starts.`
    : !fillInLabel.trim() && hasToken
      ? `The brief uses ${PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN_TEXT}, so name the fill-in above — one value, asked for at start.`
      : null;
  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim() || !title.trim() || fillInProblem) return;
    onSubmit({ name: name.trim(), jobType, title: title.trim(), notes: notes.trim(), postCount: jobType === "x_posts" ? postCount : undefined, fillInLabel: fillInLabel.trim() ? fillInLabel.trim() : null });
  }
  function insertToken() {
    setNotes((current) => current.includes(PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN_TEXT) ? current : `${current}${current && !current.endsWith(" ") && !current.endsWith("\n") ? " " : ""}${PRESET_FILL_IN_TOKEN_TEXT}`);
  }
  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onClose} label={preset ? "Edit preset job" : "New preset job"}>
    <p className="sheet-kicker">Preset jobs</p>
    <h3>{preset ? "Edit preset" : "New preset"}</h3>
    <p className="sheet-sub">A preset is a saved job shape — it does nothing until you click Start on it in the Work panel. Starting one creates a completely normal job through the usual crew flow.</p>
    <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="preset-name">Preset name</label>
      <input id="preset-name" className="field-control" autoFocus value={name} onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)} maxLength={80} placeholder="e.g. Paranoid post from a source link" required />
      <label className="field" htmlFor="preset-type">Job type</label>
      <select id="preset-type" className="field-control" value={jobType} onChange={(event) => setJobType(event.target.value as PresetJobType)}>
        <option value="standard">Standard job — Remmy assigns the crew</option>
        <option value="research">Research — Research Department case</option>
        <option value="x_posts">X Posts — Olivia drafts for @PulseHQOffice</option>
        <option value="perfectly_paranoid">Perfectly Paranoid — story pipeline post</option>
      </select>
      {jobType === "perfectly_paranoid" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">P</span><p><b>The fixed story pipeline</b><small>Tom researches and verifies · Johnny writes in the locked voice · Nik makes the image · you decide once, at the end.</small></p></div>}
      {jobType === "research" && <div className="remmy-triage-note"><span aria-hidden="true">§</span><p><b>Research Department · Pulse HQ</b><small>Walter reads · Peter verifies · Tom writes the case brief. You decide once, at the end.</small></p></div>}
      {jobType === "x_posts" && <><label className="field" htmlFor="preset-post-count">How many posts</label><input id="preset-post-count" className="field-control" type="number" min={1} max={10} value={postCount} onChange={(event) => setPostCount(Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Number(event.target.value) || 1)))} /></>}
      <label className="field" htmlFor="preset-title">{jobType === "x_posts" ? "Topic or angle" : "Job title"}</label>
      <input id="preset-title" className="field-control" value={title} onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)} maxLength={120} required />
      <label className="field" htmlFor="preset-notes">Brief / notes</label>
      <textarea id="preset-notes" className="field-control field-textarea" value={notes} onChange={(event) => setNotes(event.target.value)} maxLength={5000} placeholder="The instructions this job starts with, every time…" />
      <label className="field" htmlFor="preset-fillin">Fill-in label <span className="field-optional">optional — at most one</span></label>

function StandingOrderCard({ order, onToggle, onDelete, onEdit, onRunNow, busy }: { order: StandingOrder; onToggle: () => void; onDelete: () => void; onEdit?: () => void; onRunNow?: () => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const hour12 = order.scheduleHour % 12 || 12;
  const time = `${hour12}:${String(order.scheduleMinute).padStart(2, "0")} ${order.scheduleHour < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
  const schedule = order.mode === "pipeline" ? `Keep ${order.targetCount ?? 1} active` : order.cadence === "weekly" ? `Weekly · ${["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"][order.weekday ?? 1]} at ${time}` : `Daily at ${time}`;
  return <article className={order.enabled ? "order-card" : "order-card is-paused"}>
    <div className="order-top"><div><b>{order.instruction}</b><span>{memberById(order.assignee)?.name ?? "Remmy"} · {schedule}</span></div><span className={order.enabled ? "order-state active" : "order-state"}>{order.enabled ? "Active" : "Paused"}</span></div>
    <div className="order-meta">{order.mode === "scheduled" && order.nextRunAt ? `Next run ${formatStamp(order.nextRunAt)} · ${order.timezone}` : order.lastRunAt ? `Last ran ${formatStamp(order.lastRunAt)}` : "Waiting for first run"}</div>
    <div className="order-actions"><button onClick={onToggle} disabled={busy}>{order.enabled ? "Pause" : "Resume"}</button>{onEdit && <button onClick={onEdit} disabled={busy}>Edit</button>}{onRunNow && <button onClick={onRunNow} disabled={busy}>Run batch now</button>}<button className="danger-link" onClick={onDelete} disabled={busy}>Delete</button></div>
  </article>;
}

function BlockerSheet({ blocker, onClose, onSubmit, onVerify, busy, submitError, onClearError }: { blocker: Blocker; onClose: () => void; onSubmit: (answer: string) => void; onVerify: () => void; busy: boolean; submitError?: string; onClearError?: () => void }) {
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
  function submit(event: FormEvent) { event.preventDefault(); if (answer.trim()) onSubmit(answer.trim()); }
  const browserAction = blocker.kind === "browser_action";
  const checkLabel = busy ? "Resuming…" : blocker.verificationStatus === "checking" ? "Resume step now" : "I've done it — resume step";
  return <Sheet onClose={busy ? () => undefined : onClose} label="Crew request">
    <p className="sheet-kicker danger-kicker">{browserAction ? "Browser action needed" : "Decision needed"}</p>
    <h3>{memberById(blocker.memberId)?.name ?? "The crew"} is waiting</h3>
    <p className="blocker-question">{blocker.question}</p>
    {blocker.retryCount > 1 && <p className="sheet-sub">This is the same gate seen {blocker.retryCount} times. It stays one request.</p>}
    {submitError ? <p className="blocker-submit-error" role="alert">{submitError}</p> : null}
    {browserAction ? <div>
      <p className="sheet-sub">Complete the action in the browser, then resume the same step here. The worker checks the gate while doing the real work and reopens this same request if it is still blocked.</p>
      {blocker.verificationStatus === "failed" && blocker.answer && <p className="blocker-question">Previous check: {blocker.answer}</p>}
      <button className="big-button amber" type="button" onClick={onVerify} disabled={busy}>{checkLabel}</button>
    </div> : <form onSubmit={submit}>
      <label className="field" htmlFor="blocker-answer">Your decision</label>
      <textarea id="blocker-answer" className="field-control field-textarea" autoFocus value={answer} onChange={(event) => { setAnswer(event.target.value); onClearError?.(); }} maxLength={5000} required />
      <p className="sheet-sub">Give a direct choice or instruction. A question keeps the blocker open.</p>
      <button className="big-button amber" disabled={busy || !answer.trim()}>{busy ? "Sending decision…" : "Send decision and resume"}</button>
    </form>}
  </Sheet>;
}

const DEFAULT_MUSIC_VOLUME = 55;
const MUSIC_GAIN_MIN = 0.24;
const MUSIC_GAIN_MAX = 1.5;
const MUSIC_VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY = "ai-office-music-volume";
const DEFAULT_AMBIENCE_VOLUME = 32;
const AMBIENCE_VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY = "ai-office-ambience-volume";

function readStoredMusicVolume(): number {
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(MUSIC_VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw === null) return DEFAULT_MUSIC_VOLUME;
    const stored = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(stored) && stored >= 0 && stored <= 100 ? stored : DEFAULT_MUSIC_VOLUME;
  } catch {
    // Desktop browsers can deny iframe storage. Volume persistence is optional,
    // so keep the office usable with the default instead of failing the render.
    return DEFAULT_MUSIC_VOLUME;
  }
}

function storeMusicVolume(volume: number): void {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(MUSIC_VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY, String(volume));
  } catch {
    // Storage may be unavailable in a sandboxed or privacy-restricted iframe.
  }
}

function musicGainFor(volume: number): number {
  const normalized = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, volume)) / 100;
  return MUSIC_GAIN_MIN + normalized * (MUSIC_GAIN_MAX - MUSIC_GAIN_MIN);
}

function readStoredAmbienceVolume(): number {
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(AMBIENCE_VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw === null) return DEFAULT_AMBIENCE_VOLUME;
    const stored = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(stored) && stored >= 0 && stored <= 100 ? stored : DEFAULT_AMBIENCE_VOLUME;
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_AMBIENCE_VOLUME;
  }
}

function storeAmbienceVolume(volume: number): void {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(AMBIENCE_VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY, String(volume));
  } catch {
    // Storage may be unavailable in a sandboxed or privacy-restricted iframe.
  }
}

function ambienceVolumeFor(volume: number): number {
  return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, volume)) / 100;
}

function dustySpeakerCurve(): Float32Array {
  const samples = 1024;
  const curve = new Float32Array(samples);
  const grit = 0.7;
  for (let index = 0; index < samples; index += 1) {
    const input = (index * 2) / (samples - 1) - 1;
    curve[index] = ((1 + grit) * input) / (1 + grit * Math.abs(input));
  }
  return curve;
}

type AgentMotion = { position: MapPoint; durationMs: number; facing: Facing; walking: boolean };
type IdleActivityKind = "chief" | "survey" | "wander" | "coffee" | "chat" | "kimChat" | "desk" | "inbox" | "stretch" | "window" | "tidy" | "phone" | "doodle" | "pace" | "snack" | "plants" | "boss" | "scurry" | "inspection";
type IdleActivity = {
  kind: IdleActivityKind;
  label: string;
  target: MapPoint;
  // Where the member turns once settled at the target, when the activity
  // has a thing to face (a plant being inspected, above all).
  facing?: Facing;
  nextChoiceAt: number;
  resumeAt?: number;
  partnerId?: MemberId;
  chatGroupId?: string;
  chatMemberIds?: MemberId[];
  chatHoldMs?: number;
  chatTopic?: string;
  scolding?: boolean;
};

type BackToWorkSequence = {
  phase: "approaching" | "scolding" | "workers-returning" | "remmy-returning";
  workerIds: Exclude<MemberId, "remmy">[];
  gatherPoint: MapPoint;
  scoldUntil?: number;
};

function deskWork(memberId: MemberId, tasks: Task[], briefs: Brief[]): { title: string; active: boolean } | undefined {
  const liveBrief = briefs.find((brief) => brief.assignee === memberId && brief.status === "in_progress");
  if (liveBrief) return { title: liveBrief.title, active: true };

  const liveTaskIds = new Set(briefs.filter((brief) => brief.status === "in_progress").map((brief) => brief.taskId));
  const task = tasks.find((item) => item.assignee === memberId && item.status === "approval" && !liveTaskIds.has(item.id))
    ?? tasks.find((item) => item.assignee === memberId && item.status === "working" && !liveTaskIds.has(item.id));
  return task ? { title: task.title, active: false } : undefined;
}

const FLOOR_WORKERS: MemberId[] = ["scout", "forge", "quill", "ledger"];

// The ONE designated seat at a member's desk (Ben, 2026-10-14): for the
// four crew workers that is the chair tile directly south of their desk
// top (FLOOR_WORKER_DESK_STATIONS) — never the desk-top tile itself, never
// an adjacent tile the pathfinder happens to substitute. Every "at desk"
// target, spawn, restored steady-state position, and at-desk check goes
// through this one function, so a member at their desk is always planted
// in exactly the same chair, facing the desk. Remmy's anchor already IS
// his chair tile (region 13, the boss chair south of his desk run).
function deskAnchorFor(memberId: MemberId): MapPoint {
  return memberId === "remmy" ? FLOOR_ANCHORS.remmyDesk : FLOOR_WORKER_DESK_STATIONS[memberId];
}

function isWorkerSpriteId(memberId: MemberId): memberId is WorkerSpriteId {
  return memberId === "scout" || memberId === "forge" || memberId === "quill" || memberId === "ledger";
}

// Explicit desk-station facing, mirroring the Research Department's
// per-station table: the desk tops (y=3) are region 0 on Ben's saved map,
// so a worker working at his desk actually stands on the chair tile
// directly south (y=4) that the pathfinder substitutes as the goal. Only
// the worker's OWN chair tile counts — standing on a neighbour's chair
// or passing along the desk row changes nothing.
function deskStationFacingFor(memberId: MemberId, position: MapPoint): Facing | undefined {
  if (!isWorkerSpriteId(memberId)) return undefined;
  const station = FLOOR_WORKER_DESK_STATIONS[memberId];
  return position.x === station.x && position.y === station.y
    ? FLOOR_WORKER_DESK_STATION_FACING[memberId]
    : undefined;
}

function indexedAnchor(points: readonly MapPoint[], index: number): MapPoint {
  return points[Math.abs(index) % points.length] ?? points[0] ?? pointForRegion(2, 0);
}

// One shared step clock for every floor routine in this file. 378ms per
// tile is a deliberate 10% slower amble than the old 340ms (speed scales
// with 1/STEP_MS, so 340 / 0.9 ≈ 378): the crew strolls now, they do not
// hurry. Enforcement sprints (scurry/boss legs) keep their own timings.
const STEP_MS = 378;
// Idle crew mostly stay where they are: after arriving somewhere (or
// finishing a chat) a member dwells for a long, varied stretch — tens of
// seconds to well over a minute — before choosing anything new. Ambient
// trips are the exception now, not the default state.
const ROUTINE_MIN_MS = 45_000;
const ROUTINE_MAX_MS = 100_000;
const INITIAL_ROUTINE_MIN_MS = 14_000;
const INITIAL_ROUTINE_MAX_MS = 28_000;
const BACK_TO_WORK_MAX_MS = 15 * 60_000;
const BACK_TO_WORK_SCOLD_MS = 2_300;
const DESK_ACTIVITY_LABELS: Record<Exclude<MemberId, "remmy">, readonly string[]> = {
  scout: ["📖 reading old reports", "🗺️ tracing a lead", "📝 comparing notes", "🔎 checking a source", "📚 reorganizing research"],
  forge: ["🔧 tinkering with a prototype", "⌨️ testing a tiny fix", "🧰 sorting spare parts", "📐 sketching a build", "🖥️ cleaning up the desktop"],
  quill: ["✍️ scribbling a headline", "🗒️ trimming a draft", "🖊️ testing punchlines", "📓 filling a margin", "⌨️ polishing a sentence"],
  ledger: ["🗂️ organizing the queue", "📊 checking the numbers", "🧾 straightening receipts", "📋 updating a checklist", "🗃️ filing loose notes"],
};
// The tile beside Kim's desk where a crew member stands to chat with her:
// (10,8), the path tile immediately east of her desk seat (9,8), facing
// west toward her. The old target (8,8) is the reception desk counter
// itself — a blocked furniture tile — and the pathfinder's only stand-in

const SVEN_FLIRT_TARGET: MapPoint = { x: 10, y: 8 };
// Weighted toward staying put: the desk is home, stationary pastimes
// (phone, doodle, window, stretch) outrank trips, and pure wandering or
// pacing — a walk with no destination worth naming — is now rare.
const WORKER_ACTIVITY_WEIGHTS: ReadonlyArray<{ kind: IdleActivityKind; weight: number }> = [
  { kind: "wander", weight: 3 },
  { kind: "desk", weight: 22 },
  { kind: "coffee", weight: 7 },
