const recentActivityLabels: string[] = [];
const recentChatTopics: string[] = [];
function variedChoice(options: readonly string[], recent: string[], recentLimit: number): string {
  const available = options.filter((option) => !recent.includes(option));
  const pool = available.length > 0 ? available : [...options];
  const choice = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)] ?? options[0] ?? "taking a break";
  recent.push(choice);
  while (recent.length > recentLimit) recent.shift();
  return choice;
}
function randomActivityLabel(kind: IdleActivityKind): string {
  return variedChoice(ACTIVITY_LABELS[kind] ?? ["taking a breather"], recentActivityLabels, 12);
}
function randomDeskLabel(memberId: Exclude<MemberId, "remmy">): string {
  return variedChoice(DESK_ACTIVITY_LABELS[memberId], recentActivityLabels, 12);
}
function randomChatTopic(kim = false): string {
  return variedChoice(kim ? KIM_CHAT_TOPICS : CHAT_TOPICS, recentChatTopics, 20);
}

type FloorMeeting = { taskId: string; title: string; participantIds: MemberId[] };
// Main-floor handoffs only involve main-floor crew. Research Department
// handoffs (Walter/Peter/Tom on a research case) animate on the research
// floor instead — see ResearchFloorLayers.
type MainHandoff = Omit<Handoff, "fromMemberId" | "toMemberId"> & { fromMemberId: MemberId; toMemberId: MemberId };

function isMainMemberId(id: string | undefined): id is MemberId {
  return id === "remmy" || id === "scout" || id === "forge" || id === "quill" || id === "ledger";
}

type FloorHandoff = {
  event: MainHandoff;
  phase: "approaching" | "holding" | "returning";
  fromTarget: MapPoint;
  toTarget: MapPoint;
  holdUntil?: number;
};

const HANDOFF_SEEN_KEY = "ai-office-seen-handoffs-v1";
const HANDOFF_RECENT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const HANDOFF_HOLD_MS = 2_400;
const GHOST_APPEARANCE_MIN_MS = 4 * 60 * 1000;
const GHOST_APPEARANCE_MAX_MS = 6 * 60 * 1000;
const GHOST_OCCUPIED_RETRY_MS = 15_000;

function isConferenceRoomPosition(point: MapPoint): boolean {
  if (regionAt(point) === 5) return true;
  // Region 5 marks the meeting positions, but the room also contains region-2
  // transit tiles. Counting the whole walkable room prevents the ghost from
  // lingering beside someone who has crossed the doorway but has not reached
  // their final meeting marker yet.
  const region = regionAt(point);
  return point.x >= 1 && point.x <= 6 && point.y >= 11 && point.y <= 14
    && region !== 0 && region !== 11;
}

function readSeenHandoffs(): Set<string> {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(HANDOFF_SEEN_KEY) ?? "[]");
    return new Set(Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string") : []);
  } catch {
    return new Set();
  }
}

function rememberHandoff(id: string): void {
  try {
    const seen = readSeenHandoffs();
    seen.add(id);
    window.localStorage.setItem(HANDOFF_SEEN_KEY, JSON.stringify(Array.from(seen).slice(-50)));
  } catch {
    // A private browser can block storage; the in-memory guard still prevents repeats in this mount.
  }
}

function meetingSeatFor(memberId: MemberId, meeting: FloorMeeting): MapPoint {
  // The first conference marker is the head-of-table position. Crew use the
  // four actual chairs, assigned by this meeting's participant order so two
  // people can never resolve to the same seat.
  const chairSpots = FLOOR_ANCHORS.meetingSpots.slice(1);
  const participantIndex = Math.max(0, meeting.participantIds.indexOf(memberId));
  return indexedAnchor(chairSpots, participantIndex);
}

function handoffMeetingTargets(event: MainHandoff, meeting: FloorMeeting | undefined): [MapPoint, MapPoint] | undefined {
  const occupied = new Set((meeting?.participantIds ?? [])
    .filter((memberId) => memberId !== event.fromMemberId && memberId !== event.toMemberId)
    .map((memberId) => {
      const seat = meeting ? meetingSeatFor(memberId, meeting) : undefined;
      return seat ? `${seat.x},${seat.y}` : "";
    })
    .filter(Boolean));
  const available = FLOOR_ANCHORS.meetingSpots.filter((spot) => !occupied.has(`${spot.x},${spot.y}`));
  if (available.length < 2) return undefined;

  const receiverIndex = Math.max(0, FLOOR_WORKERS.indexOf(event.toMemberId));
  const firstIndex = receiverIndex % available.length;
  const first = available[firstIndex] ?? available[0];
  const second = available[(firstIndex + 1) % available.length] ?? available[1];
  return first && second ? [first, second] : undefined;
}

function currentFloorMeeting(tasks: Task[], briefs: Brief[]): FloorMeeting | undefined {
  for (const task of tasks) {
    if (task.status !== "working") continue;
    if (task.pipeline === "research_case") continue;
    const taskBriefs = briefs.filter((brief) => brief.taskId === task.id);
    if (!taskBriefs.some((brief) => brief.status === "in_progress")) continue;
    const participantIds = Array.from(new Set(taskBriefs
      .map((brief) => memberById(brief.assignee)?.id)
      .filter((id): id is MemberId => Boolean(id) && isMainMemberId(id) && id !== "remmy")));
    if (participantIds.length < 2) continue;
    return { taskId: task.id, title: task.title, participantIds };
  }
  return undefined;
}

function randomDelay(minimum: number, maximum: number): number {
  return minimum + Math.floor(Math.random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
}

function randomRegionPoint(region: number): MapPoint {
  const points = REGION_TILES[region] ?? [];
  const point = points[Math.floor(Math.random() * points.length)];
  return point ?? pointForRegion(region, 0);
}

function pickWorkerActivityKind(): IdleActivityKind {
  const total = WORKER_ACTIVITY_WEIGHTS.reduce((sum, option) => sum + option.weight, 0);
  let roll = Math.random() * total;
  for (const option of WORKER_ACTIVITY_WEIGHTS) {
    roll -= option.weight;
    if (roll < 0) return option.kind;
  }
  return "wander";
}

type PlantStop = { plant: MapPoint; position: MapPoint; facing: Facing };

// Where a crew member stands to tend a plant: never on the plant tile
// itself. Region 11 paints the plant — and, for the planters that sit on
// a table, the table under it — so aiming an inspection stop at the plant
// tile put Sven standing on the table, in the plant, "checking a
// suspicious leaf". The stop is a walkable floor tile BESIDE the plant —
// an orthogonal neighbour when one exists, a diagonal only when that is
// the plant's one reachable side — and the member faces the plant while
// settled there. Kim's watering stops further down follow the same rule;
// these are the crew's version, resolved against the live region paint
// each time one is chosen, so a region edit can never strand a stop back
// on the furniture.
function plantStopFor(plant: MapPoint, from: MapPoint): PlantStop | undefined {
  const neighbours: Array<{ point: MapPoint; diagonal: boolean }> = [];
  for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy += 1) {
    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx += 1) {
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) continue;
      const point = { x: plant.x + dx, y: plant.y + dy };
      const region = regionAt(point);
      if (region === 0 || region === 11) continue;
      neighbours.push({ point, diagonal: dx !== 0 && dy !== 0 });
    }
  }
  // Orthogonal stands first; between them, the side a person naturally
  // takes — south of the plant facing up at it, then north, east, west.
  const sideRank = (point: MapPoint): number => {
    if (point.x === plant.x && point.y === plant.y + 1) return 0;
    if (point.x === plant.x && point.y === plant.y - 1) return 1;
    if (point.x === plant.x + 1 && point.y === plant.y) return 2;
    if (point.x === plant.x - 1 && point.y === plant.y) return 3;
    return 4;
  };
  neighbours.sort((left, right) => Number(left.diagonal) - Number(right.diagonal) || sideRank(left.point) - sideRank(right.point));
  const position = neighbours.find((candidate) => (
    (candidate.point.x === from.x && candidate.point.y === from.y)
    || shortestRegionPath(from, candidate.point).length > 1
  ))?.point;
  return position ? { plant, position, facing: facingForStep(position, plant) } : undefined;
}

function randomPlantStop(from: MapPoint): PlantStop | undefined {
  const stops = (REGION_TILES[11] ?? []).flatMap((plant) => {
    const stop = plantStopFor(plant, from);
    return stop ? [stop] : [];
  });
  return stops[Math.floor(Math.random() * stops.length)];
}

function soloIdleActivity(member: Member, now: number, current: MapPoint, requestedKind?: IdleActivityKind): IdleActivity {
  if (member.id === "remmy") {
    return {
      kind: "chief",
      label: "Sitting in his office chair",
      target: FLOOR_ANCHORS.remmyDesk,
      nextChoiceAt: now + ROUTINE_MAX_MS,
    };
  }

  if (member.id === "walter" || member.id === "peter" || member.id === "olivia" || member.id === "astrid" || member.id === "september" || member.id === "maria" || member.id === "ben" || member.id === "marni") {
    // Research Department and Front Office people never idle on the main
    // floor; this fallback only satisfies the type system.
    return { kind: "wander", label: "In another department", target: current, nextChoiceAt: now + ROUTINE_MAX_MS };
  }

  const kind = requestedKind === "chat" || requestedKind === "chief" || requestedKind === "survey"
    ? "wander"
    : requestedKind ?? pickWorkerActivityKind();
  const kimTopic = kind === "kimChat" ? randomChatTopic(true) : undefined;
  const label = kind === "kimChat" ? `💬 chatting with Kim about ${kimTopic ?? "the front desk"}`
    : kind === "desk" ? randomDeskLabel(member.id)
      : randomActivityLabel(kind);
  // A plant inspection stands BESIDE the plant, facing it — the stop is
  // resolved from the plant tile, never the plant tile itself.
  const plantStop = kind === "plants" ? randomPlantStop(current) : undefined;
  const target = kind === "coffee" || kind === "snack" ? randomRegionPoint(7)
    : kind === "kimChat" ? SVEN_FLIRT_TARGET
      : kind === "desk" || kind === "doodle" || kind === "phone" || kind === "tidy" ? deskAnchorFor(member.id)
        : kind === "inbox" ? FLOOR_ANCHORS.inbox
          : kind === "stretch" ? current
            : kind === "window" ? (Math.random() < 0.5 ? { x: 1, y: 6 } : { x: 3, y: 3 })
              : kind === "plants" ? (plantStop?.position ?? current)
                : randomRegionPoint(2);
  // How long the activity itself holds once chosen. These are dwells, not
  // pauses: a coffee run, a window break, or a chat with Kim occupies the
  // member for the better part of a minute, so the floor reads as people
  // being somewhere rather than passing through everywhere.
  const transientDuration = kind === "coffee" || kind === "snack" ? randomDelay(45_000, 85_000)
    : kind === "kimChat" ? randomDelay(40_000, 70_000)
      : kind === "inbox" ? randomDelay(30_000, 55_000)
        : kind === "stretch" || kind === "phone" || kind === "doodle" ? randomDelay(25_000, 50_000)
          : kind === "window" || kind === "tidy" || kind === "plants" ? randomDelay(35_000, 65_000)
            : kind === "pace" ? randomDelay(30_000, 55_000)
              : undefined;
  return {
    kind,
    label,
    target,
    facing: plantStop?.facing,
    nextChoiceAt: now + randomDelay(ROUTINE_MIN_MS, ROUTINE_MAX_MS),
    resumeAt: transientDuration === undefined ? undefined : now + transientDuration,
    chatTopic: kimTopic,
  };
}

function createInitialIdleActivities(): Record<MemberId, IdleActivity> {
  const now = Date.now();
  const starts = Object.fromEntries(MEMBERS.map((member) => [
    member.id,
    deskAnchorFor(member.id),
  ])) as Record<MemberId, MapPoint>;
  const activities = Object.fromEntries(MEMBERS.map((member) => {
    const requestedKind: IdleActivityKind = member.id === "remmy" ? "chief"
      : member.id === "quill" ? "coffee"
        : "wander";
    const activity = soloIdleActivity(member, now, starts[member.id], requestedKind);
    activity.nextChoiceAt = now + randomDelay(INITIAL_ROUTINE_MIN_MS, INITIAL_ROUTINE_MAX_MS);
    return [member.id, activity];
  })) as Record<MemberId, IdleActivity>;

  // Tom and Nik start at adjacent desks, so their opening chat starts in
  // place — a pair already standing together never walks to talk.
  if (tileDistance(starts.scout, starts.forge) === 1) {
    const chatEndsAt = now + 55_000;
    const chatTopic = randomChatTopic();
    const chatGroupId = `${now}-scout-forge`;
    activities.scout = { kind: "chat", label: "💬 chatting with Nik", chatTopic, chatGroupId, chatMemberIds: ["scout", "forge"], target: starts.scout, partnerId: "forge", resumeAt: chatEndsAt, nextChoiceAt: chatEndsAt + randomDelay(ROUTINE_MIN_MS, ROUTINE_MAX_MS) };
    activities.forge = { kind: "chat", label: "💬 chatting with Tom", chatTopic, chatGroupId, chatMemberIds: ["scout", "forge"], target: starts.forge, partnerId: "scout", resumeAt: chatEndsAt, nextChoiceAt: chatEndsAt + randomDelay(ROUTINE_MIN_MS, ROUTINE_MAX_MS) };
  }
  return activities;
}

// Tom's inter-department commute override, set by OfficeFloor during render.
// While a trip is in its departure/arrival leg on the main floor, Tom's real
// target is the front door (walking out) or his main-office desk (walking in).
let activeTomTripTarget: MapPoint | undefined;

function realFloorTarget(member: Member, tasks: Task[], briefs: Brief[], hasApproval: boolean, meeting: FloorMeeting | undefined, handoff?: FloorHandoff | null): MapPoint | undefined {
  if (member.id === "walter" || member.id === "peter" || member.id === "olivia" || member.id === "astrid" || member.id === "september" || member.id === "maria" || member.id === "ben" || member.id === "marni") return undefined;
  if (member.id === "scout" && activeTomTripTarget) return activeTomTripTarget;
  if (handoff && (member.id === handoff.event.fromMemberId || member.id === handoff.event.toMemberId)) {
    if (handoff.phase === "returning") return deskAnchorFor(member.id);
    return member.id === handoff.event.fromMemberId ? handoff.fromTarget : handoff.toTarget;
  }
  const workerIndex = Math.max(0, FLOOR_WORKERS.indexOf(member.id));
  if (member.id !== "remmy" && hasApproval) return indexedAnchor(FLOOR_ANCHORS.huddleSpots, workerIndex);
  if (meeting?.participantIds.includes(member.id)) return meetingSeatFor(member.id, meeting);
  if (deskWork(member.id, tasks, briefs)?.active) return deskAnchorFor(member.id);
  return undefined;
}

function hasRealFloorAssignment(memberId: MemberId, tasks: Task[], briefs: Brief[], hasApproval: boolean, meeting: FloorMeeting | undefined, handoff?: FloorHandoff | null): boolean {
  if (memberId === "scout" && activeTomTripTarget) return true;
  if (handoff && (memberId === handoff.event.fromMemberId || memberId === handoff.event.toMemberId)) return true;
  if (memberId !== "remmy" && hasApproval) return true;
  if (meeting?.participantIds.includes(memberId)) return true;
  if (briefs.some((brief) => brief.assignee === memberId && brief.status === "in_progress")) return true;
  return tasks.some((task) => task.assignee === memberId && task.status === "working");
}

function handoffIsLive(event: Handoff, tasks: Task[], briefs: Brief[]): boolean {
  return tasks.some((task) => task.id === event.sourceTaskId && task.status === "working")
    && briefs.some((brief) => brief.id === event.targetBriefId && brief.status === "in_progress");
}

function tileDistance(first: MapPoint, second: MapPoint): number {
  return Math.abs(first.x - second.x) + Math.abs(first.y - second.y);
}

function chatTargets(first: MapPoint, second: MapPoint, occupied: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()): [MapPoint, MapPoint] | undefined {
  const center = { x: (first.x + second.x) / 2, y: (first.y + second.y) / 2 };
  const candidates = [...CHAT_TILES].sort((left, right) => (
    Math.abs(left.x - center.x) + Math.abs(left.y - center.y)
  ) - (
    Math.abs(right.x - center.x) + Math.abs(right.y - center.y)
  ));
  const directions: readonly MapPoint[] = [{ x: 1, y: 0 }, { x: -1, y: 0 }, { x: 0, y: 1 }, { x: 0, y: -1 }];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    // Conversation spots must be free to settle on: never a tile someone
    // else is settled on or has claimed, and the two spots are always
    // two distinct adjacent tiles — never the partner's tile.
    if (occupied.has(settleTileKey(candidate))) continue;
    for (const direction of directions) {
      const neighbor = CHAT_TILE_BY_KEY.get(`${candidate.x + direction.x},${candidate.y + direction.y}`);
      if (!neighbor || occupied.has(settleTileKey(neighbor))) continue;
      const direct = tileDistance(first, candidate) + tileDistance(second, neighbor);
      const swapped = tileDistance(first, neighbor) + tileDistance(second, candidate);
      return direct <= swapped ? [candidate, neighbor] : [neighbor, candidate];
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

// A chat group only counts as gathered once everyone is actually standing
// together: face to face (distance 1) for a pair, or a tight cluster where
// nobody is more than two tiles from anyone else for a group of three.
// Standing "at my target tile" is not enough on its own — the conversation
// must never play between sprites on opposite sides of the room.
function chatPositionsGathered(positions: MapPoint[]): boolean {
  if (positions.length < 2) return false;
  const keys = new Set(positions.map((point) => `${point.x},${point.y}`));
  if (keys.size !== positions.length) return false;
  const limit = positions.length === 2 ? 1 : 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 1) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < positions.length; j += 1) {
      const first = positions[i];
      const second = positions[j];
      if (!first || !second || tileDistance(first, second) > limit) return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function chatGroupTargets(points: MapPoint[], occupied: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()): MapPoint[] | undefined {
  if (points.length === 2) {
    const first = points[0];
    const second = points[1];
    if (!first || !second) return undefined;
    return chatTargets(first, second, occupied);
  }
  if (points.length < 2) return undefined;
  const candidates = [...CHAT_TILES].filter((point) => (regionAt(point) === 2 || regionAt(point) === 4) && !occupied.has(settleTileKey(point)));
  const candidateKeys = new Set(candidates.map((point) => `${point.x},${point.y}`));
  const center = {
    x: points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.x, 0) / points.length,
    y: points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.y, 0) / points.length,
  };
  const sorted = candidates.sort((left, right) => tileDistance(left, center) - tileDistance(right, center));
  const seed = sorted[0];
  if (!seed) return undefined;
  const directions: readonly MapPoint[] = [{ x: 1, y: 0 }, { x: -1, y: 0 }, { x: 0, y: 1 }, { x: 0, y: -1 }];
  // Prefer a seed tile with enough orthogonal neighbours so the whole group
  // stands around one spot, everyone within two tiles of everyone else.
  let cluster: MapPoint[] | undefined;
  for (const candidateSeed of sorted) {
    const neighbours = directions
      .map((direction) => CHAT_TILE_BY_KEY.get(`${candidateSeed.x + direction.x},${candidateSeed.y + direction.y}`))
      .filter((point): point is MapPoint => Boolean(point) && candidateKeys.has(`${point?.x},${point?.y}`))
      .sort((left, right) => tileDistance(left, center) - tileDistance(right, center));
    if (neighbours.length >= points.length - 1) {
      cluster = [candidateSeed, ...neighbours.slice(0, points.length - 1)];
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!cluster) {
    cluster = candidates
      .filter((point) => tileDistance(point, seed) <= 2)
      .sort((left, right) => tileDistance(left, seed) - tileDistance(right, seed))
      .slice(0, points.length);
  }
  if (cluster.length !== points.length) return undefined;
  const remaining = [...cluster];
  return points.map((point) => {
    const best = remaining.sort((left, right) => tileDistance(point, left) - tileDistance(point, right))[0] ?? seed;
    const index = remaining.indexOf(best);
    if (index >= 0) remaining.splice(index, 1);
    return best;
  });
}

function backToWorkGatherPoint(workerPoints: MapPoint[], remmyPoint: MapPoint): MapPoint {
  const anchor = [...workerPoints].sort((left, right) => {
    const leftDistance = workerPoints.reduce((sum, point) => sum + tileDistance(left, point), 0);
    const rightDistance = workerPoints.reduce((sum, point) => sum + tileDistance(right, point), 0);
    return leftDistance - rightDistance;
  })[0] ?? pointForRegion(2, 0);
  const occupied = new Set(workerPoints.map((point) => `${point.x},${point.y}`));
  const candidates = [
    ...(REGION_TILES[1] ?? []),
    ...(REGION_TILES[2] ?? []),
    ...(REGION_TILES[7] ?? []),
  ].filter((point) => !occupied.has(`${point.x},${point.y}`));
  return [...candidates].sort((left, right) => {
    const leftScore = tileDistance(left, anchor) * 20 + tileDistance(left, remmyPoint);
    const rightScore = tileDistance(right, anchor) * 20 + tileDistance(right, remmyPoint);
    return leftScore - rightScore;
  })[0] ?? anchor;
}

function backToWorkActivity(kind: "boss" | "scurry", label: string, target: MapPoint, now: number, scolding = false): IdleActivity {
  return {
    kind,
    label,
    target,
    scolding,
    nextChoiceAt: now + BACK_TO_WORK_MAX_MS,
  };
}

function facingForStep(from: MapPoint, to: MapPoint): Facing {
  if (to.x > from.x) return "right";
  if (to.x < from.x) return "left";
  if (to.y < from.y) return "up";
  return "down";
}

type SecretaryPhase = "desk" | "walking" | "activity" | "returning";
type SecretaryActivityKind = "desk" | "watering" | "coffee" | "window" | "tidying" | "mail" | "conference" | "lap";
type SecretaryWateringStop = { plant: MapPoint; position: MapPoint; facing: Facing };

const SECRETARY_ROUTE_REGIONS = [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10] as const;
const SECRETARY_WATERING_STOPS: readonly SecretaryWateringStop[] = (REGION_TILES[11] ?? []).flatMap((plant) => {
  const candidates: MapPoint[] = [];
  for (let yOffset = -1; yOffset <= 1; yOffset += 1) {
    for (let xOffset = -1; xOffset <= 1; xOffset += 1) {
      if (xOffset === 0 && yOffset === 0) continue;
      const candidate = { x: plant.x + xOffset, y: plant.y + yOffset };
      const candidateRegion = regionAt(candidate);
      if (candidateRegion === 0 || candidateRegion === 11) continue;
      if (shortestRegionPath(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, candidate, SECRETARY_ROUTE_REGIONS).length > 1) candidates.push(candidate);
    }
  }
  const position = candidates.sort((left, right) => (
    shortestRegionPath(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, left, SECRETARY_ROUTE_REGIONS).length
    - shortestRegionPath(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, right, SECRETARY_ROUTE_REGIONS).length
  ))[0];
  if (!position) return [];
  return [{ plant, position, facing: facingForStep(position, plant) }];
});
const SECRETARY_FIRST_TRIP_MS = 25_000;
const SECRETARY_TRIP_MIN_MS = 65_000;
const SECRETARY_TRIP_MAX_MS = 115_000;
const SECRETARY_ACTIVITY_MIN_MS = 14_000;
const SECRETARY_ACTIVITY_MAX_MS = 26_000;
const SECRETARY_DESK_ACTIVITIES = [
  "Tending her FarmVille crops", "Checking Facebook", "Watching a suspiciously specific TikTok", "Adding a tiny sticker to her planner",
  "Color-coding the office pens", "Doodling hearts on a sticky note", "Answering the front desk phone", "Sorting today's deliveries",
  "Updating the visitor log", "Rewriting a sticky note more neatly", "Checking the office calendar", "Filing a stack of forms",
  "Making a tiny to-do list", "Choosing tomorrow's planner sticker", "Untangling the phone cord", "Reading the group chat",
  "Labeling a mystery key", "Polishing the reception bell", "Counting the good pens", "Checking a delivery window",
  "Folding a note into a perfect square", "Organizing the lost-and-found drawer", "Looking up a plant-care tip", "Updating the birthday calendar",
  "Ranking everyone's coffee mugs", "Quietly judging the inbox", "Testing three different highlighters", "Writing down a harmless rumor",
  "Straightening the business cards", "Checking whether anyone noticed the ghost",
] as const;
const SECRETARY_TRIP_ACTIVITIES: ReadonlyArray<{ kind: SecretaryActivityKind; label: string; target: MapPoint; facing: Facing }> = [
  { kind: "coffee", label: "Making tea in the kitchen", target: FLOOR_ANCHORS.kitchen, facing: "up" },
  { kind: "coffee", label: "Refilling her coffee", target: { x: 10, y: 13 }, facing: "up" },
  { kind: "window", label: "Looking out the front window", target: { x: 1, y: 6 }, facing: "left" },
  { kind: "window", label: "Checking the weather", target: { x: 3, y: 3 }, facing: "up" },
  { kind: "tidying", label: "Straightening the lounge chairs", target: { x: 18, y: 14 }, facing: "down" },
  { kind: "tidying", label: "Tidying the conference room", target: { x: 3, y: 14 }, facing: "up" },
  { kind: "mail", label: "Checking the office inbox", target: FLOOR_ANCHORS.inbox, facing: "up" },
  { kind: "conference", label: "Setting out the meeting chairs", target: { x: 4, y: 14 }, facing: "up" },
  { kind: "lap", label: "Taking a quick office lap", target: { x: 12, y: 8 }, facing: "right" },
  { kind: "lap", label: "Checking in on the break room", target: FLOOR_ANCHORS.breakRoom, facing: "down" },
];

function pickSecretaryDeskActivity(current?: string): string {
  const alternatives = SECRETARY_DESK_ACTIVITIES.filter((label) => label !== current);
  return variedChoice(alternatives.length > 0 ? alternatives : SECRETARY_DESK_ACTIVITIES, recentActivityLabels, 12);
}

// The current settle target of each non-crew regular on the main floor,
// so crew settling can treat those tiles as claimed (and vice versa via
// the occupancy getter the floor passes into each routine).
let activeKimTarget: MapPoint | undefined;
let activeChunkTarget: MapPoint | undefined;
let activeCeoMainTarget: MapPoint | undefined;

type MainOccupancyGetter = (exclude: MemberId | "kim" | "chunk" | "ben") => Set<string>;

// Kim's trips end at fixed stations and plant stops that the crew also
// settle on. Her actual stop is resolved against whoever is already
// settled (or has claimed a tile): the station when free, the nearest
// reachable free tile beside it when not, and no trip at all when
// nothing near the station is free — she waits at her desk instead of
// stacking on someone.
function resolveSecretaryStop(target: MapPoint, getOccupied: MainOccupancyGetter | undefined): MapPoint | undefined {
  if (!getOccupied) return target;
  const occupied = getOccupied("kim");
  if (!occupied.has(settleTileKey(target))) return target;
  const candidates = [...SETTLE_TILES]
    .filter((candidate) => tileDistance(candidate, target) >= 1 && tileDistance(candidate, target) <= 4)
    .filter((candidate) => !occupied.has(settleTileKey(candidate)))
    .filter((candidate) => shortestRegionPath(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, candidate, SECRETARY_ROUTE_REGIONS).length > 1)
    .sort((left, right) => tileDistance(left, target) - tileDistance(right, target));
  return candidates[0];
}

function useSecretaryRoutine(prefersReducedMotion: boolean, conferenceReserved: boolean, getOccupiedTiles?: MainOccupancyGetter): { motion: AgentMotion; phase: SecretaryPhase; label: string; activityKind: SecretaryActivityKind } {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<SecretaryPhase>("desk");
  const [label, setLabel] = useState<string>(() => pickSecretaryDeskActivity());
  const [activityKind, setActivityKind] = useState<SecretaryActivityKind>("desk");
  const [motion, setMotion] = useState<AgentMotion>({
    position: FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk,
    durationMs: STEP_MS,
    facing: "up",
    walking: false,
  });
  const positionRef = useRef<MapPoint>(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk);
  const occupiedGetterRef = useRef(getOccupiedTiles);
  occupiedGetterRef.current = getOccupiedTiles;

  // Steady state: Kim resumes where she actually was — her saved tile,
  // phase, and activity — instead of respawning at the front desk. A saved
  // desk phase (or a saved spot on her desk tile) snaps to her one desk
  // seat; a mid-errand phase resumes at the errand spot and her routine
  // carries on from there.
  const kimPresence = useCrewPresence();
  const kimRestoredRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!kimPresence.ready || kimRestoredRef.current) return;
    kimRestoredRef.current = true;
    const record = kimPresence.records.get("main:kim");
    if (!record) return;
    const savedPhase = (["desk", "walking", "activity", "returning"] as const).find((value) => value === record.phase);
    const savedKind = (["desk", "watering", "coffee", "window", "tidying", "mail", "conference", "lap"] as const).find((value) => value === record.extra.activityKind);
    const atDesk = savedPhase === "desk" || savedKind === "desk";
    const position = atDesk ? FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk : { x: record.x, y: record.y };
    positionRef.current = position;
    setMotion({ position, durationMs: 0, facing: atDesk ? "up" : record.facing, walking: false });
    if (savedPhase) setPhase(savedPhase === "walking" || savedPhase === "returning" ? "activity" : savedPhase);
    if (savedKind) setActivityKind(savedKind);
    if (record.label) setLabel(record.label);
  }, [kimPresence.ready, kimPresence.records]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!kimPresence.ready) return;
    saveCrewPresence({
      memberKey: "main:kim", floor: "main",
      x: motion.position.x, y: motion.position.y, facing: motion.facing,
      label, phase, extra: { activityKind },
    });
  }, [kimPresence.ready, motion.position, motion.facing, label, phase, activityKind]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timers: number[] = [];
    let cancelled = false;
    let nextPlantIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.max(1, SECRETARY_WATERING_STOPS.length));
    const later = (callback: () => void, delay: number) => {
      const timer = window.setTimeout(callback, delay);
      timers.push(timer);
    };

    const moveTo = (target: MapPoint, finalFacing: Facing | undefined, onArrival: () => void) => {
      const path = shortestRegionPath(positionRef.current, target, SECRETARY_ROUTE_REGIONS).slice(1);
      if (path.length === 0) {
        setMotion((previous) => ({ ...previous, facing: finalFacing ?? previous.facing, walking: false }));
        onArrival();
        return;
      }
      path.forEach((waypoint, index) => {
        later(() => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          const previousPoint = positionRef.current;
          positionRef.current = waypoint;
          setMotion({
            position: waypoint,
            durationMs: STEP_MS,
            facing: facingForStep(previousPoint, waypoint),
            walking: true,
          });
        }, index * STEP_MS);
      });
      later(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setMotion((previous) => ({ ...previous, facing: finalFacing ?? previous.facing, walking: false }));
        onArrival();
      }, path.length * STEP_MS + 40);
    };

    const scheduleTrip = (delay: number) => {
      later(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const chooseWatering = SECRETARY_WATERING_STOPS.length > 0 && Math.random() < 0.34;
        const wateringStop = chooseWatering ? SECRETARY_WATERING_STOPS[nextPlantIndex % SECRETARY_WATERING_STOPS.length] : undefined;
        if (wateringStop) nextPlantIndex += 1;
        const trip = wateringStop
          ? { kind: "watering" as const, label: variedChoice([
            "Watering the lobby plants", "Checking the big fern", "Giving the window plant a drink", "Mist-spraying the tropical plants",
            "Rotating a plant toward the light", "Inspecting a suspicious leaf", "Making the plant rounds", "Rescuing a droopy plant",
          ], recentActivityLabels, 12), target: wateringStop.position, facing: wateringStop.facing }
          : SECRETARY_TRIP_ACTIVITIES[Math.floor(Math.random() * SECRETARY_TRIP_ACTIVITIES.length)];
        if (!trip) {
          scheduleTrip(randomDelay(SECRETARY_TRIP_MIN_MS, SECRETARY_TRIP_MAX_MS));
          return;
        }
        // The trip's stop must be free to settle on: if a crew member is
        // already settled at the station (or the plant stop), Kim takes
        // the free tile beside it; if nothing nearby is free, she skips
        // this trip and stays at her desk rather than stacking.
        const stop = resolveSecretaryStop(trip.target, occupiedGetterRef.current);
        if (!stop) {
          scheduleTrip(randomDelay(SECRETARY_TRIP_MIN_MS, SECRETARY_TRIP_MAX_MS));
          return;
        }
        const resolvedTrip = { ...trip, target: stop };
        activeKimTarget = stop;
        setActivityKind(resolvedTrip.kind);
        setLabel(resolvedTrip.label);
        setPhase("walking");
        moveTo(resolvedTrip.target, resolvedTrip.facing, () => {
          // Arrival re-check: someone may have settled on her stop while
          // she walked. If so she steps to a free tile beside it (or
          // heads back to her desk) — she never settles on top of them.
          const getter = occupiedGetterRef.current;
          if (getter && getter("kim").has(settleTileKey(resolvedTrip.target))) {
            const beside = resolveSecretaryStop(resolvedTrip.target, getter);
            if (beside && (beside.x !== resolvedTrip.target.x || beside.y !== resolvedTrip.target.y)) {
              activeKimTarget = beside;
              moveTo(beside, resolvedTrip.facing, () => {
                setPhase("activity");
                later(() => {
                  if (cancelled) return;
                  setPhase("returning");
                  setLabel("Returning to the front desk");
                  activeKimTarget = undefined;
                  moveTo(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, "up", () => {
                    setActivityKind("desk");
                    setLabel(pickSecretaryDeskActivity());
                    setPhase("desk");
                    scheduleTrip(randomDelay(SECRETARY_TRIP_MIN_MS, SECRETARY_TRIP_MAX_MS));
                  });
                }, randomDelay(SECRETARY_ACTIVITY_MIN_MS, SECRETARY_ACTIVITY_MAX_MS));
              });
              return;
            }
            setPhase("returning");
            setLabel("Returning to the front desk");
            activeKimTarget = undefined;
            moveTo(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, "up", () => {
              setActivityKind("desk");
              setLabel(pickSecretaryDeskActivity());
              setPhase("desk");
              scheduleTrip(randomDelay(SECRETARY_TRIP_MIN_MS, SECRETARY_TRIP_MAX_MS));
            });
            return;
          }
          setPhase("activity");
          later(() => {
            if (cancelled) return;
            setPhase("returning");
            setLabel("Returning to the front desk");
            activeKimTarget = undefined;
            moveTo(FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, "up", () => {
              setActivityKind("desk");
              setLabel(pickSecretaryDeskActivity());
              setPhase("desk");
              scheduleTrip(randomDelay(SECRETARY_TRIP_MIN_MS, SECRETARY_TRIP_MAX_MS));
            });
          }, randomDelay(SECRETARY_ACTIVITY_MIN_MS, SECRETARY_ACTIVITY_MAX_MS));
        });
      }, delay);
    };

    if (prefersReducedMotion || conferenceReserved) {
      positionRef.current = FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk;
      setPhase("desk");
      setActivityKind("desk");
      setLabel(conferenceReserved ? "Holding the conference room for the crew" : pickSecretaryDeskActivity());
      setMotion({ position: FLOOR_ANCHORS.secretaryDesk, durationMs: 0, facing: "up", walking: false });
    } else {
      scheduleTrip(SECRETARY_FIRST_TRIP_MS);
    }

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      activeKimTarget = undefined;
      timers.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
    };
  }, [prefersReducedMotion, conferenceReserved]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== "desk" || conferenceReserved) return;
    let timeoutId: number | undefined;
    const chooseActivity = () => {
      setLabel((current) => pickSecretaryDeskActivity(current));
      timeoutId = window.setTimeout(chooseActivity, randomDelay(8_000, 16_000));
    };
    timeoutId = window.setTimeout(chooseActivity, randomDelay(5_000, 10_000));
    return () => {
      if (timeoutId !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [phase, conferenceReserved]);

  return { motion, phase, label, activityKind };
}

// Ben, the CEO, does the rounds now. He lives in his Front Office corner
// office, tours the Front Office stations, and periodically travels to the
// main floor and the Research lab for an unannounced stop — one Ben, one
// place at a time. The machine below owns where he is; each floor renders
// him only while its stop is active.
type CeoStop = "front-office" | "front-tour" | "front-leaving" | "front-entering" | "main" | "research";
type CeoVisitPhase = "away" | "entering" | "inspecting" | "leaving";
type CeoVisit = { visible: boolean; phase: CeoVisitPhase; motion: AgentMotion };
const CEO_INSPECTION_POINT: MapPoint = { x: 12, y: 6 };

function useCeoMainVisit(prefersReducedMotion: boolean, active: boolean, onFinished: () => void, getOccupiedTiles?: MainOccupancyGetter): CeoVisit {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<CeoVisitPhase>("away");
  const [motion, setMotion] = useState<AgentMotion>({
    position: FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor,
    durationMs: STEP_MS,
    facing: "right",
    walking: false,
  });
  const finishedRef = useRef(onFinished);
  finishedRef.current = onFinished;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) {
      setVisible(false);
      setPhase("away");
      return;
    }
    const timers: number[] = [];
    let cancelled = false;
    const later = (callback: () => void, delay: number) => {
      const timer = window.setTimeout(callback, delay);
      timers.push(timer);
    };
    const walk = (from: MapPoint, to: MapPoint, finalFacing: Facing, onArrival: () => void) => {
      const path = shortestRegionPath(from, to).slice(1);
      if (prefersReducedMotion || path.length === 0) {
        setMotion({ position: to, durationMs: 0, facing: finalFacing, walking: false });
        onArrival();
        return;
      }
      path.forEach((waypoint, index) => {
        later(() => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          const previous = index === 0 ? from : path[index - 1] ?? from;
          setMotion({ position: waypoint, durationMs: STEP_MS, facing: facingForStep(previous, waypoint), walking: true });
        }, index * STEP_MS);
      });
      later(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setMotion({ position: to, durationMs: STEP_MS, facing: finalFacing, walking: false });
        onArrival();
      }, path.length * STEP_MS + 40);
    };

    // Ben's inspection stop is resolved like anyone's settle tile: if a
    // crew member is already settled there, he inspects from the free
    // tile beside them instead of standing on them.
    const occupied = getOccupiedTiles ? getOccupiedTiles("ben") : new Set<string>();
    const inspectionPoint = occupied.has(settleTileKey(CEO_INSPECTION_POINT))
      ? nearestFreeSettleTile(CEO_INSPECTION_POINT, occupied, SETTLE_TILES, 4) ?? FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor
      : CEO_INSPECTION_POINT;
    activeCeoMainTarget = inspectionPoint;
    setVisible(true);
    setPhase("entering");
    setMotion({ position: FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor, durationMs: STEP_MS, facing: "right", walking: false });
    walk(FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor, inspectionPoint, "down", () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      setPhase("inspecting");
      later(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setPhase("leaving");
        activeCeoMainTarget = undefined;
        walk(inspectionPoint, FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor, "left", () => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setVisible(false);
          setPhase("away");
          finishedRef.current();
        });
      }, randomDelay(9_000, 14_000));
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      activeCeoMainTarget = undefined;
      timers.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
    };
  }, [active, prefersReducedMotion]);

  return { visible, phase, motion };
}

type ChunkPhase = "patrolling" | "checking" | "returning" | "to-keyboard" | "sitting-keyboard" | "leaving-keyboard";
type ChunkReaction = "…" | "💢" | "💛";
// One crew member Chunk could currently bother: seated in their own desk
// chair, not walking, and working at that desk. Computed by the floor each
// render (its motion/activity state lives there); the signature captures
// the member's work state, so any change to it mid-sit ends the sit.
type ChunkKeyboardTarget = { memberId: MemberId; name: string; deskTile: MapPoint; chairTile: MapPoint; signature: string };
type ChunkRoutine = {
  phase: ChunkPhase;
  motion: AgentMotion;
  label: string;
  keyboardTargetId?: MemberId;
  reaction?: ChunkReaction;
  reactionKey: number;
  shadesOn: boolean;
  onDesk: boolean;
};
const CHUNK_HOME: MapPoint = { x: 19, y: 13 };
const CHUNK_CHECK_HOLD_MS = 5_000;
// Chunk's keyboard visits (Ben, 2026-10-16): purely ambient. He considers
// one only when his random gate opens — the first gate opens a little
// sooner so the behaviour is discoverable, later gates keep sits a couple
// of minutes apart at most, and a finished sit always starts a full
// cooldown, so sits never run back-to-back. A sit lasts 20–45s; the
// worker's reaction rotates every few seconds, and the moment the mad
// reaction (💢) appears Chunk gets his sunglasses for the rest of the
// sit — never before it, never without it.
const CHUNK_KEYBOARD_FIRST_MIN_MS = 30_000;
const CHUNK_KEYBOARD_FIRST_MAX_MS = 55_000;
const CHUNK_KEYBOARD_COOLDOWN_MIN_MS = 110_000;
const CHUNK_KEYBOARD_COOLDOWN_MAX_MS = 175_000;
const CHUNK_KEYBOARD_RETRY_MIN_MS = 6_000;
const CHUNK_KEYBOARD_RETRY_MAX_MS = 10_000;
// While a keyboard visit is due but nobody is seated at a desk yet, Chunk
// loiters: his patrol legs stay in the desk-row corridor (region-2 tiles
// at y 3–6) with short rests, so he re-checks for a target every few
// seconds instead of only once per long patrol cycle. Desk stints last
// tens of seconds, so a circling cat reliably catches one — and a cat
// circling the desks before pouncing reads as intent, not machinery.
const CHUNK_LOITER_REST_MIN_MS = 4_000;
const CHUNK_LOITER_REST_MAX_MS = 7_000;
const CHUNK_SIT_MIN_MS = 20_000;
const CHUNK_SIT_MAX_MS = 45_000;
const CHUNK_REACTION_FIRST_MIN_MS = 1_400;
const CHUNK_REACTION_FIRST_MAX_MS = 2_400;
const CHUNK_REACTION_MIN_MS = 4_000;
const CHUNK_REACTION_MAX_MS = 6_500;
const CHUNK_HOP_MS = 300;

// The tile Chunk stands on to hop onto a desk: a walkable tile beside the
// desk tile (never the worker's own chair, never a plant or blocked tile),
// preferring plain path tiles and an orthogonal hop over a diagonal one,
// then the shortest walk from where Chunk is now.
function chunkKeyboardApproach(from: MapPoint, deskTile: MapPoint, occupied: ReadonlySet<string>): MapPoint | undefined {
  const neighbours: MapPoint[] = [
    { x: deskTile.x - 1, y: deskTile.y }, { x: deskTile.x + 1, y: deskTile.y },
    { x: deskTile.x, y: deskTile.y - 1 }, { x: deskTile.x, y: deskTile.y + 1 },
    { x: deskTile.x - 1, y: deskTile.y + 1 }, { x: deskTile.x + 1, y: deskTile.y + 1 },
    { x: deskTile.x - 1, y: deskTile.y - 1 }, { x: deskTile.x + 1, y: deskTile.y - 1 },
  ];
  const regionRank = (point: MapPoint): number => {
    const region = regionAt(point);
    return region === 2 ? 0 : region === 1 ? 1 : region === 4 ? 2 : region === 3 ? 3 : 4;
  };
  return neighbours
    .filter((point) => {
      const region = regionAt(point);
      return region !== 0 && region !== 11 && !occupied.has(settleTileKey(point));
    })
    .sort((left, right) => regionRank(left) - regionRank(right)
      || (Math.abs(left.x - deskTile.x) + Math.abs(left.y - deskTile.y)) - (Math.abs(right.x - deskTile.x) + Math.abs(right.y - deskTile.y))
      || shortestRegionPath(from, left).length - shortestRegionPath(from, right).length)[0];
}
// After each patrol leg Chunk settles where he stopped for a while
// instead of instantly setting off again — a watchdog resting between
// rounds, not a roomba. A watchdog check still preempts the rest.
const CHUNK_REST_MIN_MS = 10_000;
const CHUNK_REST_MAX_MS = 22_000;
const CHUNK_HUDDLE_PATROL: readonly MapPoint[] = [
  CHUNK_HOME, { x: 17, y: 13 }, { x: 20, y: 13 }, { x: 17, y: 12 }, { x: 20, y: 12 }, { x: 18, y: 11 },
];

const KB_FIRST_MIN_MS = CHUNK_KEYBOARD_FIRST_MIN_MS;
const KB_FIRST_MAX_MS = CHUNK_KEYBOARD_FIRST_MAX_MS;
const KB_COOLDOWN_MIN_MS = CHUNK_KEYBOARD_COOLDOWN_MIN_MS;
const KB_COOLDOWN_MAX_MS = CHUNK_KEYBOARD_COOLDOWN_MAX_MS;
const KB_RETRY_MIN_MS = CHUNK_KEYBOARD_RETRY_MIN_MS;
const KB_RETRY_MAX_MS = CHUNK_KEYBOARD_RETRY_MAX_MS;
const KB_SIT_MIN_MS = CHUNK_SIT_MIN_MS;
const KB_SIT_MAX_MS = CHUNK_SIT_MAX_MS;
const KB_REST_MIN_MS = CHUNK_REST_MIN_MS;
const KB_REST_MAX_MS = CHUNK_REST_MAX_MS;
const KB_LOITER_REST_MIN_MS = CHUNK_LOITER_REST_MIN_MS;
const KB_LOITER_REST_MAX_MS = CHUNK_LOITER_REST_MAX_MS;

function useChunkRoutine(prefersReducedMotion: boolean, watchdogEvent?: WatchdogEvent, getOccupiedTiles?: MainOccupancyGetter, getKeyboardTargets?: () => ChunkKeyboardTarget[]): ChunkRoutine {
  const handledEvents = useRef(new Set<number>());
  const positionRef = useRef<MapPoint>(CHUNK_HOME);
  const [patrolCycle, setPatrolCycle] = useState(0);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<ChunkPhase>("patrolling");
  const [label, setLabel] = useState("Patrolling from the huddle area");
  const [motion, setMotion] = useState<AgentMotion>({ position: CHUNK_HOME, durationMs: STEP_MS, facing: "left", walking: true });
  const [keyboardTargetId, setKeyboardTargetId] = useState<MemberId | undefined>(undefined);
  const [reaction, setReaction] = useState<ChunkReaction | undefined>(undefined);
  const [reactionKey, setReactionKey] = useState(0);
  const [shadesOn, setShadesOn] = useState(false);
  const [onDesk, setOnDesk] = useState(false);
  // The keyboard-visit gate runs on a plain timer — the same clock that
  // drives Chunk's legs — never on a Date.now() deadline. A setTimeout
  // gate tracks the same delays as the rest of his routine.
  const gateOpenRef = useRef(false);
  const gateSoonRef = useRef(true);
  const gateTimerRef = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);
  const armGate = useCallback((delayMs: number, soon: boolean) => {
    if (gateTimerRef.current !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(gateTimerRef.current);
    gateSoonRef.current = soon;
    gateTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      gateTimerRef.current = undefined;
      gateSoonRef.current = false;
      gateOpenRef.current = true;
    }, delayMs);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    armGate(randomDelay(KB_FIRST_MIN_MS, KB_FIRST_MAX_MS), true);
    return () => {
      if (gateTimerRef.current !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(gateTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, [armGate]);
  const keyboardTargetsRef = useRef(getKeyboardTargets);
  keyboardTargetsRef.current = getKeyboardTargets;
  const occupiedGetterRef = useRef(getOccupiedTiles);
  occupiedGetterRef.current = getOccupiedTiles;

  // Steady state: Chunk resumes on the patrol tile he was last resting
  // on, with his saved phase and label, instead of respawning at his home
  // tile. A saved watchdog check is transient — he resumes patrolling.
  const chunkPresence = useCrewPresence();
  const chunkRestoredRef = useRef(false);
  const chunkResumeRestUntilRef = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!chunkPresence.ready || chunkRestoredRef.current) return;
    chunkRestoredRef.current = true;
    const record = chunkPresence.records.get("main:chunk");
    if (!record) return;
    const position = { x: record.x, y: record.y };
    positionRef.current = position;
    setMotion({ position, durationMs: 0, facing: record.facing, walking: false });
    setPhase(record.phase === "returning" ? "returning" : "patrolling");
    if (record.label) setLabel(record.label);
    // He was resting when the floor closed: the rest resumes too, so he
    // does not set off on a new leg the instant the floor reopens.
    chunkResumeRestUntilRef.current = Date.now() + Math.min(Math.max(presenceNumber(record.extra.restRemainMs, CHUNK_REST_MIN_MS), 3_000), CHUNK_REST_MAX_MS);
  }, [chunkPresence.ready, chunkPresence.records]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!chunkPresence.ready) return;
    // A keyboard visit is transient cosmetic flavour: never persisted, so
    // a reload mid-sit resumes Chunk from his last patrol spot instead of
    // stranding him on someone's desk tile.
    if (phase === "to-keyboard" || phase === "sitting-keyboard" || phase === "leaving-keyboard") return;
    saveCrewPresence({
      memberKey: "main:chunk", floor: "main",
      x: motion.position.x, y: motion.position.y, facing: motion.facing,
      label, phase, extra: { restRemainMs: motion.walking ? 0 : CHUNK_REST_MIN_MS },
    });
  }, [chunkPresence.ready, motion.position, motion.facing, label, phase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timers: number[] = [];
    let cancelled = false;
    const later = (callback: () => void, delay: number) => {
      const timer = window.setTimeout(callback, delay);
      timers.push(timer);
    };
    const walk = (target: MapPoint, finalFacing: Facing, onArrival: () => void) => {
      const start = positionRef.current;
      const path = shortestRegionPath(start, target).slice(1);
      if (prefersReducedMotion || path.length === 0) {
        positionRef.current = target;
        setMotion({ position: target, durationMs: 0, facing: finalFacing, walking: !prefersReducedMotion });
        later(onArrival, prefersReducedMotion ? 400 : 40);
        return;
      }
      path.forEach((waypoint, index) => {
        later(() => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          const previous = positionRef.current;
          positionRef.current = waypoint;
          setMotion({ position: waypoint, durationMs: STEP_MS, facing: facingForStep(previous, waypoint), walking: true });
        }, index * STEP_MS);
      });
      later(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setMotion((previous) => ({ ...previous, position: target, facing: finalFacing, walking: true }));
        onArrival();
      }, path.length * STEP_MS + 40);
    };

    const gateCheck = (): boolean => gateOpenRef.current;

    // One keyboard visit, when the random gate is open and a crew member
    // is seated working at their desk. Returns false (and quietly re-arms
    // the gate a little later) when nobody qualifies right now, so the
    // caller falls through to an ordinary patrol leg.
    const startKeyboardVisit = (): boolean => {
      const candidates = keyboardTargetsRef.current?.() ?? [];
      const occupied = occupiedGetterRef.current ? occupiedGetterRef.current("chunk") : new Set<string>();
      const target = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
      const approachTile = target ? chunkKeyboardApproach(positionRef.current, target.deskTile, occupied) : undefined;
      if (!target || !approachTile) {
        gateOpenRef.current = false;
        armGate(randomDelay(KB_RETRY_MIN_MS, KB_RETRY_MAX_MS), true);
        return false;
      }
      const deskTile = target.deskTile;
      setPhase("to-keyboard");
      setLabel(`Sneaking over to ${target.name}'s keyboard`);
      setKeyboardTargetId(target.memberId);
      setReaction(undefined);
      setShadesOn(false);
      setOnDesk(false);
      activeChunkTarget = approachTile;
      walk(approachTile, facingForStep(approachTile, deskTile), () => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        // Arrival re-check: the worker may have stood up while Chunk was
        // crossing the room. No hop onto an empty (or changed) desk.
        const current = (keyboardTargetsRef.current?.() ?? []).find((candidate) => candidate.memberId === target.memberId);
        if (!current || current.signature !== target.signature) {
          gateOpenRef.current = false;
          armGate(randomDelay(KB_RETRY_MIN_MS, KB_RETRY_MAX_MS), true);
          setKeyboardTargetId(undefined);
          activeChunkTarget = undefined;
          setPhase("patrolling");
          setLabel("Patrolling from the huddle area");
          setPatrolCycle((value) => value + 1);
          return;
        }
        // The hop: one step from the tile beside the desk up onto the
        // desk tile itself, in front of the worker, facing them.
        positionRef.current = deskTile;
        setMotion({ position: deskTile, durationMs: CHUNK_HOP_MS, facing: "down", walking: false });
        setOnDesk(true);
        setPhase("sitting-keyboard");
        setLabel(`Sitting on ${target.name}'s keyboard`);
        activeChunkTarget = deskTile;
        const sitMs = randomDelay(KB_SIT_MIN_MS, KB_SIT_MAX_MS);
        const sitEndsAt = Date.now() + sitMs;
        let sitEnded = false;
        let reactionsShown = 0;
        let madShown = false;
        let lastReaction: ChunkReaction | undefined;
        const endSit = (_reason = "sit-elapsed") => { void _reason;
          if (sitEnded) return;
          sitEnded = true;
          // The sit is over: the reaction bubble goes, and so do the
          // shades — they only ever live for the rest of a sit.
          setReaction(undefined);
          setShadesOn(false);
          setPhase("leaving-keyboard");
          setLabel(`Hopping down from ${target.name}'s desk`);
          const occupiedDown = occupiedGetterRef.current ? occupiedGetterRef.current("chunk") : new Set<string>();
          const landing = chunkKeyboardApproach(positionRef.current, deskTile, occupiedDown) ?? approachTile;
          positionRef.current = landing;
          setMotion({ position: landing, durationMs: CHUNK_HOP_MS, facing: "down", walking: false });
          setOnDesk(false);
          activeChunkTarget = undefined;
          later(() => {
            if (cancelled) return;
            setKeyboardTargetId(undefined);
            gateOpenRef.current = false;
            armGate(randomDelay(KB_COOLDOWN_MIN_MS, KB_COOLDOWN_MAX_MS), false);
            setPhase("patrolling");
            setLabel("Patrolling from the huddle area");
            setPatrolCycle((value) => value + 1);
          }, CHUNK_HOP_MS + 80);
        };
        const scheduleReaction = (delay: number) => {
          later(() => {
            if (cancelled || sitEnded) return;
            const remaining = sitEndsAt - Date.now();
            if (remaining <= 2_500) return;
            let emote: ChunkReaction;
            // The mad reaction is guaranteed a slot in every sit (mid-sit
            // at the latest); the rest of the rotation is weighted —
            // mostly put-upon silence, the 💢, and occasionally a fond 💛.
            if (!madShown && (reactionsShown >= 2 || remaining < sitMs * 0.45)) {
              emote = "💢";
            } else {
              const roll = Math.random();
              emote = roll < 0.42 ? "…" : roll < 0.78 ? "💢" : "💛";
              if (emote === lastReaction) emote = emote === "…" ? "💢" : "…";
            }
            lastReaction = emote;
            reactionsShown += 1;
            setReaction(emote);
            setReactionKey((value) => value + 1);
            // Meme timing, exact: the shades drop in the same state
            // update as the first 💢 — never before it, never without it,
            // and they stay on for the rest of the sit.
            if (emote === "💢" && !madShown) {
              madShown = true;
              setShadesOn(true);
            }
            scheduleReaction(randomDelay(CHUNK_REACTION_MIN_MS, CHUNK_REACTION_MAX_MS));
          }, delay);
        };
        scheduleReaction(randomDelay(CHUNK_REACTION_FIRST_MIN_MS, CHUNK_REACTION_FIRST_MAX_MS));
        // Standing-watch: if the worker stands up, leaves, or their work
        // state changes mid-sit, Chunk hops down early.
        const checkTargetStillSeated = () => {
          if (cancelled || sitEnded) return;
          const currentNow = (keyboardTargetsRef.current?.() ?? []).find((candidate) => candidate.memberId === target.memberId);
          if (!currentNow || currentNow.signature !== target.signature) {
            endSit("target-changed-mid-sit");
            return;
          }
          later(checkTargetStillSeated, 900);
        };
        later(checkTargetStillSeated, 900);
        later(() => {
          if (!cancelled) endSit();
        }, sitMs);
      });
      return true;
    };

    const shouldCheck = watchdogEvent && !handledEvents.current.has(watchdogEvent.id);
    if (shouldCheck && watchdogEvent) {
      handledEvents.current.add(watchdogEvent.id);
      const worker = memberById(watchdogEvent.memberId);
      // A watchdog call preempts a keyboard visit outright — Chunk hops
      // down (the state clears here) and goes to check on the worker.
      setKeyboardTargetId(undefined);
      setReaction(undefined);
      setShadesOn(false);
      setOnDesk(false);
      setPhase("checking");
      setLabel(`Checking on ${worker?.name ?? "a worker"}`);
      walk(deskAnchorFor(watchdogEvent.memberId), "down", () => {
        later(() => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setPhase("returning");
          setLabel("Returning to the huddle area");
          activeChunkTarget = CHUNK_HOME;
          walk(CHUNK_HOME, "left", () => {
            activeChunkTarget = undefined;
            setPhase("patrolling");
            setLabel("Patrolling from the huddle area");
            setPatrolCycle((value) => value + 1);
          });
        }, CHUNK_CHECK_HOLD_MS);
      });
    } else if (chunkResumeRestUntilRef.current > Date.now()) {
      // Resumed mid-rest after a reload: hold the rest, then patrol on.
      setPhase("patrolling");
      setMotion((previous) => ({ ...previous, walking: false }));
      later(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        chunkResumeRestUntilRef.current = 0;
        setPatrolCycle((value) => value + 1);
      }, chunkResumeRestUntilRef.current - Date.now());
    } else if (gateCheck() && startKeyboardVisit()) {
      // startKeyboardVisit set the visit in motion; nothing else to do
      // this cycle — the visit ends by bumping the patrol cycle itself.
    } else {
      setPhase("patrolling");
      setLabel("Patrolling from the huddle area");
      // A patrol rest is a settle: Chunk never rests on a tile someone
      // is already settled on (or has claimed). Occupied candidates are
      // filtered out of the pool; if his home tile is taken he rests on
      // the nearest free patrol tile instead, and if a whole pool is
      // taken he simply rests where he is.
      const occupied = getOccupiedTiles ? getOccupiedTiles("chunk") : new Set<string>();
      const broadPatrol = (REGION_TILES[2] ?? []).filter((point) => tileDistance(point, positionRef.current) >= 4 && !occupied.has(settleTileKey(point)));
      const homePatrol = CHUNK_HUDDLE_PATROL.filter((point) => tileDistance(point, positionRef.current) >= 2 && !occupied.has(settleTileKey(point)));
      // Loitering while a keyboard visit is due (see the constants): the
      // leg stays in the desk-row corridor so the arrival re-check below
      // gets frequent chances at a freshly seated worker. "Due" here is
      // the gate timer's own state — open now, or armed on a short fuse
      // (first gate / a retry). A post-sit cooldown is armed long, so it
      // never counts as loitering.
      const loitering = gateOpenRef.current || gateSoonRef.current;
      const deskCorridor = loitering
        ? (REGION_TILES[2] ?? []).filter((point) => point.y >= 3 && point.y <= 6 && tileDistance(point, positionRef.current) >= 2 && !occupied.has(settleTileKey(point)))
        : [];
      let pool = deskCorridor.length > 0 ? deskCorridor : patrolCycle % 4 === 3 ? [CHUNK_HOME] : Math.random() < 0.58 ? homePatrol : broadPatrol;
      if (pool === homePatrol || pool === broadPatrol) {
        if (pool.length === 0) pool = [...homePatrol, ...broadPatrol];
      } else if (pool.length === 1 && pool[0] === CHUNK_HOME && occupied.has(settleTileKey(CHUNK_HOME))) {
        pool = [...homePatrol, ...broadPatrol];
      }
      const target = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)] ?? positionRef.current;
      activeChunkTarget = target;
      walk(target, "left", () => {
        activeChunkTarget = undefined;
        setMotion((previous) => ({ ...previous, walking: false }));
        // Arrival re-check: a worker may have sat down at their desk
        // while Chunk was crossing the room. If a visit is due and one
        // qualifies now, it starts from here — no rest first.
        if (gateCheck() && startKeyboardVisit()) return;
        later(() => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setPatrolCycle((value) => value + 1);
        }, loitering
          ? randomDelay(KB_LOITER_REST_MIN_MS, KB_LOITER_REST_MAX_MS)
          : KB_REST_MIN_MS + Math.floor(Math.random() * (KB_REST_MAX_MS - KB_REST_MIN_MS + 1)));
      });
    }

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      activeChunkTarget = undefined;
      timers.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
    };
  }, [patrolCycle, watchdogEvent?.id, watchdogEvent?.memberId, prefersReducedMotion]);

  return { phase, motion, label, keyboardTargetId, reaction, reactionKey, shadesOn, onDesk };
}

type LightingPhase = "morning" | "day" | "evening" | "night";
type LightingMix = Record<LightingPhase, number>;

// Ben has paused the local-time lighting cycle. Keep the implementation wired
// behind one switch so it can be restored without rebuilding the effect.
const DYNAMIC_FLOOR_LIGHTING_ENABLED = false;
const LIGHTING_TRANSITION_MINUTES = 30;
const LIGHTING_BOUNDARIES: ReadonlyArray<{ minute: number; from: LightingPhase; to: LightingPhase }> = [
  { minute: 6 * 60, from: "night", to: "morning" },
  { minute: 9 * 60, from: "morning", to: "day" },
  { minute: 17 * 60, from: "day", to: "evening" },
  { minute: 21 * 60, from: "evening", to: "night" },
];

function circularMinuteDelta(value: number, boundary: number): number {
  let delta = value - boundary;
  if (delta > 720) delta -= 1440;
  if (delta < -720) delta += 1440;
  return delta;
}

function lightingMixForTime(clock: Date): LightingMix {
  const minute = clock.getHours() * 60 + clock.getMinutes() + clock.getSeconds() / 60;
  const halfTransition = LIGHTING_TRANSITION_MINUTES / 2;
  for (const boundary of LIGHTING_BOUNDARIES) {
    const delta = circularMinuteDelta(minute, boundary.minute);
    if (Math.abs(delta) <= halfTransition) {
      const progress = (delta + halfTransition) / LIGHTING_TRANSITION_MINUTES;
      return {
        morning: 0,
        day: 0,
        evening: 0,
        night: 0,
        [boundary.from]: 1 - progress,
        [boundary.to]: progress,
      };
    }
  }
  if (minute >= 6 * 60 && minute < 9 * 60) return { morning: 1, day: 0, evening: 0, night: 0 };
  if (minute >= 9 * 60 && minute < 17 * 60) return { morning: 0, day: 1, evening: 0, night: 0 };
  if (minute >= 17 * 60 && minute < 21 * 60) return { morning: 0, day: 0, evening: 1, night: 0 };
  return { morning: 0, day: 0, evening: 0, night: 1 };
}

export function OfficeFloor({ tasks, waitingCount, notificationCount, unreadIdeaHunts, huddleCount, briefs, handoffs, watchdogEvent, clock, inboxArrival, onInboxArrivalHandled, onMemberOpen, onOpenWorkPanel, workingCount, doneCount, summaryLabel, greeting, agentCount, openCount, onCreateWork, onEditRegions, onShowJobs, onShowReview, onShowOutreach, overlayHostRef, floor, onFloorChange, onPanelCrewRowsChange, hideOwnChrome }: { tasks: Task[]; waitingCount: number; notificationCount: number; unreadIdeaHunts: number; huddleCount: number; briefs: Brief[]; handoffs: Handoff[]; watchdogEvent?: WatchdogEvent; clock: Date; inboxArrival: InboxArrival | null; onInboxArrivalHandled: (id: string) => void; onMemberOpen: (member: Member, floorStatus: FloorMemberStatus) => void; onOpenWorkPanel: () => void; workingCount: number; doneCount: number; summaryLabel: string; greeting: string; agentCount: number; openCount: number; onCreateWork: () => void; onEditRegions: () => void; onShowJobs: () => void; onShowReview: () => void; onShowOutreach: () => void; overlayHostRef: (element: HTMLDivElement | null) => void; floor?: "main" | "research" | "front"; onFloorChange?: (floor: "main" | "research" | "front") => void; onPanelCrewRowsChange?: (floor: "main" | "research" | "front", rows: PanelCrewRow[]) => void; hideOwnChrome?: boolean }) {
  // Round 4: the controls moved OFF the map's borders and into the side
  // panels flanking the floor (see .floor-side-panels in theme.css). The
  // LEFT panel carries identity and status — the wordmark/greeting block,
  // the three job-state counts, and the Work panel launcher. The RIGHT
  // panel carries the floor tabs, Edit regions, Create work, the Music
  // button with its inline expanding controls section, a dedicated
  // always-visible Enforce button, the date/time, and the music credit.
  // Fullscreen lives inside the music section — Ben withdrew the
  // standalone Fullscreen button ("the map takes up the full screen"
  // already).
  // The floor itself keeps its round-3 size and centered position; its
  // top and bottom borders are clean. The panels are plain flex siblings
  // of the floor frame, rendered by this component below.
  const approvalCount = waitingCount;
  const hasApproval = huddleCount > 0;
  const meeting = currentFloorMeeting(tasks, briefs);
  const lightingMix = lightingMixForTime(clock);
  const lightingStyle = {
    "--morning-light": lightingMix.morning,
    "--day-light": lightingMix.day,
    "--evening-light": lightingMix.evening,
    "--night-light": lightingMix.night,
  } as CSSProperties;
  // The viewed floor. Normally this component owns the choice (its own
  // switcher below); a host interface may instead own it — pass `floor`
  // and `onFloorChange` and this component follows, so the host's one
  // switcher drives the map, this panel set, and everything keyed off
  // the floor. The classic office passes neither and is unchanged.
  const [internalFloor, setInternalFloor] = useState<"main" | "research" | "front">("main");
  const activeFloor = floor ?? internalFloor;
  const setActiveFloor = (next: "main" | "research" | "front") => {
    setInternalFloor(next);
    onFloorChange?.(next);
  };
  // Map zoom (Ben, 2026-10-14): wheel zoom anchored at the cursor, on the
  // map only. This hook owns the view transform; the .floor element below
  // publishes it as CSS variables and each floor's map image + interactive
  // layer render inside a .floor-zoom-viewport that consumes them, so
  // sprites, labels, and click targets track the picture exactly. The
  // side panels and all UI controls sit outside the map element and are
  // never touched. Switching floors resets to the full-floor view.
  const floorZoom = useMapZoom<HTMLDivElement>({ resetKey: activeFloor });
  const tomInResearch = researchJobActive(tasks, briefs);
  // Tom's commute is a trip, not a teleport. When his active floor flips, he
  // walks to the door of the floor he's leaving, disappears in transit, then
  // walks in through the other floor's entrance to his desk there. The trip
  // runs on timers and position callbacks in this always-mounted component,
  // so it plays on whichever floor Ben happens to be watching — the view is
  // never force-switched.
  type TomTrip = { dir: "to-research" | "to-main"; phase: "leaving" | "transit" | "arriving" };
  const [tomSettledHome, setTomSettledHome] = useState<"main" | "research">(() => (researchJobActive(tasks, briefs) ? "research" : "main"));
  const [tomTrip, setTomTrip] = useState<TomTrip | null>(null);
  const tomTripTarget: MapPoint | undefined = tomTrip?.dir === "to-research" && tomTrip.phase === "leaving"
    ? FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor
    : tomTrip?.dir === "to-main" && tomTrip.phase === "arriving"
      ? FLOOR_WORKER_DESK_STATIONS.scout
      : undefined;
  activeTomTripTarget = tomTripTarget;
  const tomVisibleOnMain = tomTrip
    ? tomTrip.dir === "to-research" ? tomTrip.phase === "leaving" : tomTrip.phase === "arriving"
    : tomSettledHome === "main";
  const researchTomRender: "hidden" | "entering" | "present" | "leaving" = tomTrip
    ? tomTrip.dir === "to-research"
      ? tomTrip.phase === "arriving" ? "entering" : "hidden"
      : tomTrip.phase === "leaving" ? "leaving" : "hidden"
    : tomSettledHome === "research" ? "present" : "hidden";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tomTrip) return;
    if (tomInResearch && tomSettledHome === "main") {
      setTomTrip({ dir: "to-research", phase: activeFloor === "main" ? "leaving" : "transit" });
    } else if (!tomInResearch && tomSettledHome === "research") {
      setTomTrip({ dir: "to-main", phase: activeFloor === "research" ? "leaving" : "transit" });
    }
  }, [tomInResearch, tomSettledHome, tomTrip, activeFloor]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tomTrip) return;
    const settle = () => {
      setTomSettledHome(tomTrip.dir === "to-research" ? "research" : "main");
      setTomTrip(null);
    };
    if (tomTrip.phase === "leaving") {
      // Safety net: if the departure leg can't complete (floor unmounted
      // mid-walk), the trip still advances instead of stranding Tom.
      const id = window.setTimeout(() => setTomTrip((current) => (current?.phase === "leaving" ? { ...current, phase: "transit" } : current)), 12000);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
    }
    if (tomTrip.phase === "transit") {
      const id = window.setTimeout(() => setTomTrip((current) => (current?.phase === "transit" ? { ...current, phase: "arriving" } : current)), 2000);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
    }
    const destinationViewed = tomTrip.dir === "to-research" ? activeFloor === "research" : activeFloor === "main";
    if (!destinationViewed) {
      const id = window.setTimeout(settle, 1200);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
    }
    const safety = window.setTimeout(settle, 20000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(safety);
  }, [tomTrip, activeFloor]);

  const [musicOn, setMusicOn] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTrackIndex, setSelectedTrackIndex] = useState(0);
  const [musicVolume, setMusicVolume] = useState(readStoredMusicVolume);
  const [ambienceOn, setAmbienceOn] = useState(false);

  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false);

  // The left panel's crew list (Ben, 2026-10-14): plain always-visible
  // content — no collapsible bar, no toggle — sitting between the

  const [researchCrewRows, setResearchCrewRows] = useState<PanelCrewRow[]>([]);

  const [ceoStop, setCeoStop] = useState<CeoStop>("front-office");
  const ceoVisitsRef = useRef(0);
  // Where Ben is headed when he walks out of the Front Office. The tour
  // timer chooses the destination, but he only actually changes floors

  const ceoPendingDestinationRef = useRef<"main" | "research">("main");

    setCeoStop(ceoPendingDestinationRef.current);
  }, []);

    setCeoStop("front-office");

      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setCeoStop("front-tour"), randomDelay(18_000, 30_000));
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    if (ceoStop === "front-tour") {
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        ceoPendingDestinationRef.current = ceoVisitsRef.current % 2 === 0 ? "main" : "research";
        setCeoStop("front-leaving");
      }, randomDelay(28_000, 42_000));
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    if (ceoStop === "front-leaving" || ceoStop === "front-entering") {
      // Completed by the Front Office floor's doorway callbacks (below);
      // this effect is only their safety net.
      return;
    }

    // timer is only a safety net so Ben always comes home.
    const timer = window.setTimeout(advanceCeoHome, 45_000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [ceoStop, advanceCeoHome]);
  // Doorway safety nets. While the Front Office is on screen, its floor
  // component walks Ben to the entrance (leaving) or to his desk
  // (entering) and reports arrival; the long timer here only fires if
  // that walk somehow never completes. While another floor is on screen
  // the Front Office is unmounted and nobody can see the walk, so the
  // handoff settles quickly instead of stranding Ben in the doorway.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ceoStop === "front-leaving") {
      const timer = window.setTimeout(finishCeoExit, activeFloor === "front" ? 25_000 : 1_200);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    if (ceoStop === "front-entering") {
      const timer = window.setTimeout(finishCeoEntry, activeFloor === "front" ? 25_000 : 1_200);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [ceoStop, activeFloor, finishCeoExit, finishCeoEntry]);
  // Settled-occupancy registry for the main floor, refreshed every
  // render below (after all motion state exists) and read by every
  // routine that chooses a place to STOP: each entry is a character's
  // current tile, whether they are walking, when they settled, and the
  // tile they have claimed as their next stop. Walking through a tile
  // never consults this — only settling does.
  type MainSettleEntry = { position: MapPoint; walking: boolean; settledSince: number; target?: MapPoint };
  const mainSettleRef = useRef<{ crew: Partial<Record<MemberId, MainSettleEntry>>; kim?: MainSettleEntry; chunk?: MainSettleEntry; ben?: MainSettleEntry }>({
    crew: {},
  });
  const settleTrackRef = useRef<Record<string, { walking: boolean; since: number }>>({});
  const getMainSettledOccupied = useCallback<MainOccupancyGetter>((exclude) => {
    const snapshot = mainSettleRef.current;
    const positions: MapPoint[] = [];
    const reserved: Array<MapPoint | undefined> = [];
    (Object.keys(snapshot.crew) as MemberId[]).forEach((memberId) => {
      if (memberId === exclude) return;
      const entry = snapshot.crew[memberId];
      if (!entry) return;
      if (!entry.walking) positions.push(entry.position);
      reserved.push(entry.target);
    });
    if (exclude !== "kim" && snapshot.kim) {
      if (!snapshot.kim.walking) positions.push(snapshot.kim.position);
      reserved.push(activeKimTarget);
    }
    if (exclude !== "chunk" && snapshot.chunk) {
      if (!snapshot.chunk.walking) positions.push(snapshot.chunk.position);
      reserved.push(activeChunkTarget);
    }
    if (exclude !== "ben" && snapshot.ben) {
      if (!snapshot.ben.walking) positions.push(snapshot.ben.position);
      reserved.push(activeCeoMainTarget);
    }
    return settleOccupiedSet(positions, reserved);
  }, []);
  const ceoMain = useCeoMainVisit(prefersReducedMotion, ceoStop === "main", advanceCeoHome, getMainSettledOccupied);
  const ceoVisiting = ceoMain.visible;
  // Chunk's keyboard-visit targets, refreshed during render below (once
  // the crew motion/activity state exists) and read by his routine
  // through this getter — the routine itself runs before that state is

  const chunkKeyboardTargetsRef = useRef<ChunkKeyboardTarget[]>([]);

  const fullscreenRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

    source: MediaElementAudioSourceNode;

    lowpass: BiquadFilterNode;

  } | null>(null);

  const [idleActivities, setIdleActivities] = useState<Record<MemberId, IdleActivity>>(createInitialIdleActivities);
  const [motions, setMotions] = useState<Record<MemberId, AgentMotion>>(() => Object.fromEntries(
    MEMBERS.map((member) => {
      const home = deskAnchorFor(member.id);
      const position = realFloorTarget(member, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff) ?? home;
      return [member.id, { position, durationMs: STEP_MS, facing: "down" as Facing, walking: false }];
    }),

  const movementRef = useRef<Record<MemberId, MapPoint>>(Object.fromEntries(
    MEMBERS.map((member) => [member.id, motions[member.id].position]),
  ) as Record<MemberId, MapPoint>);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Crew presence steady states (Ben, 2026-10-14): the main crew and Ben's
  // rounds schedule restore from their saved presence once it loads, and
  // save back on a slow interval as they move. A member with a live job
  // assignment (brief, meeting, huddle, handoff, Tom's commute) is owned
  // by the pipeline at load time too — the saved spot never overrides it;
  // it only resumes members who were ambient when the floor closed.
  const crewPresence = useCrewPresence();
  const crewPresenceRestoredRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!crewPresence.ready || crewPresenceRestoredRef.current) return;
    crewPresenceRestoredRef.current = true;
    const now = Date.now();
    const ceoRecord = crewPresence.records.get("ceo");
    if (ceoRecord) {
      const stop = ceoRecord.phase;
      if (stop === "front-tour" || stop === "main" || stop === "research") setCeoStop(stop);
      else if (stop === "front-office" || stop === "front-leaving" || stop === "front-entering") setCeoStop("front-office");

      if (Number.isFinite(visits)) ceoVisitsRef.current = Math.floor(visits);
    }

    const restoredMotions: Partial<Record<MemberId, AgentMotion>> = {};
