      const record = crewPresence.records.get(`main:${member.id}`);
      if (!record || record.floor !== "main") return;
      if (member.id === "scout" && (tomTrip || tomSettledHome !== "main")) return;
      if (hasRealFloorAssignment(member.id, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff)) return;
      const savedKind = record.phase as IdleActivityKind;
      const kind: IdleActivityKind = savedKind === "chat" || savedKind === "kimChat" || savedKind === "boss" || savedKind === "scurry" || savedKind === "inspection" || savedKind === "survey"
        ? (member.id === "remmy" ? "chief" : "desk")
        : (["chief", "wander", "coffee", "desk", "inbox", "stretch", "window", "tidy", "phone", "doodle", "pace", "snack", "plants"].includes(savedKind) ? savedKind : (member.id === "remmy" ? "chief" : "desk"));
      const seat = deskAnchorFor(member.id);
      const savedPosition = { x: record.x, y: record.y };
      const savedTarget = presencePoint(record.extra.target);
      const deskKind = kind === "desk" || kind === "doodle" || kind === "phone" || kind === "tidy" || kind === "chief";
      const deskTop = isWorkerSpriteId(member.id) ? FLOOR_ANCHORS.workerDesks[member.id] : undefined;
      // The seat rule applies to restored positions too: a member whose
      // saved activity is desk-bound — or whose saved tile is the old
      // desk-top tile — resumes planted in their chair, nowhere else.
      let position = deskKind || (deskTop !== undefined && presenceSameTile(savedPosition, deskTop)) ? seat : savedPosition;
      let restoredTarget = deskKind ? seat : (savedTarget ?? position);
      let restoredFacing: Facing | undefined;
      // A plants activity saved before the stand-beside fix can hold a
      // stop ON the plant tile itself (position and/or target): resume at
      // that plant's beside-the-plant stop, facing it, instead of back
      // in the plant.
      if (kind === "plants") {
        const plantTile = savedTarget && regionAt(savedTarget) === 11 ? savedTarget
          : regionAt(savedPosition) === 11 ? savedPosition
            : undefined;
        const stop = plantTile ? plantStopFor(plantTile, savedPosition) : undefined;
        if (stop) {
          position = stop.position;
          restoredTarget = stop.position;
          restoredFacing = stop.facing;
        }
      }
      movementRef.current[member.id] = position;
      restoredMotions[member.id] = { position, durationMs: 0, facing: deskKind ? "up" : (restoredFacing ?? record.facing), walking: false };
      const remainMs = Math.min(Math.max(presenceNumber(record.extra.remainMs, 30_000), 5_000), ROUTINE_MAX_MS);
      restoredActivities[member.id] = {
        kind,
        label: kind === savedKind && record.label ? record.label : (member.id === "remmy" ? "Sitting in his office chair" : randomDeskLabel(member.id)),
        target: restoredTarget,
        facing: restoredFacing,
        nextChoiceAt: now + remainMs,
      };
    });
    if (Object.keys(restoredMotions).length > 0) {
      setMotions((previous) => ({ ...previous, ...restoredMotions }));
    }
    if (Object.keys(restoredActivities).length > 0) {
      setIdleActivities((previous) => ({ ...previous, ...restoredActivities }));
    }
    // Restore runs once per mount, the moment presence first loads; the
    // job state it consults is whatever is live at that moment.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [crewPresence.ready, crewPresence.records]);

  const presenceSnapshotRef = useRef({ motions, idleActivities, ceoStop, tomVisibleOnMain, ceoMainPosition: ceoMain.motion.position, ceoMainFacing: ceoMain.motion.facing });
  presenceSnapshotRef.current = { motions, idleActivities, ceoStop, tomVisibleOnMain, ceoMainPosition: ceoMain.motion.position, ceoMainFacing: ceoMain.motion.facing };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!crewPresence.ready) return;
    const save = () => {
      const snapshot = presenceSnapshotRef.current;
      const now = Date.now();
      MEMBERS.forEach((member) => {
        if (member.id === "scout" && !snapshot.tomVisibleOnMain) return;
        const motion = snapshot.motions[member.id];
        const activity = snapshot.idleActivities[member.id];
        if (!motion || !activity) return;
        saveCrewPresence({
          memberKey: `main:${member.id}`, floor: "main",
          x: motion.position.x, y: motion.position.y, facing: motion.facing,
          label: activity.label, phase: activity.kind,
          extra: { target: activity.target, remainMs: Math.max(0, activity.nextChoiceAt - now), walking: motion.walking },
        });
      });

        memberKey: "ceo",

        x: snapshot.ceoStop === "main" ? snapshot.ceoMainPosition.x : 0,

    };

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [crewPresence.ready]);

  // Refresh the settled-occupancy registry from this render's motion
  // state, tracking when each character settled (a walking character has
  // no settle time). The newcomer in any stack is the one with the later
  // settle time — the character who was there first is never moved.
  {
    const trackSettled = (id: string, walking: boolean): number => {
      const now = Date.now();
      const track = settleTrackRef.current[id];
      if (walking) {
        settleTrackRef.current[id] = { walking: true, since: 0 };
        return 0;
      }
      if (!track || track.walking) {
        settleTrackRef.current[id] = { walking: false, since: now };
        return now;
      }
      return track.since;
    };
    mainSettleRef.current = {
      crew: Object.fromEntries(MEMBERS.map((member) => [member.id, {
        position: movementRef.current[member.id],
        walking: motions[member.id].walking,
        settledSince: trackSettled(member.id, motions[member.id].walking),
        target: realFloorTarget(member, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff) ?? idleActivities[member.id].target,
      }])) as Partial<Record<MemberId, MainSettleEntry>>,
      kim: {
        position: secretary.motion.position,
        walking: secretary.motion.walking,
        settledSince: trackSettled("kim", secretary.motion.walking),
        target: activeKimTarget,
      },
      chunk: {
        position: chunk.motion.position,
        walking: chunk.motion.walking,
        settledSince: trackSettled("chunk", chunk.motion.walking),
        target: activeChunkTarget,
      },
      ben: ceoVisiting ? {
        position: ceoMain.motion.position,
        walking: ceoMain.motion.walking,
        settledSince: trackSettled("ben", ceoMain.motion.walking),
        target: activeCeoMainTarget,
      } : undefined,

    // walking, and working at that desk — a live brief, a working job
    // pinning them there, a desk-bound pastime, or holding their desk
    // while Ben inspects. Chatting, roaming, huddling, meetings and
    // handoffs never qualify, and Tom only counts while he is actually
    // on this floor. The signature folds in the work/activity state, so
    // Chunk's standing watch notices any change to it mid-sit.
    chunkKeyboardTargetsRef.current = FLOOR_WORKERS.flatMap((memberId) => {
      if (memberId === "scout" && !tomVisibleOnMain) return [];
      if (!isWorkerSpriteId(memberId)) return [];
      const motion = motions[memberId];
      const activity = idleActivities[memberId];
      if (!motion || !activity || motion.walking) return [];
      const chair = deskAnchorFor(memberId);
      if (motion.position.x !== chair.x || motion.position.y !== chair.y) return [];
      const work = deskWork(memberId, tasks, briefs);
      const liveBrief = briefs.find((brief) => brief.assignee === memberId && brief.status === "in_progress");
      const deskBound = activity.kind === "desk" || activity.kind === "doodle" || activity.kind === "phone"
        || activity.kind === "tidy" || activity.kind === "inspection";
      if (!liveBrief && !work?.active && !deskBound) return [];
      const member = memberById(memberId);
      if (!member) return [];
      return [{
        memberId,
        name: member.name,
        deskTile: FLOOR_ANCHORS.workerDesks[memberId],
        chairTile: chair,
        signature: `${memberId}|${chair.x},${chair.y}|${liveBrief?.id ?? work?.title ?? ""}|${activity.kind}`,
      }];
    });
  }

  // An ambient crew activity's settle tile, resolved against everyone
  // already settled or claiming a tile: the intended stop when free, the
  // nearest free tile beside it when not, and the member's own desk (a
  // per-person station, always theirs) when nothing near is free.
  // Station-bound kinds (desk work and its pastimes, the inbox run, a
  // chat with Kim at her desk, enforcement legs) keep their exact
  // targets — this only resolves free-roam stops.
  const resolveCrewSettleActivity = (memberId: MemberId, activity: IdleActivity): IdleActivity => {
    if (activity.kind === "desk" || activity.kind === "doodle" || activity.kind === "phone" || activity.kind === "tidy"
      || activity.kind === "stretch" || activity.kind === "chief" || activity.kind === "inbox" || activity.kind === "kimChat"
      || activity.kind === "boss" || activity.kind === "scurry" || activity.kind === "inspection" || activity.kind === "chat") {
      return activity;
    }
    const occupied = getMainSettledOccupied(memberId);
    if (!occupied.has(settleTileKey(activity.target))) return activity;
    const free = nearestFreeSettleTile(activity.target, occupied, SETTLE_TILES, 6);
    return free ? { ...activity, target: free } : { ...activity, target: deskAnchorFor(memberId) };
  };

  // Main-floor legs of Tom's commute: the departure leg ends when he reaches
  // the front door; the arrival leg ends when he reaches his main-office desk.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tomTrip) return;

    if (!motion || motion.walking) return;

      && motion.position.x === FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor.x && motion.position.y === FLOOR_ANCHORS.frontDoor.y) {
      setTomTrip((current) => (current?.dir === "to-research" && current.phase === "leaving" ? { ...current, phase: "transit" } : current));
    }
    if (tomTrip.dir === "to-main" && tomTrip.phase === "arriving") {
      const desk = FLOOR_WORKER_DESK_STATIONS.scout;
      if (motion.position.x === desk.x && motion.position.y === desk.y) {
        setTomSettledHome("main");
        setTomTrip(null);
      }
    }
  }, [tomTrip, motions]);

  const [ghostVisible, setGhostVisible] = useState(false);
  const [ghostCycle, setGhostCycle] = useState(0);
  const ghostVisibleRef = useRef(ghostVisible);
  ghostVisibleRef.current = ghostVisible;
  const conferenceOccupied = Object.values(motions).some((motion) => isConferenceRoomPosition(motion.position))
    || isConferenceRoomPosition(secretary.motion.position);
  const conferenceOccupiedRef = useRef(conferenceOccupied);
  conferenceOccupiedRef.current = conferenceOccupied;
  const ghostHideout = pointForRegion(5, 0);

  function dismissConferenceGhost(): void {
    if (!ghostVisibleRef.current) return;
    ghostVisibleRef.current = false;
    setGhostVisible(false);
    setGhostCycle((cycle) => cycle + 1);
  }
  const legTimeouts = useRef<Record<MemberId, number[]>>({ remmy: [], scout: [], forge: [], quill: [], ledger: [] });
  const backToWorkRef = useRef<BackToWorkSequence | null>(null);
  const ceoWasVisibleRef = useRef(false);
  const previousMeetingRef = useRef<FloorMeeting | undefined>(meeting);
  const roundupTimersRef = useRef<number[]>([]);
  const [enforceNotice, setEnforceNotice] = useState("");
  const lastTouchActivationRef = useRef<Record<"music" | "ambience" | "fullscreen" | "enforce", number>>({ music: 0, ambience: 0, fullscreen: 0, enforce: 0 });

  function activateFloorControl(
    event: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement> | MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>,
    control: "music" | "ambience" | "fullscreen" | "enforce",
    action: () => void | Promise<void>,
  ) {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if ("pointerType" in event && (event.pointerType === "touch" || event.pointerType === "pen")) {
      event.preventDefault();
      lastTouchActivationRef.current[control] = Date.now();
      void action();
      return;
    }
    if (!("pointerType" in event) && Date.now() - lastTouchActivationRef.current[control] < 800) return;
    if (!("pointerType" in event)) void action();
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const update = () => setPrefersReducedMotion(media.matches);
    update();
    media.addEventListener("change", update);
    return () => media.removeEventListener("change", update);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let timeoutId: number | undefined;

      if (conferenceOccupiedRef.current) {
        timeoutId = window.setTimeout(attemptAppearance, GHOST_OCCUPIED_RETRY_MS);
        return;
      }
      setGhostVisible(true);
    };
    timeoutId = window.setTimeout(
      attemptAppearance,
      randomDelay(GHOST_APPEARANCE_MIN_MS, GHOST_APPEARANCE_MAX_MS),
    );
    return () => {
      if (timeoutId !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [ghostCycle]);

  useEffect(() => {

  }, [conferenceOccupied, ghostVisible]);

  useEffect(() => {

      });

    });

  useEffect(() => {
    const wasVisible = ceoWasVisibleRef.current;
    ceoWasVisibleRef.current = ceoVisiting;
    if (ceoVisiting) {

      roundupTimersRef.current.forEach((timerId) => window.clearTimeout(timerId));
      roundupTimersRef.current = [];
      const now = Date.now();
      setIdleActivities((previous) => {
        const next = { ...previous };
        for (const member of MEMBERS) {
          next[member.id] = {
            kind: "inspection",
            label: member.id === "remmy" ? "😰 trying to look calm for Ben" : "Working hard while Ben does his rounds",
            target: deskAnchorFor(member.id),
            nextChoiceAt: now + BACK_TO_WORK_MAX_MS,
          };

    const now = Date.now();
    setIdleActivities((previous) => {
      const next = { ...previous };
      for (const member of MEMBERS) {
        next[member.id] = soloIdleActivity(member, now, movementRef.current[member.id], member.id === "remmy" ? "chief" : "wander");
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [ceoVisiting]);

  useEffect(() => {
    storeMusicVolume(musicVolume);
    const context = audioContextRef.current;
    const gain = audioNodesRef.current?.gain;
    if (context && gain) gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(musicGainFor(musicVolume), context.currentTime, 0.025);
  }, [musicVolume]);

  useEffect(() => {
    storeAmbienceVolume(ambienceVolume);
    const ambience = ambienceAudioRef.current;
    if (ambience) ambience.volume = ambienceVolumeFor(ambienceVolume);
  }, [ambienceVolume]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inboxArrival) return;
    const preferred = MEMBERS.find((member) => member.id === inboxArrival.memberId);
    if (!preferred) {
      onInboxArrivalHandled(inboxArrival.id);
      return;
    }
    const candidates = [preferred, MEMBERS.find((member) => member.id === "remmy"), ...MEMBERS].filter((member): member is MainMember => Boolean(member));
    const checker = candidates.find((member, index) => candidates.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === member.id) === index
      && !hasRealFloorAssignment(member.id, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff)) ?? preferred;
    const now = Date.now();
    setIdleActivities((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [checker.id]: {
        kind: "inbox",
        label: `📥 new: ${inboxArrival.title}`,
        target: FLOOR_ANCHORS.inbox,
        resumeAt: now + 30_000,
        nextChoiceAt: now + 30_000 + randomDelay(ROUTINE_MIN_MS, ROUTINE_MAX_MS),
      },
    }));
    onInboxArrivalHandled(inboxArrival.id);
  }, [inboxArrival?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncFullscreenState = () => {
      const isNativeFullscreen = document.fullscreenElement === fullscreenRef.current;
      if (isNativeFullscreen) {
        nativeFullscreenRef.current = true;
        setIsFullscreen(true);
      } else if (nativeFullscreenRef.current) {
        nativeFullscreenRef.current = false;
        setIsFullscreen(false);
      }
    };
    const closeOnEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key !== "Escape" || !isFullscreen || document.fullscreenElement) return;
      setIsFullscreen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", syncFullscreenState);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("fullscreenchange", syncFullscreenState);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
    };
  }, [isFullscreen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.classList.toggle("floor-maximized", isFullscreen);
    return () => document.body.classList.remove("floor-maximized");
  }, [isFullscreen]);

  // The music controls are an inline expanding section inside the right
  // side panel (see rightPanel below) — in normal flow, never a floating
  // popover — so there is nothing to dismiss on outside clicks or Escape:
  // the Music button itself expands and collapses the section.

  async function toggleFullscreen() {
    const container = fullscreenRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    if (isFullscreen) {
      setIsFullscreen(false);
      if (document.fullscreenElement === container) await document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => undefined);
      return;
    }

    // The Muse shell may not grant iframes the native Fullscreen API. Enter the
    // in-page maximized view first so the control always works, then enhance it
    // with native fullscreen when the host permits it.
    setIsFullscreen(true);
    if (!document.fullscreenEnabled) return;
    try {
      await container.requestFullscreen();
      nativeFullscreenRef.current = true;
    } catch {
      nativeFullscreenRef.current = false;
    }
  }

  function ensureSpeakerEffect(): AudioContext | undefined {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return undefined;
    if (audioContextRef.current && audioNodesRef.current) return audioContextRef.current;

    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext ?? (window as Window & { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return undefined;
    const context = new AudioContextClass();
    const source = context.createMediaElementSource(audio);
    const highpass = context.createBiquadFilter();
    highpass.type = "highpass";
    highpass.frequency.value = 400;
    highpass.Q.value = 0.72;
    const lowpass = context.createBiquadFilter();
    lowpass.type = "lowpass";
    lowpass.frequency.value = 4000;
    lowpass.Q.value = 0.64;
    const distortion = context.createWaveShaper();
    distortion.curve = dustySpeakerCurve();
    distortion.oversample = "2x";
    const gain = context.createGain();
    gain.gain.value = musicGainFor(musicVolume);
    source.connect(highpass).connect(lowpass).connect(distortion).connect(gain).connect(context.destination);
    audioContextRef.current = context;
    audioNodesRef.current = { source, highpass, lowpass, distortion, gain };
    return context;
  }

  async function startMusic(audio: HTMLAudioElement) {
    const context = ensureSpeakerEffect();
    try {
      if (context?.state === "suspended") await context.resume();
      if (!context) audio.volume = musicVolume / 100;
      await audio.play();
      musicOnRef.current = true;
      setMusicOn(true);
    } catch {
      musicOnRef.current = false;
      setMusicOn(false);
    }
  }

  async function toggleMusic() {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;
    if (!audio.paused) {
      audio.pause();
      musicOnRef.current = false;
      setMusicOn(false);
      await audioContextRef.current?.suspend().catch(() => undefined);
      return;
    }
    await startMusic(audio);
  }

  async function toggleAmbience() {
    const ambience = ambienceAudioRef.current;
    if (!ambience) return;
    if (ambienceOnRef.current) {
      ambience.pause();
      ambienceOnRef.current = false;
      setAmbienceOn(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      ambience.volume = ambienceVolumeFor(ambienceVolume);
      await ambience.play();
      ambienceOnRef.current = true;
      setAmbienceOn(true);
    } catch {
      ambienceOnRef.current = false;
      setAmbienceOn(false);
    }
  }

  async function selectMusicTrack(index: number) {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    const track = OFFICE_PLAYLIST[index];
    if (!audio || !track) return;

    audio.pause();
    audio.currentTime = 0;
    audio.src = track.url;
    audio.load();
    setSelectedTrackIndex(index);
    await startMusic(audio);
  }

  useEffect(() => () => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    const ambience = ambienceAudioRef.current;
    audio?.pause();
    ambience?.pause();
    musicOnRef.current = false;
    ambienceOnRef.current = false;
    const nodes = audioNodesRef.current;
    nodes?.source.disconnect();
    nodes?.highpass.disconnect();
    nodes?.lowpass.disconnect();
    nodes?.distortion.disconnect();
    nodes?.gain.disconnect();
    void audioContextRef.current?.close().catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setWalkTick((value) => value + 1), 180);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const liveHandoffIds = handoffs
    .filter((handoff) => handoffIsLive(handoff, tasks, briefs))
    .map((handoff) => handoff.id)
    .sort()
    .join("|");
  const activeHandoffIsLive = activeHandoff ? handoffIsLive(activeHandoff.event, tasks, briefs) : false;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeHandoff) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    const eligible = handoffs
      .filter((handoff) => now - new Date(handoff.createdAt).getTime() <= HANDOFF_RECENT_MS)
      .filter((handoff) => handoffIsLive(handoff, tasks, briefs))
      .filter((handoff) => !seenHandoffIds.current.has(handoff.id))
      .filter((handoff) => isMainMemberId(handoff.fromMemberId) && isMainMemberId(handoff.toMemberId))
      .filter((handoff) => tasks.find((task) => task.id === handoff.sourceTaskId)?.pipeline !== "research_case");
    const candidate = eligible[eligible.length - 1];
    if (!candidate) return;
    const event = candidate as MainHandoff;
    if (prefersReducedMotion) {
      seenHandoffIds.current.add(event.id);
      rememberHandoff(event.id);
      return;
    }
    const targets = handoffMeetingTargets(event, meeting);
    // If every conference seat is already occupied, keep this handoff queued
    // until the room clears rather than stacking two sprites on one chair.
    if (!targets) return;
    seenHandoffIds.current.add(event.id);
    const [fromTarget, toTarget] = targets;
    setActiveHandoff({ event, phase: "approaching", fromTarget, toTarget });
  }, [liveHandoffIds, activeHandoff, prefersReducedMotion, meeting?.taskId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeHandoff || activeHandoffIsLive || activeHandoff.phase === "returning") return;
    setActiveHandoff((current) => current?.event.id === activeHandoff.event.id
      ? { ...current, phase: "returning", holdUntil: undefined }
      : current);
  }, [activeHandoff?.event.id, activeHandoff?.phase, activeHandoffIsLive]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeHandoff) return;
    const fromMotion = motions[activeHandoff.event.fromMemberId];
    const toMotion = motions[activeHandoff.event.toMemberId];
    if (activeHandoff.phase === "approaching") {
      const bothArrived = !fromMotion.walking
        && !toMotion.walking
        && tileDistance(fromMotion.position, activeHandoff.fromTarget) === 0
        && tileDistance(toMotion.position, activeHandoff.toTarget) === 0;
      if (!bothArrived) return;
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setActiveHandoff((current) => current?.event.id === activeHandoff.event.id
        ? { ...current, phase: "holding", holdUntil: Date.now() + HANDOFF_HOLD_MS }
        : current), 120);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    if (activeHandoff.phase === "holding") {
      const remaining = Math.max(0, (activeHandoff.holdUntil ?? Date.now()) - Date.now());
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setActiveHandoff((current) => current?.event.id === activeHandoff.event.id
        ? { ...current, phase: "returning" }
        : current), remaining);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    const bothHome = !fromMotion.walking
      && !toMotion.walking
      && tileDistance(fromMotion.position, deskAnchorFor(activeHandoff.event.fromMemberId)) === 0
      && tileDistance(toMotion.position, deskAnchorFor(activeHandoff.event.toMemberId)) === 0;
    if (!bothHome) return;
    const eventId = activeHandoff.event.id;
    const participantIds = [activeHandoff.event.fromMemberId, activeHandoff.event.toMemberId] as const;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      rememberHandoff(eventId);
      const now = Date.now();
      setIdleActivities((previous) => {
        const next = { ...previous };
        participantIds.forEach((memberId) => {
          const member = memberById(memberId);
          if (member) next[memberId] = soloIdleActivity(member, now, deskAnchorFor(memberId), memberId === "remmy" ? "chief" : "desk");
        });
        return next;
      });
      setActiveHandoff((current) => current?.event.id === eventId ? null : current);
    }, 180);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [activeHandoff, motions]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enforceNotice) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setEnforceNotice(""), 4200);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [enforceNotice]);

  function enforceBackToWork() {
    if (backToWorkRef.current) {
      setEnforceNotice("Remmy is already handling it.");
      return;
    }
    const now = Date.now();
    if (hasRealFloorAssignment("remmy", tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff)) {
      setEnforceNotice("Remmy is LIVE — roundup postponed.");
      return;
    }
    const idleWorkerIds = FLOOR_WORKERS.filter((workerId): workerId is Exclude<MemberId, "remmy"> => (
      !hasRealFloorAssignment(workerId, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff)
    ));
    if (idleWorkerIds.length === 0) {
      setEnforceNotice("The whole crew is already on assigned work.");
      return;
    }
    if (prefersReducedMotion) {
      setIdleActivities((previous) => {
        const next = { ...previous };
        for (const workerId of idleWorkerIds) {
          next[workerId] = backToWorkActivity("scurry", randomDeskLabel(workerId), deskAnchorFor(workerId), now);
        }
        return next;
      });
      setEnforceNotice("Crew sent back to their desks.");
      return;
    }
    const gatherPoint = backToWorkGatherPoint(
      idleWorkerIds.map((workerId) => movementRef.current[workerId]),
      movementRef.current.remmy,
    );
    backToWorkRef.current = { phase: "approaching", workerIds: idleWorkerIds, gatherPoint };
    setIdleActivities((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      remmy: backToWorkActivity("boss", "🚨 rounding up the crew", gatherPoint, now),
    }));
    setEnforceNotice("Remmy is on the warpath.");
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const sequence = backToWorkRef.current;
    if (!sequence || sequence.phase !== "approaching" || roundupTimersRef.current.length > 0 || prefersReducedMotion) return;
    const approachSteps = shortestRegionPath(movementRef.current.remmy, sequence.gatherPoint).slice(1).length;
    const arrivalTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      const active = backToWorkRef.current;
      if (!active || active.phase !== "approaching") return;
      const now = Date.now();
      backToWorkRef.current = { ...active, phase: "scolding", scoldUntil: now + BACK_TO_WORK_SCOLD_MS };
      setIdleActivities((previous) => {
        const next = { ...previous, remmy: backToWorkActivity("boss", "GET BACK TO WORK!", active.gatherPoint, now, true) };
        for (const workerId of active.workerIds) {
          next[workerId] = backToWorkActivity("scurry", "RUN!", deskAnchorFor(workerId), now);
        }
        return next;
      });

      const longestRunSteps = active.workerIds.reduce((longest, workerId) => {
        const steps = shortestRegionPath(movementRef.current[workerId], deskAnchorFor(workerId)).slice(1).length;
        return Math.max(longest, steps);
      }, 0);
      const returnStartTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        const scolding = backToWorkRef.current;
        if (!scolding || scolding.phase !== "scolding") return;
        const returnNow = Date.now();
        backToWorkRef.current = { ...scolding, phase: "remmy-returning" };
        setIdleActivities((previous) => {
          const next = { ...previous, remmy: backToWorkActivity("boss", "🚶 returning to office", FLOOR_ANCHORS.remmyDesk, returnNow) };
          for (const workerId of scolding.workerIds) {
            const worker = memberById(workerId);
            if (!worker) continue;
              next[workerId] = soloIdleActivity(worker, returnNow, deskAnchorFor(workerId), "desk");
          }
          return next;
        });

        const returnSteps = shortestRegionPath(scolding.gatherPoint, FLOOR_ANCHORS.remmyDesk).slice(1).length;
        const finishTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
          const returning = backToWorkRef.current;
          if (!returning || returning.phase !== "remmy-returning") return;
          backToWorkRef.current = null;
          roundupTimersRef.current = [];
          const remmy = memberById("remmy");
          if (remmy) setIdleActivities((previous) => ({ ...previous, remmy: soloIdleActivity(remmy, Date.now(), FLOOR_ANCHORS.remmyDesk, "chief") }));
        }, returnSteps * 315 + 450);
        roundupTimersRef.current.push(finishTimer);
      }, Math.max(BACK_TO_WORK_SCOLD_MS, longestRunSteps * 90 + 300));
      roundupTimersRef.current.push(returnStartTimer);
    }, approachSteps * 315 + 350);
    roundupTimersRef.current.push(arrivalTimer);
  }, [idleActivities.remmy.kind, idleActivities.remmy.target.x, idleActivities.remmy.target.y, prefersReducedMotion]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    roundupTimersRef.current.forEach((timerId) => window.clearTimeout(timerId));
    roundupTimersRef.current = [];
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateRoutine = () => {
      if (ceoVisiting) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      const busyIds = new Set(MEMBERS.filter((member) => hasRealFloorAssignment(member.id, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff)).map((member) => member.id));
      const sequence = backToWorkRef.current;
      if (sequence) {
        const interrupted = busyIds.has("remmy") || sequence.workerIds.some((workerId) => busyIds.has(workerId));
        if (interrupted || prefersReducedMotion) {
          backToWorkRef.current = null;
          roundupTimersRef.current.forEach((timerId) => window.clearTimeout(timerId));
          roundupTimersRef.current = [];
          setIdleActivities((previous) => {
            const next = { ...previous };
            const remmy = memberById("remmy");
            if (remmy) next.remmy = soloIdleActivity(remmy, now, movementRef.current.remmy, "chief");
            for (const workerId of sequence.workerIds) {
              const worker = memberById(workerId);
              if (worker) next[workerId] = soloIdleActivity(worker, now, movementRef.current[workerId], busyIds.has(workerId) ? "desk" : "wander");
            }
            return next;
          });
          return;
        }
        return;
      }

      setIdleActivities((previous) => {
        const next = { ...previous };
        const handled = new Set<MemberId>();
        let changed = false;
        // Settle safety net: an idle member who has ENDED movement on a
        // tile another character is already settled on steps aside to
        // the nearest free tile and dwells there instead. Whoever
        // settled first keeps the tile (job-pinned holders and Kim /
        // Chunk at their stops always keep it); walking through a tile
        // is never touched, and members mid-conversation or on a job
        // are left exactly where they are.
        {
          const snapshot = mainSettleRef.current;
          const holders: Array<{ id: string; key: string; since: number }> = [];
          (Object.keys(snapshot.crew) as MemberId[]).forEach((memberId) => {
            const entry = snapshot.crew[memberId];
            if (entry && !entry.walking) holders.push({ id: memberId, key: settleTileKey(entry.position), since: entry.settledSince });
          });
          if (snapshot.kim && !snapshot.kim.walking) holders.push({ id: "kim", key: settleTileKey(snapshot.kim.position), since: snapshot.kim.settledSince });
          if (snapshot.chunk && !snapshot.chunk.walking) holders.push({ id: "chunk", key: settleTileKey(snapshot.chunk.position), since: snapshot.chunk.settledSince });
          if (snapshot.ben && !snapshot.ben.walking) holders.push({ id: "ben", key: settleTileKey(snapshot.ben.position), since: snapshot.ben.settledSince });
          for (const member of MEMBERS) {
            if (busyIds.has(member.id)) continue;
            const entry = snapshot.crew[member.id];
            if (!entry || entry.walking) continue;
            const currentActivity = next[member.id];
            if (currentActivity.kind === "chat" || currentActivity.kind === "kimChat" || currentActivity.kind === "boss"
              || currentActivity.kind === "scurry" || currentActivity.kind === "inspection") continue;
            if (tileDistance(entry.position, currentActivity.target) !== 0) continue;
            const key = settleTileKey(entry.position);
            const duplicated = holders.some((holder) => holder.id !== member.id && holder.key === key
              && (holder.id === "kim" || holder.id === "chunk" || holder.id === "ben"
                || busyIds.has(holder.id as MemberId)
                || (holder.since > 0 && entry.settledSince > 0 && holder.since <= entry.settledSince)));
            if (!duplicated) continue;
            const occupied = getMainSettledOccupied(member.id);
            const free = nearestFreeSettleTile(entry.position, occupied, SETTLE_TILES, 6);
            const target = free ?? deskAnchorFor(member.id);
            if (target.x === entry.position.x && target.y === entry.position.y) continue;
            next[member.id] = {
              kind: "wander",
              label: randomActivityLabel("wander"),
              target,
              resumeAt: now + randomDelay(45_000, 80_000),
              nextChoiceAt: now + randomDelay(ROUTINE_MIN_MS, ROUTINE_MAX_MS),
            };
            handled.add(member.id);
            changed = true;
          }
        }
        const remmyIsLeaving = regionAt(movementRef.current.remmy) === 8
          && next.remmy.kind === "wander"
          && regionAt(next.remmy.target) !== 8;
        if (!busyIds.has("remmy") && remmyIsLeaving) {
          const idleWorkerIds = FLOOR_WORKERS.filter((workerId): workerId is Exclude<MemberId, "remmy"> => !busyIds.has(workerId));
          if (idleWorkerIds.length > 0 && !prefersReducedMotion) {
            const gatherPoint = backToWorkGatherPoint(
              idleWorkerIds.map((workerId) => movementRef.current[workerId]),
              movementRef.current.remmy,
            );
            backToWorkRef.current = { phase: "approaching", workerIds: idleWorkerIds, gatherPoint };
            next.remmy = backToWorkActivity("boss", "🚨 rounding up the crew", gatherPoint, now);
            return next;
          }
        }

        for (const member of MEMBERS) {
          if (busyIds.has(member.id) || handled.has(member.id)) {
            handled.add(member.id);
            continue;
          }
          let activity = next[member.id];

          if (activity.kind === "chat") {
            const groupIds = activity.chatMemberIds ?? [member.id, ...(activity.partnerId ? [activity.partnerId] : [])];
            const groupActivities = groupIds.map((memberId) => next[memberId]);
            const validGroup = groupIds.length >= 2 && groupIds.every((memberId, index) => {
              const groupActivity = groupActivities[index];
              return !busyIds.has(memberId)
                && groupActivity?.kind === "chat"
                && (activity.chatGroupId ? groupActivity.chatGroupId === activity.chatGroupId : true);
            });

            if (!validGroup) {
              activity = resolveCrewSettleActivity(member.id, soloIdleActivity(member, now, movementRef.current[member.id], member.id === "remmy" ? "chief" : "wander"));
              next[member.id] = activity;
              changed = true;
            } else {
              const allArrived = groupIds.every((memberId, index) => {
                const groupActivity = groupActivities[index];
                return Boolean(groupActivity) && tileDistance(movementRef.current[memberId], groupActivity?.target ?? movementRef.current[memberId]) === 0;
              });
              // The conversation only starts once the whole group has walked
              // up and is standing together, face to face. Until then the
              // group is still gathering: no topic, no talking label, and
              // the talk clock has not started.
              const gathered = chatPositionsGathered(groupIds.map((memberId) => movementRef.current[memberId]));
              if (activity.resumeAt === undefined && allArrived && gathered) {
                const holdUntil = now + (activity.chatHoldMs ?? randomDelay(45_000, 80_000));
                const chooseAgainAt = holdUntil + randomDelay(ROUTINE_MIN_MS, ROUTINE_MAX_MS);
                groupIds.forEach((memberId, index) => {
                  const groupActivity = groupActivities[index];
                  if (!groupActivity) return;
                  const otherNames = groupIds.filter((candidateId) => candidateId !== memberId).map((candidateId) => memberById(candidateId)?.name).filter(Boolean).join(" & ");
                  next[memberId] = { ...groupActivity, label: `💬 chatting with ${otherNames}`, resumeAt: holdUntil, nextChoiceAt: chooseAgainAt };
                });
                changed = true;
              } else if ((activity.resumeAt !== undefined && now >= activity.resumeAt) || (activity.resumeAt === undefined && now >= activity.nextChoiceAt)) {
                groupIds.forEach((memberId) => {
                  const groupMember = memberById(memberId);
                  if (groupMember) next[memberId] = resolveCrewSettleActivity(memberId, soloIdleActivity(groupMember, now, movementRef.current[memberId], memberId === "remmy" ? "chief" : "wander"));
                });
                changed = true;
              }
              groupIds.forEach((memberId) => handled.add(memberId));
              continue;
            }
          }

          if (activity.resumeAt !== undefined) {
            if (now < activity.resumeAt) {
              handled.add(member.id);
              continue;
            }
            activity = resolveCrewSettleActivity(member.id, soloIdleActivity(member, now, movementRef.current[member.id], member.id === "remmy" ? "chief" : "wander"));
            next[member.id] = activity;
            handled.add(member.id);
            changed = true;
            continue;
          }
          if (now < activity.nextChoiceAt) continue;

          // A chat with Kim starts only while her flirt tile is free —
          // if someone is settled there, this member does something else
          // instead of settling on top of them.
          const kimTileTaken = getMainSettledOccupied(member.id).has(settleTileKey(SVEN_FLIRT_TARGET));
          const requestedKind = member.id === "remmy"
            ? undefined
            : secretary.phase === "desk" && !kimTileTaken && !Object.values(next).some((candidate) => candidate.kind === "kimChat") && Math.random() < 0.11
              ? "kimChat"
              : pickWorkerActivityKind();
          if (requestedKind === "chat") {
            const availablePartners = MEMBERS.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== "remmy"
              && candidate.id !== member.id
              && !busyIds.has(candidate.id)
              && !handled.has(candidate.id)
              && next[candidate.id].kind !== "chat");
            const desiredPartners = availablePartners.length >= 2 && Math.random() < 0.42 ? 2 : 1;
            const partners = availablePartners.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, desiredPartners);
            const groupMembers = [member, ...partners];
            const groupIds = groupMembers.map((groupMember) => groupMember.id);
            const currentPositions = groupIds.map((memberId) => movementRef.current[memberId]);
            // Already standing together: talk starts right here, no walking.
            // Otherwise everyone first walks to adjacent meeting spots near
            // the group's midpoint, and the conversation only begins once
            // the arrival check above sees the group gathered.
            const alreadyTogether = chatPositionsGathered(currentPositions);
            // Conversation spots skip every tile someone outside the
            // group is settled on or has claimed — the group gathers on
            // free adjacent tiles, the second chair at the table.
            const chatOccupied = getMainSettledOccupied(member.id);
            groupIds.forEach((groupId) => {
              if (groupId !== member.id) {
                const entry = mainSettleRef.current.crew[groupId];
                if (entry && !entry.walking) chatOccupied.add(settleTileKey(entry.position));
                if (entry?.target) chatOccupied.add(settleTileKey(entry.target));
              }
            });
            currentPositions.forEach((position) => chatOccupied.delete(settleTileKey(position)));
            const spots = alreadyTogether ? currentPositions : chatGroupTargets(currentPositions, chatOccupied);
            if (groupMembers.length >= 2 && spots?.length === groupMembers.length) {
              const chatTopic = randomChatTopic();
              const chatGroupId = `${now}-${groupIds.join("-")}`;
              const chatEndsAt = now + randomDelay(45_000, 80_000);
              groupMembers.forEach((groupMember, groupIndex) => {
                const otherNames = groupMembers.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== groupMember.id).map((candidate) => candidate.name).join(" & ");
                const partner = groupMembers[(groupIndex + 1) % groupMembers.length] ?? groupMembers[0];
                next[groupMember.id] = alreadyTogether
                  ? {
                    kind: "chat",
                    label: `💬 chatting with ${otherNames}`,
                    chatTopic,
                    chatGroupId,
                    chatMemberIds: groupIds,
                    target: spots[groupIndex] ?? movementRef.current[groupMember.id],
                    partnerId: partner?.id,
                    resumeAt: chatEndsAt,
                    nextChoiceAt: chatEndsAt + randomDelay(ROUTINE_MIN_MS, ROUTINE_MAX_MS),
                  }
                  : {
                    kind: "chat",
                    label: `💬 heading over to chat with ${otherNames}`,
                    chatTopic,
                    chatGroupId,
                    chatMemberIds: groupIds,
                    target: spots[groupIndex] ?? movementRef.current[groupMember.id],
                    partnerId: partner?.id,
                    chatHoldMs: randomDelay(45_000, 80_000),
                    nextChoiceAt: now + 90_000,
                  };
                handled.add(groupMember.id);
              });
              changed = true;
              continue;
            }
          }

          next[member.id] = resolveCrewSettleActivity(member.id, soloIdleActivity(member, now, movementRef.current[member.id], requestedKind));
          handled.add(member.id);
          changed = true;
        }
        return changed ? next : previous;
      });
    };

    updateRoutine();
    const timer = window.setInterval(updateRoutine, 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting?.taskId, activeHandoff?.event.id, activeHandoff?.phase, prefersReducedMotion, secretary.phase, ceoVisiting]);

  const movementPlanKey = MEMBERS.map((member) => {
    const activity = idleActivities[member.id];
    const target = ceoVisiting
      ? deskAnchorFor(member.id)
      : realFloorTarget(member, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff) ?? activity.target;
    return `${member.id}:${target.x},${target.y}:${activity.kind}`;
  }).join("|");

  useEffect(() => {
    MEMBERS.forEach((member) => {
      legTimeouts.current[member.id].forEach((timeoutId) => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId));
      legTimeouts.current[member.id] = [];
      const activity = idleActivities[member.id];
      const target = ceoVisiting
        ? deskAnchorFor(member.id)
        : realFloorTarget(member, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff) ?? activity.target;
      const start = movementRef.current[member.id];
      const legDurationMs = activity.kind === "scurry" ? 90 : activity.kind === "boss" ? 315 : STEP_MS;
      const needsOfficeTransit = regionAt(start) === 6 || regionAt(target) === 6;
      const path = shortestRegionPath(start, target, needsOfficeTransit ? [8] : []).slice(1);
      if (path.length === 0) {
        setMotions((previous) => ({ ...previous, [member.id]: { ...previous[member.id], walking: false } }));
        return;
      }
      path.forEach((waypoint, legIndex) => {
        const move = () => {
          const previousPoint = movementRef.current[member.id];
          movementRef.current[member.id] = waypoint;
          if (isConferenceRoomPosition(waypoint)) {
            conferenceOccupiedRef.current = true;
            dismissConferenceGhost();
          }
          setMotions((previous) => ({
            ...previous,
            [member.id]: { position: waypoint, durationMs: legDurationMs, facing: facingForStep(previousPoint, waypoint), walking: true },
          }));
        };
        const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(move, legIndex * legDurationMs);
        legTimeouts.current[member.id].push(timeoutId);
      });
      const stopId = window.setTimeout(() => {
        setMotions((previous) => ({ ...previous, [member.id]: { ...previous[member.id], walking: false } }));
      }, path.length * legDurationMs + 40);
      legTimeouts.current[member.id].push(stopId);
    });
  }, [movementPlanKey]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    Object.values(legTimeouts.current).forEach((timeouts) => timeouts.forEach((timeoutId) => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId)));
  }, []);

  function openResearchAgent(id: ResearchAgentId, status: ResearchAgentStatus) {
    const member = memberById(id);
    if (!member) return;
    onMemberOpen(member, { label: status.label, badge: status.badge, active: status.active, taskId: status.taskId, title: status.title });
  }

  const kimVisitor = MEMBERS.find((member) => idleActivities[member.id].kind === "kimChat"
    && !hasRealFloorAssignment(member.id, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff));
  const kimConversation = kimVisitor ? idleActivities[kimVisitor.id].chatTopic : undefined;
  // Kim's chat counts as a conversation only once her visitor has walked up
  // and is standing next to her — never across the room while she roams.
  const kimConversationActive = Boolean(kimVisitor
    && tileDistance(motions[kimVisitor.id].position, idleActivities[kimVisitor.id].target) === 0
    && tileDistance(motions[kimVisitor.id].position, secretary.motion.position) <= 1);
  const liveCrewStatuses = MEMBERS.map((member) => {
    const work = deskWork(member.id, tasks, briefs);
    const liveBrief = briefs.find((brief) => brief.assignee === member.id && brief.status === "in_progress");
    const motion = motions[member.id];
    const currentRegion = regionAt(motion.position);
    const approvalHuddling = member.id !== "remmy" && hasApproval && currentRegion === 4;
    const inMeeting = Boolean(meeting?.participantIds.includes(member.id)) && currentRegion === 5;
    const routineIdle = !hasRealFloorAssignment(member.id, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff);
    const activity = idleActivities[member.id];
    const isHandoffFrom = activeHandoff?.event.fromMemberId === member.id;
    const isHandoffTo = activeHandoff?.event.toMemberId === member.id;
    const isInHandoff = Boolean(isHandoffFrom || isHandoffTo);
    const handoffPartnerId = isHandoffFrom ? activeHandoff?.event.toMemberId : isHandoffTo ? activeHandoff?.event.fromMemberId : undefined;
    const handoffPartner = handoffPartnerId ? memberById(handoffPartnerId) : undefined;
    const chatGroupIds = activity.chatMemberIds ?? [member.id, ...(activity.partnerId ? [activity.partnerId] : [])];
    const chatNames = chatGroupIds.filter((memberId) => memberId !== member.id).map((memberId) => memberById(memberId)?.name).filter(Boolean).join(" & ");
    // resumeAt is only set once the group has gathered face to face (or was
    // already standing together), so the topic is never announced while
    // anyone is still walking over.
    const chatLabel = routineIdle && activity.kind === "chat" && activity.resumeAt !== undefined && activity.chatTopic && chatNames
      ? `Chatting with ${chatNames} about ${activity.chatTopic}`
      : "";
    const kimChatReady = activity.kind === "kimChat"
      && tileDistance(motion.position, activity.target) === 0
      && tileDistance(motion.position, secretary.motion.position) <= 1;
    const activityDisplayLabel = activity.kind === "kimChat" && !kimChatReady ? "💬 heading over to chat with Kim" : activity.label;
    const handoffLabel = activeHandoff?.phase === "returning"
      ? (isHandoffTo ? "Brief received — heading to desk" : "Conference handoff complete")
      : activeHandoff?.phase === "holding"
        ? (isHandoffTo ? `Receiving brief from ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}` : `Handing off to ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}`)
        : (isHandoffTo ? `Heading to handoff with ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}` : `Bringing a brief to ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}`);
    const label = ceoVisiting
      ? member.id === "remmy" ? "Trying to look calm — Ben is doing his rounds" : "Working hard while Ben does his rounds"
      : isInHandoff
        ? handoffLabel
      : approvalHuddling
        ? "In approval huddle"
        : inMeeting
          ? `In a meeting · ${meeting?.title ?? "active job"}`
          : liveBrief && work
            ? work.title
            : work
              ? work.title
              : routineIdle
                ? chatLabel || activityDisplayLabel
                : member.id === "remmy"
                  ? "Running the office"
                  : "Standing by";
    const status: FloorMemberStatus = {
      label,
      badge: chatLabel || routineIdle
        ? "Activity"
        : isInHandoff
          ? "Handoff"
          : approvalHuddling
            ? "Huddle"
            : inMeeting
              ? "Meeting"
              : liveBrief
                ? "Live"
                : work
                  ? "Working"
                  : "Standby",
      active: isInHandoff || approvalHuddling || inMeeting || Boolean(liveBrief) || Boolean(work),
      taskId: inMeeting ? meeting?.taskId : liveBrief?.taskId,
      title: inMeeting ? meeting?.title : work?.title,
    };
    return { member, status };
  }).filter(({ member }) => !(member.id === "scout" && !tomVisibleOnMain));

  // Left-panel crew list rows for the floor being viewed. The main floor's
  // rows are the liveCrewStatuses above (plus Ben while he visits this
  // floor). The other two floors report their own rows up from their

        <span className="footer-clock" aria-label={`${clock.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric" })}, ${clock.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" })}`}>{clock.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" })} · {clock.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" })}</span>
        <p className="music-credit" title="Music: Kevin MacLeod — Airport Lounge, Bossa Antigua, Casa Bossa Nova & Local Forecast · Elevator — CC-BY 4.0 · Workplace ambience: Freesound user 221296">Music: Kevin MacLeod — Airport Lounge, Bossa Antigua, Casa Bossa Nova &amp; Local Forecast · Elevator — CC-BY 4.0 · Workplace ambience: Freesound user 221296</p>
      </div>
    </aside>;

  return <div ref={fullscreenRef} className={isFullscreen ? "floor-fullscreen-shell is-maximized" : "floor-fullscreen-shell"}>
    <div className="floor-side-layout">
    {leftPanel}
    <div className="floor-frame">
    <div
      ref={floorZoom.containerRef}
      className="floor rpg-floor"
      role="region"
      data-floor={activeFloor}
      data-zoom-scale={floorZoom.zoom.scale.toFixed(3)}
      data-zoomed={floorZoom.isZoomed ? "true" : "false"}
      data-panning={floorZoom.isPanning ? "true" : "false"}
      style={floorZoom.zoomVars}
      {...floorZoom.handlers}
      data-conference-occupied={conferenceOccupied ? "true" : "false"}
      aria-label={activeFloor === "research"
        ? `Research Department floor, Pulse HQ. Walter reads, Peter verifies, Tom writes the brief, Astrid assists Walter at case intake. ${approvalCount} ${approvalCount === 1 ? "job is" : "jobs are"} waiting on you. Tap a researcher for live details.`
        : activeFloor === "front"
          ? `Front Office floor, Pulse HQ. Maria runs the client-facing department from her desk; Marni keeps reception; Ben, the CEO, works from his corner office and does his rounds from here. ${approvalCount} ${approvalCount === 1 ? "job is" : "jobs are"} waiting on you. Tap a person for live details.`
          : `Interactive RPG Maker office. ${approvalCount} ${approvalCount === 1 ? "job is" : "jobs are"} waiting on you. Tap a worker for live details.`}
    >
    {activeFloor === "research" && <ResearchFloorLayers
      tasks={tasks}

        if (tomTrip?.dir === "to-research" && tomTrip.phase === "arriving") {
          setTomSettledHome("research");
          setTomTrip(null);

      }}
      approvalCount={approvalCount}

    {activeFloor === "front" && <FrontOfficeFloorLayers
      tasks={tasks}

      ceoHome={ceoStop === "front-office" ? "office" : ceoStop === "front-tour" ? "tour" : ceoStop === "front-leaving" ? "leaving" : ceoStop === "front-entering" ? "entering" : null}
      onCeoExited={finishCeoExit}

    <audio
      ref={audioRef}
      src={OFFICE_PLAYLIST[selectedTrackIndex]?.url ?? OFFICE_PLAYLIST[0].url}
      preload="metadata"
      onEnded={() => { musicOnRef.current = false; setMusicOn(false); }}
      onPlay={() => { musicOnRef.current = true; setMusicOn(true); }}
      onPause={() => { musicOnRef.current = false; setMusicOn(false); }}
      onError={() => { musicOnRef.current = false; setMusicOn(false); }}
    />
    <audio ref={ambienceAudioRef} src={workplaceAmbienceUrl} preload="none" loop />

    {activeFloor === "main" && <div className="floor-zoom-viewport" data-zoom-viewport="main">
      <RpgMapBackground className="rpg-map-background" />
      <LoungeTvScreen />
      <div className="crt-flicker-layer" aria-hidden="true">
      <i className="crt-screen wide" style={{ left: "22.8%", top: "7.5%", width: "7%", height: "4.1%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen wide" style={{ left: "36.1%", top: "7.5%", width: "6.9%", height: "4.1%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen" style={{ left: "17.4%", top: "13.5%", width: "4.3%", height: "3.8%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen" style={{ left: "22.4%", top: "13.5%", width: "4.4%", height: "3.8%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen" style={{ left: "39%", top: "13.5%", width: "4.3%", height: "3.8%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen" style={{ left: "43.5%", top: "13.5%", width: "4.4%", height: "3.8%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen" style={{ left: "35.4%", top: "44.7%", width: "4%", height: "4.2%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen" style={{ left: "40.4%", top: "44.7%", width: "3.2%", height: "4.2%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen wide" style={{ left: "6.4%", top: "58%", width: "7.2%", height: "4.1%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen" style={{ left: "15%", top: "58%", width: "4.7%", height: "4.1%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen wide" style={{ left: "21.9%", top: "58%", width: "6.7%", height: "4.1%" }} />
      <i className="crt-screen wide" style={{ left: "77.3%", top: "58%", width: "7%", height: "4.2%" }} />
      </div>
      {DYNAMIC_FLOOR_LIGHTING_ENABLED && <div className="floor-lighting" style={lightingStyle} aria-hidden="true">
      <span className="light-tint morning-tint" />
      <span className="light-tint evening-tint" />
      <span className="light-tint night-tint" />
      <span className="fluorescent-pools" />
      <span className="fluorescent-flicker" />
      </div>}
      <div className="floor-night-exempt">

    {ghostVisible && !conferenceOccupied && <div
      className="floor-agent rpg-agent floor-ghost"
      style={{
        ...mapPointStyle(ghostHideout),
        zIndex: 1000 + (ghostHideout.y + 1) * 20 + 5,
      }}
      data-character="ghost-girl"
      data-tile={`${ghostHideout.x},${ghostHideout.y}`}
      role="img"
      aria-label="A pale little girl hiding in the conference room"
    >
      <GhostGirlSprite />
    </div>}

    {activeFloor === "main" && ceoMain.visible && <button
      type="button"
      className={`floor-agent rpg-agent floor-ben-ceo${ceoMain.motion.walking ? " is-walking" : ""}`}
      style={{
        ...mapPointStyle(ceoMain.motion.position),
        zIndex: 1000 + (ceoMain.motion.position.y + 1) * 20 + 12,
        transitionDuration: `${ceoMain.motion.durationMs}ms`,
      }}
      onClick={() => {
        const ben = memberById("ben");
        if (ben) onMemberOpen(ben, { label: "Ben is doing his rounds", badge: "Activity", active: false });
      }}
      data-character="ben-ceo"
      data-member="ben"
      data-floor="main"
      data-phase={ceoMain.phase}
      data-tile={`${ceoMain.motion.position.x},${ceoMain.motion.position.y}`}
      data-facing={ceoMain.motion.facing}
      data-walking={ceoMain.motion.walking ? "true" : "false"}
      data-status-label="Ben is doing his rounds"
      aria-label={`Open Ben live details, Ben is doing his rounds on the main floor${ceoMain.phase === "inspecting" ? ", looking over the crew's work" : ceoMain.phase === "leaving" ? ", heading back to the Front Office" : ", arriving unannounced"}`}
    >
      <span className="agent-head-tag" aria-hidden="true"><i className="agent-head-name">Ben</i><i className="agent-status-symbol live" /></span>
      <BenCeoSprite facing={ceoMain.motion.facing} frame={ceoMain.motion.walking ? ([0, 1, 2, 1] as const)[walkTick % 4] ?? 1 : 1} />
    </button>}

    <div
      className={`floor-agent rpg-agent floor-chunk${chunk.motion.walking ? " is-walking" : ""}${chunk.phase === "checking" ? " is-checking" : ""}${chunk.onDesk ? " is-on-desk" : ""}${chunk.shadesOn ? " has-shades" : ""}`}
      style={{
        ...mapPointStyle(chunk.motion.position),
        zIndex: 1000 + (chunk.motion.position.y + 1) * 20 + (chunk.onDesk ? 34 : 8),
        transitionDuration: `${chunk.motion.durationMs}ms`,
      }}
      data-character="chunk"
      data-phase={chunk.phase}
      data-tile={`${chunk.motion.position.x},${chunk.motion.position.y}`}
      data-facing={chunk.motion.facing}
      data-walking={chunk.motion.walking ? "true" : "false"}
      data-keyboard-target={chunk.keyboardTargetId ?? undefined}
      data-shades={chunk.shadesOn ? "true" : "false"}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`Chunk, office cat, ${chunk.label.toLocaleLowerCase()}${chunk.shadesOn ? ", wearing sunglasses" : ""}`}
    >
      <span className="agent-head-tag" aria-hidden="true"><i className="agent-head-name">Chunk</i><i className={`agent-status-symbol ${chunk.phase === "checking" ? "live" : "standby"}`} /></span>
      <ChunkSprite facing={chunk.motion.facing} frame={chunk.motion.walking ? ([0, 1, 2, 1] as const)[walkTick % 4] ?? 1 : 1} />
      {chunk.shadesOn && <span className="chunk-shades" aria-hidden="true">🕶️</span>}
    </div>

    <div
      className={`floor-agent rpg-agent floor-secretary${secretary.motion.walking ? " is-walking" : ""}${secretary.activityKind === "watering" ? " is-watering" : ""}`}
      style={{
        ...mapPointStyle(secretary.motion.position),
        zIndex: 1000 + (secretary.motion.position.y + 1) * 20 + 10,
        transitionDuration: `${secretary.motion.durationMs}ms`,
      }}
      data-character="kim"
      data-activity={secretary.activityKind}
      data-tile={`${secretary.motion.position.x},${secretary.motion.position.y}`}
      data-facing={secretary.phase === "desk" ? "up" : secretary.motion.facing}
      data-walking={secretary.motion.walking ? "true" : "false"}
      role="img"
      aria-label={kimVisitor && kimConversationActive
        ? `Kim, secretary, chatting with ${kimVisitor.name} about ${kimConversation ?? "the office"}`
        : `Kim, secretary, ${secretary.label.toLocaleLowerCase()}`}
    >
      <span className="agent-head-tag" aria-hidden="true"><i className="agent-head-name">Kim</i><i className={`agent-status-symbol ${secretary.activityKind === "desk" ? "standby" : "activity"}`} /></span>
      <SecretarySprite
        facing={secretary.phase === "desk" ? "up" : secretary.motion.facing}
        frame={secretary.motion.walking ? ([0, 1, 2, 1] as const)[walkTick % 4] ?? 1 : 1}
      />
    </div>

    {MEMBERS.map((member, index) => {
      // Tom is never in two places at once: he renders on the main floor only
      // while it is his settled home, while he is walking out its front door,
      // or while he is walking in from it. Mid-trip he is on neither floor.
      if (member.id === "scout" && !tomVisibleOnMain) return null;
      const work = deskWork(member.id, tasks, briefs);
      const working = Boolean(work?.active);
      const liveBrief = briefs.find((brief) => brief.assignee === member.id && brief.status === "in_progress");
      const isLive = Boolean(liveBrief);
      const motion = motions[member.id];
      const currentRegion = regionAt(motion.position);
      const approvalHuddling = member.id !== "remmy" && hasApproval && currentRegion === 4;
      const inMeeting = Boolean(meeting?.participantIds.includes(member.id)) && currentRegion === 5;
      const routineIdle = !hasRealFloorAssignment(member.id, tasks, briefs, hasApproval, meeting, activeHandoff);
      const activity = idleActivities[member.id];
      const isHandoffFrom = activeHandoff?.event.fromMemberId === member.id;
      const isHandoffTo = activeHandoff?.event.toMemberId === member.id;
      const isInHandoff = Boolean(isHandoffFrom || isHandoffTo);
      const handoffPartnerId = isHandoffFrom ? activeHandoff?.event.toMemberId : isHandoffTo ? activeHandoff?.event.fromMemberId : undefined;
      const handoffPartner = handoffPartnerId ? memberById(handoffPartnerId) : undefined;
      const huddling = approvalHuddling;
      const atDesk = tileDistance(motion.position, deskAnchorFor(member.id)) === 0;
      const activityLabel = activity.label;
      const chatGroupIds = activity.chatMemberIds ?? [member.id, ...(activity.partnerId ? [activity.partnerId] : [])];
      const chatNames = chatGroupIds.filter((memberId) => memberId !== member.id).map((memberId) => memberById(memberId)?.name).filter(Boolean).join(" & ");
      // The topic line only exists once the conversation has started —
      // resumeAt is set on arrival (or at creation when already together).
      const chatBubbleLabel = routineIdle && activity.kind === "chat" && activity.resumeAt !== undefined && activity.chatTopic && chatNames
        ? `chatting with ${chatNames} about ${activity.chatTopic}`
        : "";
      const kimChatReady = activity.kind === "kimChat"
        && tileDistance(motion.position, activity.target) === 0
        && tileDistance(motion.position, secretary.motion.position) <= 1;
      const displayActivityLabel = activity.kind === "kimChat" && !kimChatReady ? "💬 heading over to chat with Kim" : activityLabel;
      const handoffLabel = activeHandoff?.phase === "returning"
        ? (isHandoffTo ? "Brief received — heading to desk" : "Conference handoff complete")
        : activeHandoff?.phase === "holding"
          ? (isHandoffTo ? `Receiving brief from ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"} in conference room` : `Handing off to ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"} in conference room`)
          : (isHandoffTo ? `Heading to conference room with ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}` : `Bringing brief to conference room for ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}`);
      const handoffPopupLabel = !isInHandoff ? ""
        : activeHandoff?.phase === "returning"
          ? (isHandoffTo ? `Received from ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}` : `Passed to ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}`)
          : (isHandoffTo ? `Receiving from ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}` : `Passing to ${handoffPartner?.name ?? "crew"}`);
      const focusLabel = ceoVisiting
        ? member.id === "remmy" ? "Trying to look calm — Ben is doing his rounds" : "Working hard while Ben does his rounds"
        : isInHandoff
          ? handoffLabel
        : approvalHuddling
          ? "In approval huddle"
          : inMeeting
            ? `In a meeting · ${meeting?.title ?? "active job"}`
            : isLive && work
              ? work.title
              : working && work
                ? work.title
                : routineIdle
                  ? displayActivityLabel
                  : member.id === "remmy"
                    ? "Running the office"
                    : "Standing by";
      const partnerMotion = activity.partnerId ? motions[activity.partnerId] : undefined;
      const chatMemberIds = activity.chatMemberIds ?? [member.id, ...(activity.partnerId ? [activity.partnerId] : [])];
      const conversationActive = routineIdle
        && activity.kind === "chat"
        && activity.resumeAt !== undefined
        && chatMemberIds.length >= 2
        && chatPositionsGathered(chatMemberIds.map((memberId) => motions[memberId].position))
        && chatMemberIds.every((memberId) => {
          const groupActivity = idleActivities[memberId];
          const groupMotion = motions[memberId];
          return groupActivity.kind === "chat"
            && groupActivity.chatGroupId === activity.chatGroupId
            && !groupMotion.walking
            && tileDistance(groupMotion.position, groupActivity.target) === 0;
        });
      const chatFacing = conversationActive && partnerMotion
        ? facingForStep(motion.position, partnerMotion.position)
        : motion.facing;
      const ambientFacing = routineIdle && activity.kind === "kimChat" && kimChatReady
        ? facingForStep(motion.position, secretary.motion.position)
        : chatFacing;
      const handoffPartnerMotion = handoffPartnerId ? motions[handoffPartnerId] : undefined;
      const handoffFacing = isInHandoff
        && activeHandoff?.phase === "holding"
        && handoffPartnerMotion
        ? facingForStep(motion.position, handoffPartnerMotion.position)
        : ambientFacing;
      // The chair tile south of a worker's desk is his desk station (see
      // FLOOR_WORKER_DESK_STATIONS): standing there counts as at his desk
      // and faces north, even though the desk anchor itself is a blocked
      // tile he can never stand on. Like the Research Department's station
      // table, an active face-to-face conversation still turns him toward
      // his partner — but the moment the conversation ends, or work (or a
      // Maria inspection) has him at his desk, he settles back to north
      // instead of keeping whatever facing his last step left him with.
      const deskStationFacing = !motion.walking && !conversationActive
        ? deskStationFacingFor(member.id, motion.position)
        : undefined;
      // Settled at a plant stop, the member faces the plant they are
      // inspecting — the stop was chosen beside it for exactly this.
      const plantFacing = !motion.walking && routineIdle && activity.kind === "plants" ? activity.facing : undefined;
      const northFacingStation = !motion.walking && (atDesk || currentRegion === 5 || huddling);
      const idleRemmySeated = member.id === "remmy" && routineIdle && atDesk && !motion.walking && activity.kind === "chief";
      const displayFacing: Facing = idleRemmySeated ? "down" : northFacingStation ? "up" : deskStationFacing ?? plantFacing ?? handoffFacing;
      const accessibleFocusLabel = chatBubbleLabel || focusLabel;
      const floorStatus: FloorMemberStatus = {
        label: accessibleFocusLabel,
        badge: chatBubbleLabel || routineIdle
          ? "Activity"
          : isInHandoff
            ? "Handoff"
            : approvalHuddling
              ? "Huddle"
              : inMeeting
                ? "Meeting"
                : isLive
                  ? "Live"
                  : work
                    ? "Working"
                    : "Standby",
        active: isInHandoff || approvalHuddling || inMeeting || isLive || Boolean(work),
        taskId: inMeeting ? meeting?.taskId : liveBrief?.taskId,
        title: inMeeting ? meeting?.title : work?.title,
      };
      const frameCycle = [0, 1, 2, 1] as const;
      const spriteFrame = motion.walking ? (frameCycle[walkTick % frameCycle.length] ?? 1) : 1;
      const classes = [
        "floor-agent",
        "rpg-agent",
        `label-tier-${index % 2}`,
        working && !hasApproval ? "working" : "",
        isLive ? "is-live" : "",
        isInHandoff ? "is-handoff" : "",
        huddling ? "huddling" : "",
        activity.scolding ? "is-scolding" : "",
        activity.kind === "scurry" ? "is-scurrying" : "",
        activity.kind === "boss" && motion.walking ? "is-marching" : "",
        ceoVisiting ? "under-inspection" : "",
        motion.walking ? "is-walking" : "",
      ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      return <button
        className={classes}
        key={member.id}
        style={{
          ...mapPointStyle(motion.position),
          zIndex: 1000 + (motion.position.y + 1) * 20 + 10,
          transitionDuration: `${motion.durationMs}ms`,
        }}
        onClick={() => onMemberOpen(member, floorStatus)}
        data-member={member.id}
        data-activity={activity.kind}
        data-tile={`${motion.position.x},${motion.position.y}`}
        data-facing={displayFacing}
        data-desk-station={deskStationFacing !== undefined ? "true" : "false"}
        data-chat-topic={chatBubbleLabel || undefined}
        data-conversation-active={conversationActive ? "true" : "false"}
        data-status-label={accessibleFocusLabel}
        data-walking={motion.walking ? "true" : "false"}
        aria-label={`Open ${member.name} live details, ${accessibleFocusLabel}${isLive ? ", currently active" : ""}${isInHandoff ? ", real brief handoff in progress" : ""}${approvalHuddling ? ", sitting in the approval huddle" : ""}`}
      >
        <span className="agent-head-tag" aria-hidden="true"><i className="agent-head-name">{member.name}</i><i className={`agent-status-symbol ${floorStatus.badge.toLocaleLowerCase()}${conversationActive ? " conversation" : ""}`} /></span>
        {handoffPopupLabel && <span className="handoff-callout" aria-hidden="true">{handoffPopupLabel}</span>}
        {chunk.keyboardTargetId === member.id && chunk.reaction && <span key={chunk.reactionKey} className={`chunk-reaction${chunk.reaction === "💢" ? " is-mad" : ""}${chunk.reaction === "💛" ? " is-fond" : ""}`} data-chunk-reaction={chunk.reaction} aria-hidden="true">{chunk.reaction}</span>}
        {member.id === "remmy" && activity.scolding && <span className="roundup-mark boss-mark" aria-hidden="true">!</span>}
        {member.id === "remmy" && ceoVisiting && <span className="roundup-mark fear-mark" aria-hidden="true">!!</span>}
        {member.id !== "remmy" && activity.kind === "scurry" && <span className="roundup-mark panic-mark" aria-hidden="true">!!</span>}
        <AgentSprite agentId={member.id} facing={displayFacing} frame={northFacingStation ? 1 : spriteFrame} />
      </button>;
    })}
      </div>
    </div>}
    {activeFloor === "main" && <>
      {activeHandoff && <div className="handoff-truth-banner" data-zoom-ignore role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <span>Real chain</span>
        <b>{memberById(activeHandoff.event.fromMemberId)?.name ?? "Crew"} → {memberById(activeHandoff.event.toMemberId)?.name ?? "Crew"}</b>
      </div>}
      {approvalCount > 0 && <div className="map-status approval-status" data-zoom-ignore style={{ zIndex: 2600 }} aria-label={`${approvalCount} jobs waiting on you`}>
        <span>Needs you</span><b>{approvalCount}</b>
      </div>}
    </>}
    {floorZoom.isZoomed && <button
      type="button"
      className="floor-zoom-reset"
      data-zoom-ignore
      onClick={floorZoom.resetZoom}
      aria-label="Reset map zoom to full floor view"
      title="Reset zoom — or double-click the map"
    ><span aria-hidden="true">⤢</span><b>{Math.round(floorZoom.zoom.scale * 100)}% · Reset view</b></button>}
    </div>
    </div>
    {rightPanel}
    </div>
    <div className="floor-overlay-host" ref={overlayHostRef} />
  </div>;
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from "react";

type Task = OfficeState["tasks"][number];
type Brief = OfficeState["briefs"][number];
type Blocker = OfficeState["blockers"][number];
type Pkg = OfficeState["packages"][number];
