const MEMBER_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  remmy: "Remmy", scout: "Tom", forge: "Nik", quill: "Johnny", ledger: "Sven",
  walter: "Walter", peter: "Peter", olivia: "Olivia", maria: "Maria",
};
const memberName = (id: string) => MEMBER_NAMES[id] ?? "Remmy";
type OfficeLogEntry = OfficeState["log"][number];
// The classic office's member-card helpers, copied in behaviour so a
// floor click here shows the SAME personal pop-up the classic floor
// shows: same live status, same stage track, same recent activity.
const LEGACY_MEMBER_NAMES: Record<string, string> = { Scout: "Tom", Forge: "Nik", Quill: "Johnny", Ledger: "Sven" };
function displayMemberNames(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/\b(?:Scout|Forge|Quill|Ledger)\b/g, (name) => LEGACY_MEMBER_NAMES[name] ?? name);
}
function formatStamp(value: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }).format(new Date(value));
}
function elapsedLabel(startedAt: string, clock: Date): string {
  const elapsedSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor((clock.getTime() - new Date(startedAt).getTime()) / 1000));
  if (elapsedSeconds < 60) return `${elapsedSeconds}s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(elapsedSeconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  const remainder = minutes % 60;
  return remainder ? `${hours}h ${remainder}m` : `${hours}h`;
}
function crewStageFor(task: Task | undefined, brief: Brief | undefined): { label: string; steps: string[]; currentIndex: number } {
  if (!task) return { label: brief?.status === "in_progress" ? "Being worked" : "Standing by", steps: ["Being worked", "Waiting on You", "Done"], currentIndex: 0 };
  const steps = ["Being worked", "Waiting on You", "Done"];
  const currentIndex: Record<Task["status"], number> = { working: 0, approval: 1, done: 2 };
  const fallback = task.status === "done" ? "Done" : task.status === "approval" ? "Waiting on You" : "Being worked";
  return { label: brief?.progressText || fallback, steps, currentIndex: currentIndex[task.status] };
}
// The classic office's assignability rule: Astrid, September, Ben, and
// Marni are support presences who take no briefs, so their cards carry
// no Create work button — exactly as in the classic office.
const NON_ASSIGNABLE_MEMBER_IDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["astrid", "september", "ben", "marni"]);
function FloorMemberAvatar({ member }: { member: Member }) {
  const hasPortrait = hasMemberPortrait(member.id);
  return <span className={`nb-member-avatar${hasPortrait ? " nb-has-portrait" : ""}`} style={{ background: member.color }} aria-hidden="true">{hasPortrait ? <MemberPortrait memberId={member.id} /> : member.name[0]}</span>;
}
const JOB_TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  standard: "Standard job", research: "Research", x_posts: "X posts",
  perfectly_paranoid: "Perfectly Paranoid", market_briefing: "Market briefing",
  creative_package: "Creative package", client_report: "Client report",
};
const CREW_IDS = ["scout", "forge", "quill", "ledger", "walter", "peter", "olivia", "maria"] as const;
// Every member id the classic floor can name (App.tsx's AnyMemberId) —
// used to stamp inbox arrivals for the embedded floor.
const FLOOR_MEMBER_IDS = new Set(["remmy", "scout", "forge", "quill", "ledger", "walter", "peter", "olivia", "astrid", "september", "maria", "ben", "marni"]);
// The classic App portals its Work panel into the floor's overlay host;
// this interface routes Work through its own door instead, so the host
// stays empty here.
const noopOverlayHost = (_element: HTMLDivElement | null) => undefined;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// Membership rules — the SAME definitions the classic client uses
// (App.tsx), so both interfaces agree on what needs Ben and what is a
// deliverable. Copied verbatim in behaviour; do not let them drift.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function isPublishablePostTask(task: Pick<Task, "pipeline">): boolean {
  return task.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid";
}
function isApprovedPackage(task: Pick<Task, "pipeline" | "status" | "publicationStatus" | "clientId">): boolean {
  return isPublishablePostTask(task)
    && (!task.clientId || task.clientId === PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID)
    && task.status === "approval"
    && (task.publicationStatus === "awaiting_manual_publish" || task.publicationStatus === "approved_posting" || task.publicationStatus === "preparing_upload");
}
function isPostedPackage(task: Pick<Task, "publicationStatus" | "postedAt">): boolean {
  return Boolean(task.postedAt) || task.publicationStatus === "posted";
}
function isLibraryTask(task: Task): boolean {
  if (isApprovedPackage(task)) return false;
  if (task.status === "working") return false;
  if (isPublishablePostTask(task) && isPostedPackage(task) && isPostSelfCleared(task.postedAt)) return false;
  if (task.pipeline === "research_case" && task.clientId && task.clientId !== PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID) return false;
  return task.approvedAt !== null || isPostedPackage(task);
}
function isReadyForYouTask(task: Task, blockedTaskIds: ReadonlySet<string>): boolean {
  if (task.standingOrderId) return false;
  if (task.pipeline === "client_delivery") return false;
  if (blockedTaskIds.has(task.id)) return true;
  if (task.status !== "approval" || isApprovedPackage(task)) return false;
  if (task.clientId && task.clientId !== PERFECTLY_PARANOID_CLIENT_ID && !isBounceExhausted(task.contractStatus, task.contractBounces)) return false;
  return true;
}
function waitingSinceForTask(task: Task, briefs: Brief[], blockers: Blocker[]): string {
  let latest = 0;
  for (const brief of briefs) {
    if (brief.taskId !== task.id) continue;
    const time = new Date(brief.updatedAt).getTime();
    if (time > latest) latest = time;
  }
  if (latest > 0) return new Date(latest).toISOString();
  let earliest = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for (const blocker of blockers) {
    if (blocker.taskId !== task.id) continue;
    const time = new Date(blocker.createdAt).getTime();
    if (time < earliest) earliest = time;
  }
  if (earliest !== Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) return new Date(earliest).toISOString();
  return task.created;
}
function formatWaitingStamp(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  const time = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }).format(date);
  const startOfDay = (day: Date) => new Date(day.getFullYear(), day.getMonth(), day.getDate()).getTime();
  const dayDiff = Math.round((startOfDay(new Date()) - startOfDay(date)) / 86_400_000);
  if (dayDiff === 0) return `Today ${time}`;
  if (dayDiff === 1) return `Yesterday ${time}`;
  const datePart = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", ...(date.getFullYear() !== new Date().getFullYear() ? { year: "numeric" as const } : {}) }).format(date);
  return `${datePart}, ${time}`;
}
function waitingLabel(sinceIso: string): string {
  const ms = Date.now() - new Date(sinceIso).getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(ms) || ms < 0) return "Waiting";
  const minutes = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
  if (minutes < 1) return "Waiting just now";
  if (minutes < 60) return `Waiting ${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `Waiting ${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return `Waiting ${days} day${days === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
}
function isToday(iso: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!iso) return false;
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const now = new Date();
  return d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() && d.getMonth() === now.getMonth() && d.getDate() === now.getDate();
}
function money(cents: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (cents === null || cents === undefined) return "—";
  return `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
}
function firstLine(text: string | null | undefined, max = 180): string {
  if (!text) return "";
  const line = text.split("\n").map((part) => part.trim()).find((part) => part.length > 0) ?? "";
  const clean = line.replace(/^#+\s*/, "").replace(/\*\*/g, "");
  return clean.length > max ? `${clean.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : clean;
}
// The first real prose line of a document — never a bare markdown heading
// or a label-only line ("SUMMARY", "Verdict"), which read as an empty slot
// on a card face instead of the result.
function firstProseLine(text: string | null | undefined, max = 220): string {
  if (!text) return "";
  for (const raw of text.split("\n")) {
    const line = raw.trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    if (line.startsWith("#")) continue;
    const bare = line.replace(/[*_`]/g, "").trim();
    if (/^(?:summary|verdict)$/i.test(bare)) continue;
    const clean = line.replace(/\*\*/g, "");
    return clean.length > max ? `${clean.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : clean;
  }
  return "";
}
async function copyText(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    return true;
  } catch {
    const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
    ta.value = text;
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    let ok = false;
    try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch { ok = false; }
    ta.remove();
    return ok;
  }
}

function Corners() {
  return <><span className="nb-cnr nb-tl" /><span className="nb-cnr nb-tr" /><span className="nb-cnr nb-bl" /><span className="nb-cnr nb-br" /></>;
}
function Badge({ tone, children }: { tone?: "blue" | "amber" | "red" | "green" | "gray"; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <span className={`nb-badge${tone ? ` nb-${tone}` : ""}`}><span className="nb-dot" />{children}</span>;
}
function DoorHead({ eyebrow, children, sub }: { eyebrow: string; children: ReactNode; sub?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="nb-door-head">
      <p className="nb-eyebrow"><span className="nb-tick">▸</span> {eyebrow}</p>
      <h1 className="nb-answer" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{children}</h1>
      {sub ? <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{sub}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// The verdict a Decide card leads with: the job's answer (the primary
// deliverable's verdict paragraph) first, then the package summary.
function verdictForTask(task: Task, briefs: Brief[], deliverables?: Deliverables): string {
  if (deliverables?.answer) return deliverables.answer;
  if (deliverables?.packageSummary) return deliverables.packageSummary;
  if (task.escalationClaimCount !== null && task.escalationClaimCount !== undefined && task.escalationClaimCount > 0) {
    const documented = task.escalationDocumented ?? 0;
    return `${documented} of ${task.escalationClaimCount} claims documented — every claim checked and labelled.`;
  }
  const mine = briefs.filter((b) => b.taskId === task.id && b.result).sort((a, b) => b.stepIndex - a.stepIndex);
  const latest = mine[0];
  if (latest?.result) {
    const line = firstProseLine(latest.result, 220);
    if (line) return line;
  }
  if (task.contractStatus === "bounced" && task.contractViolation) return `Held by its outcome check: ${task.contractViolation}`;
  return firstLine(task.notes, 220) || "Finished and waiting on your call.";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// The claims check, in plain words (Ben's refinement): a tally sentence
// full of all-caps labels ("All 34 claims held up as DOCUMENTED, with
// 0 MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION, …") is computer lingo, not an answer a
// person can read. Inside Specifics the check renders as a small
// structured block instead: how many claims were checked, then the
// outcome per label in plain words / short chips. The counts are parsed
// from the tally text the verifier already authored — no new claims
// data model.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
type ClaimCheck = { total: number; documented: number; mainstream: number; fringe: number; notVerified: number };
function parseClaimCheck(text: string | null | undefined): ClaimCheck | null {
  if (!text) return null;
  const numBefore = (re: RegExp): number | null => {
    const m = re.exec(text);
    return m?.[1] ? Number.parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;
  };
  const mainstream = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION/i);
  const fringe = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+FRINGE CLAIM/i);
  const notVerified = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+NOT VERIFIED/i);
  let documented = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+(?:claims\s+)?held up as DOCUMENTED/i);
  let total = numBefore(/all\s+(\d+)\s+claims held up/i) ?? numBefore(/(\d+)\s+claims checked/i);
  if (documented === null && total !== null && mainstream !== null && fringe !== null && notVerified !== null) documented = total - mainstream - fringe - notVerified;
  if (total === null && documented !== null && mainstream !== null && fringe !== null && notVerified !== null) total = documented + mainstream + fringe + notVerified;
  if (total === null || documented === null || Number.isNaN(total) || Number.isNaN(documented)) return null;
  return { total, documented, mainstream: mainstream ?? 0, fringe: fringe ?? 0, notVerified: notVerified ?? 0 };
}
function findClaimCheck(sources: Array<string | null | undefined>): ClaimCheck | null {
  for (const source of sources) {
    const check = parseClaimCheck(source);
    if (check) return check;
  }
  return null;
}
// The claim-check grades (Research Department, 2026-10-22): a second,
// independent pass grades every claim strong / supported / shaky /
// misframed on provenance, triangulation, definition fit, and
// vintage/scope, and the brief's verdict rests only on the strong and
// supported claims. The counts are parsed from the tally the
// claim-checker (and the brief's SUMMARY) already state in plain words —
// the same read-the-authored-tally approach as the verifier check above.
type GradeCheck = { total: number; strong: number; supported: number; shaky: number; misframed: number };
function parseGradeCheck(text: string | null | undefined): GradeCheck | null {
  if (!text) return null;
  const numBefore = (re: RegExp): number | null => {
    const m = re.exec(text);
    return m?.[1] ? Number.parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;
  };
  const strong = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+strong\b/i);
  const supported = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+supported\b/i);
  const shaky = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+shaky\b/i);
  const misframed = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+misframed\b/i);
  if (strong === null || supported === null || shaky === null || misframed === null) return null;
  const total = numBefore(/(\d+)\s+claims checked/i) ?? strong + supported + shaky + misframed;
  if (Number.isNaN(total)) return null;
  return { total, strong, supported, shaky, misframed };
}
function findGradeCheck(sources: Array<string | null | undefined>): GradeCheck | null {
  for (const source of sources) {
    const check = parseGradeCheck(source);
    if (check) return check;
  }
  return null;
}
function plainCheckLine(check: ClaimCheck): string {
  if (check.documented === check.total) return `${check.total} claims checked — all held up as documented. Nothing failed checking.`;
  return `${check.total} claims checked — ${check.documented} held up as documented, ${check.mainstream} mainstream interpretation, ${check.fringe} fringe claim, ${check.notVerified} not verified.`;
}
// A summary line for a Specifics contents row: a tally line becomes its
// plain structured line; any other all-caps label phrase is written in
// plain words, never left as an all-caps sentence.
function plainSpecificsSummary(text: string | null | undefined, fallback: string): string {
  if (!text) return fallback;
  const check = parseClaimCheck(text);
  if (check) return plainCheckLine(check);
  return text
    .replace(/MAINSTREAM INTERPRETATION/g, "mainstream interpretation")
    .replace(/FRINGE CLAIM/g, "fringe claim")
    .replace(/NOT VERIFIED/g, "not verified")
    .replace(/\bDOCUMENTED\b/g, "documented");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// DECIDE — the front page, composed as frozen in the reference:
// "N waiting on you", then verdict-first cards carrying their decision
// buttons on the card itself.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function DecideCard({ ctx, task }: { ctx: Ctx; task: Task }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const blockers = data.blockers.filter((b) => b.taskId === task.id && b.status === "open");
  const blocker = blockers[0];
  const deliverables = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["nb-deliverables", task.id],
    queryFn: () => api.get_task_deliverables({ taskId: task.id }),
    enabled: !blocker && task.status === "approval",
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
  const since = waitingSinceForTask(task, data.briefs, data.blockers);
  const images = (deliverables.data?.items ?? []).filter((item) => item.kind === "image" && item.imageUrl);
  const client = task.clientId ? data.clients.find((c) => c.id === task.clientId) : undefined;
  const approve = () => void ctx.run(`approve-${task.id}`, () => api.set_task_status({ id: task.id, status: "done" }), "Approved — the job is done.");
  return (
    <article className="nb-card nb-hot">
      <Corners />
      <p className="nb-eyebrow">{blocker ? "Needs your answer" : "Needs your call"}</p>
      <h2 className="nb-title">{task.title}</h2>
      {blocker ? (
        <>
          <p className="nb-verdict">{blocker.question}</p>
          <p className="nb-stamp">{waitingLabel(since)} · {memberName(blocker.memberId)} is stuck on this</p>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 14, display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <button type="button" className="nb-pill nb-primary" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "answer", blockerId: blocker.id })}>Answer</button>
            <button type="button" className="nb-pill nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "delete-task", taskId: task.id })}>Delete job</button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p className="nb-verdict">{verdictForTask(task, data.briefs, deliverables.data)}</p>
          {task.gradingStatus === "incomplete" && (
            <p role="alert" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
              <Badge tone="red">⚠ GRADING INCOMPLETE — not fully checked</Badge>
              <span className="nb-sub" style={{ display: "block", marginTop: 6 }}>
                {task.gradingIncompleteIds.length} of {task.gradingManifestCount} claims could not be accounted for in the claim-check{task.gradingIncompleteIds.length > 0 ? `: ${task.gradingIncompleteIds.join(", ")}` : ""}. The verdict rests only on the claims that were graded strong or supported.
              </span>
            </p>
          )}
          {images.length > 0 && (
            <div className="nb-strip">
              {images.slice(0, 6).map((item) => <img key={item.relativePath} src={item.imageUrl ?? ""} alt={item.humanTitle || item.fileName} />)}
            </div>
          )}
          <p className="nb-stamp">
            {waitingLabel(since)}
            {client ? ` · For ${client.businessName}` : ""}
            {task.escalationClaimCount ? ` · ${task.escalationClaimCount} claims checked, all labelled` : ""}
          </p>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <button type="button" className="nb-linkish" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "task", taskId: task.id, back: "decide" })}>Open →</button>
          </div>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 14, display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <button type="button" className="nb-pill nb-primary" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={approve}>Approve</button>
            <button type="button" className="nb-pill" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "sendback", taskId: task.id })}>Send back</button>
            <button type="button" className="nb-pill nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "delete-task", taskId: task.id })}>Delete</button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

function DecideDoor({ ctx }: { ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { data } = ctx;
  const blockedTaskIds = useMemo(() => new Set(data.blockers.filter((b) => b.status === "open").map((b) => b.taskId)), [data.blockers]);
  const ready = useMemo(
    () => data.tasks.filter((t) => isReadyForYouTask(t, blockedTaskIds)).sort((a, b) => waitingSinceForTask(a, data.briefs, data.blockers).localeCompare(waitingSinceForTask(b, data.briefs, data.blockers))),
    [data.tasks, data.briefs, data.blockers, blockedTaskIds],
  );
  const oldest = ready[0];
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <div className="nb-door-head">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow"><span className="nb-tick">▸</span> Decide</p>
        <h1 className="nb-answer" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          {ready.length === 0 ? <>All clear — <span className="nb-hl">nothing waits on you.</span></> : <>{ready.length} waiting on you{oldest ? <> — <span className="nb-hl">the oldest is “{oldest.title.length > 44 ? `${oldest.title.slice(0, 44)}…` : oldest.title}”.</span></> : null}</>}
        </h1>
      </div>
      {ready.map((task) => <DecideCard key={task.id} ctx={ctx} task={task} />)}
      {ready.length === 0 && (
        <article className="nb-card">
          <p className="nb-eyebrow">The queue is empty</p>
          <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Finished work and the crew's questions land here the moment they need you. Everything else is in Work.</p>
        </article>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// LAB EXTRAS (Change 2) — source provenance records, the measurement
// block, and the standard-vs-tiered A/B comparison, all inside the
// Breakdown. Provenance is shown as recorded; measurements are computed
// from the stored manifest, grades, and provenance records.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
const DOC_TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  primary_document: "Primary document", official_statistics: "Official statistics", vendor_page: "Vendor page",
  compilation_roundup: "Compilation / roundup", news_report: "News report", other: "Other",
};
const INDEPENDENCE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  independent: "Independent source", same_owner_family: "Same-owner family as another gathered source", syndicated_copy: "Syndicated / copied version of another source",
};
type LabGrading = Deliverables["grading"];
type LabMeasurements = LabGrading["measurements"];

function pctLabel(rate: number | null): string {
  return rate === null ? "—" : `${Math.round(rate * 1000) / 10}%`;
}

function LabMeasurementsBlock({ measurements, heading }: { measurements: LabMeasurements; heading: string }) {
  const m = measurements;
  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
      <p className="nb-eyebrow">{heading}</p>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
        <b>{m.totalClaims} claims</b> · graded {m.gradedCount} of {m.totalClaims} ({pctLabel(m.completenessRate)} complete)
        {m.unaccountedCount > 0 ? <> · {m.unaccountedCount} with no grade yet</> : null}
      </p>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: 8 }}>
        {m.dispositions.map((entry) => (
          <Badge key={entry.disposition} tone={entry.disposition === "STRONG" ? "green" : entry.disposition === "SUPPORTED" ? "blue" : entry.disposition === "SHAKY" ? "amber" : entry.disposition === "MISFRAMED" || entry.disposition === "UNGRADED" ? "red" : "gray"}>
            {entry.disposition.charAt(0) + entry.disposition.slice(1).toLowerCase()} · {entry.count} ({pctLabel(entry.rate)})
          </Badge>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
        Weak-source share: <b>{m.weakSourceShare === null ? "not measurable yet" : `${pctLabel(m.weakSourceShare)} of claims with a recorded source`}</b>
        {m.weakSourceEligible > 0 ? <> — {m.weakSourceClaims} of {m.weakSourceEligible} claims rest only on secondary sources (no primary source recorded behind them)</> : <> — no claim resolves to a provenance record yet</>}
        {" "}· Provenance records: {m.provenanceRecords} sources, covering {m.claimsWithProvenance} of {m.totalClaims} claims.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function LabBreakdownExtras({ ctx, task, grading }: { ctx: Ctx; task: Task; grading: LabGrading }) {
  const [compareId, setCompareId] = useState("");
  const candidates = ctx.data.tasks.filter((t) => t.id !== task.id && (t.jobType === "research" || t.pipeline === "research_case"));
  const comparison = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["nb-lab-compare", task.id, compareId],
    queryFn: () => api.compare_research_jobs({ taskIdA: task.id, taskIdB: compareId }),
    enabled: compareId !== "",
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
  const compared = comparison.data?.jobs ?? [];
  const mine = compared.find((job) => job.taskId === task.id);
  const other = compared.find((job) => job.taskId === compareId);
  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
      <p className="nb-eyebrow">Gathering mode &amp; measurements</p>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
        This job gathered in <b>{grading.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? "tiered" : "standard"} mode</b>
        {grading.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? " — figures found in secondary sources were chased to their primary source first; the outcome is on each source's record below." : " — sources were gathered as found."}
      </p>
      <LabMeasurementsBlock measurements={grading.measurements} heading="Measurements — this job" />
      <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Source provenance — what stands behind the claims</p>
        {grading.provenance.length === 0 && <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>No provenance records yet — the gatherer records one for every source as the case is gathered.</p>}
        {grading.provenance.map((record) => (
          <div key={record.sourceRef} className="nb-logline">
            <span className="nb-logtime">{record.publisher}{record.vintage ? ` · ${record.vintage}` : ""}</span>
            <b style={{ color: "var(--nb-ink)" }}>{record.tier === "primary" ? "Primary" : "Secondary"} · {DOC_TYPE_LABELS[record.docType] ?? record.docType}</b>
            <> — {INDEPENDENCE_LABELS[record.independence] ?? record.independence}{record.independenceNote ? ` (${record.independenceNote})` : ""}</>
            <span style={{ display: "block", wordBreak: "break-all" }}>{record.sourceRef.startsWith("http") ? <a href={record.sourceRef} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{record.sourceRef}</a> : record.sourceRef}</span>
            {record.primaryRef ? <span style={{ display: "block" }}>Primary source it derives from: <span style={{ wordBreak: "break-all" }}>{record.primaryRef}</span></span> : null}
            {record.primaryAttempt ? <span style={{ display: "block" }}>Primary retrieval (tiered gathering): {record.primaryAttempt}</span> : null}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Compare gathering modes — standard vs tiered</p>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Run the same research question twice — once in each mode — then pick the other run here to read the two measurement blocks side by side.</p>
        <label className="nb-field" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}><span>Compare with</span>
          <select className="nb-select" value={compareId} onChange={(e) => setCompareId(e.target.value)} aria-label="Compare with another research job">
            <option value="">Pick another research job…</option>
            {candidates.map((candidate) => <option key={candidate.id} value={candidate.id}>{candidate.title} ({candidate.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? "tiered" : "standard"})</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
        {compareId !== "" && comparison.isLoading && <p className="nb-note-line">Reading both jobs' records…</p>}
        {mine && other && (
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr))", gap: 12, marginTop: 6 }}>
            <div>
              <p className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{mine.title}</p>
              <p className="nb-meta">{mine.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? "Tiered gathering" : "Standard gathering"} · this job</p>
              <LabMeasurementsBlock measurements={mine.measurements} heading="Measurements" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{other.title}</p>
              <p className="nb-meta">{other.gatheringMode === "tiered" ? "Tiered gathering" : "Standard gathering"}</p>
              <LabMeasurementsBlock measurements={other.measurements} heading="Measurements" />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// TASK DETAIL — the item view from the design (back, verdict, sticky
// decision bar, the work itself, pieces index, breakdown door).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function TaskView({ ctx, taskId, back }: { ctx: Ctx; taskId: string; back: Door }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const task = data.tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
  const deliverables = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["nb-deliverables", taskId],
    queryFn: () => api.get_task_deliverables({ taskId }),
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
  const [keepSel, setKeepSel] = useState<Record<string, boolean> | null>(null);
  const [specificsOpen, setSpecificsOpen] = useState(false);
  if (!task) {
    return (
      <section className="nb-view">
        <div className="nb-door-head">
          <button type="button" className="nb-backbtn" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: back })}>← Back</button>
          <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 18 }}>That job no longer exists.</p>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const blockers = data.blockers.filter((b) => b.taskId === task.id && b.status === "open");
  const blocker = blockers[0];
  const blockedTaskIds = new Set(data.blockers.filter((b) => b.status === "open").map((b) => b.taskId));
  const needsCall = isReadyForYouTask(task, blockedTaskIds);
  const toPost = isApprovedPackage(task);
  const d = deliverables.data;
  const items = d?.items ?? [];
  const images = items.filter((item) => item.kind === "image" && item.imageUrl);
  const myBriefs = data.briefs.filter((b) => b.taskId === task.id).sort((a, b) => a.stepIndex - b.stepIndex);
  const client = task.clientId ? data.clients.find((c) => c.id === task.clientId) : undefined;
  const keepOf = (path: string) => keepSel?.[path] ?? true;
  const reviewableImages = images.filter((item) => !item.excluded);
  const showReview = task.status === "approval" && !task.deliverableReviewFinalizedAt && reviewableImages.length >= 2 && !blocker;
  const approve = () => void ctx.run(`approve-${task.id}`, () => api.set_task_status({ id: task.id, status: "done" }), "Approved — the job is done.");
  const claimCheck = findClaimCheck([
    ...items.map((item) => item.plainSummary),
    ...(d?.briefs ?? []).map((brief) => brief.plainSummary),
    ...(d?.briefs ?? []).map((brief) => brief.summary),
  ]);
  const gradeCheck = findGradeCheck([
    ...items.map((item) => item.plainSummary),
    ...(d?.briefs ?? []).map((brief) => brief.plainSummary),
    ...(d?.briefs ?? []).map((brief) => brief.summary),
  ]);
  const backLabel = back === "decide" ? "Decide" : back === "work" ? "Work" : back === "deliverables" ? "Deliverables" : back === "content" ? "Content" : "Back";
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <div className="nb-door-head">
        <button type="button" className="nb-backbtn" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: back })}>← {backLabel}</button>
        <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 18 }}><span className="nb-tick">▸</span> {JOB_TYPE_LABELS[task.jobType ?? "standard"] ?? "Job"}{client ? ` · ${client.businessName}` : ""}</p>
        <h1 className="nb-answer" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{task.title}</h1>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{verdictForTask(task, data.briefs, d)}</p>
      </div>

      {(needsCall || toPost || blocker) && (
        <div className="nb-decisionbar">
          <span className="nb-lab">YOUR CALL</span>
          {blocker ? (
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "answer", blockerId: blocker.id })}>Answer {memberName(blocker.memberId)}</button>
          ) : toPost ? (
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`posted-${task.id}`, () => api.mark_task_posted({ id: task.id }), "Marked posted — the job is closed to Done.")}>Mark posted</button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={approve}>Approve</button>
              <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "sendback", taskId: task.id })}>Send back</button>
            </>
          )}
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "delete-task", taskId: task.id })}>Delete</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {blocker && (
        <article className="nb-card nb-hot">
          <p className="nb-eyebrow">The crew is stuck</p>
          <p className="nb-verdict">{blocker.question}</p>
          <p className="nb-stamp">{memberName(blocker.memberId)} asked · {formatWaitingStamp(blocker.createdAt)}</p>
        </article>
      )}

      {(() => {
        const recon = d?.grading?.reconciliation;
        const incomplete = task.gradingStatus === "incomplete" || recon?.status === "incomplete";
        if (!incomplete) return null;
        const unaccounted = recon && recon.incompleteIds.length > 0 ? recon.incompleteIds : task.gradingIncompleteIds;
        const total = recon?.manifestCount ?? task.gradingManifestCount;
        return (
          <article className="nb-card nb-hot" role="alert" style={{ borderColor: "var(--nb-red, #e5484d)" }}>
            <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ color: "var(--nb-red, #e5484d)" }}>⚠ Grading incomplete — this job is not fully checked</p>
            <p className="nb-verdict">
              {unaccounted.length} of {total} claims could not be accounted for in the claim-check{unaccounted.length > 0 ? <>: <b>{unaccounted.join(", ")}</b></> : ""}.
            </p>
            <p className="nb-stamp">Every claim in the manifest needs exactly one grade. Until the missing or ungraded claims are resolved, this brief must not be read as fully checked — its verdict rests only on the claims graded strong or supported. The full per-claim record is in Specifics → Breakdown.</p>
          </article>
        );
      })()}

      {d?.postCopy && (
        <article className="nb-card">
          <p className="nb-eyebrow">The post — final copy</p>
          <p className="nb-postcopy">{d.postCopy}</p>
          <div className="nb-inline-actions">
            <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => void copyText(d.postCopy ?? "").then((ok) => ctx.toast(ok ? "Post copied." : "Copy failed — select the text instead."))}>Copy post</button>
          </div>
        </article>
      )}

      {images.length > 0 && (
        <div className="nb-strip">
          {images.map((item) => (
            <img key={item.relativePath} src={item.imageUrl ?? ""} alt={item.humanTitle || item.fileName} style={{ cursor: "pointer" }} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "piece", taskId: task.id, path: item.relativePath })} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {showReview && (
        <article className="nb-card">
          <p className="nb-eyebrow">Image review — keep the ones that ship</p>
          <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Untick any image to delete it for good when you save. Everything ticked ships exactly as shown.</p>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 9 }}>
            {reviewableImages.map((item) => (
              <label key={item.relativePath} className="nb-keepcheck">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={keepOf(item.relativePath)} onChange={(e) => setKeepSel((prev) => ({ ...(prev ?? {}), [item.relativePath]: e.target.checked }))} aria-label={`Keep ${item.humanTitle || item.fileName}`} />
                {item.humanTitle || item.fileName}
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="nb-inline-actions">
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`review-${task.id}`, () => api.finalize_deliverable_review({ taskId: task.id, keepPaths: reviewableImages.filter((i) => keepOf(i.relativePath)).map((i) => i.relativePath) }), "Image choices saved.")}>Save image choices</button>
          </div>
        </article>
      )}

      {deliverables.isLoading && <p className="nb-note-line">Loading the finished work…</p>}
      {d?.warning && <p className="nb-note-line">{d.warning}</p>}

      <div className="nb-specifics">
        <button type="button" className="nb-specifics-toggle" aria-expanded={specificsOpen} aria-label={specificsOpen ? "Hide specifics" : "Show specifics"} onClick={() => setSpecificsOpen((open) => !open)}>
          <span>Specifics</span>
          <span className="nb-chev" aria-hidden="true">{specificsOpen ? "▾" : "›"}</span>
        </button>
        {specificsOpen && (
          <div className="nb-specifics-body">
            {items.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>Contents — every piece</p>
                {items.map((item, index) => (
                  <button key={item.relativePath} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "piece", taskId: task.id, path: item.relativePath })}>
                    <span className={`nb-sdot ${item.excluded ? "nb-gr" : item.kind === "image" ? "nb-b" : "nb-g"}`} />
                    <div>
                      <div className="nb-nm">{index + 1}. {item.humanTitle || item.fileName}</div>
                      <div className="nb-meta">{item.excluded ? "Held out of this pack by ruling" : item.plainSummary ? plainSpecificsSummary(item.plainSummary, item.fileName) : item.fileName}</div>
                    </div>
                    <span className="nb-chev">›</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </>
            )}
            <article className="nb-card">
              <p className="nb-eyebrow">Breakdown — claims, sources, checks, run state</p>
              {claimCheck && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                  <p className="nb-eyebrow">Check</p>
                  <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}><b>{claimCheck.total} claims checked</b></p>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: 8 }}>
                    <Badge tone="green">Documented · {claimCheck.documented}</Badge>
                    <Badge tone="gray">Mainstream interpretation · {claimCheck.mainstream}</Badge>
                    <Badge tone="gray">Fringe claim · {claimCheck.fringe}</Badge>
                    <Badge tone={claimCheck.notVerified > 0 ? "amber" : "gray"}>Not verified · {claimCheck.notVerified}</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{claimCheck.documented === claimCheck.total ? "All held up as documented. Nothing failed checking." : claimCheck.notVerified > 0 ? `${claimCheck.notVerified} could not be verified — held out of anything published.` : "Nothing failed checking."}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {gradeCheck && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                  <p className="nb-eyebrow">Claim-check grades</p>
                  <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}><b>{gradeCheck.total} claims graded</b></p>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: 8 }}>
                    <Badge tone="green">Strong · {gradeCheck.strong}</Badge>
                    <Badge tone="blue">Supported · {gradeCheck.supported}</Badge>
                    <Badge tone={gradeCheck.shaky > 0 ? "amber" : "gray"}>Shaky · {gradeCheck.shaky}</Badge>
                    <Badge tone={gradeCheck.misframed > 0 ? "red" : "gray"}>Misframed · {gradeCheck.misframed}</Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>The verdict rests only on the strong and supported claims{gradeCheck.misframed > 0 ? ` — ${gradeCheck.misframed} misframed ${gradeCheck.misframed === 1 ? "claim is" : "claims are"} listed in the brief as failed, never used as evidence` : ""}.</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {d?.grading && d.grading.reconciliation.status !== "none" && (() => {
                const g = d.grading;
                const recon = g.reconciliation;
                const gradeById = new Map(g.grades.map((grade) => [grade.claimId, grade]));
                const provByRef = new Map(g.provenance.map((record) => [record.sourceRef, record]));
                return (
                  <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
                    <p className="nb-eyebrow">Claim completeness gate — manifest, chunks, reconciliation</p>
                    <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                      <b>{recon.manifestCount} claims in the manifest</b> · {recon.gradedCount} graded · {recon.chunkCount} chunk{recon.chunkCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} of at most 15
                    </p>
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: 8 }}>
                      {recon.status === "complete"
                        ? <Badge tone="green">Reconciled — every claim accounted for</Badge>
                        : <Badge tone="red">⚠ GRADING INCOMPLETE</Badge>}
                      <Badge tone="green">Strong · {recon.counts.STRONG}</Badge>
                      <Badge tone="blue">Supported · {recon.counts.SUPPORTED}</Badge>
                      <Badge tone={recon.counts.SHAKY > 0 ? "amber" : "gray"}>Shaky · {recon.counts.SHAKY}</Badge>
                      <Badge tone={recon.counts.MISFRAMED > 0 ? "red" : "gray"}>Misframed · {recon.counts.MISFRAMED}</Badge>
                      <Badge tone="gray">Untraceable · {recon.counts.UNTRACEABLE}</Badge>
                      <Badge tone={recon.counts.UNGRADED > 0 ? "red" : "gray"}>Ungraded · {recon.counts.UNGRADED}</Badge>
                    </div>
                    {recon.status === "incomplete" && (
                      <p className="nb-sub" role="alert" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                        {recon.incompleteIds.length} of {recon.manifestCount} claims are unaccounted for{recon.incompleteIds.length > 0 ? <>: <b>{recon.incompleteIds.join(", ")}</b></> : ""}. This job is not fully checked.
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {recon.errors.length > 0 && (
                      <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                        {recon.errors.map((error) => <p key={error} className="nb-sub">Reconciliation error: {error}</p>)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                      {g.manifest.map((entry) => {
                        const grade = gradeById.get(entry.claimId);
                        return (
                          <div key={entry.claimId} className="nb-logline">
                            <span className="nb-logtime">{entry.claimId} · {entry.role}</span>
                            <b style={{ color: "var(--nb-ink)" }}>{grade ? grade.disposition : "NO GRADE RECORDED"}</b>
                            <> — {entry.claimText.length > 140 ? `${entry.claimText.slice(0, 139)}…` : entry.claimText}</>
                            {grade?.reason ? <> · {grade.reason}</> : null}
                            {entry.sources.length > 0 && (
                              <span style={{ display: "block", marginTop: 3 }}>
                                {entry.sources.map((ref) => {
                                  const prov = provByRef.get(ref);
                                  return (
                                    <span key={ref} style={{ display: "block" }}>
                                      ↳ {prov
                                        ? <>{prov.publisher} · {DOC_TYPE_LABELS[prov.docType] ?? prov.docType} · {prov.tier === "primary" ? "Primary" : "Secondary"}{prov.vintage ? ` · ${prov.vintage}` : ""} — <span style={{ wordBreak: "break-all" }}>{ref}</span></>
                                        : <>Source with no provenance record yet — <span style={{ wordBreak: "break-all" }}>{ref}</span></>}
                                    </span>
                                  );
                                })}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}
              {d?.grading && (task.jobType === "research" || task.pipeline === "research_case") && (
                <LabBreakdownExtras ctx={ctx} task={task} grading={d.grading} />
              )}
              {task.escalationClaimCount !== null && task.escalationClaimCount !== undefined && task.escalationClaimCount > 0 && (
                <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}><b>{task.escalationDocumented ?? 0} of {task.escalationClaimCount} claims documented</b> · {task.escalationNotVerified ?? 0} not verified — held out of anything published.</p>
              )}
              {task.contractLabel && <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Outcome contract: {task.contractLabel}{task.contractStatus ? ` — ${task.contractStatus}` : ""}{task.contractViolation ? ` · ${task.contractViolation}` : ""}</p>}
              {myBriefs.length === 0 && <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>No steps recorded for this job.</p>}
              {myBriefs.map((brief) => (
                <div key={brief.id} className="nb-logline">
                  <span className="nb-logtime">{memberName(brief.assignee)} · {brief.status === "done" ? "Done" : brief.status === "in_progress" ? "Working" : brief.status === "failed" ? "Failed" : "Queued"} · {formatWaitingStamp(brief.updatedAt)}</span>
                  <b style={{ color: "var(--nb-ink)" }}>{brief.title}</b>
                  {brief.progressText ? <> — {brief.progressText}</> : null}
                  {brief.status === "new" && <QueuedBriefEditor ctx={ctx} brief={brief} />}
                </div>
              ))}
              {task.notes && <p className="nb-note-line"><b>The brief:</b> {task.notes}</p>}
              {!needsCall && !toPost && !blocker && (
                <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
                  <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "delete-task", taskId: task.id })}>Delete this job</button>
                </div>
              )}
            </article>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function QueuedBriefEditor({ ctx, brief }: { ctx: Ctx; brief: Brief }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(brief.title);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(brief.notes);
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState(brief.assignee);
  if (!editing) {
    return (
      <span className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ display: "flex", marginTop: 8 }}>
        <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => setEditing(true)}>Edit queued step</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={ctx.busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`cancel-brief-${brief.id}`, () => api.cancel_queued_brief({ id: brief.id }), "Queued step cancelled.")}>Cancel step</button>
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span style={{ display: "block", marginTop: 10 }}>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Step title</span><input className="nb-input" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} aria-label="Queued step title" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Instructions</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} aria-label="Queued step instructions" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Crew member</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={assignee} onChange={(e) => setAssignee(e.target.value)} aria-label="Queued step crew member">
          {CREW_IDS.map((id) => <option key={id} value={id}>{memberName(id)}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      <span className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ display: "flex" }}>
        <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={ctx.busy !== null || !title.trim()} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`edit-brief-${brief.id}`, () => api.update_queued_brief({ id: brief.id, title: title.trim(), notes, assigneeId: assignee as typeof CREW_IDS[number] }), "Queued step updated.").then((ok) => { if (ok) setEditing(false); })}>Save step</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => setEditing(false)}>Cancel</button>
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// OFFICE — rebuilt anew in the new interface. The map is the classic
// office's own floor, whole and untouched: every pipeline and mechanic
// that lives on it in the classic office lives on it here — its own
// floor switcher (the ONE switcher, in its panel right beside the map,
// driving the map and its crew list together), its own live crew list
// (the ONE roster, in the same panel — pressing Office shows the office
// and its crew together), music and ambience with track and volume,
// Enforce, Create work, Edit regions, the Work panel button, its
// counts, clock, zoom, handoffs, meetings, and inbox arrivals. This
// door adds no second switcher, no second roster, and no duplicate
// buttons of its own. The floor's panels are restyled in new-ui.css in
// the NeonBlade language (glass, cyan glow, corner-cut controls — the
// yellow is gone) without changing what any control does. Agent clicks
// behave exactly as they do in the classic office: clicking a crew
// member on the floor opens that member's personal pop-up over the
// floor, and clicking Remmy opens the Remmy briefing — a floor click
// never navigates to the Work door (see onFloorMemberOpen in the root).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function OfficeDoor({ ctx }: { ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { data } = ctx;
  const blockedTaskIds = useMemo(() => new Set(data.blockers.filter((b) => b.status === "open").map((b) => b.taskId)), [data.blockers]);
  const readyCount = data.tasks.filter((t) => isReadyForYouTask(t, blockedTaskIds)).length;
  const unreadIdeaHunts = useMemo(() => new Set(data.ideas.filter((idea) => !idea.seenAt).map((idea) => idea.taskId)).size, [data.ideas]);
  const huddleCount = data.tasks.filter((t) => isReadyForYouTask(t, blockedTaskIds) && !blockedTaskIds.has(t.id)).length;
  const floorGreeting = (() => {
    const hour = ctx.floorClock.getHours();
    const part = hour < 5 ? "Night" : hour < 12 ? "Morning" : hour < 17 ? "Afternoon" : hour < 22 ? "Evening" : "Night";
    return `${part} shift.`;
  })();
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <DoorHead eyebrow="Office — what's happening right now">
        {readyCount > 0 ? <>Crew working. <span className="nb-hl">{readyCount} {readyCount === 1 ? "thing waits" : "things wait"} on you</span> — in Decide.</> : <>Crew working. <span className="nb-hl">Nothing waits on you.</span></>}
      </DoorHead>
      <div className="nb-floor-embed">
        <OfficeFloor
          tasks={data.tasks}
          waitingCount={readyCount}
          notificationCount={readyCount + unreadIdeaHunts}
          unreadIdeaHunts={unreadIdeaHunts}
          huddleCount={huddleCount}
          briefs={data.briefs}
          handoffs={data.handoffs}
          watchdogEvent={watchdogEventFor(data.log.find((entry) => entry.text.includes("stalled with no progress")))}
          clock={ctx.floorClock}
          inboxArrival={ctx.inboxArrival}
          onInboxArrivalHandled={ctx.onInboxArrivalHandled}
          onMemberOpen={ctx.onFloorMemberOpen}
          onOpenWorkPanel={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "work" })}
          workingCount={data.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "working" && !blockedTaskIds.has(t.id)).length}
          doneCount={data.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "done").length}
          summaryLabel={readyCount === 0 ? "Nothing waiting on you" : `${readyCount} waiting on you`}
          greeting={floorGreeting}
          agentCount={13}
          openCount={data.tasks.filter((t) => t.status !== "done").length}
          onCreateWork={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "newjob" })}
          onEditRegions={ctx.onOpenClassic}
          onShowJobs={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "work" })}
          onShowReview={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "decide" })}
          onShowOutreach={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "ops" })}
          overlayHostRef={noopOverlayHost}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// WORK — everything, one list.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
type WorkFilter = "all" | "needs" | "run" | "blocked" | "done" | "history";
function workBucket(task: Task, blockedTaskIds: ReadonlySet<string>, data: OfficeState): WorkFilter {
  if (isReadyForYouTask(task, blockedTaskIds)) return "needs";
  if (blockedTaskIds.has(task.id)) return "blocked";
  if (task.status === "working") return "run";
  // "Done today" means finished TODAY — a job done earlier is history,
  // never counted here. History stays reachable under All.
  if (task.status === "done" && (isToday(task.approvedAt) || isToday(task.postedAt) || data.briefs.some((b) => b.taskId === task.id && b.status === "done" && isToday(b.updatedAt)))) return "done";
  return "history";
}
function WorkDoor({ ctx }: { ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { data } = ctx;
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<WorkFilter>("all");
  const blockedTaskIds = useMemo(() => new Set(data.blockers.filter((b) => b.status === "open").map((b) => b.taskId)), [data.blockers]);
  const topLevel = useMemo(() => data.tasks.filter((t) => !t.parentTaskId), [data.tasks]);
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const c: Record<WorkFilter, number> = { all: topLevel.length, needs: 0, run: 0, blocked: 0, done: 0, history: 0 };
    for (const t of topLevel) c[workBucket(t, blockedTaskIds, data)] += 1;
    return c;
  }, [topLevel, blockedTaskIds, data]);
  const visible = topLevel.filter((t) => filter === "all" || workBucket(t, blockedTaskIds, data) === filter);
  const order: Record<WorkFilter, number> = { needs: 0, blocked: 1, run: 2, done: 3, history: 4, all: 5 };
  const sorted = [...visible].sort((a, b) => order[workBucket(a, blockedTaskIds, data)] - order[workBucket(b, blockedTaskIds, data)] || b.created.localeCompare(a.created));
  const badgeFor = (t: Task): { tone: "amber" | "blue" | "red" | "green" | "gray"; label: string; dot: string } => {
    const bucket = workBucket(t, blockedTaskIds, data);
    if (bucket === "needs") return { tone: "amber", label: "NEEDS YOU", dot: "a" };
    if (bucket === "blocked") return { tone: "red", label: "BLOCKED", dot: "r" };
    if (bucket === "run") return { tone: "blue", label: "IN PROGRESS", dot: "b" };
    if (bucket === "done") return { tone: "green", label: "DONE TODAY", dot: "g" };
    return { tone: "gray", label: t.status === "done" ? "DONE" : "FINISHED", dot: "gr" };
  };
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <DoorHead eyebrow="Work — everything, one list">
        <span className="nb-hl">{counts.needs} need you</span> · {counts.run} running · {counts.blocked} blocked · {counts.done} done today · {counts.history} earlier.
      </DoorHead>
      <div className="nb-chips" role="tablist" aria-label="Work filters">
        {([["all", "All"], ["needs", "Needs Me"], ["run", "In Progress"], ["blocked", "Blocked"], ["done", "Done today"]] as Array<[WorkFilter, string]>).map(([id, label]) => (
          <button key={id} type="button" className={`nb-chip${filter === id ? " nb-on" : ""}`} onClick={() => setFilter(id)}>{label}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div>
        {sorted.map((task) => {
          const badge = badgeFor(task);
          const activeBrief = data.briefs.filter((b) => b.taskId === task.id).sort((a, b) => b.stepIndex - a.stepIndex)[0];
          return (
            <button key={task.id} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "task", taskId: task.id, back: "work" })}>
              <span className={`nb-sdot nb-${badge.dot}`} />
              <div>
                <div className="nb-nm">{task.title}</div>
                <div className="nb-meta">{JOB_TYPE_LABELS[task.jobType ?? "standard"] ?? "Job"} · {memberName(task.assignee)}{activeBrief?.progressText ? ` · ${activeBrief.progressText}` : ""}</div>
              </div>
              <span className="nb-right"><Badge tone={badge.tone}>{badge.label}</Badge></span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
        {sorted.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">Nothing in this list right now.</p>}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// CLIENTS — who we serve; a client detail is one living space.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function clientRevenue(data: OfficeState, clientId: string): number {
  return data.ledger.filter((e) => e.clientId === clientId && e.status === "paid").reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
}
function PackageStepper({ status }: { status: Pkg["status"] }) {
  const steps = ["Drafting", "Waiting Review", "Approved", "Shipped"];
  const nowIndex = status === "assembling" ? 0 : status === "ready" ? 1 : 3;
  return (
    <div className="nb-steps" aria-label={`Package status: ${status}`}>
      {steps.map((label, i) => (
        <span key={label} style={{ display: "contents" }}>
          {i > 0 && <span className="nb-step"><span className="nb-bar" /></span>}
          <span className={`nb-step${status === "delivered" || i < nowIndex ? " nb-done" : i === nowIndex ? " nb-now" : ""}`}>
            <span className="nb-n">{status === "delivered" || i < nowIndex ? "✓" : i + 1}</span>{label}
          </span>
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function ClientsDoor({ ctx }: { ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { data } = ctx;
  const clients = data.clients;
  const testCount = clients.filter((c) => c.isTest).length;
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <DoorHead eyebrow="Clients — who we serve">
        {clients.length} {clients.length === 1 ? "client" : "clients"}{testCount > 0 ? <> · {testCount} test {testCount === 1 ? "client" : "clients"}</> : null}. <span className="nb-hl">Every package, one place.</span>
      </DoorHead>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "client-form" })}>Add a client</button>
      </div>
      {clients.map((client) => {
        const clientPackages = data.packages.filter((p) => p.clientId === client.id);
        const waitingPkg = clientPackages.find((p) => p.status !== "delivered");
        return (
          <button key={client.id} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "client", clientId: client.id })}>
            <span className={`nb-sdot ${client.isTest ? "nb-b" : "nb-g"}`} />
            <div>
              <div className="nb-nm">{client.businessName}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{waitingPkg ? `Package waiting: ${waitingPkg.title}` : clientPackages.length > 0 ? "All packages shipped" : "No packages yet"} · {money(clientRevenue(data, client.id))} paid to date</div>
            </div>
            <span className="nb-right">{client.isTest ? <Badge tone="blue">TEST</Badge> : <Badge tone="gray">{client.status.toUpperCase()}</Badge>}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
      {clients.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">No clients in the registry yet. Add the first one above.</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

function ClientView({ ctx, clientId }: { ctx: Ctx; clientId: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const client = data.clients.find((c) => c.id === clientId);
  const [voiceNotes, setVoiceNotes] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false);
  if (!client) {
    return (
      <section className="nb-view">
        <div className="nb-door-head">
          <button type="button" className="nb-backbtn" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "clients" })}>← Clients</button>
          <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 18 }}>That client is no longer in the registry.</p>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const clientPackages = data.packages.filter((p) => p.clientId === client.id);
  const clientTasks = data.tasks.filter((t) => t.clientId === client.id && !t.parentTaskId);
  const clientLedger = data.ledger.filter((e) => e.clientId === client.id);
  const isActiveClient = ctx.activeClientId === client.id;
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <div className="nb-door-head">
        <button type="button" className="nb-backbtn" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "clients" })}>← Clients</button>
        <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 18 }}><span className="nb-tick">▸</span> {client.isTest ? "Test client — real business, simulated relationship, never contacted" : `Client · ${client.status}`}</p>
        <h1 className="nb-answer" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{client.businessName}</h1>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          {client.approverName ? `Approver: ${client.approverName} · ` : ""}{client.platforms || "No platforms recorded"}
          {client.nextReportAt ? ` · Next report ${formatWaitingStamp(client.nextReportAt)}` : ""}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "newjob", clientId: client.id })}>New job for this client</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`report-${client.id}`, () => api.run_client_report_now({ clientId: client.id }), "Client report started — it lands in Work.")}>Run report now</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "client-form", clientId: client.id })}>Edit client</button>
        {!confirmDelete
          ? <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-danger" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(true)}>Delete client</button>
          : <>
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`del-client-${client.id}`, () => api.delete_client({ id: client.id }), "Client removed from the registry.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "clients" }); })}>Confirm delete</button>
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(false)}>Keep</button>
          </>}
      </div>

      <button type="button" className={isActiveClient ? "populate-world-button is-on" : "populate-world-button"} onClick={() => ctx.onToggleActiveClient(client.id)} aria-pressed={isActiveClient} aria-label={isActiveClient ? `Show all clients instead of only ${client.businessName}` : `Populate the world with only ${client.businessName} — view only this client`}>{isActiveClient ? `Populating the world — only ${client.businessName} · tap for all clients` : "Populate the world — view only this client"}</button>
      {isActiveClient && <p className="active-client-note">This client is populating the world: the Deliverables Library shows only their deliverables. Ready for You, the floors, the Work boards, and To post still show everyone.</p>}

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">How this client sounds — their instructions</p>
        <label className="nb-field">
          <span>Voice notes the crew works to</span>
          <textarea className="nb-textarea" value={voiceNotes ?? client.voiceNotes} onChange={(e) => setVoiceNotes(e.target.value)} aria-label={`Voice notes for ${client.businessName}`} />
        </label>
        <div className="nb-inline-actions">
          <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={busy !== null || voiceNotes === null || voiceNotes === client.voiceNotes} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`voice-${client.id}`, () => api.update_client_instructions({ id: client.id, voiceNotes: (voiceNotes ?? "").trim() }), "Client instructions saved.")}>Save instructions</button>
        </div>
        <p className="nb-note-line">
          Photo library: {client.photoLibraryStatus.replace(/_/g, " ")}{client.photoLibraryLocation ? ` — ${client.photoLibraryLocation}` : ""} · Showcase permission: {client.showcasePermission ? "yes" : "no"} · Reports: {client.reportCadence}

      {clientPackages.map((pkg) => (

      ))}

      {clientTasks.length > 0 && (

          {clientTasks.map((task) => (
