          ))}
        </article>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// DELIVERABLES — finished work, one place; packages are decided here.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function PackageView({ ctx, packageId }: { ctx: Ctx; packageId: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const pkg = data.packages.find((p) => p.id === packageId);
  const deliverables = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["nb-deliverables", pkg?.taskId ?? ""],
    queryFn: () => api.get_task_deliverables({ taskId: pkg?.taskId ?? "" }),
    enabled: Boolean(pkg?.taskId),
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
  const [link, setLink] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keepSel, setKeepSel] = useState<Record<string, boolean> | null>(null);
  if (!pkg) {
    return (
      <section className="nb-view">
        <div className="nb-door-head">
          <button type="button" className="nb-backbtn" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "deliverables" })}>← Deliverables</button>
          <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 18 }}>That package no longer exists.</p>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const client = data.clients.find((c) => c.id === pkg.clientId);
  const d = deliverables.data;
  const items = d?.items ?? [];
  const keepable = items.filter((item) => !item.excluded);
  const keepOf = (path: string) => keepSel?.[path] ?? true;
  const task = data.tasks.find((t) => t.id === pkg.taskId);
  const downloadZip = async () => {
    const r = await api.download_package_zip({ id: pkg.id });
    if (!r.ok) { ctx.toast(r.error); return; }
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = r.url;
    a.download = r.fileName;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    ctx.toast(`Package ZIP downloaded — ${r.entryCount} files.`);
  };
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <div className="nb-door-head">
        <button type="button" className="nb-backbtn" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: "deliverables" })}>← Deliverables</button>
        <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 18 }}><span className="nb-tick">▸</span> Delivery package{client ? ` · ${client.businessName}` : ""}</p>
        <h1 className="nb-answer" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{pkg.title}</h1>
        {pkg.coverNote && <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{pkg.coverNote}</p>}
      </div>
      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Where it stands</p>
        <PackageStepper status={pkg.status} />
        {pkg.postingStatus && <p className="nb-note-line">Posting: <b>{pkg.postingStatus}</b></p>}
        {pkg.status !== "delivered" && (
          <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
            {pkg.status === "assembling" && <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`finish-pkg-${pkg.id}`, () => api.finish_assembling_package({ id: pkg.id }), "Package finished assembling — it is ready for your call.")}>Finish assembling</button>}
            {pkg.status === "ready" && <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`approve-pkg-${pkg.id}`, () => api.approve_delivery_package({ id: pkg.id, keepPaths: keepable.filter((i) => keepOf(i.relativePath)).map((i) => i.relativePath) }), "Package approved and delivered — it is in the ledger now.")}>Approve &amp; deliver</button>}
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "package-rework", packageId: pkg.id })}>Send back for rework</button>
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void downloadZip()}>Download ZIP</button>
            {task && isApprovedPackage(task) && <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`posted-${task.id}`, () => api.mark_task_posted({ id: task.id }), "Marked posted.")}>Mark its post posted</button>}
          </div>
        )}
        {pkg.status === "delivered" && (
          <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void downloadZip()}>Download ZIP</button>
          </div>
        )}
        <label className="nb-field">
          <span>Customer link</span>
          <input className="nb-input" value={link ?? pkg.customerLink ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setLink(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://…" aria-label="Customer link for this package" />
        </label>
        <div className="nb-inline-actions">
          <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={busy !== null || link === null || link === (pkg.customerLink ?? "")} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`link-${pkg.id}`, () => api.save_package_customer_link({ id: pkg.id, url: (link ?? "").trim() }), "Customer link saved.")}>Save link</button>
          {pkg.customerLink && <a className="nb-linkish" href={pkg.customerLink} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" style={{ fontSize: 13.5 }}>Open link</a>}
        </div>
      </article>

      {d?.postCopy && (
        <article className="nb-card">
          <p className="nb-eyebrow">The post — final copy</p>
          <p className="nb-postcopy">{d.postCopy}</p>
          <div className="nb-inline-actions"><button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => void copyText(d.postCopy ?? "").then((ok) => ctx.toast(ok ? "Post copied." : "Copy failed — select the text instead."))}>Copy post</button></div>
        </article>
      )}
      {items.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>In this package</p>
          {items.map((item, index) => (
            <div key={item.relativePath} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
              <span className={`nb-sdot ${item.excluded ? "nb-gr" : "nb-g"}`} />
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <div className="nb-nm">{index + 1}. {item.humanTitle || item.fileName}</div>
                <div className="nb-meta">{item.excluded ? "Held out by ruling — never ships" : item.plainSummary ? item.plainSummary : item.fileName}</div>
              </div>
              {pkg.status === "ready" && !item.excluded && (
                <label className="nb-keepcheck"><input type="checkbox" checked={keepOf(item.relativePath)} onChange={(e) => setKeepSel((prev) => ({ ...(prev ?? {}), [item.relativePath]: e.target.checked }))} aria-label={`Keep ${item.humanTitle || item.fileName} in the package`} /> Keep</label>
              )}
              <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "piece", taskId: pkg.taskId, path: item.relativePath })}>Open</button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </>
      )}
      {deliverables.isLoading && <p className="nb-note-line">Loading the package contents…</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

function DeliverablesDoor({ ctx }: { ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { data } = ctx;
  const readyPackages = data.packages.filter((p) => p.status !== "delivered");
  const shippedPackages = data.packages.filter((p) => p.status === "delivered");
  const toPost = data.tasks.filter((t) => isApprovedPackage(t));
  const activeClient = ctx.activeClientId ? data.clients.find((c) => c.id === ctx.activeClientId) : undefined;
  // Populate World — the Library is the one scoped surface, exactly as in
  // the classic office: with a client active it reads the scoped state
  // (server-filtered to that client, lab sub-cases hidden, Library
  // membership by approval) and shows only their deliverables. To post
  // above it keeps using the global state and never filters.
  const scopedTasks = ctx.scopedData?.tasks ?? [];
  const scopedSubcaseIds = new Set(scopedTasks.flatMap((t) => (t.escalationSubtaskId ? [t.escalationSubtaskId] : [])));
  const library = ctx.activeClientId && ctx.scopedData
    ? scopedTasks.filter((t) => !scopedSubcaseIds.has(t.id) && !t.standingOrderId && isLibraryTask(t) && !toPost.some((p) => p.id === t.id))
    : data.tasks.filter((t) => isLibraryTask(t) && !toPost.includes(t));
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <DoorHead eyebrow="Deliverables — finished work, one place">
        {shippedPackages.length} shipped to clients. {readyPackages.length + toPost.length > 0 ? <span className="nb-hl">{readyPackages.length + toPost.length} waiting on your call.</span> : <span className="nb-hl">Nothing waiting.</span>}
      </DoorHead>
      {activeClient && (
        <div className="active-client-banner" role="status" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <p><b>Showing only {activeClient.businessName}.</b><span>This client is populating the world: the Library below shows only their deliverables. Ready for You, the floors, the Work boards, and To post still show everyone.</span></p>
          <button type="button" onClick={ctx.onClearActiveClient} aria-label={`Show all clients instead of only ${activeClient.businessName}`}>All clients</button>
        </div>
      )}
      {readyPackages.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>Ready to ship</p>
          {readyPackages.map((pkg) => {
            const client = data.clients.find((c) => c.id === pkg.clientId);
            return (
              <button key={pkg.id} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "package", packageId: pkg.id })}>
                <span className="nb-sdot nb-a" />
                <div><div className="nb-nm">{pkg.title}</div><div className="nb-meta">{client ? `${client.businessName} · ` : ""}{pkg.status === "ready" ? "Finished and packaged — ships the moment you approve it" : "Still being assembled by Maria"}</div></div>
                <span className="nb-right"><Badge tone="amber">{pkg.status === "ready" ? "NEEDS YOUR CALL" : "ASSEMBLING"}</Badge></span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}
      {toPost.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>To post</p>
          {toPost.map((task) => (
            <button key={task.id} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "task", taskId: task.id, back: "deliverables" })}>
              <span className="nb-sdot nb-a" />
              <div><div className="nb-nm">{task.title}</div><div className="nb-meta">Approved — copy the post and image from the job, publish it, then mark it posted</div></div>
              <span className="nb-right"><Badge tone="amber">TO POST</Badge></span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </>
      )}
      {shippedPackages.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>Shipped</p>
          {shippedPackages.map((pkg) => {
            const client = data.clients.find((c) => c.id === pkg.clientId);
            const entry = data.ledger.find((e) => e.packageId === pkg.id);
            return (
              <button key={pkg.id} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "package", packageId: pkg.id })}>
                <span className="nb-sdot nb-g" />
                <div><div className="nb-nm">{pkg.title}</div><div className="nb-meta">{client ? `${client.businessName} · ` : ""}Delivered{pkg.deliveredAt ? ` · ${formatWaitingStamp(pkg.deliveredAt)}` : ""}</div></div>
                <span className="nb-right"><Badge tone="green">SHIPPED{entry ? ` · ${money(entry.amountCents)} ${entry.status.toUpperCase()}` : ""}</Badge></span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}
      {library.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>Library — approved work, kept</p>
          {library.slice(0, 30).map((task) => (
            <button key={task.id} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "task", taskId: task.id, back: "deliverables" })}>
              <span className={`nb-sdot ${isPostedPackage(task) ? "nb-g" : "nb-gr"}`} />
              <div><div className="nb-nm">{task.title}</div><div className="nb-meta">{JOB_TYPE_LABELS[task.jobType ?? "standard"] ?? "Job"}{task.clientId ? ` · ${data.clients.find((c) => c.id === task.clientId)?.businessName ?? "Client"}` : ""}</div></div>
              <span className="nb-right">{isPostedPackage(task) ? <Badge tone="green">POSTED</Badge> : <Badge tone="gray">HISTORY</Badge>}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </>
      )}
      {readyPackages.length === 0 && shippedPackages.length === 0 && toPost.length === 0 && library.length === 0 && (
        <p className="nb-note-line">Nothing has shipped yet. Finished, approved work lands here.</p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// CONTENT — what we're making, and is it true.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function ContentDoor({ ctx }: { ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const [angle, setAngle] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (data.ideas.some((idea) => !idea.seenAt)) {
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => { void api.mark_visionary_ideas_seen({}).catch(() => undefined); }, 2500);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    return undefined;
  }, [data.ideas]);
  const ppTasks = data.tasks.filter((t) => t.pipeline === "perfectly_paranoid" && !t.parentTaskId).slice(0, 12);
  const liveCount = ppTasks.filter((t) => isPostedPackage(t)).length;
  const queued = data.xPosts.filter((p) => p.status === "queued");
  const posted = data.xPosts.filter((p) => p.status === "posted").slice(0, 5);
  const shelves = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Story[]>();
    for (const story of data.stories) {
      const list = map.get(story.shelf) ?? [];
      list.push(story);
      map.set(story.shelf, list);
    }
    return [...map.entries()];
  }, [data.stories]);
  const shelfLabel = (shelf: string) => shelf === "perfectly_paranoid" ? "Perfectly Paranoid shelf" : shelf === "pulse_hq" ? "Pulse HQ shelf" : shelf;
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <DoorHead eyebrow="Content — what we're making, and is it true">
        {liveCount > 0 ? <>{liveCount} Paranoid {liveCount === 1 ? "post" : "posts"} live. </> : null}<span className="nb-hl">{queued.length} X {queued.length === 1 ? "draft" : "drafts"} in the queue.</span>
      </DoorHead>

      <article className="nb-card nb-hot">
        <Corners />
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Perfectly Paranoid — published &amp; in flight</p>
        {ppTasks.map((task) => {
          const postedTask = isPostedPackage(task);
          return (
            <button key={task.id} type="button" className="nb-rowitem" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "task", taskId: task.id, back: "content" })}>
              <span className={`nb-sdot ${postedTask ? "nb-g" : task.status === "approval" ? "nb-a" : "nb-b"}`} />
              <div><div className="nb-nm">{task.title.replace(/^Perfectly Paranoid:\s*/i, "")}</div><div className="nb-meta">{postedTask ? "Posted and confirmed" : task.status === "approval" ? "Finished — waiting on your call" : task.status === "done" ? "Closed" : "In the pipeline — Tom researches, Johnny writes, Nik images"}</div></div>
              <span className="nb-right">{postedTask ? <Badge tone="green">LIVE</Badge> : task.status === "approval" ? <Badge tone="amber">NEEDS YOU</Badge> : <Badge tone="blue">IN PROGRESS</Badge>}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
        {ppTasks.length === 0 && <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>No Paranoid jobs yet.</p>}
        <label className="nb-field">
          <span>Start a new story job — an angle, or leave blank and Tom finds one</span>
          <input className="nb-input" value={angle} onChange={(e) => setAngle(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. the declassified file on…" aria-label="Perfectly Paranoid story angle" />
        </label>
        <div className="nb-inline-actions">
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("pp-start", () => api.start_perfectly_paranoid_pipeline({ angle: angle.trim() }), "Story job started — Tom, Johnny, and Nik are on it.").then((ok) => { if (ok) setAngle(""); })}>Start story job</button>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Social Queue — Olivia, @PulseHQOffice</p>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Every draft carries an image or a link and ends with its strongest hashtags. Nothing publishes until you paste it yourself.</p>
        {queued.map((post) => (
          <div key={post.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default", alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
            <span className="nb-sdot nb-b" style={{ marginTop: 6 }} />
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div className="nb-nm" style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14.5 }}>{post.text.length > 160 ? `${post.text.slice(0, 160)}…` : post.text}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{post.hasImage ? "Image attached" : post.hasLink ? "Carries a link" : "Text only"} · drafted {formatWaitingStamp(post.createdAt)}</div>
              {post.imageUrl && <img src={post.imageUrl} alt="Draft post image" style={{ width: 132, height: 88, objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: 9, marginTop: 8, border: "1px solid var(--nb-line-soft)" }} />}
              <div className="nb-inline-actions">
                <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => void copyText(post.text).then((ok) => ctx.toast(ok ? "Draft copied — paste it into X." : "Copy failed — select the text instead."))}>Copy draft</button>
                <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`xpost-posted-${post.id}`, () => api.mark_x_post_posted({ id: post.id }), "Marked posted — moved to the queue history.")}>Mark posted</button>
                <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`xpost-del-${post.id}`, () => api.delete_x_post({ id: post.id }), "Draft deleted from the Post Queue.")}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {queued.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">The queue is empty — Olivia's next batch drafts on schedule.</p>}
        {posted.map((post) => (
          <div key={post.id} className="nb-rowitem nb-inert">
            <span className="nb-sdot nb-g" />
            <div><div className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{post.text.length > 90 ? `${post.text.slice(0, 90)}…` : post.text}</div><div className="nb-meta">Posted {post.postedAt ? formatWaitingStamp(post.postedAt) : ""}</div></div>
            <span className="nb-right"><Badge tone="green">POSTED</Badge></span>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("olivia-now", () => api.run_olivia_batch_now({}), "Olivia is drafting a batch now — drafts land in this queue.")}>Run Olivia's batch now</button>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Visionary ideas — Sven</p>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Sven's finds, in plain words. Launch one and Remmy turns it into a job; deny one and it is gone for good.</p>
        {data.ideas.slice(0, 9).map((idea) => (
          <div key={idea.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default", alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
            <span className={`nb-sdot ${idea.seenAt ? "nb-gr" : "nb-b"}`} style={{ marginTop: 6 }} />
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div className="nb-nm">{idea.title}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{idea.plainSummary}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{idea.scope === "within" ? "Inside what we already do" : idea.scope === "outside" ? "A new direction" : "From an earlier hunt"} · {idea.category} · found {formatWaitingStamp(idea.createdAt)}</div>
              <div className="nb-inline-actions">
                {idea.launchedTaskId
                  ? <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "task", taskId: idea.launchedTaskId as string, back: "content" })}>Open the job</button>
                  : <>
                    <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`idea-launch-${idea.id}`, () => api.launch_visionary_idea({ ideaId: idea.id }), "Idea sent to Remmy — the crew is moving.")}>Launch it</button>
                    <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`idea-deny-${idea.id}`, () => api.deny_visionary_idea({ ideaId: idea.id }), "Idea denied and removed.")}>Deny</button>
                  </>}
                {idea.sourceUrls[0] && <a className="nb-linkish" style={{ fontSize: 13 }} href={idea.sourceUrls[0]} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Source</a>}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {data.ideas.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">No ideas on the shelf right now.</p>}
        <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("sven-hunt", () => api.run_visionary_hunt_now({}), "Sven is out hunting — new ideas will appear here.")}>Send Sven hunting now</button>
        </div>
      </article>

      {shelves.map(([shelf, stories]) => (
        <article key={shelf} className="nb-card">
          <p className="nb-eyebrow">Story shelf — {shelfLabel(shelf)}</p>
          {stories.slice(0, 8).map((story) => (
            <div key={story.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default", alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
              <span className="nb-sdot nb-b" style={{ marginTop: 6 }} />
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <div className="nb-nm">{story.headline}</div>
                <div className="nb-meta">{story.fitReason}</div>
                <div className="nb-meta">{story.sourceLabel}{story.isDeclassified && story.agency ? ` · Declassified ${story.agency} file${story.documentTitle ? `: ${story.documentTitle}` : ""}` : ""} · found {formatWaitingStamp(story.foundAt)}</div>
                <div className="nb-inline-actions">
                  <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`story-job-${story.id}`, () => api.make_job_from_story({ storyId: story.id }), "Story became a job — the crew is moving.")}>Make it a job</button>
                  <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`story-dismiss-${story.id}`, () => api.dismiss_story({ storyId: story.id }), "Story dismissed — Sven will not file it again.")}>Dismiss</button>
                  <a className="nb-linkish" style={{ fontSize: 13 }} href={story.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Source</a>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </article>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// OPS — what runs the place: ledger, outreach book, standing orders,
// presets, dispatch, the activity log.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
const OUTREACH_STATUSES = ["Waiting", "In conversation", "Interested", "Not now", "Said no", "Blocked", "Became a client"] as const;
function OpsDoor({ ctx }: { ctx: Ctx }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const [inboxMsg, setInboxMsg] = useState("");
  const [dispatchMsg, setDispatchMsg] = useState("");
  const [confirmDel, setConfirmDel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const paidTotal = data.ledger.filter((e) => e.status === "paid").reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const owedTotal = data.ledger.filter((e) => e.status === "owed").reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.amountCents ?? 0), 0);
  const openBlockers = data.blockers.filter((b) => b.status === "open").length;
  const checkInbox = async () => {
    const r = await api.check_inbox_now({});
    if (r.status === "clear") setInboxMsg("Nothing is waiting in the inbox.");
    else if (r.status === "started") setInboxMsg(`Started ${r.eligible} ${r.eligible === 1 ? "job" : "jobs"}.`);
    else setInboxMsg(r.message);
  };
  const runDispatch = async () => {
    const r = await api.poll_dispatch({});
    if (r.status === "clear") setDispatchMsg(`Dispatch ran — all clear (${r.standingOrdersEvaluated} standing orders checked).`);
    else if (r.status === "spawned") setDispatchMsg(`Dispatch ran — ${r.eligibleBriefs} ${r.eligibleBriefs === 1 ? "step" : "steps"} started${r.newBlockers > 0 ? `, ${r.newBlockers} new blockers` : ""}.`);
    else setDispatchMsg(r.message);
  };
  return (
    <section className="nb-view">
      <DoorHead eyebrow="Ops — what runs the place">
        {openBlockers > 0 ? <>{openBlockers} {openBlockers === 1 ? "thing needs" : "things need"} you here. <span className="nb-hl">The rest is quiet.</span></> : <>All quiet. <span className="nb-hl">The place is running itself.</span></>}
      </DoorHead>
      <div className="nb-statgrid">
        <div className="nb-stat"><span className="nb-cnr nb-tl" /><div className="nb-v">{money(paidTotal)}</div><div className="nb-k">REVENUE TO DATE</div></div>
        <div className="nb-stat"><span className="nb-cnr nb-tl" /><div className="nb-v" style={{ color: owedTotal > 0 ? "var(--nb-amber)" : "var(--nb-green)" }}>{money(owedTotal)}</div><div className="nb-k">OWED</div></div>
        <div className="nb-stat"><span className="nb-cnr nb-tl" /><div className="nb-v">{data.ledger.length}</div><div className="nb-k">JOBS SHIPPED</div></div>
        <div className="nb-stat"><span className="nb-cnr nb-tl" /><div className="nb-v">{data.outreach.length}</div><div className="nb-k">BUSINESSES IN THE OUTREACH BOOK</div></div>
      </div>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Dispatch — the crew's heartbeat</p>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>The dispatcher starts queued steps, fires standing orders that are due, and sweeps stuck work back into line. It also runs on its own schedule.</p>
        <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("dispatch", async () => { await runDispatch(); return { ok: true }; })}>Run dispatch now</button>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("inbox", async () => { await checkInbox(); return { ok: true }; })}>Check inbox now</button>
        </div>
        {dispatchMsg && <p className="nb-note-line">{dispatchMsg}</p>}
        {inboxMsg && <p className="nb-note-line">{inboxMsg}</p>}
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Standing orders</p>
        {data.standingOrders.map((order) => (
          <div key={order.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
            <span className={`nb-sdot ${order.enabled ? "nb-b" : "nb-gr"}`} />
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14.5 }}>{firstLine(order.instruction, 90)}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{memberName(order.assignee)} · {order.mode === "scheduled" ? `${order.cadence ?? "scheduled"}${order.nextRunAt ? ` · next ${formatWaitingStamp(order.nextRunAt)}` : ""}` : "Pipeline stage"}{order.lastRunAt ? ` · last ran ${formatWaitingStamp(order.lastRunAt)}` : ""}</div>
            </div>
            <button type="button" className={`nb-switch${order.enabled ? " nb-on" : ""}`} aria-label={`${order.enabled ? "Disable" : "Enable"} standing order: ${firstLine(order.instruction, 40)}`} disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`order-toggle-${order.id}`, () => api.set_standing_order_enabled({ id: order.id, enabled: !order.enabled }))} />
            <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "order-form", orderId: order.id })}>Edit</button>
            {confirmDel === `order-${order.id}`
              ? <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`order-del-${order.id}`, () => api.delete_standing_order({ id: order.id }), "Standing order deleted.")}>Confirm</button>
              : <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" onClick={() => setConfirmDel(`order-${order.id}`)}>Delete</button>}
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "order-form" })}>New standing order</button>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Presets — one-tap jobs</p>
        {data.presets.map((preset) => (
          <div key={preset.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
            <span className="nb-sdot nb-b" />
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14.5 }}>{preset.name}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{JOB_TYPE_LABELS[preset.jobType] ?? preset.jobType} · {preset.title}{preset.fillInLabel ? ` · needs its ${preset.fillInLabel}` : ""}</div>
            </div>
            <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => preset.fillInLabel ? ctx.openSheet({ kind: "preset-start", presetId: preset.id }) : void ctx.run(`preset-start-${preset.id}`, () => api.start_preset({ id: preset.id }), `Preset “${preset.name}” started — the crew is moving.`)}>Start</button>
            <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "preset-form", presetId: preset.id })}>Edit</button>
            {confirmDel === `preset-${preset.id}`
              ? <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`preset-del-${preset.id}`, () => api.delete_preset({ id: preset.id }), "Preset deleted.")}>Confirm</button>
              : <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" onClick={() => setConfirmDel(`preset-${preset.id}`)}>Delete</button>}
          </div>
        ))}
        {data.presets.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">No presets saved yet.</p>}
        <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "preset-form" })}>New preset</button>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Outreach Book</p>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}><b style={{ color: "var(--nb-ink)" }}>{data.outreach.length} businesses in the book.</b> No business is ever drafted twice — the book is the record.</p>
        {data.outreach.map((contact) => (
          <div key={contact.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
            <span className={`nb-sdot ${contact.status === "Became a client" ? "nb-g" : contact.status === "In conversation" || contact.status === "Interested" ? "nb-a" : contact.status === "Said no" || contact.status === "Blocked" ? "nb-r" : "nb-gr"}`} />
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14.5 }}>{contact.businessName}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{contact.town ? `${contact.town} · ` : ""}{contact.group} · {contact.channel}{contact.dateContacted ? ` · ${contact.dateContacted}` : " · not contacted yet"}{contact.followUp ? " · follow-up flagged" : ""}</div>
              {contact.note && <div className="nb-meta">{firstLine(contact.note, 130)}</div>}
            </div>
            <select className="nb-select" style={{ width: "auto", padding: "7px 10px", fontSize: 13 }} value={contact.status} aria-label={`Status for ${contact.businessName}`} disabled={busy !== null} onChange={(e) => void ctx.run(`outreach-status-${contact.id}`, () => api.update_outreach_contact({ id: contact.id, status: e.target.value as typeof OUTREACH_STATUSES[number] }))}>
              {OUTREACH_STATUSES.map((status) => <option key={status} value={status}>{status}</option>)}
            </select>
            <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "outreach-form", contactId: contact.id })}>Edit</button>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "outreach-form" })}>Add to the book</button>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Shipped &amp; Revenue ledger</p>
        {data.ledger.slice(0, 40).map((entry) => (
          <div key={entry.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
            <span className={`nb-sdot ${entry.status === "paid" ? "nb-g" : "nb-a"}`} />
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <div className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14.5 }}>{entry.whatShipped}</div>
              <div className="nb-meta">{entry.clientLabel || "No client named"} · shipped {entry.shippedDate}{entry.method ? ` · ${entry.method}` : ""}</div>
            </div>
            <Badge tone={entry.status === "paid" ? "green" : "amber"}>{money(entry.amountCents)} {entry.status.toUpperCase()}</Badge>
            <button type="button" className="nb-mini" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "ledger-form", entryId: entry.id })}>Edit</button>
            {confirmDel === `ledger-${entry.id}`
              ? <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`ledger-del-${entry.id}`, () => api.delete_ledger_entry({ id: entry.id }), "Ledger entry deleted.")}>Confirm</button>
              : <button type="button" className="nb-mini nb-danger" onClick={() => setConfirmDel(`ledger-${entry.id}`)}>Delete</button>}
          </div>
        ))}
        {data.ledger.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">Nothing has shipped yet — the first delivery opens the ledger.</p>}
        <div className="nb-inline-actions" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "ledger-form" })}>Add a ledger entry</button>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">Activity — the office log</p>
        <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
          {data.log.slice(0, 30).map((line) => (
            <div key={line.id} className="nb-logline"><span className="nb-logtime">{formatWaitingStamp(line.t)}</span>{line.text}</div>
          ))}
          {data.log.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">The log is quiet.</p>}
        </div>
      </article>

      <article className="nb-card">
        <p className="nb-eyebrow">The classic office</p>
        <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>The previous interface — floor maps, the region editor, every original surface — is untouched and fully working.</p>
        <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}><button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.onOpenClassic}>Open the classic office</button></div>
      </article>
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHEETS — every form and piece viewer, in the design's sheet language
// (verdict first, actions, then the work).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function SheetShell({ title, eyebrow, onClose, children }: { title: string; eyebrow: string; onClose: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "Escape") onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [onClose]);
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" className="nb-scrim" aria-label="Close panel" onClick={onClose} />
      <aside className="nb-sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title}>
        <button type="button" className="nb-closex" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close panel">×</button>
        <p className="nb-eyebrow"><span className="nb-tick">▸</span> {eyebrow}</p>
        <h2 className="nb-verdict" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{title}</h2>
        {children}
      </aside>
    </>
  );
}

const JOB_TYPES = ["standard", "research", "x_posts", "perfectly_paranoid", "market_briefing", "creative_package", "client_report"] as const;

function NewJobSheet({ ctx, clientId }: { ctx: Ctx; clientId?: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [jobType, setJobType] = useState<typeof JOB_TYPES[number]>("standard");
  const [postCount, setPostCount] = useState(3);
  const [gatheringMode, setGatheringMode] = useState<"standard" | "tiered">("standard");
  const [forClient, setForClient] = useState(clientId ?? "");
  const [angle, setAngle] = useState("");
  const submit = async () => {
    const ok = await ctx.run("create-work", () => api.create_work({
      title: title.trim(), notes, jobType,
      ...(jobType === "x_posts" ? { postCount } : {}),
      ...(jobType === "research" ? { gatheringMode } : {}),
      clientId: forClient ? forClient : null,
    }), "Job created — the crew is moving.");
    if (ok) ctx.closeSheet();
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title="New job" eyebrow="Create work" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Give the crew a job. Remmy divides it into steps and the right people pick it up.</p>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>What needs doing</span><input className="nb-input" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="The job, in one line" aria-label="Job title" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>The brief</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="Everything the crew needs to know" aria-label="Job brief" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Kind of job</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={jobType} onChange={(e) => setJobType(e.target.value as typeof JOB_TYPES[number])} aria-label="Kind of job">
          {JOB_TYPES.map((type) => <option key={type} value={type}>{JOB_TYPE_LABELS[type]}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      {jobType === "x_posts" && (
        <label className="nb-field"><span>How many posts</span>
          <select className="nb-select" value={postCount} onChange={(e) => setPostCount(Number(e.target.value))} aria-label="How many X posts">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
      )}
      {jobType === "research" && (
        <label className="nb-field"><span>Gathering mode</span>
          <select className="nb-select" value={gatheringMode} onChange={(e) => setGatheringMode(e.target.value as "standard" | "tiered")} aria-label="Gathering mode">
            <option value="standard">Standard — gather as usual</option>
            <option value="tiered">Tiered — chase secondary finds to their primary source first</option>
          </select>
          <span className="nb-meta" style={{ marginTop: 6, display: "block" }}>Tiered changes gathering only — checking, grading, and the brief work the same either way. Run the same question twice, once per mode, to compare them in the job's Breakdown.</span>
        </label>
      )}
      <label className="nb-field"><span>For a client (optional)</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={forClient} onChange={(e) => setForClient(e.target.value)} aria-label="Client for this job">
          <option value="">No client — house work</option>
          {data.clients.map((client) => <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>{client.businessName}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !title.trim()} onClick={() => void submit()}>Create the job</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>

      <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 26 }}>Or start a preset</p>
      {data.presets.map((preset) => (
        <div key={preset.id} className="nb-rowitem" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
          <span className="nb-sdot nb-b" />
          <div style={{ flex: 1 }}><div className="nb-nm" style={{ fontSize: 14.5 }}>{preset.name}</div><div className="nb-meta">{JOB_TYPE_LABELS[preset.jobType] ?? preset.jobType}{preset.fillInLabel ? ` · needs its ${preset.fillInLabel}` : ""}</div></div>
          <button type="button" className="nb-mini" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => preset.fillInLabel ? ctx.openSheet({ kind: "preset-start", presetId: preset.id }) : void ctx.run(`preset-start-${preset.id}`, () => api.start_preset({ id: preset.id }), `Preset “${preset.name}” started.`).then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Start</button>
        </div>
      ))}
      {data.presets.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">No presets saved yet — they live in Ops.</p>}

      <p className="nb-eyebrow" style={{ marginTop: 26 }}>Perfectly Paranoid — quick story job</p>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>An angle (optional)</span><input className="nb-input" value={angle} onChange={(e) => setAngle(e.target.value)} placeholder="Leave blank and Tom finds a story" aria-label="Story angle" /></label>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("pp-start-sheet", () => api.start_perfectly_paranoid_pipeline({ angle: angle.trim(), clientId: forClient ? forClient : null }), "Story job started.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Start the story pipeline</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function SendBackSheet({ ctx, taskId }: { ctx: Ctx; taskId: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const task = data.tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState("");
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<"copy" | "image" | "research">("copy");
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState("");
  if (!task) return null;
  const submit = async () => {
    const ok = await ctx.run(`sendback-${task.id}`, () => api.send_back_task({ id: task.id, feedback: feedback.trim(), target, ...(assignee ? { assigneeId: assignee as typeof CREW_IDS[number] } : {}) }), "Sent back — the same job moved back to Working.");
    if (ok) ctx.closeSheet();
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title="Send it back" eyebrow={task.title} onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Say plainly what is wrong and what done looks like. Only the part you pick gets replaced — everything else in the package stays exactly as it was.</p>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>What needs to change</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={feedback} onChange={(e) => setFeedback(e.target.value)} aria-label="Rework feedback" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Which part</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={target} onChange={(e) => setTarget(e.target.value as "copy" | "image" | "research")} aria-label="Part to rework">
          <option value="copy">The copy</option>
          <option value="image">The image</option>
          <option value="research">The research</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Who reworks it (optional)</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={assignee} onChange={(e) => setAssignee(e.target.value)} aria-label="Crew member for the rework">
          <option value="">The usual owner of that part</option>
          {CREW_IDS.map((id) => <option key={id} value={id}>{memberName(id)}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !feedback.trim()} onClick={() => void submit()}>Send back for rework</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function DeleteTaskSheet({ ctx, taskId }: { ctx: Ctx; taskId: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const task = data.tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
  if (!task) return null;
  return (
    <SheetShell title="Delete this job?" eyebrow="A wrong result is deleted, not kept" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>“{task.title}” — the job, its steps, and its finished files are removed for good. Nothing is left in Deliverables or Done.</p>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`delete-${task.id}`, () => api.delete_task({ id: task.id }), "Job deleted — nothing of it is kept.").then((ok) => { if (ok) { ctx.closeSheet(); } })}>Delete it</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Keep it</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function AnswerSheet({ ctx, blockerId }: { ctx: Ctx; blockerId: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const blocker = data.blockers.find((b) => b.id === blockerId);
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
  const [evidence, setEvidence] = useState("");
  if (!blocker) return null;
  const task = data.tasks.find((t) => t.id === blocker.taskId);
  return (
    <SheetShell title={blocker.kind === "browser_action" ? "A gate only you can clear" : "The crew needs your call"} eyebrow={task ? task.title : "Blocker"} onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <p className="nb-verdict" style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>{blocker.question}</p>
      <p className="nb-stamp">{memberName(blocker.memberId)} asked · {formatWaitingStamp(blocker.createdAt)}</p>
      {blocker.kind === "decision" ? (
        <>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Your answer — it restarts the step</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={answer} onChange={(e) => setAnswer(e.target.value)} aria-label="Your answer to the crew" /></label>
          <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !answer.trim()} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`answer-${blocker.id}`, () => api.resolve_blocker({ id: blocker.id, answer: answer.trim() }), "Answer sent — the step is resuming.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Send the answer</button>
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Not yet</button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {blocker.verificationInstructions && <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>{blocker.verificationInstructions}</p>}
          {blocker.verificationStatus === "checking" ? (
            <>
              <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>The gate is being checked. If it is clear now, confirm with what you saw; if it is still blocked, say so and the job stays waiting.</p>
              <label className="nb-field"><span>What you saw</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={evidence} onChange={(e) => setEvidence(e.target.value)} aria-label="Gate verification evidence" /></label>
              <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
                <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !evidence.trim()} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`gate-clear-${blocker.id}`, () => api.confirm_blocker_verification({ blockerId: blocker.id, cleared: true, evidence: evidence.trim() }), "Gate verified clear — the step is queued.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Gate is clear</button>
                <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-danger" disabled={busy !== null || !evidence.trim()} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`gate-blocked-${blocker.id}`, () => api.confirm_blocker_verification({ blockerId: blocker.id, cleared: false, evidence: evidence.trim() }), "Noted — the job stays waiting on this gate.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Still blocked</button>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
              <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`gate-verify-${blocker.id}`, () => api.verify_blocker({ id: blocker.id }), "Done — the crew is queued to retry the step.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>I did it — check the gate</button>
              <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Not yet</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function PieceSheet({ ctx, taskId, path }: { ctx: Ctx; taskId: string; path: string }) {
  const deliverables = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["nb-deliverables", taskId],
    queryFn: () => api.get_task_deliverables({ taskId }),
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
  const item = deliverables.data?.items.find((i) => i.relativePath === path);
  const isWebPage = item ? /\.html?$/i.test(item.fileName) : false;
  const preview = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["nb-website-preview", taskId, path],
    queryFn: () => api.get_website_preview({ taskId, relativePath: path }),
    enabled: Boolean(item) && isWebPage,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
  if (!item) {
    return <SheetShell title="Loading the piece…" eyebrow="Deliverable" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}><p className="nb-note-line">One moment.</p></SheetShell>;
  }
  return (
    <SheetShell title={item.humanTitle || item.fileName} eyebrow="The work itself" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      {item.plainSummary && <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>{item.plainSummary}</p>}
      {item.provenance && <p className="nb-note-line" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{item.provenance.label}</p>}
      {item.kind === "image" && item.imageUrl && <img className="nb-workimg" src={item.imageUrl} alt={item.humanTitle || item.fileName} />}
      {item.kind === "video" && item.fileUrl && <video controls preload="metadata" src={item.fileUrl} style={{ width: "100%", marginTop: 14, borderRadius: 12 }} aria-label={item.humanTitle || item.fileName} />}
      {isWebPage && (preview.isLoading
        ? <p className="nb-note-line">Loading the page…</p>
        : preview.data && !preview.data.ok
          ? <p className="nb-note-line">{preview.data.error}</p>
          : preview.data
            ? <iframe className="nb-preview-frame" title={`${item.fileName} — finished website preview`} sandbox="" srcDoc={preview.data.html} />
            : null)}
      {item.text && (
        <div className="nb-letterbox">
          {item.text.split(/\n{2,}/).map((para, i) => <p key={i}>{para}</p>)}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        {item.text && <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={() => void copyText(item.text ?? "").then((ok) => ctx.toast(ok ? "Copied." : "Copy failed — select the text instead."))}>Copy the text</button>}
        {item.fileUrl && <a className="nb-btn nb-ghost" href={item.fileUrl} download={item.fileName} style={{ textDecoration: "none", display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center" }}>Download</a>}
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Close</button>
      </div>
      <p className="nb-stamp">{item.fileName} · {item.size < 1024 ? `${item.size} B` : item.size < 1024 * 1024 ? `${(item.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB` : `${(item.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`}</p>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// CREW MEMBER POP-UP — the personal pop-up the classic office opens
// when a crew member is clicked on the floor (its CrewOverlay), in this
// interface's sheet language: the member's identity and live badge,
// their current status and how long it has run, what they are working
// on, the stage track, their recent activity, and Create work for
// members who take briefs. It opens over the Office door; the floor
// stays exactly where it was underneath, and it never navigates.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function CrewMemberSheet({ ctx, member, floorStatus }: { ctx: Ctx; member: Member; floorStatus: FloorMemberStatus }) {
  const { data } = ctx;
  const tasks = data.tasks;
  const briefs = data.briefs;
  const log = data.log;
  const clock = ctx.floorClock;
  const liveBrief = briefs.find((brief) => brief.assignee === member.id && brief.status === "in_progress");
  const floorTask = floorStatus?.taskId ? tasks.find((task) => task.id === floorStatus.taskId) : undefined;
  const currentTask = floorTask ?? (liveBrief
    ? tasks.find((task) => task.id === liveBrief.taskId)
    : tasks.find((task) => task.assignee === member.id && task.status === "approval")
      ?? tasks.find((task) => task.assignee === member.id && task.status === "working"));
  const active = floorStatus?.active ?? liveBrief?.status === "in_progress";
  const title = floorStatus?.label ?? liveBrief?.title ?? currentTask?.title;
  const stage = crewStageFor(currentTask, liveBrief);
  const stageLabel = floorStatus?.label ?? stage.label;
  const statusBadge = floorStatus?.badge ?? (active ? "Live" : "Standby");
  const progress = stage.steps.length > 1 ? Math.round((stage.currentIndex / (stage.steps.length - 1)) * 100) : 0;
  const startedAt = liveBrief?.updatedAt ?? currentTask?.created;
  const legacyName = Object.entries(LEGACY_MEMBER_NAMES).find(([, current]) => current === member.name)?.[0];
  const nameNeedles = [member.name, legacyName].filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value)).map((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase());
  const activity = log.filter((entry) => nameNeedles.some((name) => entry.text.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(name))).slice(0, 4);
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" className="nb-scrim" aria-label={`Close ${member.name} card`} onClick={ctx.closeSheet} />
      <aside className="nb-sheet nb-crew-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`${member.name} live status`} data-current-status={stageLabel} style={{ "--member-color": member.color, "--crew-progress": `${progress}%` } as CSSProperties}>
        <button type="button" className="nb-closex" onClick={ctx.closeSheet} aria-label={`Close ${member.name} card`}>×</button>
        <header className="nb-crew-identity">
          <span className="nb-crew-beacon"><FloorMemberAvatar member={member} />{active && <i aria-hidden="true" />}</span>
          <div>
            <small>{member.role}</small>
            <h2>{member.name}</h2>
            <span className={active ? "nb-crew-chip" : "nb-crew-chip nb-standby"}>{statusBadge}</span>
          </div>
        </header>

        <section className={active ? "nb-crew-console nb-active" : "nb-crew-console"} aria-label={`${member.name} progress`}>
          <div className="nb-crew-dial" aria-hidden="true"><span><b>{stage.currentIndex + 1}</b><small>of {stage.steps.length}</small></span></div>
          <div className="nb-crew-console-copy"><span>Current status</span><b>{stageLabel}</b><small>{startedAt ? `${active ? "Active" : "Open"} for ${elapsedLabel(startedAt, clock)}` : active ? "Active now" : "No active clock"}</small></div>
          <div className="nb-crew-signal" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /><i /><i /></div>
        </section>

        {title ? (
          <section className="nb-crew-current" aria-label="Current activity">
            <span>{floorStatus ? "Current activity" : "Current brief"}</span><b>{title}</b>
            {floorStatus?.title && floorStatus.title !== title && <small>{floorStatus.title}</small>}
            {!floorStatus && liveBrief && <small>Picked up {formatStamp(liveBrief.updatedAt)}</small>}
          </section>
        ) : (
          <section className="nb-crew-current nb-empty-current" aria-label="Current activity"><span>Current activity</span><b>Standing by</b><small>{member.focus}</small></section>
        )}

        <ol className="nb-crew-track" aria-label={`Workflow progress: ${stageLabel}`}>
          {stage.steps.map((step, index) => (
            <li key={step} className={index < stage.currentIndex ? "nb-complete" : index === stage.currentIndex ? "nb-current" : "nb-upcoming"}>
              <i aria-hidden="true">{index < stage.currentIndex ? "✓" : index + 1}</i><span>{step}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>

        <section className="nb-crew-activity" aria-labelledby={`nb-crew-activity-${member.id}`}>
          <div className="nb-crew-panel-heading"><h3 id={`nb-crew-activity-${member.id}`}>Recent activity</h3><span>Auto-refreshes</span></div>
          {activity.length ? (
            <div className="nb-crew-activity-list">{activity.map((entry, index) => (
              <div key={entry.id} className="nb-crew-activity-item"><i className={index === 0 && active ? "nb-hot" : ""} aria-hidden="true" /><p><span>{displayMemberNames(entry.text)}</span><time>{formatStamp(entry.t)}</time></p></div>
            ))}</div>
          ) : <p className="nb-crew-no-activity">No activity milestone has been logged yet.</p>}
        </section>

        {!NON_ASSIGNABLE_MEMBER_IDS.has(member.id) && (
          <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-crew-assign" onClick={() => ctx.openSheet({ kind: "newjob" })}>Create work</button>
        )}
      </aside>
    </>
  );
}

function RemmySheet({ ctx, sessionId, setSessionId }: { ctx: Ctx; sessionId: string | null; setSessionId: (id: string | null) => void }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const briefing: Briefing | undefined = (sessionId ? data.remmyBriefings.find((b) => b.id === sessionId) : undefined)
    ?? data.remmyBriefings.find((b) => b.status !== "dispatched");
  const start = () => void ctx.run("remmy-start", async () => {
    const r = await api.start_remmy_briefing({});
    if (r.ok) { setSessionId(r.briefing.id); return { ok: true }; }
    return { ok: false, error: r.error };
  });
  const send = () => {
    if (!briefing || !draft.trim()) return;
    const text = draft.trim();
    setDraft("");
    void ctx.run("remmy-send", () => api.send_remmy_message({ sessionId: briefing.id, text, attachments: [] }));
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title="Ask Remmy" eyebrow="Briefing — talk it through, then Remmy shapes the job" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      {!briefing ? (
        <>
          <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Start a briefing thread. Tell Remmy what you need in plain words; he reads the whole thread, asks what's missing, and posts a shaped job back here for your go.</p>
          <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
            <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={start}>Start a briefing</button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="nb-chatlog">
            {briefing.messages.map((msg) => (
              <div key={msg.id} className={`nb-msg ${msg.role === "user" ? "nb-user" : "nb-remmy"}`}>
                {msg.text}
                {msg.attachments.length > 0 && <span className="nb-msg-meta">{msg.attachments.map((a) => a.fileName).join(" · ")}</span>}
                <span className="nb-msg-meta">{msg.role === "user" ? "You" : "Remmy"} · {formatWaitingStamp(msg.createdAt)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
            {briefing.messages.length === 0 && <p className="nb-note-line">No messages yet — say the first word below.</p>}
          </div>
          {briefing.shaped && (
            <article className="nb-card" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
              <p className="nb-eyebrow">Remmy's shaped job</p>
              <h3 className="nb-title">{briefing.shaped.title}</h3>
              <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{briefing.shaped.summary}</p>
              <p className="nb-note-line">{JOB_TYPE_LABELS[briefing.shaped.jobType] ?? briefing.shaped.jobType}{briefing.shaped.postCount ? ` · ${briefing.shaped.postCount} posts` : ""}</p>
            </article>
          )}
          {briefing.status === "dispatched" ? (
            <>
              <p className="nb-note-line">This briefing already went to the crew{briefing.taskTitle ? <> — “{briefing.taskTitle}”</> : ""}.</p>
              <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
                {briefing.taskId && <button type="button" className="nb-btn" onClick={() => { ctx.closeSheet(); ctx.go({ kind: "task", taskId: briefing.taskId as string, back: "decide" }); }}>Open the job</button>}
                <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={start}>New briefing</button>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <label className="nb-field"><span>Message Remmy</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} aria-label="Message to Remmy" placeholder="What do you need?" /></label>
              <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
                <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !draft.trim()} onClick={send}>Send</button>
                {(briefing.status === "open" || briefing.status === "awaiting_remmy") && (
                  <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("remmy-shape", () => api.request_remmy_shaping({ sessionId: briefing.id }), "Sent to Remmy — his summary will land in this thread.")}>Ask Remmy to shape it</button>
                )}
                {briefing.status === "shaped" && (
                  <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void ctx.run("remmy-dispatch", () => api.start_remmy_briefing_job({ sessionId: briefing.id }), "Dispatched — the crew is moving.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Send it to the crew</button>
                )}
              </div>
              {briefing.status === "awaiting_remmy" && <p className="nb-kbd-hint">With Remmy — he reads the thread and posts his reply and the shaped job here.</p>}
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function ClientFormSheet({ ctx, clientId }: { ctx: Ctx; clientId?: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const existing = clientId ? data.clients.find((c) => c.id === clientId) : undefined;
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState(existing?.businessName ?? "");
  const [approverName, setApproverName] = useState(existing?.approverName ?? "");
  const [platforms, setPlatforms] = useState(existing?.platforms ?? "");
  const [voiceNotes, setVoiceNotes] = useState(existing?.voiceNotes ?? "");
  const [photoStatus, setPhotoStatus] = useState<"provided" | "none" | "not_recorded">(existing?.photoLibraryStatus ?? "not_recorded");
  const [photoLocation, setPhotoLocation] = useState(existing?.photoLibraryLocation ?? "");
  const [showcase, setShowcase] = useState(existing?.showcasePermission ?? false);
  const [isTest, setIsTest] = useState(existing?.isTest ?? false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"prospect" | "pilot" | "retainer" | "paused">(existing?.status ?? "prospect");
  const [cadence, setCadence] = useState<"off" | "weekly" | "monthly">(existing?.reportCadence ?? "off");
  const payload = { businessName: businessName.trim(), approverName, platforms, voiceNotes, photoLibraryStatus: photoStatus, photoLibraryLocation: photoLocation, showcasePermission: showcase, isTest, status, reportCadence: cadence };
  const submit = async () => {
    const ok = existing
      ? await ctx.run(`client-edit-${existing.id}`, () => api.update_client({ id: existing.id, ...payload }), "Client saved.")
      : await ctx.run("client-create", () => api.create_client(payload), "Client added to the registry.");
    if (ok) ctx.closeSheet();
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title={existing ? "Edit client" : "Add a client"} eyebrow="Client registry" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Business name</span><input className="nb-input" value={businessName} onChange={(e) => setBusinessName(e.target.value)} aria-label="Business name" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Who approves their work</span><input className="nb-input" value={approverName} onChange={(e) => setApproverName(e.target.value)} aria-label="Approver name" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Platforms</span><input className="nb-input" value={platforms} onChange={(e) => setPlatforms(e.target.value)} placeholder="Facebook, website…" aria-label="Platforms" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Voice notes — how they sound</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={voiceNotes} onChange={(e) => setVoiceNotes(e.target.value)} aria-label="Client voice notes" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Photo library</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={photoStatus} onChange={(e) => setPhotoStatus(e.target.value as typeof photoStatus)} aria-label="Photo library status">
          <option value="not_recorded">Not recorded</option>
          <option value="provided">Provided</option>
          <option value="none">They have none</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Photo library location</span><input className="nb-input" value={photoLocation} onChange={(e) => setPhotoLocation(e.target.value)} aria-label="Photo library location" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Status</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as typeof status)} aria-label="Client status">
          <option value="prospect">Prospect</option>
          <option value="pilot">Pilot</option>
          <option value="retainer">Retainer</option>
          <option value="paused">Paused</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Client reports</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={cadence} onChange={(e) => setCadence(e.target.value as typeof cadence)} aria-label="Report cadence">
          <option value="off">Off</option>
          <option value="weekly">Weekly</option>
          <option value="monthly">Monthly</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="nb-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={showcase} onChange={(e) => setShowcase(e.target.checked)} /> They allow their work in the showcase</label>
      <label className="nb-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={isTest} onChange={(e) => setIsTest(e.target.checked)} /> Test client — real business, simulated relationship, never contacted</label>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !businessName.trim()} onClick={() => void submit()}>{existing ? "Save client" : "Add client"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function LedgerFormSheet({ ctx, entryId }: { ctx: Ctx; entryId?: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const existing = entryId ? data.ledger.find((e) => e.id === entryId) : undefined;
  const today = new Date();
  const todayStr = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  const [shippedDate, setShippedDate] = useState(todayStr);
  const [whatShipped, setWhatShipped] = useState("");
  const [clientId, setClientId] = useState("");
  const [clientLabel, setClientLabel] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(existing?.amountCents !== null && existing?.amountCents !== undefined ? String(existing.amountCents / 100) : "");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"owed" | "paid">(existing?.status ?? "owed");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState(existing?.method ?? "");
  const [note, setNote] = useState(existing?.note ?? "");
  const amountCents = amount.trim() === "" ? null : Math.round(Number(amount) * 100);
  const submit = async () => {
    const ok = existing
      ? await ctx.run(`ledger-edit-${existing.id}`, () => api.update_ledger_entry({ id: existing.id, amountCents, status, method, note }), "Ledger entry saved.")
      : await ctx.run("ledger-add", () => api.add_ledger_entry({ shippedDate, clientId: clientId ? clientId : null, clientLabel, whatShipped: whatShipped.trim(), amountCents, status, method, note }), "Ledger entry added.");
    if (ok) ctx.closeSheet();
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title={existing ? "Edit ledger entry" : "Add a ledger entry"} eyebrow="Shipped & Revenue" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      {existing ? (
        <>
          <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{existing.whatShipped} — {existing.clientLabel || "no client named"} · shipped {existing.shippedDate}. Amounts and payment state are yours alone to record.</p>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Date shipped</span><input className="nb-input" type="date" value={shippedDate} onChange={(e) => setShippedDate(e.target.value)} aria-label="Date shipped" /></label>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>What shipped</span><input className="nb-input" value={whatShipped} onChange={(e) => setWhatShipped(e.target.value)} aria-label="What shipped" /></label>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Client (from the registry)</span>
            <select className="nb-select" value={clientId} onChange={(e) => setClientId(e.target.value)} aria-label="Ledger client">
              <option value="">No registry client</option>
              {data.clients.map((client) => <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>{client.businessName}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          {!clientId && <label className="nb-field"><span>Client name (free text)</span><input className="nb-input" value={clientLabel} onChange={(e) => setClientLabel(e.target.value)} aria-label="Client name for the ledger" /></label>}
        </>
      )}
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Amount (dollars)</span><input className="nb-input" inputMode="decimal" value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder="50.00" aria-label="Amount in dollars" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Payment state</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as typeof status)} aria-label="Payment state">
          <option value="owed">Owed</option>
          <option value="paid">Paid</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>How they paid</span><input className="nb-input" value={method} onChange={(e) => setMethod(e.target.value)} placeholder="e-transfer, cash…" aria-label="Payment method" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Note</span><input className="nb-input" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} aria-label="Ledger note" /></label>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || (!existing && !whatShipped.trim())} onClick={() => void submit()}>{existing ? "Save entry" : "Add entry"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

const OUTREACH_CHANNELS = ["Contact form", "Email", "Facebook DM", "In person", "Inbound"] as const;
const OUTREACH_GROUPS = ["Founding seven", "Pack 1", "Pack 2", "Pack 3", "Mockup pitches", "Inbound"] as const;
function OutreachFormSheet({ ctx, contactId }: { ctx: Ctx; contactId?: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const existing = contactId ? data.outreach.find((c) => c.id === contactId) : undefined;
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState(existing?.businessName ?? "");
  const [town, setTown] = useState(existing?.town ?? "");
  const [channel, setChannel] = useState<typeof OUTREACH_CHANNELS[number]>(existing?.channel ?? "Contact form");
  const [group, setGroup] = useState<typeof OUTREACH_GROUPS[number]>(existing?.group ?? "Pack 1");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<typeof OUTREACH_STATUSES[number]>(existing?.status ?? "Waiting");
  const [note, setNote] = useState(existing?.note ?? "");
  const [followUp, setFollowUp] = useState(existing?.followUp ?? false);
  const [followUpNote, setFollowUpNote] = useState(existing?.followUpNote ?? "");
  const submit = async () => {
    const ok = existing
      ? await ctx.run(`outreach-edit-${existing.id}`, () => api.update_outreach_contact({ id: existing.id, status, note, followUp, followUpNote }), "Outreach row saved.")
      : await ctx.run("outreach-add", () => api.add_outreach_contact({ businessName: businessName.trim(), town, channel, group, status, note, followUp, followUpNote }), "Added to the outreach book.");
    if (ok) ctx.closeSheet();
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title={existing ? existing.businessName : "Add to the outreach book"} eyebrow="Outreach Book" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      {!existing && (
        <>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Business name</span><input className="nb-input" value={businessName} onChange={(e) => setBusinessName(e.target.value)} aria-label="Outreach business name" /></label>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Town</span><input className="nb-input" value={town} onChange={(e) => setTown(e.target.value)} aria-label="Outreach town" /></label>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Channel</span>
            <select className="nb-select" value={channel} onChange={(e) => setChannel(e.target.value as typeof channel)} aria-label="Outreach channel">
              {OUTREACH_CHANNELS.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Batch</span>
            <select className="nb-select" value={group} onChange={(e) => setGroup(e.target.value as typeof group)} aria-label="Outreach batch">
              {OUTREACH_GROUPS.map((g) => <option key={g} value={g}>{g}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
        </>
      )}
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Status</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as typeof status)} aria-label="Outreach status">
          {OUTREACH_STATUSES.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Outcome note</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} aria-label="Outreach outcome note" /></label>
      <label className="nb-check"><input type="checkbox" checked={followUp} onChange={(e) => setFollowUp(e.target.checked)} /> Needs a follow-up</label>

      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || (!existing && !businessName.trim())} onClick={() => void submit()}>{existing ? "Save row" : "Add to the book"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
