}

function OrderFormSheet({ ctx, orderId }: { ctx: Ctx; orderId?: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const existing = orderId ? data.standingOrders.find((o) => o.id === orderId) : undefined;
  const [instruction, setInstruction] = useState(existing?.instruction ?? "");
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState(existing?.assignee ?? "ledger");
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"scheduled" | "pipeline">(existing?.mode ?? "scheduled");
  const [cadence, setCadence] = useState<"daily" | "weekly">(existing?.cadence ?? "daily");
  const [weekday, setWeekday] = useState(existing?.weekday ?? 1);
  const [hour, setHour] = useState(existing?.scheduleHour ?? 9);
  const [minute, setMinute] = useState(existing?.scheduleMinute ?? 0);
  const submit = async () => {
    const ok = existing
      ? await ctx.run(`order-edit-${existing.id}`, () => api.update_standing_order({ id: existing.id, instruction: instruction.trim() }), "Standing order saved.")
      : await ctx.run("order-create", () => api.create_standing_order({ instruction: instruction.trim(), assigneeId: assignee as typeof CREW_IDS[number] | "remmy", mode, ...(mode === "scheduled" ? { cadence, ...(cadence === "weekly" ? { weekday } : {}), scheduleHour: hour, scheduleMinute: minute } : {}) }), "Standing order armed.");
    if (ok) ctx.closeSheet();
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title={existing ? "Edit standing order" : "New standing order"} eyebrow="Standing orders" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>The order — what runs, in plain words</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={instruction} onChange={(e) => setInstruction(e.target.value)} aria-label="Standing order instruction" /></label>
      {!existing && (
        <>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>Crew member</span>
            <select className="nb-select" value={assignee} onChange={(e) => setAssignee(e.target.value)} aria-label="Standing order crew member">
              {["remmy", ...CREW_IDS].map((id) => <option key={id} value={id}>{memberName(id)}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="nb-field"><span>How it runs</span>
            <select className="nb-select" value={mode} onChange={(e) => setMode(e.target.value as typeof mode)} aria-label="Standing order mode">
              <option value="scheduled">On a schedule</option>
              <option value="pipeline">As a pipeline stage</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          {mode === "scheduled" && (
            <>
              <label className="nb-field"><span>Cadence</span>
                <select className="nb-select" value={cadence} onChange={(e) => setCadence(e.target.value as typeof cadence)} aria-label="Standing order cadence">
                  <option value="daily">Daily</option>
                  <option value="weekly">Weekly</option>
                </select>
              </label>
              {cadence === "weekly" && (
                <label className="nb-field"><span>Weekday</span>
                  <select className="nb-select" value={weekday} onChange={(e) => setWeekday(Number(e.target.value))} aria-label="Standing order weekday">
                    {["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"].map((day, i) => <option key={day} value={i}>{day}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </label>
              )}
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10 }}>
                <label className="nb-field" style={{ flex: 1 }}><span>Hour</span><input className="nb-input" type="number" min={0} max={23} value={hour} onChange={(e) => setHour(Number(e.target.value))} aria-label="Standing order hour" /></label>
                <label className="nb-field" style={{ flex: 1 }}><span>Minute</span><input className="nb-input" type="number" min={0} max={59} value={minute} onChange={(e) => setMinute(Number(e.target.value))} aria-label="Standing order minute" /></label>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {existing && <p className="nb-note-line">Schedule and crew stay as armed — this edits the order's words. Runs go straight to Done; creating the order was the approval.</p>}
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || instruction.trim().length < 3} onClick={() => void submit()}>{existing ? "Save order" : "Arm the order"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

const PRESET_JOB_TYPES = ["standard", "research", "x_posts", "perfectly_paranoid"] as const;
function PresetFormSheet({ ctx, presetId }: { ctx: Ctx; presetId?: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const existing = presetId ? data.presets.find((p) => p.id === presetId) : undefined;
  const [name, setName] = useState(existing?.name ?? "");
  const [jobType, setJobType] = useState<typeof PRESET_JOB_TYPES[number]>((existing?.jobType as typeof PRESET_JOB_TYPES[number]) ?? "standard");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(existing?.title ?? "");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(existing?.notes ?? "");
  const [postCount, setPostCount] = useState(existing?.postCount ?? 3);
  const [fillInLabel, setFillInLabel] = useState(existing?.fillInLabel ?? "");
  const payload = { name: name.trim(), jobType, title: title.trim(), notes, ...(jobType === "x_posts" ? { postCount } : {}), fillInLabel: fillInLabel.trim() ? fillInLabel.trim() : null };
  const submit = async () => {
    const ok = existing
      ? await ctx.run(`preset-edit-${existing.id}`, () => api.update_preset({ id: existing.id, ...payload }), "Preset saved.")
      : await ctx.run("preset-create", () => api.create_preset(payload), "Preset saved — it starts only when you click Start.");
    if (ok) ctx.closeSheet();
  };
  return (
    <SheetShell title={existing ? "Edit preset" : "New preset"} eyebrow="Presets — one-tap jobs" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Preset name</span><input className="nb-input" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} aria-label="Preset name" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Kind of job</span>
        <select className="nb-select" value={jobType} onChange={(e) => setJobType(e.target.value as typeof jobType)} aria-label="Preset job kind">
          {PRESET_JOB_TYPES.map((type) => <option key={type} value={type}>{JOB_TYPE_LABELS[type]}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Job title — use {"{{fill-in}}"} where the fill-in goes</span><input className="nb-input" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} aria-label="Preset job title" /></label>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>The brief</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} aria-label="Preset brief" /></label>
      {jobType === "x_posts" && (
        <label className="nb-field"><span>How many posts</span>
          <select className="nb-select" value={postCount} onChange={(e) => setPostCount(Number(e.target.value))} aria-label="Preset post count">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
      )}
      <label className="nb-field"><span>Fill-in label (optional — what you type at Start)</span><input className="nb-input" value={fillInLabel} onChange={(e) => setFillInLabel(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. the business name" aria-label="Preset fill-in label" /></label>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !name.trim() || !title.trim()} onClick={() => void submit()}>{existing ? "Save preset" : "Save preset"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function PresetStartSheet({ ctx, presetId }: { ctx: Ctx; presetId: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const preset = data.presets.find((p) => p.id === presetId);
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  if (!preset) return null;
  return (
    <SheetShell title={preset.name} eyebrow="Start a preset" onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{preset.title}</p>
      {preset.fillInLabel && (
        <label className="nb-field"><span>{preset.fillInLabel}</span><input className="nb-input" value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} aria-label={preset.fillInLabel} /></label>
      )}
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || (Boolean(preset.fillInLabel) && !value.trim())} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`preset-start-${preset.id}`, () => api.start_preset({ id: preset.id, ...(preset.fillInLabel ? { fillInValue: value.trim() } : {}) }), `Preset “${preset.name}” started — the crew is moving.`).then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Start it</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

function PackageReworkSheet({ ctx, packageId }: { ctx: Ctx; packageId: string }) {
  const { data, busy } = ctx;
  const pkg = data.packages.find((p) => p.id === packageId);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState("");
  if (!pkg) return null;
  return (
    <SheetShell title="Send the package back" eyebrow={pkg.title} onClose={ctx.closeSheet}>
      <p className="nb-sub" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Maria takes the package back and the work is redone against your words. Say what is wrong and what done looks like.</p>
      <label className="nb-field"><span>What needs to change</span><textarea className="nb-textarea" value={feedback} onChange={(e) => setFeedback(e.target.value)} aria-label="Package rework feedback" /></label>
      <div className="nb-sheet-actions">
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn" disabled={busy !== null || !feedback.trim()} onClick={() => void ctx.run(`pkg-rework-${pkg.id}`, () => api.rework_delivery_package({ id: pkg.id, feedback: feedback.trim() }), "Package sent back — Maria is on the rework.").then((ok) => { if (ok) ctx.closeSheet(); })}>Send back for rework</button>
        <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={ctx.closeSheet}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </SheetShell>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// ROOT — the shell: brand + Menu header, pill ask bar, the seven doors,
// sheets, toast, the floating + New job, and the dispatch heartbeat.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
export function NewApp({ onOpenClassic }: { onOpenClassic: () => void }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const state = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["office-state"],
    queryFn: () => api.get_state({}),
    refetchInterval: 5000,
  });
  // Populate World — the classic Clients view's active-client scoping:
  // the same scoped read the classic office runs, feeding only the
  // Deliverables Library and only while a client is active.
  const [activeClientId, setActiveClientId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const scopedState = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["office-state", "scoped", activeClientId],
    queryFn: () => api.get_state({ clientId: activeClientId ?? undefined }),
    enabled: Boolean(activeClientId),
    refetchInterval: activeClientId ? 5000 : false,
  });
  // The embedded floor's clock and inbox-arrival watch — the same
  // anchors the classic office hands its floor.
  const [floorClock, setFloorClock] = useState(new Date());
  const [inboxArrival, setInboxArrival] = useState<InboxArrival | null>(null);
  const seenTaskIds = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);
  const seenBriefIds = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>({ kind: "door", door: "decide" });
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<Sheet>(null);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toastMsg, setToastMsg] = useState("");
  const [askText, setAskText] = useState("");
  const [remmySessionId, setRemmySessionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toastTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const toast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMsg(msg);
    if (toastTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(toastTimer.current);
    toastTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setToastMsg(""), 4200);
  };
  const refresh = async () => { await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["office-state"] }); };
  const run: Ctx["run"] = async (_key, fn, okMsg) => {
    setBusy(_key);
    try {
      const result = await fn();
      if (result.ok) {
        if (okMsg) toast(okMsg);
      } else {
        toast(result.error ?? "That did not work. Try again.");
      }
      await refresh();
      return result.ok;
    } catch {
      toast("That did not work. Try again.");
      return false;
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  // The dispatch heartbeat: the same poll_dispatch the office runs on,
  // ticking quietly while this interface is open (and on the classic
  // office's behalf too — it is one shared backend).
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const tick = async () => {
      try {
        await api.poll_dispatch({});
        if (!cancelled) await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["office-state"] });
      } catch { /* the next tick tries again */ }
    };
    const initial = window.setTimeout(tick, 4000);
    const timer = window.setInterval(tick, 45_000);
    return () => { cancelled = true; window.clearTimeout(initial); window.clearInterval(timer); };
  }, [queryClient]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setFloorClock(new Date()), 30000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  // New-work arrivals for the embedded floor — the same seen-ids watch
  // the classic office runs, so a fresh brief sends the crew to the
  // inbox on the Office door's floor exactly as it does there.
  useEffect(() => {
    const latest = state.data;
    if (!latest) return;
    if (!seenTaskIds.current || !seenBriefIds.current) {
      seenTaskIds.current = new Set(latest.tasks.map((task) => task.id));
      seenBriefIds.current = new Set(latest.briefs.map((brief) => brief.id));
      return;
    }
    const newBriefs = latest.briefs.filter((brief) => !seenBriefIds.current?.has(brief.id));
    const visibleArrivalBriefs = newBriefs.filter((brief) => {
      const task = latest.tasks.find((item) => item.id === brief.taskId);
      return brief.stepIndex === 0 && !task?.standingOrderId;
    });
    const briefTaskIds = new Set(newBriefs.map((brief) => brief.taskId));
    const newTasks = latest.tasks.filter((task) => !seenTaskIds.current?.has(task.id) && !briefTaskIds.has(task.id) && !task.standingOrderId);
    latest.tasks.forEach((task) => seenTaskIds.current?.add(task.id));
    latest.briefs.forEach((brief) => seenBriefIds.current?.add(brief.id));
    const newestBrief = visibleArrivalBriefs[0];
    const newestTask = newTasks[0];
    const arrival = newestBrief
      ? { id: `brief:${newestBrief.id}`, assignee: newestBrief.assignee, title: newestBrief.title }
      : newestTask
        ? { id: `task:${newestTask.id}`, assignee: newestTask.assignee, title: newestTask.title }
        : undefined;
    if (!arrival) return;
    const arrivedFor = arrival.assignee === "walter" || arrival.assignee === "peter" || arrival.assignee === "olivia" || arrival.assignee === "astrid" ? "scout" : arrival.assignee;
    setInboxArrival({
      id: arrival.id,
      // Walter, Peter, Olivia, and Astrid work on the research floor;
      // Tom, head of research in both departments, is the one who checks
      // the main-office inbox for them. (The classic office's mapping.)
      memberId: (FLOOR_MEMBER_IDS.has(arrivedFor) ? arrivedFor : "remmy") as InboxArrival["memberId"],
      title: arrival.title,
    });
  }, [state.data]);

  // If the active client's record disappears (deleted in the registry),
  // the Populate World selection clears with it — the classic office's
  // guard, so a scoped view never points at a client who no longer exists.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeClientId && state.data && !state.data.clients.some((client) => client.id === activeClientId)) setActiveClientId(null);
  }, [activeClientId, state.data]);

  const data = state.data;
  // The floor's saved region map — the same call the classic office
  // makes on its state, so the embedded floor reads the saved floor
  // configuration, not the base map.
  if (data) setOfficeRegionData(data.floorMap.regionData);
  const blockedTaskIds = useMemo(() => new Set((data?.blockers ?? []).filter((b) => b.status === "open").map((b) => b.taskId)), [data]);
  const readyCount = useMemo(() => (data ? data.tasks.filter((t) => isReadyForYouTask(t, blockedTaskIds)).length : 0), [data, blockedTaskIds]);

  const ctx: Ctx = {
    data: data as OfficeState,
    busy,
    toast,
    run,
    go: (next) => { setView(next); setMenuOpen(false); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); },
    openSheet: (next) => setSheet(next),
    closeSheet: () => setSheet(null),
    onOpenClassic,
    floorClock,
    inboxArrival,
    onInboxArrivalHandled: (id) => setInboxArrival((current) => (current?.id === id ? null : current)),
    onFloorMemberOpen: (member, floorStatus) => {
      // Floor clicks behave exactly as they do in the classic office:
      // Remmy's sprite opens the Remmy briefing, and every other crew
      // member opens their own personal pop-up over the floor. A floor
      // click never navigates — the Work door is never a destination
      // from the map.
      if (member.id === "remmy") { setSheet({ kind: "remmy" }); return; }
      setSheet({ kind: "member", member, floorStatus });
    },
    activeClientId,
    scopedData: scopedState.data ?? null,
    onToggleActiveClient: (clientId) => setActiveClientId((current) => (current === clientId ? null : clientId)),
    onClearActiveClient: () => setActiveClientId(null),
  };

  const doorForView: Door = view.kind === "door" ? view.door : view.kind === "task" ? view.back : view.kind === "client" ? "clients" : "deliverables";

  const submitAsk = async () => {
    const text = askText.trim();
    if (!text) { setSheet({ kind: "remmy" }); return; }
    setAskText("");
    await run("ask-remmy", async () => {
      let sessionId = remmySessionId;
      const existing = data?.remmyBriefings.find((b) => b.status !== "dispatched");
      if (!sessionId && existing) sessionId = existing.id;
      if (!sessionId) {
        const started = await api.start_remmy_briefing({});
        if (!started.ok) return { ok: false, error: started.error };
        sessionId = started.briefing.id;
      }
      setRemmySessionId(sessionId);
      const sent = await api.send_remmy_message({ sessionId, text, attachments: [] });
      return sent.ok ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, error: sent.error };
    });
    setSheet({ kind: "remmy" });
  };

  return (
    <div className="nb-root" data-door={doorForView}>
      <div className="nb-wrap">
        <header className="nb-top">
          <div className="nb-brand"><span className="nb-pulse" />Pulse HQ</div>
          <button type="button" className="nb-menubtn" aria-label="Open the menu" aria-expanded={menuOpen} onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}>
            <span className="nb-burger" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></span>
            Menu
            {readyCount > 0 && <span className="nb-bdg" aria-label={`${readyCount} waiting on you`}>{readyCount}</span>}
          </button>
          {menuOpen && (
            <nav className="nb-menu" aria-label="Doors">
              {DOORS.map((door) => (
                <button key={door.id} type="button" className={doorForView === door.id && view.kind === "door" ? "nb-on" : ""} onClick={() => ctx.go({ kind: "door", door: door.id })}>
                  {door.label}
                  {door.id === "decide" && readyCount > 0 && <span className="nb-bdg">{readyCount}</span>}
                </button>
              ))}
              <div className="nb-menu-sep" />
              <button type="button" onClick={onOpenClassic}>Classic office — the previous interface</button>
            </nav>
          )}
        </header>

        <form className="nb-askbar" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void submitAsk(); }}>
          <input value={askText} onChange={(e) => setAskText(e.target.value)} type="text" placeholder="Ask Pulse HQ…" aria-label="Ask Pulse HQ" />
          <button className="nb-plus nb-askbtn" type="submit" aria-label={askText.trim() ? "Send to Remmy" : "Open the chat with Remmy"}>{askText.trim() ? "Send" : "Ask Remmy"}</button>
        </form>

        {!data ? (
          <section className="nb-view">
            <div className="nb-door-head">
              <p className="nb-eyebrow"><span className="nb-tick">▸</span> Pulse HQ</p>
              <h1 className="nb-answer" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{state.isError ? <>The office did not answer. <span className="nb-hl">Try again.</span></> : <>Opening the office…</>}</h1>
              {state.isError && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 16, display: "flex", gap: 10, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                  <button type="button" className="nb-btn" onClick={() => void state.refetch()}>Retry</button>
                  <button type="button" className="nb-btn nb-ghost" onClick={onOpenClassic}>Open the classic office</button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>
        ) : view.kind === "task" ? (
          <TaskView ctx={ctx} taskId={view.taskId} back={view.back} />
        ) : view.kind === "client" ? (
          <ClientView ctx={ctx} clientId={view.clientId} />
        ) : view.kind === "package" ? (
          <PackageView ctx={ctx} packageId={view.packageId} />
        ) : view.door === "decide" ? (
          <DecideDoor ctx={ctx} />
        ) : view.door === "office" ? (
          <OfficeDoor ctx={ctx} />
        ) : view.door === "work" ? (
          <WorkDoor ctx={ctx} />
        ) : view.door === "clients" ? (
          <ClientsDoor ctx={ctx} />
        ) : view.door === "deliverables" ? (
          <DeliverablesDoor ctx={ctx} />
        ) : view.door === "content" ? (
          <ContentDoor ctx={ctx} />
        ) : (
          <OpsDoor ctx={ctx} />
        )}
      </div>

      <button type="button" className="nb-newjob" aria-label="New job" onClick={() => setSheet({ kind: "newjob" })}>
        <span className="nb-plus-sign">+</span> New job
      </button>

      {sheet?.kind === "newjob" && data && <NewJobSheet ctx={ctx} clientId={sheet.clientId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "sendback" && data && <SendBackSheet ctx={ctx} taskId={sheet.taskId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "delete-task" && data && <DeleteTaskSheet ctx={ctx} taskId={sheet.taskId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "answer" && data && <AnswerSheet ctx={ctx} blockerId={sheet.blockerId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "remmy" && data && <RemmySheet ctx={ctx} sessionId={remmySessionId} setSessionId={setRemmySessionId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "client-form" && data && <ClientFormSheet ctx={ctx} clientId={sheet.clientId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "ledger-form" && data && <LedgerFormSheet ctx={ctx} entryId={sheet.entryId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "outreach-form" && data && <OutreachFormSheet ctx={ctx} contactId={sheet.contactId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "order-form" && data && <OrderFormSheet ctx={ctx} orderId={sheet.orderId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "preset-form" && data && <PresetFormSheet ctx={ctx} presetId={sheet.presetId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "preset-start" && data && <PresetStartSheet ctx={ctx} presetId={sheet.presetId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "package-rework" && data && <PackageReworkSheet ctx={ctx} packageId={sheet.packageId} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "piece" && data && <PieceSheet ctx={ctx} taskId={sheet.taskId} path={sheet.path} />}
      {sheet?.kind === "member" && data && <CrewMemberSheet ctx={ctx} member={sheet.member} floorStatus={sheet.floorStatus} />}

      {toastMsg && <div className="nb-toast" role="status">{toastMsg}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}
